songs.title: A LUNGSET LONGLOU
songs.author: Ngamminthang Guite
songs.lyrics:
A lungset longlou in tonsot in athoh e
Alungset longlou in keiding in athoh e
Ka hinna din athi’n, Athou kittai
Van gou lodin vankot eihontai

Verse 1
Pakai kadong in i-chan’a nei ngailut ham kati leh
Ka ngailutna hiven eiti’n cross chung’a ahinna alhatai

Verse 2
Ngaidam kachanna jouse hi kachih le thep vang hilou
Lungset sangpen kachan jalbou thina’a kon hinna kaneitai

Verse 3
Pa’n Ei lungsetna iti san hitam
Lei vanpao’a seijou hoi hilou
Ama bang’a Eilungset ding aumpoi
Ama bang’a Eilungset ding

songs.title: ABRAHAM ABRAHAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tona Pu Pa Tera le Abraham,
Chaldia gammun khopi minthang;
Abolnau gamnom chu dalha ding'in,
Pakai Pathen in Abraham chu akoutai.
"Abraham! Abraham! Katepna gam jonto
Katepna Canaan gam jontan tun!"
Abraham phatthei boh ding'a-
Pathen in akou chun
Halleluijah! Abraham akipan doh tai

Verse 2
Abraham in vang alhun nading gam chu,
Anop le hah ding aboi poi;
A neh le chah dingjong lungkham louvin,
Tahsan na jal in Gamtep chu ajontai.

Verse 3
Gamdang mite inn-doi sel-doi bang’a,
Kalhah joulou Chonset chom chom;
Tun kahung tai Doi le Aai lhim bang'a,
Kabol na gamlui dalha'n kahin jontai.
"Abraham! Abraham! Katepna gam jonto
Katepna Canaan gam jontan tun!"
Abraham phatthei boh ding'a-
Pathen in akou chun
Halleluijah! Abraham akipan doh tai....

songs.title: AHUNG LHUNGTAI KIPANA CHRISTMAS
songs.author: Apao Mate
songs.lyrics:
Ahung lhungtai kipa na Christmas chibai
Ahung lhungtai kipa na Christmas chibai

Agunglhung tai kipana Christmas
Lemchih ute lamchih ute
Ahunglhung tai kipa na Christmas
Lemchih ute lamchih ute

Malai Themgao ten ana seiju, Messiah hungpeng  ding nikho loupi chu
Mailai Themgao ten ana seiju,Messiah hungpeng ding nikholoupi chu
Tunin Bethlehem khopia aguilhung tai
Naosen lemnan lam'u hite
Tunin Bethlehem khopia aguilhung tai Naosen lem nan lam'u hite

Veuvin Pathen kelngoinou Jesu
Ahungpeng e gan ankong sunga
Veuvin Pathen kelngoinou Jesu
Ahung Peng e gan ankong sung a
Sopi nangle kei ding a kipana Christmas
Pakai lem nan lam'u hite
Sopi nangle kei ding a kipana Christmas
Pakai lem nan lam'u hite

songs.title: ANITINA THILPHA BOLDING
songs.author: Mangneo Haokip
songs.lyrics:
A nitina thilpha bolding
Kithopi ding angaicha ho
Leiya hinkho chomcha ding bou
Kabolthei chan tongpan tange

Hinkho nilhum ding koncha hi
Nisot louva kache teiding
Ka tohga hon eina lamto ding
Chunggam nilhum louna gam a

Tonsotna kem-lou hinkho chu
Anun nemin thengin aphai
Pakaiya dia saakhi hinan
Tongute chim tih neilouvin

Kholjinna gam ijot Lai hin
Pohgih kingai jang to ute
Jan muthim jong vah-a khelding
Ilam lhonga pahbang pah ding

songs.title: AW HE PHAT
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw he phat la hung um sot tapon tin
Mitheng lah tou nikho hunglhung ta le
Pate na insung mi akim nadeu vem?
Na chate lhagao hinna anei hi nam kikhol in
Mitheng lahtou pakai ang Ihun teng le
Na insung mi nakim soh deu hinam?
Phat um pet hin kisem phan na insung.

Verse 2
Psalm 127 : 03 na in hiti hin aseije
Ven chate hi pakaija kon gou ahi
Naobu sung'a pengdoh jong kipaman ahiye

Verse 3
Pakaiyin napeh na goulu tah chu
Niseh in Pakai ang'a pedoh jing in
Chingthei jin na chate ve pha jing in
Pakai thuhil in a chonna ding dol in khou khah in
Phat um pet hin kisem phan na insung.

songs.title: AW KA INNEIPU
songs.author: Goukhoseim Gangte
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sun nitin phat chejing in,
Damlai ni beiding koncha .
Navang lim kabel o ka inneipu deitah.
Nachate chengtoh naji lungmol hi hinna lampi najotpi lou dingham?.

Chorus
Lei loupinaho kalhengchompoi,
Haosat naho jong kalheng deh poi,
Pakai lunglheina innsunga  akimpou le.
Agamnom in beini neitalou ding vangam noma .aw elal lukhuh jemhoi ding hochu echa te cheng hinte.

Verse 2
Aw zion khopi tonglam kotpi chu kagal dot le,
Aw ka inn neipu e chateng cheng kimlouin zion chaten kimna la asah teng, lungmong in kimna la e sa ngam nadem?.

Verse 3
Edamlai sung nilhum kon, khenna elhun ding koncha ,
Lungtheng aw nemin nitin inn neipun junglang, nachate chengtoh naji lungmol hi kikhen louna gam a neipui lut un.

songs.title: AW KHANGDONG
songs.author: Kamkholun Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Minu chanei khel atam ngei
Mipa chapa neikhel atam
Christa toh khanghoi lai mang khom lou
Minu mipa lhiso khum khangdong
Aw kingai to phat hilou ham?
Aw khang dong khang hoi lai
Phat hoilai hatlai hoilai
Nilim kihei bang hinkho nanei sung hin
Nasempa gel doh jing jeng in

Verse 2
Nile phat hi hung kikhel ding
Hatlai hoilai jong che mang ding
Phat in koima ngah lou ding nang jong
Aw khangdong na hinkho hoilai in
Na sempa gel doh jing jeng in

Verse 3
Christa toh hing khom o khangdong
Minu mipa pachat khangdong
Pakai Pathen pachat aw khangdong
Asem Pa ging jing khangdong hochu
Songmantam sanga manlujo
Aw khang dong khang hoi lai

songs.title: AW NGAILUTNA
songs.author: L S Mangboi Lhungdim
songs.lyrics:
Aw ngailutna  ka gam uvai hom tan
kilung khatna le chamnan vaihomto
U-tu Pa-cha kah-a ki hetkhelna ho
Pailha pumkhat kahi theina diuvin

Ngailut nan ei kankhom tao hen
Lungkhatnan ei huikhom taovin
Ka kilungdou nau hi mangloi hen ,
Lungkhatna kolni hungsoh loiyo

Nam le nam jat le jat  ki khenna ho,
Hung mang Loiyo ka gamsung uvah hin,
Alen alal aching athem kichu nan
Ka jotnau gam ka lhungjou tapouve

Phung le Chang a ka kikhen telnau ho
Upa neo jo-a ka kiboi nau hou Jong
Ka nampi diuva apha chom ding hilou
Kipumkhat nan zalengam  eilhut diu

Nam ngailu nahi le najat mi ngailu'n
Phung ngailu nahi le na sopi ngailu'n
Ngailutna nei lou chu ahom keu ahi
Asempa Pathen doujing mihem ahi

songs.title: AW NGAILUTNA
songs.author: LS. Mangboi Lhungdim
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw ngailutna ka gam uvai hom tan,
Kilung khatna le chamnan vaihomto;
U-tu Pa-cha kah-a ki hetkhelna ho,
Pailha pumkhat kahi theina diuvin.

Chorus
Ngailut nan ei kankhom tao hen,
Lungkhatnan ei huikhom taovin;
Ka kilungdou nau hi mangloi hen ,
Lungkhatna kolni hungsoh loiyo.

Verse 2
Nam le nam jat le jat ki khenna ho,
Hung mang Loiyo ka gamsung uvah hin;
Alen alal aching athem kichu nan,
Ka jotnau gam ka lhungjou tapouve.

Verse 3
Phung le Chang a ka kikhen telnau ho,
Upa neo jo-a ka kiboi nau hou Jong;
Ka nampi diuva apha chom ding hilou,
Kipumkhat nan zalengam eilhut diu.

Verse 4
Nam ngailu nahi le najat mi ngailu'n,
Phung ngailu nahi le na sopi ngailu'n;
Ngailutna nei lou chu ahom keu ahi,
Asempa Pathen doujing mihem ahi.
Ngailut nan ei kankhom tao hen,
Lungkhatnan ei huikhom taovin;
Ka kilungdou nau hi mangloi hen ,
Lungkhatna kolni hungsoh loiyo.

songs.title: AW PAKAI NAGAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalei hinkho phat chomcha sung’a hin,
Twimei le pahcha bang ka hinkho;
Nilim kiheibang bep hinkho hi,
Kaki ngailutnao hin khan sah jing in.

Chorus
Aw pakai nagam ka hunglhung masang seuvin,
Na houbung mite nei suhal jing un;
Nei thahsem kit uvin nagam theng’a ding in,
Aw lal Immanuel Immanuel.

Verse 2
Ka chennao chonset mun ahin pakai,
Ka khelnao nei ngaidam uvin hepa;
Lhepna a kalhah lou na deuvin,
Nei dinpi jing un o Immanuel.

Verse 3
Lung’a gelchim theilou pakai nagam,
Sana khopi  chu hinjon kahiuve;
Tahsan te mun ding aloupi e,
Mulouva  tahsan lhan nunnom ahi.

Verse 4
Na lui pul’a na thah noukit bang in,
Hinkho lui dalha’a hinkho thah a;
Nou jing hen pakai na houbung hi,
Luipang hing jing thingphung nei bahsah un.

songs.title: Atheng Atheng  (Revelation Song)
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi & Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kelngoinu thi-sa a loupi, atheng atheng Ama
Lathah saote, vanlal touna tou
Van Kelngoinou adin (2X)

Chorus
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng
Pathen thahat chungnungpen
Auma aumsa leh hung kiding
Thilsem jouse toh sange Thangvah in lengho leng
Nang keidia ijakai Ken nang choi an inge

Verse 2
Lal loupinan Na kijem e Kolphe vah leh van kithin bangin
Pathei leh Jana Thahat, lou pi naho jouse
Nangbou chih na leng Pakai

Verse 3
Loupi Nadim thupi na dim Namin akiphah jong leh
Jesu, namin thahat pen Ka hin na huileh tuihing
Mihem chihnan kholdoh joulou

Bridge
Yeah...

songs.title: CHOI AT DIA LOM
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi & Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai chu keingoi ching a eiching pa, kei lha sam louding
Aman thina kon’n ei huh doh in, chondih na lampi a eipui lei
Thina phaicham limjot jeng jongleng, thilse kagin tapoi
Nangin neilhonpin thon louhel phatna leh hepinan eijui jing e

Chorus
Choi-at dia lom Ka Pakai, nangbou nahi
Ama thahat pen ama dia bolmo umlou
Ka kiselna songpi le kaki ngaina
Ama hatchung nung, loupi pen
Lungset them hepi na dimset, Kitepna thon ngailou

Verse2
Huhhingpu tonsot Pathen loupipen thahat chungnung pen
Atha neinan tan tihni neilou ding, lengho leng pakai ho Pakai;
Ngailut chamkim, khoto them Pathen, phatthei tincheng kon na,
Nangbou vahchoiyin nangbou thangvah inge thangvah dia lom ka Pakai

Bridge
Thangvah dia lom atheng pen
Vahchoi dia lom loupi pen
Choi-at- dia lom hatchung nung
Leile van a vaihompa  (2X)

songs.title: CHRISTA JAL’A
songs.author: Solomon V Hmar
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai neipui hoidan lampi hi,
Kagal dot teng aloupi ngei;
Naphat na le na hoina pakai,
Kalam  lhah tin’a alang jing.

Chorus
Christa jal’a ka hamphat ahi,
Kaphong jou poi ka lom joupoi;
Naphat na le nahoi na pakai,
Gin umna munna alang jing.

Verse 2
Naphat na le nahoi na pakai,
Kama sang’a along let jing ;
Genthei lengvai cha hi jeng jong leng,
Kahin nei jih in kalha among.

Verse 3
Hah sat na le vangset na pakai ,
Kei a ding chun alu ngei e ;
Na phathei na nalhamonna thu le,
Namel ei mu sah tu ahi.

Verse 4
Leised loupi na le hao sat na,
Leiset chih na le thep na hon;
Nang pang lou chu ema cha hilou,
Na ang sung’a hin ka hung kilhai.

songs.title: CHRISTA MOU
songs.author: Solomon V. Hmar.
songs.lyrics:
Miphah mi veise munthip ngah kahi,
Ima hilou koima het phah lou,
Lei le vana leng loupi pen chun,
A mou hidin khutjem ei buh peh e.

Vanin mou a lop ni teng chu le,
Keijong jao tei ding kahi,
Van kotkhah kihong loupi a chun,
Vantîl ho gin ngei thongna achun,
Lungsetpa christan eina lom intin,
Van kotkhah a kipan jailan oi ing e.

Lengvai leh genthei kei thima dim,
Gou ima neilou sagoh keu kahi,
Ikim neipa chun eina nei in,
A gou lopi ding chu kana hi tai.

Christa mou kahi a loupi ngei,
A haosatna ho lopi dingin,
A thuoh na ho jong thuoh pi dinga,
A thisana lhatsah ama a kahi.

Ka kholjin nagam leisetna hin,
Setna jeh in nitin mau jong leng,
Lah kit tei ding hin na nei kahi,
Van Jerusalem in ei ngah jing e

songs.title: CHUNNU NGAILUTNA
songs.author: Nemneihoi Baby
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nilhangkai ding hita chul dehlou chunnu lungtup,
Na vonchoi se mitso nadin jum le ja na thoh in;
Numei ching leh mantam hi nang nahi,
Nangjeh in insung alum e henu, kakipah e Henu.
*Chorus:*
Nute nikho niloupi nin,
Chunnu somai adanglam deh e;
Henu tia kakouthei hi kahamphat na ahi,
Kouchim sachim jou ponge kachunnu ngailutna.

Verse 2
O Phat hi che jing in hinkho jong achal jinge,
Kachunnu hung lhasam tei ding henu olmo loujen in;
Na vonchoi ten na angkoi uving ting,
ngailut le homtho na dimset pum in nahin pomnau vinge

Verse 3
O chung Pathen dilsun nakengbul a kataove
Hibang Chunnu neipeh jeh in namin kathangvah e
Keijong ama toh bangdin neisem in
Nei lamhil jing in nitin in Pathen ka Chunnu toh bang din
Kouchim sachim jou ponge kachunnu ngailutna.

songs.title: CROSS LAMPI
songs.author: Rev. S. Vaiphei
songs.lyrics:
Cross lampi chu kei ding in

Katonsot inlam jotna

Mitem musit nin koi jeng jong le

Hichu keidia lampi phapen

Nom hen hah jong le kajui jing ding

Chorus:

Ka Pakai thina Cross kei ding a kadam na

Seichoile nge kadam sung in chimlouva sajing ding

Amelhoi kamu man

Thina lui kagal kei teng

Ka Cross chu ka tolkoi ding

Hinna lallukhuh toh kalhet ding

Kagim naho jouse bei ding

Lallukhuh chuken kasan tengle

Thildang ima gelpo nge

Pakai thina Cross tailou

Lampi dang umlou keihin na ding

Thildang jouse kinep nabei

Leiset toh mangtha ding jeng ahi

songs.title: GAMTEP GAM
songs.author: C.Lalzarmawia
songs.lyrics:
Gamtep gam jonin hatlou tah pumin
Nitin kache jing
Hinlah O Pakai eilhem ding atam e
Kache thiem poi.
Satan in nitin eilhem nangma dalha dingin
Hinlah hatlou pet lai’in jong kabel ngampoi
Pakai nangin neipui jing in

Nang’a kahi e... tonsot adin;
Ka chihna, thepna hojong
Pakai nang’a ahi;
Hiche ka thupipen nang vahchoi hi.

Tuhin O Pakai hiche hi kahe tai
Kakipah ngeiye;
Ka lhinlelna ho pumin neina sangin
Neimang nom e;
Ka sietna ho jouse hi miten hejing jongle
Pakai nang’n neivet jiteng na haimil jin
Na ngailutna vahchoi tange...

songs.title: GIN NGEI LOUPI PEN
songs.author: C. lalzarmawia
songs.lyrics:
Lhangtin chonin  moltin khollin ve le in

Luipi dam heu le huilhi theng

Khotin loso mihem loupi na hohin

Asempa loupi je eihille.

Chorus:

Keiman vahchoi jingding eisempa lemin

Tonsot hinna eipe lemin

Chusanga lujo gingei dang um chom deh lou

Henge hia hi gingei loupi pen

Leiset hungkhang hen ahoina so jinghen

Lhangtin le moltin in thang jinghen

Thingtin pah emjinghen hamthem chengten jong

Ahoi cheh ui asempa choi-at in

Mihem chihna thepna jouse nei inting

Choi-at nale loupi naho jong

Nangchoi at nadal thei idang ken lhenglou

Nang vahchoi theihi kadei penne.

songs.title: Galjona nang nahi (Battle Belong to you)
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1:
Kama lhepna gal tam jong le
Keidin Jonna namui
Ken kamu molsang hojeng jong
Nangin natol mang jie
Lhepna meipi lah jot jong leng
Ngailut nan neikhui
Kichat ding umtalou
Nangin neiveng bit e

Chorus:
Keima dilsuh in galsat inge
Kakhot domsang in ting
Pakai galjona nang nahi
Kichat naho na ang a seplhan
Chim louvin sang e
Pakai galjona nang nahi

Verse 2:
Nangin neipan pi leh
Koiham eidou ding (Yeah)
Ajeh chu Pakai nang din bolmo aumpoi
Keidin imalou bang jong le
Nangdin ahoi ye
Ken kamu cross jeng bou Pakai
Nangin lhan keo namui

Bridge:
Thahat chungnung pen nangin neipui yui
Koiman deh joulou ding Pakai thahat na chu
Muthim nasal vah in gal jouse najouvin
Koiman deh joulou Pakai thahat na chu

songs.title: Golpha Jesu
songs.author: David Kakap
songs.lyrics:
Aw Jesu keiding’a kagol phapen nahi kalhaa’n nangai e
Sakhi sihtwi ngai’a aum bangin Pakai kalhaa’n nangai e

Aw Jesu keiding’a kalung monna nahi kalhaa’n nangai e
Nitin setgal kajo theina din Pakai nangbou kangai e.

Van lhagao hung kumlhan kalungsung vilkit in tha nei pekit o
Chonse kisih pum in tun Pakai
Nang kahin nai kit e.

Aw Jesu keiding’a kagol phapen nahi kalhaa’n nangai e
Sakhi sihtwi ngai’a aum bangin Pakai kalhaa’n nangai e

Van lhagao hung kumlhan kalungsung vilkit in tha nei pekit o
Chonse kisih pum in tun Pakai
Nang kahin nai kit e.
Bridge:
Kachonsetna thisan bangin san jongle
Buhbang banga soptheng dingin
Nangma lam kahin sang’e Pakai

Van lhagao hung kumlhan kalungsung vilkit in tha nei pekit o
Chonse kisih pum in tun Pakai
Nang kahin nai kit e.
Nang kahin nai kit e.

songs.title: HALLELUJAH AMEN
songs.author: Seiminlen Boilen Chongloi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen Ngailut kidang tahchu,
Chonse kei ei-ngailut jeh in;
Achapa chang khat Christa chu,
Kei lhatdoh ding in ahinsol.. (2 times)

Chorus
Aw lungset kidang kachan jal in,
Hallelujah Amen!
Hallelujah, ti’n asauve
Mitheng le Vantil ten jong.

Verse 2
Christa jal’in kangai tapoi,
Kilhai na gantha le Hing kilha,
Calvary’a chonset ngaidam nale
Pa toh kicham na Christa kanei.

Verse 3
Pathen Ngailut kidang tah chu,
Twi-khanglen le Thingna jouse
Pen twi leh Lekha hijong le
Dol deh ponte Pa Ngailut na…
Aw lungset kidang kachan jal in,
Hallelujah Amen!
Hallelujah, ti’n asauve
Mitheng le Vantil ten jong.
Mitheng le Vantil ten jong.

songs.title: HALNA HALNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka PU le Ka Pa teu nikho in
Mi lim doi hou na akon in
Pathen dihtah nangma chu o
Kahin mu doh tah jih un
Ason achilhah te keihon
Lampi chu kahin jot pan un
Ahin tun’in lhagaovin kangui soh kitjou taove.
Halna Halna
Ka ngai chao ve o ka pakai
Neisem thah kit un o thaneipen pathen,
Lhagaova dailha ka hinkhou
Nei kaithou kit uvin lang
Halna hin bunglhan o
ka houbung sung uva hin

Verse 2
Na tundoh na houbung ho jong
Nitin in a chehchao jing un
Aching bei kelngoi bang in
Aki khen tel gam tao ve
O hinven na lunglheina dem?
Na thisan a na lhatdohsa ho
Itih le kahal doh kit deu vem
Ka tao ui o Ka tao ve.

Verse 3
Anguitai ka houbung u jong
Lhagaovin ka nguijou taove
Kamit vet un ati ati
Ka lundeiyun kachon un
O kamit u hin hahsah un lang
Namai vah chun neisal vah un
Chuteng halnan eilo un tin
Namin loupi jing tan te.

songs.title: INSUNG NOM
songs.author: Solet Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset na Vangam naipen chu Insung nom ahi,
Na Insung nalhung lai mong hinam?
Insung cheh a mopo i-hiuve.
PATE a ding in vang  lenggam ahi,
NUTE a ding in loupi na pen ahi;
CHATE a ding in cholngah na mun nom ahi.

Verse 2
PATE ho na lenggam sung uva
Iti na chon em?
Lenggam sung a vaihom them lou chu,
Lei le van na a dapen ahi.

Verse 3
NUTE ho na loupi nadiuva
Iti na chom em?
Nunnem le thohhat nin kivon  nin,
Na loupi na chu phaten ching in.

Verse 4
CHATE ho na cholngah nao mun'a
Iti na chom em?
Nu le Pa thu a I-nun ding u,
I Cholngah nao mun nom sung'a.

songs.title: JAN ASOTJO ACHETAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jan asotjo ache tai,
Sun ahung nai tai;
Hiche jih chun tuhin muthim natoh pailhao hitin,
Khovah von'in kivon ute o sopi deite.
Chorus:
Phat a aboui.. Phat a aboui..
Tun kipeh tan phat le ni achal jing,
Natahsa leivui chu it louvin;
O sopi pakaiya din tun kipeh tan.

Verse 2
Pakaiyin hitin ati,
Keiman lah phatchan;
Na taona kasang'e,
Huhhing nikhon nangma kahuh;
Veuvin tuhi lah phat tah ahi,
Huhhing phat ahi.

Verse 3
Hiche jih chun Pakai in,
Vo i mumil ho,
Khang in Chule athi lah akon in thou doh loil inn;
Chuteng Christan nangma na salvah ding ahi ati.
Phat a aboui.. Phat a aboui..
Tun kipeh tan phat le ni achal jing
Natahsa leivui chu it lou vin
O sopi pakaiya din tun kipeh tan.
O sopi pakaiya din tun kipeh tan.

songs.title: JESU NAGAM NALHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka kholjinna sapstna mun,
Lungdon twisang len kinong;
Panpi kangai  ka lhandampu,
Nei hin huh in.

Chorus
Jesu nagam nalhung teng nei he jing in,
Leiset chonset asang taloi;
Kadou joupoi pakai nunnem,
Jesu nagam nalhung teng nei he jing in.

Verse 2
Ka damsung ni chomcha ahin,
Hetlou kah in zan mollep;
Setna meipi jingnoi jahin,
Nei huhhing in.

Verse 3
Ka damsung nikho man ding dan,
Neihil jing in lhandampu;
Kaphat hoilai hi nang ding in,
Mang tang kate.

Verse 4
Leiset loupi naho sang in,
Na hoiye kalung sung’a;
Sapstena ling lukhuh jong chu,
Khuh jong le chun.
Jesu nagam nalhung teng nei he jing in.

songs.title: JESU’N NOPMO ASAI
songs.author: Seiminlen Boilen Chongloi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu’n nopmo asai, Jerusalem Hou-in
Kapa in chu Taona-In kiti ding ahi,
Hinlah nanghon Kailhang in naso tauve ati,
Hiche jeh chun Jesu’n nopmo asai.
Jesu’n nopmo asai, Jerusalem Hou-in
Kapa in chu Taona-In kiti ding ahi,
Hinlah nanghon Kailhang in naso tauve ati,
Hiche jeh chun Jesu’n nopmo asai.
Aw! Jerusalem, Jerusalem!
Themgao ho that a, akisol peh jouse songa sep a,
Ahpi’n anou te ahuikhom bang,
Ijat vei nachate huikhom ding kagot hitam,
Hinlah nangin, neinop peh poi ati.

Verse 2
Gethsamane hon a ataove I Pakai chu,
Lunggim hesoh thoh in a-ul thisan along,
Hinlah asei juite kho pholouva aumu amun,
Kiging jinga um a tao din eihil.

Verse 3
Eiho hi man kipea chohsa ihi taove.
I tahsau jong atheng Pathen Hou-in ahi.
Hiche jeh chun I tahsauvin Pathen choi-at ute.
Eikou pao le Pakai lung dei ahi.
Hinlah nangin, neinop peh poi ati.

kakipanau thu kahin Phong uve

songs.title: KA KHANGHOI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Khanghoi ka khangdon laihin
Pathen le kanu leh kapa ding’a
Thilpha Ipi hi bolpeh leng
Pathen le kanu le kapa ding’a
Lung lhaina khangdong kahi thei dem?
O Chung pathen ka khang hoilai nikho
Kanu le Kapa kana kahi nom poi
Kanu le Kapa domsang
Kanu le Kapa ding’a
Lunglhai napen bol dohdin neipan pi o.

Verse 2
Leisetna ka chunnu bang’a
Eingailu eilungset ding aum lou
Leisetna ka jopa bang’a
Eikhoto le eikhohsah ding um lou
Helouvin kana lung hang je’e

Verse 3
Nule pa chanei khel atam
Nu le pa lhilon na khangdong atam
Vo khangdong na khangdon laihin
Nu le pan na kinep pi jing’e
Gelpha temmo na vaigei man.

songs.title: KA KHOLJINNA
songs.author: JM Helen Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kakholjinna leiset hi ka in hilou, khut a sahlou van tonsot in Pakai sem khopi chu keidin gotsa ahitai
Tun gen-thei hahsat na toh jongleng hai pongnge van cannan gam kalhun kahsen pakai lal nunnem ang sunga chun tonsot jingval pah banga vah jing ding
2  Vannoi nopsah naten nitin eilhem jing, nitin kakhutin eikai jing, hiho sangin Pa nangin nei ngailutna a sangjoi

Verse 3
A phat alhin nile Pan ei hungpui ding, Chua kagenthei nacheng Mil in kathuh gimna leiset chunghi Kin ngai kit ta louding..

songs.title: KA LAMLHAH JOUSE
songs.author: Wycliff Lunneo Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Khol le toulla vahle banga hichi leisetna,
tahsa hinna pemle ihiuve,
sot talou ding leinop na,
sot taponte lhi lonna,
nopna gopi hungju ding kon ahitai.
Chorus:
Kalam lhah jouse simmin
kadin le katou eihei,
Nitinna eiching Pathen hi kangaiye,
Avan loupi najouse kahet sanga nom joa
eimusah ding kahe jing in Pathen in.

Verse 2
Thong go noiya nisa ngaibang
nisa noi a lim kibel,
loulhou min thong go hungjuh adei kit jin
deikiplel na gamma hin lung monna bukim jou lou,
Dei kikim na chung vangam bou ahi e.

Verse 3
Jan muthim umtalou ding,
Genthei le chaga umlou,
ngai kikhen na lhi lonna umtalou ding,
Nop na kem lou jaila ngai chimlou hella isah diu,
thoh hat ute chung khopi ilhun mao vin.

songs.title: KA LUNGTHIM
songs.author: Pastor Elvis Nehlal Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka lungthim katahsa pumpin
Na ang ngah kanachonse tai,
Nang akon kana jamgo jin
Kasetna kana sel gojie
Ka lungthim katahsa pumpin
Na ang ngah kanachonse tai,
Nang akon kana jamgo jin
Kasetna kana sel gojie
Nei ngaidam O pakai
Tun kahung nalai e
Ka chonset naho kamai ja alang jing nge
Them kana kichen naho
Themmo kachan na
Lhing kana kisah na jong
kana lhin lal na.

Verse 2
Guhthim ma ka thilbol jousi
Mihemten muthei hih jong leh
Guhthim in nei na mujing in
kasetna namelchih jinge.

Verse 3
Achonset kisihte vangchu
Pakai jin angaidam tei ding
Keijong kahung nge O pakai
kisihna mitlhi long pum in.

songs.title: KAKINGAI NA NAHI
songs.author: Hatneichong Baite
songs.lyrics:

songs.title: KAKIPAH E PAKAI
songs.author: Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakai kei koi kahiya, hibang a nei ngailut a
Chonset a mangthah ta dingsa
Calvery ngailutna thisan in neihung hodohin
Chonset thina kon hinna goulo dingin neisem tai

Verse 2
Hileiset genthei na muna kalen laiyin
lhepna in meipi jing bang eitom jinge
Hinla na lhagao puihoi na chun nei galkai sahyin
Setgal jona kachangtai thahat chungnung O Pakai

Chorus:
Kakipah e Pakai nei ngailutna
Kakipah e Pakai nei Khotona
Kakipah e Pakai na vangboh na sim joulou
Nitin a nei chansah ho kakipah e

Verse 3
Heleiset kholjin na muna malam kalson ahahsai
Christa nangma pui na louvin
Kajot jing tonsot gam jong nangin nei gonpeh ahi
Tahsan jalla chu gam chu kei nikhat le kalhun ding

songs.title: KATHUM E
songs.author: EMBROS
songs.lyrics:
Lungleng vaijin belding kahol jinge,

neikhoton neihuhhing in Aw Pakai..kathum e

mitcho ho jong khomu theina apen
chonse pen jong angailut na achan in,
aloupi naho kamu phat in pakai katahsan e....
kachonset najouse nathisan chun neisil theng in.

Nitin lhepnan eijuilei puimang ding eigo jinge
naban thahat chun neituh jing in
kalhuh lou nading in
neidalhah le amangsa kei nangma bou kahatna...

songs.title: KHANGDONG KEIMA
songs.author: ST Hesei Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Hi leiset kalenna

Nitin lhepna ahat

Khangdong lung ngai naho

Setnan ei jui jinge aw Pakai

Chorus:

Aw nei sango Pakai nun nem

Tun naheng jonin kahunge lhinglal jongleng

Khangdong keima nei panpin

Lhepna ahat kakhol jinna gam

Genthei hesoh na a

Ei panpi jing Pakai

Damthei lung monna Jong

Nanga kon, ken vahchoi jing tange

Christan ei ngailutna

A sangin aloupi e

Lam vaiya thi dingsa

Tonsot a din hinna nei petai

songs.title: KHANGDONG MELHOI
songs.author: Benjamin N Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Khangdong melhoi sanakang manlu,
Iding tu a loubang chuljing nahim?
Hingel tem o…. khamtheina songkul a
Ailhim na bah jeng hi
Na sempa alung oina dem?

Verse 2
Loudong bangbep nakhang hoi laihi
Phat chomcha bou hingding na hinkho hi
Lei nopsahna Pathen douna lampia
Hinkho naman jeng ham?
Nasempa pathen kisih khante.
I Lei hinkho abeiteng chu leh
Mitin chung thu kitan teiding
Ki ngaiton o Khangdong
Chuni teng kisih jong geisang ding
Hinjon in Pakaiyin Na kouve.

Verse 3
Samson bang in na khanghoi laini
Nangma deilam nopchon nan mang hih in
Setna dalhan pakai heng hin jon in
Pakaiyin na kouve
Lungmonna bukim chu na chan ding
Nalei hinkho hung bei teiding
Vaigei khan nate nagaiton khangdong
I Pakai ang sung nadin teng
Nathun them nachan nadem o?
Avaigei man hinjon loiyin

songs.title: Ka Hatna Pakai
songs.author: Charis Worship
songs.lyrics:
Tonsot thina changdia um tasa

Nangailut na khen neilouchun

Chonset nenpen neipom in

Nathisan in neichodoh tai

Ka hatna konna Pakai

Ka monna konna Pakai

Kaki selna kakulpi det nahi

Ka hatna konna Pakai

Ka monna konna Pakai

Loupina jouse nang'a ahi

Amen

(Bridge)

Halleluyah ahing kahitai

Halleluyah sohcha kahitai

Halleluyah vangou Kalo tai

Halleluyah ahing kahitai

Halleluyah sohcha kahitai

Halleluyah vangou kaloding

Nang bou kavah choi ding

songs.title: Kei Kichat Na Soh Hi Talou (No longer Slave)
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi & Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Na aw nemtah chun, Neihung holdoh tai
Na lhatdam na langei chun
Kamelma akon nei huhdoh ji in
Kaki chat na beiman

Chorus:
Kei kichatna soh hi talou
Kei Pa-then cha kahi (2X)

Verse 2:
Naobuh sunga kon, Nangin nei lheng in
Ngailut nan ei kouve,  Neisem thah kit tai
Na inn pi adin, Nanga dia hing kahi

Bridge:
Tuipi chu na khen e, ka-gal kai thei na din
Ngailutnan kichat subeita
Neihuh doh jeh in kahinvah choi ye
Keima Pa-then cha kahi (2X)

Ending
:
Keima  Pathen cha Kahi
Keima Pathen cha kahi
Keima Pathen cha kahi

songs.title: LEISET A
songs.author: JM Helen Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset a haosatna Le genthei Nate hin ka lhagao lamvaijin
Kahilchen thei nading in pakai naban tha hatna chun neivon in
Tun kajai pakaijin eikouna, nachonset nen thisan bangjongle kelngoinou jolsel bahsah ingtin nachonset na nangai dampih ing nge ati

Verse 2
Aw pakai hibanga neingailut kadingin, Calvary Cross chunga thisan Le tuisih in nalongin kavengam poi kachonset jih in

Verse 3
Kelngoi ja lah a vah mang sate, kelngoi chun pakai kou nangaijin,  ehatmo nao ahen akhut in lha louvin eikai Le jingjing ui.

songs.title: LEISET THIL LE GOU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset thil le gou amang ding ho hi,
Na lung’a nagel jing nah lai em? O sopi;
Leiset thil nagel le tonsot meidil’a,
Da in kap jong le chun che tei ding.
Sana dangka sang in nahin jing nadin
Kisan in christa
Chuteng  a van in nom’a na pui ding.

Verse 2
Mi haopa le lazar chu hingel tem in,
Hoijoh chu nahi nom em? Kigel phatem in;
Leiset loupi naho ve lal hih beh in,
Hi achun thinan vai ahom’e.

Verse 3
O Sopi deitah niloupi nileh,
Na insung mi a kim nadem pakai ang’a;
Dalhah a um te chu lhasen kap jong leu,
Pakaiyin sang lou ding kap jing long leu;

Verse 4
Leiset hinkho hi twimei tobang ahi,
Khovah ding ahi tai kiging jing in um un
Pakaiyin a mite hinna lallukhuh
Apeh teng nang jong nachang na dem?

songs.title: LHAGAO PUILE A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao puile a kana um lai chun
O anom ngeije kipana jing bou
Nop sahna lampia kache phat in o
Lhagao theng in kei eina dalha tai

Chorus
Pathen Ihagao theng nei hinsol peh in
Lhagao jao louvin ding jou pong kate
Kanung kama a hep a huipil hi
Nang louvin pakai paljou pong kate

Verse 2
Lhagaova chapang ka nahi jeh in
Na ang'a umji kana hethem poi
Nitin chondan ho neihil jing in o
Lhagaova hatlou kahi'e pakai

Verse 3
Lhagao theng thilbol theina nei peuvin
Ipi ham nei tohsah nom o Pakai
Ka kiphel theng'e nei mang cha in o
Na natong ding in ka kipe Pakai
Pathen Ihagao theng nei hinsol peh in
Lhagao jao louvin ding jou pong kate
Kanung kama a hep a huipil hi
Nang louvin pakai paljou pong kate

songs.title: LHANGKUM KHO
songs.lyrics:

Pakai thoh na ka gel gel ji teng.

Samang kajal theilou lungin adol lou
Pakai thoh na ka gel gel ji teng.
Ka vahchoi e aw halleluijah
Kading a gal najo na jal in
Ei lhandampu leng jesu
Aw lhandampu leng jesu

Verse 2
Eiho Ibon chauva kelngoi bang’a
Avahmang sa Ihiuve
Hinlah pakai jesu Ithem mo nahou
Abonchan a chung’a alhut tai

Verse 3
Lhang khumkho kihei in  ju le va mao
Jan kho sot nung in lunggel asang’e
Samang kajal theilou lungin adol lou
Pakai thoh na ka gel gel ji teng.
He…. lhandampu leng jesu

songs.title: LHEPNA TWIPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhepna twipi nitin in akinong jing’e
Tahsan chate douding in lhepna atam’e
Molle lhang damle phai
Solelhum  sahle lhang tin’a
Lhepna twipi len kinong.

Verse 2
Tulai lhepna housah nopsah na ideijui
Kabolthei tai tiholah ju leh sa atam ta
Kavaichai tiho lah bollou bolmah Ibolgam ta
I Pakai lung alhai na dem?
Tahsan chate galvon chu leng jesu
Lhepna gal kajo nale  ka hinna
Aw ka leng jesu nangma bou nahi e
Thilsoh kidang hen lang
Lhepna twi kinong jong le.

Verse 3
Tulai thisoh milim hou doichoi kidou,
Kinah kinel kimitthep lunghang loitup sem;
Kilang khen Kibung khen ki thangset, Jukham altolna nitin in vannoi aloi.
Tahsan chate galvon chu leng jesu

Verse 4
Lhepna twipi nitin in akinong jing’e
Tahsan chate douding in lhepna atam’e
Molle lhang damle phai
Solelhum  sahle lhang tin’a
Lhepna twipi len kinong.
Tahsan chate galvon chu leng jesu
Thilsoh kidang hen lang
Lhepna twi kinong jong le.
Tahsan chate galvon chu leng jesu

songs.title: LOUPI PEN PAKAI (Such an Awesome God)
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi & Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nisa naso sahin, lhum jong nalhum sahin
Kalhagao jong nanga, kahai-nahu jong nang

Chorus:
Loupi pen Pakai, hatchung nung, a theng pen, aki----dang pen

Lal tounan a touvin, laltouna theng a chun

Angai- lutle hepina bang umlou (4X)

songs.title: MI LUNGSET THEM PAKAI
songs.author: Kamlal Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mi lungset them’a o pakai,
Lhagao in nei hung vil kit un;
Insung mi kap in vai gam taove,
Lhagoa in nei hung suhal kit un.

Chorus
Rapture nikho…. hung lhung le,
Insung mi ikim na deu vem?
Pa Lal touna ang sung’a,
Kipaman san niteng ajao lou um khan te.

Verse 2
O heno na chate lhagao,
Huhhing a um soh deu hinam?
Chuni teng le sem nom jong le chun,
Phat um talou ding kingai to phan.

Verse 3
O hepa insung semtup loijin,
Pakai nikho hung lhung ta le;
Chuni teng le sem nom jong le chun,
Phat um talou ding kingai to phan.

songs.title: MIN NGEIPEN CHUNNU
songs.author: Moses Khongsai
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thilsem hinna nei jouse dia,
minngei chungnung pen aw Chunnu..

Nangma ho jal'in Pathen ka thangvah ui.
Kipana jailan ka awi ui..

Na loupiuve chunnu nahi nau.
Na loupiuve Chunnu nahi nau.

Verse 2
Singsung a dia na thoh nau cheng.
Na vonchoi cheng dia na gim nau cheng
lonlhi thonggo bang alonna cheng aw Chun ngai.
Ipin lethuh ta'ngem ipin ale thuh ta'ngem.

Verse 3
Chungmang Pathen vangboh chang un

kipanan nahin bom jing u hen chunngai,

songs.title: MUTHEILOU LHAGAO
songs.author: JL Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei mihem chih nan amu phah lou hingjing Pathen le eima tailou ahe chen amu chen ding dang aUm poi lhagao hinna thu aUm poi lhagao hinna thu pha.
Mutheilou na lhagao chu lung mong a um jing hinam thi lungmon na chu nanei hitam na nei loule kisop theng in Christa thisan long a chun.

Verse 2
Tulai Christian i-hinkho u hi lungmonna dih tah neilou atam i lhagao a kap kap jin alhem bi ding dang um lou Christa tailou alhem ding um lou.

Verse 3
Hing jing i-Pakai jin ei kouvui lunghei a ama lam bel ding in alal na gam a kon in asemsa a chate ho ahin gal dot in angah jing e

songs.title: NA HOUBUNG

songs.lyrics:

Aw pakai nangailutna aloupie,  na houbunga dingin thina nachang,keiho jong khatle khat kaki lamhil nadiuvin,  nangma hou-na intheng kahin lhan ui

songs.title: NADEI KILHEN IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nadei Kilhen in o sopi,
Lampi niseh bou nanei je;
Na hinkho damlai sung ahin
Na hinkho chu twimei bang bep ahi,
Hetlou janmang kah abei jing thei;
Kisan in na huhhing pu chu.
Na kouve nang Jsesu,
Na ngah jing’e jesu lungset in;
Na kouve nang Jesu,
Na ngah jing’e jesu lungset in.

Verse 2
Tonsot thinna lam ache ho chun,
Kale gagil na thoh un te;
Jesu huhhing kisan lou ho.

Verse 3
Tonsot hinna lam ache ho vang
Kipana cham kim chang un te;
Jesu huhhing kisan ho chu.
Na ngah jing’e jesu lungset in.

songs.title: NAM CHOM KHENNA UMLOU
songs.author: Ncy Doungel
songs.lyrics:
Ka jinna gam lamsao
Ka chol ta-ngeiye
Vo! Samaria mi lungset tah in
Don ding twi themkhat beh neipe ta'n

Nangmala Juda mi hi-ngal'a
Samaria mi kom'a
Don ding neipen nati chu
Iti'n hithei intem

Nam chom khenna umlou
Pakai Christa jal'in
Samaria, Juda, namlen, namneo
Khenna umkit talou

Don ding hung thum'a chu
Hethem hivele chun
Ama kom'a thumjon natin o
Ama'n hintwi peijo tading a

A thalna dingla neilouva Pu
Itwikulla thuh ngal'a
Nasei hintwi nati chu
Hoiya nalah hintem?

Hiche twi don chan chu
Dangchah kittei ding
Keiya kon hintwi vang kemtheilou
Dangchah kitlouna hintwi ahi

Hikom'a kahung kit ngailou na
Dangchah kitlouna twi
Tonsot a kangngailou chu
Lungset in neipe ta'n

songs.title: NANGKOM KAHUNG' E
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eihuh hingpu kaki ngaina
Pakai nabang koima umlou
Avel vellin losam jeng jong leng
Nei khoto na aki khel ngaipoi
Naban thahat in nei phong dingin
Nei sem thah in Pakai nanga ding in

Chorus
Nang kom kahung in, Pakai nangin nei sangin
Neituh jing in nei lha kang ngaipoi
Thildang jouse sang in ken nang kalheng e
Ken ka ngailui loupi pen Pakai

Verse 2
Nacha dia lom lou hi jong leng
Nacha somko lelko dalhan
Amang sa keima nei holdoh tai
A sang ta ngeije  nei ngailutna
Neikou na aw ngeitah chu kajai
Aloupi ngei Pakai naphat naho

BRIDGE:
Nang keidia hoipen, Ka ijakai nahi
Esus
Nei nung sun  ngaipoi

songs.title: NAPON BUH KEHLEN IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen in athilsem lah’a manlu pen,
Alim leh melpua asem PA  ahi;
Aloupina phongdoh ding,
Ama choisang ding;
Pakai adia man lupen mipa ahi.
Napon buh sonna mun chu kehlen in,
Na khaojang chu nung jel kit hih in;
Lhagoa mangthai gamlah ding tampi aum’e,
Cholngah louvin pakai nachu tong jing ute.

Verse 2
Insung maicham semjing pa nahi jjing jeng hinam?
Lhagaova insung mipa nahi hi nam?
Na insung mite naven tup jing jeng hinam?
Pakai in mopohna lentah eipeuve

Verse 3
Na insung mi na huhdoh jou dinG hinam?
Noah bang’a insung mi akim nadem?
Abraham bang’a na tahsanna len hinam?
Pakai dia maicham thiltoh napeh hinam?

Verse 4
Huhingna ngaicha sang tampi aum’e
Lhagao mangthai ho huhdoh na ding in
Pakai in nagle kei che ding in eingense ve
Kipan uhitin gahuhdoh loi uhite

songs.title: NEHCHINTO A UMTO
songs.author: Pr.Seitinpao Lupho
songs.lyrics:
Tona umsa jalen nachu mihem in,
Eden hon lailung a ina mansah tauve, Hiche chonset nachun tahsa le lhagao
Eina sohchan sah tauve.

Insung khat chu kibung khenna loitum chun vai ahomtai,
Khaiye..! Khangjing..! Thouvun, kho avah tai..

Ven o sopi tunin, Jesun nang le kei eisol e,
Tahlel te heng a kipana thu seipeh din
Soh a ta'ngho lhadoh nathu seipeh a mitcho ho kho muna dingthu seipeh a Nehchinto aumho lha'ong nathu seipeh a'
Christa nungjui Christian Nangle kei,
Eiki sol ui.

Inampiu chonna khankho le sakho khat Pupa khang apat milmo khangthu jemhoisel imil tauve lungkhat a hi chun chonset, Sohtanna eilhut tauve. Ichungmang Pathen le Ipu ipa lhaolha oinan tem,
Khaiye..! khangjing..! Thouvun..kho avah tai...
Jesun keima vannoi salvah kahin, koi hijong leh kathu nitte vangchu, muthim lam ajot talou ding, Khovah muding, thina jou christa jal a Zalen tadingSee Translation

Pakai kahung kipei nang a dingin

lhinglel kahinkho hi, nei sangin aw.... (X2)

Namin thupi nadin nei mangin
Kahinna bang² in
Nangin nei pom inlang
Nadei namun jousen nei mangchan o

Ki Manna ding umlou kahi jongle
Hoi ding natina mun a neikoi in...
Leibel asempa in adei bang abol bang

mihem in avet bang nei vehih in

songs.title: NEIHOULIM PILEH PAKAI
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Neihoulim pileh Pakai, Ken nanung kajuiding
Ahin nalung lam louvin, kei kache ngampoi Pakai
Kabol katoh ding jouse, Nanga kingai jing kahi
O Pakai neipui jing jengin (2X)

Chorus:
Chenge Pakai Neipuijin, Nanga din kahung kipei
Lhagao helna neipen, Nalengam natong din
Chenge Pakai Neipuijin, Kipana thu lhasam din
Nacha kei chonse lhasam hijeng jong leng (2X)
O Pakai Neipui jing jengin ( 2X when ending)

Verse 2
Nitin lhepna tam jongle, Keima ding det jingding
Niso hoilai hihen lang, meibol kailai hejong le
Pakai nangma naumle, keidia kichatding umlou
O Jesu nangin nei puijin

songs.title: NEIKOU NA AW!
songs.author: Jeff Akai Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Neikou na Aw kajan kahung e O pakai,
Ipi pen tong dinga nei dei em?
Chihna thepna neilou mimol pen hijong leng,
Nanga din kahung kilhan e Pakai.
Kahung ki lhan e Pakai
Kahung ki lhan e Pakai
Leiset nopsah naleh ahoina ho sangin
Jesu Nang kalheng jotai,
Lungmonna chamkim le kipana chamkim Pakai
Jesu nung jui tange.

Verse 2
Immanuel Pathen Lhagao theng in nitin
Phattin in nei umpi jing jeng o,
Nang louvin lamlhung jou ponge O ka Pakai
Nang louvin lam lhung jou ponge O Pakai

Verse 3
Leiset a neile gou sumle pai holna in
Nitin le phattin in ka boiji'n
Hinlah lungmon nale olna chamkim umlou,
Monna le olna chamkim Christa a hi.
Kahung ki lhan e Pakai
Kahung ki lhan e Pakai

songs.title: NEIPUI JING IN
songs.author: Rev Lunneo Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Molle lhang sang hen gole dai kai jong le
Chelou thei kahi lou,Pakai ngailut na cross nung jui ding
Thimpi jing hen ling le khao tam jong le kajui ding nalampi
Neipui jing in, Nei kai hoijin.Nang lou vin lam lhung jou
Pong e nitin lhep na ahat ne.Nitin cross lampi kajui lai
Hin hahsat nale boinan.eibom jing kajui them ji poi na Lampi

Verse 2
Seiset japi na insung boi naho hin, Nitin in ei vil jing
Kap pum pum in ken kajui jing. Chollou vin cheng e ka dou
Gal tamjong le kajui ding na lampi

Kathem chen na cross, lhatdam ka chen na cross
Kisih kit talou ding nung chon lou ding jui jing ding
Ei umpi ding ei pui ding agam nom eilhut ding pakai jin

songs.title: NGAILUT CHAMKIM
songs.author: Wycliff Lunneo Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Ngailut chamkim Pakai Pathen a,
Damna bitna le hinna
Sohchangte dia suchetna ahi
Zalen na bulpi Ama bou.

Ngailut chamkim kachan na Cross chun
Lhagao halnan ei vil e,
Thisan hunglhong lha kei lhatdamna chu
Chamkim pen ngailutna ahi.

Mitchote dia khumu na Pakai
Elbai te dia lamjot na
Genthei te dia kile doh thei na
Chonsete ngaidam I-Pathen.

Lhagao tahsa Pakai Pathen a
Setna a kon ei lhatdoh tai
Leiset kholjin ijo teng ule
Pakai in eiho eipui diu.

songs.title: NOAH DAMLAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ven kin in chen tah in dah in lang
O Pa mu na te phat chom dan,
Naji nacha te ma theng nao vem, d
Dalhah nei khah natevekit  in.

Chorus
Noah damlai miten nuisat un,
Tuilet ding kicha louvin mong un,
Pakai kouna O hung ging le,
Na ja na diuvem na inko uvin.

Verse 2
Hunglhung loijin te Pakai nikho,
Ngailutna phat hung beiloi ding,
Keichang ka sohchai tikhan nate,
Nachate kim nauvem vekit in.
Pakai jin ati kahung ding teng,
Ling kihot ding kel hung lha ding,
Kidou thuthang ding ngailut daiding,
Pakai thutep adihlou umlou.

Verse 3
Sun le jan chol louva lhatsa te,
Khongpi le tumhing thei tho a,
Hinna thinglima hintwi don in,
Na jao nadiu vem na inkou-vin.

songs.title: NOAH KONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen adia nolnabei mikhat amin Noah,
Pathen lhakang lou athupeh juijing anahi e;
Hichun nikhat pathen in kong innei tuhding in,
Noah chu thupeh ana petai.

Verse 3
Hichun Noah kipan in Phunchelna nei louhel in,
Genthei hahsatna thoh pumin ana tong jing’e;
Twisang alet phat in Ju le va namkim le Noah insung pathen in ahuhhing tai.
Twisang let phat in Noah kong chu adel un,
Ahin lah pathen in Kot akhah tai Kot akhah ta’e;
Sopi nang jong tun kikhol in phatbei man
Phat beima in.

Verse 3
Nule pa u le nao Na tahsan kong u chu,
Bitjing jeng hinam? kikhol chel jing uhite;
Lhagaova dam hinam?
Insung le houbung sung,
I mutna kon khah phat chu hitalou ham?
Na tahsan kong u chu,
Bitjing jeng hinam? kikhol in o sopi;
Khongai sot dan Khongai sot dan,
Mihem hinkho hi twimei bang chomcha bou,
Khongai sot dan.

songs.title: NUTE NIKHO
songs.lyrics:
Nute nikho niloupi ahung lhungtai

Verse 1
Nute nikho niloupi ahung lhungtai,
Kipah in lungkhat in lengkhom ute;
Pathen phatthei boh i-chan nahou hi,
Chung nungpen Pathen vahchoiyu hiute.
Numei chingin a inchen asem phan,
Numei ngolin vang inchen asukeh joi;
I-piu Sarah bangin tahsan nale,
Chonnem na in chamkim ute eiho jong;
I-piu Sarah bangin tahsan nale,
Chonnem na in chamkim ute eiho jong.

Verse 2
Insung mi nute jouse kigel ute,
Na innei pu dinga natao jing hinam?
Na chate  ding a Jong natao hinam?
Phatle nikho ahung naitul-tul e.

Verse 3
Pate ho jouse jong kigel chen loi-un,
Na inneipi beiya naum kah-in;
Na sempau Pathen chu geldoh loiyun,
Ajole vaikhonung kha in nate.

Verse 4
Phatle nikhon nangle kei eingah louding,
In neipu jalou lolhing joulou;
Pakai a dingin panla khom ute,
Vangam gei adingin pangkhom u hite.

songs.title: Ngailut na kidang (This is amazing grace)
songs.author: Goulal Tuboi & Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Koiham thina leh, chonsetna man sah thei
A thahatna leh alungsetna longlou
Lengjouse leng leh Hatchungnung leng Pakai,
Koiham leiset chunga lhagao halna pehthei
Chuleh thil kidang, bolla eikipasah,
Leng jouse leng leh hatchungnung Leng Pakai

Chorus:
Tantih neilou lungset, A lungsetna kidang
keima mun nalo in, Keima cross napo in
Nahinkho nape in, Keima lhatdam nadin,
Oh, Jesu nei phathei boh jallin ken lan sange.

Verse 2:
I Boina jouseo, hung semtoh koiham;
Chaga leh genthei, cha asem koiham?
Lengjouse lengle, Pakai jouse Pakai;
thudih leh thutah, a nampi vai hom
Nisa vah bangin, avah emselle
Lengjouse lengle Pakai jouse Pakai

Bridge:
kelngoinou thisa a loupi, A loupi e thina jou leng Pakai
kelngoinou thisa a loupi, A loupi e thina jou leng Pakai
kelngoinou thisa a loupi, nalou nalou naloupi e

songs.title: PA NGAILUT NA
songs.author: Seiminlen Boilen Chongloi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinna damna eipe ka Pakai nang,
Aw iti kipana thu’n sei tang em
Mihem pehhoi hilou, nei ngailut nahi,
Zaila’n oi oijin sajing tang’e (2

Chorus
Kipa la’n namin Vahchoi inge
Agil dan haimil thei ka hilou,
Tonsot hinna geiya neichan tah jeh in,
Kaki pah e Pa nei Ngailut na.

Verse 2
Senneo apat lei hinkho kaman dan,
Neina ve in neihin pui jing’e.
Ling-le-Khao lah hihen, Gal-le-tol lah a,
Neihin pui hoiyin nei khoukhah tai.

Verse 3
Na Lampi deibanga kajot thei nadin,
Ei khoukhah dia neipeh Kachun-le-Jo,
Na nganse na Houbung lhacha le Houbung mitheng te,
Din katao peh e, phatthei boh un.

Verse 4
Tunvang na Lengpi lei a kon dingin,
Kahung e nei lanlang nei soptheng in,
Hinna damna kanei laisen nangding in,
O Ngailut Pakai nakin bol tang’e.
(Tonsot a kemlou Pa Ngailut Na)

songs.title: PAKAI CHU KALUM LE KAPHO
songs.author: Pajangul Chongloi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai chu kalum le ka pho ahi
Sietgal kajona, lhasam louvin
Che jing jeng uhite, tahsan chate ho
Calvary ngailutna athisan longchun
Echonsiet jouseu angai dam soh tai
Keima neisol’in, keima cheng kate
La’n sachoi leng e, phat kanei sunnin
Douding melma i-jat, in tam jong le

Pakai chu eiho lam a apan le
I-ham igindiu jona ponlap chu
dom sang uhite, Lhagao chem jam chu
Kipaman san ding nikho anai tai
Chuche nikho chu nikho loupi pen

Verse 3
I-hinkhuo hoilai Pakai a ding in
Kiphal theng ute dettah in pang uhite Pakai’a
Machal na ding in
I-hinsung damlai nikho chomcha bou
Ineitai sopi hung kipan loi-in

La’n sachoi leng e, phat kanei sunnin

Douding melma i-jat, in tam jong le

songs.title: PAKAI NEI NGAILUTNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai nei ngailutna hi akidang’e,
Chonsetna thi ding’a ka um laijin;
Kahinna din Zumle jachat nathoh in,
Calvary thing cross ana hung thi tai.

Chorus
Aw pakai kei michonse jeh in,
Cross chung’a chun na thisan along’e;
Thina jouvin lhan akon athoudoh in,
Tonsot innom van kot eihon peh tai.

Verse 2
Thisan lu o thisan lu cross along chun,
Ka chonset na soptheng in ei damsah tai;
Huhhing nahi khonbang in domsang in ting
Seichoi le tang’e kadam sung in.

Verse 3
Linglukhuh na khuh chu keidin lallukhuh
Na thohna maha chu kei eidam sahtai;
Leiset nahin genthei jin lengvai jong leng,
Tonsot nopna vangam chu chang tang’e.
Aw pakai kei michonse jeh in

songs.title: PAKAI PHATDAN
songs.author: Sang Khawbung
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kahinna ho jouse hi
Naloupi na din kalhan
Kachihna le thep naho
Naman chah din kalhan
Aw Pakai phatdan hi akidang ngei e
Ijakai hohi agontup.

Verse 2
Aw pakai nangma louchu
Kalungkham ei lhamon ding
Leiset a kamu joupoi
Nei umpi jing in aw

Verse 3
Hi leiset nopsah nahon
Ei suboi jing jong leuhen
Chekhel kichat umlah a
Nang in neiveng jingin
Verse2 repeat

songs.title: PAKAI PHATNA
songs.author: Ngaminlen Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Aw pakai naphat naho
Akidang in aloupi
Nei phatthei na simsen lou
Ipin lethuh tang katem

Chorus:
Aw eingailu ka Pakai
Ka kipana jallin
Seiphong lenge kache phah nachan nin
Naphat naho sachoile tange

Nangin nitin kahin khoa
Kathil ngaichat hojouse
Lhasam le vat lou hellin
Nei pe bukim sel ji e

Loupi na le ja bol na
Let na le lalna jouse
Ijakai nang nga ahi
Nangbou vahchoi jing tange

songs.title: PAKAI VAHCHOILAN SANGE
songs.author: John Guite
songs.lyrics:
Pakai vahchoi lan sange.Lim le Mel kanei laisen
sange avahchoi la,
Hin naleh damna eipe Pakai amabou ahi
ka lolhin na jong nahi,
Tun oi inge jaila sa in
vahchoi Inge Pakai Ei lhandampu....

Thilsem jule vaten bon avahchoi thei ule,
kei injong vahchoi ing e.
Thilsem namkin jousen jong avahchoi thei ule,
kei iti vahchoi lou va kaum ding ham?
Lim leh Mel kanei laisen vahchoi inge,
Amintheng, Tonsot in vahchoi Inge.

Aloupi nan vannoi leiset losoh Jing jeng hen!
Tule atonsot geiyin,
Namtin vaipi jousen Sam hen
aloupina khongpi le dahpi tho in Sam ute,
Lim leh Mel kanei laisen vahchoi Inge,
leng David bang, pakai ang ngah lam ute.

songs.title: PENNA JOUGAM LEI
songs.author: Chungthang Tuboi.
songs.lyrics:
Penna Jougam lei nomin ahoi ngei

Sihtwi nun jemhoi Lounan jong

Pupa chenna a Jalen nao thinglhang gam

Lungle bantha khat in pan lao te

I-Nam le gam adin.

Chorus:

Chunle jo kipana pi le pute lojang thanna

Tua nampi kinep na khanougol

Nampi kongtol them hidin mangpan nei choijun

Chuteng bollunmang cheng jong lungoi taovin te.

Tonna pule PA thilsem namkim toh

Khankho heikhom

Bang  heikhom mu hite

Kito dellin lamtol khatna vo laijon

Dahpi bang thong lhung hen jalai ja

I-nun kho hoilai.

Khanga khang hoilai khang a Sana khang

Simlai tahchanu simlai tahchapa

Selung molden na Eva vei Jing deu ham

Nampi khonung dingin Tom pannin

Pheiphung son nute.

songs.title: PHARASIS MIPA
songs.author: Jeff Akai Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pharasis mipa simon inn’a
Pakai jesu alut in
Dokhang chung’a an-kong alui lai un
Numei chonse nu ahung tai.

Chorus
Pakai jesu keng bul’a chun
Numei chonse nu adelsun akap lha jing tai
A lunhgthim le a nei jouse
Zum le ja ding gel louvin akiphal theng tai

Verse 2
Pharasis mihon I Pakai chu
Themgao bang in agel un
Pathen chapa vanlal touna toupa
A loupi je ahe pouve

Verse 3
I pakai jesun mijouse hi
A Lungset in a ngailui
Chonset kisih lunghei atahsan ho
A ngaidam in ahuhhing’e
A lunhgthim le a nei jouse
Zum le ja ding gel louvin akiphal theng tai

songs.title: PHAT HI TWI LONG BANG IN
songs.author: Jeff Akai Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat hi twi long bang in long in,
A niseh in achal jing’e;
Vannoi leiset leh athil ngaichat,
Mangthai ding kon ahi tai.
Vannoi leiset hi abei teng le,
Leng christa lal touna ang’a
Lhaisel’a I lenkhon deu.

Verse 2
Aw sopi hung un cheu hite,
Pakai inn nom sem’a cheng din;
Vannoi leiset leh athil ngaichat,
Mangthai ding kon ahi tai.

Verse 3
Aw pakai ka taonao sang in,
Hileiset gim munna kon hin;
Vannoi leiset leh athil ngaichat,
A Mangthai ding ahi tai.

songs.title: PUMGO THILTO
songs.author: Wycliff Lunneo kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Pakai a kipah thanom jingin

Aman nadei chan napeh ding

Na hinna pumpin vahchoijin

Ama eiho dia huhhingpu

Chorus:

Pakaiya kiman hi anomin

Amin vahchoi hi kipana

Avahchoi la a lamkhom hi

Pumgo thilto bang in asangji

A-Inpi nom a kipah khom in

Gospel kipana sei khom in

Phattheina tin cheng sei khom in

Ami huhhing na oi khom in

Choi-at na lompen leng Jesu

Vahchoi na peute Emmanuel

Thangvah nan lam in a anga

Jehovah jire eiho dia

songs.title: Pelthei Hilou Lei Tahsa Thina
songs.author: Jeru Chawngthu
songs.lyrics:
Pelthei hilou lei tahsa
thina kokhuh jonna che jing ihiu
Lei kholjin chelai ihiuve
Phatkhat teng idalhah cheh diu hichi lei inn hi
Gamnom eisem peh u ichan thei nadin
Jesu nei nahi nam?

Tahsan un huhhingna amabou
Nalam jotlai chu gel tem in
achaina ding nahet em?
Kipana jeng ahipoi
gousum le pai letna hohi
Bei loiding lei houna le kipana
Ihinkho'n a ngaichat penchu
tonsot a choldona bou chu ahi
Thildang umlou hinjon jengtan huhhingpu christa

Lei hinkho damsung ni
chomcha ahin kipah jing jeng in
Navella boina ho jih in
boilou jennin O sopi
Ithahat lai ipahlainiu achom ngei
Phat chesa gentheina ho jeh in
lung lhadai lou jennin o sopi
Na cross putchu gih jongle nunglam heilou jennin

songs.title: SAPSETNA THINGPEL
songs.author: Jeff Akai Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sapsetna thingpel pudia lom lou
Ami ngailut na jeh in
Apu in athi e calvary a, Nangle kei hinna din

Verse 2
Halleluija halleluija amen
Vahchoi jing dia  lom chu nangbou
Aw Pakai jesu nangbou nahi
Vahchoi jing dia lom chu
Ngajin Pakaijin a sei e
Hahjing nga naum lou leh
Gucha bang’a naheng’a ka hung ding ahi ati,
Hung vah jet ding kahi
Nalel lukhuh chu koiman
Nalah peh lou nadin nanei sunchu tuhdeh jing in

Verse 3
Lungdam lou najouse lunghana
Lungsat kinah kitai tom ho
Gitlou engset najouse nangho
Akon in koimang un
Kihepi  tocheh un nunnem un
Pathen in christa a nangho
Na ngaidam bangun chun khat le khat
Ki ngaidam to cheh un

Verse 4
Ngaijun ngaijun western style jeng’a
Hinkho man nom lungthim bei ho
Gam dang khantou na ela lao vin
I Khen suh pi taove
Thutah cha cha ja umdol cha cha
Adih lam cha cha theng cha cha
Dei um cha cha seiphat cha cha ho
Pa lunglam chu gel un
NB: Sing - 1, 2, Chorus, 3, 4 then Chorus

songs.title: SAPSETNA THINGPEL
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sapsetna thingpel pudin na lompoi,
Lei mihemte chonsiet najih in;
Nathoh e calvary a keiho damna ding in,
Neihin peuve tonsot hinna.

Chorus
Chorus:
Aloupi ngeiye mihem na Ngailutna kidang hohi,
Mihem kam paova seichim jou hilou;
Kadam laisen Pakai vahchoi tang'e.

Verse 2
Leisiet hinkho chomcha inei sung hi,
Ama lou kiphondoh nadia asem hepha lou;
Asemsa mihem tampi vannoi leiset,
Nopchon nale du'am nan alodim sottai.

Verse 3
Tun jong eikou ui,
Ngailut le lungset aw nem in;
A ang'a  Ngaidam bukim chang tei ding in,
Eikou kou jing ui..he....

Verse 4
Christa sangnom loute vang chu,

Christa kouna aw ngaiya lunghei chan chu,
Van khopi'a kipah a cheng tading... Tonsot a...

songs.title: SONLEL MELPU
songs.author: Lalboi
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonset gotmun a kaum laijin,
Jesu lungset awnem in eikou;
Ka tahsan phat phatni dan chun,
Huhhing na loupi eichan tai.

Chorus
Pakai nangdia sonlel melpu,
Na nungjui din kahung kipei;
Khoisat genthei na mun ajong,
Thangvah pum in na ang’a taojing tang’e.

Verse 2
Ka lhagao thi kholkhul akon,
Nei lhatdoh na vang’a ka tahsa;
Dam le bit a nei koijal in,
Seichoi leng nge o namin ngei.

Verse 3
Ka hinkho twimei le pahcha,
Jaova molhoipah bang bep ahi;
Chomlou kah a molloi ding jong,
Na vang’a kinem jing kahi.

Verse 4
Lhinglal leh hatlou nacha hi,
Van lhagao theng in neipui jing in;
Christa lallukhuh jemhoi din,
Ka hinna hi suthengsel in.

songs.title: TAHSAN CHATE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tahsan chate Pakaiyin eikou vui
Koung Aw chu ngai phao hite
Christa Lenggam tungdoh ding in
Thina thim noija tou ho puidin
Kon uhite ana tong din
Hung uvin Kipan ute galsat ding in
Lhagao chem jam pan in malam noute
Christa Sepoy nung chon louvin
Kipana thupha lhangsam leute
Jona lal lukhuh I-san deu

Verse 2
Vo Khongdong ho pakaiyin eikou vui
Lung kitoh in pang khom ute
Kipana thupha langsam din Nang jong pakaiyin nakou jing'e
Ana tongdin hung kipan tai

Verse 3
Kei ka um'e Ka pakai nei sol'in
Kei cheng kate na natong din
Ani seh a Cross kiput in
Hin jui nange pakai na lampi
Na gam kahung Ihun masang sen.
Christa Sepoy nung chon louvin
Kipana thupha lhangsam leute
Jona lal lukhuh I-san deu

songs.title: THILPHA BOL
songs.author: Wycliff Lunneo Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Molhoipah bang hinkho
Manlutah neipeh hi
Gentheite din mangchang kate
Loi-le-paite noplenna
Mulou bang kisang kate
Pakai Namgma tuhdet jing ding...

Chorus:
Thilpha le chan nadia Thilpha bol kahipoiye
Pakai ngailutna kacham louvin eisolle
Chollou kisan jum ding ginlouvin machal inge
Thilpha bolnan Pakai apang jinge.

Mihem sempa Pathen na-anga kahin lhanne
Malam thimjing hinsal vah in
Nalunglam holna jalin mite muset kachangji
Kinepna vang akhanglen jing...

Muchi chu ahung pah tai
Thingpi jing chu ahung vah tai
Gelmo jatam lungthim sudam
Kagelphah phahlou chan vangpha
Kachunga ahung thong lhung
Pakai vang Pathen dih chu ahi.

songs.title: THINA LUI
songs.author: Upa CT Lalnunthanga
songs.lyrics:
Thina lui thuh tah a,
kalhah lai in eilhandam pun,
lungset jeh in eilhat
boina tuinong kapel ta e.

Kipah in sa jing tang e
Eilhandam pu vahchoi in,
tonsot gam kalhun chan in
Eihuhing pun nei puijing o.

Tuvang hin kipah tah in
Eihuhing pu ka jui jing ding,
Alungset loupi hi
namtin henga sei jig tang e.

Van khopi kalhun teng le
Hesoh na gam hi leiset hi,
Ngailou vin Pakai heng a
Tonsot in o kei leng tange

songs.title: THISAN LU
songs.lyrics:
𝟷. 𝙻𝚞𝚗𝚐𝚜𝚎𝚝 𝚞𝚖 𝙺𝚊 𝙿𝚊𝚔𝚊𝚒 𝙹𝚎𝚜𝚞,
𝙻𝚞𝚗𝚐 𝙶𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚒 𝚝𝚑𝚘𝚑 𝚒𝚗;
𝙰-𝚞𝚕 𝚝𝚑𝚒𝚜𝚊𝚗 𝚒𝚗 𝚊𝚕𝚘𝚗𝚐,
𝙺𝚎𝚒 𝚎𝚒𝚗𝚐𝚊𝚒𝚕𝚞𝚊 𝙿𝚊𝚔𝚊𝚒 𝚌𝚑𝚞,
𝙶𝚊𝚖𝚜𝚊 𝚋𝚊𝚗𝚐 𝚒𝚗 𝚊𝚓𝚎𝚙 𝚞𝚒.

Thisan Lu o Thisan Lu,
Twibang a long chu;
Ka Pakai thisan hung long chu,
Keidin damna.

𝟸. 𝙻𝚞𝚗𝚐𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚗𝚊 𝚊𝚝𝚎𝚙𝚒 𝚞𝚖𝚕𝚘𝚞,
𝙻𝚒𝚗𝚐 𝚕𝚞𝚔𝚑𝚞𝚑 𝚔𝚑𝚞𝚑 𝚒𝚗;
𝙰 𝚌𝚑𝚞𝚗𝚐𝚝𝚑𝚞 𝚊𝚝𝚊𝚗 𝚞𝚗,
𝙰𝚝𝚑𝚎𝚖 𝚝𝚑𝚞 𝚜𝚎𝚒 𝚝𝚊𝚕𝚘𝚞𝚟𝚒𝚗;
𝙲𝚊𝚕𝚟𝚊𝚛𝚢 𝚕𝚑𝚊𝚗𝚐 𝚊𝚓𝚘𝚗 𝚝𝚊𝚒.

𝟹. 𝙻𝚞𝚗𝚐𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚗𝚊 𝚔𝚊𝚑𝚎 𝚌𝚑𝚎𝚗 𝚝𝚊𝚒 𝚝𝚞𝚗,
𝙺𝚊 𝙿𝚊𝚔𝚊𝚒 𝚝𝚑𝚒𝚜𝚊𝚗;
𝙲𝚊𝚕𝚟𝚊𝚛𝚒𝚊 𝚊𝚗𝚊 𝚕𝚘𝚗𝚐,
𝙺𝚎𝚒 𝚓𝚎𝚑 𝚊 𝚝𝚑𝚒 𝙿𝚊𝚔𝚊𝚒 𝚌𝚑𝚞,
𝚅𝚊𝚗𝚗𝚊 𝚙a𝚗 𝚓𝚘𝚗𝚐 𝚟𝚎 𝚗𝚐𝚊𝚖 𝚕𝚘𝚞.

songs.title: THUHIL LHEM
songs.author: Lalboi Kipgen
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pengthah lou Pakai lhacha atam tangei,
Pathen lhagao theng changlou mipui lamvai;
I Houbung leh I gamsung hi alodim tai,
Ki ngaiton hou lamkai nadinmun chu;
Hoijoh a nahi khah em?
Ajoh leh thuhil lhem min pang khan nate.
Aw Thuhil lhem thutah jachat pi’a
Maipha vetna alhagao natong atam’e
Mihem pachat sang’a pakai lunglhai najoh
A loupe jo e Aw  a loupe jo e.

Verse 2
Pengthah leh pakai lhacha kahi tia,
Thutah dinpi ngamlou lhacha atam;
Amachang phatchom nading deiya kisah lella,
Lhagao mangthai ding ngailutna neilou;
Nangma phatchom nading gel nahi leh,
Pakai ang’a themmo nachan teiding ahi.

Verse 3
Aw pastor evangelist leh solchah teho,
A vel in ngai tou hite I din munnu;
Kipana thuhil lhem chu I hi khah leh ,
Christa thupi tanna ma ang’a chu;
Na din ding ahi ti kihet them in,
Seithem nan vangam chuna puilut louding.
Mihem pachat sang’a pakai lunglhai najoh
A loupe jo e Aw  a loupe jo e

songs.title: TILCHUN PAKAI KEIMA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tilchun pakai keima neihin ve le chun,
Nei pamai sanan nate;
Ka hinkho hoilai hi nang’a pe louvin,
Satan a kape jing e.

Chorus
Nei ngaidam nei ngaidam in o ka pakai
Tun naheng kahin jon nalai e
Kei nei sang in kei nei sang in o ka pakai
Tun naheng kahin jon nalai e

Verse 2
Kamit hi Idia nasem ham Iti le,
Hinna thu amu nading;
Ahin lah poi pakai setna jeng bou ave,
Ka lhagao akap kap e.

Verse 3
Ka hinkho hi pakai twimei bang bep ahi,
Sao tah din kana gel’in.
Keima nopdan lam a kana chon jih;
Ka thina ding jong helou.

Verse 4
Phatsot tah pi pakai setna in eikhun,
Khovah jong mupha jou lou;
Na nah teng’a sut jong kana henai pakai;
Giltah in kana he poi.

songs.title: Thisan Lu
songs.author: Rev. Dr. Satminlen Khongsai
songs.lyrics:
Naloupi naho hinda lha in
Kineo sah in leiya na hunge
Nathi ding jong namil a hipoi
Ngailut jalla bou nahung ahi

Nathaneina jong tah lang louvin
Athiding in nakipe jenge
Van le lei loupi naho neipa
Sagoh keuvin cross a nathi'e

Chorus
Thisanlu thisanlu tah chu
I-chonset nao soptheng ahitai
Thisanlu thisanlu tah chun
I-chonset nao soptheng ahitai

Ending
Hinna kaneitai nathi jal in
Nakijep nan eisudam tai
Thisanlu a choh ka hitai
Thisan in them eichantai
Thisan in them eichantai
Thisan in them eichantai

songs.title: VANGBOHNA SIMJOULOU
songs.author: Rev. Onkhomang Touthang
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset hi a loupina le,
Ahoina toh hung bei ding;
Set thuneina Pakaiyin cross chunga ajou soh tai,
Koi hijong le a tahsan jouse hinna ding in,
Calvary cross chunga lhatdamna kot a hong tai.

Verse 2
Mihem chihna le thepna,
Haona, hatna, boltheinaa;
Chan thei hi lou tonsot gou Pakaiyin eihin pe tai,
Ken nikhat le lei kholjin na hi kachai soh a;
Ka tonsot van in nom  a len ding ei nem jing e.

Chorus
:
Vangbohna Sim joulou nitin a kachan hohi,
Pakaiya kon ahi keima thep vang le hatvang hilou
Ami ngailutna le khoto jal bou ahi,
Keima, thahat le, thilbol thei navang hilou.

Verse 3
Ka hinkho jeng jong twimei bang,
Chomlouva hung bei jeng thei;
Hijeng jong le Pakaiyin nitin in eiveng jing in,
Hampa pah bang ka hinkho eiveng bit jingjeng in,
Thahatna damtheina nitin in ei  pe ji

songs.title: VANGKHOJOL
songs.author: NU NEMVEI HAOKIP
songs.lyrics:
Setlei ka chenna vangkho jol hi
Aw chung pathen hinthing pah bang
Hin pahsah o kalenna vangkho jol hi
Chunle jo ngaicheng in kholsin jon tajong le

Neilha kanglou jen un
Neium pi jing unlang
Lhagao hal na nei pi kit uvin
Na lhagao ngai in kaum uve

Pathen ka chenna vangkho jol hi
Aching athem ki sepna hihen
Khangthah te din na phatthei channa hihen
Nule pate adin inchen semdoh na mun

Na lhagao theng ngaichan kaum ui
Lhagao mangsa te huhdoh namun
Lhagao va nguisa teho hal na mun
Tahsa le lhagao phatthei channa mun hihen

Leiset gim gentheina  hesoh namun
Leiset lhepna tuipi kinong bang
Lhepna ka lhahlou nadin nei umpiu vin
Na loupi na kaphondoh theina ding uvinj

songs.title: VEUVIN VANNOI LEISET
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin vannoi leisiet chang amin tai
A natong ache ding koi ham? tin
Tunin khangdong teho lah a
Pakaiyin kho asam sam e

Chorus
Keima kaum nai neisol'in Keima kaum nai neisol'in
Tin katha nei sun sun le
Ka lungthim a pum pin
Ka kipei Pakaiya natong ding in

Verse 2
Hungun golle paite tongpan ute
Tong ute pakaiyin eisol ui
Vannoi leisiet kol kim vel'a Kipana thupha hi phong le din

Verse 3
Veuvin I-gam sung'u adaijou tai
Lhagaova hal doh kitna ding in
Khangdong nang le kei kin ahi
Hungun cheu hite kei kakon tai

songs.title: VO HEZEKIAH
songs.author: Pastor Elvis Nehlal
songs.lyrics:
Vo Hezekiah na inn sung kisem tup ta

Pakaiyin inn sung semtup din nakouve

Pate tunin na mopoh na ve pha tem un

Na inn sung kisem tup din nakouve

Chorus:

Pate na insung na semtup hi nam

Het manlouvin Rapture ni hunglhung jeng le

Insung kikim nantem aw Pakai ang a

Damun jong ding um khante na insung a

Leng Hezekiah'n lung dong in bang lam aven

Adilsun mitlhi lon akap jahtai

Pate tunin nang jong na inn sung nga ding ngin

Mitlhi long nga taopan din in nakou ve

Leng Hezekiah atao na a kisang tai

Thina kon in hinna lam agal kai tai

Pate tunin nang jong thina akon hinna

lampi jon din Pakaijin nakou jing'e

songs.title: ZALENNA KOLNI
songs.author: Henminthang Haokip
songs.lyrics:
Zalenna kolni hungso ding ngahlel in

Amiphunggol tinin pupa jougam leisung ahin

Lungngoi thangoi tah in kagal doh ui

Chungmang pan jalena kolni  hin heitemmo

Chorus:

Ajing nikho hungvah intin zalenna kolni hungso tante

Tia kakinep jing laijun ajing nikho vah jong kidangchom dehlou

Ohe hoilamba hitam zalen nakolni

Amilunglhai cheng nguijin jaitha nemin

Nam dang khutnoi jakon  thoudoh joulou kabang uve

Lungkhat thakhat tah in pangkhom ute

Zalen na niloupi lhung ding kagal dot jingui

Chunnu vailhung ding ngahlel vonchoi te bang

Nam dang khut noija kon chamlhat ding kagal doh jingui

Khangluija akon kakhel nao ngaidamin

Chungmangpan jalenna kolni  hinhei temmo

Jesu bou kadei chungnung pen,

Jesu bou kadei penâ€™e kagol din,
Ama mi chonse te dia jol ahi,
Jesu bou kadei chungnung pen ahi,
Ama banga gol lungnem le thahat dang umlou.

songs.title: 2. LEISET CHUNGA CHENG MIJOUSEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Psalms 100)

Verse 1
Leiset chunga cheng mi jousen,
La ngeiyin Pakai vahchoiyun ;
A anga kunun chibaiyun,
Kipah-in hungun A angah.

Verse 2
Eisempau Pathen Pakai chun,
Eina semun eivah jingui ;
Eiho Ama a ihiuve,
Asemsa Amite ihiu.

Verse 3
Vahchoi pumin A ang jonun,
Kipah in naiyun thanomin ;
Vahchoiyun Amintheng chungnung,
I bol ding doltah cheh ahi.

Verse 4
Lei le van Pathen Theng chungnung,
A milungset tena nei lou ;
Tonsot’a abang hijing jeng,
Kitah jing tonsot tonsot’a.

songs.title: 2. LUNGDON MEI AJING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gethsemani hon’a Pakai Jesu chu ataove,
Mipi ahung kikhom i-Pakai chu man din;
Achung thu lel dan chu athem pouve,
Thempu lal insunga athalou som’un.

Chorus
Lungdon mei ajing, (2)
I-Pakai ahungbom Calvary lhang chunga;
Ling lukhuh le sapsetna thing Cross pun,
Abel ding umtalou i-Pakai Jesu.

Verse 2
Aw Simon Peter le solchah lungdongte hungthouvun,
Ipu chu akaiyun athina ding mun’a,
Van’a hung kumlhan van Lal genthei chu,
Alungdon nem dingin koima um talou.

Verse 3
Iti vetlel umtam i-Pakai Jordan kai ding chu,
Atha ahung nguiyin Alu chu akaikun;
Alhagao alhan thimpi ajingin,
Set le dougal jouvin Jordan lui akai.

Verse 4
Noiya le van chunga thupha ahil Lhandampu chun,
Atha ding agouvin aw Zion nunao ten,
Aphatlai ni chu nasumil tauve,
Nanopnau hilou ham nadamnau Pa chu.

songs.title: LUNGDON MEI AJING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gethsemani hon’a Pakai Jesu chu ataove,
Mipi ahung kikhom i-Pakai chu man din;
Achung thu lel dan chu athem pouve,
Thempu lal insunga athalou som’un.

Chorus
Lungdon mei ajing, (2)
I-Pakai ahungbom Calvary lhang chunga;
Ling lukhuh le sapsetna thing Cross pun,
Abel ding umtalou i-Pakai Jesu.

Verse 2
Aw Simon Peter le solchah lungdongte hungthouvun,
Ipu chu akaiyun athina ding mun’a,
Van’a hung kumlhan van Lal genthei chu,
Alungdon nem dingin koima um talou.

Verse 3
Iti vetlel umtam i-Pakai Jordan kai ding chu,
Atha ahung nguiyin Alu chu akaikun;
Alhagao alhan thimpi ajingin,
Set le dougal jouvin Jordan lui akai.

Verse 4
Noiya le van chunga thupha ahil Lhandampu chun,
Atha ding agouvin aw Zion nunao ten,
Aphatlai ni chu nasumil tauve,
Nanopnau hilou ham nadamnau Pa chu.

songs.title: 3. ITI NGEITAM LUNGSET KIDANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Iti ngeitam lungset kidang,
Chonse kei eilhat tai,
Kei a mangsa eihol dohtai,
Mitchon tun kamu tai.

Verse 2
Hichun kigin je eihil e,
Tun kei eilha montai,
Hi lungset chu eimu sat tai,
Ka tahsan phat phat chun.

Verse 3
Gim hesoh na a kon keima,
Tun sohcha ka hi tai,
Hiti chun eihin puihoi lei,
Tun jong in eilhut ding.

Verse 4
Hi a chun kum sangsom sangja,
Ni bang a em jing ding ,
Tonsot a kipa la sa ding,
Vahchoiyin Lhandampu.

songs.title: 3. PAKAI CHUNGNUNG PATHEN
songs.lyrics:
Key. B. Flat. Sl (Rev. 15:4)

Verse 1
Pakai chungnung Pathen nang,
Na thu jaotah mong neilou ;
Nang gam jousea leng ho Leng,
Tonsot Leng Nang bou nahi.

Verse 2
Juda, Gentile, soh mijai,
Pumkhat hi soh ding nangah ;
Messiah min pan cheh ding,
A ngailut phongjal cheh ding.

Verse 3
Chin te a-ihmut khang ding,
Africa bul kilham ding ;
Na mite hen vo Egypt,
Pathen Nangma vahchoi ding.

Verse 4
India gam hoiya miten,
Na vahchoi langei sading ;
Ceylon twikol min sa ding,
“Leng Christa loupi hen” tia.

Verse 5
Vannoi chitin le namtin,
Lei lallukhuh laltouna ;
Nangma anga kun cheh ding,
Leng ho Leng Pakai chungnung.

songs.title: 3. THE CELESTIAL CITY (L. Th. 24)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hiche leiya kalen lai hin,
Lungdonna jeng bou kamui;
Thina Jordan lui kagal kai teng,
Pakai dei na ang’a ka um ding.
Aw neimu sah-in nasem Salem,
Goldei mithengte lenna;
Kikhen louna gam,
Lei lung jinna hin dalha-a,
Aw itih le kahung lhung tadem.

Verse 2
Gentheiya na umte ho jong,
Mun loupi chu alhun teng;
Che masate le van mithengten,
Salem Pakai chu avahchoiyui.

Verse 3
Tonsot hinna la sate chun,
Eikouvui che masa ten;
Amaho awgin kajah phat in,
Chu mun ngaina in keima ka kap.

Verse 4
Ka ngaiye Nang Immanuel,
Nasem Salem thah hoi chu;
Genthei mun’a cheng kahi Pakai,
Aw Nangin kei nei hung puidoh in.

songs.title: 4. AW VAN LAL AHI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonset bul eikihennau hi,
Sutna in Lhandampu;
Ling lukhuh le lal pon sil’in,
Thisan kai neunouvin puiyun;
Themlalte in tin’a,
Thina hesoh thoh in athisah-un.
AW van Lal ahi,
Genthei tintang thoh chu;
Israelte le milenten,
Thutan vaihomten hechenleu;
Pakai loupina chu thingpel chunga,
Koiman khaisang lou ding.

Verse 2
Mitin anom Cross a tha ding,
Lei lalte insunga;
Van Lal lungdongin akun’in,
Chonsete din along toh-in;
Calvary lhang chunga,
Amelmate chun Hanla asauve.

Verse 3
Aw chung vanpi hung kithingin,
Van Lal phu-la dingin;
Leiset miten ka-la’n sau hen,
Twilon bangin lhi jong long hen;
Lingpi hung kihot hen,
Van Lal donglai gentheiya athi nin.

Verse 4
Chonset bulpi thina genthei,
Jouvin athou kit tai;
Thina jal’a gentheite chu,
Hinkho thah in akipah-un;
Eilhandampu jal’in,
Hinna khopi gamnom alo tauve.

songs.title: 4. I PAKAI VAH A CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I Pakai vah a chu, Ama jui ihiuve,
Loupina ichandiu aum e,
Alunga ichon leh, Aman ei umpi diu,
Huhhingpa ahi tahsan jing in.

Chorus
Tahsan jingin,
Pakai tahsan jing in,
Nopna ding lamdang umlou,
Pakai tahsan tailou.

Verse 2
Chung meithim kailouding, gim hesoh beita ding,
Pathen chenna chung gam nom achun,
Thi le nat umta lou, lhilon na beita ding,
Phatthei na ahi tahsan jing in.

Verse 3
Ami lungsetna chu, mihem ten simjou lou,
A laltouna ilhun teng ule,
Thisan a alhat sa, Ami lungset te chu,
Kipana chang ding tahsan jing in.

Verse 4
Pakai khopi muh a, nomtah a kitou ding,
Ama toh laitol ilen khom diu,
Chung Mitheng te jousen, Ama sei ngai cheh
ding,
Lung olmo louvin tahsan jing in.

songs.title: 4. VO PATHEN CHUNGNUNGPEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl

Verse 1
Vo Pathen chungnungpen kahin vahchoiye,
Hingjing Pathen le ima jouse bolthei ;
Lungdong soh genthei te michonse te jol,
Chagate gentheite (3 vei) Pakai le Pathen.

Verse 2
Mite taona sang Pathen nahijeh in,
Na miten asinmo athumnau pejing ;
Nachate ka le hamna ngailhi jinge,
Thudih a thilpha bol (3 vei) na nungsun ngaipoi.

Verse 3
Hiche hi milen le mineo hetsah in,
Mipite le Nangma thu dou jing ho hi ;
Tua huhhinga aum theina dinguva,
“Ipi kati diu ham” (3 vei) tiu hen lang Amen.

Verse 4
Namtin thim’a kon soh a kon kipah hen,
“Chungnung pen’a Pathen loupina hihen,
Lei chunga kipahte chunga cham leng hen,
“Hosana” (6 vei) samin la’n sau hen.

songs.title: 5. KACHUN NGAI KEN SUMIL THEILOU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kachun ngai ken sumil theilou
Eilhahna lungset awnem chu,
Kanao nei dalha jongle chun,
Katao peh na hi gel jinginâ

Chorus
Kachun ngai ken kagel doh teng,
Ka kom a um in kabol ji,
Lenlhang phaithi nun gin kajah,
Kachun nu tao awâ€™n kagel ji.

Verse 2
Kachun ngai ken sumil theilou,
I chanâ€™a gamla hijong le,
Kanun eitaopeh na aw chu,
Kalung sunga aging jinge.

Verse 3
Kumkho sot in jong kamil poi,
Kachun nun neitao pehna chu,
Ka dinga dilsua atao pet,
Kalung mit in ken kamu jing.

Verse 4
Lhandampuâ€™n kei eilungset na,
Sumil ponge itih chan in,
Kachun nu taona asang in,
Ka chonset ei ngaidam sohtai.
Huhhingpa Nang kavahchoiye,
Chung gam Mitheng nomte lai-ah,
Kachun ngaitoh kimu kit ding,
Chun ngai tao gui lhunna ahi.

songs.title: 5. LUNGIN VAN GAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungin van gam ka ngaito le,
Leiset gimna thoh joute chu;
Nui siuseuva um ka gahmui,
Akipanau la awnem chu;
Nitin olpet kanei thei poi,
Aw lhunkal ka ngahlel ngeiye.
Nei hin vetan van Lal Pakai,
Lungset um le hatlou kahi;
Chonset’in thih khaovin eihen,
Nagam hunglhun ding nom jong leng;
Thina le lung jinnate hin,
Nitin in eibom’e.

Verse 2
Kei ngaito a hung thei hilou,
Ti hi nei hin hetsah jal’in;
Lungdonin eisun khum jitai,
Lhunkal ka ngalel jal ahi;
Pakai nagam theng nom em chu,
Ngaiyin ka lan kasa jitai.

Verse 3
Ima jouse ka ngaito le,
Ka gentheije ka kihetnin;
Ka kakho sotna ding bep’in,
Kap pet chapang banga nuina;
Leisetna hin kamu jou poi,
Ngailou thei chu kahi tapoi.

Verse 4
Kap pet nao bangin nui ponge,
Pakai neihung pui masangsen;
Ka lung donna hi bei ponte,
Ka khankho akikhelma hin;
Van gam lhunkal ngahlel jong leng,
Pakai hung lhung theisam ponge.

Verse 5
Leiset gimmun jenga jong hin,
Pakai nangin nei umpi le;
I-louva ka lungdon ding ham?
Nei umpi ti kahet phat le;
Kap pet nao bangin nuiying ting,
Leiset gimna hi mil tange.

songs.title: 5. TONSOT TONSOTNA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Tonsot tonsot’a Pathen keima kaina,
Leiset kisem masang laipeh a-umsa ;
Nangma let thu chan sei thei dinga koi ham ?
Nangma lung ngaito hepha dinga umlou.

Verse 2
Kum sangsom sangja Nangma dinga haini,
Hiti chun Nangma phat umchan ka Pathen ;
Keima hinkho vang ihmutlan mang bangin,
Niseh in akem jinge che mang loi din.

Verse 3
Hui nun’a thingna louna apul bangin,
Nangma lung hanna mihemte thigam thei ;
Hing kahi keima Nangma vanga Pathen,
Nangma louva keima ima tithei lou.

Verse 4
Na lung hanna kon iti sochat ningem ?
Nang gin’in hoiya gakisel tangem kei ;
Leng theiying twilen leng galkai le jong leng,
Chukom jongchu Nangma angsung ma hi ding.

songs.title: 6. ATHENG, ATHENG, ATHENG!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat d. (Rev. 4:8)

Verse 1
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! Pathen hat chungnung pen,
Jingpi tah-in Nangma vahchoi la ka sauve ;
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! mikhoto hat chungnung,
Athuminin khat hin, khat chu thum ahi.

Verse 2
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! van mithengte jousen,
A lhai jingui Ama chu tantih nei louvin ;
Vantil asangja le van mithengte jousen,
A lhai jingui Ama tan nei louvin.

Verse 3
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! leiset mite vet’a,
Nangma loupi akimu thei lou jeng vangin ;
Nangma bou Athenga atheng adang umlou,
Theng le mi khoto lungset chamkim soh.

Verse 4
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! Pathen hat chamkim soh,
Vannoi namtin jousen Nangma jeng bou lhai ding ;
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng ! mi lungset hat chungnung,
A thumin khat hin, khat chu thum ahi.

songs.title: 6. KAHIL THEIPOI HOIYA HUNGKON
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kahil theipoi hoiya hung kon,
Kalung a chamna hi,
Cham nan alo bou hi kahei,
Dam heova a hin lo.
Ka lunga chamna luipi along (2)
Kavelâ€™a set twi long jong le
Christan ei umpi nai.

Verse 2
Tohgim noiya um hijong leng,
Luipi kisel long jing,
Kalha lengvai dang nou jing ding,
Chang a lunghel lou ding.

Verse 3
Kasei theipoi a ngailut na,
Chungnung eipeh u hi,
Ka lungsung thim jing semhoh ta,
Tahsan jal bou ahi.

Verse 4
Kahil theipoi I pia eilhen,
Gimthoh le thi ding a,
Hinla athoh khompi hileng,
Ama toh leng chang ding.

songs.title: 6. WITHOUT THEE WE CANNOT LIVE (L. Th. 50)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Eilhandampu ka ngai tangeiye,
Kei din lungdon meipi ajing;
Namel dei um kei dia lung kinepna,
Valpa ahsi’n hungvah kit’in.

Chorus
Aw ka ngai lheh jenge,
Nei umpin lang;
Na umlou le a aw nang ka Pakai,
Kei mong theilou ding.

Verse 2
Ka lenna gamthip genthei mun ahi,
Nei dalhah hih-in Lhandampu;
Na lungsetna chun nei ching jingin lang,
Lam hilouva kache laisen.

Verse 3
Thina Jordan luiya leng jeng jong leng,
Nei umpin lang aw Lal Jesu;
Na gamnom lungsetna kul sunga chun,
Nei puilut’in Nang vahchoi din.

Verse 4
Salem kulsung hinna theng tah a chun,
Vantil thengte umjeng jongle;
Nang na umlou le Eilhandampu chu,
Ngaiying kating mongjou ponge.

songs.title: 7. KA NGAIYE KIKHEN LOUNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ngaiye kikhen louna,
Pathen chenna Gam chu;
Kolni hungsoh kit ding,
I-kikhenna dingin,
Ka ngai kikhen louna Zion gam chu.
Ka ngai van pahcha pahna,
Kikhen louna khopi;
Pakai mel le hinna thingphung,
Saron pah hoi a-pah.

Verse 2
Van Jerusalem nom’a,
Hinna twi along’e;
Mitna mulou gam le,
Hinna thing lim noiya,
Salem tolpi sunga nei puilut in.

Verse 3
Lalna kulpi sunga chun,
Van kelngoite aleng;
Janthim lungdonna le,
Ka-na aum tapoi,
Eilhut inte Pakaiyin Salem chu.

Verse 4
Lalna kulpi thu chan chu,
Seijou gol ahipoi;
Pakai Lhandampu le,
Van mithengte lenna,
Ka Pakai lenna Zion lhang hoi chu.

songs.title: 7. KIPAH-UN PATHEN’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl
(Psalms 68:3)

Verse 1
Kipah-un Pathen’a nom’un,
Lung thengsel mithengte jousen ;
Pathen chu ging’un tahsan’un,
Genthei gim lungdon pai lhauvin.

Chorus
Nom’un … Nom’un,
Kipah-un Pathen’a nom’un ;
Nom’un … Nom’un,
Kipah-un Pathen’a nom’un.

Verse 2
Nom’un Ama Pakai ahi,
Vannoi leiset le van chunga ;
Aman gam thum vaipi apoi,
Eihuhhing hatchungnung ahi.

Verse 3
Muthim’in nang khu jongle chun,
Janna vanpi nim bang jongle ;
Ima lungdonna nei louvin,
Pathen jenga tahsan jingun.

Verse 4
Kipah-un Pathena nom’un,
A vahchoina la ngei sauvin ;
Sauvin na-o sansah un lang,
Ao-vun Halleluiyah tiuvin.

songs.title: 7. THILSEM KIDANG HOHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thilsem kidang hohi kageldoh kom le,
Pathen loupina chu akilang e,
Vanâ€™a ahsi le van gin kithong jong hi,
Abonchan ama thahat na ahi.
Chuteng kalhan vahchoi ding Huhhingpa,
Aloupi ngei aloupi ngei (2)

Verse 2
Gammang thimjing lai a keima ka leng e,
Ham ngei kidang vacha aw chu kajai,
Molsang chung vumâ€™a kon in kagal dot le,
Nemheu hui lhi le gin ngei chu kajai.

Verse 3
Pathen milungset kidang chu kahetai,
Chapa chang khat leiset a hinsol lhan,
Olmo louvin Calvary cross chunga chun,
Ka chonset jouse apomang sohtai.

Verse 4
Loupi tah Pakai chu ahung teng leh,
A Inpia eipui tou niteng chuleh,
Kalung le kalha kipana dimset ding,
â€œAloupi ngeiâ€ ting ting vahchoi tange.

songs.title: 8. JAN LUNGJIN UMPET’IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jan lungjin umpet’in i-Pakai Jesu chun,
Atahsa ahom’e athisan ahom’e;
Nei het jingna dingun chehi don’un ati,
Lungdon mitlhi pum’in.

Chorus
Te-na asem’uvin Zion kulpi sunga,
Lhing louvin alhin sah-un;
Athudih a tan talou,
I-Pakai chunga hin.

Verse 2
Honlam jonin potnun galto kitoh dingin,
Aloite lung dongin ana ihmu tauve;
Pakaiyin achangin ul thisan soh leuvin,
Jankhon Pathen alhai.

Verse 3
Roman sepai engse ho chun abol seuve,
Veuvin kotpi phung chu thisan kainel nul’in,
Khodung le khovaiya akai le le tauve,
Pakai genthei Pa chu.

songs.title: 8. KAKIPAH-E VAN’A KAPA AUM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl (I John 4:8)

Verse 1
Ka kipah-e van’a ka-Pa aum,
Athupha lungmonna thu eihil’e ;
Athupha bua thu kidang tah kamui,
Hibang thupha Jesun eilungsetna.

Chorus
Ka kipah-e, Jesun eilungset,
Kei eilungset, kei eilungset ;
Ka kipah-e, Jesun eilungset,
Kei jong eilungset’e.

Verse 2
Ken Ama sumil’ing lamvai jong leng,
Mang tajong leng Aman eilungset’e ;
Aman eilungset ken kagel doh teng,
Kalut kit jitai Ama khut sunga.

Verse 3
Keiman langei khat anasa thei leng,
Leng loupi chungnung mel kamu ni le ;
Hichu hiding ka tonsot chulmo la,
Jesun eilungsetna akidang’e.

Verse 4
Kichen tah a lungmonga kahi tai,
Jesu tahsana nomsa kahitai ;
Kalunga kon satan ajamji tai,
Jesun eilungset keiman kasei teng.

songs.title: 8. TAONA LOLHIN SAH PEN PATHEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Taona lolhin sah pen Pathen,
lhamonna kathumâ€™e,
Lungdong in hesoh jeng jong leng.
Pakai neithe hih in.

Verse 2
Nangma banga um kanom e,
Nangbou ei ngailu pen,
Thengsel chan umthei hih jong leng.

Verse 3
Na nopna chang hoi kahipoi,
chonse kahi jeh in,
Nang komâ€™a hung dinga lomlou.

Verse 4
Ule nao ka inko ten jong,
eideimon eitheu hen,
Golcheng in eidalha jong leu.

Verse 5
Hi leiset a nahung kumlhan,
thingpel a nahung thin,
Vanâ€™a neitao peh jing jeh un.

Verse 6
Houbung lah a umthei dingin,
thina ging talou vin,
Vanâ€™a kitup tah a um din.

Verse 7
Mihem thi le hing thu tan a,
Loupi le ja umâ€™a,
Meilomâ€™a nahung kum phat teng.

songs.title: 9. EIHUHHINGPAN EIPUILEN EICHINGNAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. d (Psalms 49:2)

Verse 1
Eihuhhingpan eipuilen eichingnai,
Itobang hung lhung jongle kahoiye ;
Hui le go kithona a eisel ding,
A khutphang komtong sunga.
A khutphang komtong sunga, (2 vei)
Itobang hung lhung jongle ka hoiye ;
Akhutphang komtong sunga.

Verse 2
A milungset ban’in kei eihoiye,
A van lungmonna thun eilha mon’e ;
Pathen khut’in eikoiyin ka hoiye,
A khutphang komtong sunga.

Verse 3
A lungsetna ken sumil joulou ding,
Ka Pathen toh eikhen jou ding umlou ;
I-tihchan hijongle eilha lou ding,
A khutphang komtong sunga.

songs.title: 9. THE LILY OF THE VALLEY (L. Th. 9)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei Lal pon loupi chu kem’inte,
Molhoi pahcha jong chu kem’inte;
I-hinkhou jong hi ahung mangloi thei ahi,
Hijongle Pakai Jesu keiya.

Chorus
Mol hoi pah bang Lal Jesu keiya,
Kei dinga pah tonsot gam nom’a;
Gentheina a jong Aman eiumpi ding,
Mol hoi pah bang Lal Jesu keiya.

Verse 2
Eilungsetnau gamnom em’a chun,
Ama chu tonsot Valpa ahi;
Genthei thoh jeng jong leng hinoi leisetna hin,
Agam’a chun eipuilut inte.

Verse 3
Tuhin kap in peng peng jeng jong leng,
Thina in kamit asin tengle;
Kicha louvin lhanthim’a kon eikaithou ding,
Ka mitlhi jouse theh hul’inte.

Verse 4
Kagol ngaiten hinoi leisetna,
Eidalhauvin kalung ahel’e;
Hijeng jongle kalung ngai bangin ka umnai,
Molhoi pah bang Lal Jesu keiya.

songs.title: 9. VANGPHAT NA THISAN LUINAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vangphat na thisan luinah chun,
Vannoi chonset a lhat ahi,
Nunnom hen Pathen Chapa chu,
athoh mahan eidam sah ui,
Ahong a kon vahmang kahi,
kalungsung nat le sat adim,
Kelngoi nou thisan in soplhan,
kei buhbang sanga bang joding.
Buh â€¦..sanga bang jon (2)
Kelngoi nou thisan in soplhan,
Kei buhbang sanga bang joding.

Verse 2
A lallukhuh chu ling lukhuh,
ahin cross a chun ajoutai,
Lungdon le hesoh athoh in,
athoh gimna chu moh hilou,
Chu luinah chu kalhung theidem?
Hichun ka chonset soptheng ding,
Chu thisan longlhan neisil in,
kei buhbang sanga bang joding.

Verse 3
Pathen nanga kon vahmanga,
kalung chonset nan lamvai in,
Kalungsung setnan lo dimta,
twiya sotheng thei hita lou,
Jesu nangma twikhuh jon in,
na thutep ging chan ka hunge,
Na thisan in neisop theng in,
kei buhbang sanga bang joding.

songs.title: 10. KAMIT IN PAKAI HUNGNADING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. sl (Psalms 24:8)

Verse 1
Ka mit’in Pakai hung nading loupitah chu amu tai,
Lung hanna lengpi theiga kikhol’a chu chilngim dingin ;
Aman kolphe banga man-gangtah chemjam chu alamtai,
Pathen agal kon’e.
Aloupita ! Halleluiyah (3vei)
Pathen agal kon’e.

Verse 2
Simsenlou sepai galkappet ve ding Pakai kamu tai,
Nilhah dainou lah a Ama din Maicham asah peh un ;
Achonphat thulhun chu meivah pha bangin kasim theiye,
Pathen agal kon’e.

Verse 3
Hung kinung tol’un tilouhel dingin sumkon amut tai,
Athupi tan masanga mihemte lung akhensoh ding ;
Gangin kalha Ama donbut ding thanomin ka khophang,
Pathen agal kon’e.

Verse 4
Twikhanglen gal’a lily hoi lah a Christa peng ahi.
Ama anga loupitah a nang le kei ivou kikhel ;
Mi thenna dia athi bangin thiu hite mi hinna din,
Pathen agal kon’e.

songs.title: 10. PACHATNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kei dingin Pathen hou thu la,
Hi aging deng deng;
Chuteng kei jong lut ding,
Aumna gam sungah.

Chorus
Kei dingin aging deng deng,
Hiche gin ngai kihol leh;
Hoiyah kimun tem,
Agin ngeidan aging deng deng.

Verse 2
Kei dingin hitobang la hi,
Kalung adim’e;
Agin ngeidan chun kalung sunga,
Ging deng deng.

Verse 3
Hitobang la ging deng deng hi,
Ken milta ponge;
Ka gol ngaite ka lhai,
Hiche ging deng deng hin.

songs.title: 10. TUNIA CHOLDO NITHENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tunia choldo nitheng hunglhung,
Avahchoi din ikikhom ui,
Jingpia thou in Ama hou din,
I kipanau thu lhut ute.

Verse 2
Chonset pumâ€™a thupha choiyin,
Eihon thuse ijop jing un,
Alungset kidang I gelle,
Eihing hoi datmo aum e.

Verse 3
Nigup sung in na itong un,
Pakai nitheng nitding ahi,
Ama thu jeng bou gelna dia,
Pakai nitheng asem ahi.

Verse 4
Ka lunggel in thu man louho,
Van gam thu tailou gelda hen,
Pathen loupi le Athen je,
Ngaito jo hen adol ahi.

Verse 5
Jesu bang a thilpha bol in,
Ama bang a thusei theinan,
Pakai Lha Theng bou ka ngaiye,
Van choldo na a eipui din.

songs.title: 11. KUM LHOMCHA BOU UMTA
songs.lyrics:
