Verse 1
Kum lhomcha bou umta,
Phat chomkhat hung beiding,
Ngai cheng toh ibol khom nadiu,
Lhanâ€™a mol lem ho toh.

Chorus
Aw Pakai neisemphan,
Na niloupi nia din,
Na thisan luâ€™n neisop theng in,
Ka setna siltheng in.

Verse 2
Ni lhomcha bou umta,
Hiche gam thimâ€™a hin,
Nisa ngailou na ichen diu,
I monnau chung chon ding.

Verse 3
Chomkhat meipi ajing,
Hiche songthop gamâ€™a,
Huipi nun louna ichen diu,
Luipi nong umlou ding.

Verse 4
Gentheina chom khat bou,
Kikhen na chom cha bou,
Tohgim kana chomkhat jou le,
Kana umta louding.

Verse 5
Hicheng hi chomkhat bou,
Ama hung kit loiding,
I hinna diuva thoukit pa,
Ama toh leng chang ding.

songs.title: 11. LEISET LUNGNGAINA JOUSE HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset lungngaina jouse hi,
Pel tange tonsot gam nom’a;
Alungsetna lhalim noiya,
Pakai ngaiyin eikouve.

Chorus
Umkit lou ding kikhen kitna,
Lung gentheina mitlhi lonna;
Eilhandampu Pakai Jesun,
Na theh hulpeh inge ati.

Verse 2
Lhandampu chun anagotsa,
Kipana khopi emnom chu;
Chu loupi mun emtah a chun,
Tonsotna em ding kahi.

Verse 3
Kipah tah in vantilte le,
Lhatdam chate ikikhop diu;
Tonsot hin kemlou ichan diu,
Kikhen kitna umlou ding.

Verse 4
Calvary lhang kagavet le,
Ka chenna gam ding alange;
Van Kelngoinou Lalna ahi,
Sana khopi em sunga.

Verse 5
Lhandampu lungsetna jal’in,
Aloupina chu ichan diu;
Chu gam emnom chu kalhun ding,
Vahchoina chim talou ding.

songs.title: 11. VAHCHOIYUN LOUPI LENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat d. (Psalms 34:1)

Verse 1
Vahchoiyun loupi Leng, Pathen chungnung chu,
Vahchoiyun thil kidang eibolpeh jal’un ;
Umpi jing eithutep, ichenau chan’a,
Meikou le mei lom’a, eipui le jal’un.
Van mitheng vah jousen,
Vahchoi vahchoiyun,
Choi-an’un amiten,
Amai mucheng chun ;
A gamsung loupia chun,
Phat kitol laisen,
Anatoh ho jousen (2 vei)
Pathen vahchoi cheh ding,
Kalhan vahchoi ding.

Verse 2
Vahchoiyun manbeiya, mijouse alhat,
Hinna twinah eipe, eidamsah thei chu ;
Eilungset eihepiu, lungsetna jallin,
I taonau a sange ti kichet jallin.

Verse 3
Vahchoiyun lungsetna gui eilhah-uva,
Van chunga thilpha toh eikan gom’uva ;
Tahsan’a gal jona, kinepna vah jing,
I ngai cheng chen khomna agam nom ahi.

songs.title: 12. CALVARY LHANG CHUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary lhang chunga Pakai chu,
Cross chunga linglukhuh le;
Mipi ho nuisat dingin,
Thingleh a akhai sangun.
Aw ana ngeiye ka Pakai thohna chu,
Akhut, akeng, alu veuvin;
Chonset jal’in athisan,
Theng tah chu alonglha tai,
Lungset um ngei Pa chu.

Verse 2
Athi dinga adangchah lai chun,
Koima chan apenom poi;
Melmaten hem’in nouvin,
Dangchah giu geuvin athi.

Verse 3
Kadang achah-e tia athum chun,
Ju thuh adonsah uvin;
Ju thuh chun sunou lou ding,
Lhagao ngaiya chah ahi.

Verse 4
Aw ka lhagao nalhat Pa natje,
Keiman ka hilchen thei poi;
Chen lang Calvary lhanga,
I-Pakai chu gadong tan.

songs.title: 12. KELNGOI CHINGHON AGAM GENA UVA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kelngoi chinghon agam gena uva,
Jankhang lai in Vantil sangja hung kilah in,
Chung a la ngei tah in asauve,
Hichu Pakai golnop kipat ahi.
Nopni ..Nopni..Nopni..Nopni
Apeng tai vannoi Leng chungnung.

Verse 2
Valpa hung soh solam a kon in,
Jing ninou bang in ahung vah kidang tah in
Hichun vannoi ahin salsoh in,
Hichu sun le jan in avah jinge.

Verse 3
Hiche solam Valpa vah kai chun,
Latah a kon solam miching thum ahung e,
"Israel te Leng hoiya peng ham"?
Tin ahin hol un valpa vah kai in.

Verse 4
Miching ho chu Naosen umna In,
Sunga alut un hapan akipah uvin,
Kipa man in Sana, Bego, Mor,
Lultah in apeuvin alem uve.

songs.title: 12. LAM NEI HIL’IN O JEHOVAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. sl
(Psalms 73:24)

Verse 1
Lam nei hil’in O Jehovah,
Hiche leiset gam thim’a ;
Pathen Nangma hat chungnungin,
Nei huhhing lungdonna.
Van’a kon’in, van’a kon’in ;
Hinna an chun nei vah in. (2)

Verse 2
Pathen keima nei hon peh in,
Hinna twinah kemlou chu ;
Na Lhagao chun neipui len lang,
Ka masang sanga che hen.
Hat chungnungin, hat chungnungin ;
Nei-huhhingin kei Jesun. (2)

Verse 3
Jordan luipi gal kakaiya,
Hi leiset ka dalhah teng ;
Ka lungdonna sumang soh in,
Nei pui lhung teiyin van gam.
Na vahchoi la, Na vahchoi la ;
Bangmon sange ni tinin. (2 )

songs.title: 13. EDEN HON’A PATHENIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Gen. 2:24)

Verse 1
Eden hon’a Pathenin,
Ana sem’in nu le pa ;
Ana gom’in lul tah in,
Phattheina tincheng apei.

Chorus
Pathen Adam le Eve,
Na nagom’in pentil in ;
Tun jong hite ni gomin,
Phattheina chamkim in pen.

Verse 2
Pentil thu umchan bangin,
A kicheng tai hite ni ;
Anu apa hin dalhan,
Kikhen kittih neilou din.

Verse 3
Kilungset to gel tah in,
Kivahto jing jeng lhon hen ;
Apheu alhau khat hi hen,
Lung khat’in in-cheng lhon hen.

Verse 4
Pathen houvin kumtu hen,
Chung gam alhun teng jongle ;
Mun khat’a kaltou lhon hen,
Van gam nom’a cheng lhon hen.

songs.title: 13. THE LILY OF THE VALLEY (L. Th. 9)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kinepna gam kagel chim poi,
Lei lungdonna gal lam;
Hin lai lungdon meipi noiya,
Pel tange ka-na gam.

Chorus
Lei lungdonna mitlhi hul ding,
Ka-na nikho mangtante;
Pakai mel mukal ka ngah lel,
Aw mang tahen leiset hi.

Verse 2
Calvary ka ngai loupi pen,
Van gam kot ahong’e;
Gachen chu-a aw kalhagao,
Alange van gam nom.

Verse 3
Ka-na janthim hi mangta hen,
Jordan luigal lam’a;
Leiset gentheina kakhel teng,
Ngai ponge ka-na gam.

Verse 4
Kei jong itih le kalhung dem,
Jordan luigal lam chu;
Aw ka ngaiye kagol ngaite,
Che tange chu gam’a.

songs.title: 13. THINA LUIGAL A KHOPI HOITAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thina luigal a khopi hoitah aumâ€™e,
Aloupi je koiman sei joulou,
Chua ni lhum ngailou thingna jong pul ngailou,
Chung sana khopi nom tah a chun.
Chu a ni lhum ngailou,
Thingna jong pul ngailou,
Chu gamâ€™a chu Lhandampu le
Mitheng te cheng,
Chung sana khopi nom tah a chun.

Verse 2
Chung gamâ€™a Leng chu eihuhhingpa le Pakai,
Genthei molso cheng toh acheng ui,
Chua chun ahsi bang in a emsel jingui,
Chung sana khopi nom tah a chun.

Verse 3
Lhagao mangsa cross phunga lhutsoh uhite,
Kelngoi hon lah a lhalut ute,
Hichu i-dinguva van Lallukhuh hiding,
Chung sana khopi nom tah a chun.

songs.title: 14. KAPA NANGMA LAM KASANG’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d (Psalms 88:9)

Verse 1
Ka Pa nangma lam ka sange,
Eihu ding dang umlou ;
Nei dalhan kichon mang le chun,
Hoiya iti tang’em ?

Chorus
Ka tahsane, ka tahsane,
Kei jal’a Jesu thi ;
Ama thisan lu tah a chun,
Ka chonset theng soh ding.

Verse 2
Na Chapa Jesu a thoh in,
Ka hai thei masangin ;
Nat thoh lel gimna athoh tai,
Ka lhagao huhhing nan.

Verse 3
Jesu Nang ka tahsan thei tai,
Na thahat chu ka hei ;
Ka ngaichat jouse tun neipen,
Kalung kipah jing hen.

Verse 4
Jesu nangma lam ka sange,
Ka mit khamna neiven ;
Nei pen na thilpha lu tah chu,
Hibou chu ka hinna.

songs.title: 14. KUM LUI MANGTA NILE LHA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kumlui mangta nile lha kum kiheita,
Tujing kumthah ni emsel sohta,
Jalna kon in hung thoudou un lhaisel in,
Kipah in lem ute ninou emsel toh.

Chorus
Hung un Hung un Pakai vahchoi ute,
Alungset na sumil ding koi ham?
Kumlhung a damsel a eichingpau ahi,
Tonsot tonsot in Amin loupi jing hen.

Verse 2
Hinkho lhing a chemasa ingai teu chu,
Tuhin van gam nomâ€™a aleng ui,
Iding chu ho pul idou diu ham leiya,
Kumlhung a Eiching pau Pathen vahchoi un.

Verse 3
Kipana thule tohga keng in hung in,
Tunin Pa ahunge vang hom din,
Lhandampun na chonna thuphon angai nom,
Kumlhung a mona phong in lang set bangtan.

Verse 4
Ningkum lhau te tukum lemnan la sautÃ©,
Nabon un na inkon hung lhauvin,
Nung le Pa vangpeh chan jouse kisih ding,
Lhaisel in lem ute Pa le Lhandampu

songs.title: 14. WE ARE MARCHING TO OUR HEAVENLY HOME
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tu athah kilungsetna gam em’a,
Ka Pakai mun loupi;
Kipana pahcha namtui apah tai,
Chul kitta lou dingin.

Chorus
Olle ikikhop diu nomtah a,
Van mithengte ho jouse khuto;
Lungdonna gam’a ika-nau hi,
I-Pakai anga kipa la ding.

Verse 2
Ka hinlai ni hi akem masang sen,
Ka dinga mei jing jing;
Ajou le chu gam kalhun teng chule,
Lei hi ngai talou ding.

Verse 3
Chu gam khopi emhoi tah chu jonin,
Lei hi dalha tang ting;
Tun agim namtui chu ka tepkha tai,
Aw anomna dinge.

Verse 4
Eihuhhingpa mel dei um kamu teng,
Alaltouna chunga;
Thu atan ding lhatsate kipana,
Hallelujah Amen.

songs.title: 15. BEIHEN KATAHSAN MO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Beihen katahsan mo ka komâ€™a Jesu,
Hoinan te Pathen in Ama chate chu,
Kei aheng a tao leng thonmon ngai nante,
Ka komâ€™a naum le ka olmona bei.

Verse 2
Kalam mu athim vang aman eipui nai,
Ken athu kangai ding aman eipui chu,
Kong keh hen mijouse lhamang jeng jongle,
Ama thusei vang chu khang tou jing tei ding.

Verse 3
Ama milungset ken tuman kamu tai,
Kei athi tading sa eina cho hing tai,
Aman a aw ngei chun eina lhem dam in,
Aman lunglhai sel in eina huhhing tai.

Verse 4
Nat le genthei lengvai lungdon olmo na,
Keima lung pha mongem aman seisoh ta,
Sochat na ding chu kahei ama seinan,
Iti nama jong le jui jinge Pakai.

Verse 5
Koima cha ngam lou ding Ama thoh bang chu,
Athoh tai mi chonse sochat theina ding,
Lamse jo a achetai kei lampi sang a,
Pakai chena a chun kei che daâ€™ng ka tem?

songs.title: 15. KAPATHEN NANGMA KOM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Jas. 4:8)

Verse 1
Ka Pathen Nangma kom, ka hung naiye,
Gim genthei lungdonna, toh jeng jong leng ;
Na vahchoi la sange, Na kom ka hung naiye,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom, ka hung naiye.

Verse 2
Kho jing hen thim jongle, nei lhonpin lang,
Vah hen thim jeng jongle, nei pui lhungin ;
Ka tah in ka mangin, na kom nai ka nom’e,
Na kom cheh a Pathen, ka hung naiye.

Verse 3
Van jotna van lampi, hin lhung lhan lang,
Van kalbi hin lah in, nei lungset in ;
Na vantil hin sol lhan, eipui lhung pai dingin,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom, ka hung naiye.

Verse 4
Lungjinna kon ka thoa, ka lunghal teng,
Pathen Nang vahchoi la, keiman sange ;
Ka hunge nei sangin, neilan nei chul namin,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom, ka hung naiye.

Verse 5
Len theina ving neiying, kipah tah in,
Nisa sanga sangjon, leng sang jong leng ;
Hiche la hi mangmon, na vahchoi nan sange,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom, na hung naiye.

songs.title: 15. THE BLESSED DAY (L. Th. 149)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdonna meipi laiya,
Keima ka lenge;
Kipana ni em chul’in,
Kho avah thei lou.
Aw vanghomna ni kangai ngeiye,
Ka chunga hung vah-in,
Thimna gal lennin eikhang vel’e,
Aw hung vah-in natonsot gam,
Nopna kholmun’a nei hung puiyin.

Verse 2
Adam lhan thimpi sunga,
Aw navah ngaiyin;
Lhatna thisan lu jal’in,
Nang kahin sam’e.

Verse 3
Lei hi hamna in aloi,
Chitin namtin din;
Aw Eden ni em chul’in,
Ngaina bang thei lou.

Verse 4
Olle lhagao lei thah-a,
Kipana lhun teng;
Thim le vannoi leiset pah,
Hi inemse diu.

songs.title: 16. ANTICIPATION OF HEAVEN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka loupina ni le ka hinna din,
Galgin um le kichat umlouna;
Gamthip a konin kamu pha joupoi,
Chu gam lhun ding chu kalung kinem.

Chorus
Galdot jing inge kalhun masangsen,
Kilungsetna gam em le nopna;
Miten chu mun chu luiyin gel jongle,
Kasei thei poi thah-in alange.

Verse 2
Hiti phat chule chitin namtin ten,
Aloupina emjam vel’a chun;
Lhandampu mel emhoi le loupi chu,
Amu phat ule tahsan unte.

Verse 3
Ka lhagao lungdong le genthei koma,
Kilungsetna Christa Thu hinna;
Ka dinga jong aphaltah jeh-u chun,
Hallelujah vahchoi chim ponge.

Verse 4
Gamthim genthei mun’a kon vahmangsa,
Nitinin lungjin nan eibom’e;
Lhandampu ang’a kadin phat chule,
Ka lungdonna ka kipana ding.

Verse 5
Ajou le Pathen cha lungsette to,
Tonsot valpa ahsi emhoi chu;
Ka dinga um ahitai abonchan,
Tonsot kipa la chu sa tange.

songs.title: 16. CHENA VANA HOIMA JOUSEA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. s (Isaiah 41:13)

Verse 1
Chena vana hoima jousea,
Pathenin eipuile jing nai ;
Lung gel le na tohna jousea,
Pathenin eipuile jing nai.

Chorus
Pathenin eipuile jing nai,
Ama khut tah in eikai lei ;
Aseijui tahsan kichen tah,
Hinge eipuile jing jeh in.

Verse 2
Lungjin, lungdon nat thoh lelna,
Genthei nan eibom jeng jong le ;
A van thupha hinna thu chun,
Eipui len eilhem lungmonge.

Verse 3
Hahsa toh ing nom toh jong leng,
Twihat le twinem pal jong leng ;
Eden hon noma leng jong leng,
Pathenin eipuile jing nai.

Verse 4
Ka thi teng keima Pathenin,
Jordan lui eipui galkai ding ;
Van in nom’a cheng jing tange.
Olmo lou Aman eipui nai.

songs.title: 16. PAKAI CHRISTA LENG CHU VAHCHOI UN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai Christa Leng chu vahchoi un,
A tonsot in vahchoi in umhen,
Loupi jana Ama a ahi,
Tun jong atonsot in.

Chorus
Vahchoi ute, Vahchoi ute,
Gam loupia Leng vahchoi uhite,
Vahchoi cheh uhite,
Alem nan aw ging hen.

Verse 2
Chung a Vantil sangjan alem ui,
Laltouna kim in la asauve,
Namtin in jom un kipana la,
Vahchoi un Leng chungnung.

Verse 3
Chonset galjou Ama bou ahi,
I chunguva Aman vaihom hen,
Amin a eiman jong ijo ding,
Tonsot in vahchoi un.

songs.title: 17. JESU KALUNG IN KADEI PEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu kalung in kadei pen,
Vang neipeh chu muchen thei leng,
O nadei bang tah in neipen,
Nangma bou chu lungset theina.

Chorus
Lungthim giltah neihin peuvin,
Na khopi hoi chu muna din,
Ka lungthim hi hinvah sah in,
Kei dinga um vanâ€™a Pathen.

Verse 2
Pathen nang in kei nei lungset,
Chonse ho jong Nang a ahi,
Kipah tahin nang ka sange,
Mu kanom e neilungset na.

Verse 3
Kholmun olna gam nom a chun,
Pahcha hoitah gamu jong leng,
Lhagao hatmo hatsah na ding,
Na lungset na kallhah umlou.

Verse 4
Lungset tah in halna neipen,
Na gam loupi neimu sah in,
Na lhenchom te kipa na ding,
Neihol nau chu neimu sah in.

songs.title: 17. REDEMPTION (L. Th. 8)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu chun chonset jeh in,
Leiya genthei thoh-in;
Michonse khang gilou bangin,
Thinga akhen beh-un.

Chorus
Aw hinna Lal thengpen Pa chun,
Kei din athoh joutai;
Lungdonna genthei athoh in,
Chonse eilhatdam tai.

Verse 2
Alampi chu vetem uvin,
Calvary lhang geiyin;
Pakai kajui ngamta pouve,
Aloiten atiuve.

Verse 3
Lhandampun “Ka dang achah-e”,
Ti-a asap lai chun;
Mipi tamtah jeng ho jong chu,
Twi penom aumpoi.

Verse 4
Alungdonna atao pet in,
Panpi ding ahol’e;
Ami deite achu-na in,
Thina akimu tai.

songs.title: 17. VO PATHEN NANGMA VAHCHOI LA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl (Psalms 118:15)

Verse 1
Vo Pathen Nangma, vahchoi la kasauve,
Eihuhhing din Nachapa nahinsol lhai ;
Halleluijah ! Nang naloupi,
Halleluijah ! Amen !
Halleluijah ! Nang naloupi,
Neihal sah kit’un.

Verse 2
Lhagao Theng vangin, La ka sauve Pathen,
Jesu chun eihil’un muthim apai lhai ;

Verse 3
Loupina jouse, Kelngoi nou thisanin,
Mihem chonset jouse apomang sohtai ;

Verse 4
Kalung suhal’in, ngailutnan losoh hen,
Mi jouse lunga ngailut meiyin kong hen ;

Verse 5
Pentecost nia bang chun, Lhagao Theng hung kumlhan,
Mi lungsung jousea mei bangin hung kong hen ;

songs.title: 18. LHASAM JENG JONG LEU HEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lha poute,
Kipana imu theina ding un,
Jesu Christa nung chu jui ute,
Del jing uhite iphah mauvin.

Chorus
Aniseh in del jing u hite
Kalhasamâ€™e tia hailou ding in
Jesu Christan eipen te thahat
Del jing uhite iphah mauvin.

Verse 2
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lha poute,
Genthei thoh hi um jeng ta jongle,
Jesu Christa chu ahi eiding,
Ijo na diu tha dang a umpoi.

Verse 3
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lha poute,
Pu hite Lal Christa thingpel chu,
Eihon iheuve genthei thoh ding,
Sumang u hite aboncha chun.

Verse 4
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lha poute,
Adihtah imu theina diuvin,
Gamtin a khovah ahung naiye,
Aban chan ahung chal khovah chu.

songs.title: 18. THE GLORY GOD (L. Th. 13)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Hallelujah Pakai loupi pen,
Gamtin na Ama vahchoiyute;
Namtin Lal loupi le ja um penin,
Mitin lungsunga thu hinsei kitnin.

Chorus
Hin puikhom kitnun vahmangte chu,
Ihmute chu kaithou kit un lang;
Leiset lamkai Valpa loupi chu,
Lungjinna le lungdonna gam salvah-in.

Verse 2
David lengpa le lamkai Mose chu,
Van gam in emnom alhung lhon tai;
Tun Pakai Christa le Lhagao theng chu,
Thempu lenpen le lamkai loupi pen.

Verse 3
Van le lei twikhanglen sem masanga,
Na um hetphah lou Pathen nahi;
Ni le lha le ahsi jouse jong hi,
Nang jal’a vah loupi nei ahiuve.

Verse 4
Thu neina le loupina jouse hi,
Pakai Christa malsomna a kon;
Lei kisem til’a kithat Kelngoinou,
Athisanin leiset huhhing ta hen.

songs.title: 18. TONSOT SONGPI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl (Isaiah 26:4)

Verse 1
Tonsot songpi ka dinga,
Khia chun Nangin neisel’in ;
Na nah thenga hung longdoh,
Longlha thisan le twi chu ;
Ka chonset nei sop thengin,
Nei huhhingin keima tun.

Verse 2
Ka khut hin na tong jong leng,
Ka mitlhi long jeng jongle ;
Lungnun’in gunchu jong leng,
Nangma chondan thupeh chu ;
Keiman juikim joulou ding.
Ka chonset theng theilou ding.

Verse 3
Ima ka hin choi poi ken,
Cross jenga chu ki ngaiya ;
Pon sil lou, ponsil dinga ,
Nangma kom hinbel kahi ;
Nei huhhingin lengvai kei,
Chonset’a thi ding kahi.

Verse 4
Hiche lung ka gel lai hin,
Thinan kamit asin’a ;
Hi leiset ka galkaiya,
Na thupi tan kamu teng ;
Tonsot Songpin nei huh in,
Nei sellin nei huhhingin.

songs.title: 19. DETNA NEILOU KEI TOBANG DIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Detna neilou kei tobang din,
Na thisan kei din along e,
Na heng a hungdin nei kouve,
O ka Pakai kei ka hung e.

Verse 2
Vaicha genthei mitcho kei din,
Lungsung nat na sudam nahi,
Heng ka ngaichan Nang a mudin,
O ka Pakai kei ka hung e.

Verse 3
Sang in nate kei tobang din,
Ngaidam suhtheng eilha ong din,
Na thutep ka tahsan jal in,
O ka Pakai kei ka hung e.

Verse 4
Na lungset hethei lou keima,
Na thutep chan sukeh jong leng,
Tun Nangma a bou hi ding in,
O ka Pakai kei ka hung e.

songs.title: 19. LEAD THOU ME THROUGH THE VALLEY OF DEAD (L. Th. 8)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoiya hin aw eilhandampu,
Lungdong tah-in ka um jinge;
Nei puiyin nalampi lam’a,
Aw eilhandampu.

Chorus
Thina lui neipui galkaiyin,
Ka le maona gal lam’a khun;
Goldei ikikhenpi ho to,
Kipah in leng taute.

Verse 2
Lungdon puldou le mitlhi lonna,
Genthei thoh a ka kana hi;
Pahbang mol hen leiset gam hi,
Lungdon ka kana.

Verse 3
Ka ngaitah Pakai angsunga chun,
Kikhenna thu seikit lou ding;
Kelngoinou idiuva thi chu,
La’n vahchoiyute.

Verse 4
Valpa ahsi Lhandampu Lalmang,
Ka lungsung set thim lah a hin;
Hungvah in nalampi thengtah,
Chu kamu na din.

songs.title: 19. VO KAPATHEN! LUNGSET TAH-IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d

Verse 1
Vo ka Pathen ! lungset tah in,
Ka chonsetna sumang soh in ;
Na milungset simthei lou chun,
Ka chonset sim thei lou sop lhan.

Verse 2
Ka kisem’a chonsea hung peng,
Chonse pan kei ka nu sunga ;
Hijeh chun ka chonset sop lhan,
Nei ban sah-in buhbang bangin.

Verse 3
Ka Pathen nei jah sah kit’in,
Nanga kon lung halna thupha ;
Ka lung gelna kagu bongsa,
Jong chu kipan kijop kit hen.

Verse 4
Lungtheng lungnem athah nei pen,
Ka lunga Lhagao Theng cheng hen ;
Chuteng Thupha seiphong lenge,
Mi chonse lamvaite henga.

Verse 5
Vo Pathen, Nang mi huhhingna,
Thupha chu keiman lan sange ;
Nangma min ngei vahchoina chu,
Keiman sei lenge nitin’in.

songs.title: 20. GIVES US THE HOLY SPIRIT.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao Theng chu nei hin peuvin lang,
Pakai Jesu min’in;
Kalung sunga cheng jing dingin,
Athil bol chu mei bangin.

Verse 2
Penticost ni ahung lhun ni chun,
Mihemte apanpi;
Achonsetnau chu ahedoh-un,
Mijousen atahsan’un.

Verse 3
Hiche jou chun athu het theinan,
Lhagao Theng ka thum’ui;
Eihil jingin eilhamon jingin,
Van’a akaltou jou chun.

Verse 4
Thildang jouse bulhing jeng jongle,
Hiche hi ka thum’e;
Chonset phong le eilhamon dingin,
Lha theng bou aloupi pen.

songs.title: 20. KEIMA CROSS SEPAI CHU KAHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Keima cross sepai chu kahi,
Pakai seijui kahi,
Akinâ€™a pang ding kicha lou,
Amin seichoi leng e.

Chorus
Det tah in ding un,
Kipaman sanna ding in,
Det tah in ding un,
Lallukhuh hoi isan diu.

Verse 2
Vanâ€™a kipaman sanna din,
Midang kitet lai hin,
Keima kaki choldo ding ham?
Hiche leiset chunga.

Verse 3
Ka din leiya douding atam,
Thisan luinoh kahi,
Keiman leiyah gol ka neipoi,
Pakai bou eihu ding.

Verse 4
Keiman ma nong ting dou inge,
Pakai in tha neipen,
Genthei hesoh ding ka ging poi,
Nei panpin Pakai in.

songs.title: 20. PATHEN NANGMA HOUBUNG MITE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl
(Heb. 1:6)

Verse 1
Pathen Nangma Houbung mite,
Lungset’in phattheina pen ;
Namai vah chun salvah soh in,
Ka lah-uva kilang hen.

Chorus
Chutile vannoi leiset min,
Muntin Nangma Thupha theng hi ;
Vannoi namtin le phung tin’in,
Gam jousen hinna tante.

Verse 2
Vo Pathen, Nangma vahchoi la,
A mihem jousen sau hen ;
Mi asang ja o-gin thong chun,
Vannoi leiset lo soh hen.
Mi sutheng thei nahi Nangma,
Na gam loupi chu hin lah in ;
Vannoi leiset gam kimvel’a,
Chonsetna son mang soh in.

Verse 3
Vo Pathen, ka taona sangin,
Van Lhagao Theng hin sollin ;
Na gam ka chalsah na diuvin,
Houbung mite tha hinpen.
Pathen phattheina neipeuvin,
Niseh in nei kithopiuvin ;
Chuteng vannoi leiset miten,
Na loupi hetau vinte.

songs.title: 21. NI LE LHAVAH ANGAI POI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. m.

Verse 1
Ni le lhavah angai poi,
Mi thengte chenna chu ;
Chua setna um talou,
Pathen chenna ahi.

Chorus
Chu gam nom chu,
Mitin kinepna ahi ;
Lhandampu lenna ichenna diu,
Mitin kinepna ahi.

Verse 2
Lungdon lungjin umtalou,
Cholte kitha ol ta ;
Van vou thah in lhaisel’in,
Chu gama alengui.

Verse 3
Chu gam khopi em hoi chu,
Kul le kotpi emsel ;
Kelngoi nou vah-in sal’in,
Sun le jan um talou.

songs.title: 21. OLGAM KA-NGAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ol gam ka-ngai ka Lal lenna,
Lungdon umlouna van gam chu;
Itih le ka lhung dem?
Ka lungdonna mitlhi hi;
I-tih le hul ding ham?
Hinna thinglim damnoiya chun,
Nei kicholdo sah-in Pakai;
Lhepna nisa hi kadou jou poi,
Hinna thinglim damnoiya chun,
Nei kicholdo sah-in Pakai.

Verse 2
Leiset gimna thoh joute chun,
Chu-a ponin lim asongun;
Eihin son khum’uve,
Olna thinglim um talou;
Olna thinglim umlou, leiset gimna a hin,
Lhepna nisa chu ahah-e.

Verse 3
Hi leiset gimna gam thip a,
Ol mun um’am tia kahol’e;
Olna gam aumpoi,
Gam hung lhung ding chu hilou;
Leiset gimna ahi, ti hi ka kihet’in,
Hinna thinglim damnoi ka ngai.

Verse 4
Hinna thingphung lim noiya chun,
Mithengte kicholdo jouta;
Kei hi iti kicholdo, thei louva um kahim?
Ka leiset vou thenglou;
Van vouvin nei khel’in,
Kei jong tun kicholdo tange.

songs.title: 21. VEN LHANDAMPU CALVARY CROSS CHUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ven Lhandampu calvary cross chunga,
Nang le keidin genthei athoh tai,
Lungset tah in nang nakou ngai in,
Tahsan in sang in.
Tahsan in sang in (2)
Cross chunga hinna twi alonge,
Tahsan in sang in.

Verse 2
I chonset nau jouse asoptheng tai,
Lhatdam ichan theina ding uvin,
Jesun hinna kot chu ahong tai,
Tahsan in sang in.

Verse 3
Ven Lhandampu lhanâ€™a kon athoutai,
Aheng jon in mun a on lai hin,
Mailhai sel a nang na lhamon ding,
Tahsan in sang in.

Verse 4
Tun chung van nom a Jesu acheng tai,
Genthei te hesoh na vejing in,
Nang jong chu gam a napui tou ding,
Tahsan in sang in.

songs.title: 22. ALL THIS FOR ME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. d (John 19:17, Rom. 12:1)

Verse 1
Ei Lhandampu neisal vahna,
Na Lhagao le na lungsetna ;
Akidange ! nei lungsetna,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

Chorus
Eilhandampu, hithei nangem !
Long lhen theng gan kihinglha bang !
A-itih a, tonsot geiya,
Nangma dingin hithei nangem.

Verse 2
Na mite huhhingna dingin,
Na thoh in na long natoh-e ;
Genthei nathoh, Getsemania,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

Verse 3
Nalu thengtah lingin sunta,
Eihuhhingna thisan along ;
Calvary Cross kidang tah chu,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

Verse 4
Cham le lungset nahao ngeiye,
Na vangam dim, gou le thillu ;
Manbeiya lungset tonsot’a,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

songs.title: 22. JING NINOU SANG IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jing ninou sang in na hoijoi,
Lhandampu le ka Lengpa,
Na hoi le navah emsel chu,
Ka lung in jaichim thei lou.

Chorus
Jing ninou sang in nahoi joi,
Sunlai ni sang in jong navah joi,
Loupi chungnung nang umna a,
Mei le thim akihoh e.

Verse 2
Ponbang vamleh a kijem Nang,
Na lallukhuh emsel toh,
Na vaihomna Leng gam a chun,
Tonsot Pakai Nang nahi.

Verse 3
O na milungset loupi chu,
Na mi khoto chu haona,
Na Lenggam kilungset na chu,
Keidin jong mun asem e.

Verse 4
Hinlai sana gui atan teng,
Leiset hinkho hung mang ding,
Tanglou vin chu gam hoiya chun,
Na vahchoi la ken sange

songs.title: 22. UNDER HIS WINGS
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Alhanoi dailim nom’a chun,
Lhatdamte kicholdo tante;
Amauva tonsot hinna amu tengu le,
Kipah tauvinte.

Chorus
Chengunte cheng den tauvinte,
Lungsetna Pakai vahchoiyun;
Atonsot nin hal jing tauvinte,
Alhanoi dailim nom’a chun.

Verse 2
Alhanoi dailim nom’a chun,
Gentheina jouse beita ding;
Hinna twikhuh a kisil’unte,
Buhbang sangin bangjou vinte.

Verse 3
Alhanoi dailim nom’a chun,
Ka le lungdonna um talou;
Setna huipi le lhepna gallen,
Abei tai khopi nom’a chun.

Verse 4
Aw chu mun’a lengte ho chun,
Leiset gentheina thoh talou;
Van selangdah gin ngei tum’unte,
Van Kulpi chu veltau vinte.

songs.title: 23. ITI NOPTAM PATHEN LHAI PET
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Psalms 55:17)

Verse 1
Iti nop tam Pathen lhai pet,
Leiset lung ngai lunga beita ;
Ingai jouse kimin eipei,
Van’a Pa laltouna konin ;

Chorus
Satan gallin lam eipel tai,
Ka tao pet’a Nang nahung le,
Ka lungdon lungjin pet jong le,
Ka lungmon le kipan aloi.

Verse 2
Iti nop tam Pathen lhai pet,
Vantil kei dinga hungpa chun ;
Ka taona Pathen ang sunga,
Na lhavingin po touvin lang ;
Pan eilungset na thu kajai,
A thupha dihtah chu kahei ;
Ka lung apumpin kape tai,
Hung kum lhan tun katao pet hin.

Verse 3
Iti nop tam Pathen lhai pet,
Nanga kon’a lungmonna thu ;
Ka lung sunga hin khum dimin,
Van in nom ka hung lhun kahsen;
Ka leiset vou kapai lhah a,
Kemlou vanvou chu ka chan teng,
Ka len thoa vanjol ka gei teng,
“Ka lhai ka lhai leiset” tinge.

songs.title: 23. PAKAI NATONG A MITE CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai natong a mite chu a vangpha,
Song mantam bang a manlu pen a Lhagao,
Lhagao tamtah chung a puidoh na dingin,
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha.

Chorus
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha ,
Chung gam inpi nom laiya,
Aman sim joulou Lallukhuh isan diu,
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha.

Verse 2
In nomâ€™a chun lungset maiso jeng vah ding,
Nitin Jesu banga hing jing jeng ta ding,
Mangthah ding lhagao van lamâ€™a eipui diu,
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha.

Verse 3
Taona toh thon eiho che jing jeng ute,
Muntin a mangsa lhagao holdoh in lang,
Kelngoi ching Pakai komâ€™a i-um jing diu,
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha.

Verse 4
Gospel thu chu gam tin ah galhang sam un,
Lungset na thu nalung sung a ching jing in,
Chonseâ€™n Pakai a lung ahei na ding in,
Lhagao huhhing chu vangpha.

songs.title: 23. WE WILL SERVE THE LORD (L. Th. 40)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Akem baita ngeiye ka leiset hinkho,
Ka kipana ni amang jitai;
Nitin mongin ka um theipoi,
Ngaiyin gel jeng jong leng.
Leiya ka gol ngaite,
Kikhen kit jongleu hen;
Kipah tah le lung khat cheh-in,
I-leiset hinkhou chom jongle,
I-Pakai na tong cheh-ute.

Verse 2
Jan thim’a le sunthip a jenga jong hin,
Leiset gentheinan eisulung jing;
Ka lungdon kipana soh hen,
Ka ka-na beita hen.

Verse 3
Pakai nei puiyin ka goldeite se to,
Na lenna gam nom ka muna din;
Kikhen kitna um talou ding,
Lungdonna gal lam’a.

Verse 4
Leiset’a kapten kikhen kicha talou,
Ahsi kal gam nom’a lengte chun,
La asauvin aw ngei cheh-in,
Loupina van in’a.

songs.title: 24. BELSHAZZAR LE A SEMANG PACHONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Belshazzar le a Semang Pachong akivah laiyun,
Hou-in theng sana khon ho chu amangun ju adon ui,Â ajan chun Leng insung a mu kidang tah amu ve, Inpi tijat in alotai hichu â€œPathen khutâ€ ahi.
Bang sun chu Pathen khut ahi (2)
Akisun chu koiman helou
Mijouse lung dong jouta,
Bang hin sun chu Pathen khut ahi.

Verse 2
Sohchang Daniel mihang chu leng ang ah aga
dingin, Lengpa khansetna lentah chu asosal in aphoh tai, Akisun chu asim in leng le mipi ngui jouta, â€œTua pat in Lenggam abeitaiâ€ tin Daniel in aletai.

Verse 3
Pathen in thanei nale hanna chu Daniel ape,
Tichun lung olmo lou helin achen na Juda gam le, Asohchan na gam a jong milen le mineo ang ah, A Pathen khutsut asim thei bang a kisun chu ahi.

Verse 4
Hiche khut chun asun cheh eiho chonna jouse jong, Milen le mineo mo channa phat hung lhung tei ding ahi, Hijeh chun nang mi chonsen lung hei in Jesu ang ah,Themmo nachan louna dingin pel in bang a kisun chu.

songs.title: 24. PATHEN NANGMA LHAI DIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Pathen Nangma lhai din,
Ka kaikhom kit tauve ;
Nei nung sun lou jenun Pathen,
Ka chonset jeng vangun.

Verse 2
Ka chonset apumpi,
Ka hinpoi na hengah ;
Na ngaidam ding le sop theng din,
Na kom ka hin bel’e.

Verse 3
Ka chonset sim thei lou,
Sapset thei ka hiuve ;
Hijong le Nangma mi lungset,
Hatjon sumang soh-in.

Verse 4
Hijeh chun ka taonau,
Ngaiyin lung theng homin ;
Leiset lung ngai sumang soh-in,
Chonphat lung nei peuvin.

Verse 5
Pathen hou tha nom chu,
Vangpha le nom chungnung ;
Athi teng van’a cheng jing ding,
Van mitheng nom laiya.

songs.title: 24. THOU ART MY COMFORTER (L. Th. 111)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakai lungdongin ka genthei,
Vangsetna ten eijui jinge;
Ka le maona gam thip a hin,
Kalhi pumin kahin hol jinge.

Chorus
Aw ka Pakai ka lungdonna jouse,
Nakhut chunga ka hinpe tai;
Alung dongte lhamon Pa chun,
Kei jong neihin lhamon jingin.

Verse 2
Aw Pakai ka lungdon nem dingin,
Nanglou chu monna ka neipoi;
Koikom dangba kajot ding ham?
Nangbou eilhamon ding chu nahi.

Verse 3
Lungdonna meipi kei din ajing,
David leng sochatna kulpi;
Kei migenthei jong neilan lang,
Set genthei cha kei jong kahunge.

Verse 4
Til’a Canaan gam dung le vaiya,
Lungdong chate nalhamon jing;
Genthei chate chun nalem’un,
Kei kipana pen jong chu nahi.

songs.title: 25. GAM NGAI KINEPNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam ngai kinepna ka ngaito le,
Leisetna kon’in ka galdot;
Ka ngai ngeiye chu gamnom chu,
Hilei lungjinna nung tengle,
Ve jing tange chu Gam nom chu.
Aw chen ka lhagao lengvai,
Na lhandampu Pakai Jesu jui jingin lang;
Naset pohgih chu,
Leisetna hin dalha tan lang,
Gam ngai um chu jonin chetan, chetan.

Verse 2
Ka ngai nom lente lah a lhah ding,
Gam nom van mite la sahna;
Leng thei hileng huiva bangin,
Leng tange chu gamnom jonin,
Hin thingbah chunga gachunge.

Verse 3
Hinlai niso hi ka ngaito le,
Lei lungjinnan eikhu jitai;
Ka lha leng tan chu gamnom’a,
Lhatdamte chenna chu hol’in;
Hinlai lungjin hi mangta ding.

songs.title: 25. KANGAI NOM E CHRISTA THUSIM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ngai nom e Christa thusim,
Mihem alungset na thusim,
Ami huhhing thusim kidang,
Lungset jal in keidin athi.
Christa thusim kidang (2)
Ami huhhing thusim kidang,
Lungset jal in keidin athi.

Verse 2
Ka ngai nom e Christa thusim,
Athen le aloupina chu,
Pathen lhagao in eihil in,
Ka lungsung a hin cheng jing hen.

Verse 3
Ka ngai nom e Christa thusim,
Pakai toh kilhon khom kahi,
Amun tin ah a aw kajai,
Tahsan det ding in eideiye.

Verse 4
Ka ngai nom e Christa thusim,
Ahao na le aloupina,
Aleng gam loupi khang touding,
Chamna Lengpa chu hung kit ding.

songs.title: 25. PAKAI PHATTHEI NAN NEILHAUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Eph. 1:3)

Verse 1
Pakai phatthei nan neilhauvin,
Ka lung kipa dimsah in ;
Nang ngailutna lung nei peuvin ,
Khat cheh in nei lungset nun ;
Neithah sem’un tha nei peuvin,
Gam thip ka jot lai seuvin.

Verse 2
Thangvah to thon ka choi annui,
Na Thupha nei peh jal’un ;
Na-mi huhhingna ga pung hen,
Leiya kahin lai seuvin ;
Tahsan umtah tah nei souvin,
Hiu vinge tahsan jing Nang.

Verse 3
Chuti chun van thu hung lhunna,
Kei ho cheng nei kou tengle ;
Vantil eipui touding hung chu,
A nung jui ding kipah a ;
Christa toh vaihom khom theinan,
Tonsot kemlou van gama.

songs.title: 26. KA PHAL THENGTAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka phal thengtai Pakai dingin,
Man beiyin ka phal thengtai,
Ken ngai jing le tahsan jing ding,
Nitin Aman eiching ding.
Kaphal theng sohtai (2)
Eihuhhingpa Nang a dingin
Kaphal theng soh tai.

Verse 2
Ka phal thengtai Pakai dingin,
Nem in A ang a kakun,
Leiset nopna kanuse tai,
Tun Pakai in neiching tan.

Verse 3
Ka phal thengtai Pakai dingin,
Huhhingpan neisu theng in,
Aw Lhagao theng hihen ahe,
Kei Nang a Nang keima a.

Verse 4
Ka phal thengtai Pakai dingin,
Nang dingin kaki phaltai,
Lungset nale thahat neipen,
Ka chunga phatthei umhen.

Verse 5
Ka phal thengtai Pakai dingin,
Kalung Lhagao in lohen,
Sochat na Thupha kidang hi,
Tonsot tonsot in thanghen.

songs.title: 26. OVER LIVES JOURNEY (L. Th. 39)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai luipi dung hi gahol le jong leng,
Malam khonom Canaan ka galdot e;
Ka kipana Lallukhuh anaita-e,
Kap in leisetna hin umsot taponge.

Chorus
Sot taponte hinlai lungdon lungjin.
Eikouna aw nem chu kaja in;
Laltouna anga eingalelnau aw chu,
Lungsette ka na nikho asot ngeiye.

Verse 2
Ka vaveina luidung hi sao jeng jongle,
Lamkai Valpa chu vejing ing kate;
Kong kaina lhang theng chu eilhut teiyinte,
Chu-a lungset le gol ngaite kim tante.

Verse 3
Jon jinging ting tonsot huilhi theng nunna,
Kelngoinou le van Pahcha umna chu;
Chullouvin pahcha hoi ana um’inte,
Thisan jal’in chu-a eilhut teiyinte.

Verse 4
Van khonom kisei tol’a kalen phat le,
Nunglam gentheina hi ngaita ponge;
Pakai tepna gamnom lungmonna a chun,
Kemlouvin kumkhon a-em’in sal’inte.

songs.title: 26. PRAYER IN SICKNESS.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat m. (Psalms 78:72)

Verse 1
Ka Pathen kei mi chonse,
Ka hung taove nahenga ;
Pathen nei engbol hih in,
Ka chonkhelna ngaidamin.

Verse 2
Mi khoto chungnung Pathen,
Ka thoh hesoh kho nei ton ;
Ka mitlhi long theh hul’in,
Ka nat thoh lel subeiyin.

Verse 3
Thempu jouse Thempu Nang,
Pakai ho Pakai nahi ;
Hinna damna lungmonna,
Nang louva hing thei umlou.

Verse 4
Pathen hung kihei kit’in,
Ka lha dammo huhhingin ;
Pathen ka het jing thei nan,
Nei damsah in tuchung hin.

songs.title: 27. LUNGDON NA SET KINGAIDAM TA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdon na set kingaidam ta,
Lungdon kit datan,
Ihmut a kon hung thoudoh in,
Nalung kot hong in

Chorus
Hinna thaomei avah lai hin,
Pathen lung alhaipet cha hin,
Kihei in A lungset na a,
Kinem in um in.

Verse 2
Lhandampun nakai hoi jing nai,
Lungdon kit datan,
Tun lungset in nangma nakou,
Na lung kot hong in.

Verse 3
Gospel in nangma nakou jing,
Lungdon kit datan,
Lhatdam na chamkim mu dingin,
Na lung kot hong in.

Verse 4
Kipa nan tantih neita lou,
Lungdon kit datan,
Chamlen na a din nakou jing,
Na lung kot hong in.

songs.title: 27. NANGMA KA NGAI JINGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat d. (Psalms 86:1)

Verse 1
Nangma ka ngai jinge, lungset Pakai,
Na kam ngei aw dam chun, eilungmon thei.
Ka ngaiye, Nang ka ngaiye,
Phattin nidan tinin ;
Phattheina nei pen Jesun,
Tun ka hunge.

Verse 2
Nangma kangai jinge, neingah jingin,
Lhepnan eijou lou ding, nei umpi le.

Verse 3
Nangma kangai jinge, gim le nopna,
Nangma beiya keima hingjou lou ding.

Verse 4
Nangma kangai jinge, lungtheng neipen,
Kachunga nalung chan bulhit soh in.

Verse 5
Niseh in ka ngaiye, Vo ka Pathen,
Nacha’n neisem bulhing soh in keima.

songs.title: 27. THE HEAVENLY JERUSALEM (L. Th. 40)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw van’a Jerusalem,
Thah emnom tah-a chun;
Mithengte jouse chuto,
Lhatdamte aum nauva chun;
Lhandampu chu imu diu,
Loupi tah chu ichan diu;
Jerusalem thah nomtah a chun.

Verse 2
Aw Jerusalem khothah,
Kipana khopi chu;
Chu-a peogal nomtah chu,
Tonsot em loupi tah a chun;
Lhahchomna chu beita ding,
Cholte athau oltante,
Jerusalem thah nomtah a chun.

Verse 3
Aw Jerusalem khothah,
Khothah emnom’a chun;
Aloupina jouse jong,
I-gamu theina diuvin;
Alangkachah khopi chu,
Kelngoinou din em’inte,
Jerusalem thah nomtah a chun.

songs.title: 28. HUNG KUMLHAN LHATHENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl

Verse 1
Hung kumlhan Lha theng van vakhu,
Bu hung san ka lunga ;
Ka lunga Pathen ngailutna,
Khumin meiyin kong hen.

Verse 2
Leiset lung ngai len thang sunga,
Ka lung acheng denin ;
Tonsot nopna lam’a kalung,
A kal toujou tapoi.

Verse 3
Ka la sah jong phatchomna bei,
Hal dohna umdeh lou ;
Nopla jong ka sa chim jitai,
Ka tahsan lhom jeh-in.

Verse 4
Ka ngai Pathen, itih chan kei,
Hitia ka um ding ham ;
Nangman nei lungset sim theilou,
Na lung ka tona bei.

Verse 5
Vo Lhatheng van vakhun hungin,
Ka lungah hung busan ;
Lungtheng lungnem lungdih khumin ;
Ka lungah cheng denin.

songs.title: 28. I THAO TWIYU ADIM NADEM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I thao twiyu adim nadem Pakai hung tengleh,
I thaomei vah u chim nantem Pakai hung tengleh, Chuche jan loupi tah a,
I thaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.
O kiging un (3)
Pakai hung na ding.

Verse 2
Ki lamto aw kija nantem Pakai hung tengleh,
Kipa nopna awgin thong ding Pakai hung tengleh, Chuche jan loupi tah a,
I thaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.

Verse 3
Geisang louvin kiging phaute Pakai hung
tengle,
Kise khenna phat hung lhung ding Pakai hung tengle, Chuche jan loupi tah a,
I thaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.

Verse 4
Kipa na nikho hi nantem Pakai hung tengleh,
Hallelujah kipana hiding Pakai hung teng,
Chu jan chu kipana jan,
I thaomai vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.

songs.title: 28. KAPA GAM SEM KA NGAI.
29. CANAAN PHAICHAM SARON PAHHOI.
29. NASET POHGIH A KON
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Naset pohgih a kon theng nan natem?
Thisan bou ahi na thenna ding,
Setna jouse nangman jou nan natem?
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

Chorus
Thisan bou chun na kidang a tong,
Kelngoi nou thisan in,
Thisan bou chun na kidang a tong,
Kelngoi nou thisan lutah chun.

Verse 2
Buhbang sang in nang bang jou nan natem?
Thisan bou ahi nabanna ding,
Setnan mihem hinkho alen mangpi,
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

Verse 3
Na Lengpa Jesu na tong nan natem?
Thisan bou ahi na toh na ding,
Nitin Ama na vahchoi ding hinam?
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

songs.title: 29. NGAIYUVIN VANTIL HO LASAH
30. HUNGUN PATHEN MITE
30. JESUN LUNGSET CHAPANG HO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesun lungset chapang ho A anga din akou,
Aman hinkho thah apei Van gam kot ahon peh.
Jesun chapang ho lungset tah in a kou,
Hinkho thah chu ape jinge,
Chapang golpha Ama.

Verse 2
Jesun lungset chapang ho Alungset sei joulou,
A lunggim nau ahe nai khat cheng in apan pi.

Verse 3
Jesun lungset chapang ho phatthei na vang pe
jing,
A lungset nan ngah jing imachan suse lou ding.

Verse 4
Jesun lungset chapang ho apan pi niseh in,
Kipah thanom tah in na kouna aw ngai jing in.

Verse 5
Jesun lungset chapang ho adei e a goldin,
Aman iti jong le tonsot a aumpi ding.

songs.title: 30. MITHENGTE LENNA GAM.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tahsanin Calvary lhang chunga,
Gam ngai um le khotheng nom alang’e;
Mithengte lenna gam,
Chu khopi-a keijong kalen ding;
Hinlai lungdon le gentheinan,
Eichim khum talou ding.

Verse 2
Eichimkhum phahlou ding kahetnin,
Hallelujah Pakai kavahchoiye;
Kei eilhatdam jal’in,
Set posa le themmo changsa hing;
Thisanin them eichansah tai,
Gam nom’a leng dingin.

Verse 3
Gam nom’a keijong kalen phat le,
Leiset gimna hi gahve ji tange;
Ka-va veina gam hi,
Chuteng kamitlhi long taponte;
Pakaiyin eiumpi tante,
Nunglam ngai taponge.

Verse 4
Pakai ngaiya kahamna gam hi,
Ka lhagao le leiset akikhen teng;
Lalpan eipui tante,
Alha chunga eitousah inte;
Jordan twinong le gin um chu,
Eigal kaipi tante.

songs.title: 31. CANAAN PHAICHAM SARON PAHHOI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen kei mi genthei,
Gam lungset hungmang ding pel kanom’e;
Pakai Na ang’a kicholdo tang’e,
Mei le twilen in eiphah louna din.

Chorus
Ka tonsot in, (2)
Dinga Pakaiyin eisempeh le;
Sana kotpi hoi chu,
Mu kanom lungdon umlouna gam chu.

Verse 2
Ka ngaiye van Jerusalem,
Gam thah hung lhung dinga len kanom’e;
Aw van Lhagao hung lengin neipuiyin,
Kadou joupoi hi leiset gimna hi.

Verse 3
Song mantam chitin asem’e,
Pakai lenna gam lungmona a chun;
Leng tange chu gam in emnom’a chun,
Leiset lungngai pon banga chul kit ding.

songs.title: 31. KHANGKIM LAIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl (Luke 2:14)

Verse 1
Khangkim laiyin van’a konin,
Van la loupi chu ahin sauve ;
Asa vantil thengte janel,
Achoinau ngeitah hiche ahi.

Chorus
“Chungnung pen’a Pa loupi hen,
Leiya lungmon le chamna leng hen ;
A tonsot geiyin thangsoh hen,
Lei chunga kipa leng hen.”

Verse 2
Kelngoiching gam geh hon amui,
A vah loupi emhoi chungnung chu ;
Chungnung pen lemna la ngei chun,
Gankong sung chu alodim soh tai.

Verse 3
Pathen Kelngoi nou hung peng chu,
Mihem chonset apomang soh tai ;
Vahchoina le kipana lan,
Leng Christa chu vahchoiyu hite.

songs.title: 31. PAKAI NANG KEIMA LENG NAHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai nang keima leng nahi,
Namin loupi jing hen;
Ling lukhuh kahai louna din,
Calvary a nei puiyin.

Chorus
Gethsemani hailou nadin,
Nathoh gim kahai lou nadin,
Nei lungset kahai louna din,
Calvary a nei puiyin.

Verse 2
Na lhankhuh chu nei musah in,
Kap a na op nau mun;
Na lup pet a vantil thengten,
Na nga nau mun chu.

Verse 3
Mary bangin lunggim pumin,
Na henga ka hunge;
Lhan gohkeo chu neimu san in,
Calvary a nei puiyin.

songs.title: 32. KELNGOI CHING HON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. dl (Luke 2:10)

Verse 1
Kelngoi ching hon jankhang laiyin,
A kelngoi nga pet’un ;
Pathen vantil ahung kum lhan,
A salvah soh jenge.

Verse 2
Vantil chun “Kicha hih-uvin,
Keima neimu jeh-un ;
Kipana Thupha kahin poi,
Nang le mi jouse din.

Verse 3
David Leng phungah apenge,
Vannoi huhhing ding chu ;
Vannoi Pakai ahung kum lhan,
Nu-ngah chan apeng tai.

Verse 4
“Che leu chun gan ankong sunga,
Van a kon Naosen chu ;
Ponsea kijel mu’vin nate,
Hichu Christa ahi.”

Verse 5
Asei jouvin vantil ho chun,
Van’a la asauve ;
“Vannoi Pathen chungnung nom hem,
Mihem lungmong soh hen.”

Verse 6
“Chungnunga Pathen loupi hen,
Leiya chamna leng hen ;
Van le leiset kijop matna,
Hihen atonsot’in.”

songs.title: 32. THE AGONY OF CHRIST.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai thohna ka ngaito le,
Kap lou thei ka hipoi;
Amai abehnau le, avohnau atamnau,
Ka geldoh ni le ken kalan kasai.

Chorus
I-ti nat tam eilhatdamnau, (2)
Leiset Lhandampu chu;
Akaiyui lhang lam’a,
Pakai nunnem ahi genthei jongle.

Verse 2
Judaten them chansah lou din,
Ngaito jeng tajongleu;
Ken vang ka ngaito poi, Pakai nunnem ahi,
Eiho chonset jal’in mo achang tai.

Verse 3
Lhandampu thi mipi lungdong,
Lungdong lou jong aum;
Kap pum’in along chu, ajongun hon lam’a,
Lhan’a alupsah-un i-Pakai chu.

Verse 4
Athou kit tai i-Pakai chu,
Olna gam jon dingin;
Olivet lhang chunga, meipin ahin tom’in,
Olna gam ajon’e i-Pakai chun.

Verse 5
Olna van gam najot phat’in,
Leiset angui jeng tai;
Hung kile kit maitan, vannoi gimna ahin,
Nalhatdamna seiyin kipah-ute.

songs.title: 32. VEUVIN LUNGSETNA KEMLOU HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin lungsetna kemlou hi Pan eipeh u ahi,
Setna lamvai mangsa eiho,
Pathen cha kivo ding.
Veuvin lungset na kemlou,

Chorus
Lungset na kemlou Pan â€œChaâ€ tia
Eikou nau aw nem chu,
Van vou a I kikhel teng,
Pathen cha eiki kou ding.

Verse 2
Thisan jal a ngaidam changten,
Lungset na heu hite,
A lungset na aw ja jing ding, Pathen naiyu hite.

Verse 3
Loupina ichan diu ni chu,
Tun hung lhung loi tante,
I Pakai imu teng uleh, Ama mel iput diu.

Verse 5
Phatthei ichan na ding uvin,
Tahsan theng hiu hite,
Thoukit Pakai ang a din teng, Amai lhai imu diu.

songs.title: 33. CANAAN GAMTHAH
33. EILHANDAMPU BETHLEHEM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Ezek. 34:11)

Verse 1
Ei Lhandampu Bethlehem bong in’a,
A penge genthei jachat thoh soh in ;
A kidange Pakai hinlai khankho,
Keima eihol hol’e. (3 vei)
A kidange Pakai hinlai khankho,
Keima eihol hol’e.

Verse 2
Ei Lhandampu Calvary thing chunga,
A thin kabat jouse eisah pehtai ;
Hibang hesoh iti athoh hi tam !
Keima jeh in athi. (3 vei)
Hibang genthei iti athoh hitam !
Keima jeh in athi.

Verse 3
Chonset muthim’a kei ka lamvai teng,
Jesu Christa bou ahi eihuhhing ;
Ka hinna din eikouve o-nemin,
Keima eikou kouve. (3 vei)
Ka hinna din eikouve O-nemin,
Keima eikou kouve.

Verse 4
Ei Lhandampu hung kit ding van’a kon,
A thutep theng chu keiman kamu ding ;
Van’a kon’a ahung kum kamu ding ;
Keima puiya hung ding. (3 vei)
Vanna kona ahung kum kamu ding ;
Keima puiya hung ding.

songs.title: 33. NILHUM NUNGA CHUGAM NOM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nilhum nunga chugam nom lhunding kagel leh,
Kalung sung kipana adim e,
Lungset jal a Lhandampu kom kalhun teng le,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantem?
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantem
Chong nan tem?
Nilhangkai nilhum jou teng chu leh,
Kicholdo na Inpi nom chu ka lhun tengle,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantam?

Verse 2
Pakai thahat pan in tao toh thon tong ingting,
Lhagao mangsa huhdohna ding in,
Chu niloupi nile Ahsi keima san ding,
Vahchoi aw twilen kinong bang ding.

Verse 3
Pakai mel kamu teng iti kipa tang em,
Nop le kipna kem talou ding,
Chung sana khopia chen ding chun kei einem e,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong tei ding.

songs.title: 34. GAM LATAH MOLCHUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam latah molchunga cross lui khat adinge,
Hiche hi gim le jum melchih na,
Ken cross lui chu thildang sangin kadei pen e,
Chonset kilha dohna chu ahi.

Chorus
Ken kangai nai hiche cross lui chu,
Ka leiset hinkho kalha kah sen,
Ken hiche cross lui chu tuh jing ding,
Nikhat Lallukhuh toh ka lheh ding.

Verse 2
Hiche leiset miten akidah cross lui chu,
Kei ding in lungset na um e,
Pathen kelngoinou chun Aloupina dalhan,
Calvary a thina athoh e.

Verse 3
Chuche cross lui chunga thisan theng along lhai,
Ahoi kidang chu ken kamu tai,
Christa chu cross chunga athoh gim in athin,
Kei eingaidam in eisop theng tai.

Verse 4
Chuche cross chu keiman dihtah a jui jing ding,
Gim le jum tona ken neilou ding,
Nikhat ka Inpi a Aman eihin kou ding,
Aloupina chang jing jeng ta ding.

songs.title: 34. JESU MIN HI ITI NGEI TAM!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Phil. 2:2)

Verse 1
Jesu min hi iti ngei tam !
A tahsan te dinga ;
Lung donga alung monsah thei,
Dammo adamsah thei.

Verse 2
Lhagao damlou ho dam thei na,
Lung genthei lung olna ;
Lhagao hinna an pha ahi,
Tha chol dinga olna.

Verse 3
Min ngei hi ka hinna Songpi,
Ka lum le ka pho hi ;
Kem theilou ka gou thil kholna,
Van gou eilungsetna.

Verse 4
Pakai ka gol kei eichingpa,
Ka Pathen, ka Themgao ;
Ka hinna ka Lampi ahi,
Sang teiyin ka taona.

Verse 5
Ka hin laisen na min ngei hi,
Keiman seichoi lenge ;
Vo Jesu ken bangmon sange,
Na min ngei vahchoi la.

songs.title: 34. KAHINNAU NANG NAHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi twisoget lenna hin,
Ka hinnau Pakai Nang nahi;
Aw nang kalamkai malai Ahsi emhoi,
Lhepna vanpi nim’a jong nang hungvah in,
Vannoi leiset gentheina a hin.
Aw lungjin meijam meivom kal’a,
Lily pahhoi pahna gama chun;
Kipa huitheng bangin a hung,
Nei puilut in chugam em’a chun.

Verse 2
Kavet chimlou Zion lhanghoi,
Lhatsa goldeite lenna gam;
Lhamonna luipi bangin along kimvel,
Van Lal kelngoinou Laltouna ang’a chun,
Lungdon lungjin thina umtalou.

Verse 3
Vekit tem’un Zion lhang hoi,
Aloupije kasei thei poi;
Aw van’a mithengte chun avahchoiyun,
Nang naloupi-e Hallelujah tiuvin,
Van kelngoinou athasa Pau chu.

songs.title: 35. ENTER YE INTO THE JOY OF THE LORD (L. Th. 194)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mang jengta hen lei lungdonna,
Gol ngai kikhenna jouse jong;
Natna le lungdonna jouse,
Tonsot nopna dingin kile hen.

Chorus
Lungdon lungjin um talou ding,
Lhandampu lenna van gam’a;
Leiset gimna thoh talou ding,
Aw kalhagao choldo din chetan.

Verse 2
Gel jingin ka hung kitna ding,
Phat le ni hi ahung nai tai;
Lei thil jouse kidang sohta,
Jonin Pakaiyin naholna gam.

Verse 3
Goldeite toh lung lhaisel’in,
Zion Pakai chu vahchoiyun;
Pakai kei jong neilhat jal’in,
Nei puilutnin aw Na van gam’a.

Verse 4
Leiset chunga lung hesoh hon,
Zion Pakai chu vahchoiyun;
Ama thisan jal’a miten,
Ka kipah-e tin vahchoiyute.

songs.title: 35. JESUN NAMTIN AKHOP DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesun namtin akhop ding ahi phat khat le,
Mise le mipha khen ni a akhen ding ahi,
Loikhat chu Jesun nang naphai ati phatle,
Nang na umna dem hiche miho lah a chun.

Chorus
Mitheng ten kipa la asah teng,
Mitlhi longa kap tam ding u,
Huhhing a mitten hinna twi adon phat le,
Twi dua dangchah a thum tamtah umding ahi.

Verse 2
Ka phat alhin teng kei jong kache ding van a,
Leichung damsung tohman kasan tei ding ahi,
Loikhat in chonphat na Lallukhuh akhuh teng,
Nang najou nadem hiche miho lah a chun.

Verse 3
Hung lhung ding ahi Pakai nikho phat khat le,
Hiche thutep chu koiman apel theilou ding,
Loikhat in thina meikong ajot teng uleh,
Nang na um khadem hiche miho lah a chun.

Verse 4
Mo neilou Pathen Chapa athi laitah in,
Chonse kei khel a Pathen vaihom toh ahi,
Huhhing hisa Mitheng te akhop teng chuleh,
Kei umding kahi aw chu miho lah a chun.

songs.title: 35. KHATVEI DAVID LENGPA KHOPIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Luke 2:11)

Verse 1
Khatvei David Lengpa khopia,
Bong in’a gan an konga !
Minu khat in achasen theng,
Ponsea jellin alup sah ;
Minu chu Mariam ahi,
Acha chu Christa ahi.

Verse 2
Van’a konin ahung kum lhai,
Vannoi Pakai Pathen chu ;
Loupi pen lhunna ding ong lou,
Bong in’a ahung lhung tai ;
Mivaicha genthei ho toh,
Leiya ahung cheng khome.

Verse 3
A chapanlai khankho kidang,
Nunnem le jana neiyin ;
Lungset’in khoton anu ngai,
Lungset them Pakai theng chun ;
Eiho Ama nung juite,
Ama chon theng bang hiute.

Verse 4
Khatvei Amai imu kit diu,
Lungsetna eilhat jal’a ;
I Pakaiyu nunnem theng chu,
Chungnungpen Pakai ahi ;
A mite hungpui tou ding,
A van in noma cheng dia.

songs.title: 36. KELNGOI CHING HON BONG IN’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Heb. 2:9)

Verse 1
Kelngoi ching hon bong in’a,
Koi ham aga lem’u chu ?
Pakai Jesu huhhing kidang,
Leng ho Leng, Pakai ho Pakai ;
Keiman lhaijing ting tinge,
Loupipen chungnung Pakai.

Verse 2
Gam thip’a gilkel thoh a,
Satan lhepna toh koiham ?

Verse 3
Chonse hin theina dinga,
Cross chunga kithat koiham ?

Verse 4
Mihem chonset jal’a thia,
Lhan’a kon thoukit koiham ?

Verse 5
A Pa jetlam’a touva,
Pakai chungnung pen koiham ?

songs.title: 36. NANGMA A KAHI O EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nangma a kahi O eilhandampu,
Na lungset aw nem kajai,
Kalung sunga hin tahsanna khang hen,
Nang kahin naithei na din.

Chorus
Neipui naiyin, Pakai neipui in,
Na thina cross phung a chun,
Neipui naiyin naiyin Pakai neipui in,
Na thisan lonna a chun.

Verse 2
Na natong ding in Pakai neithen son,
Na lungset thahat na chun,
Ka lhagao mang ding Nang a kingai hen,
Nangma a kalung mong hen.

Verse 3
Nangma angsung a taovin ka kun e,
Laltouna ang in kabol,
Ka Pathen na ang a ka dilsuh hi,
Golbang a Nang bel kahi.

Verse 4
Thina twikhanglen gal a lungsetna,
Aumâ€™e kamu phahlou,
Kipana chungnung aumâ€™e chua,
Kalhun teng keima san ding.

songs.title: 36. THE SUFFERING OF THE LORD (L. L. 407)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu thisan along’e,
Kachonset thenna din;
Alu theng chu akaikun’in,
Kalha huhhingna din.

Chorus
Kelngoinou nunnem Pa chu,
Calvarya athi tai;
Kelngoinou thasa thoudoh kit a chu,
Eilhandampu ahi.

Verse 2
Kachonset ka suhkhel vangin,
Cross chunga apengin;
Lungsetna le khoto na in,
Eipei tonsot hinna.

Verse 3
Nisan amai asel peh-in,
Avah so ngam louvin;
Lhandampun kachonset apoi,
Thingpel’a athi chun.

Verse 4
Kenjong kalu kakun sah ding,
Pakai Cross ang’a chun;
Athoh natje chu gel’ing ting,
Amel kamu phatle.

Verse 5
Kalungdon mitlhi long jongle,
Kei din athohna joi;
Kapum’in lut’in kipenge,
Hibou chu kathem khon.

songs.title: 37. PAKAI IN NANGAIDAM THU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai in nangaidam thu naphon nah em?
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in,
Pakai thina cross chu iti najot em?
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in,
Nang nache nah em, a Ama vah a chu,
Ngaidam nachan nah em mona kon,
Ama sun le nakipana jan le la,
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in.
Seikit in ngaiyu hite thu,
Seikit in seikit tem in,
Thusim ngei chu seikit tem in,
Na dinga Loupina hiding,
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in.

Verse 2
Na galsat najona thusim ngei tah chu,
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in,
Galsat kipan ho dingin phachom inte,
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in,
Chonset gallen sat ihiuve huh in,
Christa toh gam kilo loi ta ding,
Christa ding a Lhagao huhhingna thu chu,
Seikit in ngaiyu hite avel vel in.

songs.title: 37. PATHEN TAHBEH KHAT BOU AHI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiya pathen tam jeng jongle,
I-Pau khatmai van’a aum’e;
Pentil neilou hingjing Pathen ahi.
Aw ule nao nu le pa deite,
Tonsot hinkemlou neina din;
Lung heiyun lang Pathen hin bel’un.

Verse 2
Jouthei pathen hinna neilou,
Kaneiye tin eipuimang jitai;
Aneisun jong dana ahibouve.

Verse 3
Chonset bulpu nungjaipa chun,
Atoh le akipana pen chu;
Lhagao damun’a puilut hi ahi.

Verse 4
Ngaiyun eisempau Pathen chun,
Ami mangsate holdohna din;
Achapa changkhat chu eihin peuve.

songs.title: 37. VANNOI KIPAH HEN PAKAI HUNG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. s. (Psalms 98:1)

Verse 1
Vannoi kipah hen Pakai hung,
Leiyin sang hen a Leng ;
A umna ding mun mi jousen,
Lungsung gotsan koihen. (3 vei)

Verse 2
Vannoi kipah Pakai vaihom,
Sauvin avahchoi la ;
Mol le lhang, Phaicham twi lenin,
A vahchoi la sauvin. (3vei)

Verse 3
Thutah lungset nan vai apoi,
Heu hen leiset miten ;
Achon phat le aloupina,
Seiphong hen lei chungah. (3 vei)

songs.title: 38. BONG IN’ A SOH CHU KOI HAM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Bong in’a soh chu koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa ;
Lop manna kijoh koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa.

Chorus
Calvarya gimthoh koi ham ?
Eihuhhingna thia koi ham ?
Vannoi huhhing Leng chungnung,
Nunnom Jesu Christa.

Verse 2
I taonau ngaiya koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa,
Hinkemlou eipea koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa.
Thina ding twisoh laiya,
Eila galkai ding koi ham ?
Hinna, damna Leng chungnung,
Nunnom Jesu Christa.

Verse 3
Thi louna eipea koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa,
Lhan’a kon thouva koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa.
Vannoi Thupi tan ni le,
Van kot hong dinga koi ham ?
Mi lungset Leng hat chungnung,
Nunnom Jesu Christa.

Verse 4
Ol eipe diuva koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa ;
Van’a kija pen koi ham ?
Nunnom Jesu Christa.
Lallukhuh khuhsah-un lang,
Vahchoiyun ami jousen ;
Hinna damna van Lengpa,
Nunnom Jesu Christa.

songs.title: 38. SURELY HIS SALVATION IS NIGHT (L. Th. 110)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampun mun asem jou tai,
Setna thisa thoukit un lang;
Ama vahchoiyu hite,
Kikhenna um kitta lou ding.
Aw khotona lungset aw chun,
Kichol dong’e Pa gam sem’a;
Tonsot in emnom’a ka chen.

Verse 2
Ka umna lei in gimna hi,
Se jeng jongle tonsot in ding;
Kei dinga gotsa ahi,
Genthei chate kipana din.

Verse 3
Koi ham kakom’a hung ding chu,
Hot nei ponge eiti jal’in;
Ka chonsetna jouse hi,
Aw Pakai nei suthengin kei.

Verse 4
Goldeite chu ngai jeng jong leng,
Pakai gam sem nom lam’a chun;
Lungmonna lungset aw chun,
Tun Pakaiyin eilhamon’ui.

songs.title: 38. TWINAH KHAT UM THISAN ALONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Twinah khat um (thisan a long -3) (2)
Calvary a kondoh chu,
Thisan luipi (chonse pen in -3) (2)
Thenna anei na chu.
Aw calvary lui hoitah (3)
Keiding a nahung lon.

Verse 2
Chonse khatbeh (thiding kon chu -3) (2)
Then na lui chu amui.
Ama bang in (chonse jong leng -3) (2)
Buhbang eiso sah thei.

Verse 3
Pakai ngaitah (na thisan lu -3) (2)
Tamtah in hepha lou,
Huhhing ho chun (hichu amun -3) (2)
Pohgih a kon ong ta.

Verse 4
Tahsan na in (lui chu kamui -3) (2)
Ka gam geija hung long,
Ka thupi pen (eingailut na -3) (2)
Ka thi ni geija ding.

songs.title: 39. JESUN CHONSET ASOP THENG TAI!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. sl (Isaiah 9:6)

Verse 1
Jesun chonset asop theng tai,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi !
A thisannin eilhatdoh tai,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi.

Chorus
Huhhingpa kidang ahi,
Pakai Jesu Christa,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi,
Pakai Jesu chu.

Verse 2
Eilhatdoh tai athisan in,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi !
Chule Pathen toh eigom tai,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi.

Verse 3
Lam eihil’in kei eipui lei,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi !
Eiching jinge kei damsel chan,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi.

Verse 4
Thoh hat le lung hat jong eipei,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi !
Hichun eilhem’a kaneh jou,
Huhhingpa kidang ahi.

songs.title: 39. KAHIN JON’E SALEM KHO CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kahin jon’e Salem kho chu,
Lungdon umlou na gamnom chu;
Kinemin kahin jon jinge,
Pakai kei dinga mun ong nam?

Chorus
Lungdon puldouvin kavah lei,
Kava veina leisetna hin;
Van gam kaina Nangbou nahiye,
Van Lal Pakai nei dalha loujenin.

Verse 2
Tonsot hinna thinglim noiya,
Van mithengte chu alengui;
Set gentheiyin eijui jinge,
Nei sumil lou jenin Pakai.

Verse 3
Hinna Pakai kahin bel’e,
Kama lungdon meipi ajing;
Van le leiset kah a hin aw,
Nang louvin hung lhung jou ponge.

Verse 4
Ka ma thina Jordan lenin,
Nang gal hinna gam vah nahi;
Van gam kahung lhun jouna din,
Aw van lhagao nei puilut in.

songs.title: 39. KALHAGAO VIN CHRISTA JENGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka lhagaovin Christa jeng a,
Lhamon na ahol chu,
Vangbohna tamtah simjou,
Tunvang akimu tai.

Chorus
Christa tailou chu koima dang,
Eiki pasah umlou,
Ngailut nale kipa jingna,
Ama jeng a kamu.

Verse 2
Aheng a olna hol louva,
Leiset gouhom keuva,
Kahol pet hin Eihuhingpan,
Ngailut in eisang tai.

Verse 3
Vo Pakai leiset a twikhuh,
Thal ding tin kadel lin,
Hinla a twi kadon theilou,
Thina gutwi ahi.

Verse 4
Ka nopna mangsa lha ngaiyin,
Nang la kahol ji pon,
Na ngailut na thu theng tah chu,
Nei hetsah masang sen.

songs.title: 40. CHRISTAN MICHONSE ALAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Matt. 9:22)

Verse 1
Christan michonse alai,
Mi jouse gasei peh un ;
Lam hilouva chete le,
Lamvaiya gam mangsa ho.

Chorus
Lan sauvin avel vel’in,
Mi chonse Christan alai ;
Ahet thei nauvin hil un,
Christan mi chonse alai.

Verse 2
Hungun ol peuvin nate,
Tahsan’un Christa thusei ;
Aman mi chonse alai.
Nangma jong thonmoa la ding.

Verse 3
Ka mona aum tapoi,
Lung theng sel’a kahi tai ;
Ka chonset nen asop tai,
Danthu peh ka gingta poi.

Verse 4
Christan mi chonse alai,
Keima jong eipampai poi ;
Chonset kisop ngim soh a,
Vanmi hi ding kahitai.

songs.title: 40. JINGKAH DAITWI ALHAH TENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jingkah daitwi alhah teng,
Leichung thingna louna,
Jan daitwi in achap teng,
Ahing doh soh jitai.
Vannoi jousea gasei leuvin
Pakai chu athoudoh kittai.
Pakai chu athoudoh kittai

Verse 2
Easter jing ninou asoh,
Pahcha namkim apah,
Apah hoi in lei ajem,
Mihem lung alhai e.

Verse 3
Jing i-mu pengpalep ho,
Nalhau jah doh uvin,
Hung leng doh soh uvin lang,
Pakai athou kittai

songs.title: 40. WHEN SHALL WE SEE THEE (L. Th. 74)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai leiya nalungset ho hin,
Sun le janin ka ngah jingui;
I-tih ka kipanau ni loupi,
Vetnom kidang chu kamu diuvem?

Chorus
Aw Pakai tonsot lhang chunga chun,
Mitheng ho sim joulou chuto;
Valpa ahsi bangin hung vah in lang,
Chuteng leiset hi kadalhah ding.

Verse 2
Kahin nai tah em Pakai nagam,
Lhandampu kangah lel ngeiye;
Pakai vahchoina la sa dingle,
I-ma ponlap choikal kangah lel.

Verse 3
Chu luikam chapangte lenna a,
Hinna thinglim damnoiya chun,
Ving neiya leng galkai thei hileng,
Leiset gentheina ngaikit lou ding.

Verse 4
Nang hung jingin namtin Lal loupi,
Na vangphat hom ding hinchoiyin;
Lam nom’a chun nalamto dingin,
Jerusalem geiyin vahchoiyun.

songs.title: 41. GOSPEL DAH GIN ATHONG E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gospel dah gin athong e,
Twikhaglen le leichung a,
Manbei a huhhing na Thupha,
Nang le keima eihung pei,
Pathen in vannoi mi a ngailut behseh jeh in,
Achapa changkhat eipeuve,
Atahsan chan hinna din.
Gospel dah aginge,
Twikhanglen le leichung a,
Gospel dah manbei yin,
Nang le kei eihung peuve.

Verse 2
Gospel dah in eikou ui, golvah na ankong umdin,
Eikou nau ngaida lou jen un,
Lungset na eikou nau hi,
â€œHinna changlhahâ€™ kahi Lhagao gilkel an neuvin,
Na chonset itobang jongle,
Aboncha chu bang soh ding.

Verse 3
Gospel gin kipa umtah, athong in gamtin aloi,
Ngaidam chamkim na thu apoi,
Cross a Jesu thi vang in,
Hapa kipana thu, ka pohpeh e mijouse,
Huhhing a ahung pengtai,
Leng le Pakai Christa chu.

songs.title: 41. IHAM EISOPTHENG THEIYA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Heb. 9:27)

Verse 1
I ham eisop theng theiya ?
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou ;
Ka chonset sop theng soh thei,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou.

Chorus
Chu thisan luipi chun,
Buhbang eiso sah thei ;
A dang ima umlou,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou.

Verse 2
Chonset suhmang soh theina,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou ;
Kei chonphat na theng jou lou,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou.

Verse 3
Chu bou eiki ngaidamna,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou ;
Set’a kon’a then theina,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou.

Verse 4
Chu bou nop le lungmona,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou ;
Chu bou nop le lungmonna,
I dang bei Jesu thisan bou.

songs.title: 41. LEI LE VAN’A CHAM LENG HEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaite Calvary nalungdon ni chun aw,
Melma sim jouloute akikhom’un;
Nalung donna veding koi ham?
Van meiyin Nang nahin bom’e,
Calvary ahinlei,
Amen, Amen Hallelujah Amen,
Leiya le van’a cham leng hen;
Twisoget le leiset jong hi,
Hallelujah Amen!

Verse 2
Ngaite thina jouvin athoudoh kittai,
Chung khopi le Van mithengte nguisa;
Calvary pah lamtoa lem din,
Thokit jinga halna thah in,
Van khopi kithongta.

Verse 3
Thina luigal’a aw Salem thah hoi chu,
Lalna gam pahcha hoi kimvel’a chun;
Kipana selangdah tum’un,
Galjou Pakai avahchoiyun;
Vahchoina dai ngailou.

Verse 4
Aw kalhagao vejingin khopi nom chu,
Lhandampu le van mithengte lenna;
Thi le lungdon puldou beina,
Hinna Pahcha pahna gam’a,
Ka na aum tapoi.

songs.title: 42. O ITI NOP TAM!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (I John 3:2)

Verse 1
O iti nop tam ! Christa kanei,
Van gam loupi le anop eihil tai ;
Van gou lo dinga lhat kahi tai,
Thisan le Lhagaova peng kahi.

Chorus
Hiche ka thusim, hiche ka la,
Keiman vahchoi ding kahin laisea ;
Hiche kathusim, hiche ka la,
Ken vahchoi jing ding kahin laisea.

Verse 2
Ahenga lut chu nop chamkim soh,
Thokit loupi nia loupina chang ding ;
Vantil hung kumlha eipuitou ding,
A koma chenga ol jing jeng ding.

Verse 3
A henga lut chu ol chamkim soh,
Genthei lengvai chol jong beisohta ding ;
Ki gingin ahung ngah jing inge,
Aphatna cheng vahchoi la’n sange.

songs.title: 42. THILPHA IMU BANG HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thilpha imu bang hi koiman amuthei poi,
Ipau gamthil ahin leiset miâ€™n mu thei lou,
Eikhen ponte imachan jong,
Pathen ngailut na a kon in.

Verse 2
Asan je simthei lou athuh je seithei lou,
Ngailut chungnung ichan aman simthei lou chu,
Nang ho vana Mitheng te ho,
Aloupi je neihil thei um?

Verse 3
Leiset amang pantai aphat na jouse toh,
Athilbol thei nale aloupina ho jong,
Lei pahcha hi achol jitai,
Ka Pakai bou aphai kati.

Verse 4
Leiset gou thil pha le aloupina ho jong,
Ahoina jouse le muthei jouse sang in,
Ka Pakai bou alul penâ€™e,
Ling lukhuh chu khuhpeh jong leu.

songs.title: 42. THIS IS MY BODY (L. Th. 157)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chujan lungdonna a gollhahnan Pakaiyin,
Hiche katahsa le ka thisan hi don’un;
Nei het jingna dingun.
Lhandampu deilouvin Zion kulpi sunga,
Panpi ding nei louvin;
Sapsetna thing abel.

Verse 2
Thoudoh-un hia konin chedoh loiyute,
Pakai chu setna simtha dinga agotnau phat;
Hung lhung ding ahitai.

Verse 3
Hichun apotdoh-un Olive lhanglam jonin,
Thempulen teho le sepai teng choiho chun;
Akan’un avouvin.

Verse 4
Pilat lal ponsil’in ling lukhuh akhuh-in,
Calvary lam jona mipin akailai chun;
Panpi ding nei talou.

Verse 5
Calvary lugu lhang nitin kave jinge,
Eilhandampu deitah michonse nin kahsen;
Kalunga milthei lou.

songs.title: 43. CHRISTA KANEI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat sl (Gal. 9:7)

Verse 1
Leiset nop mang jongle,
Christa kanei ;
Leiset hi chim jongle,
Christa kanei.

Chorus
Hi leiset gam muthim,
Olna mun la umlou ;
Christa kei kingaina ,
Christa kanei.

Verse 2
Ka lhagao lhem hih in,
Christa kanei ;
Leiya hin um jong leng,
Christa kanei ;
Leiset phe mang kit ding,
Ni chomkhat dinga peng ;
Kalunga mang jeng hen,
Christa kanei.

Verse 3
Hinkho janmang tobang,
Christa kanei ;
Chomkah in bei jongle,
Christa kanei ;
Ka lunga kagel chu,
Mang hen mil tange ken ;
Jesu bou ka hinna,
Christa kanei.

Verse 4
Ka hinkho lhing jongle,
Christa kanei ;
Sangin tonsot hinna,
Christa kanei ;
Sangin nop le phatthei,
Olna mun chu jon’in ;
Sangin Jesu angsung,
Christa kanei.

songs.title: 43. THERE THEY CRUCIFIED HIM. (L. Th. 50)
43. THISAN LU THISAN LU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thisan lu thisan lu,
Thing cross chunga long chun;
Chonset na kon eilhat,
Mi chonse ei ngaidam;
Chonset nen pen athenna chu,
Calvary thisan lu ahi (2)

Verse 2
O thisan thisan lu,
Vankot eihon peh e,
Van gam ilhun teng leh,
I lau chullou ding chu,
â€œThisan thisan lu thisan luâ€
Tia tang louva la isah diu (2)

Verse 3
O Lhanghoi Calvary,
Miten musit jong leu,
Lhang dang jouse sang in,
Ken ka ngailu pen e,
O nopna lhang ,vo mun theng pen,
Pathen thisan alonna chu (2)

songs.title: 44. JESU BANGA GOLPHA UMLOU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Eph. 5:2)

Verse 1
Jesu banga golpha lungneng umlou,
Khat jengcha jong umlou ;
I lhau nat thoidam thei adang umlou,
Khat jengcha jong umlou.

Chorus
Jesun ilung gimnau ahenai,
Eipui lhung tei dingu vangam ;
Jesu banga golpha lungneng umlou,
Khat jengcha jong umlou.

Verse 2
Ama banga Theng le alen umlou,
Khat jengcha jong umlou ;
Hibang gol lungnem le pha dang umlou,
Khat jengcha jong umlou.

Verse 3
A mithengte adalhah khah um em ?
Khat jengcha jong umlou.
Mi chonsete adeimo khah um am ?
Khat jengcha jong umlou.

Verse 4
Jesu banga pha eina kipe kham ?
Khat jengcha jong umlou ;
Van in’a chengdin ei deimou vintem ?
Khat jengcha jong umlou.

songs.title: 44. PATHEN VAHCHOI UN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen vahchoi un, Pathen vahchoi un,
Eisempau Pathen vahchoi un,
Pathen chungnung chu, vahchoi un ging un,
Nasempau Pathen vahchoi un.

Verse 2
Pathen jeng ging un, Pathen jeng ging un,
Loupi chungnung Pathen ging un,
Ama thun nung un, Ama thun nung un,
Nasempau Pathen thun nung un.

Verse 3
Christa lam touvin, Christa lam touvin,
Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa chu,
Hosanna samun, Hosana samun,
Lamtou vin na Lengpau Christa.

Verse 4
Amintheng lul chu, choi-an un ging un,
Jacheh un Christa mintheng chu,
Amin choi sangun, Amin vahchoiyun,
Eilhatpau Jesu vahchoi un.

songs.title: 44. PRAYING FOR THE HOLY GHOST. (L. Th. 88)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Penticost nia bang chun aw Lhandampu,
Hung leng kit’in namtin jouse din;
Tonsot luigal lam helouvin um’un,
Hin puidoh kitnin.

Verse 2
Thina hesoh thoh-a nalhatsate,
Sitlei pah mol bang leiset mite;
Nangin puiyin natonsot lalna gam,
Lam heloute chu.

Verse 3
Lhagao Thengpen nunnem hung kit in lang,
Lhatdam a-ngai nacha vahmangte;
Atonsot hinna lampiu helouvin,
Mimang ding ho chu.

Verse 4
Asumil tauve thingpel’a nathi,
Achonset lung thimpiu salvah-in;
Subeiyin ahinnau leipah-u chu,
Napui theina din.

Verse 5
Lungdon lungjinna nasalvah dingin,
Hinpen lang nahatna loupi chu;
Chonsetna sumang dingin van Lhagao,
Mei kongin hungin.

songs.title: 45. CHOLNGAH NA GAMNOM KANGAI CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Cholngah na gammon ka ngai chu
I tih ahung lhung dem,
I tih ka galvon kakoi in,
In nom a ka cheng dem.
Na tong jung uhite,
Jesu hung kit kahsen tong un,
Jesu hung teng Van in a kikhom ding.

Verse 2
Leija hin nopna aumpoi,
Hinna damna olna,
Lei hi keidia gamthip ahi,
Leihi ka In hilou.

Verse 3
Keima Jesu henga ka chen,
Cholnga tan eina ti,
Ama omâ€™a kingai jing din,
Van In ah eikouve.

Verse 4
Ka beltai keiman Jesu chu,
Chonse kit talou ding,
Thi jong leng anung kajui ding,
Van In kalhun kahsen.

songs.title: 45. KIPA OGIN KAJAUVE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Sol. 16:31)

Verse 1
Kipa ogin ka jauve,
Jesun eihuhhingui,
Thupha chu seiphong leuvin,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;

Chorus
Thu chu gam tin’a pouvin,
Mol le twilen kaipiuvin,
Cheuvin Pakai thu ahi,
Jesun eihuhhingui.

Verse 2
A ban ban’in tolun lang,
Jesun eihuhhingui,
Hilsoh un michonsete,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;
Twikol cheng jousen sau hen !
Twilen tin kithong soh hen !
Vannoi leiset kipah hen,
Jesun eihuhhingui.

Verse 3
Chung’an jong chutin sauhen,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;
Athi chu hinkemlouna,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;
Muthim lah jousea seiyun,
A lung thisa hal kit hen ;
Lhan chung tin’a lan sauvin,
Jesun eihuhhingui.

Verse 4
Hui nung bangin seileuvin,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;
Tun namtin kipah soh hen,
Jesun eihuhhingui ;
Huhhingna thu seileuvin,
Gam tin le twilen tin’a ;
Vannoi leiset thongsoh hen,
Jesun eihuhhingui.

songs.title: 45. LET EVERY CHRISTIAN PRAISE HIM (L. Th. 14)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Lalpa David phunga alha Ahsi,
Nagam thenga dinga nangin nei gotsa;
Kakipana twisoget gin bang ahi,
Thina luigal’a namin kavahchoi ding.

Chorus
Aw Pakai tingting namin pahchange,
Namtin nasemsate jousen jong;
Pakai vahchoina la chu sau hen,
Leiset hi kipanan losoh hen.

Verse 2
Mihem kahi masangin Pakai Jesu,
Athisan lon ding it louhel’in eilhat;
Sim theiying gahe tave leng hileng aw,
Leiya hin olmona beiya ka um ding.

Verse 3
Pakai hoikom ham mun nagasemna chu,
Daniel bangin bangkot a galdot inge;
Langkachah khopi amin thengtah a chun,
Gentheina a jong dilsung ting lhaiyinge.

Verse 4
Aw Immanuel lei le van thah sem chu,
Adung le avaiya leng len gave leng;
Gentheiya kikhen pisa goldeite chu,
Van mun loupi a amel’u kamu ding.

songs.title: 46. AW NANG HO JERUSALEM MITE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jan lungjin um Zion indan sunga,
Pakaiyin Athisan ahom’e;
Hiti chun lungdon meipi ajinge,
Ka Pakai lungset um akap-e.

Chorus
Aw nangho Jerusalem mite,
Alungset nachan chu hejingun;
Nanatnau jouse adamsah jeh chun,
Alungdonna chu hailou jen’un.

Verse 2
Jerusalem kulpi kulpam lam’a,
Themgao thidan ahipoi tiuvin;
Aw hin vetem tan Calvary lhang chu,
Mipi lah a ka Pakai kamui.

Verse 3
Vetan Calvary lhang alhutmai diu,
Ahitai i-kalo diu hitam ?
Aw ka Pakai nahung kitlou ding ham?
Namun ding chu Calvary hitam?

Verse 4
Hin sumil ponge ka Pakai Jesu,
Calvary lam hinve jing nange;
Ka dinga nathohna kalung sunga,
Ka laicha geiyin hejing nange.

songs.title: 46. NAHINNA DIN KEIMA NEIVEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Na hinna din keima neiven,
Kouna thupeh ngaijin,
Manbei ja lhatdam na thu hi,
Gamtinâ€™a seiphong len.

Chorus
Na hinna din keima neiven,
Leiset chunga umten,
Na Pathen u kahi jeh in,
Na hinna din keima neiven.

Verse 2
Cross chunga kaum neiveu vin,
Set pohna lengvai te,
Na set jal in genthei thoh in,
Nei tahsan jing uvin.

Verse 3
Na Pakai thoudoh pa neiven,
Lhepna muthim phatsung,
Hepina manbei a pe ding,
Satan jong nehjou ding.

Verse 4
Na hinna din neive jingin,
Panpi dang na neipoi,
Ngaidam chamna na ngaichat teng,
Keima jeng bou neiven.

songs.title: 46. PAKAI HESOH THOH JAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl (Luke 23:33)

Verse 1
Pakai hesoh thoh jan chu ka ngaito le,
Kalung sunga thimpi ajinge ;
Mihem dinga asem ni aso phat’in,
Ka lungsung thim jing avah soh tai.

Chorus
Keima jeh in, Calvary jonin achei,
Keima jeh in, keima jeh in ;
Keima jeh in, Calvary jonin achei,
Eilhatdoh nan athi.

Verse 2
Mi chonse a anga ka kithing thinge,
Ka kun’e lungset ngaidam thum nan ;
“Na chonset ka ngaidam tai” ti o kajai,
“Ka satai nabat jouse” eiti.

Verse 3
Huhhingpan ei ngailut akidang lheh e,
Van’a laltouna ahin dalhai ;
I hinna dingun Calvarya ahung thi,
Vahchoiyun Amin theng phong leuvin.

songs.title: 47. CHAMNA LENGPA APENG BETHLEHEMâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chamna Lengpa apeng Bethlehemâ€™a,
Hichu gam lai lungpen Canan gam nom,
Namtin dinga keng a lhun thei na ahi,
Chua hin le dam twitheng along e.

Chorus
O lunglhai sel in Naosen Leng pen nihin,
Kipah in sautÃ© Cham le lung ol na,
Chitin namtin ding in sochatna ahi,
Nom un lem un, Hallelujah tiuvin.

Verse 2
Phalbi dapjan khosot phoinel chunga,
Kelngoi chinghon a kelngoi nga pet un,
Jankhang lai in Gabriel in ahung vil un,
â€œHinna damna Thupha kahin poiâ€ ati.

Verse 3
Chu in vantil sangjan vanlai jol a,
Hung kilah in chung la ngei asauve,
Chungnung pen a Pathen loupina hihen,
â€œLeichunga kipa le Chamna leng hen.â€

Verse 4
Kipah ute chung le noi Leng pen nin,
Van khongpi le lei khongpi ging to hen,
Leng jouse Lengle Pakai jouse Pakai,
Hinlai damsung in lem ute Leng Christa.

Verse 5
Kelngoi chinghon chu khopi sung jon un,
Solam miching ten jong chu kho jon un,
Chibai boh un vaicha ten anei sun un,
Leng le Lal ten jong agoubom ahong un.

songs.title: 47. SOCHATNA KONG NIKHAT KALTOU DING.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Sochatna kong nikhat kaltou ding,
Jesu sochatna kongtol ahi;
Kong sung’a chu namtin kimsoh ding,
Apuilut ding vanchung gam nom’a.

Chorus
Chu gam’a lut dingin, chu gam’a lut dingin;
Kong’a chun hungkal’un u-le nao;
Chu gam’a lut dingin, chu gam’a lut ding,
Kong’a chun hungkal’un u-le nao.

Verse 2
Jesun lungset tah-in nakouve,
Kong’a hung kal’un michonsete;
Zion gam jon ding kong dang umlou,
Phat hom’in hunglut in kong sunga.

Verse 3
Kaina sochatna kong chu chele,
Hung kile lou ding kou jongle chun;
Zion gam nom em lam kai tading,
Nang naka ding twikhanglen gal’a.

songs.title: 47. THE BEAUTIFUL HOME. (L. Th. 20)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thina luigal’a gam hoitah a chun,
Ka tonsot van in ding chu aum;
Goldei ikikhenpi sate ho chun,
Luigal gamnom lam’a eingah jing.

Chorus
Aw nopna tonsot van in nom’a chun,
Mitlhi lonkit louna gam nom’a;
Alungset te Lhandampu kom’a,
Thon louva ikimu kit cheh diu.

Verse 2
Calvarya gentheina athoh jeh chun,
Alungsetna vahchoi chim ponge;
Melmaten thingpel’a akhai jeh chun,
Ka tonsot van in ding asem’e.

Verse 3
Ka na le gentheina athoh jeh chun,
Aw van Lhagao Theng nei umpin lang;
Calvarya Kelngoinou athi jeh chun,
Aloupina eijong ichan diu.

songs.title: 48. CHUNGNUNG PEN’A LOUPI PEN HEN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyun awgin iti ngeitam,
Niloupi hung lhung ding chu;
Leiset chonset le thina hi,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.
Chungnung pen’a loupi pen hen, (2)
Tin selangdah gin ngei thon;
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 2
Til’a Aigupta gam bang chun,
Jubilee ahung lhung tai;
Chungnung pen’a loupi pen hen,
Salem thah kot hong Pa chu.

Verse 3
Mel hetlou mi ahi lasa,
Lhanpu lem la sa ho chu;
Tonsot cham Lal loupi lemnan,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 4
Ahoi ngeiye apon loupiu,
Amel’u ni banga em;
Pon bang vamleh loupi sil’un,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 5
Nei hil’uvin vantil thengten,
Van Lal Immanuel chu;
Laltouna theng loupi dalhan,
Michonse din ahung tai.

Verse 6
Hung vah kit’in ka chunguva,
Melchihna Valpa ahsi;
Chamna leng hen muntin’a hin,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

songs.title: 48. THISAN LUIPI KHAT ALONGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. d. (Zech. 13:1)

Verse 1
Thisan luipi khat alonge,
Christa thajunga kon ;
Mi chonseten chu luiya chun,
Chonset asop lhauve.

Chorus
Chonset asop lhauve,
Chonset asop lhauve ;
Mi chonse ten chu luiya chun,
Chonset asop lhauve.

Verse 2
Cross chunga um thi dingsa chun,
Thisan lui chu amui ;
Kei jong ama banga chonse,
Ka chonset sop thengin.

Verse 3
Na thisan luinah chu keiman,
Tahsanin ka mutai ;
O ngeiyin Nang vahchoina la,
Kathi kahsen sange.

Verse 4
Ka leiset hinkho abeiya,
Lhan’a kon katho teng ;
Van’a o-ngei cheh in sange,
Na vahchoi tang louvin.

songs.title: 48. VAN KHOPI VANTIL SANGJA LENâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Van khopi Vantil sangja lenna,
Chu a lhatdam changte jong cheng ding,
Lunghel lungdon kana bei tading,
Chung Van khopi lhunkal ka ngah lel.

Chorus
Vo Edenâ€¦â€¦.. khopi thah,
Eden lui sang a nom,
Chua tonsot nopna kem talou,
Pakai sem khopi thah ka ngai e.

Verse 2
Chung van khopi nom tolsung a chu,
Hi leiset idalhah teng u leh,
Mitheng ache masa ngai cheng toh,
Chung Pathen komâ€™a ichen khom diu.

Verse 3
Chua chun Mitheng sangja aleng,
Van Mitheng te jouse jong chu cheng,
Lhenchom chapang thengte jouse chun,
Laltouna kimvel in asauve.

Verse 4
Van khopi sung chu sana emsoh,
Van gam vah chu Kelngoi nou ahi,
Vantil ho le lhatsa Mitheng te,
Van khonom a mukal ka ngah lel.

songs.title: 49. CHUNG VAN MIN NOM A KHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chung van mun nom a khun lhatsa ten lasan,
A Lallukhuh a Lengpau ang a koi un,
Leiset lungdon lungjin na akhel tauve,
Mitheng lhatsa ten kipa la asauve.

Chorus
Jesu vahchoi un,
Malaiya Calvary a thi chu,
Jesu vahchoi un,
Tonsot geiya dia hing kit chu.

Verse 2
Ngailut na la kidang tah chu akimtai,
Atahsan din thau namtui tah abang e,
Chonset jal a thi Pakai thokit vang in,
Vai ihomdiu Pakai toh a tonsot a.

Verse 3
Kelngoi nou thisan a kisil ngim lou chu,
Chu lathah chu koimanchan sathei louding,
Setna kon eilhatpau in eisil ngimtai,
Tun kipa la loupi sa pan tau hite.

songs.title: 49. PAKAI CHRISTA HUHHING LENGPA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai Christa huhhing lengpa,
Lhai jing’ute ami jousen;
Kipa nopna lengkhom kit din,
Alungsetnan eina hoidam’ui.

Chorus
Lhai jing’ute Lengpa chu eihon,
Aman eihoidam jeh-uvin;
Kikhen pisa golngaite to,
Lhaisel’in i-kimu kit tauve.

Verse 2
Christa minna sopi ngaite,
Namel mu diu ka kinem’e;
Nei lamtonau welcome phung le,
Khongpi gin’in kalung alange.

Verse 3
Nei lamtonau la aw ngei hi,
Kithong hen lang chung van gil’a;
Leiset mi le van mithengten,
Pakai lemnan la satoh-u hen.

Verse 4
Hibang chun akhon ni jongle,
Eilamtou hen vantil sangjan;
Lhatheng hung lenglha hen tunin,
Ilung nguisau hi suhal kit hen.

Verse 5
Mitmu phatlou gam’a konin,
Tun kamu tai ka gol ngaite;
Pakai vahchoina ni hihen,
Amintheng loupi jing hen Amen.

songs.title: 49. VAHCHOIYUN PAKAI JESU LENG.
songs.lyrics:
Doh id D.

Verse 1
Vahchoiyun Pakai Jesu Leng David son,
Ama vaihom kitup soh ding ;
Mi genthei le mi vaicha lungset soh ding,
Chonset jouse sumang soh ding.

Verse 2
Go juh laiya hiche leiset gam chunga,
Hampa louhing kile banga ;
Ama hung kumteng lei kisem thah soh ding,
A gamtin pahcha dimsoh ding.

Verse 3
Ama hungteng chonphat punga jalsoh ding,
Gam jousea lungmon cham leng ding ;
Leng jouse le chaga jousen ja cheh ding,
Namtin A anga lut cheh ding.

Verse 4
Ama min jenga bou vannoi mi tao ding,
A kijana kemtalou ding ;
Ni le lha vanlaijol’a ache laisea,
Mihemten Ama jeng lhai ding.

songs.title: 50. BEHOLD THE MAN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vetan Lhandampu chu akaiyun,
Aling lukhuh toh;
Melma simjou louvin atom,
Calvary lhang geiyin.

Chorus
Ka set vanga nathohna chun,
Na ul thisanin alonsah;
Na awnem ngai umtah soh chu,
Acheng jing kalung gil’a hin.

Verse 2
Kave ngam poi ka Pakai ngai chu,
Melmaten vouvin;
Athoh natje kasei thei poi,
Kei din ahin apei.

Verse 3
Thina tijat tah athoh lai chun,
Koi ham apanpi;
Ka-Pa ka-Pa tin asam’e,
Sapsetna thing chunga.

Verse 4
Aw ka lhagao Lhandampu thina,
Mun’a gachen lang;
Chu-a ngaidamna namu ding,
Athisan’a kon chun.

songs.title: 50. MEIVOM KAINA CHUNG PEH A KHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Meivom kaina chung peh a khun,
La hung kisa koisah ham?
Ami ngailut nale thahat,
Na la ngeitah in sauvin.
Kelngoi nou thisan theng a
Avon sop theng a Mitheng tea hi. (2)

Verse 2
Kelngoinou chu alamkai yin,
Ama avahchoi jing ui,
Hinna an in avah jinge,
Thisana lhatdoh sate.

Verse 3
Laltouna kimvelâ€™a touva,
La ngei sa jing a koiham?
Leiset genthei na min dalha,
Vanâ€™a kicholdo ahi.

Verse 4
Pathen kelngoinou lamkai yin,
Sun le jan in atong un,
Aman van an chun avah in,
Alhiu atheh hul peh in.

Verse 5
Amin ngei tah lhatdam na chun,
Theng chungnung Christa angah,
Amit mu vin akikhel un,
Laltouna kimvel a chun.

songs.title: 50. THEMPULEN CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat s. (Matt. 28:20)

Verse 1
Thempulen chun tun einaiyui,
Mi lungset chungnung Jesu ;
Lengvai kipana aseiye,
Pakai Jesu sei ngaiyun.

Chorus
Seraph la ngei chungnung pen,
Mihem kam’a min ngei pen ;
Hichu tonsot la ngei pen,
Jesu Christa min ngei.

Verse 2
Loupina jouse Jesu a,
Ken ka tahsan tai Jesu ;
Huhhingpa min ngei ka ngailui,
Jesu min kangai nom’e.

Verse 3
A min chu lung lengvai milna,
Jesu min tailou umlou ;
Ka jah le kei ka lung monge,
Jesu Christa minlu chu.

Verse 4
Van chung gam nom’a ikal teng,
Huhhingpa mel kimu ding ;
Lungset laltouna kimvel’a,
Amin ngei la kisa ding.

songs.title: 51. O EILHANDAMPU THISAN SONA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat d. (Eph. 2:8)

Verse 1
O Eilhandampu thisan sona chu,
Nopna le ol chamlhatna ahitai ;
Sapsetna changin along toh-in,
Namtin alhatdam lungset’in.
O lungsetna sangin mi chonsen,
O lungsetna sopi’n tahsanin ;
Tonsot’a kon Cross limdam noiya,
Lhandampun nakou aw nemin.
2 Cross chunga Lhandampu nangma dingin,
Genthei lengvaiyin, linglukhuh akhuh ;
Nasetna kisei kitta lou ding,
Lungsetna ngaidam nahitai.

Verse 3
Noplen ihiuve lungdon lungjin bei,
Jesun ahoiye alhatdamte chu ;
“Hungin” tin nakou lunglhai sellin,
Hungin Aman na ngaidam tai.

songs.title: 51. PAKAI NANG KANGAILU PEN E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai Nang kangailu penâ€™e
Leiset nopna sang in,
Ajeh chu Nangma lung neipen,
Hichu ngailut na lung.

Chorus
Mi asang aja ngailut na,
Hillou lai atam e,
Ei sutheng a thisan lu chu,
Mi tamtah hillou lai.

Verse 2
Pakai Nangman nei nga jingle,
Keima kicha louding,
Namin ngei ken ka vahchoi ding,
Leiset nopna sang in.

Verse 3
O ka Pakai ka Lhandampu,
Kalung sung a cheng in,
Chuteng kalung kipah jing ding,
Leiset nopna sang in.

Verse 4
O Lhandampu lhatdam kidang,
Nei thilpeh i-hin tem?
Hitobang kipa na hinkho,
Leiyah neiching jing in.

songs.title: 51. VIRGIN BIRTH (L. TH. 139)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoiya hin leng sangja anapeng nan jong,
Leng Christa bang hi khatcha anapeng khalou;
Lhandampu ahung peng Bethlehem bong in’a,
Van Lengpa lem dingin noi le van mi kikhom.

Chorus
Kipah-in lem’ute van Lal leng pah-ute,
Asoni hin vannoi kipanan losoh hen;
Van Lengpa ahung peng Lallukhuh hom dingin,
Van mithengte jousen jong eihung lem’u hen.

Verse 2
