Van mithengten alemnan kipa la sauvin,
Hichu kelngoi ching hon ajauvin gamnoiya;
Lhandampu umna chu kichen tah-in hil’un,
Akelngoiyu dalhan chibai agaboh-ui.

Verse 3
Solam michingten thao namtui kengin hungun,
Van’a valpa amauva ahung lamkaiyin;
Gan konga anu Maryn apom gamuvin,
Agoubom’u hongun chibai agaboh-ui.

Verse 4
Leng Herod in ahet’in analung jinpin,
Chibai boh-in kilep’in michingte dongin;
Naosen peng jouse khomin Juda gamsunga,
Naosen Leng chu Pathenin anahuhdoh-e.

Verse 5
Vo Jesu tuni hin kalungsung bong in’a,
Hung kisem thah kit’in lang ka tonsot Leng din;
Kakhut theng lou hi Mary khut’in ngaiton lang,
Tonsot in kipah-in Nang lem kum lhung tange.

songs.title: 52. I NATOH ICHAISOH TENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I natoh ichaisoh teng,
Nisa hung lhum loi tading,
Chuteng lung lengvai lungmong ta ding,
Van le lei Pakai vang chun,
Eihin ban kaithou dingu,
Zion mol a ikimu to diu.
Chu a ikimu ding chua ikimuto diu,
Eilhatpau mel iput diu,
Chu gam nom hoitah a chu,
I kimuto cheh diu chua ikimuto diu,
A loupina ichan ding.

Verse 2
Dam kokhuh thuh thim noiya,
Khopi huinun gin kichan,
Muthim in ei umkimvel jing-ui,
Hinla Jesun eipuinai,
Sun nivah hoi nomâ€™a din,
Leiset huipi nun kitlou na a.

Verse 3
I lungu kicha hen lang,
I mitlhiu long jeng jongle,
Leiset lung ngai in dim jong leu hen,
I Pakai hung kit teiding,
Inlam a eipui tou ding,
Chuteng genthei kihe ta lou ding.

songs.title: 52. NEI DALHA LOU JEN’O
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat m. (Rom. 10:13)

Verse 1
Nei dalha lou jen’o Jesu,
Ka taonau ngaiyin ;
Midang Nangman nakou tengle,
Nei dalha hih-in.
Jesu, Jesu, ka taonau ngaiyin,
Nangmam midang ho nakou teng,
Nei dalha hih-in.

Verse 2
Natouna limdam noiya chun,
Keima ol neipen ;
Chua na vahchoi la sange,
Lungset’in neilan.

Verse 3
Ka lung monna twinah nahi,
Ka hinna jong Nang ;
Nanglou keiman adang neilou,
Nangbou ka hinna.

Verse 4
Ka chonsetna subei soh in,
Nei siltheng sel’in ;
Na deilam tah-in neipui len,
Na vangam geiyin.

songs.title: 52. THE CITY WHICH IS TO COME (L. Th. 35)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I-leiset hinkho hi abei teng,
Pakai Lhandampu mel chu gakimunte;
Chuteng ikipanau chul lou ding,
Olmun nom’a Pakai meldei imu diu.

Chorus
Aw hinna thing nalim noiya,
Van mitheng kipan aleng’ui;
Aw chu a ikicholdo diu;
Israel lhang thengtah-a chun.

Verse 2
Chu khopi nom ngaiyin kamaove,
Chu-a chun lunghel gimna umtalou ding;
Lhatna thisan jal’in goldeiten,
Leiset gimna jouse adalha tauve.

Verse 3
Che jing’ute aw Zion chate,
I-lenna diu gam loupi ahung nai tai;
Tu-a lunghel ka le gimna hi,
I-kipanau pahcha bangin pah-inte.

Verse 4
Chu khopi nom chu ilhun tengle,
I-lennau leiset gam hi ngai talou ding;
Kelngoi thasa Pa Laltouna chun,
Vetnom datmo le kipana kimunte.

songs.title: 53. CHONSEN THUM LE CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Chonsen thum le chun,(3 vei)
Huhhing tan nate.
Ima jouse nangman na ngai chan chu,
Thum le chun Jesun tua nang peding.

Verse 2
Chol’in thum le chun, (3 vei)
Olsah tan nate.

Verse 3
Hatmon thum le chun,(3 vei)
Thanei tan nate.

Verse 4
Kel’in thum le chun, (3 vei)
Oiva tan nate.

Verse 5
Dammon thum le chun, (3 vei)
Damthei tan nate.

Verse 6
Mongmon thum le chun, (3 vei)
Lungmong tan nate.

songs.title: 53. SUN NI KEMLOU GAM A CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sun ni kemlou gam a chun,
Khopi hoitah aum,
Imatih a mang thei lou,
Chua jan jong umlou.

Chorus
I-mitlhiu theh hulsoh ding,
Thile man kichat beita,
Phat jong kum a kisim lou,
Chua jan jong umlou.

Verse 2
A kot jouse song mantam,
Khopi ningli hoi chu,
A lamlen jong sana em,
Chua jan jong umlou.

Verse 2
A kot kikha tih umlou,
Khopi ningli hoi chu,
Hinna twi val alonge,
Chua jan jong umlou.

Verse 3
Nisa vah jong ngaita lou,
Khopi hoitah a chun,
Jesu vah jing jeng ahi,
Chua jan jong umlou.

songs.title: 53. WILL THOU NOT REVIVE US AGAIN (L. Th. 30)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao hung lengin Eden’a thil lui,
Hung mang intin nagam hoi kavet ding;
Chuteng kamu ding loupina jouse,
Vahchoina gin hui bangin nung’inte.

Chorus
Immanuel nalungset kulsunga,
Gimna gal alen’e hung nai kit’in;
Hung kile kit’in kahinnau nahi,
Nalungset kulsunga aw gimna gal alen’e.

Verse 2
Aw kipana malsomna niloupi,
Nahinna lampi nom’a neipuiyin;
Jordan luipi len chu kinong jongle,
Canaan gamnom luipi kagalkai ding.

Verse 3
Leng theiying vakhu bangin leng le leng,
Kahinna Calvary mol kalhun ding;
Chuteng chumun chu kadalhah kit teng,
Lalna gam nilhum louna kajot ding.

Verse 4
Aw kadamlai ni hi abei tengle,
Nopna khopi tollaiya kalen ding;
Calvary thina pachat la sa ho,
Kipana chul thei louva lengkhom ding.

songs.title: 54. APHAT DUNGJUI IN ACHAL JING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aphat dungjui in achal jing,
Aniseh in a chal jing,
Leiset chung natoh dalha a,
Inlam jon in che tange.
A phat dung, phat dung jui in che tange,
Chetang e, chetange Inlam jon in,
A phat dung, phat dungjui in che tange.

Verse 2
Kumho dungjui in che tange,
Chungle noi thilsem jouse,
Lungsung a kipana dim jing, lengvai genthei adimâ€™e.

Verse 3
Leiset chung mile sangsom sangja,
Keiman kajot laise hin,
Kache velkol jou phat teng le,
Inlam jon a kache ding.

Verse 4
Niseh in Pakai ah tao un,
Lamdih tah a eipui diu,
Chu tailou lamdih dang umlou,
Chubou chu lamdih ahi.

songs.title: 54. ATHISAN LU ALONGLHAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eiho eichuna in genthei tintang athoh,
Alalna hin dalhan leiset a hung kumlhan;
Chaga chan ahung peng vannoi Lhandampu chu.
Setna a sohchangsa eihung lhatdoh tauve,
Thi geiyin athoh-in athisan lu longlha;
Chu kaset thenna ding.

Verse 2
Zion indan sung chu lung gil’in gel tem’un,
Aw Eilhandampu chun athisan ahom’in;
Lungdongin adon’un Ama nungjuite chun.

Verse 3
Gam vaipo Pilat in athutan dih talou,
Cross a khaina thu le ling lukhuh anapen;
Calvary lhang lama melmaten akaiyui.

Verse 4
Alungset cheng ho jong hoiya vaitham hiuvam?
Kadang achag-e tin Cross chunga asam’e;
Twi penom umtalou vannoi setpo Pa chu.

songs.title: 54. KEI GOL NEILOU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Matt. 12:28)

Verse 1
Kei gol neilou changlha lengvai,
Pakai, neikou aw kajai ;
Kalung heiyin Nang kasange,
Tun ka hunge na hengah.

Chorus
Kei ka hunge, kei kahunge,
Na lim’a phatthei chang din ;
Kei ka hunge, kei ka hunge,
Cholnga dingin ka hunge.

Verse 2
Lungtheng, lungnem, jaidam, lungneng,
Naheng jonin ka hunge ;
Nei kol jingin Nangma anga,
Pot kit lou din ka hunge.

Verse 3
Na lim kahin bel’e Pakai,
Ka lhan olna a ngaitai ;
Jing khovah a mithengte toh,
Nun noma thou kit dingin.

Verse 4
Ka koma nei umpi jingin,
Hinkho thim jing bang jongle ;
Ka lungdon kipanan hin len,
Ka lung muthim salvah-in.

songs.title: 55. JESU PEN NI CHRISTMAS AHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu pen ni Christmas ahin,
Hung uvin sopi gol le paite,
Eiho dingin ni loupi pen,
Kumlhung a ikinep nau.

Chorus
Avahchoi na la sacheh uvin,
Leng pengthah loupi Jesu,
Mihem te lhatdoh ding Pa chu,
Apengtai Bethlehem a.

Verse 2
Valpa hungvah solam a kon,
Jing ninou bang in ahung soh in,
Hichun vannoi ahin sal in,
Sun le jan in avah jing.

Verse 3
Solam miching te ho jong chun,
Pakai pen kipapi na jal in,
Manlu Sana, Bego, Mor in,
Pakai aga lem uve.

songs.title: 55. PATHEN KEIMA MICHONSE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat m. (Psalms 78:72)

Verse 1
Pathen keima mi chonse,
Che kahi twisoh laiya ;
Chonset ka pohlel jal’in,
Asetai kache na kong ;
Pakai Jesun neihuh-in,
Nangma bou eihuhhing thei.

Verse 2
Huipi le gopi kitho,
Thi ding koncha kahi tai ;
Nei lungset’in neihuh in,
Nang tailou adang umlou ;
Thahat chungnung pen Jesun,
Keima nei huhhing teiyin.

Verse 3
Twisoh van vum’a lengta,
Nei tol’in neihuhhingin ;
Tu kalungdon pettah hin,
Ka kong kaina Nang nahi ;
Pakai Jesu Nang jeng bou,
Huhhing a kongtol nahi.

songs.title: 55. THE CLEANSING POWER (L. TH. 49)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw hoikom ham Lhandampu chun,
Lungdon hesoh athoh;
Amel dei um chu mu kanom,
Lungset thisan lonna.

Chorus
Aw nathisan lon kamu chun,
Kaset pohgih siltheng tading;
Lungdon lungjin umtalou ding,
Aw nathisan jal’in.

Verse 2
Aw ka ngaiye Pakai tu hin,
Kaset nei thensah-in;
Lei chunga hin Nangma lou chu,
Kaina ding dang umlou.

Verse 3
Kalaicha phat ahung lhunge,
Lungset in neipuiyin;
Kichalou ding thina lui chu,
Lem louva galkai ding.

songs.title: 56. AW PAKAI GENTHEI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kelngoinou set poh khu vetan,
Athina ding lhang jonin apuiyun;
Alung donna panpi ding nei talou,
Set tin po Pa chun.

Chorus
Aw Pakai genthei panpi ding nei talou,
Calvary lhang jonin apuitauve;
Nunaote silung lengvaiyin,
Kap-in akih-un.

Verse 2
Athina ding lhang alhung’un,
I-alouvem gave tem’un Pakai;
Akhut akeng akil’un thingpel’a,
Melmate nuiyun.

Verse 3
Kaven nuina him him umlou,
Athi dan iti lungdon um hitam;
Amai theng thisanin achup jou tai,
Nang jong hung vetan.

Verse 4
Pakai dei thisan so jal’in,
Themmo changsa leiset mihemte din;
Hinna lampi kot chu eihon peh-un,
Amite ho din.

songs.title: 56. JORDAN LUIPI GAL IKAI KHOM TENGLE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jordan luipi gal ikai khom tengle,
Lhatsa te loupia imu dingu,
Luipi kamâ€™a nel simsen lou bang ding,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hiding.

Chorus
Luikamâ€™a nel simsen lou jat hiding,
Luikamâ€™a nel simsen lou bang ding,
Vetnom kidang hiding, lhatsa te imu diu chu,
Luipi kamâ€™a nel simsen lou jat hi ding.

Verse 2
Lei semtil a pat a lhatsa te chu,
Lhepna lungdon na neita lou in,
Van gam nomâ€™a ikimu to khom diu,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hiding.

Verse 3
Chu luipi hoi kamâ€™a idin teng u,
Hinthing lim damnoiya ium diu,
Canan gammon lam chu galdot jinga,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hiding.

Verse 4
Eihuhhing pau le aloupina chu,
Kichen tah a imu tengu le,
Leng in gam jouse a vai ahomding chu,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hiding.

songs.title: 56. NGAIYIN KAHUNG TAONA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. s (John 21:15)

Verse 1
Ngaiyin kahung taona, Pakai Jesu,
Ka ngaicheh na dingin, lung neihin pen ;
Nang ka ngai cheh nadin,
Jesun lung neihin pen ;
Ha ngai tah-a, ka ngaina din.

Verse 2
Leiset nopna jouse, kamu soh tan,
A hin nopna olna, hin kichen lou ;
Nangma jengbou hinna,
Nopna le lung monna,
Ha ngai tah-a, ka ngaina din.

Verse 3
Tu vangin Nang jeng bou ngailutna ding,
Lung thengtah ka thum’e, kei neihin pen ;
Nang ka ngai cheh na din,
Lungtheng, lungnem neipen ;
Ha ngaitah-a, ka ngai nadin.

songs.title: 57. CHOLNGAH NA MUN NOMTAH AUM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Cholngah n mun nom tah aum,
Luigal gammon a chun,
Jan muthim beina kalchung peh a khun,
Tohgim lhiso nabei.

Chorus
Neilam ton neina lamton,
Chuni jing a niso vahhoi em a chun,
Neilam ton neina lamton,
Luigal a gammon hoitah vah jinga chun.

Verse 2
Khopi hoitah vah jing jeng chu,
Anop je seithei lou,
Chu a lut jousen Leng chu amu ding,
Akom a cheng jing ding.

Verse 3
Lallukhuh chu koisa ahi,
Christaâ€™n eipeh diu chu,
Thohhat na ahung ding ngah jing te chu,
Chang ding a loupina.

Verse 4
Chu gam khopi kot hoitah a,
I lut theina diuvin,
Tonsot chullou khopi nom a leng din,
Thigei in tahsan in.

songs.title: 57. KALHA LENGIN VAKHU BANGIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalha lengin vakhu bangin,
Na Lhatdamna gam gakholtan;
Khopi daiya na Lhandampu,
Setna in bom’in,
Adon ding khon chun a-ul,
Thisanin alonsah;
Lungset thuh-in pon nem’in,
A-ul thisan chu ga-theh-in;
Tu geiyin milungset Pakai,
Alungsetna sumilte chu,
Ana hamsah kit’un ahi;
Nahamna aw hung kithong hen,
Adinguva nalungsetna,
Namtin hetthei din.
“Kacha kathohna isahlouvin,
Um hih-in ana ngeiye;
Ka thisan longdoh chu,
Hinna thao namtui ahi”
Lhagao lengvaite lut’un;
Tin Eilhandampun aseiye.

Verse 2
Vetan khopi sunga mipi,
I-louva kichom khom hiuvam?
Panpi neilou Kelngoinou,
Melmaten akaiyun;
Taitomna lal pon le ling,
Lukhuh akhuhpeh-un,
Calvary lhang lam jonin;
Hoiba ham nalukhuh chu,
Van thuneina Lallukhuh chu;
Tunla ling lukhuh nakhuh tan,
Ka loupina kavan in chu;
Ka ngaiye nang lungsetna in,
Vantilten eivahchoina a,
Khah tai nasetnan.

Verse 3
Set pohna Cross angah jouvin,
Achunga thih-in khenbeh-un;
Alu ngapna mun sun,
Sapsetna thing chung ahi,
Ni thim hen lang lingpi,
Kihot hen songpi keh hen;
Set pomang Pa tha le jung,
Achat tai alu kunin;
Gel’in Pa le van mite lung,
Pakai jona kipa piuvin;
Ken jong kagel le kamaiya,
Kipah in lungset lhi along;
Tun nagenthei nalengvaina
Nei musah kit’in.

songs.title: 57. PAKAI JESU LENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. s. (Psalms 73:24)

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu Leng hatchungnung,
Na thahat chu hin phongin ;
Thilha kihou sumang soh in,
Vannoi gam losoh loijin,
Agam tin’a Pakai Jesu vaihomin. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Nangma khovah dihtah nahi,
Sumang soh-in muthim gam ;
Chonphatna Lhagao Theng homin,
Hiche leiset gam chunga ;
Vannoi mite huhhingin Pakai Jesun. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Kipana hinna Thupha hin,
Sumang soh hen satan gam ;
Vannoi leiset michonseten,
Sochatna Thupha mu hen ;
Huhhing molson nalhen chom Nangma ngaite. (2 vei)

Verse 4
Hat le loupina Nangma a,
Tonsot hatna Nangma a ;
Van le leiset Leng hat chungnung,
Hiche Leng jou ding koi ham ?
Huhhung soh-in na leiset sema mite. (2 vei)

songs.title: 58. JESUN NEI CHINGUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat m. (Psalms 23:1)

Verse 1
Jesun neichingun neihoiyun,
Nei hoiyun nakam damin ;
Nanga kon chonphat neihil’un,
Neivah-un Lhagao Thengin ;
Pakai Jesun neiching jingun,
Na lhatsa Nanga kahi.

Verse 2
Nanga kahiuve nei chingun,
Ka lampiu neihil jingun ;
Nei huhdoh-un chonset’a kon,
Nei hol’un ka man tengu ;
Pakai Jesu nunnom Jesu,
Ngailhi jingin ka taonau.

Verse 3
Nangman lange tia nei tepsau,
Michonse hijong lengu ;
Nei lhatun nei huhhing tauve,
Thenna ding le hoina din ;
Pakai Jesu, nunnom Jesu,
Nang lama kalung heiyin.

Verse 4
Nei holsah-un nei lungsetnau,
Nei heiyun nacham tah-in ;
Pakai Nang bou ka sochatnau,
Cheng jingin ka lunguva ;
Pakai Jesu, nunnom Jesu,
Nei lungsetna chu molson.

songs.title: 58. MOULANG LE MOUNU KILAMTONA (Kilakhom)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mounu :
Chun le jo laijon thong nusen,
Nang kahin jon’e;
Nalungset ngeh-in ka hunge,

Chorus
Nakotpi phunga.
Ka hung’e (2) potdoh kit lou din,
Thinan eikhen masangsen;
Nangma mi hinge.

Verse 2
Michom :
Najah lou ham, mikhat in nakot akiuve (2)
Aw i-lou donbut lou nahim?
Mi khat’in nakot akiuve.

Verse 3
Moulang :
Koi nahim ka in hinjon’a kotpi phunga ding,
Koi nahim kakot kiuva o-nemheucha eikou;
Hung kiseiyin koicha koinao nahim hung kiseiyin,
Aw nem jaidam’in hung kiseiyin kot hon’inge;
Mi khat’in ka kotpi phunga,
Aw nem heuchan eikouve.

Verse 4
Mounu :
Leiset gou thil loupi jouse,
Chun le jo laijon;
Hicheng sangin nang ka ngailun,
Nang kahin bel’e.
Ka hung’e (2) potdoh kitlou din,
Thinan eikhen masangsen;
Nangma mi hing’e.

Verse 5
Moulang :
Koi nahim nakisei loule kot kihon lou ding,
Tutah-a hoiya hungkon hoikom jon ding nahim?
Kiseiyin kamou nahile kotpi hon peh nange,
Koi nahim nakisei loule kot kihon lou ding;
Mi khat’in ka kotpi phunga,
Aw nem heuchan eikouve.

Verse 6
Michom :
Namou hinte mikhat’in nakot akiuve (2)
Aw i-lou donbut lou nahim;
Mikhat in nakot akiuve.

Verse 7
Mounu :
Nakotpi kei neihon’in lang,
Namou dei kahi;
Na-mi hingting naphung longe,
Nakotpi nei honin.
Ka hung’e (2) potdoh kit lou din,
Thinan eikhen masangsen;
Nangma mi hing’e.

Verse 8
Moulang :
Kamou nahile hung lut’in kotpi kahon’e,
Lungset khoto deitah-in nang din kot kahon’e;
Kamou nahile hungtan kipah tah-in lem inge,
Kipana golvah nang dinga gotsa ahitai.
Mounu dinga kot hon phat :
Tun ka mutai kadei lungset,
Ka vahchoiye chung Pathen.

Verse 9
Moulangin mipi akouna :
Kipa golvahna a lha din;
Khanghoi gol le pai ngai chullou;
Kipan ka lamtouve hi-a,
Naban jet kasang’ui.
Vangphat channi hihen tonsot,
Kilungsetnan, Christan eikankhom’ui.
Aw sopite namin cheh-un,
Kasam thei poi O-so khat’in;
Nabon chauvin Christa lungset,
Chang jingun, aw Amen.

Verse 10
Mipin adonbutna :

Verse 1
Kipa kouna awnem kajai,
Mit muphah lou gam’a konin;
Chung Pathen phatthei boh hihen,
Lung’a chamna leng hen.
Nom hen (2) Kipa golvah,
Lha nunnom hen;
Pakaiyin hamphat hen.

Verse 2
Mai lhaisel’a nei lemnau o,
Kajah-in kipanan eiloi;
Kipa nopna halna leng hen,
Chamnan jingvai hom hen.

Verse 3
Kigom :
Chung Pathen nang kavahchoiyui,
Kipa thanop konna nahi;
Kilungsetna hin khansah-in,
Det hen hinlai sungin.

songs.title: 58. PATHEN IN VANNOI LEISET MITE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen in vannoi leiset mite ho angailui,
Achapa Jesu Christa eipeuve.
Vannoi mite le Pathen kicham na
Leng Palai chu,
Vannoi themmo na achapan asem.
Tun eiho mopohna ahi Leng Palai,
Pathen ngailut lungmon na
Hepha lou ingaiteu muntin a,
Um amaho gasei peh ding,
Christa Leng Palai natong ute.

Verse 2
Pathen in ami huhhingna le lung monna thua,
Alhacha natong din ei ngan seuve,
Muntin ningtin gamtin a
Christa Thupha pole din,
Nangho cheuvin tin eiho eisol ui.

Verse 3
Corinth nina bung nga
Chang somni na sunga chun,
Christa Leng Palai nahi eitiuve,
Pathen le ahelou te ho kah a chamna leng a,
Pang ding chu khangdong teho ihiuve.

songs.title: 59. AW LOUPI PEN HALLELUJAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
O Loupi pen Hallelujah,
Ka vahchoiye Immanuel,
Vahchoi na le Lalna jouse,
Tonsot in Nanga ahiye.
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Amen. (2)

Verse 2
Vannoi mihem nam jousen jong,
Vantil te toh lung khat in long
Neilhatnau Na thisan jalâ€™in,
Salem thah tolâ€™a kaleng khom.

Verse 3
O iti giltam na lungthim,
Iti santam nalungset na,
Lhatheng leiya leng aw ngeite,
Le van paovin seiphong joulou.

Verse 4
O neihilâ€™in gilâ€™a sanje,
Gankong le sapsetna thing chu,
Vanâ€™a Lallukhuh toh kijomâ€™
Lei Eden le Salem thah jong.

songs.title: 59. HINTWI PUTNA CROSS PHUNGA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. m. (Eph. 3:23)

Verse 1
Hintwi putna Cross phungah,
Nei koiyin Jesun kei ;
Man beiya peh hinna le,
Damna lui alonge.

Chorus
Cross phungah, Cross phungah,
Ka loupina hi hen ;
Ka thokit ka kaltou man,
Luigal vangam nom ah.

Verse 2
Ka toh-e Cross phungah chun,
Lungset le sochatna ;
Chua um Jing valpa chun,
Keima eisal vah-e.

Verse 3
Tun ka ume Cross phungah,
Phattheina kim neipen ;
Nei kaihoiyin nitinin,
Nei koiyin nalim ah.

Verse 4
Ka kat jinge Cross phungah,
Eilungset kinemin ;
Ka galkai ka kaltou man,
Nopna van gam nom ah.

songs.title: 59. NAZARETH JESU UMCHAN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nazareth Jesu umchan thu,
Gelnan kalung akidang;
Ading gelnan alungkham poi,
Chonse thenglou keima din.

Chorus
Aw itobang la ngeiyin ka-Pakai,
Ka vahchoi tadem?
Aman eilungsetnau gam nom,
Em’a kalhun teng chule.

Verse 2
Kei jeh in honna ataove,
Apa lung chamma chon din;
Ading gelnan alungkham poi,
Kei din athisan along.

Verse 3
Ka chonset kalung gentheina,
Apon Calvary lhanga;
Genthei jachat thoh-in athi,
Gamnom kalhun theina din.

Verse 4
Ka lhagao ahuhdoh jan chun,
Van gamnom em’a konin;
Avantilte hung kikhom’un,
Alungdonna lhem dam din.

songs.title: 60. KA LHAGAO NGAILUA JESU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat m. (Psalms 9:9)

Verse 1
Ka lhagao ngailua Jesu,
Na anga um ka nom’e ;
Ka vella twiso laisen,
Khopi hui ahat laisen.

Chorus
Nei sellin Pakai Jesun,
Ka kichat tijat bei man ;
Nei la galkaiyin Pakai,
Lan kalha akhon ni le.

Verse 2
Kaina ding dang ken neilou,
Ka lhagao Nang jenga kai ;
Kei nei changlha lou jenin,
Neivah jingin nei ngah phan.
Ka tahsan Nang jenga um,
Nangma jeng eihuhhing thei ;
Nei lungset’in neive phan,
Na lhavingin nei hinkhun.

Verse 3
Ima jousea Nang ka ngai,
Nanga kona bou ka mu ;
Alhu jong phong dingin lang,
Ana jong damsah soh-in.
Hinna twinah Nang nahi,
Nanga kon hintwi neipen ;
Ka lung sungah lonsah-in,
Neipen hinkemlou twi chu.

songs.title: 60. SANA KHANG LEMNA.
60. VAN A CHEN DING KALUNG KINEM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Van a chen ding kalung kinem,
Adang imavang a hilou,
Jesu thisan le chonphat vang,
Jesu thisan jeng bou hinna.
Christa songpi tah a ka ding,
Mundang vang chu nel chim ahi. (2)

Verse 2
Muthim in amai asel teng,
Kalung Ama jeng a kingai,
Lungdon lengvai na jeng a jong,
Aman lung olmo lou eipei.

Verse 3
A thutep le athisan in,
Eivah jinge twisoh lai-a,
Lei le van mang jeng ta jongle,
Ama jeng a kalung kai ding.

Verse 4
Ama ahung kum kit nileh,
Ka kivon kim a A thupha,
Ka chonphat eihung toh nan tem?
A Laltouna ang a ding din.

songs.title: 61. HE SUFFERED FOR ME.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kaset jal’in aw Pakaiyin alemloi,
Athohna sei theilou agimna sei joulou;
Aw mel dei um thisan asoh jou tai.
Van Lal Leng alem’e, (2)
Amite chuna in kilna thih hem le;
Nah a hemma chu thoh in,
Lhanmol ngui ajon tai.

Verse 2
Pakai hesohna aw ngei lungset ngui chun,
Setlei athongsoh in lhagao mangsa thouvin;
Aw setna kulsunga henkol kaite jong.

Verse 3
Pakai lemna chu kolkimvel’a phongun,
Sim le mal’a min jong athohna chu heu hen;
Aw Pakai ti-in ka la’n hung lem’u hen.

Verse 4
Genthei tintang thoh-in eilhatdoh tauve,
Thisan man ihiuve setna kon lhatdamsa;
Aw Pan eiholnau gamnom eilhut tauve.

Verse 5
Ka hinna thing phung le Nang ka kipana,
Na milungset jal’in dalhang ting lei lungjin;
Aw Salem thah a sun navang nei nouvin.

songs.title: 61. HINLAI NATOH KACHAI YA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai natoh kachai a twisoh ka galkai tengle,
Jing niso loupi vahhoi chu kamu teng,
A gal langkhat kalhun teng eilhatpa chu ken he ding,
Nuiheu va eina lamto masa pen ding.

Chorus
Ken he jeng ding (2)
A lhatsa akom a kadin teng,
Ken he jeng ding (2)
A khut thingkil maha chu he ding.

Verse 2
Huhhing sa ken kipah a Pakai mai kamu tengle,
Lungsetna Amit ha hoi chu kamu ding,
Eihepi lungset ngailut iti kavahchoi tadem?
Van chunga innom gotsa eikoi peh chu.

Verse 3
Chemasa kangai ho chun hung in tin eijap jingui,
Ka kikhen nau luipang a kikhom kit din,
Eden phai hoitah a la ngei in eilamtou vinte,
Ken vang Pakai mumasah pen kanom e.

Verse 4
A khopi kot hoi a chu ponbang leh eisil peh a,
Lhiso kitlou na a chu eipui lut ding,
Tonsot kipana la chu a vahchoina kasah ding,
Keivang ka Pakai mu masah pen kanom.

songs.title: 61. KA TAHSANIN NAVEI
62. GAM THENG PENâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gamtheng penâ€™a Leng hung peng chu,
Thangvan ahsi em in ajui-e,
Miching Ama ajinte chun, Ahsi chu amuâ€™ve,
Ken jong chu ahsi em nung chu juileng,
Pakai penna Bethlehem
O Bethlehem kalhun masangsen.
Tanglouva ka che ding,
Sun ahsi em chun eipui jing inte,
Mary chiolai naosen mel, Ken kamu ding.

Verse 2
Tun Salem kho kotpi emhoi chu,
Eiho dingin ahong kittai, Manna gamthipâ€™a ana lengsa, Van gam gou loding in,
Kipah in sautÃ© Lengthah apengtai,
Leiset hi Tinsot langei-in losoh hen.

Verse 3
Koiham alemlou ding Pakai,
Van Mitheng sangjan ahinlhauve,
Pakai ngaiyin Van kho ahong tai,
Kap-in lei hin veuvin, Thangvan ahsi jeng in jong hinjuiyin, Apenna Bethlehem lhang ahin lhuttai.

Verse 4
Chung le noi mihem kidong ton,
Pakai pen thil jouse jong in phong,
Chung a cham leng noiya sochatna,
Van le lei kilol ta, Van khongpi ginghen lei hi kithing hen, Chitin namtin in Naosen Leng lemâ€™ute.

songs.title: 62. NA LALTOUNA LE LALLUKHUH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. d. (Luke 2:7)

Verse 1
Na Laltouna le lallukhuh na hin dalhan,
Na hung kumlhai hi leiset’a hin ;
Bethlehem a Nangma lhunna ding mun onglou,
Theng chungnungpen lhunna bong in.

Chorus
Hungo Pakai ka lungsungah,
Ka lunga na mun ding a ume ;
Hungo ka Pakai kalung sungah,
Na lhunna ding mun a um’e.

Verse 2
Leiset chunga gam-ui jengin jong ko anei,
Chung leng van jong gena bu anei ;
Pathen Chapan alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong,
Hinoi leiset’a ato moi.

Verse 3
Van miten la asah ding nileh van gama,
Lim tah a nahung kit ni tengleh ;
Chu ni le neikouvin, Nangma angsunga chun,
“Na mun ding aume” nei tin.
Pakai, ka lha kipah lheh ding,
Nangman chutia neikou ni tengle ;
Pakai ka lhagao kipah lheh ding,
Nangman chutia neikou ni leh.

songs.title: 62. THE MARVELLOUS LOVE OF GOD.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathenin eilungsetnau hi,
Aw iti kidan’a kidang hitam;
Hetphah lou thugil kidang hi.

Verse 2
Eilhatdam tai tonsot a din,
Eithensah tai tonsot a din;
I-lou kei nei musah lou ham?

Verse 3
Chitin namtin asang ajan,
Ngailut lungset khoto na in;
Mang theilou mihem hetphah lou.

songs.title: 63. CHONSE KAHI PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonse kahi Pkai nei ngaidam in,
Thupha kahin choiye nakeng bulâ€™a.
Ka velâ€™a Na um lou le
Leiset keidia thina,
Van jong kaka na gam ding,
O nei umpin lang.

Verse 2
Monna ding dang umlou hi leiset a,
Nangma bou ka lumdal dougal ang ah.

Verse 3
Gamthip a sottah kava mang nung hin,
Na aw kajan tuhin kahung naiye.

Verse 4
Tuhin Pakai nangin nei sil theng in,
Nagam thengâ€™a din melma dou tange

songs.title: 63. ONLY IN THEE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Zion lhang le van ahsi hoi,
Pakai sem kei dinga;
Ajoule chu mun kalhun teng,
Ka kipana pah ding.

Chorus
Aw iphat hintem tu-a eidal,
Thisan jal’a ka din Zion lhang;
Aw itih le kahin muta dem,
Lhandampu le gam nilhum louna.

Verse 2
Tu hin setto Jordan luikam,
Ka ngah-e Lhandampu;
Chu ahsi kal olna mun chu,
Itih le ka lhung dem!

Verse 3
Phat homin chen Zion chate,
Gam loupi i-ngah lel;
Ka lenna mun gamthip ahi,
Ken dalha loi tange.

Verse 4
Aw galjou Lal Immanuel,
Agam kalhun phat teng;
Lungsetna Lal ponhoi sil’a,
Tonsotna kalen ding.

songs.title: 63. PAKAI NA NATOH HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Heb. 2:2)

Verse 1
Pakai na natoh hi,
Hin suhal kit’in lang ;
Na na tongte thahat hinpen,
Na hatna kilang hen.

Chorus
Pakai na natoh hi,
Hin suhal kit in lang ;
Hung kumlhan lang tha nei peuvin,
Phattheina hin bung lhan.

Verse 2
Pakai na na tongte,
Sei themna tha pen lang ;
Gamtin lhagao huhhing nau hen,
Na mintheng loupi hen.

Verse 3
Pakai mijouse lung,
Hin suhal soh keiyin ;
Nangma mi lungsetna heu hen,
Lungsetna mei kong hen.

Verse 4
Pakai halna hin lhan,
Pentecost ni hinlhan ;
Nangma mintheng chu loupi hen,
Vahchoiyin umjing hen.

songs.title: 64. ADORING THE BABY
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mitin namtin in vahchoiyun,
Lem’uvin naosen Lhandampu;
Kipahna sauvin,
Sauvin aw ngeiyin.

Verse 2
Choiyun choiyun Lhandampu chu,
Ahung penge Bethlehem’a;
Ga vetauvin Naosen chu,
Gan ankong sunga.
}2
}2

Verse 3
Anu Mary’n aphei chunga,
Apom’e Naosen Lhandampu;
Michingte le mithengten,
Aga lem’uve.

Verse 4
Miching mitheng Vantil bangin,
Nangma jong chen lang galem’in;
Leiset hinlai dam sungin,
Lem’un na Lhan’pu.

Verse 5
Chungnung pen’a loupi jing hen,
Noi leiset’a minthang jing hen;
Chung le noiya kithang hen,
Amin tonsot in.

songs.title: 64. ATEH AKHANG IBONCHAUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl
(Eph. 3:19)

Verse 1
Ateh akhang ibonchauvin,
Jesu vahchoi la saute ;
Eihuhhing isochat jal’un,
Jesu vahchoila saute.

Chorus
Lunglhai sel’in la ngeitah in,
Jesu vahchoi la saute ;
Lunglhai sel’in la ngei saute,
Jesu vahchoi la saute.

Verse 2
In’a i-nom um kom jongle,
Jesu vahchoi la saute.
Lamlhah, khomol, khol le tol a,
Jesu vahchoi la saute.

Verse 3
In theng kipah a ikai teng,
Jesu vahchoi la saute;
Kikhoppi le chang lhatna jong,
Jesu vahchoi la saute.

Verse 4
Set tona le phattheina jong,
Jesu vahchoi la saute;
Ahao, avai, gentheiten jong,
Jesu vahchoi la saute.

songs.title: 64. JINGKAH NILHAH SUN IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jingkah nilhah sun in theo hite muchi pha,
Kehdoh ding aphat cha itohgim nau chu,
Chang at phat ngah ingting chang kikhop jou tengle,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah a.
Pathen Hou-in a (2)
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah a.

Verse 2
Theute nisa noija theute van nim noija,
Phalbi dap le gojuh ding jong ging lou vin,
Chang akikhop soh a kana toh kachai teng,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah a.

Verse 3
I mitlhi long jongle tu hite Pakai din,
Gim le genthei thoh in lou neipu ding in,
I natoh ijouva Aman eikou teng le,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanaom tah a.

songs.title: 65. NEI UMPIN TUNI LHAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nei umpin tunilhah kho thim kon hin,
Mu athimtai Pathen in nei umpin,
Panpi bei a ka lung olthei louteng,
Panpi ngaite panpin kei nei umpin.

Verse 2
A kem baiye ka hinkho chomcha hi,
Leiset loupi le nop kem mangsoh ding,
Thil jouse akem mangthei cheh ahi,
Kikhel lou Pathen in kei nei umpin.

Verse 3
Nangma chu ken nitin in ka ngai-e,
Eilhem a hatna a jong nei umpin,
Nang bang a lam eihil thei dang umlou,
Ka nopna kagim na a nei umpin.

Verse 4
Nangman nei umpi le kei olmo lou,
Gim thohlel na lhiso na ging talou,
Thina le lhankhuh iti hat jong le,
Nei umpi le kaki chat umlou ding.

Verse 5
Ka thi jongle ka komâ€™a nei umpin,
Muthim lah a lam neihil jing jeng in,
Jing khovah teng Van gam kalhun na din,
Kahin kathin kakomâ€™a nei umpin.

songs.title: 65. PAKAI JESU KEN NANG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. d. (Psalms 145:18,19)

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu ken Nang ka kai,
Nei huhhing loule kei kathi ;
Sochatna hinna ka thum’e,
Neilan iti jong leng.
Neilan iti jong leng, (2 vei)
Jesu Christa thi man jeh chun ;
Neilan iti jong leng.

Verse 2
Lungdong le themmo kei kahi,
Ka dinga na thisan long chun ;
Athah in neisem kit’in lang,
Neilan iti jong leng.

Verse 3
Kinepna neilou ka hitai,
Ka kiholna ka sukhel tai ;
Nei huhhingin nei lungset in,
Neilan iti jong leng.

Verse 4
Na banjet chun neipom jingin,
Na lungdei bangin nei chingin ;
Nalung chamtah in nei heiyin,
Neilan iti jong leng.

songs.title: 65. PRAISE YE THE NEW BORN KING.
66. ALL HAIL THE POWER OF JESUS NAME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat s. (Rev. 19:16)

Verse 1
Jauvin Jesu min choi annun,
Van min achoi anne ; (2 vei)
Leng jouse Leng, lal jouse Lal,
Lemun (5 vei) leng jouse Leng.

Verse 2
Lem’uvin Pathen martar ten,
Alhatsa mitheng ten ; (2 vei)
Jesu loupina choi annun.
Lemun (5 vei) leng jouse Leng.

Verse 3
Israel chate a um sunin,
Lhomcha hijong leu chun ; (2 vei)
Lungset’a na huhhing Pau chu,
Lemun (5 vei) leng jouse Leng.

Verse 4
Sumil lou jen’un gentile ten,
Thisana na Lhatpau ; (2 vei)
Akho muh a kuncheh un lang,
Lem’un (5 vei) leng jouse Leng.

Verse 5
Chitin, namtin le phung tinin,
Paotinin choi annun ; (2 vei)
Chung le noi Pakai Leng chungnung,
Lem’un (5 vei) leng jouse Leng.

songs.title: 66. NI LUOPI HUNG LHUN DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ni loupi hunglhun ding ni anai tai,
Chamna Lengpa le lhatsa goldei te,
Thangvan jol a khongpi le baza thon,
Eihin kou ding lhatsa goldei ten.

Chorus
Gel jingin Ni loupi
Phasa dem in um un lang,
Laltouna theng a ding ding in,
Pakai na tong cheh ute.

Verse 2
Malaiya Noah damlai nikho chu,
Geldoh uvin lang setna dalhau vin,
Hung mang in tin ichennau gamlui hi,
Namtin Jordan lui galkai tante.

Verse 3
Chu gam loupi chu a hunglhun teng le,
Leiya lhenchomte lhatdam changta ding;
Lungsonna le kana kinem sen tin,
Lhatdam changte kilengkhom soh ding.

Verse 4
Leiya lhenchom chate geljing uvin,
Chugam loupi hung lhun na ding ni chu;
Leng jouse Leng le Pakai chungnung chu,
Damlaiyin lem’ute Leng Christa.

songs.title: 66. SETGAL DOUNAN AW VAN LENGPA CHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Setgal dounan aw van Lengpa chun,
Ling lukhuh akhuh ding lungin gel’in;
Lungdongin Pa henga taovin,
A-ul thisan’in alongin Gethsemani a,
A Lengpau man’un Israelten.
Lunglhai talou, lunglhai talou,
Israelte lunglhai talou;
Achunga themmo achan’un mipin thu atan,
Pilat’in athutan le kit’in.

Verse 2
A Lengpau kaiyun Israelten,
Calvary lhang chunga akhenbeh-un;
Achun lengtheinu Mary chun,
Atoipah donglai atan chu laina ngeiyinte o;
Lalna gam chajou i-Pakai chu.

Verse 3
Lungdon lungjin lhanthimpi sunga,
Pakai nunnem Lhagao ache ni chun;
Jerusalem Hou-in thenga,
Ponjal loupi laiya lhangta sitlei kithingin;
Mitheng lhagao chu hinle kit’in.

Verse 4
Phat alhing setgal douna bangta,
Vannoi leiset Pakai le Christa gam;
Chonset gallen ajousoh tai,
Athisan lu’n gam alotai Calvary lhanga;
Hichun champi hin Pakai mel’a.

songs.title: 67. AW CHUNG VALPA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw van Lhagao Theng mei le meibanga lamkai,
Lal Immanuel hung nai kit’in;
Leiset gamthip mun kalen lai hin,
Hungvah kit in chunga Valpa;
Ahsi em hoitah chu.
Aw chung valpa (2) emhoi,
Eilhandampu le ka Pakai deipen nahi;
Lungdon twipi nongin gal hunglen jeng jongle,
Hinna Pakai kabel ding tonsot’a.

Verse 2
Van Jerusalem kotpi ahon tengule,
Langkachah tol laiya kalen ding;
Kaset jal’a lungdonna jouse hi,
Gamloupi kalhunna a chun,
Pahbang a pah jing ding.

Verse 3
Kelngoinou lalna gam nilhum ngailouna a,
Che masa golten leiset ngailou;
Kelngoinou alemnauvin asauve,
Hinna thinglim noiya pon bang,
Leh sil’in alengui.

songs.title: 67. GAL ALEN E LEISET A HIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gal alenâ€™e leiset a hin,
Satan gal a nitin in ahung len jinge,
Na Lhaagao va neipui lou chun,
Namin ngei Pakai ken pan ngam jilou ding.

Chorus
Malai Themgao te napui bang chun,
Na Lhagao vin neivon in lang,
Tahsan in namel neimu sah in,
Kipah a Na min vahchoi ding.

Verse 2
Calvary lhang chunga Pakai,
I set jal in lungdon genthei tintang athoh,
Along donna suhmil hoilou,
Set jal in O alungdin na imil joutai.

Verse 3
Nei ngaidam in Pakai Jesu,
Keiman na lungdonna sumil helta jong leng,
Nangbou ka ngailut pen Nahi,
Ka ngai ngeije Pakai namel neimu sah in.

Verse 4
Na gam tungdoh ding in Pakai,
Na lhat sate set soh akon puidoh dingin,
Set gallen jong doukit ding in,
Ka pang jinge Immanuel nei lamkai in.

songs.title: 67. THISIM KIDANG KEN LAN SANGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. flat m. (Psalms 89:1)

Verse 1
Thusim kidang ken lan sange,
Ka dinga Christa thi chu ;
A van innom ahin dalhan,
Calvarya ahung thi tai.

Chorus
Athusim kidang lan sange,
Ka dinga Christa thi chu ;
Vahchoiyun mithengte jousen,
Vahchoiyun eihuhhing nau.

Verse 2
Amangsa ei holdoh kit tai,
A kelngoi kei vahmangsa ;
Eipom’e lungsetna ban chun,
A lampia eilepui tai.

Verse 3
Tun jong thimin eium jinge,
Lung genthei katoh jinge ;
Ahin Jesun ei umpi nai,
Akhut tenin eikai lei.

Verse 4
Ka leiset hinkho lhin kahsea,
Eiching jing jeng ding Aman ;
Chule van’a eipuitou ding,
Ka ngai chengtoh cheng khom ding.

songs.title: 68. JESU MIN KIVOP JING IN LANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
I ngai Pakai Jesu min,
Na che na hungle na chanâ€™a,
Sumil hih in A min ngei.

Chorus
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jing in na lung in,
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jing in niseh in.

Verse 2
Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
Ama chu lum in sung in,
Na chang a nava le na a,
A ma min in tao jing in.

Verse 3
Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
Hoichan a che jong le chun,
A sei thu kigel jingle chun,
Na lung mong jing jeng tante.

Verse 4
Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
Hoichanâ€™a umjong le chun,
A thutep theng a kinem in,
Lhaso hih in Amintheng

songs.title: 68. NO WEEPING YONDER (L.Th. 172)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka le mao um ngailou lungdonna jousohta,
Van Salem khopi a lengte ho chun;
Setna gal jousoh-un thina gingta louvin,
Aw vahchoina la sauvin.

Verse 2
Hi leiset kavet le lungdon meiyin akhui,
Lungdon lungjinna noiya umte ho;
I-kipalai niu hi hung mang loi ding ahi,
Aw ol gam ka ngai ngeiye.

Verse 3
Aw thisan jal’in khopi nom chu neilhut’in,
Luigal gam gol ngaite kimna gam’a;
Nei puilut in van mithengte lenna gam’a,
Aw len ka nomta ngeiye.

Verse 4
Salem thah nom’a chun len kanom tangeiye,
Van mithengte ho le lhatsate chun;
Laltouna kimvel’un pachat la asauve,
Aw Hallelujah tiuvin.

songs.title: 68. VAHCHOI CHEH UN EIHUHHINGPU!
69. I’LL ARISE GOT TO MY FATHER. (L. Th. 154)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thouvin kating ka-Pa koma chekit tange,
Kama meipi bangin ajing;
Eilungset ding dang kanei lou leisetna hin,
Ka-Pa lou chu ka dougal jeng.

Chorus
Setnan nusate jong leng,
Aphatna chul ngailou;
Kisih a kahol kit le,
Alim’a leng kit ding.

Verse 2
Ka-Pa in’a ninglhing set’a sum le sel um,
Milengvaite anem jinge;
Kei gonggoh le gilkel thoh-a thi ding kahi,
I-lou gentheiya kava lem!’

Verse 3
Aw akom’a kachen lai chu iti noptam,
Leiya nopna jouse akim;
Tun kagel le ka-Pa inpi ka ngai jeng tai,
Thupha choiyin jon kit tange.

Verse 4
Kei michonset sei ngailou le Pathen jalou,
Ka dinga mun eiphal peh le;
Hi leiset pah kamelma hi ngaikit ponge,
Apal lai ni achom taloi.

songs.title: 69. PAKAI JESU EIHUHHINGPA NAMIN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Ka Pakai Jesu eihuhhingpa namin,
Vannoi leiset miten ja cheh hen ;
Na mi semte na itna le chuna in,
Vannoi leiset min nahung penge.

Chorus
Pakai Jesu eihuhhingpa,
Nangma bou hinna le damna ;
Na mintheng chungnung,
Pakai ho Pakai, leng ho Leng hat chungnung.

Verse 2
Leiset mihem van mi achan ding deinan,
Nangma leiset min nahung penge ;
Vana kemlouva atha olna dingun,
Nangman chol tintang nahung thoh-e.

Verse 3
Amaho tonsot’a anopna dingun,
Gim le genthei tin nahung thoh-e ;
A gilkel kit louna dingun kel le chah,
Nathoh in najon tai Golgotha.

Verse 4
A thi kit louna dingu le tonsot’a,
Hin kemlou anei theina dingun ;
Kem louva ahin jingna dingun Nangma,
Calvary Cross chunga nahung thi.

songs.title: 69. PAKAI VAHCHOI NAN KEN LAN SANGE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai vahchoi nan ken lan sange,
Kakam le kalung thong ting,
Eingailut kidang chu vahchoi nan,
Sang e a vahchoi la.

Chorus
Kachonset jouse apo mang tai,
Amin theng loupi vahchoi la sange,
Kachonset jouse apo mang tai,
Halleluyah Amin in.

Verse 2
Ka hunge ka chonset poh pum in,
Aman olna kim eipei,
Eilhat doh jeh chun a vahchoi la,
Tanglou in ken sange.

Verse 3
Aheng kalhun teng kei bit kei-a,
Aman eihon bit kei-a,
Ken hasah cheh ding a vahchoi la,
Tonsot gei a sa ding.

songs.title: 70. HALLELUJAH AMEN. (L. Th. 114)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw loupi pen Hallelujah,
Ka vahchoiye Immanuel;
Vahchoina le lalna jouse,
Tonsot’in Nanga ahiye.
Hallelujah, Hallelujah Amen,
Hallelujah, Hallelujah Amen.

Verse 2
Vannoi mihem nam jouse jong
Vantilte to lung khat’in long;
Nei lhatnau nathisan jal’in,
Salem thah tol’a kaleng khom.

Verse 3
Aw iti giltam nalung thim,
Iti san tam nalungsetna;
Lhatheng leiya leng aw ngeite,
Le van paovin seiphong joulou.

Verse 4
Aw nei hil’in gil’a sanje,
Gan kong le sapsetna thing chu;
Van’a Lallukhuh to kijom,
Lei Eden le Salem thah jong.

songs.title: 70. JESUN EINGAILUT AKIDANG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. s.

Verse 1
Jesun ei ngailut akidang,
Leiset mihemte dingin ;
Chungnungpen vahchoi nan saute,
Sau hite avahchoi la.

Chorus
Van gam ilhun tengu leh,
Iti kipa thanop a um tadem ;
Jesu imu teng leh,
Gal jo la sa i-ao le diu.

Verse 2
Ei holnau vangam em nom chu,
I chenna dingu ahi ;
Chenna innom eigot peh ui,
Tonsot’a chulta lou ding.

Verse 3
I mauva toh man koisa um,
Manoute kipa man chu ;
Toh gimna ichai teng amel,
Loupitah chu imu diu.

Verse 4
Songmantam kotpi ahon teng,
Van khopi sung nom em chu ;
Chu-a eiho inom lendiu,
Chung van tolpia ilen diu.

songs.title: 70. PAKAI AWGIN KHU NGAI UVIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai awgin khu ngai uvin,
Leiset a miten,
Ahung na ding ni anaitai,
Itoh gau kim lou.
Hung tei ding (2)
Van huikong theng chunga,
Aloupi aphon kichai ni teng.

Verse 2
Aman a lhenchom te apui,
Touni teng chule,
A dalhah te chengse vang chu,
Gim genthei thoh ding.

Verse 3
Damun meidil a umte chu,
Kum sangsom sangja,
Lung genthei na thoh lhum soh ding,
Hin ding go jongleu.

Verse 4
Van gou lo ding chengse vangchu,
A emsel a um,
Pa lunglhai na umjou lou ding,
I toh gau kim lou.
.

songs.title: 71. BEYOND LIVES TEMPTEOUS WAVES (L. Th. 66)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai luipi kinong gal lam’a chun,
Ka lungdei gam emhoi chu aum;
Ka ngahlel ngeiye Lhandampu lenna,
Nom lenkhom ding lhatdam ngaite to.

Chorus
Nei lhut’in lang aw Pakai dei um,
Lily pahna namun theng hoi chu;
Aw itih le kei jong kalhung dem?
Lhandampu mun sem kikhen louna.

Verse 2
Kangai lheh-e Pakai lunghel ni hin,
Lungset’in chu gam nei musah-in;
Aw hung emsel’in kalung sunga hin,
Chuteng lengthei ken ka bang tange.

Verse 3
Tuhin eingah jing’ui kagol ngaiten,
Lhandampu lenna Zion a chun;
Aw itih le kei jong kaga lhung dem?
Dei cheng to kikhen louna jaiyin.

Verse 4
Nei hung puiyin lang aw Lhandampu,
Ka maona gamthip muna konin;
Jon jinging ting kelngoinou Leng lenna,
Aw kikhen louna tonsot Khol mun.

songs.title: 71. CALVARY A NA LUNGSET NA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary a nalungset na chun,
Chansoh loihen leiset le gamtin a,
Nangma lhatsa lei mihem te,
Thina sapset lah a leng un.

Chorus
Pakai Jesu Na loupina le ngailutna,
Thangsoh loihen chitin lah a,
Mihem lungsung setna lemsa,
Na min loupi vahchoi lan sauhen.

Verse 2
Ka gam lungdon lungjin akon hin,
Koiham Pakai gache a huhdoh ding,
Sim le mal a Nangma min ngei,
Kithopi ding dang umlou hel.

Verse 3
Leiset chonset hi meipi bang in,
Ahung jinge Pakai kalung sunga,
Hin semhoh in Van meikong chun,
Nang din pahbang in pah inge.

Verse 4
Ka kap e Pakai na gam ngai in,
Tonsot gam le lungset te lenna chu,
I tih le lungdon le ham na,
Pel a mitlhi long ahul dem?

songs.title: 71. EILHATPAU VAHCHOI LA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl
(Psalms 19:14)

Verse 1
Eilhatpau vahchoi la sange,
Ei ngailutna kidang chu ;
Cross mun khoh chunga athoh e,
Setna kon eilhat dohnan.

Chorus
Eilhatpau vahchoi la sauvin,
Eilhat’ui athisanin ;
Cross chunga chun eingaidam tai;
Bat sa-lhan ei onsah tai.

Verse 2
Sei leng’e athu kidang chu,
Amangsa eihuhdoh chu ;
Ami lungset mong neilou chun,
Man beiyin eilhatdoh tai.

Verse 3
Eilhatpa vahchoi la sange,
A van mi ngailutna chu ;
Thina konin eilhatdoh tai,
Pathen Chapa thengtah chun.

songs.title: 72. NA MI NGAILUTJE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. m. (John 3:14)

Verse 1
Na mi ngailut je kahet,
Masangin ka Pakai ;
Nangma mi lungset nachu,
Kana notthap hel’e.

Chorus
Halleluiyah ! lungsetna,
Eikipe manbeiya ;
Amintheng hi loupi hen,
A thisana eilhat.

Verse 2
Chonset thimpi jing lah a,
Lamvaiya amangsa ;
Lungmonna ken nei talou,
Tun hinna ka chang tai.

Verse 3
Nangman nei ngailut jeh in,
Hin kemlou kachang tai ;
Nangman nei lungset jeh in ;
Lhatdamna kachang tai.

songs.title: 72. PEACE ON EARTH (L. Th. 67)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiya ahung peng van Lal chungnungpen,
Vantil’in achoi an’ui kipa la loupin;
Chungnung pen’a loupi pen hen,
Lei mite din chamna leng hen atiuvin.

Chorus
Aw van’a vantil la saho chun,
Bethlehem vel athong soh-e;
Akipanau la awnem chun,
Immanuel Lenglen chungnungpen hen atiuvin.

Verse 2
Chamna lengpa thengpen apeng tai,
David chilhah ahsi em hi tonsot’a ding;
Tonsot’a leng chang jing tading,
Amin loupi tonsot’a vahchoi ding.

Verse 3
Aw vantil thengten sakit tem’un,
Bethlehem dai gam mun’a ka um lai hin;
Agin ngei le athong ho chun,
Kalung sunga kumkhon cheng hen tiuvin.

songs.title: 72. TWIKHANGLEN PANGA INVAH KISONG BANG IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Twikhanglen panga invah kisong bang in,
Vah in muthim lah a chonse te mudin,
Nalung kot hong in kithopi hung nante.
Vahsah in Pathen thu chu (3)
Na thaomei avah lai hin kitheh ngim in,
Vahsah in Pathen thu chu.

Verse 2
Kong sesa bang in mi tamtah aumtai,
Muntinâ€™a mihem set thim noiyah aum,
Hil leuvin settona muntinâ€™a umho.

Verse 3
Navah emhoi chu lo khukhum lou jen un,
Navah chu mite muthei din koisang in,
Salvah in jan muthim phatthei nang chang ding.

Verse 4
Na hinkho beikah in Christa din tong in,
Christan nangma â€œHung inâ€ tia nakou tengle,
Hiche leiset mun hi jot kit pon nate.

songs.title: 73. CHRISTA PENNA BETHLEHEM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Christa penna Bethlehem,
Leiset Lengho lenna mun nom gam ahi,
Bethlehem chun huhhing chom louding,
Egypt gamâ€™a jamlut pitan ati e.
Hung lem cheh uvin (2)
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha
Tunin Christa apeng tai, Hung lem cheh uvin.

Verse 2
Anu le Apa komâ€™a,
Ajan mang chun Lhagao theng in lam hil in,
Herod thang chun oh lih chomlou ding,
Hung kinungle kitdan Herod thi kahsen.

Verse 3
Athi nung chun akou ve,
Hung kinungle kittan Herod athitai,
Hijong le na huhhing Lalpa chun,
A ngailut nan leiset mihem khomsoh ding.
O a ngailutna (2)
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha
Hosanna sam jing ute van le leiya.

Verse 4
Na hung penge leiset a,
Nangma Leng chan na din hinoi leiset a,
A tonsot in tonsot in Pakai,
Hijing in Pakai Hallelujah Amen.

songs.title: 73. KA LHAGAO HINNA DIN JESU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (John 15:13)

Verse 1
Ka lhagao hinna din Jesu,
Cross chunga kiphal’in athi ;
Nat athoh-e kei damna din,
Sei sangin eilungset.
A sei sangun eilungset joi, (2 vei)
Nasa tah in kei eilungset ;
Jesun eilungset’e.

Verse 2
Alung donna athoh theiyin,
Kineo sah in gim athoh-e ;
Hin kemlou inei theina din,
Sei sangin eilungset joi.

Verse 3
Jesun ilung monna dingun,
Pathen hengah eitao peh ui ;
Athisanin eilhat tauve,
Sei sangin eilungset.

Verse 4
Einai komle kalung kipah,
Olna kichat louna eipei ;
Ama a kinepna thonlou,
Sei sangin eilungset.

songs.title: 73. VANTILTEN AMA VAHCHOI DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary jona loupi chu,
Vantilten ama vahchoi ding;
Mipin jong vahchoi cheh inte,
Leiset Lhandampu thisanin;
Mimang ding lhat’in aum tai,
Melmate kichamna ahi.

Verse 2
Lhang jouse sangin Calvary,
Loupi chungnung pen’in langta;
Chu-a lhatna twi theng along,
Vannoi gam kimvel long chansoh;
Mijouse hinsah kit’inte,
Kumkhoa hintwi theng hita ding.

songs.title: 74. DINGUN DINGUN JESU DIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Nangho cross sepai te,
A Leng ponlap domsang un,
Manglou hel ding ahi.
Galjou akon galjou ding, a sepai te pui ding,
Gal jouse abeisoh a, Christa Leng chan kahsen.

Verse 2
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Sumkon gin thun chon un,
Gim genthei hahsa thoh un, a niloupi lai hin.
Tua ading bol a nangho,
Gal simsen lou sat cheng,
Lung ngamun settona jong, thahatna sumang un.

Verse 3
Dingun dingun Jesu din, Ama thahat pan un,
Tahsa khut thahat thonthei,
Nangma tha son dauvin.
Gospel galvon kivon un, kiging phan tao jing un,
Toh ding in nakou nauva,
Lhah chomna nei hih un.

Verse 4
Dingun dingun Jesu din, galsat sotta lou ding,
Tunia gal kisat kisei, jingle jo la sah ding.
Gal sat a galjou pa chu,
Hinna lukhuh chang ding,
Loupina Leng chungnung toh,
Tonsot vaihom khom ding.

songs.title: 74. MITHENG SANGSOM JAT
74. THE NEW BORN KING. (L. Th. 151)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gamtheng penna Leng hung peng chu,
Thangvan ahsi em’in ajuiye;
Miching Ama jong ajinte chun,
Ahsi chu amu’ve;
Ken jong chu ahsi em nung chu juileng,
Pakai penna kho Bethlehem eilhut ding.
Aw Bethlehem kalhun masangsea,
Tang louva kache ding;
Sun ahsi em chun eipui jinginte,
Mary choilai naosen mel ken kamu ding.

Verse 2
Ton Salem kho kotpi em hoi chu,
Eiho dingin ahong kit tai;
Manna gamthip a analengsa,
Van gam gou lo dingin;
Kipah-in saute Leng thah apeng tai,
Leiset hi tonsot la ngeiyin losoh hen.

Verse 3
Koi ham alemlou ding Pakai,
Van mitheng sangjan ahin lhauve;
Pakai ngaiyin van kho ahong tai,
Kap in lei hin veuvin;
Thangvan ahsi jengin jong hinjuiyin,
Apenna Bethlehem lhang ahinlhut tai.

Verse 4
Chung le noi mihem kidongton,
Pakai pen thil jouse jongin phong;
Chunga cham leng noiya sochatna,
Van le lei kilolta!
Van khongpi ging hen lei hi kithing hen,
Chitin namtin in naosen Leng lem’ute.

songs.title: 75. CHEN LANG NAPHAT JOUSEN TONGIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chen lang naphat jousen tongin,
Kipa nan Pa deilam bol in,
Hichu Pakai lampi ahi,
Najot lou ding ham ajui-an. (2)

Verse 2
Hinkho hoilai in chen tongin,
Seiset japi na ging louvin,
Mihem in a pachat lou chu,
Pathen pachat lou in geldan. (2)

Verse 3
Chen lang tongin toh phat ahi,
Nalung sung kipasah in lang,
Pakai in na pachat ding chu,
Gel in thanom in na tongin. (2)

Verse 4
Tong jing in chim louvin tong in,
Lhagao mang dingin lei aloi,
Vannoi gamtinâ€™a vah len lang,
Lhagao mangte chu puikhom in. (2)

Verse 5
Kipah in natoh kipa pin,
Tohgim chu olna nom ahi,
Ngaiyun jaloi ding Pakai aw,
â€œKahungeâ€ ti aw chu ngaiphan. (2)

songs.title: 75. KA KULPI NAHI O EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat s. (Psalms 31:2)

Verse 1
Ka kulpi nahi O Eilhandampu,
Ka kulpi nahi, ka kiselna ;
Ka kulpi nahi kahinna nahi,
Nang kom jenga bou umjing inge.

Chorus
Ka kulpi nahi, O Eilhandampu,
Ka gol nahi, Ka lamkai nahi ;
Nang kahinpi Eilhandampu nahi,
Kalung monpi Nang ka kiselna.

Verse 2
Ka kulpi nahi set’in eijol teng,
Ka kulpi nahi, Nang ka hoina ;
Ka kulpi nahi, kalung hesoh teng,
Ka kulpi nahi, gin kanei lou.

Verse 3
Ka kulpi nahi, set hoi dal nahi,
Ka gol ngai nahi kikhel lou ding ;
Kalung pumpi na chunga ka ngaiye.
Tahsan le mithengin nei koiyin.

Verse 4
Ka kulpi nahi, O Eilhandampu,
Namtin chitin le leng, lal jouse ;
Manghen leivuiyin lengmang jou jongle,
Ka tonsot Kulpi Nang hijing ding.

songs.title: 75. WHEN SHALL WE BEHOLD THY FACE. (L. Th. 92)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kachennau gamlui hung mang ding,
Aw itih ken kanuse dem?
Van mithengte le ka Pakai mel,
Mukal ka ngahlel.

Chorus
Aw Jerusalem dai Pakaiyin,
Lengvaiyin a-ngah;
Sapsetna thing chunga khaisangun,
Alinglukhuh to.

Verse 2
Nathohna kahil chen joulou,
Set thoinan van lal Kelngoinou;
Bethlehem khopia nahung pengin,
Bong in lham noiya.

Verse 3
Pakai Jesu kagel chim poi,
Calvary hin vejing nange;
Na gentheina vannoi setpohna,
Lunga mil lomlou.

songs.title: 76. CHAMKANG LOU NOULAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chamkang lou noulai ahitai,
Theichang na jong anoutai,
Che bang chun lhenchom te jouse,
Pakai lem ding in nou kit hen.

Chorus
Hung un gel un phat chedan hi,
Setna thisa tho phat ahitai,
Gam hung lhung ding kinem un,
Ngah jing ute phasa dem cheh in.

Verse 2
Chulthei leihao pahcha jeng jong,
Phat chomcha khat ding jeng chan,
Namtui sel in ahung pah in,
Namtin lung alhaisah soh ji.

Verse 3
Hijeh chun sopi te hung un,
Leng Chrisata lunglhai ding in,
Gunchu tah in natong ute,
Leiset hinkho abei kah in.

Verse 4
Phat loupi chu hung mang inte,
Gunchu le lung kinem in,
Hung kigon phasa dem cheh in,
Pa Laltouna theng a ding din

songs.title: 76. HALLELUJAH (L. Th. 138)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hallelujah aw Hallelujah Amen,
Calvary lungsetna thisan jal’in;
Kana gam le lungdonna janthim hi,
Nopna van gam em chun ahinsal.
Kipana chullou ding (Hallelujah 2)
Vahchoiyin um jing hen Kelngoinou chu;
Amilungsetnan lungdong anem.

Verse 2
Lha theng hung lengin kipa namtuiyin,
Leiset gamthip chunga lengte ho hin;
Pakai lemkal ngahlel Hallelujah,
Muntin naumna leijong van soh.

Verse 3
Setna chulsa leilui hi amanteng,
Hinna vah emsel van Saron pahhoi;
Aw napallai emsel hi chullou ding,
Chung le noi mithengten nang lem ding.

Verse 4
Aw leiset mi’n heu le Pakai loupi,
Van mitheng laiya lenna lhajal’in;
Calvary kelngoinou lungsetna in,
Oiyin sauvinte atonsot in.

songs.title: 76. JESUN EILUNGSET
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (John 4:19)

Verse 1
Jesun eilungset kahei,
Bible in kei eihil’e ;
Chapang hi acha ahi,
Ama hat chungnung ahi.

Chorus
Jesun ei lungset,
Jesun eilungset ;
Henge eilungset,
Bible in eihil’e.

Verse 2
Jesun kei eilungset’e,
Keima huhhing nan athi ;
Van kotpi ahong len’e,
Chapangte lutna dingin.

Verse 3
Jesun kei eilungset’e,
Keiman Ama thu ngai leng ;
Ka lut ding kathi nung le,
Van chung in nom hoi sungah.

songs.title: 77. EDEN THAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei Eden lui kanuse gam ahi,
Nitin malam kagaldot jing;
Lungdon lungjin meipin eijui jinge,
Ka-na’n hinkho hi kamang jou jitai.

Chorus
Aw Eden thah kangai tangeiye,
Nitin ka tahsanin kave jinge;
Aw til’a kagol ngai chemasate vang,
Naobang nuiyin la asauve.

Verse 2
Lunghel’a ka ka ni ka ngaito le,
Lungjin gal’a gam hoi alang;
Iti nop tantem ngai cheng tol lenna,
Immanuel Leng lalna ahi.

Verse 3
Leiset’a hin kinepna ding umlou,
Lonlhin golto eikhenji tai;
Eden thah tollaiya lengte ho chun,
Kalai bangin la asauve.

Verse 4
Ngai jeng jong leng nagam lhun masangsen,
Kagimna nikho sao lou sao;
Neiholna gamtheng nom em eilhut in,
Lengthei ka kana nuina soh hen.

songs.title: 77. SAPSETNA UMLOU PATHEN KELNGOINOU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sapset na umlou Pathen kelngoinou,
Laltouna chu aum jan aum lou,
Thaomei vah le nisa vah ngailou,
Pathen ngeitoh tonsot a vai homkhom tading.

Chorus
Amen, hungin Pakai Jesu hung in,
Pakai Jesu a milungset chun,
Mitheng te hochu umpi tau hen,
Hallelujah Amen. (2)

Verse 2
Pakai Themgao ho Lhagao Pathen chun,
Thil hunglhung ding ho chu avetsah e,
Ngaijin hungloi ding kahi tai,
Hiche thusei doh nitchan anun nom ahi.

Verse 3
Aphat chu hung lhung loi ding ahitai,
Chonpha lou chun chonphat lou boljing hen,
Mitheng ho chu theng jing u hen,
Ana umjing tau hen kahung loi ding ahi.

Verse 4
Lhagao thusei doh ho la manga achu,
Hinna thing le khopi theng a achan,
Chu Pathen in alah mang ding,
Hi thu hetsah pa chun kahung loi ding ahi.

songs.title: 77. TWI SOH LAIYA UM HITE HO KOI HAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. m.

Verse 1
Twi soh laiya um hite ho koi ham ?
Hesoh le thiding koncha um jinga ;
Huhhing ngaiya Christa kou,
Kelngoi thisanna kisop.

Chorus
Jerusalem thah kotpia chun lutjel jengun,
Kelngoi thisana kisop ;
Jerusalem thah kotpia chun lutjel jengun,
Kelngoi thisana kisop.

Verse 2
Ama hohi Pakai Jesu tahsan,
Ging tah a Pakai hil nitsoh keiya ;
Ama jenga ki ngaiya,
Kelngoi thisana kisop.

Verse 3
Leiya gim genthei hesoh thoh soh a,
Lung thengsel’a Ama lam jeng sanga ;
Tua lungmonga kicholdo,
Kelngoi thisana kisop.

Verse 4
Tun vang luigal gamnom akai soh un,
Thi le lungdon gimna a beisoh tai ;
Tonsot nopna gam kaita,
Kelngoi thisana kisop.

songs.title: 78. CHAMNA LE LUNGMON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Flat. s. (Psalms 34:2)

Verse 1
Chamna le lungmon kadin luiyin along,
Lungdon twisanglen bang jong le ;
Ka hetding dolse Nangman neihil chan chu,
A pha ta! a pha ta! ka dingin.
A pha ta, ka dingin ;
A pha ta, a pha ta, ka dingin.

Verse 2
Thupha chun ka chonset pumpi asel tai,
Cross chunga akhenbeh soh tai ;
Keiman tukal chonset po kit talou ding,
Vahchoiyin vahchoiyin ka lungin.

Verse 3
Christa chu hijing hen ka hinna bulpi,
Jordan in eiso khum jongle ;
Keima dinga olmona ding um talou,
Chamna thupha chu neihil jingin.

Verse 4
Pakai nahung kit ding ni ka ngah jinge,
Van gam nom ka hung lhun kah sen ;
Van sumkon gin le Nang O-gin ngah kahi,
Ka lha dia iti kipa um tam.

songs.title: 78. KHOTHENG NOM NEILHUT’IN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungjin kihoh-in kagam jong inge,
Leisetna hin kalha among theilou;
Pakai sem Salem thah gakhol lenge.
Aw thokitna niloupi thi le man jou,
Khotheng nom’a chun neilhut’in;
Luikam hoiya chun,
Lungjin thina jouvin ken la’n sange.

Verse 2
Ka kapme Pakai namel mulouvin,
Kalung lengin nilhum khovah joulou;
Zion kulpi hoilam’a um nahim?

Verse 3
Kholmun ni em hoi kalam muthim’a,
Hungvah-in lang Pakai ka gam mang tai;
Lungjinna le lhanthim’in eikhange.

Verse 4
Ka hinlai ni hi lhanna kapel teng,
Lhatdamten einganau kajot jing ding;
Luipi lon gin thip’a kichol donge.

songs.title: 78. PATHEN LEKHA SIM JINGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen lekha sim jinga,
Asun ajan a ngaito-a,
A gunchu a thanom pan,
Pathen phatthei peh amui.

Chorus
Hijeh chun sun le jan in,
Lung ngai nan nei jing un lang,
A thulu ching jing jeng in,
Phatthei na hinkem louna.

Verse 3
Mi chonse houlim pi lou,
Mi gilou nung juilou-a,
Mi seise te kom dalha,
Michun chonset apailhai.

Verse 3
Luipang a thingphung keh chu,
A nan goptih nei talou,
Hiche thing hin thei bang chun,
Mitheng nop jong kemthei lou.

Verse 4
Chonse vang chuto bang lou,
Huiya vai kithe bang ding,
Pathen thupi tan ni leh,
Mi chonse chu pampai ding.

songs.title: 79. HOICHAN’A HIJONGLE PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. s. (John 10:3)

Verse 1
Hoichan’a hijongle Pakai nei puiyin,
Na khut’in neituh jingin neilha kang hih in ;
Ling le khao thang tam jongle nanung kajui ding,
Lhandampun nei puiyin hoichan hijongle.

Chorus
Hoichan hijongle Lhandampu,
Na nung kajui ding ; (2 vei)
Hoichan hijongle Lhandampu,
Na nung kajui ding.

Verse 2
Hoichan’a hijong le Namai lhaisel’in,
Nei lhamonin tha neipen set neidal peh in ;
Ka lam muthim jeng jongle kei kicha lou ding,
Hoichan’a hijong le Nangin nei puiyin.

Verse 3
Hoichan’a hijong le Nang bou ka taona,
Lam hahsa neipui hoiyin kaman lou nadin ;
Chonsetnan eium kimvel hen hahsa jong le,
Nangin nei umpi le kei gammang lou ding.

songs.title: 79. KHUT GOH KEOVA KACHE DING HAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Khut goh keova kache ding ham,
Eilhatpa lamto dinga,
Ana nikhat jong tong louva,
Ima lan ding neilouva.

Chorus
Kache ding ham khutgoh keuva,
Eihuhhing pa lamto-a chu,
Lhagao khat beh keng louhel a,
Kache ding ham khut goh a?

Verse 2
Thina in eikai lut lou ding,
Tua Jesun eihuhhing ta,
Ka lamto ding bou khut goh a,
Phamo san kalung khamâ€™e.

Verse 3
Ka sumang tai kum phalai cheng,
Kou la ka kou kit theipon,
Hichu ajen nan mang ta leng,
A lunggot molso ta ding.

Verse 4
Thina jan chun hinpha le chun,
Lhagao khat huhhing lou in,
Na huhhing pa loupi tah chu,
I pin lamto tan na tem?

songs.title: 79. THE NEW JERUSALEM ABOVE (L. Th. 205)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chunga Jerusalem thah chu,
Van mithengte tolpi ahi;
Chu-a Lal Immanuel’in vai ahom’e,
Kajot Zion gamnom chu kangai ngeiye.
Hinoi leiset sangin anomjoi tonsot gam chu,
Nitin mi alhung lhatin in tam;
Kumtin apung jing,
Zion lhang chunga,
Kelngoinou Leng lem’in asauve.

Verse 2
Immanuel nathisan chu,
Atonsotna ka la ngei ding;
Mithengte gam kalhun tengle ken lan sange,
Tonsot thing Pakai nunnem pah kamu ding.

Verse 3
Aw Lhandampu Hallelujah,
Gam jouse hi Nanga ahi;
Nathisan lu’n neisop thengin nanga kahi,
Kangah-e lungjin Jordan mei jing noiya.

Verse 4
Hung ding nahitah em Pakai,
Kagam gentheinan atom’e;
Canaan gam le namel ngai ken kabang theilou,
Jing niso thah-in khotheng len kanom’e.

songs.title: 80. KA HOINA KUL JESU CHRISTA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. s. (Psalms 94:22)

Verse 1
Ka hoina kul Jesu Christa,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
I tobang lungdon um jongle,
Khopi huiya Jesu kabel.

Chorus
Ka lungdonna a Jesu kom ka bel ken,
Ka lungdonna, ka lung donna ;
Ka lungdonna a Jesu chu ka kulpi,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel.

Verse 2
Khopi huiyin eipha jongle,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
Setto louna chu lha ponge,
I tihchan hijong le Jesu.

Verse 3
Ka kiselna ka van Kulpi,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
I tobang hahsa hung jong le,
Khopi huiya ka bel Nangma.

songs.title: 80. LEISET DALHAU HITIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset dalhau hitin,
Nunglam ngaita louvin,
Kipa chemasa ten,
Luigal gam nomâ€™a eingah ui,
Tonsot nopna a chun.
Ka le lungjin na gam,
Leiset ka chenna hi,
Kilung tona Zion lhanga,
Jalen phat kangah lel.

Verse 2
Vetan Pakai kalennau,
Lung jinna gam hi,
Gamthip genthei ahi,
Thina hin gol eikhen jiuve,
Na gam lhun masang sen.

Verse 3
Lal Immanuel khopi
Nom Zion a chun,
Khenna hi umta lou,
Chua genthei chate jouse,
Kimu to ka ngah lel.

songs.title: 80. LORD THOU ART EVERYTHING TO ME (L. Th. 142)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw van huilhi kangaiye hung lengin,
Kalung sunga meipi jing semhoh-in;
Thim le lungjinnan kei eikhang jitai,
Kajot laiyin alei tonsot kholmun.

Chorus
Aw Pakai kadin ijakai nahi,
Hinna twikhuh nahi ken kangaiye;
Loupina le vanmun kangeh chomlou,
Vah chu Nangma nahiye nei umpin.

Verse 2
Til’a leiya Eden pahhoi lengsa,
Kahol’in vannoi setthim jing noiya;
Hin Calvary lhanga aleng kit tai,
Apah-e Eden thah hinthing phunga.

Verse 3
Leiset pah mihemte hi chulkit ding,
Anop laiyu le aw ngei jong thip thei;
Aw Pakai namel hoi vang chul ngailou,
Tonsot’a pah jinga einem jing ding.

Verse 4
Nangma ka kouvin thim akihohjin,
Gamthip lunghel nahi jaiyin ka-oi;
Kakipana athah ken seijou lou,
Na em chun keidin kho avahsah-e.

songs.title: 81. NILHUM NGAILOU ZION KHOPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nilhum ngailou Zion khopi,
Ngaiyin kamao kakap sun nitin in,
Pon loupi sil in leng in lhatsa te,
Keidia jong mun umna chu gamâ€™a chun.

Chorus
Ka ngaitave ka ngai tave,
Amun loupi hoina jouse sang in,
Lungsetpa Lal Christa meldei um chu,
Mu kanom kalung kham banna ding in.

Verse 2
Ahoina seijou lou gam chu,
Thisan in ahong tai zalenna gam,
Ka Lhagao chu gammon chu hol in lang,
Leiset gam hi chul kittei ding ahi.

Verse 3
Lungdei lhatdam te lenna mun,
Lhung theilou kadip damâ€™e Lhandampu,
Nei siltheng in Lhagao vin neipui yin,
Lal lungnem gam hoi chu kangai ngeiye.

songs.title: 81. O CALVARY.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. m. (Luke 23:33)

Verse 1
O Calvary ! … Lhang gimnei tah,
Pakai thina … Calvary lhang ;
Cross chunga chun … Athisan along,
Chonse keima … eilhatdoh tai.

Chorus
O Calvary ! …Calvary thim !
Keidia Christa thisan lonna ;
O Calvary ! … Calvary hoi,
Chu a Pakai ka din athi.

Verse 2
Ohe ! Pakai … Keima jal’a,
Hibang hesoh … nathoh hitam !
Calvary lhang … gimnei tah chu !
Vannoi chonset … pon najon tai.

Verse 3
Song chimsoh in … mu athim tai,
Hichun tan ta … Lhandampu chu ;
Hou-in ponjal … laiya lhangta,
Van kot kihong … namtin dingin.

songs.title: 81. WE ARE WAITING FOR THE KING (L. Th. 209)
82. HUNG NAIYIN LANG IMMANUEL
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kagel jinge van gam nom chu,
Hung naiyin lang Immanuel;
Lung nem kanei poi leisetna,
Genthei navang ka-na.
Aw nang kalenna gam lungmol,
Nalhang chunga genthei chate;
Lungdong thoh-in,
Aw nagam loupi lalna pahhoiyin abome;
Nangbou chu nahi kalung kinepna.

Verse 2
Kalha lengtan van gam nom’a,
Nop le ol’in lengin van’a;
Selangdah tum le lasah thon,
Pakai chu vahchoiyin.

Verse 3
Kalha lengtan van gam nom’a,
Leiset hi i-lou na ngai ham?
Nopna gamtheng nom lhun tengle,
Tonsotna kemlou ding.

Verse 4
Jesun nei puiyin nei chingin,
Nalungset tuipia kalha tai;
Zion mitheng le gamtheng chu,
Mu kanom’e Pakai.

songs.title: 82. NGAIYUN PAKAI IN EIKOU â€“UI TUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyun Pakai in eikou â€“ui tun,
Leiset ga chom khom din,
Chang-at khom ding mi alhom jeh in,
Changvui akoi joutai.

Chorus
Pakai min in kipah in cheuvin,
Ngailut le khoto thon,
Manbei a huhhinga nunnom chu,
Vannoi-ah phong leuvin.

Verse 2
Cheuvin amang ding kon huhdoh un,
Chonset muthimâ€™a kon,
Aban thahat pan un huhhing un,
Chonset bulpu galhan.

Verse 3
Kipah tah in genthei kou khom un,
Lungset ankong um din,
Amaho chu hinna changlhah a,
Pakai in lamto ding.

songs.title: 82. PAKAI JESU EIHUHHINGPAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. d. (2 Tim. 1:12)

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu eihuhhingpan,
Athoh in thi hahsa ;
A thisan lu chu atoh-e,
Mi chonse eihuh nan.

Chorus
Cross phunga, Cross phunga khovah kamunaa,
Hia chun ka chonset poh tol’a lhan ;
Hichun khovah ken tahsanin kamui,
Tunvang keiman nom kasa jing tai.

Verse 2
Keima mi chonse huhna a,
A thisan ato chun ;
Nisan jong athoh ve ngam lou,
A mai asel jenge.

Verse 3
Ka chonset mai hi jachatna,
Bei hen Cross kamu nin ;
Ka lung jong lungset in jol hen,
Ka mit lhi jong long hen.

Verse 4
Ka mitlhi luiyin long jongle,
Nei lungset sajou lou ;
Vo Jesu kalha Nang kapei,
Ima dang ka-neilou.

songs.title: 83. HE SUFFERED FOR ME. (L. Th. 75)
83. KA KHEL’IN JESU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. m. (Luke 23:33)

Verse 1
Ka khel’in Jesu ana thin kei huhhing nan,
Hing hoi hilou keima hin theinan ;
Cross phung jotna lampi khoh chu ajon lhungtai,
Ka hinlai chonset ngaidam soh nan.

Chorus
Ka chonset Cross chunga akikhenbeh sohtai,
Ijat ahin apoh mang nom’e ;
Lungdon seithei louhel thoh in Calvarya,
Ka chonsetna apomang joutai.

Verse 2
Nem heo chan ngailutnan eikho ngai sot theiyin,
Ka lungsung boh asutheng soh in ;
Themmo ei chansahna ka hepoi ka onge,
Ka chonset Cross a khenbeh jouta.

Verse 3
Eihuhhingpa dalhan chemang kitta ponge,
Niseh kipah in juile tange ;
Ka kam le ka lungin la sajing tange,
Ka chonset jouse pomang sohta.

songs.title: 83. PAKAI THAHAT PAN IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai thahat pan in hat un athu gingchan,
A Thupha theng phongun lhangsam leuvin,
Galsat lungdon na a jong
Aman eikai hoi jing ding,
Pakai min a koiham eidou thei diu.
Dingdet un, thudih a,
Leng thupeh ngai un galjo nading,
Pakai choi-at na dingin athutep molso din,
Pakai thahat pan in ding det un.

Verse 2
Pakai thahat pan in hat un athu gingchan,
Gal masang a kon nung jam kit lou in,
Ama na komâ€™a ding jing ding
Na galsat hudinga,
Malam nouvin athahat chu pan un.

Verse 3
Pakai thahat pan un hat un athu gingchan,
I tih chanâ€™a athutep thon ngai lou,
Aman na khut jetlam atuh jinge kicha hih in,
Pakai chu tahsan jing in ding det in.

songs.title: 84. KALAM MUTHIM JINGA KONIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdon ka le lungjin gam hi,
Pel’in lalna gam nom a lengun;
Jon jingin ting setthim jinga,
Nei kaiyn Nangma vah emsel’a chun.

Chorus
Kalam muthim jinga kon hin,
Ka ngaiye vejingin kei chenge;
Aw chung gamhoi nom’a chun nomin lenglen,
Ka leiset hinkho hi ngaikit ponge.

Verse 2
Aw namel a kipa namtui,
Kalemlai atoiyin achul tai;
La jongle deite tol lenna,
Alennau chullou ding chun einem’e.

Verse 3
Aw vetem’un lhatsate chun,
Jaiyin a-oiyun chu gam’a chun;
Lungset Pakai sem Salem kulpi,
Sunga leng le van mithengte to.

Verse 4
Aw lungsette chumun ngei chu,
Jon jingute aw chu gam’a chun;
Van mithengte ponbang sil’un,
I lennau gam hi avechim pouve.

songs.title: 84. SILUNG LEN IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Silung Lenin tahsan in galdot un,
Alang Van gam loupi,
Leija lengvai chate tol alen nau,
Kelngoi nou le hinna thingpah jon in,

Chorus
Lungset te aleng ui, Aloupina kipah in sau hite.
O thisan lu vahchoiyin lan sange,
Eilungset na loupi, Calvary a lhatna thisan,
Vahchoilaâ€™n oi-jinge.

Verse 2
Lunggel jing in kahin galdot jing ui,
Kipana anaitai,
Lungsetpa thisan jal a kipana,
I vangphauve Pathen cha ihiu hi,
Christan eimin vonau,
Kipana kim chu anatoh ahi,.

Verse 3
Kei ding tumâ€™a kipa loupi pen chu,
Lungset theng hi ahi,
Pathen cha le anatoh hina jong,
Neihil jingin keima neihin til in,
O ka Pakai deitah ,
Neihin mang in Lhagao sochatna ding.

Verse 4
Lhahna tongso gin ngei akithonge,
Lungset kagol ngaite,
Khanlai boina ngaidam in umtau te,
Lunggel jingun Pakai lam sang jingun,
O sopi goldei te,
I lennau leiset lhepna ahat e.

songs.title: 84. VEUVIN IHINNA DINGUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Isaiah 45:22)

Verse 1
Veuvin ihinna dingun Jesu Cross chunga,
Eihuhnan athisan along lhai ;
Ven, mi chonsen tun ven kihuhhing sah loiyin,
Nangma huhna along toh pa chu.
Ven ! Ven ! Ven hungin,
Hinna dinga Cross chunga kikhenbeh Jesu ;
Genthei tah in athi nang chunan.

Verse 2
Hungun michonsen hung ven nahinna dingin,
Cross chunga um Jesu khu tunin ;
Jesu hilou nasam gim le genthei thoh a,
Tonsot hinkemlou nang na pea chu.

Verse 3
Na chonsetna jouse hinpon Jesu koma,
Hung seplhan Ama soptheng dingin ;
Thonmon soplhante Aman athisan lu chun,
Theng tante na chonset nen jouse.

Verse 4
Chonset muthim’a hitih chanpi na ihmun,
Na umjinge Ama helouvin ;
Vo michonse tun hungin Jesu henga chun,
Khatvei hungven na sochatna din.

songs.title: 85. LHAGAO THENG VAN VAKHO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao-theng van vakhu nunnem,
Hung leng kit-in ka ngai jui,
Hinsu halkit in mipi lhasam te,
Mollep lou-vin hung kit in lang.

Chorus
O ka ngai-uve lhagao nunnem,
Nangma lou-vin mipi te lamvai yin,
Hin puikit in lang o valpa ahsi,
Zion kipa lampi theng a.

Verse 2
Ngaiyin pakai na lhatsa te,
Atonsot lam ahai-yun,
Lei kelngoiching ten hin puidih joulou,
Iti ahidiu vem pakai.

Verse 3
Lhagao-theng pen nang na um le,
Leiset lungdon anem yin,
Set huipi le lungjin gal len jong le,
Jailan naming vahchoi tang e.

Verse 4
Jesu nunnem hung ham kit in,
Lungdong tah a na thohna,
Hetsah in lang na linglukhuh chuto,
Na hesoh na kidang tah chu.

songs.title: 85. THE DAY OF GLORY IS COME. (L. Th. 132)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Niloupi hung lhung ding hita,
Ngah jing leng Immanuel;
Set le thilha nemse ding ni,
Lhatdam chate nom lenna ding ni chu.

Chorus
Chuteng kipa thanom’in kisante,
Pakai gotsa tonsot gamnom chu ichan diu;
Aw iti nop tantem aw iti hal umtan tem,
Hal kem ging louva ilen diu.

Verse 2
Jona ni ka muna diu chu,
Itih le hintem Pakai;
Leng’in Jordan hung kaiyin tin,
Nang din van ahsi’n hungvah ing’e.

Verse 3
Ahi ngeiye tonsot Pakai,
Na khopi semthah a chun;
Na thisanna nalhatsate,
Hungun kahenga hunguvin Nati.

Verse 4
Aw khopi thah nahoi ngeiye,
Nasunga galjoute leng;
Jo ngei asah diu chu,
Leiset man ni dingin tin akheh-ui.

songs.title: 85. THINGPEL’A KITHATPA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Thingpel’a kithatpa thu jop chanse le,
Pathen Chapa changkhat tahsan chanse chun ;
Sochatna chamkim’a anei ding ahi,
Aman huhhingna thahat anei jeh chun.

Chorus
Sopi Pakaiyin nangma nakou kouve,
Ami lungset khoto chu manbei ahi ;
Mi chonse lhatnan athisan alonge,
Ama bou huhhing chamkim soh thei ahi.

Verse 2
Koi hijongle Pathen Thupha jop chan chu,
Chonset keona a thisan tahsan chan chun ;
Tonsot hin kemlou anei ding ahiye,
Aman huhhingna thahat anei jeh chun.

Verse 3
Koi hile alung heiya chonset pailha,
Pakai lutna dinga lungkot honga chun ;
Ahuhhing chamkim’a nomsa ding ahi,
Huhhing ding sadem’a um ahijeh chun.

songs.title: 86. DEAR ONES IN HEAVEN. (L. Th. 37)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Valpa ahsi Lhandampu lalna gam’a chun,
Lei lungdon lungjin genthei jouse;
Hinlai meipi hi jingta ponte,
Kap in kikhen kitta lou ding.

Chorus
Lily pah le loupi navah emsel,
Kelngoinou le alhatsate lenna;
Van lamthom le vantil thengte,
Mu kangai ngeiye.

Verse 2
Galdot tem’un loupina mun’a lhungte chu,
Lem la gin ngei loupi chu jom’un;
Leiya alenpiten hoh jongleu,
Ngaiyin hung kile kitlou ding.

Verse 3
Jing lhavingpun van Jerusalem thah nom’a,
Aw alengun chu gamnom’a chun;
Kalunglen loi, amel em’u chu,
Kalung sunga hin acheng jing.

Verse 4
Lungdon gal’a Pakai chenna chung van gil’a,
Ni le lha le ahsi vah ngailou;
Jan thim lungdonna aum tapoi,
Kelngounou chu avah jinge.

songs.title: 86. MUN A â€“ONG NALAIYE KOUKHOM UN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mun a â€“ong nalaiye kou khom un,
Lengpa golvah ankong umdin,
Kou khom unlang a in midim hen,
Mi vaicha gilkel ten neu hen.

Chorus
Lamlenâ€™a le daipamâ€™a pot un,
Setna lam thimâ€™a umte chu,
Chen lang ngailut le lungset thon lang,
Vahvei ho gapui khom un.

Verse 2
Mun a-ong nalaiye khom kit un,
Amavang eingai sah lou le,
Kouna ngai louva kilep mangho,
Koiman kou kit talou hel ding.

Verse 3
Mun a-ong nalaiye kou khom un,
Chunga Pathen thupeh ahi,
Lungset hong sunga gapui khom un,
Huhhing pa lungset na a chun.

Verse 4
Genthei lengvai le ahao din jong,
Van ah mun a-ong nalaiye,
Koukhom loi un kot kihon pet in,
Gunchun hilchen kimvel leuvin.

songs.title: 86. NISA VAH CHE PHAHNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. (Psalms 72:8)

Verse 1
Nisa vah che phahna chan’a,
Gam jousea Jesun vaihom ding ;
Gam jouse chunga leng chang ding,
Ni le lhavah mol mang kahsea.

Verse 2
Chitin namtin pao tintang min,
A vahchoi la sanom cheh ding ;
Chapang sen san’in jong sa ding,
A mintheng vahchoina la chu.

Verse 3
Tan neilouva Ama henga,
Taona vahchoina umjing ding ;
Amin chu thao namtui bang ding,
Namtin vai jousen hou soh ding.

Verse 4
Chuteng leiset min ja cheh ding,
A lengpau chu sang sohkei diu ;
Vantil jong hung kumlha kit ding,
“Amen” tia leiyin kho sam ding.

songs.title: 87. ITI HALTAUVAM.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Iti haltauvam Zion kulpi a,
Mipi kikhom ho;
Israel chate chu nop la longdel’in san,
Pakai lungdonni chun. (2)

Verse 2
Aw Calvary alhutmai tauve,
Pakai nunnem chu;
Achun lengthei Mary chun iti gel’in tem?
Adou ling lukhuh chu. (2)

Verse 3
Calvary lhanga chun akhai sangun,
Chonse kikhom hon;
Anoiya mipi chun kap in kachang kip’in,
Ana ngei eilhatna. (2)

Verse 4
Lhagao neipuiyin Lhandampu thina,
Lugu mun’a chun;
Mu kanom ka Pakai linglukhuh kidang chu,
Aw athoh lai mel jong. (2)

songs.title: 87. NAIJA GAMLA CHANG AMINTAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Naija gamla chang amintai,
Changvui akoisoh gamtai,
Naija gamla a angsoh tai,
Denna lep a phaichamâ€™a.

Chorus
Pakai chang at ding hinsol in,
Na henga katao nau hi,
Ngai in chang at ding hinsol in
Chang at kile get in te.

Verse 2
Jingpi nison hinsol loiyin,
Suun nisat in hin sol in,
Nilhum kon gei jin hinsol in,
Gamtin chang at khom dingin.

Verse 3
Man gang un chang akoijou tai,
Changvui min at khom loi un,
Nilhah teng le inlam jon a,
Kipah a che ding nahi.

songs.title: 87. PAKAI KHOPI HUI ANUNGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. s. (Mark 4:39)

Verse 1
Pakai khopi hui anunge,
Twikhanglen kinong sangta !
Meiyin van ahin le thim soh tai ;
Ka bel dingu um talou ;
Ka thi diu lungkham lou nahim ?
I dia ihmu nahim ?
Chomkah louva ei tijat sah uva,
Ka thi ding kon’uva hi.
Ka thu ngaiyu hen,
Hui le twi nongin, thip tau hen !
Twikhanglen kinong hijeng jongle,
Thilha, mihem itobang hijeng jongle,
Twiyin kong chu hin chup, mang thei lou ding,
Lei le van, twilen Pakai umna a,
Ka thu angai cheh dingu ahi ;
Thip tauhen ! Thip tau hen !
Ka thu angai cheh dingu ahi ;
Thip chet tau hen.

Verse 2
Lha lengvaiyin Pakai keima,
Lungdong tah in ka taove ;
Ka lungkhamna hi anangeiye,
Hungthouvin nei huhhingin ;
Chonsetna le gentheina hin,
Ka lhagao achup tai,
Amang ding kon kahitai O Pakai !
Nangman neilalut loiyin.

Verse 3
Pakai tijatna abei tai,
Hui le twinong thip helta ;
Lungmon nisan dil asalvah tan,
Alange vangam nom chu ;
Neivop jingin O Lhandampu,
Nei dalha kit datan,
Kipahtah in Nangma lam sanging ting,
Na henga kichol donge.

songs.title: 88. HALLELUIJAH ! ATHOUDOH TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (Matt. 28:6)

Verse 1
Halleluiyah athoudoh tai,
Chunga akaltai Jesu ;
Aphujal tai thina dal tan,
Vantil O in ajom’e,
Athoudoh tai, athoudoh tai,
Ahinge thikit lou din.

Verse 2
Halleluiyah athoudoh tai,
Pakai chu loupi hidin ;
Hetsah Lhagao ahin sol’e,
I hinna diu bol ahi ;
Athoudoh tai, athoudoh tai,
A vangin them ichangui.

Verse 3
Halleluiyah athoudoh tai,
Thinan ajou jou tapoi ;
Christa chu thokitna ahi,
Lhanna amite thou ding,
Athoudoh tai, athoudoh tai,
Hingjing Pakai, hungding Leng.

songs.title: 88. LUNGDON MEI AJING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gethsemani honâ€™a Pakai Jesu chu ataove,
Mipi ahung kikhom I-Pakai chu man din,
Achung thu lel dan chu athem pouve,
Thempu lal in sung a atha lou somâ€™un,

Chorus
Lungdon mei ajing (2)
I-Pakai ahung bom Calvary lhang chung a,
Ling lukhuh le sapsetna thing Cross pun,
Abel ding um talou I-Pakai Jesu.

Verse 2
O Simon Peter le Solchah lungdong te hung
thou-vun,
I-Pu chu akaijun athina ding munâ€™a,
Vanâ€™a hung kumlha Van lal genthei chu,
Alungdon nem dingin koima umta lou.

Verse 3
Iti vetlel umtam I-Pakai Jordan kaiding chu,
Atha ahung nguijin Alu chu akaikun,
A Lhagao alhan thimpi ajingin,
Set le dougal jouvin Jordan lui akai.

Verse 4
Noija le vanchung a thupha ahil Lhandampu
chun,
Atha ding agouvin O Zion nunau ten,
Aphat lai ni chu asumil taove,
Nanop nau hilou ham na damnau pa chu.

songs.title: 88. THY GLORY LAND.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nagam loupi hunglhun phatle,
Mithengte le Vantil thengte chuto;
Chonsete hung khom ding,
Kei jong hinna chu kachang jou nadem?

Chorus
Aw setna alem kahi, Pakai neihung puiyin,
Hinna twikhuh a neipuiyin;
Kaset soptheng dingin,
Chuteng Na gam nom, hunglhung thei tange.

Verse 2
Na gam loupi hunglhun phatle,
Leisetna vaveina le ka-kana;
Ngaiyin gelkit ponge,
Silponpha laitol’a lenpi tange.

Verse 3
Lei lungdon le kana a hin,
Kipa nopna olna kamujou poi;
Pakai Jesu lou chu,
Kalung donna a einem ding umlou.

Verse 4
Van khonom ngei puldouna in,
Leisetna hin toni kalhum joupoi;
Goldeite lenna chu,
Pakai hung lhunkal kangah lel ngeiye.

songs.title: 89. CHUNGA JERUSALEM THAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chung a Jerusalem thah chu,
Van Mitheng te tolpi ahi,
Chu a Lal Immanuel in vai ahomâ€™e,
Kajot Zion gammon chu kangai ngeiye.
Hinoi leiset sang in,
Anom joi tonsot gam chu,
Nitin mi alhung lha tin in tam,
Kumtin apung jing, Zion lhang chung a,
Kelngoi nou Leng lem in asauve.

Verse 2
Immanuel na thisan chu,
A tonsot a ka la ngei ding,
Mitheng te gam kalhun tengle ken lan sange,
Tonsot thing Pakai nunnem pah kamu ding.

Verse 3
O lhandampu Hallelujah,
Gam jouse hi Nang a ahi,
Na thisan lun neisop theng in nang a kahi,
Ka nga he lungjin Jordan meijing noiya.

Verse 4
Hung ding nahi tah em Pakai,
Ka gam genthei nan atomâ€™e,
Canaan gam le Namel ngai ken kabang theilou,
Jing niso thah in khotheng len kanomâ€™e.

songs.title: 89. KUM LE LHA AKEM JINGE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kum le lha akem jinge,
Kanop lai nikho jong hi;
Na emhoi le hileiset pah hi,
Ka dingin lungdon le kana gam ahi.

Chorus
Aw ka tonsot khopi le gal munna,
Lhatdamte lenna gam chu ka ngai ngeiye;
Lungdonna le lhalengvaina,
Aum tapoi kana aw ging talou.

Verse 2
Ka noplai nikho akem,
Noi leiset pahhoi jong hi;
Lei nopna pon bangin chulkit jin,
Pah bang pahna tonsot gam ka ngei ngeiye.

Verse 3
Hi leiset lungdonna le,
Muthim’in eikhang kimvel;
Kalenna gamthip le ka maona,
Pel’a lungsette to lenkhom kanom’e.

Verse 4
Einem’in lang aw Pakai,
Genthei lengvai cha kahi;
Nei puiyin nangma lenna gam’a,
Lungjinna leiset hi ken ngai talou ding.

songs.title: 89. TUNIN CHRISTA ATHOUTAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. dl
(I Cor. 15:20)

Verse 1
Tunin Christa athoutai ! Halleluiyah !
Van min vahchoiyun ati ! Halleluiyah !
Van le leiyin la sauvin ! Halleluiyah !
Kipa la sangin sauvin ! Halleluiyah !

Verse 2
Eilhatnau kin achai tai ! Halleluiyah !
Gal sat in gal ajoutai ! Halleluiyah !
Ni oh-val akichaitai ! Halleluiyah !
Athi asohkit tapoi Halleluiyah !

Verse 3
I Lengpau ahing kittai ! Halleluiyah !
Thina thahat abeitai ! Halleluiyah !
A thin eihuhhing tauve ! Halleluiyah !
Buikhuh in ajou tapoi ! Halleluiyah !

Verse 4
Loupi Leng ahing jing ding ! Halleluiyah !
A tahsan hing jing jeng ding ! Halleluiyah !
La sauvin avahchoi nan ! Halleluiyah !
Tonsot hing jing Leng ahi ! Halleluiyah !

songs.title: 90. AW HALLELUJAH.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Lal lenna gam ngai um chu,
Lhatdam chate nom’a lenna Salem kul sung;
Van mithengte le goldeite alengui.
Aw Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Tin pachat la asauve che masaten.

Verse 2
Aw Pakaiyin athohna mun,
Calvary chu hung naiyin lang ka lhagao din;
Hung naiyin Calvary lhang sapset mun chu.

Verse 3
Ka lhagao chen chumun’a chun,
Gacholdo tan i-Pakai mun semthah a chun,
Senlai naobanga ka na umtalou ding.

Verse 4
Pakai vetan ka lennau gam,
Lungdon puldou leiset gam hi iti hahtam;
Ka ngai Jordan luigal Salem kulsung chu.

songs.title: 90. JINGKAH DAITWI ALHAH TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Jingkah daitwi alhah teng,
Lui chung thingna louna ;
Jan daitwiyin achap teng,
Ahingdoh soh kitji.
Vanoi jouse gasei leuvin,
Pakai chu athoudoh kit tai.

Verse 2
Easter jing ninou asoh,
Pahcha namkim apah ;
Apah hoiyin lei ajem,
Mihem lung alhaiye.

Verse 3
Jing ihmu pengpalep ho,
Nalhau jah doh-uvin ;
Hung lengdoh soh-uvin lang,
Pakai athou kit tai.

songs.title: 90. MIHEM CHENNA CHANâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mihem chenna chanâ€™a, galhang sam leu hite,
Hung un Christa mite, seileu te limtah in,
Mi chonse te henga, lungmon na thupha hi,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.
Lhamon sah ahung tai (2)
Pathen in eipeh u, eitepnau Lhagao theng,
Mihem chenna chanâ€™a,
Galhang sam leu hite,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

Verse 2
Muthim lungdon lengvai,
Gim le hesoh genthei,
Abonchan achai in, gamtin asal sohtai,
In hoi lul tah bangin, nisa so em bangin,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

Verse 3
Leng jouse Leng chungnung,
Mi damsah Lhagao in,
Mi chonse te henga, hinna thu hinpo lhan,
Hung un huhhing sate, la ngei hi sau hite,
Lhamon sah ahung atai.

Verse 4
Lungsetna chungnung thu, lan sa choi leu hite,
Van chunga cheng hotoh, kitoh in sau hite,
La ngei hi bang louvin, sau hite limtah in,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

songs.title: 91. NATONG IN KON UTE EIHO PATHEN SOHTE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Natong in kon ute eiho Pathen sohte,
I Pakai nung jui in cheu hite na tong in,
A man eipeh lungthim thah chu pan uhite,
I khut a itoh thei chan tong cheh uhite.

Chorus
Tong uteâ€¦. hatah in,
Na tong unâ€¦ pontah in,
Ngah uteâ€¦. kinem in,
Bang poute Pakai hung kahsen.

Verse 2
Na tong cheh uhite agilkel vana din,
Lhagao dang chah ho dang nou nadin peu hite,
I loupina dingun Cross thu seileu hite,
â€œManbei in eihuhhing uiâ€ tin sam leu hite.

Verse 3
I bonchan cheu hitin na ga tong uhite,
Chonset muthim gam chu apumpin mangsoh hen,
Jehovah Mintheng loupi chu kilang soh hen,
â€œManbei in eihuhhing uiâ€ tin sam leu hite.

Verse 4
Pontho tah in pang un Pakai thahat pan un,
Tohphat man isan diu Pathen in eipeh diu,
Lhatsa Mitheng toh vanâ€™a ichen khom diu,
â€œManbei in eihuhhing uiâ€ tin sam leu hite.

songs.title: 91. NITHUMNIN ATHOUVE JESU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Psalms 9:1)

Verse 1
Nithum nin athouve Jesu,
Thi nasatah chaiyin ; (2 vei)
Athou kittai aloupi toh,
Seijuiten amu’ve. (3 vei)

Verse 2
Chujouvin Jesun angai cheng,
Lungsetna thu seiyin ; (2 vei)
Tunia pat’in abeisoh tai,
Na chonsetnau jouse. (3 vei)

Verse 3
Amavang lung nengtah cheh in,
Nei ngaiyun, nei ngah un ; (2 vei)
Lhagao theng chu hinsol lhange,
Nalunguva cheng din. (3 vei)

Verse 4
Chujou tengle seichoi leuvin,
Lung olmo lou hellin ; (2 vei)
Gam tina cheuvin hil leuvin,
Hinna Pathen Thupha. (3 vei)

Verse 5
Koi hijong le nasei ngaiya,
Kei eihea tahsan pa ; (2 vei)
Ama chu leiset beini leh,
Tonsot hinna peng’e. (3 vei)

songs.title: 91. VAN LAL JUBILEE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Adam lhanthim noiya tang ho,
Apuidoh dingin koi hung intem;
Alunggimnau chu suhnem peh-in
Ajal’a thi dingin, Van Lal Cha ahung peng.

Chorus
Hallelujah kipah-in vahchoiyun,
Van lal Jubilee chu;
Bethlehem le Calvary lhang chunga,
Sochatna dah aging.

Verse 2
Nunglam melma gal athouve,
Chonset in lhan’a ajalkhum’e;
Jehovah-jireh lhang ahung kaiyin,
Hosana hin sam’in, Salem ponlap noiya.

Verse 3
Sheol noiya Mansoul khopi,
Asochatnau tindal hung gingin;
Nangho dingin van Lal naosen chu,
Thisanin kijem’in, Melma khopi asim.

Verse 4
Salem ponlap noiya hinna,
Salem Pakai khut’a malsomna;
Jehovah-jireh lhang a miho chun,
Hallelujah Amen.

songs.title: 92. KA PAKAI THOHNA KAVETLE.
