songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary lhang chu vekit tem’un,
Gimna thohgol ahipoi;
Ka Pakai thohna kavet le,
Kalung gimna le gentheina,
Twi bangin ahung long nem heuve.

Verse 2
Chaga genthei ho akipanau,
Leiset’a hin aum poi,
Hijeng jongle Calvary,
Gaveleu chun kipana pah;
Pakai athisan kainelnul chu.

Verse 3
Leiset gentheiya anop lenna chu,
Pakaiya kipa ahi;
Pakaiya chun kipah-un lang,
Hichun leiset gentheina chu,
Ikipanau la ding chu ahi.

songs.title: 92. LHANTHIM’A LUM AHI
92. LUNGDON NA CHONSET JOUSEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdonna chonset jousen eibomâ€™e,
Thina lamâ€™a puidin,
Tahsan in thina kanung ngat e,
Eilhandam pun eihin kou.
Kakipah tangei ye tu vang in,
Lhandampu chonnem tah le milungset chun,
Ka Lhagao a huhhing kittai.

Verse 2
Kelngoinou lenna lhang chu kalhun teng,
Kipan eilam ton tin,
Thina Jordan lui kagal kaiteng,
Van golvahna lha tading.

Verse 3
Kipana tah lunggelâ€™a kanei hi,
Jesun eipeh ahi,
Leiset kipana sang a lenjo,
Van kipana kanei tai.

songs.title: 93. JESU SEINAN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat ml (I Peter 2:24)

Verse 1
Jesu seinan kajai,
“Tha lhom nahi ngut nai ;
Tha lhom chaten thum’un,
Pekim inge Keiman.”
Ka bat jouse chu, Jesun asalhai,
Ka chonsetna jouse jong ;
Aman asop lhengtai.

Verse 2
Imacha kanei poi,
Na lungset ngehna ding ;
Nangman neisop thengin,
Calvary thisan chun.

Verse 3
Keima kathi tenga,
Ka lhagao van kal teng ;
Jesun eilhat jallin,
Kei vangam lhung ta ding.

Verse 4
Lal touna kadin teng,
Ama ang sunga chun ;
Ka galvon pailhang ting,
Jesu ang sunga chun.

songs.title: 93. KOI HIJONG LE THUPHA HI AJA CHANAN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Koi hijongle Thupha hi aja chanan,
Kipana thu hi leiset gam kimvel a,
Phong un homjal un mi umna mun jousea,
â€œAhung nomchan hung u henâ€.

Chorus
Koi hijeng jongle ahung nomchan chu,
Thinglhang le phaicham damâ€™a gasam leuvin,
Pan vahmang ho inlamâ€™a akouna hi,
â€œAhung nomchan hung u henâ€.

Verse 2
Ahung nomchan chu hung geisang lou jen un,
Kot kihon lutthei petcha hin lut loi un,
Jesu chu hinna lampi dihtah ahi,
â€œAhung nomchan hung u henâ€.

Verse 3
Ahung nomchan chu thu tepsa aumâ€™e,
Ahung nomchan chu um jing jeng ding ahi,
Koi hile anom chan hing jing ding ahi,
â€œAhung nomchan hung u henâ€.

songs.title: 93. WHEN I THINK HOW THEY CRUCIFIED MY LORD
songs.lyrics:
(III Alex 144)

Verse 1
Lhandampu akhetbeh-u ngaitouvin, (2)
“Aw kahlah, kalah kahlah beh-in,
Eina kithinsah, thinsah”

Verse 2
Linglukhuh akhuh peh-u ngaitouvin (2)

Verse 3
Amai avoh peh-u chu ngaitouvin (2)

Verse 4
Anah thengtah kisun chu ngaitouvin (2)

Verse 5
Buikhuh-a avuiyu chu ngaitouvin (2)

songs.title: 94. CHONSET LUNGDON GIM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. s. (Prov. 18:24)

Verse 1
Chonset lungdon gim pomang ding,
I neiyui golpha Jesu ;
I jakai ipoh lut thei diu,
Pathen henga taona a ;

Chorus
Lungdong lungmong mo hesoh a,
I ding gim ithoh jiu ham ?
I lhut lou jeh jiu Pathen heng,
I taonauva ijakai.

Verse 2
I neiyum thunoh le lhepna,
Lungjin lungdonna umam ?
Lung lhalouvin um jingu te,
Pathen heng lhut’in taonan ;
Mu nau hitem golpha adang ,
Ei thoh khompia ginchat thei ?
I hatmonau Jesun ahei,
Taovun aheng lhut soh un.

Verse 3
Hatmo le pohgih po ihim?
I lel’um pohgih pohna ;
I beldiu Jesu aum nai,
Taonan aheng lhut soh un ;
Gollin nadeimoa napai em ?
Taovin Pakai heng lhut in ;
A bante nia nang huhhinga,
Nangman nomsa tading chu.

songs.title: 94. LORD JESUS SHOW US THY SORROW (L.Th. 123)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Setlei pon bang achul tasa hin,
Pakai Jesu nangbou hung lengin;
Calvary a Nathohna namtin’in,
Amiljou tai Nangin hungve kit’in.

Chorus
Aw nadong natje le naleng theiye,
Calvary a nathisan longin;
Thinlung lai loi hen Calvarya,
Nalengthei lai mel, kalunga millou ding.

Verse 2
Setlei nitnom pah bang chul hen lang,
Calvary nopna pah-in choiyin;
Lam hilou a lengte najal’in,
Nom’in alengun aw thisan lu tiuvin.

Verse 3
Chemasa ho vang chu aw Pakai,
Hal’in tongdon’uvin lhaisel’in;
Angaiyu kipana pah namtuiyin,
Hinlon tin aw natonsot gamnom chu.

Verse 4
Athohna maha lutah chun,
Zion lhang hoi nom chunga chongun;
Mil theilou dinga athoh lai mel,
Maha chu veuvin analo-e tiuvin.

songs.title: 94. THOUVIN KATING TING KAPA KOMâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thouvin kating ka Pa kom ah chekit tange,
Kama meipi bang in ajing,
Eilungset ding dang kaneilou leiset a hin,
Kapa lou chu ka dougal jeng.
Set na nuse ta jong leng,
Aphat na chul ngailou,
Kisih a kahol kit le, alim a leng kit ding.

Verse 2
Kapa inâ€™a ninglhing set a sum le sel um,
Mi lengvai ten anem jinge,
Kei gonggoh leh gilkel thoh a thiding kahi,
I lou gentheiya kava lem.

Verse 3
O akomâ€™a kachen lai chun iti noptam,
Leiya nopna jouse akim,
Tun kagel le kapa inpi kangai jeng tai,
Thupha choiyin jon kit tange.

Verse 4
Kei mi chonse seingai loule Pathen jalou,
Kading a mun eiphal peh leh,
Hi leiset pah kamelma hi ngaikit ponge,
A pallai ni achom taloi.

songs.title: 95. CALVARY LHANG CHUNG A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary lhang chung a Pakai chu,
Cross chunga ling lukhuh le,
Mipi ho nuisat ding in,
Thingleh a akhai sang ui.
O ana ngeiye ka Pakai thohna chu,
Akhut akeng alu veuvin,
Chonset jal in athisan,
Thengtah chu along dohtai,
Lungset um ngei pa chu.

Verse 2
Athi dinga adang chah lai chun,
Koima chan apenom poi,
Melma ten hem in nouvin,
Dangchah giugeo vin athi.

Verse 3
Kadang achah e tia athum chun,
Juthuh adonsah uvin,
Juthuh chun sunou lou ding,
Lhagao ngaiya chah ahi.

Verse 4
O ka Lhagao nalhatpa natje,
Keiman kahil chen theipoi,
Chenlang Calvary lhang a,
I Pakai chu ga dong tan.

songs.title: 95. CHI GENTHEI LUNGDONNA GAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chi genthei lungdonna gam’a hin,
Lungdon mitlhi pum’in kangah-e;
Tanglouvin Pakai nei umpin lang,
Nam genthei lengvai pah banga pah ding.

Chorus
Aw hung lengin Pakai kangeiye,
Calvary-a nalungsetna chu;
Pon bangin jah-in kachunguva,
Nam genthei lengvai pah banga pah ding.

Verse 2
Nagam nom jot dalha jeng jong leng,
Mong pong kate Pakai Nang tailou;
Senlai nao banga ka-kapet hin,
Namtin lungmol lah-a Nang hung vah-in.

Verse 3
Chonset in eihin nai jeng jongle,
Thina thimpi noiya um jong leng;
Pakai neipeh Hinna Lhagao hi,
Nalungsetna chu pah banga pah ding.

Verse 4
Genthei jal’a aw van lallukhuh,
Chonset genthei mun’a ahungun;
Nagam le chikah-a gentheina,
Ka-Pa ang’a pah namtuiyin apah.

songs.title: 95. KALUNG KAPHU NI KANOP NI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (Prov. 16:20)

Verse 1
Kalung kaphu ni kanop ni,
Pakai Jesu le Pathen’a ;
Kalung navah ni, nomsah ni,
Seichoi lenge kho vannoi jah.
Ka nopni, kipa ni,
Jesun kachonset soplheng ta ;
A min’a taoje eihil’e,
Niseh a kipa jingna thu ;
Ka nopni, kipani,
Jesun ka chonset sop lhengta.

Verse 2
Ka molso tai thu loupi pen,
Jesu kapu kei aseijui ;
Aman eikou, ken kajuiye,
A thupha keiman phong lenge.

Verse 3
Lu tah a keiman kitepna,
Long louvin Pathen ah um hen ;
Kahin laisen jong, kathin jong,
Thu loupi penna kanei ding.

songs.title: 96. HUNG UN PATHEN NGAITE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hung un Pathen ngaite, kipah in la sauvin,
Kipah in la sacheh un lang (2)
Kikhom un kimvel un. (2)
Cheu hite Zion ah,
Zion gam nom chungnung ema;
Cheu hite Zion gam nom a,
Pathen khopi nom tah a chun.

Verse 2
Pathen hepha lou ten, vahchoi da jeng jong leu,
Eiho Pathen chate sen vang (2)
Phong un na lung kipau. (2)

Verse 3
Pathen ki houna a, asangjan thanom un,
Vanâ€™a khopi hoi ilhun man (2)
I len man lam emâ€™a. (2)

Verse 4
Chu a lhi kang soh ding, kipa la isah diu,
Immanuel cha ihiuve (2)
Van khopi a ilen diu. (2)

songs.title: 96. KA LA
96. NEIKOU OGIN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E, Flat. d. (Matt. 11:28)

Verse 1
Nei kou O gin kajai,
Nangma koma dingin ;
Nei soptheng dingin Calvarya,
Na thisan longlha chun.

Chorus
Pakai ka hunge,
Tun Nang kom jonin ;
Thisan chun neisop thengin,
Calvarya longlha chun.

Verse 2
Chonse kahi vangin,
Na heng kahin jon’e ;
Tha neipen neisop thengsel’in,
Ka thensel masang sen.

Verse 3
Jesun eikouve kei,
Tahsan det kichen din ;
Lungset tahsan det kichen din,
Lei le van chunga din.

Verse 4
Chonset hat gam sunga,
Thahat eipei Jesun ;
Lungset tah-in kei eilamtoi,
Phattheina eiboh-e.

songs.title: 97. LUNGSET TAH-IN VAN GAM KHOPI
97. VANNOI GAMTIN CHONSET MUTHIM IN ALOI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi gamtin chonset muthim in aloi,
Hinna thun salvah un,
Lhagao huhhing a um nom a atamâ€™e,
Hinna thun salvah un.

Chorus
Sochat na hinna Thupha vahchun,
A gamtin salvah soh hen,
Sochat na hinna Thupha vahchun,
Tonsot gei in salvah hen.

Verse 2
Jet le vei-a igam miten eikou ui,
Hinna thun salvah in,
Kipah tah le thanom tah in choileu te,
Hinna thun savah in.

Verse 3
Hinna Thupha mijousen amu thei nan,
Hinna thun salvan in,
Hinna Thuphan gamtin alosoh na ding,
Hinna thun salvah in.

Verse 4
Hinna thu lhacha ipan hi chim poute,
Hinna thun salavah in,
Vanâ€™a ivondiu thilpha khol ihiuve,
Hinna thun salvah in.

songs.title: 97. ZION LHANG’A KHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinve tem’un vanchung mei lah-a khun,
Alennau Zion lhang’a khun;
Tol aleng’ui lungkhat cheh-in,
Angai pouve leiset chulna mun hi.

Chorus
Lungsetna um leuvin kap-in,
Pakai Nagam ngaiyin;
Aleng dildel’ui lung khat’in,
Pakai chu tahsan’in.

Verse 2
Lei ngailouvin alengui gam thenga,
Kile na thu seilouvin chen;
Leiset hi lengvaina gam hin,
Pallai ni achul’in akem jitai.

Verse 4
Aw phat hung lhung ding chu kangah lel’e,
Kipana gal’a nei puiyin;
Aw kikhen lou ding lung deite,
Tonsot in pah-un Lhandampu Pakai.

songs.title: 98. CROSS PHUNG JONIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (John 6:37)

Verse 1
Cross phung jonin ka hunge,
Mi genthei hesoh lengvai ;
Keima mi chonse chungnung,
Tun vang lhatdam ka chang tai.

Chorus
Pakai Nang ka tahsan’e,
Calvary van Kelngoi nou ;
Ka kun’e na Cross noiya,
Nei lungset’in nei huh in.

Verse 2
Chonset’in eihen sot tai,
Lungin Nang ka lha ngaiyin ;
Nem heocha neikou kajai,
Ka hung tai Nang lim jonin.

Verse 3
Kalung le kanei jouse,
Abonchan Nang ka petai ;
Ka lhagao le ka tahsa,
A bonchan Nanga hihen.

Verse 4
Jesu hung keima hinna,
Aman kei eisop theng tai ;
Atonsot atonsot’in,
Loupi jing hen Kelngoinou.

songs.title: 98. PAH-UN LHANDAMPU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vang eipe diuvin van’a,
Vai ahom kit tai;
Eden kotkhah ahong kit tai,
Lut’in Zion kho avah tai.

Chorus
Pah-un, pah-un Lhandampu,
Kelngoinou ahung tai;
Lem’un Hallelujah Amen.
Hallelujah, Huhhing dingin ahung tai.

Verse 2
Jan la-ngei tah chun leiset hi,
Angui jenge;
Eden’a lhute athou tai,
Hoi ham sun ahsi atiu chu.

Verse 3
Leng jouse leng le Zion a,
Vaihompa chu;
Mihemten sumil thei lou ding,
Alungsetna akidange.

Verse 4
Alem la sauvin Vanna,
Mithengte jousen;
Twiso get le leiset jong hin,
Zion lo hen Hallelujah.

songs.title: 98. PAKAI PEN NIKHO ALHUNG KITTAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai pen nikho alhung kittai,
Silung lengvai te lung akaithouve,
Vannoi hil un Bethlehem lhang chunga,
Ginchat na lhang leng galkaiyin.
O Pakai nunnem Nang in neikai hoiyin,
Na chun le jo ngaiya senlai navang naka
Na mun chu kangai.

Verse 2
Bethlehem ahsi avah kittai,
Eden lhan kotkhah sung avah kittai,
Khang in thouvun Eden kho avahtai,
Lungtup gam chu jon tau hite.

Verse 3
Kangai ngeiye Bethlehem lhang chu,
Thangvan toni kol a apang leptai,
Bong insung a Pakai lengvai tah chu,
Achun nu Maryâ€™n a pomâ€™e.

Verse 4
Anom ngeiye Pakai na gam chu,
Keidin Bethlehem lhang avah kittai,
Tila pi le pu ten amu phah lou,
Saron pah lem in leng ute.

songs.title: 99. KA MONMO KALUNGHEL NI HIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka monmo kalunghel ni hin,
Hi leiset gam hi kavet le;
Lungdon meipin lhangtin akhun,
Ka lhagao lengvaiyin avah.

Chorus
Aw nei puiyin damlai,
Lungdon meipi jing noiya hin;
Nei umpin lang aw ka Pakai,
Ka kalai bang tange.

Verse 2
Aw kalungdon ahsi kal lam,
Van mitheng lung khat’a lenna;
Kei mongmo lengvai ka ka-na,
Lungdon meipi jing noiya hin.

Verse 3
Aw kalhagao nalung donna,
Hi leiset gam hi dalhan lang;
Vakhu bangin galengin lang,
Olna gam khopi nom’a chun.

Verse 4
Chu a chun lungdon le ka-na,
Um taponte Canaan gam’a;
Eilhandampu nei puiyin lang,
Olna gam khopi nom’a chun.

songs.title: 99. NANG NAHUNG DING O LHANDAMPU
99. VANG EIPI DIUVIN VANâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vang eipe diuvin vanâ€™a vai ahom kittai,
Eden kotkhah ahong kittai,
Lut in Zion kho avah tai.
Pah un Pah un Lhandampu,
Kelngoi nou ahung tai,
Lem un Hallelujah Amen,
Hallelujah huhhing ding in ahungtai.

Verse 2
Jan la ngei tah chun leiset hi angui jenge,
Eden a lhute athou tai,
Hoiham sun ahsi atiu chu.

Verse 3
Leng jouse Leng le Zion a vaihom pa chu,
Mihem ten sumil thei lou ding,
Alungset na akidange.

Verse 4
Alem la sauvin van Mitheng te jouse chun,
Twiso get le leiset jong hin,
Zion lo hen Hallelujah.

songs.title: 100. BIBLE A THU UM HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Bible a thu um hi Thupha chungnung pen,
A thu jouse hinna le sochat na,
Mi thisa jong thoukit ding in asei ye,
Lhagao mangsa hindoh kit na ahi.
Bible thu ngai un, Bible thun nung un,
Mang un Bible Thupha hinna kidang.

Verse 2
Ngaiphau vin Bible gou kemlou chungnung thu,
Lhagao hinna le sochat na ahi,
A man jat jon leiset miâ€™n simthei lou ding,
Hol in Lhagao phattheina kidang hi.

Verse 3
Mi lamvai te ding a Bible meivah pha,
Khangthah dan neilou dinga jong phat na,
Mi chonse dinga hinna le lung olna,
Teh le khang dinga hibou Thupha pen.

songs.title: 100. ITI NOP HITAM PAKAIYA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat sl (I Peter 5:7)

Verse 1
Iti nop hitam Pakaiya,
Ki ngaiya cholngah ding ;
Na thahat chun nei tung dingin,
Ka lung lhahna channa.

Chorus
Na lunggel lungkhamna jouse,
Sep lhan abonchan Achunga ;
Na lunggel lungkhamna jouse,
Aman na khankho ding agelnai.

Verse 2
Ka lunggel jouse Nachunga,
Ngaleng Nalung ahi ;
Ka lung hesoh genthei jouse,
Nangman na hesoh nai.

Verse 3
Na mi lungset khoto ging chan,
Nangma lam jeng kavei ;
Ka lungdon hesoh na channa,
Nangman lungmon neipen.

Verse 4
I bol’a ka lungkham ding ham ?
Khonung thu ding gelna ;
Ipi ka kichatpi ding ham ?
Pakaiya kingai leng.

songs.title: 100. J. SEM LA (Mt. 6:43)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyin Pakai thusei,
Kagam hol masauvin;
Chutile nangho din,
Kigot peh-un nate.

Chorus
Ngai cheh-uvin Pakai sei chu,
Avanghom chang cheh din;
Hol’ute lungthim’in,
San ding san akoisoh tai.

Verse 2
Kilungset’un nangho,
Kamin’in tao cheh-un;
Nadei chan’u penge,
Ka thutep nit jingun.

Verse 3
Ka minin kipah-un,
Keiman umpiu vinge;
Nadei chan’u penge,
Ka thutep nit jingun.

Verse 4
Chubang phattheina chu,
Hol’u hite eihon;
I-lung sutheng’u tin,
Pathen naiyu hite.

songs.title: 101. HINKHO DEILAI ACHOMâ€™E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinkho deilai achomâ€™e, thingna pullai abange,
Changphal kansa abange kiging un,
Hin nikho akem jinge,
Vangset nihung lhung inte,
Thina hung lhung loi inte kiging un.
Phat hom in kiging un,
Jesun na kou kou lai uhin kiging un,
Setna a umsot leu chun,
Hinna kot hon hom lou in,
Nalut phat kikhel inte kiging un.

Verse 2
Pahcha hoilai pulloi in, khangdong hoi ache loi in,
Nang umsot ding nahipoi kiging un,
Pathen lhan na kou lai hin,
Umhih un ngaisah lou in,
Manna lamâ€™a chun nate kiging un.

Verse 3
Phat akem tultul jinge, thi vaihom ahung naije,
Jesu khut a kikhum un man gang un,
Vangset na ahung lhunâ€™a,
Na lhagao man masang in,
Aloupina chu sim un kiging un.

Verse 4
Hilna thu chu ngaiphauvin,
Pakai chu tuhdet leu chun,
Van mi jouse kipah ding kiging un,
Chonset muthim dalhau vin,
Jesu chu tahsan un lang,
Van lam jon in tun cheuvin kiging un.

songs.title: 101. PARADISE (L.Th. 38)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Peogal gamnom chu kalhun tengle,
Leiset hung mang ding hi dalha tang ting;
Tahsa hinna hi ngaita ponge,
Hinna thing le Pakai tuh tange.

Chorus
Kangai tave peogal gamnom,
Thoukit chate lenna kholai chu;
Thina puldou le ka-na umlou,
Aw peogal kei din hung kihoh-in.

Verse 2
Chu gam kavet le kalung aleng,
Kelngoinou le alhatsate lenna;
Lei ngailouvin einung ngat tauve,
Chu gam chu kalhun thei hitale.

Verse 3
Ajou tengle kho hungvah inte,
Ti kahet le ka kapet kahaiyin;
Lei gentheinan eitomte ho hi,
Dalha tange chu gamnom’a chun.

Verse 4
Chu-a chun malaiya lemsate,
Kipah-in aleng’ui genthei chate;
Lhandampu le alhatsate to,
Kikhen louva ilen phat diu chu.

songs.title: 101. UM KAHI JESU KHUT’A
102. JESU LHALIM NOIYA CHUN
102. PAKAI NA LHAGAO VIN NEIPUIYIN LANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai na Lhagao vin neipuiyin lang,
Leimun lungdon kana gam ahi,
Lhatdam na kulpi sung a leng ding in,
Na mite pui jing in lang.

Chorus
O van gamâ€™a neipuiyin,
Thim le lung donna jouvin,
Eidougal setgal kajo tei ding,
Navah a chun leng tange.

Verse 2
Pakai Lhagao kakomâ€™a aum le,
Kamau gamthip akem jitai,
Leiset lungdon gim kathoh jou tengle,
Kalen ding na gamâ€™a chun.

Verse 3
Pakai na Lhagao vin neipui in lang,
Sang tamtah manna gam ahi,
Manglou vin gamtheng chu neilhut teiyin,
Pakai loupina gel in.

Verse 4
Lungdon na jouse kipah in nathoh,
Genthei Lalpan panpin neiti,
Thi geiyin Lhagao vin neipuiyin lang,
Mun loupi lhun masang sen.

songs.title: 102. THE LAMB THAT WAS SLAIN. (L.Th. 66)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw nang ka Pakai le ka Pathen dei,
Loupina le pachatna te thil boltheinate chu;
Na thenna jal’in mutheiyin aum,
Nangin ijakai nasem’in nadei bangtah in aum;
Hichu Pathen ahi.
Kelngoinou thasa-Pa chu,
Laltouna atouve;
Hi leiset thu hi atan ding,
Vantil thengten ati.

Verse 2
Laltouna atouvin athilsemte,
A-ang’a kun’un malsomna le pachatna chuto;
Loupina vaihomnate jouse toh,
Tonsot in umjing ta hen tia asei chu kanajai;
Hing jing til le te chun.

Verse 3
Hiche pon bangleh sil ho khu koi ham?
Hoiya kona hung’u ham, tin kei eina donguvin;
Keiman ajah a, “Na henai” kati,
Aman kaheng a hiche thu hi hechen leng tia asei,
Hung kondohna ahi.

songs.title: 103. HI LEISET GENTHEINA GAM A HIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hi leiset gentheina gamâ€™a hin,
Nopna gam le ngaite lenna,
Ka ngai ngeiye O ka Pakai,
Nopna umlou leiya.
Na gam nom kangaiye, nalungset kinem in,
Set le gimna gamâ€™a, kamong joupoi Pakai.

Verse 2
Hinna Lal thengpen Pakai Christa,
Nei lhamon in na thisan chun,
Na thutep lhin ding kangah e,
Sochat na hinkem lou.

Verse 3
Thina galâ€™a gammon ka ngai chu,
Pakai sem gam nom chu ahi,
Hinna thingphung lim noiya chun,
Nisa vah jong ngailou.

Verse 4
Chitin namtin Pakai Lengho Leng,
Cham na le lung olna gamâ€™a,
Neilhut in Salem thah nomâ€™a,
Mitheng te len na a.

songs.title: 103. KILHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gentheinate hin eibom’e,
Leiset chunga hin;
Pakai min’a kagol ngaiho,
Khenna ni asoh-e.

Chorus
Aw kikhen theilou ding (2)
Aw kagol dei ho to;
Pakai Lhagao Theng hinsol’in,
Niseh-in nei umpin.

Verse 2
Nisim le jankho asot’e,
Namin vahchoinan;
Aw kikhenna ni asoh-e,
Kagol dei ho salam.

Verse 3
Namin vahchoi ahung lhunge,
Ka lhagao kipah;
Nalungsetna lhalim noiya,
Van mi umchan ka-thoi.

Verse 4
Eiho kikhen jeng jongleu hen,
Pathen’in eimui;
Genthei thoh-a ka kapet hin,
Saron pah neisal’in.

Verse 5
Goldei teho ikikhennau,
Ni ahung lhung tai;
Damsel cheh-in kikhen taute,
Pan eipuileu jing hen.

songs.title: 103. PATHEN HENGA TAO DINGA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat d. (Sol. 3:1)

Verse 1
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnema kunpet hi,
Iti noptam Huhhingpa anga taopet hi !
Tahsan’a bel ihiu le Aman eihuhhing diu,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !
Tao hi lung ol pet, (2 vei)
Chol dinga olna ahi,
Tao hi iti nop tam !

Verse 2
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnem’a kunpet hi,
“Nalung khamnau jouse ka anga seplhauvin” ;
Tia lungset khoto tah a eiseipeh tengu le,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !

Verse 3
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnem’a kunpet hi,
Ama lung tohte gentheina amu soh in ;
Alungset lhaving noiya ni tinin ahoiye,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !

songs.title: 104. HALLELUJAH PAKAI LOUPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jerusalem khopi nom chu Zion,
Goldeite le van mithengte lenna;
Michonsete chu Pakai jal’in,
Lengunte chu gam nilhum louna gam’a.

Chorus
Hallelujah Pakai loupi hihen,
Hallelujah hihen Hallelujah;
Mi huhhing dingin ahung penge,
Aw Pakai Immanuel Hallelujah.

Verse 2
Cross chunga chun thisan lu alonglhai,
Jesu thisan loupi calvary a;
Chonset thenna dinga hung long chu,
Aloupi Pakai thisan Hallelujah.

Verse 3
Ahung kit mitin kikhop ni tengle,
Damun Pakai sosalna Jubilee;
Chapangte kipana Pakai chu,
Hosana sam’un chungnungpen chapa chu.

Verse 4
Jerusalem kipana Pakai chu,
Jerusalem kipana Pakai chu;
Pakai min’a hungte kipah-un,
Aloupi Pakai thisan Hallelujah.

songs.title: 104. JING NISO EMSEL’A KAJING THO TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. m. (Psalms 17:15)

Verse 1
Jing niso emsel’a ka jingtho teng,
Nisa hoi chun lhumtih nei talou ding ;
Tonsotna avah emhoi chullou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Chorus
Kalung lhaisel ta ding, (2 vei)
Jing niso emsel’a ka jingtho teng ;
Kalung lhaisel tading, (2 vei)
Jing niso emsel’a ka jingtho teng.

Verse 2
Na loupi mailhai mel chu kamu teng,
Lhatsa nacha deite na ngongkoi ding ;
Lungset thilpeh-in kot chu nahon teng,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Verse 3
Che masa ka ngaicheng mel kamu teng,
Iti kipang’em ken ngongkoi cheh ding;
Ka dinga naphat ken simjoulou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Verse 4
Eihuhhingpa Christa mel kamu teng,
Kei jal’a athi ken sumil lou ding ;
Tonsot chullou lan ken vahchoi tange,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

songs.title: 104. THENNA DING PHAT
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thenna ding phat nei in na Pathen hou in,
Ama toh umjing in athun kivah in,
Pathen chate ho jong kihou thei pin lang,
A hotmo te hunlang sumil lou jen in.

Verse 2
Thenna ding phat nei in athu nit jing in,
Jesu chu guhthim in atam jon houvin,
Jesu ve jing le chun Ama toh bang ding,
Na gol in amu ding A-um chan bang thon.

Verse 3
Thenna ding phat nei in lam kihil sah in,
A ang sung a kon in jammang lou jen in,
Gim hesoh na ahi na Pakai jui in,
Jesu lamkat jing in athu tahsan in.

Verse 4
Thenna ding phat nei in nalung olsah in,
Na lungput jouse chun anoiya lut in,
A vaihom thun nung in kipuisah jing in,
Ngailut bulpi ahi Vanâ€™a puilut thei.

songs.title: 105. NGAIYUN MICHONSE TEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. d.

Verse 1
Ngaiyun mi chonse ten, Leiset manni thu ding ;
Leng hat chungnung tah khat Laltouna atouve.
Hung kum teiding Jesu Christa, (2 vei)
Vantil theng asang aja toh.

Verse 2
Leiset gam kimvel’a, A vantil asol’a ;
Molle twiya cheuva, mi chomkhom sohkei ding.
Jesun michonsete jouse, (2 vei)
Alelut ding meidil sunga.

Verse 3
Chu tengle mi chonpha, Ama lung toh jouse ;
Van’a apuitou ding, Pathen lhai la sading.
Gou kemlou hin kemlou pentin, (2 vei)
Ol kemlou nop kemlou pentin ;
Kemlouva nomsa jing jeng ding.

Verse 4
Mi chonsete vang chu, ago ding meidil’a ;
A thu ngailouse chu, leiset’a um laiya.
Gim tan neilouna meikonga, (2 vei)
Tonsot’a gimthoh jing jeng ding.

songs.title: 105. NISUN VAH A CHUN CHEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nisun vah a chun chen nipi vah a chun,
Jing a pahcha pah le janlai dailhah in,
Nitin in mason in dettah in pang un,
Lamtin a Jesu jui in.

Chorus
Jui un keiman jong ka juiye
Jui in nitin in jui un,
A man napui le na chan,
Jui in Jesu chu a lam tin ah.

Verse 2
Sun nisat emlai le janlai mu thimin,
Chamkang lou noulai le chuhlai go lon in,
A man nakou ngai in asei thun nung un,
Lamtin a Jesu jui in.

Verse 3
Nisa vah emlai le thimpi jing a jong,
Khopi huinun nale lungdon na a jong,
A mi ngailut gingchan akhon ni gei in,
A nung lhaso lou jen in.

songs.title: 105. THE NEW JERUSALEM. (R.S. 16)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Van’a Jerusalem thah nom tah,
Namin chu ka-pahcha ngeiye,
Itile ka gentheina bei ding,
Nom tah-a kipah cheh dingin;

Chorus
Itih tah le nang kamu ding chu,
Jerusalem thah nom tah-a;
Na in loupi vanchung gamnom chu,
Itih le kalhung thei tadem ?

Verse 2
Pathen Jerusalem thah nomtah,
Hichu itih le kalhung dem?
Hai louva kigopna ang’a chun,
Goldei jong kikhen kitlou ding;
Chua chun set beina ding aum,
Eden hon sanga nom kit ding;
Chua nisa sanga vahjo ding,
I-Pau Pathen maikoh-a chun.

Verse 3
Khopi nomtah le kipana dim,
Chu-a lhun kal kangah lel’e;
Kaset poh jouse chu kadalhan,
Nunglam’a huipi anunge;
Gentheina, lengvaina, gimna chun,
Eisunoh kit thei talou ding;
Jerusalem kho chu kalhun teng,
Tonsot’a set po-talou ding.

Verse 4
Pakai Jesu pachat la sauvin,
Chua lim le kipa aum;
Hai louva sopi chu dinga um,
Jesu vahchoi lasa dingin;
Van’a Jerusalem thah nomtah,
A lhunkal chu kangah lel’e;
Chua chu gimna um theilou ding,
Kipana loupipen ahi.

songs.title: 106. CHOLNA JANTHIM LUNGDONNA HIN
106. LILY PAH LAL IMMANUEL.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Amin eihil Zion gam hoi chu,
Ngaiyin nitin’in kagel’e;
Nei hung puiyin nakom’a,
Luigal gamnom’a chun.

Chorus
Aw ka ngaiye eilhandampu,
Lili pah Lal Immanuel;
Damna twi thengin eilonkhum,
Aw kangai lhatsate in.

Verse 2
Setna le lhepna gal alen’e,
Ahi genthei keiho dou din;
Aw van Lhagao hung lengin,
Setna gal beina din.

Verse 3
Lungdon ngahna ding mun umtalou,
Hi leiset gimna gam a hin;
Phungtin jouse kikhopna,
Van Canaan gam hoitah.

Verse 4
Calvary lhang thingpel chunga chun,
Ahung thoh tai Pakai Jesun;
Lhatna na chu tong jouvin,
Hallelujah Amen.

songs.title: 106. PHAT HI AKEM JINGIN LEI NOPNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat hi akem jingin lei nopna amang ji,
Leiset a kipana akim theipoi,
Pakai hung leng in o niloupi lhunsah in,
Genthei chaten leiset gimna adalha nom.

Chorus
O Eden thah nomâ€™a chun neipuiyin lang,
Lunghel a khen pisa hotoh kileng khom le,
Kakipanau kim in vahchoi tau vinge,
Leiset hi ngai tapou vinge Na gamâ€™a chun.

Verse 2
Na ding a thohten chu gam chu akinep pin,
Lei kipana adiuva pahthei lou,
Zion mipi ho le lungset na Lal mel chu,
Ni loupi hung kilang ding chu ave chimpoi.

Verse 3
Lei lungdon lungin hesoh na jouse noiya,
Tahsan hon kipa la asa jingui,
Adiuvin khovah hen Salem thah nomâ€™a chun,
Napui khom na ding ni ngaiyin agaldot ui.

songs.title: 107. KA NGAH JING E KA PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kangah jing e Ka Pakai, Lei genthei thim jing noiya,
Nei holnau Salem khopi, O keiman ka ngaitai,
Leiset genthei na le, Thim noiya hin leng jong leng,
Lungset a eihol pau chu, Ken kangai bang lou ding,

Chorus
Van loupi Eden thah nom chu,
Lungdon um louna gam nom chu,
O itih le hung lhung tang em?
Na tonsot Lalna gam Emnom hoitah chu.

Verse 2
Hung naiyin Eilhandampu, Leiset a gal ahat e,
Thisan a nalhat sa te, Lung dong in akap e,
Leiya nalen laiya, Na lung donna Calvary,
Melmate ahung naiye, Na gam doudal te chu.

Verse 3
O hoikom ham Lhandampu, Zion lhang galâ€™a
monna,
Set soptheng a mi lungset, Ka diuva na louna,
Chonset thenna kulpi, Na tonset vankho le veng,
Lhatdam cha nalim noiya, Nomâ€™a alennau chu.

Verse 4
O leiset hi hung mang ding, Loupina jouse jong hi,
Lhandampun mi hin khom ding, Ken leiset pelt a ding,
Christa lungset te chuâ€™ Lal loupi na chang unte,
Lungset na akinongâ€™e, Nomun Halleluyah.

songs.title: 107. KIPAMAN HOM DINGA PAKAI HUNG TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl (Sol. 3:1)

Verse 1
Kipaman hom dinga Pakai hung teng,
Isan diu hinpo nan tem ?
I tahsan jingu ahung toh nadem ?
I nga jing Pakai Jesu.

Chorus
Ti nau hitem phasa dem cheh a um,
Kahi van chunga kal ding ;
I kigin jingu ahung toh nadem ?
Ama lam jeng chu isan jinga.

Verse 2
Jingpi phalvah-in hung kum khattou hen,
Eiho eihin kou taule ;
Pakai anga inatoh ikum teng,
Apha lheh e tinan tem ?

Verse 3
Aman eidalhah peh u tahsan chu,
Pha tah a ching jing dinga ;
Lung thengsel’a ichin cheh nah uvem ?
Van’a nop channa dinga.

Verse 4
Jan khangkimin i-Pakaiyu hung leh,
I nga jing hung toh nantem ?
Kiging jinga um chu anunnom ding,
Van’a tonsotna nom ding.

songs.title: 107. LHANG CHANGKHAT AUM’E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhang chang khat aum’e,
Gamla tah gam khat’a;
Twikhanglen dumjeju gal lam’a,
Chu gam’a lhanga chun;
Mikhat thi din achei,
Vannoi ding le nang le kei dingin.
Lhang chu kageldoh teng,
Ka mitlhi along’e;
Apanga athoh chu kahin mui.

Verse 2
Lam dunga haisam’in,
Vannoi chonset pohnan;
Linglukhuh khuh mi khat ahunge,
Abung’in Cross apun;
Mipi ho anga’a chun,
Lhanga chun akal’e thip khen chan.

Verse 3
Athoh gim atan-gei,
Yin anuisat’uve;
Aloite lungset’a a kapet chun,
Achunga athoh gim;
Vang chun apaopoh poi,
Lhanga chun athisan along lhai.

Verse 3
Chutah chun thim jingin,
Songpi akeh gamtai;
Apen chun van lung angui sohtai,
Hichu thina thoh-a;
Van Leng awgin ahi,
Apen lainat um chun van aloi.

Verse 4
Nisan amai sel’in,
Lingpi akihot’e;
Huhhinga that teho chunga chun,
Hinla Pathen Kelngoi;
Nou chun thina jouvin,
Athasau chu athoudoh kittai.

songs.title: 108. CROSS CHU INJOT NA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Cross chu injot na lampia kanei tei ding,
Chulou chu lamdang umlou,
Van kotpi hoi chu keiman mulou ding,
Ka mansah le Cross lampi chu.
Van in jotna Cross ahi (2)
Kache pum hin kalam mu kanomâ€™e,
Van in jotna Cross ahi.

Verse 2
Thisan bena lampi chu kaho tei ding,
Ei huhhing pa chenna chu,
Van chung innom jon a kakal tou ding,
Lhagao Pathen toh chen na chu.

Verse 3
Vannoi lampi chu kalha doh tai keiman,
A chung ho kit lou hel ding,
Jesun â€œHung inâ€ tin ka in ka jonâ€™e,
Kot phunga einga jing na chu.

songs.title: 108. JING NISO VAH LOUPI NIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. m. (Gen.49:10)

Verse 1
Jing niso vah loupi nia Mihem Chapa ahung nile,
A vah loupi chungnung chu imu dingu ;
Kol kimvel’a kona amite akoukhom teng chule,
Alhatsa te kikhop loupi ni hi ding.
Kikhoppi chungnung ni hi ding,
Nop kemlou gam’a kikhoppi loupi ;
Chungnung ni hi ding,
Kikhoppi chungnung ni hi ngei ding,
Lhatsa hingte kikhop loupi ni hi ding.

Verse 2
Jesun nunnoma thite akouva atho tengu le,
Lhankhuh thim sung le twikhanglen’a kona ;
Vou kikhel’a vanlai jola alamto dingu ahi,
Iti kipa thanop a umta dingem.

Verse 3
Van khopi vah hoi sunga chu inhoi tamtah imuve,
Olna twipi pang chu ilhun tengu le ;
Thinan eikhensau i-ngai chengseu toh ichenkhom tengle,
kikhop ni kilamto loupi ni hi ding.

Verse 4
Leng chu hung tei ding ahi, ahung phat anai tul tul tai,
Ei tepnau nopni loupi chu imu diu ;
Chuteng le mitphet kah louva ivouvu hi kikhel ding,
Ama koma ichen jing dingu hita.

songs.title: 108. PAKAI VAHCHOINA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Namtin chitin le phung tin’in,
Vanlal leng lungdamna dingin;
Lungthim theng le chonnem tah in,
Iphei phung’u chu son’ute.

Chorus
Pakai deilou chungnungpen,
Power le force chu mang’a;
Pakai Houbung chu sugenthei,
Adeilou chungnungpen ahi.

Verse 2
Ama mithengpen Paul’in jong,
A power le force chu paiyin;
Vanlal leng lungdamna dingin,
Apheiphung’u ason ta-e.

Verse 3
Ama Zachaeus lengpa jong chun,
Namtin zang vaise kai adon;
Pakai Christa amu phat’in,
Akaidon chu lel’in alei.

Verse 4
Akoi akoi hita jongleh,
Keima eijuinom jouse chun;
Ama genthei khoh salouvin,
Nitinin athingpel pu hen.

songs.title: 109. GEISANG LOU JEN UN MI CHONSE HO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Geisang lou jen un mi chonse ho,
Christa na hinna diu aume,
Tunin nakouve aw nem tah in,
â€œHinna pengeâ€ ati.

Chorus
Nomhen nomhen Pakai Christa min,
Ka chonset eisop lheng peh pa chu,
Akomâ€™a tonsotâ€™a kachen ding,
Van chunga in theng a.

Verse 2
Jesun na kouve ngai in chonsen,
â€œHung un chapang hoâ€ hitin ati,
Hung loi un chonse lung leng vaite,
Pakai Christa sang in.

Verse 3
Khopho louvin umhih un mite,
Tuni hin Jesun nang na kouve,
Hung un mi chonse lungbei olmo,
Na chonset lung khel in.

songs.title: 109. RESURRECTION
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Solam jing ninou hung son,
Thao namtui mantam choiyin;
Jesu long thao nu dingin,
Mary lhan lam’a achei.

Verse 2
Avan ngai amulou chun,
Adatmon alung kham’e;
Amitlhi jong along lhan,
Pakai tho ahet phat’in.

Verse 3
Chuin Jesu aw ajan,
Lung gentheina sumil’in;
Alung akipah phung tai,
Pakai tho ahet phat’in.

Verse 4
Pakai thu iti hat tam!
Muthim asumang theiye;
Ama ka-te jouse chu,
Amitlhiu atheh hul chun.

songs.title: 109. TONSOTNA CHENNA DING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is Flat sl (Matt. 7:25)

Verse 1
Tonsot na chenna ding,
Hoi laiya in sa nahim ?
Khopi hui mutlhuh theina ham ?
Chonset neldi chung hintem?

Chorus
Song chunga hin hung san,
In hung san apang det din ;
Christa jeng bou, Christa jeng bou,
Sochatna Songpi ahi.

Verse 2
Khopi hui anunna,
Na in ahin nuh teng le ;
Nellei chunga insa nangma,
Lung mongin umnan natem ?

Verse 3
Khopi hui nun kah in,
In mundet ding ki ngaiton ;
Na lung gel��in hung san tu man,
Longlou Songpi chunga hin.

songs.title: 110. CHUNG VAN GAMâ€™A KA IN GOTSA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chung van gamâ€™ a ka in gotsa um,
Ana ngaito din Pakai cheta,
Lhatdam na gam nomâ€™a chun,
Lhatdam sa lungset te toh,

Chorus
Lhatdamâ€™a vahchoi la sa jing ding in.
Kum asot um ngailou, Kipana gamâ€™a chun,
Gim genthei umta lou,
Chu munâ€™a chun khat vei ichen ding.

Verse 2
Kei ding in Lhandampu hung thita,
Ka Lhagao huhdoh na ding jeh in,
Set dimna leiset a hin, Keija konâ€™a peldoh ding,
Van gam nom hoitah a cheng jing ding in.

Verse 3
Phat tampi che jing ding o Pakai,
Keima neivop jing e ti kahei,
Mang lou helin Pakaiyin,
Ichen khom na diu lim a,
Vetnom vetda umlou chamna lengta.

Verse 4
Chung gam nom sana khopia chun,
Lhilon hesoh genthei umta lou,
Kipana la sa jing ding,
Cholle nan beisoh ta ding,
Nunnom jing ding chung gam Innomâ€™a chun.

songs.title: 110. GAM LOUPITAH HUNG LHUNG DING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl (Luke 21:28)

Verse 1
Gam loupitah hunglhung ding ka nga jing chu van chunga um,
A kum tina mithengte punkhomna chu ;
Ni kemin chu gam loupi hunglhun ding chu asunaiye,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.

Chorus
He, Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anaita e,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anaita e ;
Kigo demin vo kalung, sumkon’a eihin kou ding,
Pakai Jesun, hung lang ding loupi tah a.

Verse 2
Pathen gam loupi le aloupi gotsa chu kinemin,
Chule Pakai hungna ding lam kat jingin ;
Hichun vannoi leiwet chonsetnan eihen eihung lha ding,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.

Verse 3
Pathen gam hunglhun ni le Pakai ngaitah chu imu diu,
Gam hunglhunna Pakai chu hung kilang ding !
Halleluiyah athisan’a eilhatpau chu vahchoiyun,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.

Verse 4
Vannoi leiset min angah sottan alung lhadel tauve,
Tijat’in mihemte lung adonghel tai ;
Pathen gam Thupha chu hilleu hitin suhal’u hite,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding anai tah jeh hin.

songs.title: 110. NISA SANGA VAHJO (S.S. 872)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ni sanga jong vah loupi jo chu,
Avah kalung sunga;
Leiset vah sanga vahjo chu,
Jesu kei vah ahi.

Chorus
O phattheina ni avah-e,
Monna le kipana adim’e;
Lal mel kipa um kavet’in,
Ka lhagao kipana dim.

Verse 2
Pakai kavop in kalung sunga,
Lhatdamna twi along;
Kalung sunga kipa gin chu,
Phatnan apahjou tai.

Verse 3
Kalung sunga kipana aum,
Kinepna vahchoina;
Tuhin kipanan eipah sah,
Van kipana eihil.

songs.title: 111. GALDOT TEM UN VAN KHOPI CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Galdot tem un Van khopi chu,
Kikhen louna gam chu alang,
Ikikhen nau ni alhunge, Ka ngai kikhen louna.
Achom ngeiye lei kipana, Pahbang in achul kit jin, Kikhen lou thei ihipouve,
I lennau adan jeh in.

Verse 2
O ka ngai kikhen louna gam,
Nomâ€™a ilen na diu mun chu,Itih tah le ahung lhung dem, Kikhen louna khopi.

Verse 3
Genthei thoh a ikikhen u, Itih le kikhom u hitem,
Leiset gim mun ikhel phat le,
Kipan kikhom ute.

Verse 4
Ka ngai kikhen louna khopi,
Leiset a ikikhen u hi,Lungdon ngah na ding aumpoi, Leiset gim mun ahi.

Verse 5
Ikikhen a kaka bang hin,
Van mun loupi kagal dot e,
Kikhen aumlou kahet in, O lhunkal kangah lel.

Verse 6
Van Mitheng te le goldei ten, Lungset in nei hung umpiuvin, Leiset gimnan eikhen jitai,
Ka ngaito chim thei lou.

songs.title: 111. KAKIPAH TA-NGEIYE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdonna chonset jousen eibom’e,
Thina lam’a pui din;
Tahsan’in thina kanung ngat’e,
Eilhandampun eihin kou.
Ka kipah ta-ngeiye tuvangin,
Lhandampu chonnem tah le milungset chun;
Ka lhagao ahuhhing kit tai.

Verse 2
Kelngoinou lenna lhang chu kalhun teng,
Kipa’n eilamton tin;
Thina jordan lui kagalkai teng,
Van golvahna lhata ding.

Verse 3
Kipana thah lunggel’a kanei hi,
Jesun eipeh ahi;
Leiset kipana sanga lengjo,
Van kipana kanei tai.

songs.title: 111. PATHEN SUMKON AGINNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A .Flat d. (I Cor. 15:52)

Verse 1
Pathen sumkon aginna lei hi aumlou teng chuleh,
Tonsot hinna khovah a niso tengle ;
Akhop teng alungtohte luipi pang gal langkhat lam’a,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka um ding.

Chorus
Chua min kikouna sunga,
Chua min kikouna sunga ;
Chua min kikouna sunga,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka um ding.

Verse 2
Chu ni jingkah vahhoiya Christan mithi athosah a,
Athokit loupi achanni diu chule ;
A lhenchomte kikhop nile a in’u vanchung gam’a,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka umding.

Verse 3
Pathen na tonging kate niso a pat nilhum geiyin,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seichoi lenge ;
Chule i-natoh ijoa ihin nikho bulhin tengle,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka umding.

songs.title: 112. HINKHO TWIPI KINONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinkho twipi kinong huipi hat natoa,
Mang soh a kingaito a nalung lhah teng,
Na phatthei na jouse aban chan sim in,
Pakai thilbol cheng chun kidang san nate.

Chorus
Na phatthei na abanchan sim in,
Amin sonlang abanchan sim in,
Pakaijin nabol peh chengse chu,
Pakai thilbol cheng chun kidang san nate.

Verse 2
Pohgih poa lungkham lung donga na umem?
Na put dinga kigot peh Cross chu gih sam?
Phatthei na sim le chun ginchat lel bei ding,
Sun nisa vah bang in vah jing tan nate.

Verse 3
Mi sum nei sel nei gam nei navet komle,
Christan natepsa hao seithei lou ngaiton,
Ahao choh joulou phatthei na chu sim in,
Tohphat man nasan ding vanâ€™a atame.

Verse 4
Hijeh chun gim genhei iti hah jongle,
Lunglha hih in Pathen achungnung pen e,
Phatheina sim in vantil in na ngah nai,
Na lam lhung keija na lhonpi diu ahi.

songs.title: 112. IDIN DINGU LENG ANG’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. d. (Jer. 15:19)

Verse 1
I din dingu Leng anga,
Vantil toh la isah diu ;
Olle van gam nom’a,
Lui pang em’a ilen diu ;
Pathen vahchoi la sading,
Olle van gam nom’a.
I din dingu Leng anga,
Vantilto la isah diu ;
Loupi hen Leng chungnung chu,
Halleluijah, Halleluijah !
I din diu Leng ang sunga.

Verse 2
Van’a jola kisa ding,
I din diu Leng ang sunga ;
Olle van gam nom’a,
Gim hesoh beisoh ta ding ;
I gimnau ichaisoh teng ;
Olle van gam nom’a.

Verse 3
Chen kalha thil lu choiyin,
Leng chungnung lamto dingin ;
Olle van gam noma,
Akhopi muh a kunin ;
Alhalim noiya umin,
Olle van gam noma.

songs.title: 112. KILHAHNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Galdot tem’un Van khopi chu,
Kikhen louna gam chu alang’
Ikikhennau ni alhunge,
Ka ngai kikhen louna.

Chorus
Achom ngeiye lei kipana,
Pah bangin achul kit jin;
Kikhen lou thei ihipouve,
Ilennau adan jeh hin.

Verse 2
Aw ka ngai kikhen louna gam,
Nom’a ilenna diu mun chu;
Itih tah le ahung lhung dem?
Kikhen louna khopi.

Verse 3
Genthei thoh-a ikikhen’u,
Itihle kikhom’u hitem?
Leiset gimmun ikhel phatle,
Kipa’n kikhom’ute.

Verse 4
Ka ngai kikhen louna khopi,
Leiset’a ikikhen’u hi;
Lungdon ngahna ding aum poi,
Leiset gim mun ahi.

Verse 5
Ikikhen’a ka-ka bang’in,
Van mun loupi kagaldot le;
Kikhen aumlou ka het’in,
Aw lhunkal ka ngahlel.

Verse 6
Van mithengte le goldeiten,
Lungset’in nei hung umpiuvin;
Leiset gimnan eikhen jitai,
Ka-ngaito chim theilou.

songs.title: 113. MELMA GAL ATAM’E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Noiya nahung kum chun aw Pakai,
Nadougal atam’e, hinna nanei jeh-in;
Jerusalem khosunga navahlen,
Napanpi ding mi anom umlou hitam?
Nalung donna panpi dingin.
Aumpoi nalungdon kinepna dingin,
Nachanglhah nehpi hon nadalha tauve;
Vaipo Pilat thutanna ang’a,
Melma gal atam’e, themchanna gol hilou.

Verse 2
Twichung le gamtin’a navahlen,
Najuinom atam’e, hinna nanei jeh-in;
Anatnau jouse nasuhdam jeh chun,
Nathina ding phat ahung nai phat vang chun;
Pakai najui ngamta pouve.

Verse 3
Pakai thina ni ahunglhun chun,
Achanglhah nehpi ho chu hoiya um tauvam?
Calvary lhang jon’in apui tauve,
Alua linglukhuh chu akhuhsah uvin;
Calvary lhang ajotpi tauve.

songs.title: 113. MUTHIM UM TALOU DING.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Psalms 23:5)

Verse 1
Muthim um talou ding Jesu hung teng, (3 vei)
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a. (2 vei)
Muthim um talou ding Jesu hung teng,
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.

Verse 2
Lungdonna beita ding Jesu hung teng,(3 vei)
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.

Verse 3
Kana um talou ding Jesu hung teng. (3 vei)
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.

Verse 4
Kikhen kit talou ding Jesu hung teng,(3 vei)
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.

songs.title: 113. PHATTHEI NA GOHONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phatthei na gohong hung ju hen,
Lungset na eitepna sau,
Juh sah jing jeng hen niseh in,
Jesun hin juh lhah sah in.

Chorus
Phatthei na gohong,
Ka ngai jui phatthei na chu,
Mal khou tah in hinjuh sah in,
Hung juhen ka chung uva.

Verse 2
Go hung jun phatthei na gohong,
Lhagao thisa thoukit hen,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam jol a,
Hung chin in phatthei na go.

Verse 3
Phatthei na gohong hung ju hen,
Pathen hin sollhan tunin,
Ka lung nguisau halsah kit in,
Nei tepnau guilhun sah in.

Verse 4
Phatthei na gohong hung ju hen,
Juhsah in tuni tah in,
Ka setnau jouse sop theng in,
Jesu ka kou pet chau hin.

songs.title: 114. JESU HUNG KIT DING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Matt. 25:6)

Verse 1
Jesu hung kit ding khatvei le ahung ding kigingin,
Avan inom’a kon hung ding, ahung ding kigingin ;
I Pakaiyu dihtah ahi,
Ama lhenchomte nunnom ding ;
Apa Laltouna anga din, ahungding kigingin
Na neipa hung ding phat na kigin nam?
Lungmona kham’a na kigin nah em?
Jingkah, sun, jan hetthei lou ;
Ngim’a vah nam na thaomei,
Lung detna na ginnah em na neipa?

Verse 2
Ama leiya hungkit loi ding, ahung ding kigingin,
Alet alal akipan tai, ahung ding kigingin ;
Vana Halleluijah ging ding,
Huhhingna hinpo ding Jesun ;
Na Lengpa lamdot din navon, ahung ding kigingin.

Verse 3
Veuvin ahunge kigingin, ahung ding kigingin,
Sumkon’a eikouvah dingu, ahung phat kigingin ;
Lhagao nei mite jouse chu,
Thupi tana ahin kou chu,
Pakai anga idin cheh diu, ahung phat kigingin.

songs.title: 114. LEIYA PATHEN TAM JENG JONG LE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiya Pathen tam jeng jong le,
Ipau khat mai vanâ€™a aum e,
Pentil neilou hing jing Pathen ahi.
O ule nao nu le pa deite,
Tonsot hinkem lou neina din,
Lunghei un lang Pathen hin bel un.

Verse 2
Jouthei Pathen hinna neilou,
Kaneije tin eipui mang jitai,
Aneisun jong dana ahibouve.

Verse 3
Chonset bulpi nungjui pa chun,
Atoh le a kipana pen chu,
Lhagao damun a puilut hi ahi.

Verse 4
Ngaijun eisempau Pathen chun,
Ami mangsa te holdoh na din,
Achapa chang khat chu eihin peuve.

songs.title: 114. THU THENG PHA KA KINEPNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hi leiset damlai lungdon meipi jing noiya hin,
Vangsetna le gentheina ten eijui jinge;
Ahivangin ei Lhandampu,
Nathu thengpha kakihet’in;
Kalung donna jouse kipan hinle soh hen.
Thu thengpha ka kinepna,
Thu thengpha kei dia damna;
Pakai thu lhungthah loupi ahi,
Aw kei dia damna.

Verse 2
Setna huipi le lhepna gal’in eibom jongle,
Ka Lhandampu nalungsetna kulsunga hin;
Ka lhagao genthei hoiyintin,
Lhandampu thutep dihtah chu,
Imachan adoujou poi aw alungsetna.

Verse 3
Na lungsetna min loupitah chu ka kinepna,
Ke michonse lengvai genthei khoto na-in;
Tonsot nopna kot eihon peh,
Nathisan theng tah loupi chu,
Kalung sunga veijing hen aw Pakai Jesu.

songs.title: 115. AW TONI KALHUMJOU POI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lunghel’in lhangtin kagaldot le,
Lhummei akaiyin lungdonna gam ahin.
Aw toni kalhumjou poi leisetna hin,
Aw itih lunghelna gam ka dalhah-a,
Goldeite to nomtah-in kaleng dem?

Verse 2
Ka ngahlel goldeite mel mukal,
Einem jinge kimuto ding luigal’a.

Verse 3
Van khopi tollai kagaldot le,
ngei le Baja khongpi athong’e.

Verse 4
Ngai chim pong kate van ngei,
Achoinau la ngeiyin kalung alenge.

Verse 5
Leisetna genthei angahna bei,
Aw iti lunghel lungdon pul kadou dem?

Verse 6
Ka lel tai Pakai set gentheina,
Aw nei lhamon’in nakam dam aw ngei chun.

Verse 7
Leiset kum lhun ding ka ngahlel’e,
Kum lhun’a Pakai Christa lemkhom ding chu.

songs.title: 115. CHONSET SUHGENTHEI LHAGAO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Matt. 11:29)

Verse 1
Chonset suhgenthei lhagao ho,
Jesu tahsan leuchun ;
Aman olsah taovin nate,
Athu tahsan leu chun.

Chorus
Tahsan jengun, tahsan jengun,
Tahsan jengun tun ;
Huhhing teiding, huhhing tei ding,
Nang na huhhing ding.

Verse 2
Jesun athisan lu ason,
Hinna nom ei peuve ;
Thisan luiya chun kiphum’un,
Buh banga sop bang ding.

Verse 3
Jesu lampi dihtah ahi,
Olna gamnom jotna ;
Geisang louvin tahsan loiyin,
Phatthei nachan kim ding.

Verse 4
Ahile gam loupi jonin,
Hung lhauvin loi thenga ;
Gam loupia nom’a cheng ding,
Nop kemlou van in’ah.

songs.title: 115. LUNG IN VAN GAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lung in van gam ka ngai tole, Leiset gimna thoh
joute chu, Nui siuseu va um kagah mui, Akipanau la aw nem chu, Nitin olpet kanei theipoi,
O kalhunkal kangah lel ngeiye.
Neihin vetan Van lal Pakai, Lungset umle hatlou kahi, Chonset in thihkhau vin eihen,
Nagam hunglhun ding nom jong leng,
Thina le lung jinna te hin , nitin in eibomâ€™e.

Verse 2
Kei ngaito a hung thei hilou, Ti hi neihin hetsah jal
in, Lungdon in eisun khum jitai, Lhunkal kanga lel jal ahi, Pakai nagam theng nom em chu,
Ngaijin kalan kasa jitai.

Verse 3
Ima jouse ka ngaito le, Ka genthei je kaki het in,
Kaka khosot na ding bep in, Kappet chapang bang a nuina, Leiset a hin kamu joupoi,
Ngailou thei chu kahi tapoi.

Verse 4
Kappet naobang in nui ponge, Pakai neihung puima
sangsen,Ka lungdon na hi beipon te, Ka khankho akikhel ma hin, Vangam lhunkal ngalel jong leng,
Pakai hung lhung thei sam ponge.

Verse 5
Leiset gim mun jeng ajong hin, Pakai Nangin nei
umpi le, I louva kalungdon ding ham? Nei umpi ti kahet phat le, Kappet naobang in nui jing ting,
Leiset gimna hi miltange.

songs.title: 116. AMANG KON HUHDOH IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Amang kon huhdoh in athikon ngaiton,
Chonset khuh a konin ladoh loi in,
Chonkhel te chu hil in alhu kaithou in,
Huhhing Pakai Jesu thu seipeh in.
Amang kon huhdoh in athikon ngaiton,
Mi lungset them Jesun huhhing tei ding.

Verse 2
Ama hon angaisah lou hel vang uvin,
Aman angah jinge lung neng tah in,
Avel vel in damheu chan a kou jinge,
Tahsan pouleu a ngaidam ding ahi.

Verse 3
Mihem te lungsung set nan alo dimtai,
Hijeh chun Pakai leiyah ahunge,
Lungset khut in atham in asukhang in,
Athisa jong ahin sah kit jitai.

Verse 4
Amang kon huhdoh in nangma kin ahi,
Pakaiyin nangma thahat pennate,
Lhagao mang ding mi sangja aum uve,
Huhhing pan a lungset nau thu hil in.

songs.title: 116. LAL THISAN KAI PONLAP
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Dougal sat din neihin gonlang Pakai Jesu,
Twilen banga len jathim lal;
Gehen gal michonse ten.
Lal thisan kai ponlap galma a leh-un,
Haipoute Leng seipai ihiuve;
Set twipi kinong jeng jongle.

Verse 2
Ging lenglung gal mite sangin iloupiuve,
Chonse kikhom ho jatam gal;
I-kap Zion sepaite.

Verse 3
Gehen gal hi thisan vanga ijo tengu,
Vah hin leiset asalvah ding;
Leng Christa thohnat jeh chun.

Verse 4
Lallukhuh chu isan cheh diu sepai jousen,
I-ai diu theigol tanson toh;
Van Zion khopi a chun.

songs.title: 116. NAGACHE NAM NANGMA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat m. (Matt. 11:29)

Verse 1
Nagache nam nangma Jesu henga chun,
Athisana na kisop theng nam ?
A milungsetna chu na kinem nam nang?
Athisana na kisop theng nam?

Chorus
Athisan … thenga chun,
Na chonset nasop theng soh nah em?
Navon nen chu kicheh a ngimsel soh nam?
A thisan chun nasop thng soh nam?

Verse 2
Hung toh nantem ahung nile Moulang chun,
A thisan’a navon athen soh ;
Phasadem nan tem nalha vana kaldin,
A thisanin na kisop theng nam ?

Verse 3
Na chonset nen bena navon chu pailhan,
A thisanin kisil thengin tun ;
Nang dingin hinna twidung khat alonge,
Hia chun na chonset soptheng tan.

Verse 4
Niseh in Jesu koma na umjing nam?
Thisana na ki soptheng hinam?
Ama chu lungmona na neinam nangman ?
Athisana nakisoptheng nam?

songs.title: 117. AW VAN GAM’A NEI PUIYIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai na lhagaovin nei puiyin lang,
Lei mun lungdon kana gam hi;
Lhatdamna kulpi sunga leng dingin,
Namite pui jingin lang.

Chorus
Aw van gam’a nei puiyin,
Thim le lungdonna jouvin;
Eidougal setgal kajo tei ding,
Navah-a chun leng tange.

Verse 2
Pakai Lhagao kakom’a aumle,
Ka mao gamthip akem jitai;
Leiset lungdon gim ka-thoh jou tengle,
Kalen ding nagam’a chun.

Verse 3
Pakai nalhagaovin neipuiyin lang,
Sang tamtah manna gam’a hin;
Mang louvin gamtheng chu neilhut teiyin
Mun loupi lhun masangsen.

Verse 2
Lungdonna jouse kipah-in nathoh,
Genthei Lalpan panpin neitin;
Thi geiyin lhagaovin neipuiyin lang.
Pakai loupina gel’in.

songs.title: 117. HUNG UN CHRISTIAN TE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hung un Christian te lungkhat hiu hitin,
Seiphong leute sochatna Thupha,
Thinglhang gamsung a mi acheng jouse,
Satan bulpuvin akum tuâ€™ve.

Chorus
Hung un Christian te itha gom tou tin,
Sumang dingin idou satan hat,
Hung un Christian te tha gom tou hitin,
I thahat pen nau Jesu umna.

Verse 2
Mi sangja hijat hinna thu mulou,
Vetem tauvin akihen nau bul;
Bulpu ngaiton lang i-nop pai lhauvin,
Gasut lham ute bulpute chu.

Verse 3
Hung un sopite lung thah semu tin,
Chal sahna din Pakai Jesu gam;
Kiha bol cheh un tantih neilouvin,
Ni loupi nia pam chan louna din.

songs.title: 117. KAHENGA HUNG’UVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Matt. 11:28)

Verse 1
“Ka henga hung’uvin” ati Jesun,
Hinna Pakai nalung kipa sah chun ;
“Lungkham’a lung gentheiya umte ho”,
Ka henga hungun ken olsah inge.
Hungun keima henga hungun,
Ka henga hungun keiman olsah inge ;
Keiman ol penge, keiman ol penge.

Verse 2
Chonset pohna a pohgih lengvai ho,
Jesun na khoton na kouvui hungun ;
Na lungdon hesoh bei sohna dingin,
“Ka henga hungun keiman ol penge.”

Verse 3
Chonset le suhkhel’a thiding kon ho,
Khangun, Pathen kichauvin lung gel’un ;
Na tahsanmo pailhan tahsanin tun,
“Ka henga hungun keiman ol penge.”

songs.title: 118. JESUN NAKOU KOU LAIHIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Matt. 11:28)

Verse 1
Jesun nakou kou laihin, chonse hungin,
Nang dinga katao lai hin, chonse hungin ;
Ama neiphat tu ahi chonse hungin,
Ama hetphat tu ahi chonse hungin.

Verse 2
Na chonset poh nalel’em, chonse hungin,
Jesun napoh ngaijang ding ; chonse hungin,
Jesun nang dalha lou ding, chonse hungin,
Jesun tun nang nasange, chonse hungin.

Verse 3
Ama lungset sunga chun, chonse hungin,
Phattheina hung kisanin, chonse hungin ;
Jesun nakou petcha hin, chonse hungin,
Nang katao peh pet’u hin, chonse hungin.

songs.title: 118. REPENTENCE AND CONFESSION (L.Th. 208)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonse kahi Pakai nei ngaidam’in,
Thupha kahin choiye nakeng bul’a.
Ka vel’a na umlou le,
Leiset kei dia thina;
Van jong ka kana gam ding,
Aw nei umpin lang.

Verse 2
Monna ding dang umlou hi leiset’a,
Nangma bou kalumdal dougal ang’a.

Verse 3
Gamthip’a sottah kava mang nung hin,
Na aw kajan tuhin kahung naiye.

Verse 4
Tuhin Pakai nangin nei siltheng’in,
Nagam theng’a din melma dou tang’e.

songs.title: 118. VANNOIYA HIN LENG SANGJA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoiya hin Leng sangja ana peng nan jong,
Leng Christa bang hi khat cha ana peng khalou,
Lhandampu ahung peng Bethlehem bong inâ€™a,
Van Lengpa lem ding in noi le van mi kikhom.

Chorus
Kipah in lem ute Van Lal Leng pah ute,
Aso ni hin vannoi kipa nan losoh hen,
Van Lengpa ahung peng Lallukhuh hom ding in,
Van Mitheng te jousen jong eihung lem hu hen.

Verse 2
Van Mitheng ten alem nan kipa la sauvin,
Hichu kelngoi ching hon ajauvin gam noiya,
Lhandampu umna chu kichen tah in hil un,
A kelngoiyu dalhan chibai aga boh ui.

Verse 3
Solam miching ten thao namtui choiyun hungun,
Vanâ€™a valpa amauva ahung lamkaiyin,
Gan ankong a anu Maryâ€™n apom muvin,
Agoubom u hong un chibai aga boh ui.

Verse 4
Leng Herod in ahet in ana lung jin pin,
Chibai boh in kilep in miching te dong in,
A sepai jouse khom in Juda gamsung a,
Naosen Leng chu Pathen in ana huhdoh e.

Verse 5
Vo Jesu tuni hin kalung sung bong inâ€™a,
Hung kisem thah kit in lang ka tonsot Lengdin,
Ka khut theng lou hi Mary khut in ngaiton lang,
Tonsot in kipah in Nang lem kum lhung tange.

songs.title: 119. ETERNAL HOM.
119. HOSANA SAM JING UN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hosana sam jing un o Hallelujah Amen,
Leng Christa ahung penge Bethlehem a chun,
Atongso dam lungset thu namtin damna ahi,
Kipah in sau hite Hosana ti in.

Chorus
O Bethlehem lhang chung a,
Tonsot kho ahug vah e hilkim vel uvin,
Koi hile chu hinna vah thanomâ€™a tahsan in,
Lunghem ka le gim na thoh kit talou ding.

Verse 2
Akidang in aloupi e chamna Lengpa chu,
Ngailut na alonsah e leiset chung a hin,
Setna kon eilhat doh theina diuva hung ahi,
Lungset gam Leng ahi I Pakai Jesu.

Verse 3
Pa thutep ahung lhungtai Idamthei nau ahi,
Ngailut na along let e Calvary a chun,
Adanje koiham seithei lei mihem te lah a,
Alungset gam nom chu eilhut tauvin te.

Verse 4
Zion loupina Pakai mangsa eihol pau chu,
Van khopi ten it jong leu nang jou dehlou diu,
Ijakai ka Ijakai ya Lal pen hen Amen,
Eingailut nau hi koiman nelthei louding.

songs.title: 119. HUNG KIHEIYIN VAH MANGSA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (John 10:9)

Verse 1
Hung kiheiyin vah mangsa lung genthei,
Ven Jesu Christan naching jinge nang ;
Na hol’in na ngah e huhhing dingin,
Geisang louvin Ama tahsan loiyin.

Chorus
Lungdam sel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
Phaten ngaiyin Jesun nakou chu ;
Lung lhaisel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
“Hungun” tin lungset’in eikouvui.

Verse 2
Na manlouna dingin nangah jinge,
Hitih chan nangma vah manga nahi ;
Nangma chunan thi genthei athoh tai,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seitheilou.

Verse 3
Athu ngaiyin lang alungsetna hen,
Cross chunga nachonset apomang tai ;
Tonsot hin kemlou chu namu sah tai,
Na chonset jouse angaidam soh tai.

Verse 4
Hung’in lamkui lamdih hungjot kit’in,
Hinna kotpi Jesua hunglut loiyin ;
Lung lhaisel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
Lhachom kit talou ding nang akom’a.

songs.title: 120. DAMSEL CHAN KATONG LHUM’UI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.

Verse 1
Damsel chan katong lhum’ui,
Hiche nigup sunga hin ;
Ka kikhom tauve tunin,
Pathen lhai la ka sauve ;
Hiche Pathen nipha hi,
Van tonsot ol kihetna.

Verse 2
Mi lungset them’a Jesun,
Ka setnau soptheng soh-in ;
Chonse ho taona ngaiyin,
Ka khelnau ngaidam soh-in ;
Bei hen leiset lung ngaina,
Ka lungu Nanga kai hen.

Verse 3
Nangma ka lhaipet chau hin,
Ka lungu sunem soh-in ;
Hiche hou-in thenga hin,
Hung kiphongin Pathen Nang ;
Van’a kon an kemlou chu,
Kei ho neihin pe cheh un.

songs.title: 120. LHUM LAM GAMâ€™A KON IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhum lam gamâ€™a kon in,
Thu ahung thang lhung e,
Hichu Christa lamâ€™a tah panna thu ahi,
Ahung kitol tol in, thinglhang in lan asai,

Chorus
Christa lamâ€™a dettah a tah panna thu ahi.
Gal jona ding in (2) Pakai in kho asam e,
A thun chon u hite, gam lo loitau hite,
Christa lamâ€™a dettah a tah panna thu ahi.

Verse 2
Ngai uvin aw gin chu,
Leiset hotling soh a,
Hichu Christa lamâ€™a pah panna thu ahi,
Hang tah in tong pan un, kigin nan kho sam un,
Christa lam,â€™a dettah a tah panna thu ahi.

Verse 3
Khangdong tha kapan ui,
Tunin Jesu ang ah,
Hichu Christa lamâ€™a tah panna thu ahi,
A thupha phong leu te, vannoi mi gam jousea,
Christa lamâ€™a dettah a tah panna thu ahi.

songs.title: 120. THE DAY OF GLORY IS DRAWING NIGHT.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Niloupi hunglhun ding ni anai tai,
Chamna Lengpa le lhatsa goldeiten;
Thangvan jol’a khongpi le baza thon,
Eihin kou ding lhatsa goldei ten.

Chorus
Gel jingin ni loupi,
Phasa dem’in um’un lang;
Laltouna theng’a ding dingin,
Pakai natong cheh-u hite.

Verse 2
Malaiya Noah damlai nikho chu,
Geldoh uvin lang setna dalhauvin;
Hung mangin tin ichennau gamlui hi,
Namtin Jordan lui galkai tante.

Verse 3
Chu gam loupi chu ahunglhun tengle,
Leiya lhenchomte lhatdam changta ding;
Lungdonna le ka-na kinem sentin,
Lhatdam chengte kileng khomsoh ding.

Verse 4
Leiya lhenchom chaten gel jing’uvin,
Chu gam loupi hung lhunna ding ni chu;
Leng jouse Leng le Pakai chungnung chu,
Damlaiyin lem’ute Leng Christa.

songs.title: 121. CHRISTIAN SEPAI KON UN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Christian sepai kon un galsat in cheuvin,
Jesu lamjeng veuvin I lamkai pau chu;
Leng Christa akontai satan galsat din,
Ama alamkai tai ponlap che veuvin.
Christian sepai kon un, satan galsat din;
Jesu lam jeng veuvin, I lamkai pau chu.

Verse 2
Galmi janel banga Pathen mite kon,
Mi theng ho chena nungjui ah ihiuve,
Achom chom iumpoi iboncha pumkhat,
I kinep nau jong khat ikai nau khat bou.

Verse 3
Leiset leng ho gam le alalnau mang ding,
Christa Houbung vang chu mantih neilou ding,
Gim hesoh lungdonna kiseikit lou ding,
Atonsot tonsot a Christa vaihom ding.

songs.title: 121. HUNGUN GEL’UN SOPITE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.

Verse 1
Hungun gel’un sopite Jesun ei lungset nau,
I chonset suhmang nadin, I lungu ngaitou te.
I ding lung phamo ihim ?
I lung thoinau i-ham ?
I monau phongjal leu hen,
Aman subei tante.

Verse 2
Keima Christa tahsansa, Ama lam sangsa hing,
Ka lung thoi kittan keima, tun kalung olmo tai.
Twilen soh bang lung detlou,
Mi lengvai olmo jing ;
Tha neilou mi dammo ken,
Hoiya olna mung’em ?

Verse 3
Hijongle na huhhingpa, Getsemania ngaiton,
Nang chonset pohmangna a, Athisan ul long.
Thingpel a aumpet chun,
Athisan along lhai ;
Nang chonset jal’in athi,
Ohe tun tahsan tan.

Verse 4
Lungin tun jong atahsan lou nahi nah laiyem ?
Akhophang bul’a kunin, ichonset beina din.
Chutobang Jesu chu ken,
Nahsah mon ngai ponge ;
Ka thi nungle Akom’a,
Ka lut jel theina din.

songs.title: 121. LEI HI ANGUI JOU TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei hi angui jou tai,
Achunga mihemte le;
Setna le lunghelnan ahinlo tai,
I-mi ngai um hou le;
Golpha alem jou tai.
Aw Pakai nunnem’in,
Gam thah agasem chu;
Aw ka-lhagao nang jong,
Chu gam chu hin jon tan;
Leiset dalhah phat’a,
Na lenna mun dingin.

Verse 2
Tahna gam asem tai,
Aw tonsot gam lhun ding chu;
Lei gimna hi lhang bangin chim jongle,
Christa natahsan le,
Gam thah a nalen ding.

Verse 3
Til’a pi le puten,
Amuphah louvu gam chu;
Thisan jal’in keiman kahin mu tai,
Ache na lampi chu,
Lal Christa chu ahi.

songs.title: 122. CHRISTMAS LHAHNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw kipana Christmas kavahchoi laiyun,
Kum hung lhunglha ding hi jui go-a;
Abanna tuh-a nunglam heikit dingin,
Ka ngai nalaiyui.
Kho-ngaiyin (2) ka ngaiyui kho-ngaiyin,
Khannou gol nalem le hallai bang joulou;
Kipana Christmas.

Verse 2
Kum hung lhung ding hi juilou thei kahipoi,
Nikhat jong umthei ding kahipoi;
Na kipanau tun ache ding kahitai,
Damsel’un Chibai.

Verse 3
Pathen lungset jal’a kimu kit dingin,
Ngah jingun lang kum hunglhun ding chu;
Malsomna thah hin choiyin hung kit nange,
Damsel chan Chibai.

Verse 4
Nahung kit lam teng kimu kit tei dingin,
Kipah thanom tah-in hung kit’in;
Nasei malsomna gapha hin choiyin lang,
Kipana Christmas.

songs.title: 122. GAL SAM’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl
(Rev. 2:10)

Verse 1
Gal sam’un satan gal ahung naitai,
Christa din ponlap dom sangun ;
Galvon von’un dingdet cheh uvin,
Athu theng chu lum le phon songin.

Chorus
Kon’un galmi loi kisemtoh un lang,
Pangdet cheh un thu hi ban tol’un ;
Malam nouvin Hosana tin ao-vun,
Christa gal lamkai pipen ahi.

Verse 2
Gal hahsa hen lang itobang jong le,
I jo tei diu ahi thon mo’a ;
Khovah lum sungin lhagao chem panin,
Jona chu eiho chan ding ahi.

Verse 3
Vo! Vannoi Pathen ka kounau ngaiyin,
Nei hu’vin na milungset chun ;
Galsat kichaiya gal kijo teng leh,
Lallukhuh kasan theina dingin.

songs.title: 122. LEISET PON IN KIPHE LHAJONG LE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset pon in kiphe lhajong le,
Khopi hoitah chu keiman kanei nai,
Pakai in asem Zion chate lenna,
Hichu ka tonsot in.

Chorus
Zion chate jalen na ding ni chu anaitai,
Na jaona dem aw sopi,
Geisang le chun tonsot kot kihon hom lou ding,
Hinkho damlai Pakaiya din peuvin.

Verse 2
Lei lung ngainan puimang khan nate,
Damlai nikho ngaichat thil atamâ€™e,
Pahbang I hinkho mollep ding kon cha hi,
Pakai natong ute.

Verse 3
Nilhum kon vaiche phat ahitai,
Vantil te le mitheng chemasa hon,
Khongpi le Baza thon eina ngah jingui, Vanâ€™a kilam todin.

Verse 4
Pakai Christa Lalna gamâ€™a chun,
Leng le lal chaga genthei umta lou,
Lhunkal ka ngah lel Zion chate lenna, hichu ka tonsot in.

songs.title: 123. CHRISTIAN SEPAI KON’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Deut. 31:6)

Verse 1
Christian Sepai kon’un, galsat’in cheuvin,
Jesu lam jeng veuvin, I-Lamkaipau chu ;
Leng Christa akontai, satan galsat din,
Ama alamkai tai ponlap che veuvin.

Chorus
Christian sepai kon’un,
Satan galsat din ;
Jesu lam jeng veuvin,
I-Lamkai pau chu.

Verse 2
Galmi janel banga Pathen mite kon,
Mitheng ho chena nung juiya ihiuve ;
A chom chom iumpoi, I boncha pumkhat,
I kinepnau jong khat, I kainau khat bou.

Verse 3
Leiset lengho gamle, A lalnau mang ding,
Christa Houbung vang chu, mantih neilou ding ;
Gim, hesoh, lungdonna, kiseikit lou ding,
A tonsot tonsot’a Christan vaihom ding.

songs.title: 123. JAN LUNGJIN UM ZION INDAN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jan lungjin um Zion indan sunga,
Pakaiyin athisan ahomâ€™e,
Hiti chun lungdon meipi ajinge,
Ka Pakai lungset um akap e.

Chorus
O nangho Jerusalem mite,
Alungset na chan chu he jingun,
Nanat nau jouse adamsah jeh chun,
Along donna chu hailou jen un.

Verse 2
Jerusalem kulpi kul pam lamâ€™a,
Themgao thidan ahipoi tiuvin,
O hinve tem tan Calvary lhang chu,
Mipi lah a ka Pakai kamui.

Verse 3
Vetan Calvary lhang alhut maidiu,
Ahitai i-kalo diu hitam?
O ka Pakai nahung kit lou ding ham,
Namun ding chu Calvary hitam?

Verse 4
Hin sumil ponge ka Pakai Jesu,
Calvary lam hinve jing nange,
Ka dinga nathoh na kalung sunga,
Ka laicha geijin he jing nange.

songs.title: 123. PAKAI PEN LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai pen nikho alhung kit tai,
Silung lengvaite lung akai thouve;
Vannoi hil’un Betlehem lhang chunga,
Ginchatna lhan leng galkaiyin.
Aw Pakai nunnem Nangin neikai hoiyin,
Nachun le jo ngaiya;
Senlai naobang naka na mun chu ka ngai.

Verse 2
Bethlehem Ahsi avah kit tai,
Eden lhan kotkhah sung avah kit tai;
Khangin thouvun Eden kho avah tai,
Lungtup gam chu jontau hite.

Verse 3
Ka ngai ngeiye Bethlehem lhang chu,
Thangvan toni kol’a apanglep tai;
Bong in sunga Pakai lengvai tah chu,
Achunnu Maryn apom’e.

Verse 4
Anom ngeiye Pakai na gam chu,
Kei din Bethlehem lhang avah kit tai;
Til’a pi le puten amu phahlou,
Saron pah lem’in lengute.

songs.title: 124. GAL SAM UN SATAN GAL AHUNG NAITAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gal sam un satan gal ahung naitai,
Christa din ponlap domsang un,
Galvon kivon un ding det cheh uvin,
A thutheng chu lum le phon sung in.

Chorus
Kon un galmi loi kisem toh un lang,
Pang det cheh un thu hi bantol un,
Malam nou vin Hosana tin ao vun,
Christa gal lamkai pipen ahi.

Verse 2
Gal hahsa hen lang itobang jong leh,
I jo tei diu ahi thon mo a,
Khovah lum sung un Lhagao chem pan un,
Jona chu eiho chan ding ahi.

Verse 3
Vo Vannoi Pathen ka kounau ngai in,
Nei huvin na milungset chun,
Galsat kichai a gal kijo teng le,
Lallukhuh kasan theina ding un.

songs.title: 124. LHUM LAM GAM’A KONIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Deut. 31:6)

Verse 1
Lhum lam gama konin,
Thu ahung thang lhunge ;
Hichu Christa lama tah panna thu ahi,
Ahung kitol tol’in ;
Thing lhangin lan asai,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.
Gal jona dingin, (2 vei) Pakaiyin kho asam’e,
Athun chonnu hite ; Gam lo loitau hite,
Christa lama dettah a ; Tahpanna thu ahi.

Verse 2
Ngaiyuvin o gin chu,
Leiset hot ling soh a ;
Hichu Christa lama tahpanna thu ahi,
Hangtah in tong panun ;
Kiginnan kho sam’un,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.

Verse 3
Khangdong tha ka pan’ui,
Tunin Jesu angah ;
Hichu Christa lama tahpanna thu ahi,
Athupha phong leute ;
Vannoi mi gam jousea,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.

songs.title: 124. PAKAI PEN LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Huhhing’a Pakai Christa apeng tai,
Kipah le thanom’in lengute;
Thina thim noiya umte din,
Vah loupi tah alhung tai;
Hallelujah kipah in saute.
Amin kidang chamna leng Pakai,
Tonsot Pakai chamna Leng ahi;
Agam’in kemtih nei talou ding,
Tonsot in mantih nei taponte.

Verse 2
Tahsanin ka galdot chung vangam nom,
Chamna Leng Chapa apen ni chun;
Thinan vaihom’in a awgin,
Ngei tah chu, leiset chung le,
Chung thangvan sanga akithonge.

Verse 3
Tuhin Bethlehem khonom lam’a chun,
Tahsanin lhajal’in lengute;
Chun lengthei Mary pom lei le,
Van Lengpa lemna dingin,
Inei gou thil jousen lem’ute.

Verse 4
Mi huhhinga Pakai thah apeng tai,
Amin Lal Christa Immanuel;
Hosana chungnung pen Chapa,
Min loupi tah-in um hen;
Chamna thu leng hen leisetna hin.

songs.title: 125. CHRISTIAN IN NOM UM GOT DAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Matt. 26:41)

Verse 1
Christian in nom um got dan,
Tha ol nagot pailhauvin ;
Gal lah a um nahiuve kiging phan.

Verse 2
Vaipi po le thunei ten,
Na kigin lou petcha hin ;
Na um kim vel’un ahi kiging phan.

Verse 3
Na van galvon chu von’in,
Sun le janin kivon’in ;
Diabol chu chang jingin lang kiging phan,

Verse 4
I jakaiya Pakai sei,
Thun nungin na ngailua chu ;
Na lunga athu chingin kiging phan.

Verse 5
Kiging phan tao gunchu’vin,
Sun nilhum jan khovah in ;
Taovun nahinna dingun kiging phan.

songs.title: 125. DAMSEL CHAN KATONG LHUM UI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Damsel chan ka tong lhum ui,
Hiche nigup sung a hin,
Kaki khom tauve tunin,
Pathen lhai la ka sauve,
Hiche Pathen nipha hi,
Van tonsot ol kihet na.

Verse 2
Mi lungset them a Jesu,
Ka set nau soptheng soh in,
Chonse ho taona ngai in,
Ka khel nau ngaidam soh in,
Beihen leiset lung ngaina,
Ka lung u Nang ah kaihen.

Verse 3
Nangma ka lhaipet chau hin,
Ka lungu sunem soh in,
Hiche Hou in theng ahin,
Hung kiphong in Pathen Nang,
Vanâ€™a kon an kemlou chu,
Keiho neihin pe cheh un.

songs.title: 125. MITHENGTE LENNA GAM’A CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Genthei thoh a kapma,
Ham’a kalenna gamthip’a hin;
Itih le mang in tem?
Aw itih le hung mangin tem aw,
Lhatdamte toh lenkhomna mun chu.
Aw tonsot gam nom’a chun,
Len kanom’e, len ka nom’e;
Gam nom em’a chun,
Lengvai cha thouvun;
Mithengte lenna chun,
Van kelngoinou to lengkhom dingin.

Verse 2
Leiset gentheina gam,
Satan gal hatna munse gam’a;
Chen ding gingin kap’in,
Lunghel’in ka mitlhi;
Alonge aw tepna gam’a chun,
Lhagao Thengin nei hung puilut in.

Verse 3
Gol ngaite akim tai,
Tonsot kipana gamnom’a chun;
Hallelujah Amen,
Nei puilut’in Pakai;
Van gam nom’a leng mithengte le,
Van Kelngoinou loupina hihen.

Verse 4
Leiya genthei ka ka,
Ka mitlhi eitheh hul peh le ding;
Van Lal Kelngoi nunnem,
Jing Valpa nahung man;
O Pakai ka ngah jouta pouve,
Lengvai chate thokitna gamnom.

songs.title: 126. ATAHSAN HO CHU HINGINTE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ipun chonse ho chu alungset behseh-in,
Acha anei sunna eina lhatdoh ahi.
Atahsan ho chu hinginte,
Avan khopi nomtah a chun;
Olle Aloupina kimu nante.

Verse 2
Gul lim mai vete ho bon chu ahin’u le,
Lhandampu khetbeh vete ho chu hinginte.

Verse 3
Chonset muthim lah-a anamang jouse chu,
Alhatdamna thu chu oileng hing ding kahi.

Verse 4
Leiset oimo dingin, Acha ahinsol poi,
Atahsan hon hinna amujoh diu ahi.

Verse 5
Pathen Nalha Theng hi nei oidetsah jingin,
Naosen pengthah bangin, van an chun neivah in.

songs.title: 126. VAN’A LENGPA PONLAP
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (Psalms. 50:4)

Verse 1
Van’a Lengpa ponlap ahung lenglha tai,
Van Leng sepaite hengah ;
ollmo louvin dom sangu hite tunin,
La i-sah ngei pet’u hin.

Chorus
Hunguvin, hunguvin,
Christa jal’in mang jongleu hen ;
Khuh sah un lallukhuh hoi chu,
Thingpel ponlap noi lim’a.

Verse 2
Twipi nong bang melma hung kitol jongle,
Ponlap leh sang jingun lang ;
Alim noiya umun Pakai sepaite,
Thon louva eima jo ding.

Verse 3
Twi le leiset chunga mihem cheng jousen,
Hilsoh un hiche Thupha ;
Hiche thisan ponlap van’a lenglha chu,
Pakai galjo kithanna.

Verse 4
Nopna khovah loupi ni ahung nai tai,
Niseh in ahung nai tai ;
Chuteng Leng anga dougal beisohta ding,
Vannoi Cross in khokhong ding.

songs.title: 126. VO KHANGDONG HO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo khangdong ho nakhang hoilai,
Pakaiya din peuvin,
Na khanghoi lai Pakaiyin amangcha nomâ€™e,
Na huhhingpa nachu tong in,
Sana khang hoi laiyin.
Naâ€¦.. khangdon hoilai yin,
Nasempa Pathen geldoh in,
Na khanghoi lai Pakai dingin,
Tong in thanom tah in.

Verse 2
Phat le nikho akem jinge,
Khankho jong akem jing,
Phat tampi chejou ta nile lha kiheita,
Vo khangdong ho napah hoilai in,
Pakai na tong in.

Verse 3
Pakaiyin ati na khangdong,
Hoilai yin na tong in,
Ajou le nakhang hoilai molpang lep inte,
Tu hinkho hoilai in tongin,
Tong in tohphat ahi.

Verse 4
Nangho cheuvin namtin heng ah,
Sochat na thu hil un,
Koi hile atahsan jousen hinna mu ding,
Na khanghoi lai kilet kah in,
Pakai nachu tong i

songs.title: 127. HINKHO DEILAI KAHIN NAU LE PHAT HOI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinkho deilai kahin nau le phat hoi,
Hi ana kem loi jitai,
Imajouse kage le lunghel aum ngeiye.
Na pamai, na pamai
O phat le kumlui mol in,
Na lungset vanga namtin nomsa a cheng,
I hinlai damsung kimpet chau hin.

Verse 2
Phat kipa um akem o mi tamtah,
I hin pahlai achul tai,
Khankho akem jinge lunghel aum ngeiye.

Verse 3
Hithei hihen kavon ding kipa um,
Muthei kit ding chu hileng,
Nunlui ngaiyin kahol kumlui bou katiuve.

Verse 4
Kumlui to ikikhen koukit theilou,
Golngai kikhen pi jong chu,
Ahinkho alhing in kumlui to alhon tai.

songs.title: 127. MITHENGTE LENNA GAM’A CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lung mongmon lhangtin kachon’e,
Lung monna aumpoi leisetna;
Aw ka chennau gam dalhang ting che tange,
Kap kit talou ding.

Chorus
Aw ka-gam ngai chu,
Pahcha hoiyin abom’e;
Mi genthei keima lenna ding chu,
Lal napahhoi gam ngai ka kinepna.

Verse 2
Huiva bangin galeng thei leng,
Leng tange thangvan sang lam jonin;
Calvry lhang thing Cross chunga gachunge,
Ga tou jing tange.

Verse 3
Kho mun’a leng leng gol kim’in,
Lunghel lungdon jong hi bang tantem?
Ahipoi gol kim’in lunghel abang chom poi,
Ka abang chom poi.

Verse 4
Heng thoh cheh-ute lunghel jong,
Chung Pathen malsom’in damsel chan;
Lhagao kho mun’a chun eijong igalen diu,
Lei hi dalhau tin.

songs.title: 127. PAKAI CHRISTA VANGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (2 Cor. 1:20)

Verse 1
Pakai Christa vangin danthu nungjuiyin,
Hin kemlou chu Ama vahchoina dingin ;
Kipah le thanom tah in vahchoi cheh un,
Pakai danthu nung juiyin sauvin.

Chorus
Dingun ! dingun !
Pakai Jesu a dingun athutep juiyun ;
Dingun ! dingun !
Pakai thutep juiyin kadinge kei.

Verse 2
Danthu jui chu imatih in lha ponge,
Lhahchomna le kichatna Aman eihui ;
Mantih neilou thu chu Ama a ahi,
Pakai danthu juiyin dinguvin.

Verse 3
Athu nungjui ding keima olmo lou ding,
Lhagao Thengin eikou chu ken ngai jing ding ;
Tonsot’in Pakai vahchoiyin ol tange.
Pakai nopna chun um jing tange.

songs.title: 128. GAMLA NAIYA KON CHRISTIANTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Heb. 10:22)

Verse 1
Gamla naiya kon Christiante,
Hikom a tun ikikhom’ui;
Jesu thupha hil’a sim din,
Vannoi kipana chungnung pen chu.

Chorus
Eiho hapan loihin, Amin’a kikhom hin,
Lungkhat le thakhat’in Amin phongjal leute ;
Pathen le igamsung din pangdet cheh-ute,
Phattheina a eichin jingna dingun taovun.

Verse 2
Akikhomsen la sau hite,
Christa Lengpa vahchoina la;
Khangdongin lam amuna ding,
Hinna gamnom jotna lampi.

Verse 3
Pakai natong jing uhite,
Ikiinepna tuhdet-ute;
Athupha ho juijing’ute,
Chung gam loupia kikhop kahsen.

songs.title: 128. HUNG KIHEI IN VAH MANGSA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hung kihei in vahmangsa lung genthei,
Ven Jesu Christan na ching jinge nang,
Na hol in na ngah e huhhing ding in,
Geisang louvin Ama tahsan loi in.

Chorus
Lungdam sel in na kouve nang Jesun,
Phaten ngai in Jesun na kou chu,
Lung lhaisel in na kouve nang Jesun,
â€œHung unâ€ tin lungset in eikou ui.

Verse 2
Na man louna ding in na ngah jinge,
Hitih chan nangma vahmang a nahi,
Nangma chu nan thi genthei athoh tai,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seithei lou.

Verse 3
Athu ngaijin lang alungset na hen,
Cross chunga na chonset a pomang tai,
Tonsot hinkem lou chu namu sah tai,
Na chonset jouse a ngaidam soh tai.

Verse 4
Hungin lamlui lamdih hung jot kit in,
Hinna kotpi Jesua hung lut loi in,
Lung lhaisel in na kouve nang Jesun,
Lhachom kit talou ding nang a komâ€™a.

songs.title: 128. LUNGSETNA AKIHOM’E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungsetna akihom’e,
Chitin le namtin dingin;
Phatthei phung chu pah-uvin,
Lal loupi chungnung ahi.

Chorus
Chonset lung genthei lengvai,
Lungsetna gamnom chang’un;
Thisan theng tah-a eilhat jal’un,
Adei jouse hunguvin.

Verse 2
Vangphat kihom pet ahi,
Lut’uvin gamnom’a chun;
Nachonset jouse pouvin,
Ngaidam’inte lungset’in.

Verse 3
Tepna gam chang dia gotsa,
Sopi jam mang kit dan lang;
Kouna aw chu ngai jingin,
Canaan Pakai chu ahi.

Verse 4
Kipa aw ngei ka jatai,
Vah loupi kamu phat hin;
Dei tah-in lung ol eipei,
Lhatna thisan ka chang tai.

songs.title: 129. AMANGKON HUHDOH IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl
(Luke 14 :21)

Verse 1
Amangkon huhdoh in, athikon ngaiton,
Chonset khuh a konin ladoh loiyin ;
Chon khelte chu hil’in alhu kaithouvin,
Huhhing Pakai Jesu thu seipeh in.
Amangkon huhdoh in, Athikon ngaiton,
Mi lungset them Jesun huhhing tei ding.

Verse 2
Ama hon angaisah louhel vanguvin,
Aman angah jinge lung neng tah in ;
Avel vel’in dam heochan akou jinge,
Tahsan pouleu ngaidam ding ahi.

Verse 3
Mihemte lungsung setnan alodim tai,
Hijeh chun Pakai leiya ahunge ;
Lungset khut’in athamin asukhangin,
Athisa jong ahinsah kit jitai.

Verse 4
Amangkon huhdoh in nangma kin ahi,
Pakaiyin nangma thahat pen nate ;
Lhagao mang ding mi sangja a um’uve,
Huhhingpan alungsetnau thu hil’in.

songs.title: 129. KA PAKAI NAGENTHEI NGEIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary lhang chu ngaito leu chun,
Akhut akeng anah-a ma;
Ichonset jal’a athohna,
Anatje chu hetan nate.

Chorus
Kanao vetan ichonset jal’a thohna,
Anatje chu hetan nate;
Hungin lang akilna hung botdoh-in,
Athoh jou tapoi.

Verse 2
Aw ka Pakai nagenthei ngeiye,
Leiset mo jouse napoh hi;
Panpi nom ding umlou hitam?
Lungdon jouse nathoh lai chun.

Verse 3
Alungset jouse hung kikhom’un,
Panpi neilou Kelngoinou hi;
Najo chanin hung panpiuvin,
Adang chahna phatsah dingin.

Verse 4
Leiset twikhang len hung kinongin,
I-Pakai dangchah donsah din;
Kei che jong leng phatsah joulou,
Lhagao ngaiya dangchah ahi.

songs.title: 129. NAGA CHE NAM NANGMA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Naga che nam nangma Jesu henga chu,
A thisan in na kisop theng nam?
Ami lungset na chun nakinem nam nang,
Athisan in naki soptheng nam?

Chorus
A thisan â€¦â€¦.theng a chu,
Na chonset nasop theng soh nah em?
Navon nen chu kicheh a ngimsel soh nam?
A thisan chun naki soptheng nam?

Verse 2
Niseh in Jesu komâ€™a na um jing nam?
Thisan a na kisop theng hinam?
Ama chu lungmon na nanei nam nangma,
A thisan in naki soptheng nam?

Verse 3
Hung toh nan tem ahung nile Moulang chun,
A thisan a navon athen soh,
Phasa dem nan tem nalha vanâ€™a kaldin,
A thisan in naki soptheng nam?

Verse 4
Na chonset nen bena navon chu pailhan,
A thisan in kisil thengin tun,
Nang ding in hinna twidung khat along e,
Hia chun na chonset soptheng tan.

songs.title: 130. AW KANGAI NGEIYE GAM LOUPI CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw kangai ngeiye gam loupi chu,
Mithengte ho lenna gam chu;
Chu mun nom’a lengte ho chun,
Genthei ahe tapoi, kana aum tapoi;
Chapang golngai um chu,
Kipah-in alhung tai.
Lei hi ngai tapoi,
Adalha tai, hung kit nom lou;
Ajotnau gamnom chu,
Kipah-in alhung tai.

Verse 2
Kei hi itih le hung ding kahim?
Ti-in ka kingaito jinge;
Kap lou thei chu ka hitapoi,
Ichennau gam ngaiton, ilennau gam gel’in;
Van kho nom pul douvin,
Kap lou thei ka hipoi.

Verse 3
Kei vang chu aw Pakai mitheng tah,
Naleiset sem ngui chunga hin;
Kap le lengvaiyin kavah lei,
Leiset gimna a hin napul kadou joupoi;
Nei sumil loujen’o,
Mi genthei cha kahi.

songs.title: 130. HUNGUN CHRISTIANTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Exo. 14:15)

Verse 1
Hungun Christiante lungkhat hiu hite,
Seiphong leute sochatna Thupha ;
Thinglhang gam sunga mi acheng jouse,
Satan bulpu’vin akum tu’ve.

Chorus
Hungun Christiante itha gomtou tin,
Sumang dingin idou satan hat ;
Hungun Christiante tha gomtou hitin,
I thahat pennau Jesu umna.

Verse 2
Mi sangja hijat hinna Thu mulou,
Vetem tauvin akihen nau bul ;
Bulpu ngaiton lang i-nop pailhauvin ;
Gasut lham’ute bulpute chu.

Verse 3
Hungun sopite lungthah sem’utin,
Chalsahna din Pakai Jesu gam ;
Kihabol cheh un tantih neilouvin,
Niloupi nia pam chanlou na din.

songs.title: 130. KA KHOLJIN NA SAPSET NA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka kholjin na sapset namun,
Lungdon twisanglen kinong,
Panpi kangai ka Lhandampu,
Neihin huh in.

Chorus
Jesu nagam nalhung tengle neihe jing in,
Leiset chonset asang taloi,
Ka doujou poi Pakai nunnem,
Jesu nagam nalhun tengle neihe jing in.

Verse 2
Ka damsung ni chom cha ahi,
Hetlou kah in jan mollep,
Setna meipi jing noiya hin,
Nei huhhing in.

Verse 3
Ka damsung nikho manding dan,
Neihil jing in Lhandampu,
Ka phat hoilai hi Nang ding in,
Mang tang kate.

Verse 4
Leiset loupi naho sang in,
Na hoiye kalung sunga,
Sapsetna ling lukhuh jong chu,
Khuh jong le chun.

songs.title: 131. I DAMLAI NI PHAT CHOM CHA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I damlai ni phat chom cha hi,
Beivah ding ahitai,
Sopi kingaiton phat aum tapoi,
Na lung heijin van gam ahung naitai.

Chorus
Phat aboitai, phat avbeitai,
Lungsetna khang alem jinge,
I Pakai chu hung loi jingte,
Nalung heiyun vangam ahung naitai.

Verse 2
O hinna thu mulou hokhu,
Vetem un sopi te,
Tonsot thini na mun lam chu jon in,
Akitol ui mitlhi long pum pum in.

Verse 3
Phat kipa um chomcha sunghin,
Pakai na tong ute,
Ageisang tai o phat aum tapoi,
Kipan ute Pakai na tong ding in.

songs.title: 131. ICHONSET JAL’A GENTHEI AHI.
131. SOCHATNA LE HINNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (John 3:3)

Verse 1
Sochatna le hinna khovah thu donga,
Vaipo khat jan’a Jesu henga ahung chun ;
Jesun thudih tah in ana donbut’in,
“Pengthah kit’un” ati.

Chorus
Napen thah diu ahi,
Napen thah diu ahi ;
Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahi ahi ;
Napen thah diu ahi.

Verse 2
Jesun khuh a kon eihung lhatdoh nau hi,
Athu ngaitouvin mihem chapa chanu ten ;
Hiche Thupha hi moh hisah hih hel’un,
Napen thah diu ahi.

Verse 3
Nangho vangam nom’a lutnom ho chengsen,
Eihuhhingnau Thupha hi kipa lan sauvin ;
Tonsot mangmo hinkemlou nanei nomle,
Napen thah diu ahi.

Verse 4
Na lunga vangam nom chu namu nom le,
Kotpi hoi phunga chun nang na ngah jinguve ;
Chuche gamnom hoi a chu nalut nom le,
Napen thah diu ahi.

songs.title: 132. CHONSE SUHGENTHEI LHAGAO HO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonse suhgenthei Lhagao ho,
Jesu tahsan leu chun,
Aman olsah tauvin nate,
Athu tahsan leu chun.

Chorus
Tahsan jeng un, tahsan jengun,
Tahsan jeng un tun,
Huhhing teiding, Huhhing teiding
Nang na huhhing ding.

Verse 2
Jesun athisan lu ason,
Hinna nom eipeuve,
Thisan lui ah chun kiphum un,
Buh bang a sop bang ding.

Verse 3
Jesu lampi dihtah ahi,
Olna gam nom jotna,
Geisang louvin tahsan loi jin,
Phatthei nachan kim ding.

Verse 4
Ahile gam loupi jon in,
Hung lhauvin loi theng a,
Gam loupia in nomâ€™a cheng din,
Nop kemlou van in ah.

songs.title: 132. HINKHO HI PAHCHA BANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka hinkho hi pahcha banga,
Chom kah-a hung mangloi ding;
Janna mang kho ahung vah-a,
Aman kit tobang ahi.

Chorus
Aw ka lhagao van’a leng tan,
Lei hi ilou na ngai ham?
Na tonsot khopi nom jonin,
Van mithengte tolpi chu.

Verse 2
Leiset hinkho hi ipi ham?
Natna le lungdonna bou;
Kipa thanop jouse jong hi,
Hampa pah bang bou ahi.

Verse 3
Ache masa igol ngai hou,
Nop le kipan alengui;
Laltouna kim’in asauve,
Tonsot Pathen vahchoiyun,

Verse 4
Aloupina emhoi tah chu,
Nisa sangin a-emjoi;
Chu-a aloupi masanga,
Pakai Jesu imu diu.

Verse 5
Ka aw ngei nei chasun sun’in,
Vahchoi jinge kalhun teng;
Vakhu banga leng thei hileng,
Leng tange gol ngai mudin.
Aw ka lhagao tuhin leng tan,
Leiset hi dalha tan lang;
Tonsot khopi nom lam jonin,
Khopi nom Pathen chenna.

songs.title: 132. VAN CHUNG GAMNOM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Rev. 21:23)

Verse 1
Van chung gamnom emhoi tah a,
Chun vantilten la asai ;
Halleluiyah Hosana tin,
Asamun Leng vahchoi nan ;
Hiche leiset genthei munna konin,
Pakaiyin eipui lei ;
Gangtah in ka jon’uve,
Vanchung gamnom hoitah chu.
O chu gam ilhun teng le,
Sana lukhuh isan diu ;
Kipah le thanom tah a,
Chu gamnom em’a ilen diu.

Verse 2
Vanchung gamnom emhoi jon chun,
Nitin mi ache jinge ;
Eiho chu gam lhunna ding,
Nikhon eihin naiyuve ;
Jesu heng lam jon ihiuve,
Ama toh leng khom dingin ;
Hiche gama chu tonsot’a,
Ama kivahchoi ta ding.

Verse 3
Chu gam emhoi nom tah a chun,
Mitin din in nom aum ;
Lhandampu tahsan jouse le,
Kouna ngai jouse dingin,
Pakai thupeh hung lhun phat le,
Kipana hung lhung tading ;
Chuteng hi leiset dalha gam,
Nom hoitah chu ijot diu.

songs.title: 133. IN THE WORLD I HAVE TRIBULATION (L.Th 196)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Akem baita ngeiye,
I leiset hinlai nikho te hi;
Kipana pah chulkit ding ahi,
I kikhenna diuvin;
Kol’a nisa ahung soh kit tai,
Kikhen louna gam i-ngaita ngeiye.
Kikhen louna kisei gam’in nom’a,
I golchan kicholdo hite;
Eichingpau Lal Christa,
Eilhandampu kipana ang’a,
Lungdon beita ding.

Verse 2
Leiset chunga hin aw,
Kap-in ham’ing vah genthei jong leng;
