Lungjin gal’a khun gamnom aum,
Eilhandampu Christa;
Juiya ihinkho ho iphal le,
Chu gam nom’a chu eijong ichen ding.

Verse 3
Kipana pah umna,
Lhandampu Christa lenna mun chu;
Ngaiyin nitin in kagel jinge,
Van’a vantilte le;
Igol ikikhen pisa ho to,
Itih le kipan ikikhom diuvem?

Verse 4
Eiho igolchauvin,
I-Pau natoh ding thase louvin;
Phat hi nitin in akem jinge,
Jing valpa hoi loupi;
Hung kilahna ding ni anai tai,
Natoh jouva ikicholdona diu.

Verse 5
Aw Pakai Lhandampu,
Ka kipanau pah namtui nahi;
Leiya kipana pah amol tai,
Na maiso a chun aw;
Kipana jouse hung kilang hen,
Kipana pah Saron pahhoi nahi.

songs.title: 133. PATHEN SUMKON A GINâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen sumkon aginâ€™a lei hi aum lou teng
chuleh,
Tonsot hinna khovah a niso tengle,
Akhopteng alung tohte luipi pang gal lang khat lamâ€™a, Chu a min kikouna sunga ka um ding.
Chu a min kikouna sung a (3)
Chua min kikou na sunga ka um ding.

Verse 2
Chuni jingkah vah hoi a Christan mithi athosoh
a,
Athokit loupi achan ni diu chule,
A lhenchom te kikhop nile a in u van chung gamâ€™a, Chu a min kikou na sunga ka um ding.

Verse 3
Pathen natong ing kate niso apat nilhum gei in,
A mi ngailut kidang chu seichoi lenge,
Chule inatoh ijo a ihin nikho bulhin tengle,
Chu a min kikou na sunga ka um ding.

songs.title: 133. PHATTHEINA GO HONG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (Ezek. 34:23)

Verse 1
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Lungsetna eitepna sau ;
Juhsah jing jeng hen niseh in,
Jesun hinjuh lhah sah in.

Chorus
Phattheina go hong,
Ka ngaiyui phattheina chu ;
Malkhou tah in hinjuhsah in,
Hungju hen ka chunguva.

Verse 2
Go hungjun phattheina go hong,
Lhagao thisa thoukit hen,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam jol’a,
Hung chinnin phattheina go.

Verse 3
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Pathen hin sollhan tunin ;
Kalung nguisau halsah kit hen,
Nei tepnau guilhun sah in.

Verse 4
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Juhsah in tuni tah in ;
Ka setnau jouse sop thengin,
Jesu kakou petchau hin.

songs.title: 134. THE ECCEPTABLE YEAR OF THE LORD (L.Th 196)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lal lunglhai kum kipa phat chu,
Tu hin alhung kit tai;
Ga che hen Bethlehem kho pam’a,
Van mite in sahna.

Chorus
Aw nang Bethlehem iti ka ngai hitam?
Nalhang chunga lamkai ahsi em chu;
Kap in kahin hol peh-e,
Pakai penna mi i-sahlou gam.

Verse 2
Ngailou um’intem chu mun chu,
Pakai penna mun chu;
Caesar leng chan lai ni phalouva chun,
Ka Lal naobang akap.

Verse 3
Ga ve tem’un Vantil thengten,
Nadeiyu Lal Jesu;
Ahung penge genthei chate dingin,
Pah banga ilem diu.

Verse 4
Cham tadiuvin kelngoi ching ho,
Lungset mun’a um’un;
Lungdon louna ahsi kal, gamnom’a,
Chu-a ichenkhom diu.

songs.title: 134. VANTIL LE LEISET MIHEM PAO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Vantil le leiset mihem pao,
Hechen soh jeng jongleu hen ;
Lunga ngailut aum lou le,
Ahomkeo bou ihiuve. (3 vei)

Verse 2
Mol le lhang tolmang theina hel,
Tahsan nei jeng jongleu hen ;
Inei jouseu hom jeng jongleu hen,
Phatchomna bei ahiye. (3 vei)

Verse 3
Tahsa pumpi govam dingin,
Phal hen toh ngam jongleu hen ;
Lungsetna inei louvu le,
Pa lunglhaina umdeh lou. (3 vei)

Verse 4
Pao jouse hung mangsohkei ding,
Chih le themna jong bei ding,
Kigin kijabol mangsoh ding,
Kilungsetna manglou ding. (3 vei)

songs.title: 134. VO GOSPEL KHOLJIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo Gospel kholjin hoilang cheding nahim?
Nangma ngaiya dangchah sang tampi aumtai,
Mujing a mulou le jajing a jalou hon,
Nathilbol thei lhatdamna angah ui.

Chorus
Mol le lhang sang jong le cheding kahi,
Pakai thupeh juilou thei kahipoi,
Angailut nan eisol kacham louvin,
Pakai natoh kakin ahi.

Verse 2
Setna soh in mi sangja thim noiya aum,
Calvary sochat na niso lam helou vin,
Gotmunâ€™a ding in lhem lungmong in satan in,
Ache jing ui o Gospel kou loiyin.

Verse 3
Gospel kouna sang nomlou jouse te hochu,
Kale hagel na thoh unte tonsot geiyin,
Chua kisih jong le ngaidam chang talou ding,
Achung uva tonsot themmo chuta.

Verse 4
Aw sopite Gospel kouna sangloi uvin,
Gospel lah touna din Rapture ni anaitai,
Tahsan chate jouse chugamâ€™a leng unte,
Choldo vin te Hallelujah tiuvin.

songs.title: 135. AW KIPANA CHRISTMAS KA VAHCHOI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw kipana Christmas ka vahchoi laihin,
Kum hung lhung lha ding hi yui go-a,
Aban a tuh a nunglam heikit ding in,
Ka ngai na laiyui.
Khongaiyin (2) ka ngaiyui khongaiyin,
Khannou go na lem le hallai bang joulou,
Kipana Christmas.

Verse 2
Kum hunglhung ding hi juilou thei kahipoi,
Nikhat jong umthei ding kahipoi,
Na kipanau tun ache ding kahitai,
Damsel un chibai.

Verse 3
Pakai lungset jal a kimu kit ding in,
Ngah jing unlang kum hung lhun ding chu,
Vangbohna thah hinchoi yin hung kit nange,
Damsel chan chibai.

Verse 4
Na hungkit lamteng kimu kit tei ding in,
Kipah thanom tah in hung kit in,
Na sei Vangbohna gapha hinchoi yin lang,
Kipana Christmas.

songs.title: 135. HALLELUJAH TIN VAHCHOI LA ASAUVE.
135. KAN EIHUHHING LOU DING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Eqh. 2:8)

Verse 1
Kan eihuhhing lou ding,
Ka lhin kamai phet jong leng ;
Ka lungdon subei lou ding,
Kumsot chonset beilou ding,
Kan eihuhhing lou ding.
Kei chuna Jesu thita,
Thingpel’a kikhen behta ;
Eingah-e huhhing dingin,
Huhhing jou Ama bou.

Verse 2
Toh-in eihuhhing lou ding,
Iti chonphat jeng jong leng ;
Itobangin hou jong leng,
Ka lung thahsah theilou ding,
Toh in eihuh lou ding.

Verse 3
Ngah leng kei hinglou ding,
Panpi bei mi mangsa kei ;
Lungset’a eikou pet hin,
Ngah leng keima thita ding,
Ngah leng kei hinglou ding.

Verse 4
Christa tahsan hinna,
Pathen chapa Jesu chu ;
A tohchan ken gingcha leng,
A bantha eihuhhing ding,
Christa tahsan hinna.

songs.title: 136. HUNGUN GEL’UN PHAT CHE DAN HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chamkang lou noulai ahitai,
Theichang na jong anou tai;
Che bang chun lhenchomte jouse,
Pakai lem dingin nou kit hen.

Chorus
Hungun gel’un phat che dan hi,
Setna thisa thophat ahitai;
Gam hung lhun ding kinem’in,
Ngah jingute phasadem cheh-in.

Verse 2
Chul thei leihao pahcha jeng jong,
Phat chomcha khat ding jeng cha’n;
Namtui sel’in ahung pah-in,
Namtin lung alhaisah sohji.

Verse 3
Hijeh chun sopite hung’un,
Leng Christa lunglhai dingin;
Gunchu tah in na tong’ute,
Leiset hinkho abei kah-in.

Verse 4
Phat loupi chu hung manginte,
Gunchu le lung kinem’in;
Hung kigon phasadem cheh-in,
Pa Laltouna thenga ding din.

songs.title: 136. KA LEISET HINKHO ABEI TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Eph. 2:5)

Verse 1
Ka leiset hinkho abei teng,
Ken bang ding tulai ka lasah ;
Pathen inpi sung lim noiya,
Kalut teng kei kipah jing ding.

Chorus
Kimaitoa muding Amai ken,
Lungset’a eilhat thu sei ding ;
Kimaitoa mu ding Amai ken,
Lungset’a eilhat thu seiding.

Verse 2
Nikhat ka leiset in chimding,
Asot apal kasei thei poi ;
Ahin ka dingin van chunga,
Mun a ume tio ken kahei.

Verse 3
Nikhat chung toni jong mang ding,
Leiset pahhoi jouse mang ding ;
Pakaiyin, “Nabol aphai” tia,
Eikou teng lut’a ol ta ding.

Verse 4
Pakaiyin kot ahon tengle,
Ka lhagao lutjel theina ding,
Ka thaomei devah jinging ting,
Ki gingin ken ngah jing inge.

songs.title: 136. KIPA MAN HOM DINGA PAKAI HUNG TENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kipa man hom dinga Pakai hung teng,
I sandiu hinpo nan tem?
I tahsan jing u ahung toh nadem?
I nga jing Pakai Jesu.

Chorus
Tinau hitem phasa dem cheh a um
Kahi van chunga kaldia,
I kigin jingu ahung toh na dem?
Ama lam jeng chu isan jing a.

Verse 2
Jingpi phalvah in hung kum khat tou hen,
Eiho eihin kou tau le,
Pakai anga inatoh ikum teng,
A pha lheh e ti nan tem?

Verse 3
Aman eidalhah peh u tahsan chu,
Phatah a ching jing dinga,
Lungtheng sel a ichin cheh nah uvem,
Vanâ€™a nom chenna dinga.

Verse 4
Jan khangkim in I Pakaiyu hung leh,
I nga jing hung toh nan tem?
Kiging jing a um chu anun nom ding,
Vanâ€™a tonsot a nom ding.

songs.title: 137. GAM LOUPI TAH HUNG LHUNG DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam loupi tah hung lhung ding
Kanga jing chu van chunga um,
A kum tin a Mitheng te puikhom na chu;
Ni kem in chu gam loupi hunglhun ding chu
Asunai-e Pathen gam hung lhun ding chu anai ta-e.
He! Pathen gam hung lhun ding anai ta-e,
Pathen gam hung lhun ding chu anai ta-e,
Kigo dem in vo kalung sumkon a eihin kouding
Pakai Jesun hung lang ding Loupi tah a.

Verse 2
Pathen gam loupi le aloupi gotsa chu kinem in,
Chule Pakai hung na ding lam kat jingin,
Hichun vannoi leiset chonset nan
Eihen eihung lhading,
Pathen gam hung lhun ding chu anai ta-e.

Verse 3
Pathen gam hung lhun nile
Pakai ngaitah chu imu diu,
Gam hung lhunma Pakai chu hung kilang ding,
Halleluijah athisan a eilhatpau chu vahchoi in,
Pathen gam hung lhun ding chu anai ta-e.

Verse 4
Vannoi leiset miâ€™n angah sottan
A lung lhadel tauve,
Tijat in mihem te lung adong heltai,
Pathen gam Thupha chu hilleu hitin suhal u hite,
Pathem gam hung lhun ding anai tah jeh hin.

songs.title: 137. MIDANG KOU PONGE PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Pathen aw Pakai Pathen,
Idinga kei nei dalhah ham?
Ka taonan nanung ahinjui,
Ka taona lungset’in sangin.

Chorus
Ka taona suhmil’a um’am?
Lungset in sangin ka taona;
Midang vang kou ponge Pakai,
Lungset them Nangma tailou chu.

Verse 2
Ju-thuh jong kei dia lhing joulou,
Tenga sut jong lhingjou loulai;
Cross chunga na thisan long lha,
Hichun ka chonset atheng tai.

Verse 3
Arimathia khomi lamkai,
Pathen ngah jinga um ahin;
Pilat henga ngampel’in che’n,
Pakai long chu aga thum tai.

Verse 4
Sepai jalamkai adongun,
Joseph thum chu bulhit peh din;
Along chu tupat pon nem chan,
Tom’in song lhan’a avui tai.

Verse 5
Ave dia che Anu loi ho,
Atho thu Vantil in hil’un;
Nithum le jan thum achamin,
Athou tai tin aseipeh-e.

songs.title: 137. NALUNG HESOH SEL’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat d. (Isaiah 35:10)

Verse 1
Na lung hesoh sel’in, min jong anei nai,
Thuh tah-in hasel’in, phatechan sel’in ;
Na changa na umna lung gelin ngaiton,
Jesu jah-a seiyin lung mong tan nate.

Verse 2
Jesu jah a seiyin, athohsa ahi,
Seisoh in ahenga, nang panpi tei ding ;
Lung mon theina thu chu nalungin ching phan,
Pohgih ngai jang anom, ahenga taovin.

Verse 3
Lungdong hesoh mihem, tamtah aume,
Amaho thu gapen lungmonna thu hi ;
Sel’in nalung hesoh, mi chu kipah hen,
Nalung hesohna chu Jesu heng lhutjon.

songs.title: 138. HUNGINTE VANLAL NAO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Setna twikhanglen gal’a,
Kamong jou poi Pakai; (2)
Lhepna leiset chunga hin;
Hunginte, hunginte,
Van meikhu kong chunga;
Van lal nao Kelngoinou.

Verse 2
Lhepna leiset chunga hin,
Hunginte Zion’a; (2)
Olive thing phung sang chunga.

Verse 3
Olive thing phung sang chunga,
Hunginte Van lal nao; (2)
Avantil sangja chuto.

songs.title: 138. NGAIYUN AW GIN ITI NGEITAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyun aw gin iti ngeitam, ni Loupi hung lhung ding chu, Leiset chonset le thina hi,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.
Chungnung penâ€™a loupi pen hen (2)
Tin selangdah gin ngei thon,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 2
Tilâ€™a Aigupta gam bang chun, Jubilee ahung
lhung tai, Chungnung pen a loupi pen hen, Salem thah kot hongpa chu.

Verse 3
Mel hetlou mi ahi lasa, Lhandampu lemla sa ho,
Tonsot cham lal loupi lemnan,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 4
Ahoi ngeiye apon loupi, amel u nibang a em,
Ponbang vamleh loupi sil un,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

Verse 5
Neihil uvin vantil Thengten, Van lal Immanuel
chu, Laltouna theng loupi dalhan,
Michonse din ahung tai.

Verse 6
Hungvah kit in ka chung uva, melchih na valpa
ahsi, Chamna lenghen mun tinâ€™a hin,
Cham leng hen tin asauve.

songs.title: 138. NITIN’IN KA TAHSAN’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat. (Job. 13:15)

Verse 1
Nitin’in ka tahsane,
Ka lung tha alhom tengle ;
Kalam muthim teng jong le,
Christa a kalung kinem.

Chorus
Ni tin’in ka tahsane,
Lung dong lou ding itih a ;
I tile kahin laisea ;
Christa a kalung kinem.

Verse 2
Ka nop kom le la sange,
Kagim kom le tao vinge ;
Set toh jeng jong leng keima,
Christa a ka lung kinem.

Verse 3
Pathen Lhagaovin keima,
Eisalvah-e nitin’in ;
Aman kei eiching jinge,
Christa a kalung kinem.

Verse 4
Keima kahinlai chansen,
Hi leiset aman kah sen ;
Nopna vangam kalhun man,
Christa a kalung kinem.

songs.title: 139. ADANG CHE NUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat m. (John 14:6)

Verse 1
Adang che nunga mol chunga,
Kelngoi vah mang keiman ;
Hinna lungmonna hong sung lam,
Iti holdoh tang ngem ?

Chorus
Kei kahi, hinna lam leh thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi ;
Kei kahi, hinna lam le thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi.

Verse 2
Kana vahmang lengvaiyin kei,
Pathen heng jon louvin ;
“Hilam khu lama” eitiuvin,
Thutah la kahol mon.

Verse 3
Hinna lam le thutah Jesu,
Henge ka chei, tukal ;
Mangthah kit talouhel dingin,
A anga ka lut tai.

songs.title: 139. ALHANOI DAILIM NOMâ€™A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Alhanoi dailim nomâ€™a chun,
Lhatdam te kicholdo tan te,
Amauva tonsot hinna amuteng ule,
Kipah tauvin te.

Chorus
Cheng unte chengden tauvin te,
Lungset na Pakai vahchoi yun,
Atonsot in haljing tauvin te,
Alhanoi dailim nomâ€™a chun.

Verse 2
Alhanoi dailim nomâ€™a chun.
Genthei na jouse beita ding,
Hinna twikhuh a kisil unte,
Buhbang sang in bang jouvinte.

Verse 3
Alhanoi dailim nomâ€™a chun,
Ka le lungdon na um ta lou,
Setna huipi le lhepna gallen,
Abeitai khopi nomâ€™a chun.

Verse 4
O chu mun a leng teho chun,
Leiset genthei na thoh talou,
Van selangdah gin ngei tum unte,
Van kulpi chu vel tauvin te.

songs.title: 139. HUNG TEI DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai aw gin khu ngaiyuvin,
Leisetna miten;
Ahung nading ni anai tai,
I-tohgau kimlou.
Hung tei ding, (2)
Van huikong theng chunga;
Aloupi aphon kichai niteng.

Verse 2
Aman alhenchomte apui,
Tou ni teng chule;
Adalhahte chengse vang chu,
Gim genthei thoh ding.

Verse 3
Damun meidil’a umte chu,
Kum sangsom sangja;
Lung gentheina thohlhum soh ding,
Hin ding go jongleu.

Verse 4
Van goulo ding chengse vang chu,
A-emsel’a um;
Pa lunglhaina um jou lou ding,
I-tohgau kimlou.

songs.title: 140. GOLCHA KILHAHNA LA (MT. 10:28)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hi leiset hesoh lunghel gim mun hi,
Namelhoi toiyin chul jita;
Napah jin chomkhat gol mel kiplouvin,
Hamna le lhisonan nungjui jita.

Chorus
Deikip lelna leiset mun hi,
Ohe anai golngai kikhenna mun hi;
Nikhat nunnopna lei thah-a,
Kimu to kit kinem ing.

Verse 2
Gal hat chungnung pen aum nahet em?
Leiset phe keo that theiya thi;
Ging po-te olmo hih-in kalhai gol,
Ikimu to kit lou lam jong hetlou.

Verse 3
Mikhat aum’e nahet em? gal hat!
Mikhel galhat Pakai Christa;
Nikhat hung lamkaiya gal hinsat ding,
Thi ahinjo ding mitin jouse mua.

songs.title: 140. HOICHAN GAM HIJONGLE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Psalms 37:5)

Verse 1
Hoichan gam hijongle kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia eipuina channa chu ;
Ama beiya lung kipa thanopna bei,
Jesun eilhonpina a kei kicha lou.
Hoi chan’a hijong le kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia bitkeicha kei che ding.

Verse 2
Kei ka chang hilou Jesun eilhonpi nai,
Gol le pai thon jong le Ama kanei nai ;
Lam hahsa lama Aman eipui jongle,
Jesu toh umna chu vahchoina in hi.

Verse 3
Jesun ei lhonpina chan’a kei nom’a,
Imu thei kavel iti thim jeng jong le ;
Lung lhaisel’a ka jingtho ding chu kahei,
Jesu toh umna chan chu innom ahi.

songs.title: 140. I DIN DINGU LENG ANGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I din dingu Leng anga,
Vantil toh la isah ding;
Olle van gam noma, lui pang ema ilen diu,
Pathen vachoi la sa ding, olle van gam noma.
I din dingu Leng anga
Vantil toh la isah diu;
Loupi hen Leng chungnung chu,
Halleluiyah! Halleluiyah !
I din diu Len ang sunga.

Verse 2
Van a jo la kisa ding,
I din diu Leng ang sunga;
Olle van gam noma, gim genthei bei sohta ding;
I gimnau ichai soh teng, olle van gam noma.

Verse 3
Chen kalha thillu choi-in,
Leng chungnung lamto dingin,
Olle van gam noma, A khopi muh a kun in,
Alha lim noi-a umin, olle van gam noma.

songs.title: 141. HINKHO TWIPI KINONG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat m (Eph. 1:3)

Verse 1
Hinkho twipi kinong huipi hat natoa,
Mang soh a kingaito a nalung lhah teng ;
Na phattheina jouse abanchan simmin,
Pakai thilbol cheng chun kinsah in nate.

Chorus
Na phattheina abanchan simin,
Amin son lang abanchan simin ;
Pakaiyin na bolpeh chengse chu,
Pakai thilbol chengchun kinsah in nate.

Verse 2
Pohgih poa lungkham lungdonga na um’em ?
Naput dinga kigotpeh Cross chu gih sam ?
Phattheina sim le chun ginchat lel bei ding,
Sun nisa vah bangin vah jing tan nate.

Verse 3
Mi sumnei, selnei, gamnei navet kom le,
Christan natepsa hao seitheilou ngaiton ;
Ahao choh joulou phattheina chu simin,
Toh phatman nasan ding van’a atam’e.

Verse 4
Hijeh chun gim genthei iti hah jong le,
Lunglha hih in Pathen achungnung pen’e ;
Phattheina simin vantil’in nangah nai,
Nalam lhung keiya nalhonpi diu ahi.

songs.title: 141. NGAIYUN MI CHONSE TEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyun mi chonse ten, Leiset man ni thu ding,
Leng hatchungnung tah khat Laltouna a touve.
Hung kum tei ding Jesu Christa (2)
Vantil theng asang aja toh.

Verse 2
Leiset gam kimvel a, a vantil asol a,
Molle twija cheuva, mi chomkhom soh keidiu.
Jesun mi chonse te jouse (2)
A lelut ding meidil sung ah.

Verse 3
Chuteng le mi chonpha, Ama lung toh jouse,
Vanâ€™a apui touding, Pathen lhai la sa ding.
Gou kemlou hin kemou pentin,
Ol kemlou nop kemlou pentin,
Kem louva nomsa jing jeng ding.

Verse 4
Mi chonse te vang chu, a go ding meidil a,
A thu ngai louse chu, Leiset na um lai-a.
Gimtan neilou na mei konga (2)
Tonsot a gim thoh jing jeng ding.

songs.title: 141. THI LHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lumtan lumtan goldei lumtan kicholdo tan,
Jing ninou hungso kit kahsen;
Aw jing thona dah agin ni tengle,
Goldei te hotoh lengkhom tau hite.
Chibai (3) i-kimu kit kahseuvin,
Van gam nom’a ilen phatle;
Umlou ding kilhahna chibai.

Verse 2
Ohe goldei lumtan, ihmun, ihmu miltan,
Lhisona ka-na neilouvin;
Lei genthei hesoh lungdonna jouse,
Bangin lang kicholdona in lumtan.

Verse 3
Kahin sel’ui nalong damsa sen nao bangin,
Lhisona lhan ngui thim sunga;
Aw damsel chan Pa ang sung chu jontan,
Kap kit talou, mao kit talou dingin.

Verse 4
Van khonom nalhun teng neihin hailou jen’un,
Lhilonna leiya goldei te;
Aw chung toni jeng jong hung thimta hen,
Genthei chate lhilon hi bang tahen.

songs.title: 142. CROSS CHU IN JOTNA LAMPIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (I Cor. 5:8)

Verse 1
Cross chu in jotna lampia kanei tei ding,
Chulou chu lamdang umlou ;
Van khopi hoichu keiman mulou ding,
Ka mansah le Cross lampi chu.
Van in jotna Cross ahi, (2 vei)
Kache pum hin ka lammu kanome ;
Van in jotna Cross chu ahi.

Verse 2
Thisan bena lampi chu kaho tei ding,
Eihuhhingpa chenna chu ;
Van chung innom jon’a kakal tou ding,
Lhagao Pathen toh chenna chu.

Verse 3
Vannoi lampi chu kalhadoh tai keiman,
Achung hokit louhel ding ;
Jesun “Hungin” tin ka in ka jon’e,
Kot phunga einga jingna chu.

songs.title: 142. MANG JENG TAHEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mangjeng tahen lei lungdonna,
Golngai kikhen na jouse jong,
Nat nale lungdonna jouse,
Tonsot nopna ding in kile hen.

Chorus
Lungdon lungjin umta louding,
Lhandampu lenna Van gamâ€™a
Leiset gimna thoh ta louding,
O ka Lhagao choldo din chetan.

Verse 2
Geljing in ka hung kitna ding,
Phat le ni hi ahung naitai,
Leithil jouse kidang sohta,
Joun in Pakai yin nahol na gam.

Verse 3
Goldei tetoh lunglhai sel in,
Zion Pakai chu vahchoiyun,
Pakai kei jing neilhat jal in,.
Neipui lut in o Na van gamâ€™a.

Verse 4
Leiset chung a lung hesoh hon,
Zion Pakai chu vahchoiyun,
Ama thisan jal a miten,
Kakipah e tin vahchoi ute.

songs.title: 142. THANGTING LHANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai dinga lhom’a kajan,
Ka lhoma len Thangting lhang;
Pakai malam nei kai jeh-in,
Tun vang lhoma chu alhung tai.

Chorus
Christa hinchen len kase,
Pakai jaitha hatna jeh-in;
Phunglunlai Haokip, chitin in,
Huhhingna chu amu tauve.

Verse 2
Thangting lhanglen pumpi sunga,
Chasan koh khat jong mujoulou;
Tun vang Pakai thahatna jeh in,
Bongnoi twisam put bangta.

Verse 3
Thangting lhanglen pumpi sunga,
Chitin namtin acheng khom cheng;
Ichung Pathen gam nin nom’a,
Nunnom nga bang ilenkhom diu.

Verse 4
Iti noptam Pakai lenggam, (Pathen)
Christa laijon le toigol cheng;
Thilhunga tahsan inei le,
Hinna lallukhuh isan diu.

Verse 5
Keima michonse hatlou in,
Pakai nagam ding na katoh a;
Pakaiyin phatthei neiboh chun,
Tun vang tumbang kavoi ta-e.

songs.title: 143. GAM THUM’A VAI AHOM’E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam thum’a vai ahom’e,
Van gam Lengpa Jesu chun;
Ama vai homna gam’a,
Sun le jan aum tapoi ati.

Chorus
Ka vahchoiye Jesu ken,
Nalet nahatna jouse chu;
Nasoh kei nei hin ngaiton,
Ka lengvaina jouse hi.

Verse 2
Twi le lei le vanchung gam,
Ama vaihomna ahi;
Jesu sanga lenjo ding,
Chung le noiya hin kimu ponte.

Verse 3
Thingpel chunga akhaiyun,
Lhandampu Jesu Christa;
Setna ima anei poi,
Hibang genthei hi athoh vangin.

Verse 4
Rome sepai engse ho chun,
Engse tah in anabol seuve;
Pilat in huhhing agon,
Ahivangin ahuhhing joupoi.

Verse 5
Alennau Galil gam’a,
Pakai van’a akal tai;
Akal pet chun aloi hon,
Van lam asangun aka tauve.

songs.title: 143. KALE MAO UMNGAI LOU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kale mao umngailou lungdona jousoh in,
Van Salem khopi a leng te ho chun,
Setna gal jousoh un thina ging talouvin,
O vahchoi nala sauvin.

Verse 2
Hi leiet kavet le lungdon meiyin akhui,
Lungdon lungjin na noiya umte ho,
Ikipa lai niu hi hung mang loi ding ahi,
Aw olgam ka ngai ngeiye.

Verse 3
O thisan jal in khopi nom chu neilhut in,
Luigal gam golngai te kimna gamâ€™a,
Nei puilut in Van Mitheng te lenna gamâ€™a,
O len kanom ta ngeiye.

Verse 4
Salem thah nomâ€™a chun len kanom ta ngeiye,
Van Mitheng te hole lhatsa te chun,
Laltouna kimvelâ€™un pachat la asauve,
O Hallelujah tiuvin.

songs.title: 143. NALUNG DONSAH HIH HEL’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (I Thess. 4:18)

Verse 1
Nalung donsah hih hel’un,
Pakaiya lung ngaiyun ;
Ama jenga kinem’un,
Christa a thi jouse chu,
Vanna ahung pui ding.
Hijeh chun nangho,
Khat le khat hicheng thu hin ;
Kilungmon to cheh un,
Hiche jeh chun nang ho,
Hijeh chun nang ho ;
Kilungmon to cheh uvin, (2 vei)
Hicheng chun.

Verse 2
Nalung donsah hih hel’un,
Christa bou tahsan’un ;
Jan’a lungdon na cheng hi,
Jinga nomsah na dinga ;
Aman nang hung pui ding.

Verse 3
Pakai hung nading nikho,
Ngah jingin anai tai ;
Van’a akal ni banga,
Amitheng ten hin tom ding,
Hung kilah loi tading.

songs.title: 144. GAMTIN’A CROSS THINA LU HI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam tin’a Cross thina lui hi,
Thangsoh loi hen kintah ahi;
Calvary a kho hungvah hen,
Ningtin muntin salvah soh hen.

Verse 2
Pakai Pathen na natoh hi,
Suhal jingin kol mong geiyin;
Nalungsetna deh joulou,
Gamtin’a kithang soh loi hen.

songs.title: 144. GEISANG LOU JEN’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (Psalms 56:1)

Verse 1
Geisang lou jennun michonse ho,
Christa na hinna diu a ume ;
Tunin nakouve, O nem tah in,
“Hinna penge” ati.

Chorus
Nom hen, nom hen Pakai Christa min,
Ka chonset eisop lhengpehpa chu ;
A kom’a tonsot’a ka chen ding,
Van chunga in thenga.

Verse 2
Jesun na kouve ngaiyin chonsen,
“Hungun chapang ho” hitin ati ;
Hung loiyun chonse lung lengvai te,
Pakai Christa sangin.

Verse 3
Kho pholouvin um hih un mite,
Tunin hin Jesun nang nakouve ;
Hungun mi chonse lungbei olmo,
Na chonset lung khel’in.

songs.title: 144. JING NISO EMSEL A KAJING THO TENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jing niso emsel a kajing tho teng,
Nisa hoi chun lhumtih neita louding,
Tonsot a avah emhoi chullou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Chorus
Kalung lhaisel ta ding (2)
Jing niso emsel a kajing tho teng,
Kalung lhaisel ta ding (2)
Jing niso emsel a kajing tho teng.

Verse 2
Na loupi mailhai mel chu kamu teng,
Lhatsa nacha deite na ngong koi ding,
Lungset thilpeh in kot chu nahon teng,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Verse 3
Chemasa kangai cheng mel kamu teng,
I ti kipa ngem ken ngong koi cheh ding,
Ka dinga na phat ken simjou lou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

Verse 4
Eihuhhingpa Christa mel kamu teng,
Kei jal a athi ken sumil lou ding,
Tonsot chullou lan ken vahchoi tange,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.

songs.title: 145. NGAIYUN PAKAI DING BOLTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. sl
(Isaiah 40:31)

Verse 1
Ngaiyun Pakai ding bolte jousen,
Hatmo leh thi dingin ;
Pakai phatthei lhah ngah jinguvin,
Eisem pha jing nante.
Pakai thahatna kingai chu,
Athau semthah untin ;
Alhan leng touvun tin,
Muvanlai bangin leng touvun tin ;
Lhaitou dingu thachol louva,
Chol louva lam jot diu ;
Lhaitou dingu chollou hel’a,
Chol louva che diu.

Verse 2
Tamtah vei theichim le lung thoiyin,
Achunga iphun’ui ;
Huhhingpa hingjing itahsan’ui,
I bol’a kilel dem.

Verse 3
Kipah un ei umpi jing nauve,
Leiset beini geiyin ;
Khodah in hungun lang mason’un,
Ingai chan eipe ding.

songs.title: 145. PATHEN HENGA TAO DING A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen henga tao dinga, lungnem a kunpet hi,
I ti noptam huhhingpu anga taopet hi,
Tahsan a bel ihiu le, Aman eihuhhing diu,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi i-ti nop tam !
Tao hi lung olpet (2)
Chol dinga olna ahi,
Tao hi i-ti nop tam !

Verse 2
Pathen henga tao dinga, lungnem a kunpet hi,
â€œNa lungkham na jouseu ka anga seplhau vinâ€
Tia lungset khoto tah a eiseipeh teng ule,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi i-ti nop tam !

Verse 3
Pathen henga tao dinga, lungnem a kunpet hi,
Ama lung toh te genthei na amusoh in,
A lungset lhaving noi-ah, nitin in eihoi e,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi i-ti nop tam !

songs.title: 145. THI LHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ipi ilainat dem, ahinkho nom ahi,
Genthei adalha tai Pathen kom’a aum;
Kipah tah-in van alhung tai,
Jesu kom’a nomsa jing din.

Verse 2
Gamlatah agei tai, chu-a lungjin beita,
Natna aum tapoi anin kemtih neilou;
Nat ham beita ahin kikhel,
Jesu kom’a nomsa jing din.

Verse 3
Kap kit talouhel ding, ka-na aum tapoi,
Ham kit talouhel ding hamna aum tapoi;
Adalha tai, kihkit lou din,
Jesu kom’a nomsa jing din.

Verse 4
Chunggih aum tapoi, nat le ka-na ho jong,
Tonsot in aume a Lhandampu tah to;
Ana hah tah atong jouvin,
Jesu kom’a nomsa jing ding.

songs.title: 146. BIBLE’A THU UM HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. d. (Psalms 119:105)

Verse 1
Bible’a thu umhi Thupha chungnung pen,
Athu jouse hinna le sochatna ;
Mi thisa jong thoukit ding tin aseiye,
Lhagao mangsa hindoh kitna ahi.
Bible thu ngaiyun, Bible thun nungun,
Mangun Bible Thupha hinna kidang.

Verse 2
Ngai phauvin Bible gou kemlou chungnung thu,
Lhagao hinna le sochatna ahi ;
Aman jat jong leiset min sim theilou ding,
Hol’in lhagao phattheina kidang hi.

Verse 3
Mi lamvaite dinga Bible meivah pha,
Khangthah dan neilou dinga jong phatna ;
Mi chonse dinga hinna le lung olna,
Teh le khang dinga hibou thupha pen.

songs.title: 146. KALUNG LENGVAI KOM LE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalung lengvai kom le,
Pakai hung lengin kalung sunga,
Lengvai chate choldo namun na lenna chu,
Neihil in aum chan,

Chorus
Lei genthei na a kalen laihin.
Aloupi je thu hi, kasei jou theipoi,
Van selangdah gin ngei,
Vahchoi na dah keidia gin ngei chu.

Verse 2
Lei genthei na ahin,
Lengvaiyin kap in mao jeng jong leng,
Thina luigal kakai phat le lungset ka Pan,
Aw eina lamton tin,
Lungdon mitlhi sona beitan te.

Verse 3
O chu munâ€™a leng chun,
Khenna thu him him a seipouve,
Khotheng nom le kelngoi nou chun tongso le lan, Mitheng le Seraphim hotoh vahchoina chim ta louding.

Verse 4
O chu mun lhun ding chu,
Lei genthei na hin eidal jitai,
O kangah lel Nagam thengnom neimu sah in,
Jona tumkao choiya, Aw Salem thah mukal ka ngah lel.

songs.title: 146. KEN NA IN DING SANG’E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ken na in ding sange,
Hoitah le nomtah in;
Nalha chenna ding van chunga,
Gilkel dangchah umlou;
Na van gam nom’a chun,
Tonsot kem theilou gam nom’a. (2)

Verse 2
Chu gam nomtah chu ken,
Ka mang bangin kamui;
Nop le ol kemkit talou ding,
Agamla tapoi tun;
Chu gamnom ka ngai chu,
Kei dinga in nom asem chu. (2)

Verse 3
Chu gam chu kei chang in,
Ding hilou nang ding jong;
Nazaret Jesu chenna chu,
Chu gam’a chengte i;
Ti nop tam tonsotna,
Aman eihepi jeh-u chun. (2)

Verse 4
Chu gam’a in chu a,
Nop ahoi sei theilou;
Chu a lung genthei gim beita,
O ngei tah le kipah;
Tah-a la mai sa ding,
Gamtin kimu to sohta ding. (2)

Verse 5
Hungun ka sopite,
Hung kipat in hungun;
Cheu hite Sion gam jonin,
Ei huhhingpan asah;
In nom’a chu cheng din,
Thikit louna gam nom em’a.
Thikit louna nat kit louna,
Lungdon, kichat, tijat, lunghel umta lou ding;
Beita ding lhiso le ka-na.

songs.title: 147. CRUCIFIXION
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu lungdongin achei,
Agalten akaiyun;
Achena ding lam kavet le,
Thina mun chu ahi.

Chorus
Chu lhanga chun akhai sangun,
Sapsetna thing chunga;
Lengvai kana o ka jah chu,
Lhandampu o ahi.

Verse 2
Alengvaina Cross chu apun,
Pakai chu akaiyun;
Lhandampu hoikom alhut’um,
Ka-Pu chu ga hunge.

Verse 3
Pon loupi le linglukhuh to,
I-Pu chu akaiyun;
Ka chonset jouse hi apon,
Gentheina lhang jonin.

Verse 4
Chu-a mipi akikhom’un,
Pakai taitomte ho;
Lungdonna ten ana bom’in,
Thingpel’a dom sangun.

Verse 5
Akhut le akeng thingkil’in,
Thing to akhenbeh un;
Hichun ka jousoh tai atin,
Pakaiyin asam’e.

Verse 6
Thina lungjin lungdon jouse,
Lung hesohna jouse;
Ipun abon’in ajouvin,
Lhan’a kon athou tai.

songs.title: 147. I LENNAU LEI MUNTHIP A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I lennau lei munthip a kon in,
Ingai ui gamtheng chu,
Ache masa I golten eingah jing-ui,
Twipi nong gal gammon a chun.

Chorus
Gol in ven ponlap na masang a,
Kouna aw nem chu ngaiphan juon jing in,
Kicha hih in Van lamthomâ€™a,
Goldei ten na ngah na in.

Verse 2
Na masanga nalhem lha dingin,
Lhepna twi long jong le,
Kichalou vin ven ponlap chu juon jingin,
Hung kile kit thei nahi tapoi.

Verse 3
Van muntheng nomâ€™a lengte ho chun,
Lei kana hin veuvin,
Lungdon puldouva umte chu amu ve,
Ahin sang ui akhut jet in.

Verse 4
Vo goldei chu mun chu najon tai,
Nunglam hin ngai louvin,
Ache masa igol laiya leng ding in,
Pakai Christan pui lhung teiyin.

songs.title: 147. NISUN VAH A CHUN CHEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (Matt. 4:19)

Verse 1
Nisun vah a chun chen, nipi vah a chun,
Jinga pahcha pah le janlai dai lhah in ;
Nitinin masonin, dettah in pangun,
Lam tinna Jesu juiyin.

Chorus
Juiyun keiman jong kajuiye,
Juiyun niti’in juiyun ;
Aman napui le na channa,
Juiyun Jesu chu alam tinnah.

Verse 2
Sun nisat emlai le, janlai muthimin,
Chamkang lou noulai le chuhlai go lonin ;
Aman nakou ngaiyun, dettah in pangun,
Lam tin’ah Jesu juiyun.

Verse 3
Nisa vah emlai le thimpi jinga jong,
Khopi hui nunna le lungdon nah a jong ;
Ami ngailut gingchan akhon ni geiyin,
Anung lhaso lou jenun.

songs.title: 148. ITI NOP HITAM PAKAI A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Iti nop hitam Pakai a, ki ngaija cholnga ding,
Na thahat chun neitung dingin,
Ka lung lhah na chanâ€™a.
Na lunggel lungkham na jouse,
Seplhan abonchan Achunga,
Na lunggel lungkham na jouse,
Aman na khankho ding agel nai.

Verse 2
Ka lunggel jouse na chunga,
Nga leng na lung ahi,
Ka lung hesoh genthei jouse,
Nangman nahe soh nai.

Verse 3
Nami lungset khoto ging chan,
Nangma lam jeng kavei,
Ka lungdon hesoh na channa,
Nangman lungmon neipen.

Verse 4
I bol a kalung kham ding ham,
Khonung thu ding gelna,
I pi kakichat pi ding ham,
Pakai a kingai leng.

songs.title: 148. JESUN KOT AKIU KIUVE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Flat (Rev. 3:20)

Verse 1
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Thachol ka henga hungun ;
Tin huhhing din nakouve,
Kot chu hong len’in.

Chorus
Kot chu hong len’in,
Kot chu hong len’in ;
Huhhing jou Ama ahi,
Kot chu hong len’in.

Verse 2
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Nang huhnan Ama athin ;
Lhanna kon athoudoh tai,
Kot chu hong len’in.

Verse 3
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Don nalung Aheng lama ;
Nalung kipana dim ding,
Kot chu hong len’in.

Verse 4
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Huhhingna anaipet hin ;
Ajou le chemang khante,
Kot chu hong lenin.

songs.title: 148. PAKAI HENGA GENTHEI AUMPOI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Alalna tonsot gamnom hin dalhan,
Ahung vah gentheiye eiho dingin;
Pakai vannoiya hin deiyin aleng ngampoi,
Setna leisetna hin umna ding neilouvin.

Chorus
Aumpoi i-Pakai banga genthei,
Leiset Lhandampu chu tugeiyin jong;
Set jeh in alung dong,
Agentheiye aw thoh sah kit hih-un.

Verse 2
Kingahna neilou chungleng va bangin,
Lung ngahna ding neilou i-Pakai chu;
Twipi chung le vangkhoa nahil’in nitin’in,
Nei ngailut jeh-uva lung genthei nahi.

Verse 3
Setna simtha dingin i-Pakaiyu,
Lal Pilat’in themmo ana chan’in;
Abanin akaiyun Calvary lam jonin,
Sapsetna thing chunga eiho din athoh.

songs.title: 149. CROSS PHUNG JON IN KAHUNG E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Cross phung jon in ka hunge,
Mi genthei hesoh lengvai,
Keima mi chonse chungnung,
Tun vang lhatdam ka changtai.

Chorus
Pakai Nang ka tahsanâ€™e,
Calvary van Kelngoi nou,
Ka kunâ€™e na Cross noi ah,
Nei lungset in neihuh in.

Verse 2
Chonset in eihen sottai,
Lung in Nang kalha ngaijin,
Nem heo cha eikou kajai,
Ka hung tai Nang lim jon in.

Verse 3
Ka lung le kanei jouse,
A bonchan Nang kape tai,
Ka lhagao le ka tahsa,
A bonchan Nang a hihen.

Verse 4
Jesu hung keima hinna,
A man kei eisop theng tai,
A tonsot a tonsot in,
Loupi jing hen Kelngoi nou.

songs.title: 149. THE LAND BEYOND THE RIVER. (L.Th. 120)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jordan lui peogal kakai teng,
Kilungsetna gam nom’a;
Lhandampu le alhatsate,
Mel lhaisel’a ka mu ding.

Chorus
Aw Pakai chun lungsetna gam emnom’a,
Olna asem tai athisan lu chun;
Kei michonsen thisan jal’in kahin bel,
Thisanin silthengin nei olsah-in.

Verse 2
Pakai tepna gam nom em’a,
Ka ngahlel chu a ol ding;
Hinna thinglim dam noiya chun,
Itih le ka ol ding ham?

Verse 3
Aw van Jerusalem Thah chu,
Ahoiye seithei hilou;
Ka laicha tengle Lal Jesun,
Khopi thah eilhun sah ding.

Verse 4
Lhandampu kom kalhun tengle,
Kalung helna bei tante;
Gimna gal gam nom’a ol ding,
Kalung gimna bei tante.

songs.title: 149. THENNA DING PHAT NEIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. m. (Lev. 20:7).

Verse 1
Thenna ding phat neiyin na Pathen houvin,
Amatoh um jingin Athun kivah in ;
Pathen chate ho jong kihou thei pin lang,
Ahatmote hun lang sumil lou jenin.

Verse 2
Thenna ding phat neiyin athu nit jingin,
Jesu chu guhthim min atamjon houvin ;
Jesu vejing le chun Ama toh bang ding,
Na gol’in amud in a umchan bang thon.

Verse 3
Thenna ding phat neiyin lam kihil sah in,
A ang sunga konin jammang lou jenin ;
Gim hesohna ahi na Pakai juiyin,
Jesu lam kat jingin Athu tahsanin.

Verse 4
Thenna ding phat neiyin nalung olsah in,
Na lungput jouse chun anoiya lut’in ;
Avaihom thun nungin kipuisah jingin,
Ngailut bulpi ahi van’a puilut thei.

songs.title: 150. AW PAKAI VANNOI CHONSET PO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakai vannoi chonset po,
Thimna gal’in alem’e.
Mithengte le Pakai Jesun,
Itobangin na ngaitou vem;
Ana-e Pakai nunnem,
Chimtih him him kanei poi.

Verse 2
Aw ka ngaiye khopi sunga,
Hosana atiu lai chu.
Nat jouse a na le damlou,
Kipa nopna kile sah Pa;
Aw ahi chonset vangin,
Nopna kolnin alem’e.

Verse 3
Kei dinga ka lha monna le,
Kalung gil’a einem Pa.
Aw athi Calvary lhanga,
Zion chate alengvaiyun;
Lunglai meipi hung jingin,
Kemtih nei kit talou ding.

Verse 4
Aw Canaan namou lemlai chu,
Ka ngaiye ka nop laini.
Tu vang hin pah bangin chulta,
Namel hoi pon bangin chul’in;
Galilee a na lenna,
Iti hin holdoh tang em?

Verse 5
Aw Simon Peter le Martha,
Athi-e ka Lhandampu.
Alennau Canan gam nguijou,
Khopi sung le Houin sung chu;
Iti hin musoh tang em,
Lhandampu le kalenna.

Verse 6
Ana-e, ana ta ngeiye,
Ka vaveina Canan gam.
Thoh ahaipouve lungdonga,
Simeon thusei te ho chu;
Ahung lhunge tutah hin,
Kalung lai asunna-e.

Verse 7
Tuhin vang Pakai Lhandampu,
Na van gam nalhun tengle.
Ling lukhuh hi ngaita louva,
Na loupina Lal lukhuh chu;
Na khuh teng lengvai keiho,
Nei hinven mithengte to.

songs.title: 150. LUNGSET NA AKIHOMâ€™E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungset na akihomâ€™e, chitin le namtin ding in,
Phatthei phung chu pah uvin, Lal loupi chungnung ahi.
Chonse lung genthei lengvai,
Lungset na gam nom chang un,
Thisan theng tah a eilhat jal un,
Adei jouse hung uvin.

Verse 2
Vang phat kihom pet ahi,
Lut uvin gam nomâ€™a chun,
Na chonset jouse pouvin,
Ngaidam inte lungset in.

Verse 3
Tepna gam chang dia gotsa,
Sopi gammang kit dan lang,
Kouna aw chu ngai jing in,
Canaan Pakai chu ahi.

Verse 4
Kipa aw ngei kajatai,
Vah loupi kamu phat in,
Dettah in lung ol eipei,
Lhatna thisan kachang tai.

songs.title: 150. O NGEITAH IN SAKIT TEM’UN
151. HINKHO DEILAI ACHOM’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Lev. 20:7)

Verse 1
Hinkho deilai achom’e,
Thingna pullai abange ;
Changpal kansa abange ki gingun,
Hin nikho akem jinge,
Vangset ni hung lhunginte ;
Thina hunglhung loiyinte ki gingun.
Phat hom’in ki gingun,
Jesun nakou kou laiyu hin ki gingun ;
Setna a umsot leu chun,
Hinna kot hon hom louvin ;
Nalut phat kikhel’in te ki gingun.

Verse 2
Pahcha hoilai pul loiyin,
Khangdong hoilai cheloiyin,
Nang umsot ding nahipoi ki gingun ;
Pathen lhan nakou laiyin ;
Umhih un ngaisah louvin,
Manna lam’a chunnate ki gingun.

Verse 3
Phat akem tul tul jinge,
Thi vaihom ahung naiye ;
Jesu khut’a kikhum’un mangang un ;
Vangsetna ahung lhun’a,
Na lhagao man masangin,
Aloupina chu simun kigingun.

Verse 4
Hilna thu chu ngai phauvin,
Pakai chu tuhdet leu chun,
Van mi jouse kipah ding kigingun ;
Chonset muthim dalhauvin,
Jesu chu tahsan’un lang,
Van lam jonin tun cheuvin kigingun.

songs.title: 151. KA GALVON KATOL KOI NGAMPOI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka galvon katol koi ngampoi,
O kachen na gal gin na mun,
Nitin lhepna chun eijui jing,
O ka Lhandampu seilep ding in.

Chorus
O neivon in Immanuel,
Na Lhagao vin neivon inlang,
Hi leiset set thim kulpi hi,
Nang dingin dou kit nange.

Verse 2
Lhasam le geuchau vin ka um,
Na din sonlel mel pu jong leng,
Gal hatte dinga Lallukhuh,
O nasem chu neimu sah kit in.

Verse 3
O hinve tan ka Lhandampu,
Na thisan a na lhatsa te,
Hi leiset set thim kulsung a,
Akihen ui Pakai simjou lou.

Verse 4
Nang in neipui le melma te,
Ken dou ding Na thisan jal a,
Na tonsot gou lopi ding in,
O set soh a kon ken puidoh ding.

Verse 5
Olle kho ahung vah tengle,
Ka Lhandampu chu kamu ding,
Chua kagal von sut lhang ting,
O ponbang loupi eisil peh ding.

songs.title: 151. LUNGLEN LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinkho deilai kahin nau le phat hoi,
Hi ana kemloi jitai;
Ima jouse kagel’e,
Lunghel aum ngeiye.

Chorus
Na pamai, na pamai,
Aw phat le kumlui mol’in;
Nalungset vanga namtin nomsa cheng,
I hinlai damsung kimpet chau hin.

Verse 2
Phat kipa um akem aw mitamtah,
Ihin pahlai achul tai;
Khankho akem jinge,
Lunghel aum ngeiye.

Verse 3
Hithei hi hen kavon ding kipa um,
Muthei kit ding chu hileng;
Nunlui ngaiyin kahol,
Kumlui bou ka tiuve.

Verse 4
Kumlui to ikikhen koukit thei lou,
Gol ngai kikhenpi jong chu;
Ahinkho alhingin,
Kumlui to alhon tai.

songs.title: 152. KA NGAI NGEIYE TONSOT GAMNOM
152. NEIKOU AWGIN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Neikou awgin kajai, Nangma komâ€™a dingin,
Nei soptheng dingin Calvary a
Na thisan long lha chun.
Pakai kahunge
Tun Nang kom jon in
Thisan chun neisop theng in,
Calvary a long lha chun.

Verse 2
Chonse kahi vangin, na heng kahin jonâ€™e,
Tha neipen neisop theng sel in,
Ka thensel masang sen.

Verse 3
Jesun eikouve kei, tahsan det kichen din,
Lungset tahsan nop kichen din,
Lei le van chung a din.

Verse 4
Chonset hatgam sunga, thahat neipen Jesun,
Lungset tah in kei eilamtoi,
Phatthei na eiboh e.

songs.title: 152. THOUVIN KALUNG NISA SO TOH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Thouvin kalung nisa so toh kijuiyin,
Ka lungin Pathen jeng gel’in ;
Lung lhaisel le lung hal pel’in lhai ponthon,
Meiyin kong hen Pathen nang ngai.

Verse 2
Sun le jan neilou van mithengte jousen,
Pathen thusim asim jingui ;
Nangman jong amaho lasah jeng gel’in,
Na vahchoi na la sangin san.

Verse 3
Pathen tujan kalha nahoi damsel’a,
Hinkho thah neipeh tujinga ;
Hibang chun vangam noma kho vah jingle,
Neilan Nangma gam nom sungah.

Verse 4
Nei ching jingin chonphat le lungnem neipen,
Na lhagao theng chun neipui len ;
Tunia ka chonnau katoh kasei jouseu,
Pathen mitmua lamjang dingin.

songs.title: 153. CHONSET LUNGDON GIM POMANG DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chonset lungdon gim pomang ding,
I neijui golpha Jesu,
I jakai ipohlut thei diu,
Pathen henga taona a.

Chorus
Lungdong lung mong mo hesoh a,
I ding gim ithoh jiu ham?
I lhut lou jeh jiu Pathen heng,
I taonau va i-jakai.

Verse 2
I neijum thunoh le lhep na,
Lungjin lungdon na um em?
Lunglha louvin um jing ute,
Pathen heng lhut in taona.
Munau hitem Golpha adang,
Eithoh khompia ginchat thei,
I hatmo nau Jesun ahei,
Taovin aheng lhut soh un.

Verse 3
Hatmo le pohgih po ihim,
I lel um pohgih poh na,
I beldiu Jesu a um nai,
Taonan aheng lhut soh un.
Gol in nadei moa napai em?
Taovin Pakai heng lhut in,
A ban tenia nang huhhing a,
Nangman nom sata ding chu.

songs.title: 153. LUNGLEN LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalung lengvai kom le,
Pakai hung lengin kalung sunga;
Lengvai chate choldo,
Na mun nalenna chu;
Nei hil’in aum chan,
Lei gentheina a kalen lai hin.
Aloupi je thu hi,
Kasei jou thei poi aw;
Van selangdah gin ngei,
Vahchoina dah kei dia gin ngei chu.

Verse 2
Lei gentheina a hin,
Lengvaiyin kap in mao jeng jong leng;
Thina luigal ka kai,
Phat le lungset ka Pan;
Aw eina lamton tin,
Lungdon mitlhi sona bei tante.

Verse 3
Aw chu mun’a leng chun,
Khenna thu him him asei pouve;
Khotheng nom le Kelngoi,
Nou chun tongso le la’n;
Mitheng le Seraphim,
Ho to vahchoina chim talou ding.

Verse 4
Aw chu mun lhun ding chu,
Lei gentheina hin eidal jitai;
Aw ka ngahlel na gam,
Theng nom neimu sah-in;
Jo-na tumkao choiya,
Aw Salem thah mukal ka ngahlel.

songs.title: 153. SEIYIN THUSIM LUI THU CHU
154. GOLCHA NI KILHAHNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I-lennau lei munthim’a kon in,
I-ngaiyui gam theng chu;
Ache masa igolten eingah jingun,
Twipi nong gal gam nom’a chun.

Chorus
Gol’in ven ponlap namasanga,
Kouna aw nem chu ngaiphan jong jingin;
Kicha hih-in, Van lamthom’a,
Goldei ten na ngah nai.

Verse 2
Na msanga nalhemlha dingin,
Lhepna twi long jongle;
Kicha louvin ponlap chu jon jingin,
Hung kile kit thei nahita poi.

Verse 3
Van mun theng nom’a lengte ho chun,
Lei ka-na hi veuvin;
Lungdon puldouva umte hi amuve,
Ahin sangui akhut jet’in.

Verse 4
Vo goldei chu mun chu najon tai,
Nunglam hin ngai louvin;
Ache masa igol laiya leng dingin
Pakai Christan puilhung teiyin.

songs.title: 154. KALUNG SUNG SET BOH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalung sung set boh nensa chu,
Na Hou in hin semthah in,
Asung a hin o ka Pakai,
Tonsot in Nang hung cheng in.
Na um na chu (2)
Tonsot kipanan aloi.

Verse 2
O khatvei beh muthei hileng,
Khatvei beh Nang namu leng,
Leiset pahhoi jouse sang in,
Ajat jan Nang nahoi joi.
Kipeng kate (2)
Nangma toh cheng khom ding in.

Verse 3
O semhoh in kaset na hi,
Ka Lhagao huhhing in lang,
Ka chimtauve thimâ€™a um hi,
Hungvah in van vah loupi.
Nahung vah teng (2)
Kalung sung kipaâ€™n adim.

songs.title: 154. VANNOI GEMTIN CHONSET
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl (Psalms 43:3)

Verse 1
Vannoi gamtin chonset muthimin aloi,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Lhagao huhhinga um noma atame,
Hinna thun salvah un.

Chorus
Sochatna hinna Thupha vah chun,
Agamtin salvah soh hen ;
Sochatna hinna Thupha vah chun,
Tonsot geiyin salvah hen.

Verse 2
Jet le veiya igam miten eikou vui,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Kipah tah le thanom tah in choileu te,
Hinna thun salvah un.

Verse 3
Hinna Thupha mijousen amuthei nan,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Hinna Thuphan gamtin alosohna din,
Hinna thun salvah un.

Verse 4
Hinna thu lhacha ipan hi chim poute,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Van’a ivon diu thilpha khol ihiuve,
Hinna thun salvah un.

songs.title: 155. HUNG’UN PATHEN NGAITE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Psalms 149:2)

Verse 1
Hungun Pathen ngaite,
Kipah in la sauvin ;
Kipah in la sacheh unlang, (2 vei)
Kikhom’un kimvel’un.(2 vei)

Chorus
Cheu hite Zion ah,
Zion gam nom chungnung em’a ;
Cheu hite Zion gam noma,
Pathen khopi nomtah a chun.

Verse 2
Pathen hepha louten,
Vahchoi da jeng jong leu ;
Eiho Pathen chate sen vang, (2 vei)
Phongun nalung kipau.(2 vei)

Verse 3
Pathen kihouna a,
Asang jan tha nom’un ;
Vanna khopi hoi ilhun man, (2 vei)
I len mam gam em’a. (2 vei)

Verse 4
Chu a lhi kangsoh ding,
Kipa la isah diu ;
Immanuel cha ihi diu, (2 vei)
Van khopia ilen diu. (2 vei)

songs.title: 155. KUM LE LHA AKEM JINGE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kum le lha akem jinge,
Kanop lai nikho jong hi,
Na emhoi le hi leiset pah hi,
Ka dingin lungdon le kana gam ahi.

Chorus
O ka tonsot khopi le gal munâ€™a,
Lhatdam te lenna gamchu kangai ngeiye,
Lungdon na le lha lengvai na,
A um tapoi kana aw ging talou.

Verse 2
Ka noplai nikho akem,
Noi leiset pahhoi jong hi,
Lei nopna ponbang in chulkit jin,
Pahbang pahna tonsot gam kangai ngeiye.

Verse 3
Hi leiset lungdon na le,
Muthim in eikhang kimvel,
Ka lenna gamthip le kamao na,
Pelâ€™a lungset tetoh lenkhom kanome.

Verse 4
Einem in lang o Pakai,
Genthei lengvai cha kahi,
Neipui yin Nangma lenna gamâ€™a,
Lungjin na leiset hi ken ngaita louding.

songs.title: 155. LEISET CHUNGA HIN AW
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset chunga hin aw,
Chung leng va banga kalen lai hin;
Eisulung jing ding lhepna ahat,
Nung le ma chem le thal;
Ahem’e ka dingin nitin in,
Lungmong le lhamong theilou kahi tai.
Pakai lungset twikhanglen ging tobang,
Hoiya tham’a lung lengvai le kahim;
Chung Pathenin setlei chunga hin aw,
Anatong dinga eilhamon hinai mo?

Verse 2
Nitinin lhepna mei,
Pi jingin eijinkhum jeng jongle;
Pakai hatnan eikhu jing ta hen,
U le nao cham del’in;
Christan eipeh-u na tongute,
Pah banga ihinkhou amol kahsen.

Verse 3
Kipah-in kalung penge,
Chungnung pen Christa kom’a chun;
Lal loupi bon noi leisetna leng,
Christa dinga kahin;
Kho hi genthei thoh dia kaphal le,
I-louva kei lung kisih ding kahim?

Verse 4
Leiset chunga kagol,
Te le kajat chanpi te ho chu;
I-themmonao ki ngaidam’ute,
Christa Lal mun loupi;
Salem gamnom ichan nadingun,
Khat le khat kingaidam to cheh-ute.

songs.title: 156. ALPHA AND OMEGA. (L.Th. 77)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Amaho chu akom’a um ding,
Amaho chu amite hitante;
Pathen ngai chun umpiu vinte,
Amit’uva mitlhi athahhul peh diu.

Chorus
Dangchah jouse kom’a chun,
Hinna twikhuh a twi manbeiyin peng kate;
Aw lhagao dangchah ho chun,
Hung don tau hen.

Verse 2
Thina umkit thei ta louhel ding,
Lungdon lhiso na le natna ho jong;
Aum kit thei talou hel ding,
Thil masa jouse jong chu abeisoh tai.

Verse 3
“Ngaiyun thil jouse kasem thah-e,
Sun in hi thu hi thutah ahi” ati;
Hin kahenga ahung lhung tai,
Kei Alpha Omega patna le jo-na.

Verse 4
Amasa pen le anunung pen,
Hinna thing chunga chun thu anei thei;
Khoa alut theina dinguvin,
Akisutheng ho chu anunnom ahi.

songs.title: 156. JESU SEINAN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu seinan kajai,
â€œThalhom nahi ngut nai,
Thalhom chaten thum un,
Pekim inge keimanâ€.
Ka bat jouse chu Jesun asalhai,
Ka chonset na jouse jong
Aman asop lheng tai.

Verse 2
I macha kanei poi,
Nalungset ngeh na din,
Nangman neisop theng in,
Calvary thisan chun.

Verse 3
Keima kathi teng a,
Ka lhagao van kalteng,
Jesun eilhat jalâ€™in,
Kei van gam lhung ta ding.

Verse 4
Laltouna ka din teng,
Ama angsung a chun,
Ka galvon pailhang ting,
Jesu ang sung a chun.

songs.title: 156. KA DINGE DETTAH IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (I Sam. 14:7)

Verse 1
Ka dinge dettah in galvon po kahi,
Ka ngah jinge Lengpan thu eipeh ding ;
Malam nonge Lengin thu eipeh le,
A kom’a ding ingting Ama jen lenge.

Chorus
“Ngaiyun ma lam novin” tia gal sam khu,
Anu nungui ven mi kichase ho ;
Pakaiyin keima einganse tei ding,
Agalvon choi bou kahi jeng vangin.

Verse 2
Ka ding jinge dettah in galvon choiyin,
Phasa demin chem le thal lum kathoi ;
Gal kisat gin ngah in ka dinge kei,
“Pakai ka ding nai” kati theina dingin.

Verse 3
Von po bou hijong leng chan kanei tei ding,
Loupina kemlou le lalukhuh hoi ;
Tahsan neiya gal kasat jousea chu,
Pathen anga maipha chang tei ding keima.

songs.title: 157. LHAN THIMâ€™A LUM AHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhan thimâ€™a lum ahi,
Lhandampu Jesu
Ni hung lhung ding ngah in Pakai Jesu.
Lhan â€˜a kon in athoutai,
A thahat in agalte jouvin,
Thina muthim gam jouvin ahung thoutai,
Tonsot loupi Laltouna a tou dingin,
Athoutai, Athoutai,
Halleluyah athoutai

Verse 2
A lhan ngau moh ahi,
Lhandampu Jesu,
Khulsin song moh ahin, Pakai Jesu.

Verse 3
Thinan ahenjou poi,
Lhandampu Jesu,
Lhan sin song phujal ta, Pakai Jesu.

songs.title: 157. NGAIYUN PAKAI JESUN EIKOU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. (Isaiah. 6:8)

Verse 1
Ngaiyun Pakai Jesun eikou,
Tunia vaikon ding koi ham ?
Jao a angtai, chang amin tai,
Aga chomkhom ding koi ham ?

Chorus
“A chang at chu manpha penge”
Hitin ati Pakaiyin ;
“Keima ka umnai nei sol’in,”
Lhaisel’a ti ding koi ham ?

Verse 2
Khol gamla che hih jongleu chun,
Holdoh ding amangsa te ;
Mun nate thilha hou sangja,
Hiho chu hinna thu pen ;
Sum tampi ahilou vangin,
Paini jeng cha hi jong le ;
Hiche themcha jong chu Jesun,
Tamtah in sang tei nante.

Verse 3
Thu seiyin themhih jongleu chun,
Solchah Paul seithem bangin ;
Jesu mi lungset sei leuvin,
Ei jal’a athi jeh chun ;
Thupi tan ding kicha louva,
Mi chonse ho adau le,
Chapang ho hin koukhom leu chun,
Pathen’in kipom nante.

Verse 4
Pakai o-gin najah mau le,
Mihem hinkho kemlai hin ;
Na thaset manin ti dauvin ;
“Keima ka-i alou poi”,
Lung lhaiyin Pathen na tongun,
Tong jingun thanom tah in ;
Asei najah mau le tiuvin,
“Pathen keima nei sol’in”.

songs.title: 157. THE FOUNDATION OF LIFE (L. Th. 31)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kum lhungin nei chingun damsel’in,
Nei ching jingun chuh le khal’in;
Lem louvin eihoiyun Pakaiyin,
I-kipanau ni let hi imu tauve.

Chorus
Chung le noiya Pakai lem’u hite,
Huhhingpa leiya pen ni hin;
Kipah thanom tah-in hung lhauvin,
Lhaisel’in lem’ute eihuhhing Pau chu.

Verse 2
Tujing hin van Lal lengpa lemnan,
Hunglha cheh-un na inkouvin;
Kipah thanom tah-in hung lhauvin,
Mijouse lungsung chu kipanan lo hen.

Verse 3
Namtin phungtin mi jouse dingin,
Ahung penge genthei thoh-in;
Genthei hesohna ajou soh-in,
Eiho chonset jouse apomang soh tai.

songs.title: 158. CHAMNA LUIPI HUNG LONG HEN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw eilhandampu set le gimna noiya hin,
Lhagaovin neipui len lang;
Na thisan’a nalhatsate chun nalem’un,
Chamna lui dunga acholdouve.

Chorus
Chamna luipi hung long hen,
Leiset gim munna hin;
Van Lalcha eihuhhingpa,
Ka ma a pah hoiyin pah jingin.

Verse 2
Lei hi Pakai thilpeh loupi masa ahi,
Kasei thei poi nei lungset;
Van mun loupi nalungsetna bulhing ahi,
Calvary lhanga nei hung lhatna.

Verse 3
Thil dang sangin naloupi e eilhandampu,
Nakhutso hoi kinepna;
Jing niso sangin nahoiye eilhandampu,
Nalungset thu kisei jou theilou.

songs.title: 158. KOI HIJONGLE THUPHA HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Rev. 22:17)

Verse 1
Koi hijongle Thupha hi aja chan’an,
Kipana thu hi leiset gam kimvel’a ;
Phongun homjal’un mi umna mun jousea,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.
”
Koi hijeng jongle ahung nom chan chu,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam’a gasam leuvin ;
Pan vahmang ho inlam’a akouna hi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.,”

Verse 2
Ahung nom chan chu hung geisang lou jenun,
Kot kihon lutthei pet cha hin lut loiyun ;
Jesu chu hinna lampi dihtah ahi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.”

Verse 3
Ahung nom chan chu thutepsa aume,
Ahung nom chan chu umjing jeng ding ahi ;
Koi hile anom chan hing jing ding ahi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.”

songs.title: 158. LHANDAMPU LUNG DONG IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu lung dong in achei,
A galten akaiyun,
Achena ding lam kavetle, thina mun chu ahi.
Chu lhang a chun akhai sang un,
Sapsetna thing chung a
Lengvai kana aw kajah chu,
Lhandampu aw ahi.

Verse 2
Alengvai na cross chu apun, Pakai chu akaiyun,
Lhandampu hoikom alhut um?
Ka Pu chu ga hunge.

Verse 3
Pon loupi le ling lukhuh to, I pu chu akaiyun,
Ka chonset jouse hi apon,
Genthei na lhang juon in.

Verse 4
Chua mipi akikhom un, Pakai taitom teho,
Lungdon na ten ana bom un,
Thingpel adom sang un.

Verse 5
Akhut le akeng thingkil in,
Thing to akhen beh un,
Hichun kajou sohtai atin, Pakaiyin asamâ€™e.

Verse 6
Thina lungjin lungdon jouse,
Lung hesoh na jouse,
Ipun abon in ajouve, lhanâ€™a kon athou tai.

songs.title: 159. DAM DUN LHUNGA JESU NUNGJUI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl (John 12:26)

Verse 1
Dam dung lhunga Jesu nungjui ding ka nome,
Pahcha namtui pahna le twilhum lona a ;
Hoichan hijongle eipuina chana jui jinge,
Anung jui jinge lallukhuh kasan man.

Chorus
Jui ding, jui ding Jesu nung kajui ding,
Achena chana anung kajui ding ;
Jui ding, jui ding Jesu nung kajui ding,
Aman eipuina channa ken kajui ding.

Verse 2
Dam dung lhunga keiman Jesu nung kajui ding,
Khopi hui nunna le twilhum lonna a chun ;
Ama khut’in eipui le keima kicha lou ding ;
Aman eilhonpi le keima olmo lou ding.

Verse 3
Dam dung hihen lang mol’a kal ding hijong leng,
Ka lhagao Jesu kom’a chu umjing jeng hen ;
Bitkei le damsel chan Aman eipui lhungkei ding,
Ol eipehna ding Pathen inpi nom chu.

songs.title: 159. LHANG KUMKHO AKIHEI TAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhang kumkho akihei tai,
Phai tidam hung leng in gol hinpui yin.
O kavahchoiye Pakai,
O Na lemnan la kasai,
Lungset in tha neipeuvin,
Genthei cha kahi.

Verse 2
Thing le louna apultai,
Lungset in tha neipen solang neikhun.

Verse 3
Thi le lungdon beina gam,
Thisanâ€™a lhatsa te neihol nau gam.

Verse 4
Chu thisan jal chun Pakai,
Nei puilut in chung van mun lalna gam.

songs.title: 159. THE NEW EDEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat hi akem jingin lei nopna amangjin,
Leisetna kipana akim thei poi;
Pakai hung lengin aw niloupi lhunsah in,
Genthei chaten leiset gimna adalha nom.

Chorus
Aw Eden thah nom’a chun neipuiyin lang,
Lunghel’a khenpisa ho to kilengkhom le;
Ka kipanau kim’in vahchoi tauvinge,
Leiset hi ngai tapou vinge nagam’a chun.

Verse 2
Na dinga thohten chu gam chu akinep pin,
Lei kipana adiuva pah theilou;
Zion mipi ho le lungsetna Lal mel chu,
Niloupi hung kilang ding chu avechim poi.

Verse 3
Lei lungdon lungjin hesohna jouse noiya,
Tahsan hon kipa la asa jingui;
Adiuvin kho vah hen Salem thah nom’a chun,
Na puikhomna ding ni ngaiyin agaldot-ui.

songs.title: 160. LUNGJINNA JOUSE BEISOH TA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungjinna jouse beisoh ta,
Lhagao leiset mun lam’a chun;
Lhatdam chate ajalennau,
Hi leiset mun bang hitalou.

Chorus
Lungjinna le gentheiyin eibom,
Lungdon twikhanglen bangin kinong;
Kipah in avahchoi la sang ting,
Lem louvin chu gam chu eilhut ding.

Verse 2
Ol mun umlou kei din leiset,
Genthei thoh-a ka ka-na bou!
Chu mun nom chu kalhun tengle,
Kipana mun gachang nang em?

Verse 3
Pakai leiya alenlai chun,
Mun gasem peh ing’e ati;
Kei din jong mun aum nadem!
Tia gel’in kave chim poi.

songs.title: 160. NITHUM NIN ATHOUVE JESU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nithum nin athouve Jesu
Thi nasatah chai in (2)
A thoukit tai aloupi toh,
Seijui ten amu ve. (3)

Verse 2
Chujou in Jesun angai cheng,
Lungset na thu sei in (2)
Tunia pat in abeisoh tai,
Na chonset nau jouse. (3)

Verse 3
Ama vang lungneng tah cheh in,
Nei ngaiyun nei ngah un (2)
Lhagao Theng chu hin sol lhange,
Na lung uva cheng din. (3)

Verse 4
Chujou teng le seichoi lenge,
Lung olmo lou hel in (2)
Gamtin a cheuvin hil leuvin,
Hinna Pathen Thupha. (3)

Verse 5
Koi hijong le nasei ngai a,
Kei eihea tahsan pa (2)
Ama chu leiset beini leh,
Tonsot hinna penge. (3)

songs.title: 160. VAN;A PONLAP KHU HUNG VEUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Rev. 2:25)

Verse 1
Van’a ponlap khu hung veuvin hungun sopite !
Galmi thah sangja ahunge, gal ijo tei diu !
Kul dalha hih un ka hunge !
Tin Jesun a sam ;
Nang thahat vangin lha ponge,
Neipen Lengpan tha.

Verse 2
Veuvin asangja ahunge, satan sepaite !
Eima sepaite kicha-in, alungthoi gam tai !

Verse 3
Gal jona ponlap khu veuvin ! ngaiyun sumkon gin !
Pakai mina ijo tei diu, galte tam jong le.

Verse 4
Gal kisat ahahsat vangin eipanpi tamna,
Igal Lamkai hattah Jesu, iham igin diu.

songs.title: 161. HALLELUYAH ATHOUDOH TAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Halleluyah athoudoh tai, chunga akaltai Jesu,
A phujal tai thina daltan, Vantil aw in ajomâ€™e,
Athoudoh tai ! Athoudoh tai !
A hinge thikit lou din (2)

Verse 2
Halleluyah athoudoh tai, Pakai chu loupi hidin,
Hetsah Lhagao ahin solâ€™e, I hinna diu bol ahi.

Verse 3
Halleluyah athoudoh tai, thinan ajou jou tapoi,
Christa chu thokit na ahi, lhanâ€™a amite thou ding.

songs.title: 161. NA TONGIN KON’UTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Matt. 21:28)

Verse 1
Na tongin kon’ute eiho Pathen sohte,
I-Pakai nungjuiyin cheu hite na tongin ;
Aman eipeh lungthim thah chu pannu hite,
Ikhut’a itoh thei chan tong cheh uhite.

Chorus
Tongute … ha tah in,
Na tongun … pon tah in ;
Ngah ute … ki nemin,
Bang poute Pakai hung kah sen.

Verse 2
Na tong cheh uhite agilkel va na din,
Lhagao dangchah ho dangnou nadin peu hite ;
I loupina dingu Cross thu seileu hite,
“Man beiyin eihuhhingui” tin samleu hite.

Verse 3
Ibonchan cheu hitin na gatongu hite,
Chonset muthim gam chu apumpin mangsoh hen,
Jehovah mintheng loupi chu kilang soh hen,
“Man beiyin eihuhhingui” tin samleu hite.

Verse 4
Pontho tah in pangun Pakai thahat panun,
Toh phatman isan diu Pathen’in eipeh diu ;
Lhatsa mithengte toh vana ichen khom diu,
“Man beiyin eihuhhingui” tin samleu hite.

songs.title: 161. TAHSAN LHA JAL HEN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tahsan lha jal hen lang,
Calvary lhang lam gachon leu hen;
Pakai thina mun lam’a chun,
Ka chenna ding Salem thah kamu ding.
Ka lei lung ngai ka ka lai bang tange,
Kipana pah hoi ka galdot teng.

Verse 2
Calvary lhang chunga,
Thisan lu long Lhandampu nah-a;
Namtin silthengna ding a chun,
Aw ka lhagao chua chun chengin.

Verse 3
Jerusalem thah chu,
Amu na ding lhang dang aumpoi;
Veu hite Calvary lhanga,
Chua alang Lhandampu nah-a chun.

Verse 4
Aw ka lhagao lengin,
Ga chon’in na Lhandampu thina;
Nangma jeh a athohna chu,
Athisan longa kisil thengin.

songs.title: 162. KINEP NA GAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kinepna gam kagel chimpoi,
Lei lungdon na gal lam,
Hinlai lungdon meipi noiya,
Pel tange kana gam.

Chorus
Lei lungdon na mitlhi hulding,
Kana nikho mang tante,
Pakai mel mukal kangah lel,
O mangta hen leiset hi.

Verse 2
Calvary ka ngai loupi pen,
Van gam kot ahong e,
Gachen chu a aw ka lhagao,
Alang e Van gam nom.

Verse 3
Kana janthim hi mang tahen,
Jordan luigal lamâ€™a,
Leiset genthei na kakhel teng,
Ngai ponge kana gam.

Verse 4
Kei jong itih le kalhung dem,
Jordan luigal lam chu,
O kangaiye ka gol ngai te,
Che tange chu gamâ€™a.

songs.title: 162. KUM THAH LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakai na malsomna lu,
I-jakai chunga kilang;
Na thu chun ka hinkho jong hi,
Ka neise to mantha ding;
Ka vahchoiye, (2)
Nalung setna kamu hin. (2)

Verse 2
Nangma lungsetna khutna kon,
Hinna le ngaichat jouse;
Hampa louhing muchi jouse,
Achang cheh-a malsomna
Vahchoina la, (2)
Asauve atonsot in. (2)

Verse 3
Aw Pakai thil jouse sem’a,
Nangma khutsoh jouse hin;
Lungjin gentheina eichingpau,
Ka vahchoi chim thei pouve;
Nei sumil dan, (2)
Nadei lam neihil jingin. (2)

Verse 4
Phat le nikho akem jinge,
Lei pahhoi jouse mol’in;
Pakai ka setnau jouse jong,
Nahatna in asil theng;
Mu kanom’e, (2)
Nahatna hung kilang ding. (2)

songs.title: 162. MIHEM CHENNA CHANNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (John 14:16)

Verse 1
Mihem chenna channa ga lhangsam leu hite,
Hungun Christa mite seileute limtah in ;
Mi chonsete henga lungmonna Thupha hi,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Lha monsah ahung tai, (2 vei)
Pathen’in eipeh-u ;
Eitepnau Lhagao Theng,
Mihem chenna channa ;
Ga lhangsam leu hite,
Lha monsah ahung tai.

Verse 2
Muthim lungdon lengvai, gim le hesoh genthei,
Abonchan achaiyin gamtin asalsoh tai ;
In hoi lul tah bangin nisa so em bangin,
Lha monsah ahung tai.

Verse 3
Leng jouse Leng chungnung, mi damsah lhagaovin,
Mi chonsete hengah, hinna thu hinpo lhan ;
Hungun huhhingsa te la ngei hi sau hite,
Lha monsah ahung tai.

Verse 4
Lungsetna chungnung thu lan sa choileu hite,
Van chunga cheng ho to kitoh in sau hite !
La ngei hi bang louvin sau hite lim tah in,
Lha monsah ahung tai.

songs.title: 163. AW CALVARY LHANG GIM NEITAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
O Calvaruâ€¦ Lhang gimnei tah,
Pakai thinaâ€¦ Calvary lhang,
Cross chunga chunâ€¦ Athisan long,
Chonse keimaâ€¦ Eilhatdoh tai.

Chorus
O Calvaryâ€¦ Calvary thim,
Keidia Christa thisan lonna
O Calvary! â€¦ Calvary hoi,
Chu a Pakai â€¦ kadin athi.

Verse 2
O he! Pakaiâ€¦ keima jalâ€™a,
Hibang hesohâ€¦ nathoh hitam!
Calvary lhangâ€¦ gimnei tah chu,
Vannoi chonsetâ€¦ poâ€™n na jontai.

Verse 3
Song chimsoh inâ€¦ mu athimtai,
Hichun tantaâ€¦ Lhandampu chu,
Hou in ponjalâ€¦ lai a lhang ta,
Van kot kihongâ€¦ namtin dingin.

songs.title: 163. HALNA GAM JON’UTE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Atonsot gou lo dingin jon jing’ute,
Lungdonna ahung len lai hin;
Ka koma um jingin lang aw,
Ka Lhandampu deitah.

Chorus
Aw halna gam jon’u hite,
Cholngahna ding;
Aw ka ngaiye khensa te,
Kimna ding gam chu.

Verse 2
Lei pahhoi jouse jong hi hung mang tei ding,
Chul talou ding tonsot lalna chu;
Sei chimlou ding khangthah geiyin,
Agam kem talou ding.

Verse 3
Mitna mulou gam nom kei dinga gotsa,
Jon jing’ute, henge chu gam chu;
Aw chu mun ngei chu aw ahi,
I-tonsot in diu chu.

Verse 4
Lei halna mangkit mai ding mun’a chengte,
Khenlouna gam eisem peh jeh-un;
Hallelujah Lhandampu chu,
Vahchoiyin um jing hen.

songs.title: 163. NAIYA GAMLA CHANG AMIN TAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Matt. 9:37)

Verse 1
Naiya gamla chang amin tai,
Changvui akoisoh gam tai ;
Naiya gamla a angsoh tai,
Denna lepma phai cham’a.

Chorus
Pakai chang at ding hin sol’in,
Na henga ka taonau hi ;
Ngaiyin chang at ding hin sol’in,
Chang at kile get inte.

Verse 2
Jingpi nison hin sol loiyin,
Sun nisat’in hin sol’in ;
Ni lhumkon geiyin hin sol’in,
Gamtin chang at khom dingin.

Verse 3
Man gangun chang akoi jou tai,
Changvui min atkhom loiyun ;
Nilhah tengle in lam jon’a,
Kipah a che ding nahi.

songs.title: 164. JERUSALEM ZION KHOPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jerusalem Zion khopi chu geltem un,
O mi atam kelngoi nou Lal lenna ding mun umlou,
O lungkham le kipana Calvary lhang ahung lange.
O nam jouse le chitin paotin in,
Van Lal nao banga kana Calvaryâ€™a
Kidang chom louve.

Verse 2
Jerusalem Zion khopi chu geltem un,
O mi janel kelngoi nou Lal lenna mun hoiya chun,
O Calvary a Pathen ngailut na, ngaitoa kul ahi.

Verse 3
Hallelujah hilthem leu hen Hallelujah,
O ngailutna daichom ngailou kipa nopna pahhoi,
Asei them le hil them umin tem o,
Angailut na hi.

songs.title: 164. LEI NOPNA NGAI HIH-IN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset khang hi sottalou ding phat anai tai,
Aw michonse khang lamvai mite;
Lei lung ngaina o na jouse chu,
Nungsun’in Pakai bel tan.

Chorus
Aw lei nopna pah ilou nangai,
Tonsot geiya imonna diu chu;
Dalha tan, ngaikit lou jenin aw sopi,
Pakaiya kinem’in kumkhon.

Verse 2
Tuhin vang aw, ihepouve thil hunglhung ding,
Hilna thu chu inot thap tauve;
Acham’a chon sei ngailoute chun,
Gim hesoh thoh joulou ding.

Verse 3
Setna thimpi jing lah a hin o ka Pakai,
Na lhagao theng chun hin salvah-in;
Chonsetna hung kilangdoh soh ding,
Set banga Nang kajui ding.

songs.title: 164. MUN A ONG NALAIYE KOU KHOM’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat

Verse 1
Mun a ong na laiye koukhom’un,
Lengpa golvah ankong um din;
Kou khom’uvin lang a In mi dim hen,
Mivaicha gilkelten neu hen.

Chorus
Lam lenna le dai pam’a potnun,
Setna lamthim’a umte chu,
Chen lang ngailut le lungset thon lang,
vah veiho gapui khom’un

Verse 2
Mun a ong nalaiye kou kit-nun,
Amavang eingaisah lou le;
Kou na ngailouva kilep mang ho chu,
Koiman kou kitta lou hel ding.

Verse 3
Mun a ong nalaiye kou kit-nun,
Chung’a Pathen thupeh a-hi;
Lung set hongsung’a gapui khom’un lang,
Huhhingpa lungsetna a chun;

Verse 4
Genthei lengvai le ahao din jong,
Vanna mun a ong nalai-ye;
Koukhom loiyun kot kihon petcha hin,
Gunchun hilchen kimvel leuvin.

songs.title: 165. LORD PREPARE MY SOUL
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdon mel him him um ponte,
Vantilte lailenna a chun;
Leiset lungdon thoh-a maoten,
Kalai bangin Pakai abel’un.

Chorus
Pakai chu gam chu neimu sah-in,
Hi leisetna kalen lai hin;
Lungdon thoh-a ka ka-na hi,
Aw nem tah-in hin thoh inge.

Verse 2
Aw chu mun’a lengte ho chun,
Khenpi sate ngai talou diu;
Hinna twitheng chu adon’ui,
Kipana pahcha hoi alouvui.

Verse 3
Galdot tem’un mun loupi chu,
Vantil thengte valpa ahsi;
Khohui akai lunglen anai,
Kelngoinou tollenna ahi.

Verse 4
Chu mun loupi kalhun tengle,
Pakaiyin kei ei umpi ding;
Vantil thengte to leng dingin,
Tonsot Pakai kavah choi ding.

songs.title: 165. PAKAI THAHAT PAN’IN HAT’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (Eph. 6:10)

Verse 1
Pakai thahat panin hat’un athu ging chan,
Athupha theng phongun lhangsam leuvin ;
Galsat lungdonna a jong Aman eikaihoi jing ding,
Pakai mina koi ham eidou thei ding ?

Chorus
Ding det un thudih a,
Leng thupeh ngaiyun galjo na ding ;
Pakai choi atna dingin athutep hi molso din,
Pakai thahat panin ding det’in.

Verse 2
Pakai thahat panin hat’un athu gingchan,
Gal masanga kon nungjam kit louvin ;
Ama nakoma ding jing ding nagalsat hu dinga,
Malam nouvin athahat chu panun.

Verse 3
Pakai thahat panin hat’un athu gingchan,
Itih channa athutep thon ngailou ;
Aman nakhut jetlam atuh jinge kicha hih-in,
Pakai chu tahsan jingin dingdet’in.

songs.title: 165. TU ATHAH KILUNGSET NA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tu athah kilungset na nom emâ€™a,
Ka Pakai mun loupi,
Kipana pahcha namtui apahtai,
Chulkit talou ding in.

Chorus
Olle ikikhop diu nom tah a,
Van Mithengte ho jouse khutoh,
Lungdon na gamâ€™a ikanau hi,
I Pakai anga kipa la ding.

Verse 2
Kahin lai nihi akem masangsen,
Ka dinga mei jing jing,
Ajou le chug am kalhun teng chule,
Lei hi ngai ta lou ding.

Verse 3
Chu gam khopi emhoi tah chu juon in,
Lei hi dalha tang ting,
Tun agim namtui chu katep kha tai,
O anom na ding e.

Verse 4
Eihuhhingpa meldei um kamu teng,
Alaltouna chung a,
Thu atan ding lhatsa te kipana,
Hallelujah Amen.

songs.title: 166. AW ANA NGEIYE EILHATDOHNAU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu lungdonna Calvary lam chu jon’in,
Lhagao theng aw nangin nei puiyin;
Mu kanom’e eilhandampu chu,
Aling lukhuh le athohna chu.

Chorus
Aw ana ngeiye eilhatdohnau,
Akhut, akeng, anah-a;
Melma hem athoh,
Kei din Cross chunga ahin apei.

Verse 2
Nitin’in ka ngaito Lhandampu thina mun chu,
Tahsan’in leiya kon hin kamui;
Michonse ni kah-a khenbeh-un,
Kadang achah-e Pakaiyin ati.

Verse 3
Ngaitem’un Lhandampu lungdon le lengvai ka chu,
“Ka Pathen ilou nei dalhah ham”
Atao peh-e akhenbeh ho din,
Cross chunga athi ding kon jong chun.

Verse 4
Aw Pakai adiuva nathohna Calvary a,
Aw mitin puiyin lang vetsah in;
Heu hen adiuva nathohna chu,
Jesu vahchoi lou thei hilou diu.

songs.title: 166. NGAIYUN PAKAI JESUN EIKOUVUI TUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat d. (Matt. 21:28)

Verse 1
Ngaiyun Pakai Jesun eikouvui tun,
Leiset ga chom khom din ;
Chang at khom ding mi alhom jeh in,
Changvui akoi joutai.

Chorus
Pakai minin kipah in cheuvin,
Ngailut le khoto thon ;
Man beiya huhhinga nunnom chu,
Vannoiya phong leuvin.

Verse 2
Cheuvin amang ding kon huhdoh un,
Chonset muthim’a kon ;
Aban thahat panin huhhingun,
Chonset bulpu ga lhan.

Verse 3
Kipah tah-in genthei kou khomun,
Lungset ankong um din ;
Ama ho chu hinna changlhah a,
Pakaiyin lamto ding.

Verse 4
Che leuvin nipi lai akeme,
Nilhum man tong loiyun ;
Koiman na atoh thei louna ding,
Jan muthim anai tai.

songs.title: 166. VANNOI KIPAH HEN PAKAI HUNG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi kipah hen Pakai hung,
Leiyin sang hen a Leng,
A um na ding mun mi jousen,
Lung sung gotsan koi hen.

Verse 2
Vannoi kipah Pakai vaihom,
Sauvin a vahchoi la,
Mol le lhang phaicham twilen in,
A vahchoi la sauvin.

Verse 3
Thutah lungset nan vai apoi,
Heu hen leiset miten,
A chonphat le a loupina,
Seiphong hen lei chung ah.

songs.title: 167. CHAMNA LE LUNGMON KADIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chamna le lungmon kadin lui in along,
Lungdon twisang len bang jongle,
Kahet ding dolse Nangma neihil chan chu,
Aphata! Aphata! Ka ding in.
Aphata! Ka ding in,
Aphata! Aphata! Ka ding in.

Verse 2
Thupha chun ka chonset pumpi aseltai,
Cross chunga akhenbeh soh tai,
Keiman tukal chonset pokit talou ding,
Vahchoi in vahchoi in ka lung in.

Verse 3
Christa chu hi jing hen ka hinna bulpi,
Jordan in eiso khum jong le,
Keima dinga olmona ding umdeh lou,
Chamna Thupha chu nei hil jing in.

Verse 4
Pakai nahung kit ding ni kangah jinge,
Vangam nom kahung lhun kahsen,
Van sumkon gin le Nang awgin ngah kahi,
Ka lha dia iti kinep umtam.

songs.title: 167. KA GALDOT JINGE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Luigal gamnom le ka Pakai,
Lungset hung lang ding chu;
Galdot jing ding lhepna huipi,
Leiset thim noiya kon.

Chorus
Ajou le lhepna meipi le,
Thimjin abei phat le;
Kilang jing ding angailutna,
Kipana lui long chu.

Verse 2
Leiset lungdonna ho dalhan,
Lungset Pakai dei um;
Kipa chullou vahchoi ngahlel,
Van ngei sa ding.

Verse 3
Leiset lungjin lah-a Pakai,
Nalungset min loupi;
Vahchoi chim ponge Lhandampu,
Kasetnan eidal’e.

songs.title: 167. LUNGHEL LUNGDONG LHAMON’UTE
168. LENG SEPAI IHIUVE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl
(2 Tim. 2:3)

Verse 1
Leng sepai ihiuve, thisan’a kilhatsa,
Min khumsa galsatpi dinga ;
Pakai Christa Leng chu ; kichat a um vangin,
Kipah-in la saute ;

Chorus
Leng sepai Lamkai chungnung chun,
I-lung hahsat jing ding.
Leng sepai ihiuve, A vahchoi la saute ;
Tahsan nei jing nading bolun, I-lengpau loupi chu.

Verse 2
Leng sepai ihiuve kipah-in choileuvin,
Cross chunga kithatpa min ngei ;
Achunga kisun chu ; Leng sepai ihiuve,
Hakam jeng jong leu hen ;
Leng chungnung Jesu choi-at nan,
Hesoh na jong thoh un.

Verse 3
Leng sepai ihiuve, Ama toh pangkhom chu,
Tun Amatoh thoh khom hen lang ;
Pampai hijong leu hen ; a ponlap dom sangun,
Phat lhin ding kon ahi ;
Lallukhuh sanni anaiye,
Leng sepaite dingin.

songs.title: 168. LENGVAI GENTHEI KOM LE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lengvai genthei komle kei mong theilou,
Chung toni jong nilhum joulou Pakai,
Einem ding dang umlou Pakai tailou,
Pahbang mol hen leiset kahin kho hi.

Chorus
Lungdon kana gim gentheina mun hi,
Pel tange tun Pakai na van inâ€™a,
Chuteng genthei gimna ken mil tange,
Leiset pel a lhunkal ngahlel kahi.

Verse 2
Leiset chung hi golngai kikhen na mun,
Insung mi jong kikhenna mun ahi,
Chungleng vabang gamtinâ€™a ka lenglen,
Monna umlou Pakai Nangma tailou.

Verse 3
Van khopi tol laiya leng teho chun,
Lungdon kana asei ngai tapouve,
Ponbang sil un Van khotol aleng in,
Itih tah le kei jing ka lhung tadem.

Verse 4
Lengthei hileng keiman dalha tading,
Ka van tonsot pahbang pahna munâ€™a,
Ken mil tange genthei puldou kana,
Che masa ngaicheng toh tolleng tange.

songs.title: 168. SECOND COMING.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyin hung kit tei ding ahi,
Loupina to van mei chunga;
Pakai Immanuel chun,
Leiset thupi tan ding.

Chorus
Chitin namtin alaltouna ang’a,
Achonnau phonga kikhom diu;
Salem Pakai anga chun aw,
I-ham kasei tah ding.

Verse 2
Amel loupi ni banga vah,
Satan le melma ho chu;
Lhatsate kipa nikho teng,
Kichan kithing tauvinte.

Verse 3
Hi leiset lungdon genthei pel’in,
Che masa le van mithengten;
Salem thah nom’a lengin,
Hinkho kem talou ding.

Verse 4
Lungdon le kana um talou ding,
Van selangdah gin ngei chuto;
Calvary a Kelngoinou thisa,
Vahchoiyin long del’in.

songs.title: 169. COMPLETE ARMOUR.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka galvon ka tolkoi ngam poi,
Aw ka channa gal ginna mun;
Nitin lhepna chun eijui jing,
Aw ka Lhandampu seilep dingin.

Chorus
Aw nei von’in Immanuel
Na lhagaovin nei von’in lang!
Hi leiset setthim kulpi hi,
Nang dingin dou kit nang’e.

Verse 2
Lhasam le geuchauvin ka um,
Nadin sonlel melpu jong leng;
Gal hatte dinga Lallukhuh,
Aw nasem chu nei musah kit’in.

Verse 3
Aw hin vetan ka Lhandampu,
Nathisan’a nalhatsate;
Hi leiset setthim kul sunga,
Akihen’ui Pakai sim joulou.

Verse 4
Nangin nei pui le melmate,
Ken jou ding nathisan jal’a;
Natonsot gou lo-pi dingin,
Aw set soh-a kon ken puidoh ding.

Verse 5
Ol le kho ahungvah tengle,
Ka Lhandampu chu kamu ding;
Chu-a ka galvon sutlhang ting,
Aw ponbang loupi eisil peh ding.

songs.title: 169. KEN NA IN DING SANGE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ken na in ding sange, hoitah le nomtah in,
Nalha chenna ding van chunga,
Gilkel dangchah umlou Na vangam nomâ€™a,
Tonsot kemthei lou gam nomâ€™a. (2)

Verse 2
Chu gam nom tah chu ken kamang bang in kamui, Nop le ol kemkit talou ding,
Agamla tapoi tun chu gam nom kangai chu,
Kei ding a innom asem chu. (2)

Verse 3
Chu gam chu keichang In ding hilou nang ding jong, Nazareth Jesu chenna chu,
Chu gamâ€™a chengte iti noptam tonsot a,
Aman eihepi jeh u chun. (2)

Verse 4
Hungun ka sopite hung kipat un hung un,
Chu a lung genthei gim beita,
O ngei tah le kipah a la ngei sading,
Gamtin kimu to soh tading. (2)
Thikit louna nat kit louna,
Lungdon kichat tijat,
Lunhghel umta louding,
Bei ta ding lhiso le kana.

songs.title: 169. O PATHEN SALVAH SOH LOIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s. (Psalms 43:3)

Verse 1
O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Vannoi leiset salvah in ;
Alhatpau deitah min’a chu,
Asochat theina dingun.

Chorus
O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Twikhanglen gal’a mite ;
Lungsetna Thupha man beiya,
Hom sdinga natepsa chu.

Verse 2
Lhagao thi kon ho salvah in,
Jan muthim’a lamvaite ;
Ahin nikhou alhin kah in,
Salvah in huhhing loiyin.

Verse 3
Athutep loupi le theng chu,
“Cheuvin leiset gamtin ah ;
A khonni geiyin ka umpi,
Ka Thupha phongjal leuvin.”

songs.title: 170. GALDOT NINGE PAKAI
170. KAKUL PI NAHI AW EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka kulpi nahi aw Eilhandampu,
Ka kulpi nahi kaki selna,
Ka kulpi nahi kahinna nahi,
Nang kom jeng a bou um jing inge.

Chorus
Ka kulpi nahi O Eilhandampu,
Ka gol nahi ka lamkai nahi,
Nang kahinpi Eilhandampu nahi,
Ka lungmonpi Nang kakisel na.

Verse 2
Ka kulpi nahi set in eijol teng,
Ka kulpi nahi Nang kahoina,
Ka kulpi nahi kalung hesoh teng,
Ka kulpi nahi gin kanei lou.

Verse 3
Ka kulpi nahi set hoidal nahi,
Ka golngai nahi kikhel lou ding,
Ka lung pumpi nachung a kangai e,
Tahsan le Mitheng in neikoi in.

Verse 4
Ka kulpi nahi O Eilhandampu,
Namtin chitin le leng lal jouse,
Manghen leivui in leng mangjou jongle,
Ka tonsot Kulpi Nang hi jing ding.

songs.title: 170. KHUT GOH KEOVA KACHE DING HAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. s

Verse 1
Khut goh keova kache ding ham,
Ei Lhatpa lamto dinga ?
Ana nikhat jong tong louva,
Ima lan ding nei louva.

Chorus
Ka che ding ham khut goh keova,
Eihuhhingpa lamtoa chu ;
Lhagao khat beh keng lou hel’a,
Ka che ding ham khut goh a ?

Verse 2
Thina in eikailut lou ding,
Tua Jesun ei huhhing ta ;
Ka lamto ding bou khut goh a ;
Phamo san kalung kham’e.

Verse 3
Ka sumang tai kum phalai cheng,
Kou la kakou kit thei pon ;
Hichu ajen nan mangta leng,
Alunggot molso ta ding.

Verse 4
Thina jan chun hinpha le chun,
Lhagao khat huhhing louvin ;
Na huhhingpa loupi tah chu,
Ipin lamto tan natem ?

songs.title: 171. HOLY SPIRIT HEAVENLY DOVE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao theng van vakhu nunnem,
Hung leng kit’in ka ngaiyui;
Hin suhal kit in mipi lhasamte,
Mol lep louvin hung kit’in lang.

Chorus
Aw ka ngaiyuve Lhagao nunnem,
Nangma louvin mipite lamvaiyun;
Hinpui kit’in lang aw Valpa ahsi,
Zion kipa lampi thenga.

Verse 2
Ngaiyin Pakai nalhatsaten,
Atonsot lam ahaiyun;
Lei kelngoi chingte hin puidih joulou,
Iti ahidiuvem Pakai.

Verse 3
Lhagao thengpen nangna umle,
Leiset lungdon anemjin;
Set huipi le lungjin gal len jongle,
Jailan namin vahchoi tange.

Verse 4
Jesu nunnem hung ham kit’in,
Lungdong tah-a nathohna;
Hetsah in lang nalinglukhuh chuto,
Na hesohna kidang tah chu.

songs.title: 171. KA LHAGAO HINNA DIN JESU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka lhagao hinna din Jesu,
Cross chunga kiphal in athi,
Nat athoh e kei damna din,
Sei sang ei eilungset.
A sei sangun eilungset joi (2)
Nasa tah in kei eilungset e,
Jesun eilungset e.

Verse 2
A lungdonna athoh thei jin,
Kineo sah in gim athoh e,
Hinkemlou inei theina diu,
Sei sang in eilungset.

Verse 3
Jesun I lungmon na dingun,
Pathen henga eitao peh ui,
Athisan in eilhat tauve,
Sei sangin eilungset.

Verse 4
Einai komle kalung kipah,
Olna kichat louna eipei,
Ama a kinepna thon lou,
Sei sang in eilungset.

songs.title: 171. NA TONGUN JAN ANAI TAI
172. AW LENKHOMNA DING NI CHU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakaiyin chenna ding mun,
Aga semna a chun;
Vahchoina la sa galengkhom ding,
Goldei kikhen kitna jong umtalou.
Aw ka ngahlel lenkhom ni ding chu,
Leiset ngailouva Zion Pakai lem le;
Goldeite kim ni ding chu.

Verse 2
Chu-a lungdon ka-na beita,
Khopi thah nom’a chun;
Thina luigal kai teng ka chenna,
Ding gel’in ka-lai kabang thei jipoi.

Verse 3
Ajou le kho avah tengle,
Goldeite leng’unte;
Chu-a Pakai neilhah sah-in lang,
Leiset ngailouva dalhah ka nom’e.

songs.title: 172. HINLAI SUNG IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai sung in kiging phaute,
Set le manna lah a hin,
Ajou le cannan gam nomâ€™a.
Goldei te toh lengkhom taute.

Chorus
O leiset a lalte chu,
Tonsot gam lhung thei lou ding,
Luigalâ€™a hinna lallukhuh chu
O tonggim chaten khuh tauvin te.

Verse 2
Ka ngai ngeiye Immanuel,
Lei lungdon gam thip ahin,
Meilah a na hung kit nile
Ka lei lungdon na beitan te.

Verse 3
Tonggim te leh pohgih te chu,
Luigalâ€™a achol ngauve,
Olle Canaan gam nomâ€™a chun.
Goldei te toh lengkhom taute.

Verse 4
Tonna Eden hontheng a chun,
Adam le Eve chu o,
Seingai louvin aum lhon in,
Set genthei na alha lhontai.

songs.title: 172. HINNA GUI JANLHAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Hinna gui janlhan thiding mi aum,
Chonset twikhanglen nong laiya mite ;
Koiham tuinonglai pal’a mi huhding ?
Hinna gui janlhan mi gahuh doh loiyin.

Chorus
Hinna gui janlhan, (2 vei)
Twiya mi mang ding ahi ;
Hinna gui janlhan, (2 vei)
Twiya mi alha lut’e.

Verse 2
Hinna gui janlhan natha le lung thon,
Ngaiyin lhagao mang din nang nakouve ;
Vetan chonset twilen’a thiding mi,
Hinna kong kailhan mi mang ding huhhingin.

Verse 3
Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding ngaiton,
Chonset twipin chup le homjou lou ding ;
Huipi, gopi kithon hinpha taleu,
Mang teidiu chen nangman ga huhdoh loiyin.

Verse 4
Mi mang ding lah phat kikhel loi tading,
Lhagao tamtah mangthai ding tonsot’a ;
Geisang louvin chen hinna kong kengin,
Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding huhdoh-in.

songs.title: 173. AW ITIH IKIKHOM DIUVEM!
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlaiyin Lhandampu jal’in,
Kipah-in lengkhom jongleu hen;
Kapmin ikikhen kit jitai,
Aw ka-ngai kikhen louna gam.

Chorus
Lhandampu mun ga sem’a chun,
Hi leiya kikhenpi sate;
Tonsot laltouna ang’a chun,
Aw itih ikikhom diuvem.

Verse 2
Alang’e Calvary lhang’ah,
Galdot’ute khenlouna gam;
I-lennau lhang kikhen jongle,
Tahsan’in lengkhom jingute.

Verse 3
Sam jing’ute i-Pakai bou,
Genthei lengvaina a einem;
Amalou einem dang umlou,
Achul jitai lei kipana.

Verse 4
Hi leisetna jong hin Aman,
Alungsetna lhalim noiya;
Kipan eipuikhom kit’unte,
Kapmin kikhen jeng jongleu hen.

songs.title: 173. KA HINKHO HI PAHCHA BANG A
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka hinkho hi pahcha bang a, Chomkah a hung mang loi ding, Jana mang kho ahung vah a,
Aman kit tobang ahi.
O Ka Lhagao vanâ€™a leng tan,
Lei hi ilou na ngai ham,
Na tonsot khopi nom jon in,
Van mitheng te khopi chu.

Verse 2
Leiset hinkho hi epi ham? Nat na le lungdon na bou, Kipa thanop jouse jong hi,
Hampa pah bang bou ahi.

Verse 3
Ache masa egolngai hou, Nop le kipan aleng ui, Laltouna kim in asauve,
Tonsot Pathen vahchoiyin.

Verse 4
Aloupi na emhoi tah chu, Nisa sang in a-emjoi,
Chu a aloupi masang a,
Pakai Jesu i-mudiu.

Verse 5
Ka aw ngei nei chasun sun in, Vahchoi jing e ka lhun teng, Vakhu banga leng thei hileng,
Leng tang e golngai mudin.
O ka Lhagao tunin leng tan,
Leiset hi dalha tan lang,
Tonsot khopi nom lam jon in,
Khopi nom Pathen chen na.

songs.title: 173. PATHEN LEKHA SIM JINGA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl

Verse 1
Pathen lekha sim jinga,
Asun ajan’a ngaitoa ;
Agunchu athanom pan,
Pathen phatthei peh amui.

Chorus
Hijeh chun sun le janin,
Lung ngainan nei jingun lang ;
A thulu ching jing jengun,
Phattheina hin kemlou na.

Verse 2
Mi chonse houlimpi lou,
Mi gilou nungjui louva ;
Mi seise te kom dalha,
Mi chun chonset apailhai.

Verse 3
Lui panga thingphung keh chu,
Anan goptih nei talou ;
Hiche thing hinthei bang chun,
Mitheng nop jong kem theilou.

Verse 4
Chonse vang chu tobang lou,
Huiya vai kithe bang ding ;
Pathen thupi tan nileh,
Mi chonse chu pampai ding.

songs.title: 174. ANITIN PATHEN CHATE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Anitin Pathen chate banga vah a icheu hinam ?
Jan muthim natoh pailha kho hungvah ding ingau hinam ?
Lei lungngai dalhan kho hungvah ding chu ingah jingui,
Lhandampu lungset jal’a hungsoh ding ninou emsel chu.

Chorus
A mit mua … icheu hinam?
Pathen cha … deite banga ;
Christa thisan lua chu ivon’u isop bangu hinam ?
Loupina chang ding khovah chate banga icheu hinam ?

Verse 2
Nunnema Pathen chate banga vah a icheu hinam ?
Hi leiset lungdon hesoh genthei muthim jing noiya hin ;
Pakaiyin Ama khel’a tong dingin eidei cheh-uve,
Tonsot hinkemlou chang dingin mi kholkhom loiyu hite.

Verse 3
Vahchoi la saute kipahtah-in khovah chate bangin,
Lhaisel’in Christa dingin mite lah-a na tongu te ;
Chutile leiset miten sochatna thu hinjom cheh diu,
Chua kon Pathen khopi jon’a Christa ijuikhom diu.

songs.title: 174. JAUVIN JESU MIN CHOI-AN UN
