songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jauvin Jesu min choi-an un,
Van min achoi-an e;
Leng jouse leng Lal jouse Lal,
Lemun Leng jouse Leng.

Verse 2
Lem uvin Patheen Martyr ten,
Alhatsa Mitheng ten;
Jesu loupi na choi-an un,
Lemun Leng jouse Leng.

Verse 3
Israel chate aum sun in,
Lhomcha hi jong leu chun;
Lungsetna na huhhing pau chu,
Lemun Leng jouse Leng.

Verse 4
Sumil lou jen un Gentile ten,
Thisanâ€™a na lhat pau;
A khomuh a kun cheh un lang,
Lemun Leng jouse Leng.

Verse 5
Chitin namtin le phung tin in,
Pao tin in choi-an un;
Chung le noi Pakai Leng chungnung,
Lemun Leng jouse Leng.

songs.title: 174. KILHAHNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
U le nao igolnop beita,
Kikhenna ni ahung lhung tai;
Leiset gimna da-na ahin,
Kikhen ding ihiuve.
Aw gel jingin Pakai lungsetna, (2)
Kalhai, u le nao damsel cheh-ute.

Verse 2
Aw sopite gel cheh-uvin,
Leiset hinkho hi mangta le;
Ikimu lou lam jong hetlou,
Van gam ilhun mauvin.

Verse 3
O sopite i-themmo nau,
Kingaidam to cheh-u hite;
Pakai lungsetna noiya hin,
Mong’in kikhen taute.

Verse 4
Leiset golnop ima hilou,
Nikhat thu dinga bou ahi;
Hibanga chu ihinkhou jong,
Nitin in akem jing.

Verse 5
Van gam thah chu ilhun tengle,
Tua lunghel bang um talou ding;
Kilungsetna kem talou ding,
Kipan vaihom tante.

songs.title: 175. ATEH AKHANG I BONCHAUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ateh akhang I bonchauvin,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©,
Eihuhhing I sochat jalun,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©

Chorus
Lunglhai sel in la ngei tah in,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©,
Lunglhai sel in la ngei sautÃ©,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©.

Verse 2
In a i-nom um kom jongle,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©,
Lamlhah khomol khol le tol a,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©.

Verse 3
Intheng kipah a ikai teng,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©,
Kikhop pi le chang lhatna jong,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©.

Verse 4
Set tona le phatthei na jong,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©,
Ahao avai genthei ten jong,
Jesu vahchoi la sautÃ©.

songs.title: 175. CHEN LANG NAPHAT JOUSEN TONGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat d. (Matt. 21:28)

Verse 1
Chen lang na phat jousen tongin,
Kipa nan Pa deilam bollin;
Hichu Pakai lampi ahi,
Najot lou ding ham ajuiyan ? (2 vei)

Verse 2
Hinkho hoilaiyin chen tongin,
Seiset japina ging louvin ;
Mihemin apachat louchu,
Pathen pachat louvin geldan. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Chen lang tongin tohphat ahi,
Nalung sung kipa sah in lang ;
Pakaiyin na pachat ding chu,
Gellin thanomin na tongin. (2 vei)

Verse 4
Tong jingin chim louvin tongin,
Lhagao mang dingin lei aloi ;
Vannoi gam tina vahlen lang,
Lhagao mangte chu puikhom in. (2 vei)

Verse 5
Kipah-in natoh kipa pin,
Toh gim chu olna nom ahi ;
Ngaiyun jaloi ding Pakai O.
“Ka hunge” ti O chu ngaiphan. (2 vei)

songs.title: 175. PAKAI JESU HUNGIN (Th. 22:6-21)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sapsetna umlou Pathen Kelngoinou,
Laltouna chu aum jan aumlou;
Thaomei vah le nivah ngailou,
Pathen ngaito tonsotna vai homkhom tading.

Chorus
Amen, hungin Pakai Jesu hungin,
Pakai Jesu a milungset chun;
Mithengte ho chu umpi tau hen,
Hallelujah Amen. (2)

Verse 2
Pakai themgao ho lhagao Pathen chun,
Thil hung lhung ding ho chu avetsah-e;
Ngaiyin hungloi ding ka hitai,
Hiche thu seidoh nitchan anunnom ahi.

Verse 3
Aphat chu hung lhung loi ding ahitai,
Chon phalou chun chon phatlou bol jing hen;
Mitheng ho chu theng jingu hen,
Ana umjing tau hen, kahung loi ding ahi.

Verse 4
Lhagao thusei doh ho lamang’a chu,
Hinna thing le khopi thenga achan;
Chu Pathenin alah mang ding,
Hithu hetsahpa chun kahung loi ding ahi.

songs.title: 176. CALVARY LHANGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eilhandampu chu akaiyun Calvary lhanga,
Lugu atiu lhang munna chun;
Gakoukit tan, aw ka lhagao,
Calvary alhun masang sen;
Vannoi chonset popa ka vengam poi.
Aw themgao hon eihilnau thu chu,
Kelngoinou nunnem chunga chun;
Tun achunga ahung lhung tai,
Jat dang ho chu amatsah-un,
Akaiyun Calvary lhanga.

Verse 2
Ka Pakai nao banga aka-na Calvary lhang,
Ka galhun tei ding hinam? oh!
Iti jeng jongle cheng kate,
Calvary kalhun masangsen;
Nahsah loule sumil thei kahipoi.

Verse 3
Hiche vedinga ache ahung kile ho chu,
I-alo tah-um kati-le;
Hetkal ngahlel’in kadoh chun,
Cross a akhenbeh tauve tin;
Athi nungsang beh-in gaveng kate.

songs.title: 176. LEI LAL PON LOUPI CHU KEM INTE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leilal pon loupi chu kem inte,
Molhoi pahcha jong chu kem inte,
I-hinkhou jong hi hung mang loi jengthei ahi,
Hijong le Pakai Jesu keiâ€™a.

Chorus
Molhoi pah bang Lal Jesu keiya,
Keiding a pah tonsot gam nomâ€™a,
Genthei na a jong Aman eiumpi ding,
Molhoi pah bang Lal Jesu keiya.

Verse 2
Eihuhhingpau gamnon emâ€™a chun,
Ama chu tonsot valpa ahi,
Genthei thoh jeng jong leng hinoi leiset ahin,
Agamâ€™a chun eipuilut inte.

Verse 3
Tuhin kap in peng peng jeng jong leng,
Thina in kamit asin tengle,
Kicha louvin lhanthimâ€™a kon eikai thou ding,
Ka mitlhi jouse theh hul inte.

Verse 4
Kagol ngaiten hinoi leiset a,
Eidalhau vin ka lung ahelâ€™e,
Hijeng jong le kalung ngai bangin kaum nai,
Molhoi pahbang Lal Jesu keija.

songs.title: 176. TOHGIM LE LUNG JINNA KHEL’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s (Psalms 37:7)

Verse 1
Tohgim le lung jinna khella,
Cholte din in nomtah aum ;
Kikhel tih nei lou in nom a,
Koi ham cholnga nomlou ding chu ?
Ngah hat in lung nengin phun louvin,
Ngah hat in lung nengin phun louvin ;
Ngah hat’in lung nengtah-in phun louvin.

Verse 2
Pohgih noiya chol jongle chun,
Van phatna in nang ngai jang ding ;
Dah-in ven tonsot anai tai,
Ngah in phun louvin ngah hat’in.

Verse 3
Na lampia ling um jeng jong le,
Pakai lu kimvel ngaiton lang ;
Nalung sudong tajeng jongle,
Nang sanga thengjo asun tai.

Verse 4
Na jong le chun tong jing tangem,
Taona ima sumil louvin ;
Na olna ding ni anai tai,
Ngah hat in phun louvin ngah in.

songs.title: 177. DINGUN DINGUN JESUN DIN
177. HICHE LEIYA KALEN LAI HIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hiche leiya kalen lai hin,
Lung donna jeng bou kamui,
Thina Jordan lui kagal kaiteng,
Pakai deina ang a kaum ding.
O neimu sah-in nasem Salem,
Goldei mitheng te lenna;
Kikhen louna gam,
Lei lungjinna hin dalhah a;
O etih le kahung lhung tadem

Verse 2
Gentheiya na um te ho jong,
Mun loupi chu alhun teng,
Che masate le Van mitheng ten,
Salem Pakai chu avahchoiyui.

Verse 3
Tonsot hinna la sate chu,
Eikouve che-masaten,
Ama ho aw gin kajah phat in,
Chu mun ngaina-in keima ka kap,

Verse 4
Ka ngaiye Nang Immanuel,
Nasem Salem thah hoi chu;
Genthei muna cheng kahi Pakai,
O nangin kei nei hung puidoh in.

songs.title: 177. KELNGOINOU CHU LOUPI HEN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Lhandampu ka vahchoi ding,
Nangma a bou ka hiye;
Thisan’a nei siltheng jal’in,
Kelngoinou chu loupi hen.

Chorus
Loupi Jesu nei lhatdam tai,
Namin theng chu loupi hen;
Thisan’a nei siltheng jal’in,
Kelngoinou chu loupi hen.

Verse 2
Ol chamkim kipana chang din,
Kum tamtah ka nahol tai;
Kipah-a Ama tahsan’in,
Phattheina chu kachang tai.

Verse 3
Mitphet kahlou jong tahsan din,
Kum tamtah ka nahol tai;
Hinna twikhuh-a choldong’e,
Ka Lhandampu heng’a chun.

Verse 4
Na natong’a kimang jouvin,
Nang dia hing le thi hinge;
Lhatdamna thu kidangtah chu,
Kipah in seichoi lenge.

songs.title: 178. AMIN GOLNOP LOUPI
178. CHRISTIAN THOUVIN IMUT SON DAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Luke 14:23)

Verse 1
Christian thouvin imut sot dan,
Lhagao mang ding don louvin ;
Pakaiyin thu eipeh laiya,
I mohtou mai mai diu ham ?

Chorus
Chen lang tongin tun panin,
Amangsa holdoh kit din ;
Chonse muthim’a konin,
Golvahna a hin puiyin.

Verse 2
Huhhingpu ingailut nah em,
Athupeh init nah um ?
Inei jouseu iphalnah um ?
Athua inun lou diu ham ?

Verse 3
Ama chu itahsan nah um ?
Ahil’a ichon nah um ?
Eiho Ama a ihiuvem ?
Na-natoh in phong cheh un.

Verse 4
Lallukhuh san itup uleh,
Cross nitin’in pu’hite ;
Gunchu tah-in na tongu te,
Phat achom ni anai tai.

songs.title: 178. PAKAI NANA TOH HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai nana toh hi, hin suhal kit in lang,
Nana tong te thahat hinpen,
Na hatna kilang hen.
Pakai nana toh hi
Hin suhal kit in lang,
Hung kumlhan lang tha nei peuvin,
Phatthei nah hin bung lhan.

Verse 2
Pakai nana tong te, seithem na tha pen lang,
Gamtin lhagao huhhing nau hen,
Na Mintheng loupi hen.

Verse 3
Pakai mi jouse lung, hin suhal soh keiyin,
Nangma mi lungset na heuhen,
Lungset na meikong hen.

Verse 4
Pakai halna hinlhan, Pentecost ni hin lhan,
Nangma Mintheng chu loupi hen,
Vahchoi in um jing hen.

songs.title: 179. AW PAKAI NEI NGAILUTNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw Pakai nei ngailutna,
Twipi bangin ahung long,
Eina chup jinge michonse lamvai kei,
Pakai chu eihuhhingpu,
Kakipana seijou lou,
Chonset a thiding hinna ei hung pei.
O eingailua Ka Pakai,
Kapum in kahung kipei,
Kei mi chonse neiman nom pou le,
Katahsa ka hinna le,
Ka hatna kalung thim toh,
Thichan geiya ding det din ka hung kipei.

Verse 2
Leiset a kadam sunghin, umdan je kahe thempoi,
Nitin a kalson ding dan kahe them poi,
Ka ngailut ka Lal nunnem,
Na khut in neituh jingin,
Ka lamthom tinâ€™a Nang hung ding jing in.

Verse 3
O Pakai ka damsung ni, hi kola alep teng le,
Mi hangsan Martyr bangin mollep kanom,
Hansan nale hatna din,
Lhagao vin neivon in lang,
Neiching jingin thichanâ€™a gin umdin.

songs.title: 179. PRAYING FOR REVIVAL FIRE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat chesa ho hi kagel le,
Achul’in mol alepjou tai;
Van pahcha le kipa chullou chun,
Chultih ni anei tapoi.

Chorus
Ka ngai ngeiye, chugam chullou chu,
Tonsotna dia Pakai gotsa gam;
Lhatdam chate chullouvin lengun,
Kelngoinou loupi lem’in.

Verse 2
Chu gam loupi kagaldot le,
Ka umna lei pahbang ahi;
Tonsotna dia lhinglou atiuve,
Aw kangai gam lhun ding chu.

Verse 3
I-lei kipana le nopna,
Ka le lungdon asohjou tai;
Hin suhal kit’in Lhagao theng,
Kipa chullou chungnungin.

Verse 4
Lhagao Theng Pa lhatsate chu,
Kagaldot mol alem jou tai;
Aw ka Pakai hin puikit in lang,
Lhandampu jaila oi ding.

songs.title: 179. VAN MITHENGTE JOUSEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl
(Luke 15:19)

Verse 1
Van mithengte jousen kipa la sauvin,
Tunin mi mangsa khat ahunge ;
Veuvin ! lung kipah tah in Pathen achei,
Acha A-anga kipom dingin.

Chorus
Kipa thanom loupi ni nopni,
“Loupi ni” atiuve vantil ten ;
Van mithengte jouse akikhom’uvin,
La asauve lung kipah tah in.

Verse 2
Van’a nop la sauvin van mitheng jousen,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in ;
Aman ahin dalhan chonset lampi chu,
Ahung tai a-Pa Pathen henga.

Verse 3
Leiya nop la sauvin mithengte jousen,
Mijouse hom’un hinna Thupha ;
I mitlhiu jong long hen ikipa man’un,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in.

songs.title: 180. DAMSEL’UN CHIBAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset gol ngaite kikhenna dingin,
Kol ninou asoh kit tai, damsel’un.

Verse 2
Leiset chunga hin lungmonna umlou,
Setnan nitin in eijui, kiging’un.

Verse 3
Nikhat kipah in nop la sa jong leng,
Lily pah amol bangin, amol’e.

Verse 4
Ikikhen diu hi leiset anguiye,
Gam le go angui jou tai, chetan gol.

Verse 5
Van gam nom’a chun kikhenna umlou,
Chu-a kimuto gingchan, ka lhauve.

songs.title: 180. KALHAGAO NGAILUA JESU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalhagao ngailua Jesu,
Na anga um ka nome,
Kavel a twiso laisen,
Khopi hui ahat laisen.

Chorus
Neisel in Pakai Jesun,
Kakichat tijat beiman;
Neila galkai in Pakai,
Lan kalha akhon nileh.

Verse 2
Kaina ding dang ken neilou,
Ka lhagao Nang jenga kai,
Kei neichang lha lou jen in,
Neivah jing in nei ngah phan.
Ka tahsan Nang jenga um,
Nangma jeng eihuhhing thei,
Neilungset in neive phan,
Na lhaving in neihin khun.

Verse 3
Imajousea Nang kangai,
Nang a kon a bou kamu,
Alhu jong phong dingin lang,
Ana jong damsah soh in.
Hinna twinah Nang nahi,
Nang a kon hintwi neipen,
Kalung sunga lonsah in,
Neipen hinkemlou twi chu.

songs.title: 180. TWIKHANGLEN PANGA IN VAH KISONG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl

Verse 1
Twikhanglen panga in vah kisong bangin,
Vah-in muthim lah-a chonsete mu din ;
Na lungkot hongin kithopi hung nante.
Vahsah-in Pathen thu chu, (3 vei)
Na thaomei avah laiyin kitheh ngim in ;
Vahsah-in Pathen thu chu.

Verse 2
Kong sesa bangin mi tamtah aum tai,
Mun tina mihem set thim noiya aum ;
Hil leuvin setto na muntina umho.

Verse 3
Navah emhoi chu lo khukhum lou jenin,
Navah chu mite mu theidin koi sangin ;
Salvah-in jan muthim, phattheina chang ding.

Verse 4
Na hinkho beikah-in Christa din tongin,
Christan nangma “Hungin” tia nakou tengle ;
Hiche leiset mun hi jotkit pon nate.

songs.title: 181. A O-NEM NGAIYUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakaiyin angailutte gam asem chu,
Leiset Canaan gam sanga nomjo ahi;
A aw nemin Amite nitin in eitem,
Agam nom tah a cheng jing dingin.

Chorus
Nitin ei … tem jingui, A o-nem ngaiyun;
Angailutna hin jonun, hin jonun,
Jordan twi kinong jongle;
Aw Pakai gam’a hung lut’uvin.

Verse 2
Aw chua khohuikai le hinna thinglim,
Ngaiyin ka galdot hinna toilou pahhoi;
Thenna luipang hoi le tonsot hinna gamnom,
Pakai lungsette alennau chu.

Verse 3
Aw chua tonsot vah i-Pakai Jesu,
Le vantilte to nop la ngei isah diu;
Christa mel ve hon chonset ging talouhel diu,
Lim’in Ama vahchoi jingute.

songs.title: 181. HINTWI PUTNA CROSS PHUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hintwi putna Cross phung ah,
Nei koi in Jesun kei,
Manbei a peh hinna le,
Damna lui along e.

Chorus
Cross phunga , Cross phunga
Ka loupina hihen,
Ka thokit kakal toumaâ€™n
Luigal vangam nomâ€™ah.

Verse 2
Ka toh e Cross phunga chun,
Lungset le sochatna;
Chua um Jing valpa chun,
Keima eisal vah e.

Verse 3
Tun ka ume Cross phung ah,
Phatthei na kim neipen,
Nei kaihoi in nitin in,
Nei koi in nalimâ€™ah.

Verse 4
Ka kat jinge Cross phungah,
Eilungset kinem in,
Ka galkai ka kal touman,
Nopna van gam nom ah.

songs.title: 181. PAKAI VAHCHOI NAN KEN LA SANGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat ml (John 1:29)

Verse 1
Pakai vahchoi nan ken la sange,
Ka kam le kalung thong ting ;
Eingailut kidang chu vahchoi nan,
Sange avahchoila.

Chorus
Ka chonset jouse apomang tai,
Amin theng loupi vahchoi la sange ;
Ka chonset jouse apomang tai,
Halleluijah Amin nin.

Verse 2
Ka hunge ka chonset poh pumin,
Aman olna kim eipei ;
Eilhatdoh jeh chun avahchoi la,
Tang louvin ken sange.

Verse 3
Aheng kalhun teng kei bit keiya,
Aman eihon bit keiya ;
Ken hasah cheh ding avahchoi la,
Tonsot geiya sa ding.

songs.title: 182. LHAGAO HUNG LENG IN EDEN A THILLUI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhagao hung lengin Eden a thillui,
Hung mangin tin nagam hoi kavet ding,
Chuteng kamu ding loupina jouse,
Vahchoina gin hui bangin nungin te.

Chorus
Immanuel na lungset kul sunga,
Gimna gal alenâ€™e hung nai kit in,
Hung kile kit in kahin nau Nahi,
Nalungset kul sunga, O gimna gal alen e.

Verse 2
O kipana vangboh na ni loupi,
Nahinna lampi noma nei puiyin,
Jordan twipi len chu kinong jongle,
Canaan gammon luipi kagal kaiding.

Verse 3
Lengthei jin vakhu bangin leng le leng,
Kahinna Calvary mol kalhun ding,
Chuteng chu mun chu kadalhah kit teng,
Lalna gam nilhum louna kajot ding.

Verse 4
O kadamlai ni hi abei tengle,
Nopna khopi tollai ya kalen ding,
Calvary thina pachat la sa ho,
Kipana chulthei louva lengkhom diu.

songs.title: 182. SALVATION IS FREE TO ALL.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhatdamna kot akihonge Calvary lhanga,
Lungdong lengvai mun neilou din;
Kipah-a ilenkhom nadiu,
Ana sem’e Van Lal in chu.
Kahin jon’e aw ka Pakai namun sem chu,
Set le lungjin gal len jongle;
Nangin neikai le jing jengin.

Verse 2
Ka lhagao na Lhandampu thina Calvary a,
Sun le janin gacheng jing tan;
Chu-a nachen nading gam chu,
Galdot’in lungdon anem’e.

Verse 3
Thillui jouse amang soh in ahung thah kit tai,
Setna thisa thoukit in lang;
Chenna dinga asem gam nom,
Kipah a i-lenkhom nadiu.

Verse 4
Immanuel lei le van thah khopi nom’a chun,
Aw itih le kalhung tadem;
Ka ngai ngeiye tonsot gam chu,
Gol ngai lungdei kimna ding chu.

songs.title: 182.JESUN EISOL’UI VAH HOM LE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Matt. 5:16)

Verse 1
Jesun eisol’ui vah hom le dingin,
Jan muthim’a meivah cha bangin vah-in ;
Hi leiset muthim hi salvah din,
Nangma mun’ah nangma, kei muna kei.

Verse 2
Jesun eisol’ui adinga vah din,
Ivah-u amol tengle Aman ahei ;
Van’a konin eihinve jingui,
Nangma mun’ah nangma, kei muna kei.

Verse 3
Jesun eisol’ui midang salvah din,
Muthimin akhui vannoi leiset mite ;
Achonset hesoh nau sumang din,
Nangma mun’ah nangma, kei muna kei.

songs.title: 183. KASET JAL IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kaset jal in O Pakaiyin alem loi,
Athohna seithei lou agimna seijou lou;
O Amel dei um thisan asoh joutai.
Van Lal Leng aleme (2)
Amite chuna in kilna thih hem le;
Nah a hemma chu thoh in,
Lhanmol ngui ajuontai.

Verse 2
Pakai hesohna aw ngei lungset ngui chun,
Setlei athongsoh in lhagao mangsa thouvin;
O setna kulsunga henkol kaite jong.

Verse 3
Paki lemna chu kolkim velâ€™a phong un,
Sim le malâ€™a minjong athohna chu heu hen;
O Pakai ti in ka lan hung lemu hen.

Verse 4
Genthei tintang thoh in eilhatdoh tauve,
Thisan man ihiuve setna kon lhatdamsa;
O Pan eiholnau gammon eilhut tauve.

Verse 5
Kahinna thing phungle Nang kakipana,
Na milungset jal in da lhangting lei lungjin;
O Salem thah a sun navang nei nouvin.

songs.title: 183. KUMTHAH CHU AHUNG LHUNG KIT TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kumthah chu ahung lhung kit tai,
Ahin lunglen apung jitai;
Nunglam lhangtin gave kit leng,
Leiset golngaite kiminte.

Chorus
Aw hoiya em … gol ngaite chu,
Pakai ngana tonsot gam’a;
Hunguvin lang hinna pah hoi,
Namtui chu galou tau hite.

Verse 2
Phat hi che-a mollep ngailou,
Langkachah khopi tol nom’a;
Lungdon silpon khuh-a lengte,
Umtalou tonsot gam ahi.

Verse 3
Ka ngai ngeiye lungset gam chu,
Veu hite khohui kai noiya;
Ahsi kal van Salem thah chu,
Lungdeite tol lenna ahi.

Verse 4
Ka ngahlel ngeiye chu gam chu,
Ajou le chu gam kalhun ding;
Goldeite kikhenpi jong leng,
Chu-a kipah a kalen diu.

songs.title: 183. TUNIN KUMLUI ABEISOH TAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Tunin kumlui abeisoh tai,
Kumthah ahung lhung tai ;
Taovu hite Pathen hengah,
I chonset beina din. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Kumlui hitia chemang bang chun,
Akem’e ihinkho ;
Akem jinge aniseh in,
Akem mang loiji tai. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Hijeh chun sopite hungun,
Pathen naiyu hite ;
Ama jenga chu kinemin,
Tonsot hin jingna din.

Verse 4
Hiche kumthah hung lhun bangin,
Thah hen ilungu jong ;
Aga phat apun theina din,
Kihabol’u hite.

Verse 5
Vo Pathen Nang ka tahsan na,
Khang hen aniseh-in ;
Ka kinepnau hin khan sah in,
Det hen thihhat aiyin.

songs.title: 184. KILUNGSET KHAOGUIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Matt.11:30)
1 Kilungset khaoguiyin,
Christian eikan khom cheh ;
I-kigol ngainau lungput chu,
Chung gam chondan ahi.

Verse 2
Pa laltouna angah,
I-taonau lhung sap cheh ;
Lungtup le kinepna thakhat,
Ilung monnau jong khat.

Verse 3
Gim genthei thoh khom’a,
Pohgih kingai jang toa ;
Khat in khat kihu to cheh hi,
Christian kilungsetna.

Verse 4
I-kikhen nung tengle,
Iti lunghel umtam ;
Hijong le ilung kikhen lou,
Kimu kit kinem a.

songs.title: 184. NGAI IN KAHUNG TAONA PAKAI JESU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyin kahung taona Pakai Jesu,
Ka ngai cheh na dingin lung neihin pen,
Nang kangai cheh na din,
Jesun lung neihin pen,
Ha ngaitah a ka ngai na din.

Verse 2
Leiset nopna jouse kamusoh tan,
Ahin nopna olna hin kichen lou,
Nangma jeng bou hinna,
Nopna le lung monna,
Ha ngaitah a ka ngai na din.

Verse 3
Tu vangin Nang jeng bou ngailut na ding,
Lung thengtah kathumâ€™e kei neihin pen,
Nang kangai cheh na din,
Lungtheng lungnem neipen,
Ha ngaitah a ka ngai na din.

songs.title: 184. VO JESU KA LHANDAMPU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai namin kija hen lang,
Na gam loupi tah in hung lhung tahen;
Vetan thuneina setnan amang,
Namin hi hin choisang kit’in.

Chorus
Vo Jesu, Ka Lhandampu,
Namin hin choisangin;
Phaijol pah Lily vangkho nom’a hin,
Setna sumang dingin Nang hung pah in.

Verse 2
Tahsante lah-a setna hin,
Pakai Jesu min aseipoi jouvin;
Aminset ding iphal diu ham,
Amelset ding pha isah um?
I-lhau lemsa hinna ahi.

Verse 3
Jesun “Ka min asei set’u,
Kalung asuna-e” ati;
Amin thengpen choisang ding le,
Adihna ponna kisil din;
Lhatsa mihem umnau hitem?

Verse 4
Setna in “talo” anei poi,
Lhagao sim joulou apuimang jou tai;
Van Lal Chapa thengpen jong chu,
Leiset a ahung lenlai chun;
Thisan longin aham sah-ui.

Verse 5
Set jeh in mon aum poi,
Leiset genthei na a;
Van gam ka ngaiye,
Ka Pa in hoi chu;
Setna meipi ajing tapoi tiuvin.

songs.title: 185. CONFLICT WITH SINE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gal alen’e leisetna hin,
Satan gal anitin ahunglen jinge;
Na lhagaova neipui lou chun,
Namin ngei hi Pakai ken pan ngam jilou ding.

Chorus
Malai themgaote napui bang chun,
Na lhagaovin nei von’in lang;
Tahsanin namel nei musah-in,
Kipah-a Namin vahchoi ding.

Verse 2
Calvary lhang chunga Pakai,
I-set jal’in lungdon genthei tintang athoh;
Alungdonna suhmil hoilou,
Set jal’in aw alungdonna imil joutai.

Verse 3
Nei ngaidam’in Pakai Jesu,
Keiman nalungdonna sumil helta jong leng;
Nangbou ka ngailut pen Nahi,
Ka ngai ngeiye Pakai namel neimu sah-in.

Verse 4
Na gam tungdoh dingin Pakai,
Nalhatsate setsoh-a kon puidoh dingin;
Set gallen jong doukit dingin,
Ka pang jinge Immanuel nei lamkaiyin.

songs.title: 185. IKIMU TO KIT DIN EINEM’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. sl
(Rom. 5:2)

Verse 1
Ikimu to kit din einem’e,
Leiset hinkho abei teng ;
Thusim lui seiding chun einem’e,
Van gam nom vah jinga chun.

Chorus
Gamnom vah a chun, (2 vei)
I-Pau chenna gam innom tah a chun ;
Kimuto nau hite, kimuto nau hite,
Galjona lallukhuh isan diu.

Verse 2
Loupia kimuto din ei nem’e,
Hinna thingphung hoi lim’a ;
Eilhatpau vahchoidin einem’e,
Alungsetna eilhat chu.

Verse 3
Loupia kimuto din ei nem’e,
Chunga laltouna kim’a ;
Lhatsa janel avahchoi lasa,
Mitheng lah a lhah ding chu.

Verse 4
Loupia kimuto din einem’e,
Leiset kin kachai tengle ;
Kipah tah-a ikikhut tuh diu,
Tonsot gamnom ema chun.

songs.title: 185. NEI DALHA LOU JENO JESU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nei dalha lou jenâ€™o Jesu, kataona ngai in,
Midang Nangman nakou tengle,
Nei dalha hih in.
Jesu Jesu kataonau ngai in,
Nangman midang ho nakou teng,
Nei dalha hih in.

Verse 2
Na touna limdam noiya chun, keima ol neipen,
Chua na vahchoi la sange,
Lungset in neilan.

Verse 3
Ka lungmonna twinah nahi, kahinna jong Nang,
Nang lou keiman adang neilou,
Nang bou ka hinna.

Verse 4
Ka chonsetna subei soh in, neisil theng sel in,
Na deilam tah in nei puilen,
Na vangam geiyin.

songs.title: 186. AW VAN HUILHI KANGAIYE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw van huilhi kangaiye hung lengin,
Kalung sunga meipi jing semhoh in;
Thim le lungjin nan kei eikhang jitai,
Kajot laiyin alei tonsot kholmun.

Chorus
O Pakai kadin ijakai Nahi,
Hinna twikhuh Nahi ken kangaiye,
Loupina le Van mun kangeh chomlou,
Van chu Nangma nahi e nei umpin.

Verse 2
Tilâ€™a leiya eden pahhoi leng sa,
Kahol in vannoi setthim jing noiya;
Hin Calvary lhanga aleng kit tai,
Apah e eden thah hinthing phunga.

Verse 3
Leiset pah mihemte hi chulkit ding,
Anop laiju le aw ngei gin jong thip;
O Pakai Namel hoi vang chul ngailou,
Tonsot a pah jinga einem jing ding.

Verse 4
Nangma ka kouvin thim akihoh jin,
Gamthip lunghel na hi jaiyin ka-oi;
Kakipana athah ken seijou lou,
Na em chun keidin kho avah sah e.

songs.title: 186. KA SOPITEN NEILHA TAUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.Flat m. (Rev. 22:1)
1 Ka sopiten neilha tauvin,
Van gam jonin che tange ;
Vannoi leiset’a um laiya,
Ka nga jing van in nom chu.
Ka van in nom ka van in nom,
Tonsot’a hinna nop kem kit louna ;
Neisol tauvin lunglhai sel’in
Nei lha tauvin sopite hon.

Verse 2
Van gam kal masa Jesu chun,
Ka umna ding mun asem ;
Tun eikouve chua cheng din,
Kipah tah-in che tange.

Verse 3
Chonset dim vannoi leiya hin,
Gim hesoh kachai tai tun ;
Ka Pathen in sem’a cheng ting,
Nop kem louva cheng tange.

Verse 4
Lunghel lou jenun sopite,
Leiya kimu hih jongleu ;
Ni khat van in nom’a thon moa,
Ikimu to kit tei diu.

songs.title: 186. NAMEL’A KIPANA AUM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nalungset jal’a kipah-a kikhom sate,
Kahung kikhen kit tauve Lhandampu;
Einem ding dang aumpoi leisetna,
Pakai Jesu kakom’uva lengin.

Chorus
Aw cheng jingin Pakai ka henguva,
Nei umpiuvin lunghel lengvai chate;
Namel’a kipana aum’e,
Ka ngai bang theilou ding.

Verse 2
Hileiset hi kap’a kikhenna mun ahi,
Pakai Jesu nalungsetna jal’in;
Natonsot gam nom’a kalhun tengle,
Kikhen kit talou ding tahsan chate.

Verse 3
Lunghel’in ka kouve ka Pakai tuni hin,
Hung lengin kalung set thim’a hin;
Valpa ahsi sangin navah hoijoi,
Namel’a lhamon le kipa aum.

songs.title: 187. CHI GENTHEI LUNGDON NA GAM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chi genthei lungdonna gama hin,
Lungdon mitlhi pum in kangah e;
Tang louvin Pakai nei umpin lang,
Nam genthei lengvai pah banga pah ding.

Chorus
O hung lengin Pakai kangaiye,
Calvary nalung set na chu;
Pon bangin jah in kachung uva,
Nam genthei lengvai pah banga pah ding.

Verse 2
Na gam nom jot dalha jeng jong leng,
Mong pong kate Pakai Nang tailou;
Senlai nao banga kaka pet hin,
Namtin lungmol lah a Nang hung vah in.

Verse 3
Chonset in eihin nai jeng jong le,
Thina thimpi noiya um jong leng;
Pakai neipen hinna Lhagao hi,
Na lungsetna chu pah banga pah ding.

Verse 4
Genthei jal a aw van Lal lukhuh,
Chonset genthei mun na a hungun;
Nagam le chi kah a genthei na,
Kapa anga pah namtui in a pah.

songs.title: 187. MAKE HASTE, TO REVEAL THY GLORY.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary a nalungsetna chu,
Chansoh loi hen leiset le gam tin’a;
Nangma lhatsa lei mihemte,
Thina sapset lah-a lengun.

Chorus
Pakai Jesu naloupina le ngailutna,
Thangsoh loi hen chitin lah-a;
Mihem lungsung setna lemsa,
Na min loupi vahchoi lan sau hen.

Verse 2
Ka gam lungdon lungjinna kon hin,
Koi ham Pakai achea gahuhdoh ding;
Sim le mal’a Nangma min ngei,
Kithopi ding dang umlouhel.

Verse 3
Leiset chonset hi meipi bangin,
Ahung jinge Pakai kalung sunga;
Hin semhoh-in van meikong chun,
Nang din pah bangin pah inge.

Verse 4
Ka kap-e Pakai na gam ngaiyin,
Tonsot gam le lungsette lenna chu;
I-tih le lungdon le hamna,
Pel’a mitlhi long ahul dem?

songs.title: 187. OHE ! TUNI LEISET BEINI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl

Verse 1
Ohe ! tuni leiset beini,
Abange ikikhen hi ;
Pathenin phattheina chamkim,
Pen lang damsel’in chetan.

Chorus
Ikikhen ahitai tunin,
Nache na damsel chan chen ;
Pathenin kivoppi jing tan,
Lei chibai chaina sangin.

Verse 2
Tunin nangma heng lam jonin,
Ahunge na kelngoi nou ;
Pathenin kichin jingin lang,
Avan gam’a puilut’ in.

Verse 3
Pathen thahatnan damsel chan,
Che tan lungset ngai chullou ;
Pakai Jesu Christan lhonpin,
Van gam nom laiya leng din.
4 Pakai chenna van gam noma,
Kimu to ding kinemin ;
Kimuto ni loupi nile,
Eina sangin banjal’in.

songs.title: 188. JESU MIN KIVOP JINGIN LANG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.Flat sl (Psalms 72:19)

Verse 1
Jesu min kivop jingin lang,
I-ngai Pakai Jesu min ;
Nache nahung le na chan’a,
Sumil hih-in Amin ngei.

Chorus
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jingin nalungin ;
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jingin niseh in.

Verse 2
Jesu min kivop jingin lang,
Ama chu lumin sungin ;
Na changa navale na ah,
Ama minin tao jingin.

Verse 3
Jesu min kivop jingin lang,
Hoichana che jongle chun ;
Asei thu kigel jing le chun,
Nalung mong jing jeng tading.

Verse 4
Jesu min kivop jingin lang,
Hoichana um jong le chun ;
Athutep thenga kinem in,
Lhaso hih-in Amin theng.

songs.title: 188. SOCHAT NA KONG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sochat na kong nikhat kaltou ding,
Jesu sochatna kong tol ahi,
Kong sunga chu namtin kimsoh ding,
Apuilut ding van chung gam nomâ€™a.
Chugam a lut dingin (2)
Kong a chun hung kal un ule nao

Verse 2
Jesun lungset tah in nakouve,
Kong a hungkal un mi chonse te,
Zion gam jon ding kong dang umlou,
Phat homâ€™in hunglut in kong sunga.

Verse 3
Kaina sochatna kong chu che leh,
Hung kile lou ding kou jongle chun,
Zion gam nom em lam kai tading,
Nang na ka ding twikhanglen galâ€™a.

songs.title: 188. WE ARE MARCHING ON.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ma a luigal’a khopi nom chu,
Lhun ka ngahlel khopi hoi chu;
Lungdei jouse akimnau mun,
Mu kanom galdot chim ponge.
Aw chelai ihiu cholnga louvin,
Pakai hatna gingchan khopi hoi jon’ute.

Verse 2
Chu khopi nom lam chu jon jingute,
Lhasam louvin che jingute;
Gal monna ding mun um louhel,
Pakai heng ilhun masangsen.

Verse 3
Hechen hileng aw vahchoi chimlou ding,
Gal ginna a leng hijong leng;
Van mun loupi kalhun tengle,
Vahchoina la daingai lou ding.

Verse 4
Aw van Lhagao Thengpen hung lengin lang,
Lung’a set kot hongkit in lang;
Nagam nom’a neipui lut’un,
Kipana kemlouna a chun.

songs.title: 189. GAZING OVER THE LAND OF PROMISE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Malaiyin Mosen Canan agaldot,
Lo jou louvin leng thupeh apolen;
Canan gam loupi le ahoina amun,
Kisih-in ngaiyin kap inte ong?

Chorus
Aw keijong Canan thah ka galdot,
Ka hatna songa lhung joulou ding;
Hinla Leng Jehova’n eipuiyin tin,
Gamnom chutobang chu kaga muding.

Verse 2
Canan khohui kai le nigui em chu,
Lamkai Mose chun agah galdot in;
Jordan galkai ding chu Pakaiyin phallou,
Alungset ho chu adalha tai.

Verse 3
Lung lenlhang chu ka ngailheh jenge,
Lalnan ajem hoiye tonsot gam chu;
Chu-a galjou Kelngoinou Leng atouve,
Avel’a lal na pah-in abom.

Verse 4
Canan pahhoi lhang nomtah ho chu,
Lamkai Mose galhungpai thei talou;
Ngailou bangin Salem lhang achan mai tai,
Israelten ngai ngeiyinte ong?

songs.title: 189. LUNGLHA HIH-IN ITOH JONGLE CHUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat ml (I Pet.5:7)

Verse 1
Lunglha hih-in itoh jong le chun,
Pathenin ching jingin ;
Alungset lhaving noiya umin,
Pathenin ching jingin.

Chorus
Pathenin naching phan,
Nache na chan a niseh-in ;
Aman naching jingin,
Pathenin ching jingin.

Verse 2
Nava le lungdonna jouse ah,
Pathenin ching jingin ;
Nache le na kichatna a jong,
Pathenin ching jingin.

Verse 3
Na ngaichat jouse nape jinge,
Pathenin ching jingin,
Nathum chan itlouvin aphal jing,
Pathenin ching jingin.

Verse 4
Na lhemlha ding itobang jongle,
Pathenin ching jingin ;
Thachol kingaiyin Pakai om’ah,
Pathenin ching jingin.

songs.title: 189. THISAN LUIPI KHAT ALONG E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thisan luipi khat alonge,
Christa thajung a kon,
Mi chonse ten chu lui a chun,
Chonset asop lhauve.
Chonset asoplhauve (2)
Michonse ten chu lui a chun,
Chonset asop lhauve.

Verse 2
Cross chunga um thiding sa chun,
Thisan lui chu amui,
Kei jong ama bang a chonse,
Ka chonset soptheng in.

Verse 3
Na thisan lui nah chu keiman,
Tahsan in kamutai,
Aw ngeijin nang vahchoina la,
Kathi kahsen sange.

Verse 4
Ka leiset hinkho abei a,
Lhanâ€™a kon katho teng,
Vanâ€™a aw ngei cheh in sange,
Na vahchoi tang louvin.

songs.title: 190. KAMON MO KALUNG HEL NI HIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kamon mo kalung hel ni hin,
Tong donna abanna ahi;
Ka leiset lonlhi long pum in,
Naban jet kahin sange tun,
Kisan in chibai o sopi .(gol lhangpa)

Verse 2
Goldei nungteng huiva mao ding,
Khoto nan navang ka kap e;
Ban jal in lonlhi huiyin lang,
Tong don in thimthu lel tem o;
Lai gila geltwi bang dap ding.

Verse 3
Nalong damsa tong donthei lou,
Keiman lhiso pi jeng jong leng;
Ichung thangvan sang najon tai,
Pakai Jesu Christan lhonpin;
Kalhauve goldei ngai chim theilou.

Verse 4
Hinoi leiset gim muna hin,
Golte ngaiyin mongjou ponge;
Vanchung gam nom nalhun tengle,
Che masa chin ngaite heng a;
Khankho thimthu cheng nalel tan.

songs.title: 190. NANGBOU CHU NAHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ham’in ka ngah gam loupi chu,
Hung neiyin lal Immanuel;
Ka lhagaovin thangvan sanga,
Nom’in galeng tante.

Chorus
Aw nang kalenna gam lungmol,
Nalhang chunga genthei chate ahbang kivai;
Aw nagam loupi lalna pahhoiyin abom’e,
Nangbou chu nahi kalung kinepna.

Verse 2
Ka lhagao aleng lunghel’in,
Pah bangin chulta di jongle;
Kipana gamtheng lhun tengle,
Chultih ni neilou ding.

Verse 3
Lei pahcha noplai ni achul,
Khen nung teng kingai anaiye;
Lung ngahna umlou leisetna,
Genthei naobang ka-na.

Verse 4
Jesu neikaiyun nei puiyun,
Nalungset twipia kalut diu;
Zion khonom le gamtheng chu,
Mu ka nom’e Pakai.

songs.title: 190. PATHENIN NANGNAUMPI JINGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Flat m. (Rom.16:20)

Verse 1
Pathenin nang na umpi jingin,
Chonna ding chan nahil jingin ;
Ahon lah-a naching jingin,
Pathenin umpin kimu kahsen.

Chorus
Ikimu kit kahsen,
Jesu keng khopi muh a ;
Ikimu kit kahsen,
Pathenin umpin kimu kahsen.

Verse 2
Pathenin nang na umpi jingin,
Alhavingin nahui jingin ;
Niseh van an in navah-in,
Pathenin umpin kimu kahsen.

Verse 3
Pathenin nang na umpi jingin,
Na lungdon na jousea na hun ;
Abante nin napom jingin,
Pathenin umpin kimu kahsen.

Verse 4
Pathenin nang na umpi jingin,
Na chunga akhut pei jing hen ;
Thi na lungdon sumang soh hen,
Pathenin umpin kimu kahsen.

songs.title: 191. AW NEIPUI JINGIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset pahhoi kavel’a pah hi,
Sem hoh-in lang meipi jing hohi;
Nalamdih a chun mang louvin,
Namin kiso Jordan gal’a chun.

Chorus
Aw neipui jingin lang,
Setna kulpi thina thim jouvin;
Neipui jingin lang,
Immanuel Lal Jesu.

Verse 2
Gamtin’a thangsoh in Lal genthei,
Nalungsetna seichoi lenge aw;
Namin thengtah choisang dingin,
Mitin hil’in lang Calvary bang chun.

Verse 3
Lungdei golngai kikhenna lei hi,
Kapmin aham’ui ka Lhandampu;
Thisan lutah-a lhatsate,
Leiset pahhoi hi akipa piuve.

Verse 4
Leng David le Valpa ahsi chu,
Hungvah kit in kalung sunga hin;
Asetnau lah-a lengte hi,
Napah hoi chun aw neipui kit’uvin.

songs.title: 191. LUNGHEL IN LHANGTIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lunghel in lhangtin kagal dot le,
Lhum mei akaiyin lungdon na gam a hin;
O toni kalhum joupoi leiset a hin,
O itih lunghel na gam ka dalhah a,
Goldei tetoh nom tah in in kaleng dem?

Verse 2
Ka ngah lel goldei te mel mukal,
Einem jinge kimu to ding luigal a.

Verse 3
Van Khopi tollai kagal dot le,
Lathah ngei le baja khongpi athong e.

Verse 4
Ngai chim pong kate van lathah ngei,
A choinau la ngeiyin kalung aleng e.

Verse 5
Leiset a gentheina a-ngah na bei,
O iti lunghel lungdon pul kadou dem?

Verse 6
Ka leltai Pakai set genthei na,
O nei lhamon in na-kam dam aw ngei chun.

Verse 7
Leiset kum lhun ding ka ngah lel e,
Kum lhuna Pakai Christa lem khom ding chu.

songs.title: 191. NISA NEIPEH HI ALHUM KIT TAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Psalms 74:16)

Verse 1
Nisa neipeh hi alhum kittai,
Nathun kho ajing tai Pakai ;
Lhailouva kajal nei ngaidamin,
Jing thoa thangvah jing na ngaiye.

Verse 2
Nangma lhenchom mit singlou umjing,
Lei langkhat lama kho vah jing ;
Tichun jingkom umlou lei pum hi,
Vannoiyin sa jing Namin ngei.

Verse 3
Molle lhang dam phai kikahse cheh,
Kolmong kikeo ninouvin jui ;
Bang louvin taona o nemin jui,
Lem la gin awn tan nei ngai lou.

Verse 4
Nilhah ihmut phat eihilpa hin,
Noimi lam sopite thouvin ;
Twipi nong banga ging o long chu,
Tang louvin van lam’a athong.

Verse 5
O Pakai Nangma lenna gam chu,
Leiset banga chulthei hilou ;
Khang touvin tin hungjao ding ahi,
Na gam loupi hung kilang hen.

Verse 6
Hiti chun namin loupi jing hen,
Setlei le thangvan kah-a hin ;
Vahchoinan leiset mihemte hin,
“Amen Halleluijah” tiu hen.

songs.title: 192. GAZING OVER THE LAND OF PROMISE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Setna kulpi lam’a chun gachen lang,
Chu lam’a kipana kahol laiyin;
Chu lui thina a aw thong chu kajan,
Kichat in ka dimset kit tai.
Vo Jesu keilam hinve kit’in,
Pakai kei lamvaiyin, kavah mange.

Verse 2
Chonset ga chu thina ahung hitai,
Kapal ngampoi thina luipi len chu;
Hinla chena lamdang umlou Pakai,
Lhamon sah Nangma ka ngaiye.

Verse 3
Kum tamtahpi kanuse jou jong hin,
Lungsetna in neina ching jing jengin;
Ijakaiya ka ijakai Pakai,
Lei chung hi vahchoi lan lo hen.

songs.title: 192. NILHAH KON AHITAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.Sharp.

Verse 1
Nilhah kon ahitai,
Gamtin mu athim tai ;
Chu tobang chun eihin naitai,
Thina ding mu thimin.

Verse 2
Kapon kakoi soh-a,
Keova kalup banga ;
Thi chun pon beiya eikoi ding,
Leiset nop pai lhante.

Verse 3
Pakai kei nei ngah phan,
Tujan khovah kah sen ;
Na vantil nei ngasah jingin,
Nisa so kit kahsen.

Verse 4
Jing khovah niso teng,
Nisa che dungjuiya ;
Chonphat lam kajot theina din,
Tha neipen neivah-in.

Verse 5
Ka hinkho alhin a,
Lei hi ka dalhah teng ;
Na anga neina kipomin,
Ol kemlou neina pen.

songs.title: 192. PAKAI HESOH THOH JAN CHU KANGAI TOLE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai hesoh thoh jan chu kangai tole,
Kalung sunga thimpi ajinge,
Mihem dinga asem ni a sophat in,
Kalung sung thim jing avah sohtai.

Chorus
Keima jeh in Calvary jon in achei,
Keima jeh in, keima jeh in,
Keima jeh in Calvary jon in achei,
Eilhat doh nan athi.

Verse 2
Mi chonse a anga kakithing thinge,
Kakunâ€™e lungset ngaidam thumnan,
â€œNa chonset ka ngaidamtaiâ€ tin aw kajai,
â€œKasatai nabat jouseâ€ eiti.

Verse 3
Huhhing pan eingailut akidang lheh e,
Van a laltouna ahin dalhan,
I hinna dingun Calvary a ahung thi,
Vahchoi un Amintheng phong leuvin.

songs.title: 193. LEISET NOP MANG JONGLE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset nop mang jongle, Christa kanei,
Leiset hi chim jongle, Christa kanei,
Hi leiset gam muthim, Olna munla umlou,
Christa kei kingaina, Christa kanei.

Verse 2
Kalhagao lhem hih in, Christa kanei,
Leiya hin um jong leng, Christa kanei,
Leiset phe mang kit ding,
Nichom khat dinga peng,
Kalunga mang jeng hen, Christa kanei.

Verse 3
Hinkho jan mang tobang, Christa kanei,
Chomkah a beita ding, Leiset hinkho,
Ka lunga kagel chu, Manghen mil tange ken,
Jesu bou kahin na, Christa kanei.

Verse 4
Ka hinkho lhing jongle, Christa kanei,
Sang in tonsot hinna, Christa kanei,
Sang in nop le phatthei, Olna mun chu jon in,
Sang in Jesu ang sung, Christa kanei.

songs.title: 193. THY HOLY HABITATION
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalung sung set boh nensa hi,
Na Houin in sem thah-in;
Asunga hin aw ka Pakai,
Tonsot’in Nang hung chengin.
Na umna chu (2)
Tonsot kipanan aloi.

Verse 2
O khatvei beh muthei hileng,
Khatvei beh Nang namu leng;
Leiset pahhoi jouse sangin,
Ajat jan Nang nahoijoi.
Kipeng kate, (2)
Nangma to chengkhom dingin.

Verse 3
O semhoh-in kasetna hi,
Ka lhagao huhhingin lang;
Ka chim tauve thim’a um hi,
Hungvah in van vah loupi.
Nahung vah teng, (2)
Kalung sung kipan adim. }2
}2
}2

songs.title: 193. VAN’A GAMNOM EM’A CHUN
194. HILTHEI ING’EM PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat chesa chu apamai ngeiye aw Pakai,
Nalungsetna jal’in koukit thei ing’em?
Koukit theilou kacha phat chesa chu,
Lungset kiphon jal’a chu hoiya na um’em?

Chorus
Hil thei ing’em Pakai,
Hil ngam ing’em Pathen;
Diabol manchah lupen chu,
Kei kahilou ham?

Verse 2
Bethlehem sochatna dah ging chu ham nasei,
Calvary lhatna dah gin ham Pa nasei;
Ahi kacha lungset um milengvaipa,
Vannoi set nopna hi nadou jou jeh-in.

Verse 3
Vannoi set nopnan eichimkhum jeng tajongle,
Nachate set lungheina chu ngaidamji Pa;
Ngaidam ji-e, kacha lengvai lungset umpa,
Ka lhamonna khut hi tuh-in cha lungset um.

Verse 4
Nakhut jet ham Pakai naveilam ham?
Hintuh jeng tang kate naveilam hijongle;
Katuhna ding khut chu kajetlam hinte,
Kalhentum nakhut thengtah chu tuh jing jengin.

songs.title: 194. JINGKAH NILHAH SUNIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. s. (Psalms 126:6)

Verse 1
Jingkah nilhah sunin theu hite michi pha,
Kehdoh ding aphatcha itoh gimnau chu ;
Chang at phat ngah ing ting chang kikhop jou tengle,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah-a.
Pathen Hou in’a Pathen hou in’a
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah-a

Verse 2
Theute nisa noiya theute vannim noiya,
Phalbi dap le go juh ding jong ging louvin ;
Chang akikhop soh-a ka natoh kachai teng,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah-a

Verse 3
I-mitlhiu long jong le tuu hite Pakai din,
Gim le gentthei thoh-in lou neipu dingin ;
Inatoh ijouva Aman eikou teng le,
Changpal pha ipohlut diu thanom tah-a.

songs.title: 194. LUNG MONGMON LHANG TIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lung mongmon lhang tin kachon e,
Lung monna aumpoi leiset a,
O ka chennau gam dalhang ting che tange,
Kap kit talou ding.

Chorus
O kagam ngai chullou,
Pahcha hoiyin abome;
Mi genthei keima lenna ding chu,
Lal na pahhoi Gam ngai kaki nepna.

Verse 2
Huiva banging a leng thei leng,
Leng tange thangvan sang lam jon in;
Calvary lhang thing cross chunga ga change,
Ga tou jing tange.

Verse 3
Kho munâ€™a lengleng gol kim in,
Lhunghel lungdon jong hi bang tantem?
Ahipoi gol kim in lunghel abang chompoi,
Ka abang chompoi.

Verse 4
Heng thoh cheh ute lunghel jong,
Chung Pathen vangboh in damsel chan;
Lhagao kho munâ€™a chun eijong iga len diu,
Lei hi dalhau tin.

songs.title: 195. AW PAKAIYIN CHENNA DING MUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
O Pakaiyin chenna ding mun,
Aga semna a chun;
Vahchoina la sa galeng khom ding,
Goldei kikhen kitna jong um ta lou.
O ka- ngah lel lenkhom ni ding chu,
Leiset ngailouva Zion Pakai lem le;
Goldei te kimni ding chu.

Verse 2
Chua lungdon ka-na beita,
Khopi thah nomâ€™a chun;
Thina lui gal kai teng kachenna,
Ding gelâ€™in ka-lai kabang thei jipoi.

Verse 3
Ajou le kho avah teng le,
Goldei te lengâ€™un te;
Chu a Pakai neilhah sah-in lang,
Leiset ngai louva dalhah ka-nomâ€™e.

songs.title: 195. KHOVAH DING AHITAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat
1 Khovah ding ahitai Pakai muchi tu din thouvin,
Nilhum geiyin Pakai din na tongin lang ;
Mihem mangthaisa ho abanin kaithou peh jengin,
Thohhat tah-in Pakai dingin na tongin.
Muchi lu chu theuvin, (2 vei)
Ningtin a le gamtin’a the chansoh keiyun ;
Hinna changlhah hom’in kipana Thupha lhangsamun,
Pakai dingin tongin tohman atam’e.

Verse 2
Jingpi tah-in thouvin Pakai dingin natong panin,
Kho thim geiyin muchi pha hi tu jingin ;
Gingcha lel louhel’in muchi pha hi tujingin lang,
Ima jouse dalhan Pakai tahsanin.

Verse 3
Muchi pha hi gunchu le tahsan neitah-in tun lang,
Na muchi tu chu na-at kit din gingchan ;
Lung le tha choltih nei louhel’in muchi pha chu tun,
Pathen henga phatthei channa ding thumin.

songs.title: 195. ZION KHOPI THAH
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ngahlel Zion khopi thah,
Lal lenna van gam loupi;
Lunglen kom le ka galdotjin,
Lei gimna nuse tange.

Chorus
Aw gamthengpen hinna gam vah,
Lalna gam hoi mu kanom ngei;
Kalhun kahsen aw Lal nunnem,
Lha louvin neikai jing jengin.

Verse 2
Chung lam’a lhajah in lengun,
Natna le lungkhamna hon;
Thina lhangvum’a cheng ihiu,
Hinna gam galdot’ute.

Verse 3
Hinlai khankho hi geltem’un,
Lungdon meipi ajing jing;
Leiset khel’a hinthah ngaiyin,
Ka kap Lal nunnem ang’a.

Verse 4
Nunnopnan einem’in Pakai,
Set chate kipana din;
Nunnop len kolni emselta,
Zion gam galdot ute.

songs.title: 196. AW ITI NOP TAM CHRISAT KANEI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Aw iti noptam Christa kanei,
Vangam loupi le anop eihiltai,
Van gou lo dinga lhat kahitai,
Thisan le lhagaova peng kahi.

Chorus
Hiche kathusim hiche ka laa,
Keiman vahchoi ding kahin laisea,
Hiche kathusim hiche ka laa,
Ken vahchoi jing ding kahin laisea.

Verse 2
A henga lut chu nop cham kimsoh,
Thokit loupi nia loupina chang ding,
Vantil hung kumlha eipui tou ding,
A komâ€™a chenga ol jing jeng ding.

Verse 3
A henga lut chu olcham kimsoh,
Genthei lengvai chol jong beisoh ta ding,
Kiging in ahung ngah jing inge,
Aphatna cheng vahchoi lan sange.

songs.title: 196. HINLAI NATOH KACHAIYA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat d. (I Cor. 13:12).

Verse 1
Hinlai natoh kachaiya twiso ka galkai tengle,
Jing niso loupi vahhoi chu kamu teng ;
Agal langkhat kalhun teng Eilhatpa chu ken he ding,
Nui heova eina lamto masa pen ding.

Chorus
Ken hejeng ding, ken hejeng ding,
Alhatsa akoma kadin teng ;
Ken hejeng ding, ken hejeng ding,
Akhut thingkil maha chu heding.

Verse 2
Huhhingsa ken kipah-a Pakai mai kamu tengle,
Lungset’a Amit ha hoi chu kamu ding ;
Ei hepi lungset ngailut iti ka vahchoi tadem,
Van chunga innom gotsa eikoipeh chu.

Verse 3
Che masa ka ngai ho chun hungin tin eijap jingui,
Kaki khennau luipanga kikhom kit ding ;
Eden phaihoi tah-a la ngeiyin eilamtou vinte,
Kei vang Pakai mu masah pen ka nome.

Verse 4
Akhopi kot hoiya chu pon bangleh eisil peh-a,
Lhiso kit louna a chu eipui lut ding ;
Tonsot kipana la chu avahchoi na kasah ding,
Keivang ka Pakai mu masah pen kanom.

songs.title: 196. KA NGAHLEL NGEIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ngahlel ngei Lhandampu lenna,
Tonsot gam nom ahung lhung ding chu;
Alhunna ni ding chu nai hen lang,
Tonsot gam hoi chu hung lhung ta hen.
Hung lhung hen lang galeng leu hen,
Chung khopi Lhatdampu le;
Van mithengte to,
Salem thah tonsot pah hoi ke-na,
A chun leiset hi ngaita pou hite.

Verse 2
Pah bang chul ding leiset gentheina,
Na gam loupi ngaiyin kamaove;
Nei hung puiyin lang Pakai Jesu,
Nakom galmonna neilhun sah-in.

Verse 3
Tuhin set thim’a kivai jong leng,
Nung teng tonsot kho hungvah tading;
Ngaiyin nitin kagaldot,
Golngai khenpi sate ho to.

Verse 4
Van khonom umchan ka geldoh nin,
Kalung sung kipan alosoh ji;
Kei jong Jesu lhatna jal’in,
Salem thah nom’a neipui lut’in.

songs.title: 197. AW NEI CHANGLHA LOU JENIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat akidang vaihomna niloupi,
Nitin kanai jinge;
Lhepna le lungjin boina hi,
Ka dougal chu ahung naiye.

Chorus
Aw nei changlha lou jenin,
Ka kom’a um jingin;
Zion lhanghoi kalhun kahsen,
Ka Lhandampu neipui jingin.

Verse 2
Ka ma a lhepna twipi ahung len,
Man ding kaging Pakai;
Chu luipia chim lhasam ho chun,
Tonsot gam lhung thei talou ding.

Verse 3
Noah damlaiya thil umchan tobang,
Le Sadom khoa bangin;
Ama nopsahna ngaitouvin,
Aw Pakai anungsun tauve.

Verse 4
Na lekhabu thenga kisun bangin,
Leiset hi aboi tai;
Ngailutna ahung dai jou tai,
Gimna le lungkham adim’e.

Verse 5
Leiset hesohna le lungjin na-in,
Pa mel nei musah-in;
Zion chate inop lennau,
Niloupi chu ahung naiye.

songs.title: 197. JESUN EILUNGSET KAHEI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesun eilungset kahei,
Bible in kei eihil e,
Chapang hi Acha ahi,
Ama hatchungnung ahi.
Jesun eilungset (2)
Heng-e eilungset,
Bible in eihil e.

Verse 2
Jesun kei eilungset e,
Keima huhhing nan athi,
Van kotpi ahong len e,
Chapang te lutna dingin.

Verse 3
Jesun kei eilungset e,
Keiman Ama thu ngaileng,
Kalut ding kathi nungle,
Vanchung Innom hoi sung ah.

songs.title: 197. NEI UMPIN TU NILHAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat m. (Luke 24:29).

Verse 1
Nei umpin tu nilhah khothim kon hin,
Mu athim tai Pathenin nei umpin ;
Panpi beiya kalung olthei lou teng,
Panpi ngaite panpin kei nei umpin.

Verse 2
Akem baiye kahinkho chomcha hi,
Leiset loupi le nop kem mangsoh ding ;
Thil jouse akem mang thei cheh ahi,
Kikhel lou Pathenin kei nei umpin.

Verse 3
Nangma chu ken nitin in kangaiye.
Eilhem ahatna a jong nei umpin ;
Nang banga lam eihil thei dang umlou,
Ka nopna ka gimna a nei umpin.

Verse 4
Nangman nei umpi le kei olmo lou,
Gim thoh lelna lhisa na ging talou ;
Thina le lhankhuh iti hat jongle,
Nei umpi le ka kichat umlou ding.

Verse 5
Kathi jongle ka koma nei umpin,
Mu thim lah-a lam neihil jing jengin ;
Jing khovah teng vangam kalhun na din,
Kahin, kathin, kakoma nei umpin.

songs.title: 198. CHRISTMAS LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hosanan sam jingun aw Hallelujah Amen,
Leng Christa ahung penge Bethlehem’a chun;
Atongso dam lungset thu namtin damna ahi,
Kipah-in sau hite Hosana ti-in.

Chorus
Aw Bethlehem lhang chunga,
Tonsot kho ahung vah-e, hil kimvel’uvin;
Koi hile chu hinna vah thanom’a tahsanin,
Lunghem ka le gimna thohkit talou ding.

Verse 2
Akidangin aloupi-e chamna Lengpa chu,
Ngailutna alonsah-e leiset chunga hin;
Setna kon eilhatdoh theina diuva hung hita,
Lungset gam leng ahi i-Pakai Jesu.

Verse 3
Pa thutep ahung lhung tai, idam theinau ahi,
Ngailutna along let’e Calvary a chun;
Adanje koi ham seithei lei mihemte lah-a,
Alungsetna gam nom eilhut tauvinte.

Verse 4
Zion loupina Pakai mangsa eiholpau chu,
Van khopiten it jongleu nangjou dehlou ding;
Ijakai ka ijakaiya Lal pen hen, Amen,
Eingailutnau hi koiman nel theilou ding.

songs.title: 198. HINLAI YIN LHANDAMPU JAL IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai yin Lhandampu jal in,
Kipah in lengkhom jong leu hen;
Kap in ikikhen kit jitai,
O kangai kikhen louna gam.

Chorus
Lhandampu mun ga sema chun,
Hi leiya kikhen pisa te;
Tonsot laltouna anga chun,
O itih ikikhom diuvem.

Verse 2
Alange Calvary lhang ah,
Galdot ute khen louna gam;
I lennau lhang kikhen jong le,
Tahsan in leng khom jingu te.

Verse 3
Sam jingu te I Pakai bou,
Genthei lengvaina a ei nem;
Ama lou ei nem dang umlou,
Achul jitai lei kipana.

Verse 4
Hi leiset a jong hin Aman,
Allungset na lha lim noiya;
Kipan eipui khom kit un te,
Kap in kikhen jeng jong leu hen.

songs.title: 198. VAN’A TONSOT NOPNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (II Cor.2:9)

Verse 1
Vana tonsot nopna aume,
Ipau Pathen chu gam ngah ahi ;
A emsel in avah jing jenge,
A itih a chua mu thim lou.

Chorus
Chu gamnom lhung dinga,
Kei kache ding chua cheng dinga ;
Chu gamnom lhung dinga,
Kei kache ding chua cheng dinga.

Verse 2
Chu gama nisa sat um talou,
Thi le man nat genthei gim beita ;
Kel le chah imajouse beita,
Kem thei louva tonsot’a nopna.

Verse 3
Chu gam a chu Vantil thengte cheng,
Van mi thengte jouse jong chu cheng,
Van lallukhuh akikhuh cheh-ui,
Tonsot a nomsa jing ahiuve.

songs.title: 199. JERUSALEM ZION KHOPI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jerusalem Zion khopi chu gel tem’un,
Aw mi atam Kelngoinou;
Lal lenna ding mun umlou,
Oh lungkham le kipana Calvary,

Chorus
Lhang ahung lange.
Oh nam jouse le chitin pao tin’in,
Van Lal nao banga aka-na Calvary;
Kidang chom louve.

Verse 2
Jerusalem Zion khopi chu gel tem’un,
Aw mijanel Kelngoinou Lal;
Lenna mun hoiya chu,
Aw Calvary a Pathen ngailutna,
Ngaitoa kul ahi.

Verse 3
Hallelujah hilthem leu hen Hallelujah,
Oh ngailutna daichom ngailou;
Kipa nopna pah hoi,
Asei them le hilthem um’in tem oh,
Angailutna hi.

songs.title: 199. KHATVEI DAVID LENGPA KHOPIA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Khatvei David Lengpa khopia,
Bong in a gan Ankong a,
Minu khat in achasen theng,
Ponseâ€™n jel in alupsah,
Minu chu Mariam ahi,
Acha chu Christa ahi.

Verse 2
Van a konin ahung kumlhai,
Vannoi Pakai Pathen chu;
Loupi pen lhunna ding onglou,
Bong in a ahung lhungtai;
Mi vaicha genthei ho toh,
Leiyah ahung cheng khom e.

Verse 3
Achapan lai khankho kidang,
Nunnem le jana neijin,
Lungset in khoton anu ngai,
Lungset them Pakai theng chun;
Eiho Ama nungjui le
Ama chontheng bang hiute.

Verse 4
Khatvei Amai imu kit diu,
Lungsetna eilhat jal a,
I-Pakaiyu nunnom theng chu,
Chungnung pen Pakai ahi,
Amite hung pui tou ding,
Avan Inn nom a cheng dia.

songs.title: 199. VAN’A CHEN DING KALUNG KINEM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl (Psalms 94:22)

Verse 1
Van’a chen ding kalung kinem,
Adang ima vanga hilou ;
Jesu thisan le chonphat vang,
Jesu thisan jeng bou hinna.
Christa songpi tah-a ka ding,
Mun dang vang chu nel chim ahi. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Mu thimin amai asel teng,
Kalung Ama jenga ki-ngai ;
Lungdon lengvaina jenga jong,
Aman lung olmo lou eipei.

Verse 3
Athutep le athisanin,
Eivah jinge twisoh laiya ;
Lei le van mang jengta jong le,
Ama jenga kalung kai ding,

Verse 4
Ama ahung kum kit nileh,
Ka kivon kima Athupha ;
Ka chonphat eihung tohnan tem,
Alaltouna anga ding din.

songs.title: 200. CHANG AT NADING PHAT
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chang at na ding phat anai tai,
Kiging jing un nidan tin in;
Thina lhankhuh na lep kah in,
Pakaiya ding in na tong un.

Chorus
Khodah uvin Loujao ho khu veuvin,
Chang amin in akoi gam tai;
Na tong ding ahin sol na din,
Lou neipu hengah tao jing un.

Verse 2
Changâ€™at phat a hung lhun teng le,
Pakaiyin chang a at khom ding;
Aw sopi lung mong ta hih in,
Lhagao manghon na kou jing e.

Verse 3
Loujao ho khu ve tem uvin,
Ana tong ding mi aum poi;
Tunin chen lang pakai ding in,
Kipah tah in na tong pan tan.

songs.title: 200. CHOLNGAH NAMUN NOMTAH AUM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.Flat. d. (Isaiah 14:3)

Verse 1
Cholngahna mun nomtah aum,
Luigal gam nom a chun ;
Jan muthim beina kalchung peh-a khun,
Tohgim lhiso na bei.

Chorus
Nei lamton, neina lamton,
Chu ni jinga niso vahhoi em’a chun ;
Nei lamton, neina lamton,
Luigal a gam nom hoitah vah jinga chun.

Verse 2
Khopi hoitah vah jing jeng chu,
Anopje seithei lou ;
Chua lut jousen Leng chu amu ding,
Akom’a cheng jing ding.

Verse 3
Lallukhuh chu koisa ahi,
Christan eipeh diu chu ;
Thoh hatna ahung ding ngah jingte chu,
Chang ding aloupina.

Verse 4
Chu gam khopi kot hoitah-a,
I lut thei na diuvin ;
Tonsot chullou khopi noma leng din,
Thigeiyin tahsan in.

songs.title: 200. CHRISTMAS LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Themgao hon aseiyu Messiah Leng,
Caesar Leng niloupi ahung lhung tai;
Leng thah kipa um chu lem’un lem’un. (2)
Oh vantil vah le Kelngoi ching hon,
Miching hungjin Solam’a kon;
Chung ahsi le mithengte chun,
Kipah tah-in Leng thah pen eihil’ui.

Verse 2
Lal jouse Leng bangin apeng nom’e,
Bethlehem bong in lham noiya apeng;
Amin kidang leng chu lem’un lem’un. (2)

Verse 3
Vantilten lhahnan la ngei asauve,
“Mihemte din chamna leng hen” ti in;
Christa chamna Leng chu lem’un, lem’un. (2)

Verse 4
Lhatdamna dah Lal Jubilee aw chu,
Lei le van gam jousea athong soh tai;
Leng Immanuel chu lem’un, lem’un. (2)

songs.title: 201. CHRISTMAS LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lenlhang kum kihei ponbang thah kitjin,
Van leng chapa mihem’a apennin;
Van mipiten pah banga alem laiyun,
Set thoinan nung teng sullang le kitta.

Verse 2
Setlei genthei gamdai adam noiya,
Jingjin chun Mary’n gan ankong sunga;
Naobang sel’in avanchoi Manglai cha chu,
Apenna munneo bong in lham noiya.

Verse 3
Jingjin michingte le kelngoi ching hon,
Chamna leng hung peng lem din ahung’ui;
Bong in sunga Chun Maryn apom lai chu,
Leng thah chibai boh-in agaboh-ui.

Verse 4
Eihon jong chibai boh le lem la san,
Tumging selangdah le aw gin ngei thon;
Gingthei tintang thon kipa le lemna lan,
Nilhum’in jankho jong vah jengute.

songs.title: 201. CHUNGNUNGA PATHEN ALOUPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chungnunga pathen aloupi,
Kum lhung keiyin eina chingun;

Pakai jesu vahchoi khomna din, Amen.

Verse 2

Kipapi chapangte kei-hon;
Tunin na kotpi phunga hin,
Ka hunguve nanei ngeh-in.

Verse 3
Pakai minâ€™a nahin to doh,
Pai-ni jeng cha hi jeng jong le;
Chapang te lung lhaina jalâ€™in,

songs.title: 201. PATHEN THILKIDANGBOL
songs.lyrics:
Doh is Ab. (Psalms 29:2

Verse 1
Pathen thil kidang bol pachatna chang hen,
Achapa changkhat chu eihinpe tauve ;
Chonse lhatna din ahinna ape tai,
Mitin lut theina dia hinna kot hongta,

Chorus
Vahchoiyun, vahchoiyun, Pathen thusei ngaiyun,
Vahchoiyun, vahchoiyun, kipah thanom tah-in ;
Jesu Christa jal’in Pa henga hungun,
Loupi pachat jouse Pakaiya hihen.

Verse 2
Lhatdam chamkimna hi thisan vang ahi,
Atahsan jouse dia Pathen thutep chu ;
Chonse pen hijong le atahsan poule,
Jesu Christa ngaidamna chu chang tei ding.

Verse 3
Thil loupi kidang eiho eihil tauve,
Jesu Christa vanga kipah ihiuve ;
Tu sanga theng jo, loupi, chule sang joa,
Huhhing kidang Jesu mel imu dingu.

songs.title: 202. ISEI JING’U OLNA GAMNOM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. s. (Rev.21:4)

Verse 1
Isei jingu olna gam nom,
Avah a vah jing jeng ahi ;
Aloupi kisei jinga ahi,
Chua chen anomna dinge.

Chorus
Chu gam a chu gam a,
Chen iti anop ta ding ngem ;
Chu gam a chu gam a,
Chen iti anop ta ding ngem.

Verse 2
Loupina chang ho von hoi chu,
Ngailutna le lungmon ahi ;
Chung gam la ngei kisahna chu,
Chua chen anomna dinge.

Verse 3
Chonset beina gam iseiyu,
Lhepna lungdon genthei umlou ;
Thu noh baotam beihel sohta,
Chua chen anomna dinge.

Verse 4
Nopna gimna a Pakaiyin,
Kalha van’a cheng din chingin ;
Chu gam a chen anopje chu,
Keihon jong heloi tauvinge.

songs.title: 202. KHANGKIM LAIYIN VANA KON IN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Khangkim laiyin vana kon in,

Chorus
â€œChungnung penna Pa loupi hen,

songs.title: 202. ZION KHOPI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Zion khopi kajot lai hin,
Setna lem’in katou den tai;
Nang louvin leisetna hin ka kap-e Pakai,

Chorus
Mollep nung teng ka galdot le,
Ka ngaiye goldei khensate;
Kikhen louna Immanuel,
Khopi lhun ding chun einem’e.

Verse 2
Ka ka-na gam hi alen tai,
Leisetna hin vahvei kahi;
Immanuel thim gal alen neipui jingin,

Verse 3

Mun aum poi lungjin gam bou;
Aw itih ham lungdeite to lenkhomna ding,
Tonsot lhangvum ahi gimna gam beina ding.

songs.lyrics:

songs.title: 203. JORDAN LUIPI-GAL IKAIKHOM TENGLE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat.ml (Hosea 1:10)

Verse 1
Jordan luipi gal ikaikhom teng leh,

Luipi kam’a nel sim senlou bang ding,

Lui kama nel simsen lou bang ding ;

Luipi kama nel simsen lou jat hi ding.

Verse 2
Lei semtil’a pat’a lhatsate chu,
Lhepna lungdonna neita louvin ;
Van gam nom’a ikimuto khom diu,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hi ding.

Verse 3
Chu luipi hoi kam’a idin tengu,
Hin thinglim damnoiya ium diu ;
Canaan gamnom lam chu galdot jinga,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hi ding.

Verse 4
Eihuhhingpau le Aloupina chu,
Kichen tah-a imu tengu le ;
Lengin gam jousea vai ahom ding chu,
Hichu vetnom kidang tah hi ding.

songs.title: 203. KA NGAI TA-VE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nilhum ngailou Zion khopi,
Ngaiyin kamao kakap sun nitin’in;
Pon loupi sil’in lengun lhatsa te,
Kei dia jong mun umna chu gam’a chun.

Chorus
Ka-ngai tave, ka-ngai tave,
Amun loupi hoina jouse sangin;
Lungset Pa Lal Christa meldei um chu,
Mu kanom kalung kham banna dingin.

Verse 2
Ahoina sei joulou gam chu,
Thisanin ahong tai jalenna gam;
Ka lhagao chu gamnom chu hol’in lang,
Leiset gam hi chul kit tei ding ahi.

Verse 3
Lungdei Lhatdamte lenna mun,
Lhung thei lou kadip dam’e Lhandampu;
Nei silthengin Lhagaovin nei puiyin,

songs.title: 204. AVAHCHOI CHIM POUVE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen galvon lungsette chu,

Chorus

Vahchoina dah tum’un,

Bang theilou diu tonsot geiya,

Verse 3

Verse 4

Ken vahchoi chim talou ding.

songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. sl (John 14:2)

Verse 1
Chung gam loupi nop ding ngaiton,
Luipi pang chu vah jing jeng ahi ;
Mitheng ho ahoinau chul theilou,

Verse 3

songs.title: 204. LEISET LOUPI NA KAHOL LAIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1

Tun vang leiset thil nuse tang ting,

songs.lyrics:

Verse 3
Khopi hoi langkachah gam nom,
Lhung taleng luigal khopi chu;
Nunlui gam hin galdot inge,

songs.lyrics:

songs.title: 207. NISATJINGNAGAM AUM’E.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat (Psalms 133:3)

Verse 1
Nisat jingna gam aume,
A gam sung vah jing jeng ;
Itih chan’a ni lhum ngailou,
Avah a chu Jesu.

Chorus
Nun nem’a Cross iput le,
Lallukhuh isan ding ;
Mitheng lah-a ichen teng
Tonsot’a ivah jing ding.

songs.lyrics:

Vang bohna tamtah chu nalung don diu ham.

Verse 3
Set na leh lungdon nalung jin na pel in,
Insung Maicham sem in Pakai kou ute,
I thoh gim nao ho chu athon ahilou nadin,
Insung Maicham sem in Pakai hou ute.

songs.title: 210. AW HALLELUJAH.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Amin Calvary Sidar thing chunga,
Hinna twi theng along damhiu heuvin;
Calvary lhang Sidar lim noiya chun.
Aw Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Lal nunnem thisan lonna mun ahi;
Namtin thennan along thisan lui chu.

Verse 2
I-Lal nunnem kipana Pakai chu,
Gougal thi nin ahin lhung lungjin gui;
Lhagao Theng hungin lang salvah-in.

Verse 3
Vetau, i-Lal nunnem Calvary a,
Van Saron pah chulni nei ngailou Pa;
Saron pahhoi atoi Calvary a.

Verse 4
I-Pakai thohna analheh jenge,
Anu genthei Mary’n ave ngam poi;
Lhagao vahhoi hungun hung panpiuvin.

songs.title: 210. EGYPT A SOHCHANG KAJAM’UI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl

Verse 1
Egypt’a sohchang ka jamui,
Ka Pakaiyu thun ka nungung ;
Lhagao le Athun eipuiyun,
Canaan gam nom jon kahiuve.

Chorus
Gamtheng jon kholjin kahiuve,
Canaan gam nom jon kahiuve ;
Pathen puile jing kahiuve,
Lamkim geina lai kahiuve.

Verse 2
Gamthip go lai jot kahiuve,
Pakaiyin eipuidih jing diu ;
Ei umpiu het nan sun le mei,
Jan le meikongin eipuiyui.

Verse 3
Songpi kivo chun eihoiyun,
Ngaichat tah hin twi eipeuve ;
Van’a kon Manna eipeuve,
Lhagao gilkel eivah vauve.

Verse 4
Luipi gal ka kai tengu leh,
Akom’a um mithengte chun ;
Nomtah a eina lamto diu,
Pakai chenna Canaan gama.

songs.title: 210. ITI NOP TAM PATHEN LHAIPET
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Iti noptam Pathen lhaipet,
Leiset lungngai lung a beita,
I-ngai jouse kim in eipei,
Vanâ€™a Pa Laltouna konin,

Chorus
Satan galâ€™in lam eipel tai,
Ka taopetna Nang nahung le,
Ka lungdon lungjin pet jongle,
Kalung mon le kipaâ€™n aloi.

Verse 2
Iti noptam Pathen lhaipet,
Vantil kei dinga hungpa chun,
Ka taona Pathen ang- sungah,
Na lhaving in potou in lang,
Pan eilungsetna thu kajai,
A thupha dihtah chu kahei,
Kalung apumpin kapetai,
Hung kumlhan tun ka taopet hin.

Verse 3
Iti noptam Pathen lhaipet,
Nanga kona lungmon na thu,
Kalung sunga hin khum dim in,
Van innom kahung lhun kahsen,
Ka leiset vou kapai lhah a,
Kemlou van vou chu kachan teng;
Ka len thoa vanjol kagei teng,
Kalhai kalhai leiset tinge.

songs.title: 211. LUNGGELGILNA THENGTAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat sl
(Heb. 11:16)

Verse 1
Lunggel gilna theng tah,
Ka lung’ah alange ;
Kanai cheh tai in lam tunin,
Tu masanga sang chun.
In kanaiye, in kanaiye,
Kanai cheh tai in lam tunin ;
Tu masanga sang chun.

Verse 2
Kanai tai Pa in,
Umna mun nom tamna ;
Laltouna bang chu kanai tai,
Tonsot hinna van gam.

Verse 3
Pohgih genthei beina,
Hinna gam kanai tai ;
Cross dalha lallukhuh sang ding,
Kon ka hitai keima.

Verse 4
Kalam jot nei lhonpin,
Nei phongin kalhuh teng ;
Tunia kon kalhunna ding in,
Naiyin ka kingaitoi.

songs.title: 211. PATHEN NANGMA LHAIDIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen Nangma lhaidin,
Kakai khom kit tauve,
Nei nungsun lou jen un Pathen,
Ka chonset jeng vangun.

Verse 2
Ka chonset apum pin,
Kahinpoi na heng ah,
Na ngaidam dingle soptheng din,
Nakom kahin belâ€™e.

Verse 3
Ka chonset simthei lou,
Sapset thei kahiuve,
Hi jongle Nangma milungset,
Hatjon sumang soh-in.

Verse 4
Hijeh chun katao nau,
Ngai in lungtheng hom in,
Leiset lung ngai sumang soh-in,
Chonphat lung nei peuvin.

Verse 5
Pathen hou thanom chu,
Vangpha le nom chungnung,
Athi teng vanâ€™a cheng jing ding,
Van Mitheng nom laiya.

songs.title: 211. VAN GAM IKINEPNAU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Calvary lhang lungsetna,
Hiljou thei ding ahipoi;
Tonsot’a mantih neilou ding,
Vahchoi cheh ding ahiye.

Verse 2
Vanchung la dinga chu hiche,
Angeipen tah hita ding;
Lhandampu Jesu ang’a chun,
Hiche mai chu isah diu.

Verse 3
I-Pu Jesu thisan phatna,
Eihuhdoh set lah-a kon;
Satan khutna ithi sangin,
Eipuitou ding van gam’a.

Verse 4
Ipi ipute jouse jong,
Van chunga imukit ding;
I-Pu Jesu min tahsanse,
Ikigop diu iboncha.

Verse 5
Van chung gam chu iti nop tam,
Hiljou thei ding ahipoi.
Hetphah loubehte ho jong chu,
Atho kit ding van gam’a.

songs.title: 212. JESUNATHU KANGAITO LE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (I Pet.2:7)

Verse 1
Jesu nathu ka ngaito le,
Kalung lhaita ngeiye ;
Namel ngai um kamu phat teng,
Ka kipa chung chon ding.

Verse 2
Leiset O ngei jouse jong hi,
Ngainom ka umsah poi ;
Mihem huhhingpa na min bou,
O gin ngeipen ahi.

Verse 3
Kisih cheng kinepna nahi,
Genthei cheng nopna jong ;
Alhusa cheng la nakho ton,
Nang hinhol jouse jong.

Verse 4
Nang mu cheng hi akipa jeu,
Thun aseijou thei poi ;
Jesu Nang ngailutje vang hi,
Amu hon miljou lou.

Verse 5
Jesu ka kipana pen’u,
Lei le van chunga jong ;
Kason pen’u hijing jengin,
Tonsot mun geiyin jong

songs.title: 212. KIPANA LUIPANG KALHUN TENGLE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nitin kakom’a umjingin lang Pakai,
Kei jong Nang kom’a umchim ponge;
Ka ngai nin choldo na gam neimu sah-in,
Vahchoi nange lungjin meipi noiya hin.

Chorus
Kipana luipang kalhun tengle,
Lunghel’a ka kikhenpi sate;
Pakai Lal mel lemsa chu vahchoiyin,
Chu-a van peogal pah banga chullou ding.

Verse 2
Akembai tangei i-hinlai nikho hi,
Aw Calvary hung thah kit’in lang;
Vahchoinan la sange napahhoi lemnan,
Kipah-in gam theng chu hinve kit nange.

Verse 3
Til’a kipanan peogal salvah jongle,
Calvary-a kho avahkit tai;
Zion gam nom’a vah ahong tai tiuvin,
Thouvun jalenna kolni a emsel tai.

Verse 4
Tuhin lung kitoh-in lengkhom jongleu hen,
Lunghel ni-a goldei ka ngaite;
Pakai ang’a kipa la isahkhom diu,
Kageldoh ni hin aw ka ngaita ngeiye.

songs.title: 212. PAKAI CHU KALUM LE KAPHO
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai chu kalum le kapho ahi setgal kajona,
Lhasam louvin che jing jeng uhite tahsan chate ho,
Calvary ngailutna athisan long chun,
I-chonset jouseu angaidam sohtai.

Chorus
Keima neisol in keima cheng kate,
Lan sachoi leng e, phat kanei sun in,
Dou ding melma I jat in tam jongle,
Che jing ding kahi nagam kalhun man.

Verse 2
Pakai chu eiho lamâ€™a apan le i-ham igin diu,
Jona ponlap chu domsang uhite lhagao chemjam chu,
Kipaman san ding nikho anai anaitai
Chuche nikho chu nikho loupi pen.

Verse 3
I hinkho hoilai Pakaija dingin kiphal theng ute,
Dettah in pang uhite Pakaiya machalna dingin,
I insung damlai nikho chomcha bou,
I neitai sopi hung kipan loiyin.

songs.title: 213. JESUS I COME.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka sohchan genthei muthim’a,
Kei kahung’e Pakai Jesu;
Nomlenna kipana a chun,
Kei ka hung’e Jesu;
Ka natna konin nadam sah din,
Ka chonsetna konin nahenga,
Ka hunge ka Pakai.

Verse 2
Na Cross vanga hamphatna konin,
Ka hunge ka Pakai Jesu;
Naphat chomna nathingpel vang chun,
Ka hunge ka Pakai;
Hinlai khopihui nunna konin,
Nei chul nam ding le huhhing dingin,
Ka hunge ka Pakai.

Verse 3
Cholngahna neilou hoitho a konin,
Ka Pakai Jesu ka hunge;
Nangma nunnem laiya cheng dingin,
Ka Pakai ka hunge;
Na ngailut indan sunga cheng din,
Amangsa chunga thoukit dingin;
Chung gam jonin vakhu leng bangin,
Ka hunge ka Pakai.

Verse 4
Kichatna tah lhankhuh a konin,
Ka Pakai Jesu ka hunge;
Kipa thanopna van in a din,
Ka Pakai ka hunge;
Sei theilou manna kokhuh a hin,
Lungmonna nahong sunga dingin;
Tonsotna loupina ve dingin,
Ka hunge ka Pakai.

songs.title: 213. KOTKHAH LEN CHU HON’IN AUM.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. s. (Rev.21:26)

Verse 1
Kotkhah len chu honin aum,
Kotkhah loupi hoitah chu ;
Kei dinga hon’a um ahi,
Lhandampu lungset jal’a

Chorus
O lungsetna loupi tah chu,
Kot chu koi dinga na hon em ?
Kei ding ….. kei ding,
Kei dinga na hon nem !.

Verse 2
Lhatdamna a konin kot chu,
Mijouse din hon ahi ;
Ahao, avai, alen, aneo,
Nam jouse dinga ahi.

Verse 3
Na dougal’u hat jeng jongle,
Manouvin kot hon pet hin ;
Cross in lallukhuh chu lo’uvin,
Tonsot thutep molso na.

Verse 4
Leiset’a Cross pu jongleu hen,
Luigal’a itol koi ding ;
Hinna lallukhuh isan diu,
Van’a ngailutna pung ding.

songs.title: 213. TAHSAN CHATE PAKAI JIN EIKOU VUI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tahsan chate Pakai jin eikou vui,
Kouna aw chu ngai phau hitin,
Christa Lenggam tung doh ding in,
Thina thimnoiya touho puidin,
Kon uhite ana tong din.
Hung uvin kipan ute galsat dingin,
Lhagao chemjam pan in malam noute,
Christa sepia nung chon louvin,
Thina thimnoiya tou ho puidin,
Kon uhite ana tong din.

Verse 2
Vo khangdong ho Pakai in eikou ui,
Lung kitoh in pang khom u tin,
Kipana Thupha lhang sam din,
Nang jong Pakaiyin na kou jinge,
Ana tong din hung kipan tan.

Verse 3
Kei kaumâ€™e ka Pakai neisol in,
Kei cheng kate nana tong din,
A niseh a cross kaput in,
Hinjui nang e Pakai na lampi,
Na gam ka hung lhun masang sen.

songs.title: 214. CHUNG VANMUN NOM’AKHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Rev.5:13)

Verse 1
Chung van mun noma khun lhatsa ten la san,
Alallukhuh Alengpau anga koiyun ;
Leiset lungdon lungjinna akhel tauve,
Mitheng lhatsa ten kipa la asauve.

Chorus
Jesu vahchoiyun,
Malaiya Calvarya thi chu ;
Jesu vahchoiyun,
Tonsot geiya dia hing kit chu.

Verse 2
Ngailutna la kidang tah chu akim tai,
Atahsan din thao namtui tah abange ;
Chonset jal’a thi Pakai thokit vangin,
Vai ihom diu Pakai toh atonsot’a.

Verse 3
Kelngoinou thisan a kisil ngim lou chu,
Chu lathah chu koima chan sah thei lou ding ;
Setna kon Eilhatpauvin eisil ngim tai,
Tun kipa la loupi sa pantau hite.

songs.title: 214. PAKAIYIN UMPIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lung lhaisel’in Pakai kalennau lhang chunga,
Calvary hin twi kadon pite chu;
Chom louva ilennau lhang lamdang ding chu.
Nache na tonglam sao jongle olmo hih-in,
Galjou i-Pakaiyin pui ding nang;
Damsel chan ngai chullou chen,
Pakaiyin umpin.

Verse 2
O nache lai ni chu Cross chu bang jongle,
Van Lhagao Thengin pui jingin lang;
Lungdonna meipi le gallen sem hoh-in.

Verse 3
Leiya golngai kikhen Zion lhanghoi chunga,
Tahsanin ilengkhom’ui lung lhaisel’in;
Hinthing pah le i-Pakai lhalim noiya.

songs.title: 214. PATHEN NANGMA HOUBUNG MITE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen nangma Houbung mite,
Lungset in phatthei na pen,
Namai vah chun salvah soh in,
Ka lah u va kilang hen.

Chorus
Chutile vannoi leiset miâ€™n
Muntin nangma Thupha theng hi,
Vannoi namtin le phung tin in,
Gam jousen hinna tante.

Verse 2
Vo Pathen Nangma vahchoi la,
A mihem jousen sauhen,
Mi asangja aw gin thong chun,
Vannoi leiset losoh hen.
Mi sutheng thei na hi nangma,
Nagam loupi chu hinlah in,
Vannoi leiset gam kimvella
Chonsetna son mang soh in.

Verse 3
Vo Pathen kataona sangin,
Van Lhagao theng hinsol in,
Nagam kachalsah nadiuvin,
Houbung mite tha hinpen.
Pathen phattheina neipeuvin,
Niseh in nei kithopiuvin,
Chuteng vannoi leiset miten,
Na loupi hetau vinte

songs.title: 215. KIKHENNNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat chomcha inei tauve,
Goldei ilenkhom nadiu;
Leiset genthei lunghelna chu,
Keiho nei hin ngailou jenin;
Tonsot gam lhun ding kinem’in.
Lungdei golte kipah-in chen,
Damsel’in o Mangpha;
Kigalvonin mei le thisan,
Lal Immanuel gam um danin.

Verse 2
Lunghel tincheng thoh khom’a,
Ngai chullou khenpi sate;
Chungto nisa hung nem’in lang,
Lhepna meipi hung jing jongle,
Alampiu Pakai salvah-in.

Verse 3
Zion thusim seikhom din,
Ilennau dang jeng jongle;
Hinna vah emsel mun’a chun,
Mitheng ho le vantil theng to;
Tonsotna kileng khomta ding.

songs.title: 215. LHEPNA ALUTHIH-IN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. Duet S & A. (Rev. 2:7)

Verse 1
Lhepna a lut hih-in chonsetna ahi,
Najo na chun midang jong aloi lut ding ;
Hang tah-in malam non muthim galkaiyin,
Sang jingin Christa chu Aman nahuh ding.

Chorus
Nahu din Christa ngeh-in,
Pen nate lungmon tha hat ;
Aman nang nahuh nom’e,
Aman nang nahuh ding.

Verse 2
Nungsun in gol phalou kivoppi hih-in,
Pathen mintheng chu lutah-in panin lang ;
Lunggel hat’in gun chun mi hepi pon thon,
Sang jingin Christa chu Aman nahuh ding.

Verse 3
Adinga doujou chu lallukhuh apei,
Thisan’a ijo diu lhu lhoi jongleu hen ;
Eihuhhingpau Jesun thahat aneiye,
Sang jingin Christa chu Aman nahuh ding.

songs.title: 215. TONSOT SONGPI KADINGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tonsot songpi kadinga,
Khiâ€™a chun Nanga neisel in,
Nanah thenga hung long doh,
Longlha thisan le twi chun,
Ka chonset neisop thengin,
Nei huhhing in keima tun.

Verse 2
Kakhut in natong jong leng,
Ka mitlhi long jeng jongleh,
Lung nunin gunchu jong leng,
Nangma chondan thupeh chu,
Keiman jui kim jou lou ding,
Ka chonset theng theilou ding.

Verse 3
Ima kahin choipoi ken,
Cross jenga chu kingaija,
Ponsil lou ponsil dinga,
Nangma kom hinbel kahi,
Nei hihhingin lengvai kei,
Chonset a thi ding kahi.

Verse 4
Hiche lung kagel laihin,
Thinan kamit asin a,
Hi leiset kagal kaija,
Na thupi tan kamu teng,
Tonsot songpiâ€™n neihuh in,
Neisel in nei huhhingin.

songs.title: 216. KUMLUI LE KUMTHAH LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Achul tasa kum le inunlui chu,
Gel bang kem mangjin janmol lem jita;
Toigo bang donthah a hoikit theilou,
Cham theilou ding ngaiyin kou jongleu hen.

Verse 2
Chung chollha le len kolni abang’e,
I-nop lai le i-ngui lai jan ho chu;
Lui gal’a bou i-to kit diu ahi,
Alem jou tai nunglam hei kit lou din.

Verse 3
Hinla kumthah sempa got loupi chu,
Ahung lhung tai malam ahin jonin;
Ihmu thouvun kolninou asoh tai,
Jalen nopna pahhoi eimu sah-ui.

Verse 4
Ka lem’ui kumlui ponbang thah kit chu,
Nop le kipa la’n jaiyin oiyung’e;
I-lennau lei chung twi bangin nem hen,
Phat lui jouvin kipa eimu sah-ui.

songs.title: 216. LUIGAL GAMNOM’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. Duet S & T & Chorus. (Rev.5:13)

Verse 1
Luigal gam nom a mai kamu hon,
Jing banga hoi le ni bang vah-in,
Lhaset, lungkham, lungdon beisoh-in,
Eiveuvin eigaldot jing jengui.

Chorus
Hilam veuvin eigaldot jingui,
Ngaiten eigaldot eingah jingui ;
Jing banga hoi le ni bang em’in,
Lungdei hon van’ah eingah jingui.

Verse 2
Van gam nom a cheng nu le pa ten,
Acha ngaiteu cheng tol galkai din ;
Kongtol miho kong lhun kal ngahlel,
Angah jingui kong kaimun a chun.

Verse 3
Sopi ngai cheng chua che jouta,
Ache ding midang ho chu ngah-in ;
Van mite banga pon bang silhon,
Noiya kon mi che ding angah-ui.

Verse 4
Van in nom lhungsa chapang ngaiten,
“Hungun” tin eijap jingui veuvin ;
Ni guiya em le dai bang chimin,
Anu, nangma na galdot jingui.

Verse 5
Huhhingpa Jesu jing Valpa chun,
Mihem mangsa chu aholdoh lei ;
Eikounau kipa um chu ngaiyun,
“Hungin chonse mangsa” ati chu.

songs.title: 216. THILSEM JULE VA JENG IN BON
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thilsem jule va jeng in bon,
Avahchoi yule Pakai keiman,
Iti vahchoi louva ka um ding ham?
Ka aw neisun mang chang kate.

Chorus
Pakai naloupi e Lhandampu,
Nasemsa lei mihem te hi,
Iti vahchoi louva ka um ding ham?
Pakai ka hinna Nang nahi.

Verse 2
Thilsem khaokho khongbai ju le va jengin bon,
A vahchoi yule Pakai keiman,
Iti vahchoi louva ka um ding ham?
Pakai ka hinna Nang nahi.

Verse 3
Thilsem thing le go twi jeng in bon,
A vahchoi yule Pakai keiman,
Iti vahchoi louva ka um ding ham,
Pakai ka hinna Nang nahi.

songs.title: 217. JESU NEI HINNA NOM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesu nei hinna nom, kipa na thuguh chu,
Ka Lhagao monna eipei, Jesu neibou kipana.
Jesu nei chihna bulpi,
Jesu nei haona bukim,
Jesu chu vannoi toh kikhen na.

Verse 2
Jesu ka neihi seichoi lenge vannoi yah,
Tahsan nan kamu chentai, athina mel cross chunga.

Verse 3
Jesu nei hinna nom, mihao ten neijou lou,
Miching hon ahe thempoi, koijeh a dangchah hintem.

Verse 4
Van Canaan ka In ding, leiset kakhol jin na,
Aigupta ahah taloi, ka Lal Jesu neipui yin.

songs.title: 217. KIGING PHAU HITE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hinlai sungin kiging phaute,
Set le manna lah-a hin;
Ajou le Canan gam nom’a,
Goldeite to lengkhom taute.

Chorus
Aw leisetna lalte chu,
Tonsot gam lhung thei lou ding;
Luigal’a hinna Lallukhuh chu,
Aw tonggim chaten khuh tauvinte.

Verse 2
Ka ngai ngeiye Immanuel,
Lei lungdon gam thim’a hin;
Mei lah-a Nahung kitni le,
Kalei lungdonna bei tante.

Verse 3
Tonggimte le pohgihte chu,
Luigal’a achol ngauve;
Olle Canan gam nom’a chun,
Goldeite to lengkhom taute.

Verse 4
Tonna Eden hon thenga chun,
Adam le Eve chu o;
Sei ngai louvin aum lhon’in,
Set gentheinan alha lhon tai.

songs.title: 217. VAN’AKAIN NOM EM’ACHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Rev.2:7)

Verse 1
Van’a ka in nom em’a chun,
Thi le lengvai lungdon lutlou ;
Akul nisa sanga vahjo,
Hi gam nom chu keima in ding.

Chorus
Chua chun chenge, chua chun chenge,
Thi louna gam nom hoiya chun ;
Thi louna gama chun chenge,
Tonsot hin jingna gama chun.

Verse 2
Van chunga gam nom hoiya chun,
Eilungset ka-Pa Pathen cheng ;
Lunghel beina van gam jonin,
Leiset dalhang ting kei chenge.

Verse 3
Miten hol hen hao le minthan,
Hichu mangkit thei leiset’a ;
Heu hen Ka-Pa laltouna ang,
Tonsot nomsa keima chenna.

songs.title: 218. ANA NGEIYE PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu chu akaiyun amelmate chun,
Calvary lhang’a;
Alua linglukhuh pum’in Cross kiput sah-un,
Cross chunga chun akhenbeh-ui.

Chorus
Ana ngeiye,
Aw i-Pakai thohna chu;
Na thisan long chun,
Chonse keima eilhatdoh tai.

Verse 2
Nisa jong vah ngamlouvin amai asel’in,
Thimpi ajing’e;
Leiset in thohjou louvin lingpi kihot’in,
Laiya songpi akeh gam tai.

Verse 3
Iti kidan’a hitam ka Pakai thinin,
O an Lengpa chu;
Asemsa van le lei jong akithing soh-in,
Aw vankho jong angui jeng tai.

Verse 4
Lungin jong kamil thei poi, ka Pakai thina,
Calvary lhang hoi;
Mitin’in nalhatdamna amu theina din,
Na tonsot kho hungvah loi hen.

songs.title: 218. CHENA VANA HOIMA JOUSEA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chena vana hoima jousea,
Pathen in eipui le jing nai,
Lunggel le natohna jouse a,
Pathen in eipui le jing nai,

Chorus
Pathen in eipui le jing nai,
Ama khut tah in eikai lei,
Aseijui tahsan kichen tah
Hiâ€™nge eipui le jing jeh in.

Verse 2
Lungjin lungdon nat thoh lelna,
Genthei nan eibom jeng jongle,
A van thupha hinna thu chun,
Eipui len eilhem lung monge.

Verse 3
Hahsa toh ing nom toh jong leng,
Twihat le twinem pal jong leng,
Eden hon nom a leng jong leng,
Pathen in eipui le jing nai.

Verse 4
Kathi teng keima Pathen in,
Jordan lui eipui galkai ding,
Van innomâ€™a cheng jing tange,
Olmo lou Aman eipuinai.

songs.title: 218. LEIYA IGOLNGAI TOH KIPAH-IN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. sl
(Isaiah 35:10)

Verse 1
Leiya igol ngai toh kipah-in,
Chomkhat ium khomin ;
Chule lunghel’a kikhenna chu,
Ahung lhung loiji tai.

Chorus
Vana kikhen kit umlou ding,
Kikhen kitta lou ding ;
Kipa jingna gam nom’a chun,
Kikhen kitta lou ding.

Verse 2
Thina luigal kaisa ngaite toh,
Kimu to din einem ;
Leiya toh gim ichaisoh tengle,
I chenkhom jing diu chu.

Verse 3
Kikhenpi sa i-ngai cheng chutoh,
Thina luigal kai teng ;
Kikhen kit tih neita lou hel’a,
Nom tah a chenkhom ding.

Verse 4
Kikhen kit thu kisei talou ding,
Van in nom hoiya chun ;
Kipa nopna lungmon tonsot’a,
La kisa jing ta ding.

songs.title: 219. HINNA TWI ALONGE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka lenna gamthip hin dalhan,
Van Jerusalem thah nom’a;
Itih le kei jong kalhung dem?
Na tonsot gam in nom’a.

Chorus
O ka ngai kikhen louna van in nom’a,
Hinna twi alonge;
Lhatdam chaten adon’un,
Kum khoa hinna changta.

Verse 2
Kelngoite lenna mun loupi,
Ngaiyin nitin’in kamaove;
Aw Lhagao Theng hung lenglhan lang,
Na gam’a neipui lut’in.

Verse 3
Kotpi gin ngei chu ahongun,
Agin ngei chun kalung aleng;
Mitheng jouse lenna gam’a o,
Kei jong len ding kanom.

Verse 4
Chu mun’a chun Pakai deitah,
Amel nisa em banga em;
A-em chun kei eisalvah sel’e,
Kum khoa damna dingin.

songs.title: 219. KA PATHEN NANGMA KOM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Pathen nangma kom kahung naije,
Gim genthei lungdonna toh jeng jong leng,
Navahchoi la sange,na kom kahung naije,
Ka Pathen nangma kom kahung naiye.

Verse 2
Kho jinghen thim jongle neilhon pin lang,
Vah hen thim jeng jong le nei puilhung in,
Katah in kamang in, na kom nai kanomme,
Na kom cheh a Pathen kahung naiye.

Verse 3
Van jotna van lampi hin lhung lhan lang,
Van kalbi hin lah in nei lungset in,
Na vantil hinsol lhan, eipui lhung pai dingin,
Ka Pathen nangma kom kahung naiye.

Verse 4
Lung jin a kon kathoa ka lung halting,
Pathen nang vahchoi la keiman sange,
Kahunge nei sangin, neilan neichul nam in,
Ka Pathen nangma kom kahung naiye.

Verse 5
Len theina ving neijing kipahtah in,
Nisa sanga sang jon leng sang jong leng,
Hiche la hi mang mon, navahchoi nan sange
Ka Pathen nangma kom kahung naiye.

songs.title: 219. NEH LHINNA GAM CHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. S. (Deut. 33:28)

Verse 1
Neh lhinna gam chu kalhung tai,
Ahaona jouse chu keiya ;
Agam vah jing phattheina chu,
Kana jan muthim beisohta.
Gam nom hoitah, gam nom chungnung,
Na molsang chunga ka dinge ;
Twikhanglen gal lam ka dot le,
Ka dinga in nom gotsa chu ;
Aloupi vah jing chu kamui,
Ka van tonsot in nom hoi chu.

Verse 2
Huhhing Jesun eilhonpi lei,
Loinom laiya lha ka hitai ;
Aman damheo chan eikai lei,
Van gam kai kimvel sunga hin.

Verse 3
Huilhi namtui nung chu hinna,
Athingna jouse chu damna ;
Pahhoi namtui pah chul ngailou,
Tonsot hintwi long kang ngailou.

Verse 4
Ponbang vamleh cheh a kivon,
Lhatdam janel chung van gam mi ;
Huhhingpa la ngei long del’in,
Vantil sangja toh asauve.

songs.title: 220. CHUNG GAM NILHUM LOUNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chung gam nilhum louna sun nivah ngailouna,
Pakai vaihom na a khat vei kileng khom ding,
Kanglou twi veina gam nomâ€™a ilhun teng le,
Lhagao va ivon kikhel soh ding.
Kisem phan lang ki ging jing un,
Nungah som thulem bang louvin,
Sumkon sangsom sangja,
Hung ging ding anaitai,
Sumkon in nakouve Van laiya.

Verse 2
Pakaiyin nang dinga chen na Innom semta,
Deimo a nopchon na insung deiya nahim?
Na Pakai in hoiya umding a nadei em?
Hung in na Pakai kom Muntheng a.

Verse 3
Nopchon tohga manbei meidil a govam ding,
Mi chonpha tohga chu Intheng kilhut soh ding,
Nopchon tohga nanei sumkon in akoupoi,
Dalhan hung in na chonset jouse.

songs.title: 220. GLORY FOR ME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. sl
(I John 3:2)

Verse 1
Ka thohgim leiset thunoh kachai teng,
Bit keiya kei vangam nom lhungta ding ;
Ka ngaitah ka-Pakai koma cheng ding,
Tonsot khang geiya loupina hi ding.

Chorus
Hichu ka loupina hi ding,
Loupina ding, loupina ding ;
Alungset vanga Amai kamu teng,
Hichu ka dinga loupina hi ding.

Verse 2
Eiholna kemlou lungset kamu teng,
Van mun nom loupi kachan ding keima ;
Amai vejinga mu jing ding keima,
Tonsot khang geiya loupina hiding.

Verse 3
Che masa golngai cheng kamusoh ding,
Kipa le thanopna twilong bang ding ;
Pakai yin nuiheova eilamto ding,
Tonsot mun geiya jong.

songs.title: 220. PHAT CHESA KOU KIT THEILOU
221. BIBLE THUDIH AHI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Bible thudih ahi (2)
Lungset na kot kihon sung hin;
Hunglut in gam thenga (3) D.C

Verse 2
Dan suse mi sugam
Pa thu kipe ahi,
Ahung lhungtai lhenchom te lah;
Genthei lhiso ka na (3) D.C

Verse 3
Phat ni tin in akem
Hinkho jong nitin kem;
Christa to nomâ€™a lenna din,
Ka hinkho lhing loi hen (3) D.C

songs.title: 221. NISA LHUMNA KALCHUNG PEH-A.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. d. (John 14:3)

Verse 1
Nisa lhumna kal chung peh-a,
Meivom kaina khel’a ;
Ahsi kaina chung peh-a khu,
A ume ka in nom.

Chorus
Khut’a sahlou van in nom chu,
Gotsa um kei dinga ;
Pathen le mitheng chenna chu,
Hichu ka in ahi.

Verse 2
Thile nat thohgim beina a,
Hinkho kem kitta lou ;
Phat kikhel kitlouna a chun,
Ka in ding gotsa um.

Verse 3
Thi le lungjin lungdon beina,
Khojin muthim beina ;
Kamui kallung kipah-in ken,
