Chung khovah in nom chu.

Verse 4
Chonset genthei lungdon hesoh,
Lhang ting lesol tange ;
Kaltou tange van tonsot in,
Jesu chenna a chun.

songs.title: 221. WHEN WE DIE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hallelujah Pakai, Hallelujah Amen,
Hung manginte lei kipana;
Lhepna natna ahijeh in,
Kinung hei kitlou jen’ute.

Chorus
Hugun ka sopi ngaite,
Kinung hei kitlou jen’ute;
I-hinkhou alhin teng chule,
Leiset kidalha ding.

Verse 2
Hungun gol le paite, gamnom chu jon’ute,
Lei lungjin nan eibop tengle;
Leiset hinkho molloi jita,
Kinunghei kit lou jen’ute.

Verse 3
Lei le van’a chungnung Pathen ahi,
Lunglha louvin vahchoiyute;
Tun gentheina toh jongleu hen,
Khonung nopna, tonsot nopna.

Verse 4
Lungset kagolte ho, vahchoi cheh uhite,
Sim le mal’a gol le paite;
Lhangsam’ute, Hinna Thupha,
Mijouse kisan cheh dingin.

songs.title: 222. KAKIPAH E VANâ€™A KAPA AUM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kakipah e vanâ€™a ka- Pa aum,
Athupha lungmonna thu eihil e,
Athupha bua thu kidang tah kamui;
Hibang thupha Jesun eilungsetna.

Chorus
Kakipah e Jesun eilungset,
Kei eilungset, kei eilungset,
Kakipah e Jesun eilungset,
Kei jong eilungset e.

Verse 2
Ken Ama sumil ing lamvai jong leng,
Mangta jong leng Aman eilungset e,
Aman eilungset ken kageldoh teng,
Kalut kit jitai ama khut sunga.

Verse 3
Keiman langei khat ana sathei leng,
Leng loupi chungnung mel kamu nile,
Hichu hi ding katonsot chulmo la,
Jesun eilungset akidange.

Verse 4
Kichen tah a lung monga kahitai,
Jesu tahsan a nomsa kahitai,
Kalunga kon satan ajam jitai,
Jesun eilungset keiman kasei teng

songs.title: 222. VAN KHOPI VANTIL SANGJA LENNA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Van khopi vantil sangja lenna,
Chua lhatdam changte jong cheng ding ;
Lunghel lungdon kana beita ding,
Chu van khopi lhun kal kangah lel.

Chorus
Vo Eden…..khopi thah,
Eden lui….. sanga nom ;
Chua tonsot nomna kemta lou,
Pakai sem khopi thah ka ngaiye.

Verse 2
Chung van khopi nom tol sunga chu,
Hi leiset idalhah tengu leh ;
Mitheng ache masa ngai cheng toh,
Chung Pathen koma ichenkhom diu.

Verse 3
Chua chun mitheng sangja aleng,
Van mithengte jouse jong chu cheng ;
Lhenchom chapang thengte jouse chun,
Laltouna kimvel’in asauve.

Verse 4
Van khopi sung chu sana emsoh,
Van gam vah chu Kelngoinou ahi ;
Vantil ho le lhatsa mitheng te,
Van kho nom a mukal ka ngahlel.

songs.title: 222. WHEN LIFE’S TEMPEST IS OVER.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Paogal gam nom le ka Pakai,
Lungset hung lang ding chu;
Galdot jing ding lhepna huipi,
Leiset thim lah-a hin.

Chorus
Ajou le lhepna meipi le,
Thimjin abei phat le;
Kilang jeng ding angailutna,
Kipa hin twi khuh chu.

Verse 2
Leiset thunoh jouse dalhan,
Lungset Pakai dei um;
Lem ka ngahlel kipa chullou,
Van ngei sah kal.

Verse 3
Leiset thunoh lah-a Pakai,
Nalungset min loupi;
Vahchoi kim joulou Lhandampu,
Kasetnan eidal’e.

songs.title: 223. KILHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhang adang lung ahelta ngei,
Khennan golte mol alep tai;
Ichan cheh-a lung lhaisel’in,
Pakaiyin hihen tin eitem.

Chorus
Damsel chan o sopite ho,
Abangkhat vang molkal tante;
I-kimu kit phat tengule,
O goldeite kim taponte.

Verse 2
Lung khat cheh in ilengnan jong,
I-kikhennau phat alhing tai;
Na khankho le nathil bol ho,
Lha ngeitah in kei hon kamui.

Verse 3
Tahsan lung khat in lengleu hen,
Leng gam loupi gamthah chang din;
Zion pah i-kijep nadiu,
Tonsot khopi gam i-lo diu.

Verse 4
Phat chun eituhda cheh hen lang,
Leng khopi tol gal monna chu;
Calvary lungsetna jal’in,
Chitin namtinte lenkhomna.

songs.title: 223. KIPAH UN PATHENA NOMUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kipah un Pathena nomun,
Lung thengsel Mithengte jouse;
Pathen chu gingun tahsan un,
Genthei gim lungdon pailhau vin.

Chorus
Nomun â€¦â€¦ Nomun,
Kipah un Pathenâ€™a nomun;
Nomun â€¦â€¦ Nomun,
Kipah un Pathena nomun.

Verse 2
Nomun Ama Pakai ahi,
Vannoi leiset le van chunga;
Aman gam thum vaipi apoi,
Eihuhhing hatchungnung ahi.

Verse 3
Muthim in nang khu jong le chun,
Jan a vanpi nim bang jong le;
Ima lungdonna nei lou in,
Pathen jenga tahsan jingun.

Verse 4
Kipah un Pathen a nomun,
A vahchoina la ngei sauvin;
Sauvin na aw sansah un lang,
Ao un Hallelujah tiuvin.

songs.title: 223. LA TAH-AKHOPI HUI NUNG GAL’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. m (Isaiah 35:10)

Verse 1
La tah-a khopi hui nung gal’a,
Thimpi ajing ;
Tonsot kipana vah alange,
Sun sangin avah joi.

Chorus
Chua lungdon nat, kikhen kit,
Um talou hel ding ;
Chu luigal a ngaicheng kimsoh ding,
Chu a ichenkhom diu.

Verse 2
La tah-a twipi nong gal lam’a,
Ngaite kaita ;
Ngaite sei sana khopi hoi chu,
Loupia ilhun cheh diu.

Verse 3
La tah-a phaicham gal lam’a khun,
Kinepna um ;
Eiho jong ama ho umna a,
Ikikhop kimsoh diu.

Verse 4
O numnom le kipa lenna a,
O ni loupi ;
Chua genthei mitlhi long jouse,
Jesun theh hulta ding.

songs.title: 224. GAMNOM HOITAH AUM.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.m.

Verse 1
Gam nom hoitah aum, gamla tah a,
Mithengte chenna chu, sun sanga vah.
Anop ahoi chungnung,
Huhhinga Jesu chenna ;
Pakai vahchoina la kemmoa kisa.

Verse 2
Sopi ngaite hungun, gam nom jon din,
Hung geisang lou jenun, tahsan lel bei.
Tonsotna nop jingna,
Chonset gim genthei beina ;
Pakai lungset tanglou nop kem talou.

Verse 3
Mi mai emsel sohta, chu gama chun,
Pathenin ching jinga, lungmon kimta.
Agam achan soh-a,
Gou chunga mitheng chen teng ;
Nisa sanga vahjo, gam mi hi ding.

Verse 4
Hungun sopi ngaite, gam nom jon din,
Pakai in nom sem’a cheng din cheute.
Chua thina beita,
Ka na lhiso na beita ;
Nat gim thohlel beita, nop kem talou

songs.title: 224. HINNA TWIKHUH CHU AHONG TAI.
224. LAL LUNGLHAI KUM KIPA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lal lunglhai kum kipa phat chu,
Tu hin a lhung kit tai,
Gache hen Bethlehem kho pamâ€™a,
Van mite In sah na.

Chorus
O nang Bethlehem iti kangai hitam?
Na lhang chunga lamkai ahsi em chu,
Kap in kahin hol peh e,
Pakai penna mi isah lou gam.

Verse 2
Ngailou um intem chu mun chu,
Pakai penna mun chu,
Caesar lengchan lai ni phalouva chun,
Ka Lal nao bang akap.

Verse 3
Gave tem un Vantil Thengten,
Na deiyu Lal Jesu;
A hung penge genthei chate dingin,
Pah banga ilem diu.

Verse 4
Cham ta diuvin kelngoi ching ho,
Lungset munâ€™a um un,
Lungdon louna ahsi kal gam nomâ€™a,
Chu a ichen khom diu.

songs.title: 225. BONG IN LE CALVARY.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eihil jou thei ding hi mi um’in tem?
Sun le janin mi tam ka nadongin;
Hil them le he chu tamtah aum,
Hi jongle seijou thei chu aum poi.

Chorus
Van Lhagao Theng nangin, nei hung hil’in,
Apenna bong in le athina Calvary;
Lei mihem lungmol hon, Joar eilhut pa hi,
Seijou thei aum poi hinna kho lhum geiyin.

Verse 2
Bethlehem’a bong thing khat akeh-in,
Solam mi le Kelngoi ching lamkai chu;
Ahsi len kei jong nei hung puiyin,
Mu kanom van Lal cha ajalna chu.

Verse 3
Apen’in Herod gal hung hatnin,
Tha dingin Juda hon vai ahom’ui;
Ka set man sa dingin ka Pakai,
Setnin athisah un khopi pam’a.

Verse 4
Ami jousen vetcheh atup Lal chu,
Jerusalem nunao ho din mun’a;
Sapsetna thingpel’a akhaiyun,
Lunghem lhilong lou thei chu ahipoi.

songs.title: 225. CHOLNGAHNA GAMNOM KA NGAI CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. d. (Jer.31:16)

Verse 1
Cholngah na gam nom ka ngai chu,
Itih ahung lhung dem ;
Itih ka galvon kakoiyin,
In nom’ah ka cheng dem.

Chorus
Na tong jingu hite,
Jesu hung kit kahsen ;
Tongun Jesu hung teng,
Van in a kikhom ding.

Verse 2
Leiya hin nopna aumpoi,
Hinna damna olna ;
Lei hi kei din gamthip ahi,
Lei hi ka in hilou.

Verse 3
Keima Jesu hengah ka chen,
Cholnga tan eina ti ;
Ama oma kingai jing din,
Van in ah eikouve.

Verse 4
Ka beltai keiman Jesu chu,
Chonse kitta lou ding ;
Thi jong leng anung kajui ding,
Van in kalhun kahsea.

songs.title: 225. HICHE LEIYA KALEN LAI HIN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hiche leiya kalen lai hin,
Lungdonna jeng bou kamui,
Thina Jordan lui kagal kaiteng,
Pakai deina ang a kaum ding.
O neimu sah in nasem Salem,
Goldei mithengte lenna;
Kikhen lou na gam,
Lei lungjinna hin dalhah a;
O itih leh kahung lhung tedem!

Verse 2
Gentheiya naum te hojong,
Mun loupi chu alhun teng;
Chemasa te van mitheng ten,
Salem Pakai chu avahchoiyui.

Verse 3
Tonsot hinna lasa te chun,
Eikouve che masa ten;
Ama ho awgin kajah phat in,
Chumun ngaina in keima kakap.

Verse 4
Ka ngaiye Nang Emmanuel,
Nasem Salem thah hoichu;
Genthei mun a cheng kahi Pakai,
O Nang in kei neihung pui doh in.

songs.title: 226. THOUVUN KHANNOU GOLTE.
226. VANMUN LOUPI NOM CHUNG’AKHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat m.

Verse 1
Van mun loupi nom chunga khu,
I-ngaiteu chengse chu cheng ;
Amaho toh chengkhom ding chun,
Leiset thilse pailhauvin.

Chorus
Vannoi leiset abei nungle,
Olle in nom hoiya chun ;
Mitheng te lenna gam nom chu,
Van in a ichen ding.

Verse 2
Tonsot in nom loupia chengte,
Insung khat cheng ahiuve ;
Chu in nom loupia chu cheng din,
Chitin namtin akouve.

Verse 3
Eihuhhingpau loupi thina,
Ngailutna thu seileuvin ;
Leiset nikho kemlai sung hin,
Tahsan um angailutna.

Verse 4
Khat chengin ichemang jingui,
Insung mi akem jingin ;
Insung mijouse akemin,
Anunung ilunghel’e,

Verse 5
Vannoi leiset abei nileh,
Tonsot van mun noma chun ;
I-inko ngaite chengseu toh,
Kimin icheng khomna dem ?

songs.title: 226. VO PATHEN CHUNGNUNG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo Pathen chungnung pen kahinvah choiye,
Hingjing Pathen le imajouse bolthei,
Lungdong soh genthei te mi chonse te jol,
Chaga te genthei te (3)
Pakai le Pathen.

Verse 2
Mite taona sang Pathen nahijeh in,
Namiten asinmo athum nau pejing,
Nachate ka le ham nangai lhi jinge,
Thudih a thilpha bol (3)
Na nungsun ngaipoi.

Verse 3
Hiche hi milen le mineo hetsah in,
Mipite le nangma thu dou jing ho hi,
Tua huhhing a aum theina dinguva,
â€œIpi kati diu ham?â€ (3)
Tiuhen lang Amen.

Verse 4
Namtin thimâ€™a kon soh a kon kipah hen,
â€œChungnung penna Pathen loupina hihen;
Leichunga kipah te chunga chamleng hen,
Hosanna (6)
Sam in lan sauvin.

songs.title: 227. EISEMâ€™A EIHUHHING PAU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eisemâ€™a eihuhhingpau chu vahchoiyun,
Lhan le thina konin eilhattauve.
Alet aloupi jabol un vahchoiyun,
Huhhing hat loupi chungnung tah ahi.
Vahchoi jingun,
Chungnung pena loupi,
Chungnung chu vahchoiyun,
Vahchoi jingun,
Pakai le Leng chu vahchoi jingun.

Verse 2
Eilungset eihonguva chu vahchoiyun,
I-kisel nau songpi le ikulpiu,
Eichinguva eikaihoi uva ahi,
Twidap lonna vahom phaicham lhunga.

Verse 3
Eisempau phat konna ch vahchoi cheh un,
Alet le aloupina vahchoiyun,
Athu ging chauvin alungset kinemun,
Angailut na eituh jing diuva chu.

songs.title: 227. KA NGAI NGEIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Van miho khu hinveuvin lang,
I-Pakai lim lim adel’uve;
Lungdong hih-un kilut inte,
Van gam nom sunga chun. (2)

Verse 2
Pakai keiho kahin laisen,
Lungdon ngahna ding kanei pouve;
Ka chennau hi lhep mun ahi,
Nuina thei aum poi. (2)

Verse 3
Pakai vetan kalennau hi,
Lhepna meipi jingin eibom’ui;
Lhepna meipi jing lah-a hin,
Kinepna aumpoi. (2)

Verse 4
Ka ngai ngeiye Nagam nom chu,
Pon loupi sil’a i-lenna ding;
I-gelpet hin hung lhung hen lang,
I-lung gil sunga hin. (2)

songs.title: 227. ON JORDAN’S STORMY BANKS.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Isaiah 33:17)

Verse 1
Jordan luikama ka dinge,
Lhunkal ngahlel kahi ;
Ka galdot’e Canaan gamnom,
Ka tonsot gam ding chu.

Chorus
Olle chu gam noma icholngah diu,
Luigal gam nom emhoi tah a chun ;
Kelngoi nou le Mose la ngei chu sauhite,
Jesu koma ichen jing diu.

Verse 2
Chu gam nom hoitah chunga chun,
A ume vah kemlou ;
Pathen le Chapan vai homin,
Jan muthim um talou.

Verse 3
I-tih le keijong ka lhungin,
Nun nom in kaleng dem ;
I-tih le Pa mel chu kamun,
Alim’a ka ol dem.

Verse 4
Ka dim’e lung kipan leijah,
Kei cheng sot talou ding ;
Jordan twipi soh jeng jong le,
Bit keiya kei kai ding.

songs.title: 228. GATHERING AFTER TEARS. S.S. 992.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. sl

Verse 1
In lam jonin kong tol’u hite,
Pathen Thupha kinepna chu ;
Vannoi gam tina seiphong leute,
Van gam in noma chen theina din.

Chorus
Lhiso nungle kikhom ding vangam noma,
Tohgim nungle tonsot’a cholnga ding ;
Lhatsa mithengte kipa lasah khu ngaiyun,
Van in nomtah a khun akikhomui.

Verse 2
In lam jonin kong tol’u hite,
Kicha louhel’in cheu hite ;
Lungmonna mun ilhun tengu leh,
Vangam loupi vah hoi imu diu.

Verse 3
Gam sung chu molle lhang emsel soh,
Pahcha hoi namtuiyin chansoh ;
Chua chu eingailua Eilhatpau,
Vahchoiya kipa la isah diu.

Verse 4
Chua damna huilhi nem nung jing,
Luipang noma khovah nom jing ;
I-ngai chengseu imusoh kei diu,
Thi le nat lungdon um talou ding.

songs.title: 228. LEISET LUNGNGAI NA JOUSE HI
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset lungngai na jouse hi,
Pel tang e tonsot gam noma;
Alungset na lhalim nui ah,
Pakai ngaiyin eikou ve.

Chorus
Umkit lou ding kikhen kit na,
Lung gentheina mitlhi lonna;
Eilhandampu Pakai Jesun,
Natheh hulpeh inge ati.

Verse 2
Lhandampu chun ana gotsa,
Kipana khopi emnom chu;
Chu loupi mun emtah a chun,
Tonsot a emding kahi.

Verse 3
Kipah tah in vantil te le,
Lhatdam changte iki khop diu;
Tonsot hinkem lou ichan diu,
Kikhen kit na umlou ding.

Verse 4
Calvary lhang kaga vet le,
Kachen na gam ding alnage;
Van kelngoinou lal na ahi,
Sana khopi em sunga.

Verse 5
Lhandampu lungsetna jalin,
Aloupina chu ichan diu;
Chu gam emmnom chu kalhun teng,
Vahchoi na chim talou ding.

songs.title: 228. MU KANOM’E EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jerusalem kho keng Calvary lhanga,
Lhandampu thingpel’a akhainau mun’a;
Chua Lhagao Thengin neipui lut’in.
Mu kanom’e eilhandampu chu,
Akhut akeng anah-a hemma chu;
Michonse eijal’a athohna chu.

Verse 2
Juda milen ho le thempu lalte chun,
I-sah louvin kaiyun Zion kulsunga;
Sapset thing chunga akhen beh-un.

Verse 3
Hungve tem’un eilhandampu nunnem chu,
Genthei tintang thoh-in van lal Kelngoinou;
Set le dougal’in lem amel nguita.

Verse 4
Chung khopi daiyin mithengte ngui jouta,
Alengpau thohna vengam um talouvin;
Pan anungsun’in toni jong thimta.

songs.title: 229. BLESS BE THE NAME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat s.

Verse 1
Pathen vahchoiyun, Pathen vahchoiyun,
Eisempau Pathen vahchoiyun ;
Pathen chungnung chu vahchoiyun gingun,
Nasempau Pathen vahchoiyun.

Verse 2
Pathen jeng gingun, Pathen jeng gingun,
Loupi chungnung Pathen gingun ;
Ama thun nungun, Ama thun nung,
Nasempau Pathen thun nungun.

Verse 3
Christa lamtouvin, Christa lamtouvin,
Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa chu ;
Hosana samun Hosana samun,
Lamtouvin na-Lengpau Christa.

Verse 4
Amin theng lul chu choi-an’un gingun,
Ja cheh-un Christa min theng chu ;
Amin choisangun, Amin choisangun,
Eilhatpau Jesu vahchoiyun.

songs.title: 229. GAMMIN THANG KISEI CHUL NGEILOU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gammin thang kisei chul ngeilou
Pakai in asem gamnom chu
Sun leh jaan um talou hel ding
Zion khopi nom tah achun

Chorus
Van Jerusalem khopi chu
Gil kel dangchah kisei kit lou hel ding;
Nileh lha leh Ahsi vah ngai lou
Kelngoi chu avah jing jeng e

Verse 2
Pakai nagam theng nom achun
Thina hui pi nung talou ding;
Mitlhi long a kikhen kit na
Umtalou ding nagam a chun

Verse 3
Hiche vannoi genthei mun a
Thina gam kano jing lai hin
Lungdong a kagenthei kum leh
Pakai nang in nei lhamuon in.

songs.title: 229. KA LA NGEIPEN CHU CHRISTA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
La ngei ding dang kamujou poi,
Hiche leisetna;
Christa kei dia athina chu,
Ka la ngei pen ahi.
Aw ka la ngeipen chu Christa ahi,
Lhepna hui le lungdon na a;
Ka kulpi le ka kingaina nahi.

Verse 2
Leiset la ngei dang jouse chu,
Pah banga mol thei;
Pakai vahchoina la ngei chun,
Chultih nei talou.

Verse 3
Lungdonga ka-ka pet jongle,
Ka monna nahi;
Kinepna ding dang kanei poi,
Christa tilou chu.

Verse 4
David dingin kulpi nahi,
Lhandampu deitah;
Ken jong kulpin mang’ing kate,
Aw Pakai Jesu.

songs.title: 230. AHUNG NAI IN E.S.S. 1140
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ahung nai in (2) mitheng ho pui dingin,
Song hoi jouse, Song mantamte;
Alungsetna kon.
Van’a ahsi te bangin,
Alallukhuh jemhoi din;
Loupi tah a hung vah din,
Alallukhuh a din.

Verse 2
Alokhom ding (2) Agam’a koi dingin,
Athim jouse avah jouse;
Alungsetna din.

Verse 3
Chapang neo ho (2) Alhatpa lungsetna,
Chu song hoi mantam chu ahi;
Alungset na kon.

songs.title: 230. THE GOSPEL BELLS ARE RINGING.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. sl
(I John 3:16)

Verse 1
Gospel dah gin athonge, twikhanglen le lei chunga,
Manbeiya huhhingna Thupha,
Nang le keima eihung pei ;
Pathenin vannoi mi, angailut behseh jeh-in,
Achapa changkhat eipeuve,
Atahsan chan hinna din.
Gospel dah aginge,
Twikhanglen le lei chunga ;
Gospel dah manbeiyin,
Nang le kei eihung peuve.

Verse 2
Gospel dah in eikouvui, golvahna ankong um din ;
Eikounau ngaidao lou jenun,
Lungsetna eikounau chu ;
“Hinna changlhah kahi, Lhagao gilkel’an neuvin,
Na chonset itobang jong le,
Aboncha chu bangsoh ding”

Verse 3
Gospel gin kipa umtah, athongin gam tin aloi ;
Ngaidam chamkimna thu apoi,
“Cross a Jesu thi vangin ;
Hapa kipana thu, kapoh peh-e mijouse”
Huhhingpa chu ahung peng tai,
Leng le Pakai Christa chu.

songs.title: 231. CLOSE TO THEE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Col.2:6)

Verse 1
Nang kei dia kumkhoa ka hinna,
Ka hinna sanga lujo ;
Ka lhagao kholjin laise hin,
Lhandampu kei nei lhonpin ;
Kahin nai, kahin nai, (2 vei)
Kalhagao kholjin laise hin ;
Khandampu kei nei lhonpin.

Verse 2
Lei nop le minthanna dinga,
Ken toh le thum neilou ding ;
Kipah-in thoh in tong inge,
Nan kei neilhonpi jingin ;
Kahin nai, kahin nai, (2 vei)
Kipah-in thoh in tong inge,
Nan kei neilhonpi jingin.

Verse 3
Phaicham thim nei pui galkaiyin,
Twipi len eikai pin lang ;
Hinkemlou kotpi eilhut in,
Pakai nangto lutkhom din ;
Kahin nai, kahin nai, (2 vei)
Hinkemlou kotpi eilhut’in,
Pakai nangto lutkhom din.

songs.title: 231. HALLELUJAH LHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Minunnempa chu koi ham?
Pathen cha ahungpa chu;
Chonset thisa thoukit din.
Hallelujah Lhandampu chu.

Verse 2
Ka chonsetna jouse chu,
Apo tai Cross chunga chun;
Athisanin eisop tai.

Verse 3
Panpi bei themmo ihiu,
Ama Pathen Kelngoinou;
Them chansah ding Ama bou.

Verse 4
Thi dinga adop sangun,
“Akichai tai” tin asam;
Tun miloupi achang tai.

Verse 5
Leng loupi chungnung thi chun,
Lhatdamsa mithengte ho;
La thah ngei hi asah diu.

songs.title: 232. HICHE SETNA LEI CHUNG’A HIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. Duet S. & T. (Heb. 11:16)

Verse 1
Hiche setna leichunga hin,
Gim toh jong leng olmo lou ding ;
Ka ma a nopna aume,
Leiset da lhang ting kache ding.

Chorus
Chuche gam nom tah van gama,
Huhhingpan kipan eingah-e ;
Ama koma cheng jing dingin,
Genthei lengvai thoh talou ding.

Verse 2
Huipi le go kitho jong le,
Gimna jouse chu thoh jong leng ;
Hicheng chu ken dalha tading,
Van chung gam nom ka lhun teng leh.

Verse 3
Ka kinepna kamu tenga,
Van gam nom tah kalhun tengle ;
Christa koma kei cheng jing ding,
Van chung gam nom ka Pa gama

songs.title: 232. THE CLEANSING BLOOD
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin Pathen Kelngoinou chonset poh,
Calvary kiti lhang chunga;
Sapsetna thing chunga chun khai sangun,
Kei din Athisan lu alonglhai.

Chorus
Lhandampu nah theng sunga chun,
Thisan le twi chu along lhai;
Ka lunga sumil ponge,
Chonset thenna lui chu.

Verse 2
Lungsetna twi theng chu along tai tun,
Lhandampu athina munna chun;
Sun le janin chen hiche munna chun,
Ka Lhandampu nunnem henga chun.

Verse 3
Hiche thisan luiya kisil jouse,
Asetnau buhbang bang ding;
Von chonset nen chu hung sop thenguvin,
‘Hungun’ tin Lhandampun aseiye.

Verse 4
Leiset chunga hin ken mansah ponge,
Ka Pakai ke Lhandampu thina;
O Lhagao thengtah chun nei kithopin,
Na meldei um chu nei musah-in.

songs.title: 233. LEISET KHOLJINNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen ka kholjin hi leisetna,
Kap lung lengvai tah-in;
Nang naum’e ti kahet chun,
O lungmon nan ka dim’e.

Chorus
Kanei tai tonsot gam,
Peogal gam nom chu;
Lhiso kitlou na khopi hoi chu,
Chu gam hing chullou.

Verse 2
Kei migenthei tah lengvai dingin,
Kei din Christa athi;
Malai khang lamvaite bang chun,
O achon talouhel din.

Verse 3
Pathen hatchungnung lei le van sem,
Namit mua kilang soh;
Kimusit na ho nahoji;
Kahet in kalha among.

Verse 4
Mihem angailut namtin het din,
Lhagao huhhing dingin;
Gel jing’ute sopite ho,
Angailutna kemlou chu.

songs.title: 233. LUNGGENTHEI CHU ALOUPI TA!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Psalm 8:5)

Verse 1
Lung genthei chu aloupi ta !
A mitheng ten tun veuvin ;
Galjou hung kile kit ahi,
Namtin A-anga kun ding.
Khuh sah-un van min lallukhuh,
Huhhinga leng ho Leng chu

Verse 2
Van miten lallukhuh lul chu,
Khuh sah-un Huhhingpa chu ;
Hat laltouna atou sah-un,
Van kul sung kithong soh-in.

Verse 3
Michonse ten Huhhingpa chu,
Nui jatnan akhuh sah-un ;
Mitheng le van min kimvel’un,
Amin ngei avahchoiyui.

Verse 4
Vahchoina O gin khu ngaiyun,
Jo la kisah gin ngei khu ;
Jesu mun chungnung achang tai,
Iti hoi vetnom um tam.

songs.title: 234. KEN KA NGAIYE AMA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei ngailutna kalunga beita hen,
Chonset jouse thisanin soptheng hen;
Cross a chun kalung kinem jingta hen,
Jesu thisanin soptheng ding buhbang bangin.

Chorus
Ken ka ngaiye Ama,
Eina lungset jeh-in;
Lhatdamna eibol peh,
Kei din Calvary’a.

Verse 2
Setna kiphum gam mangsa kahi.
Hesoh tah thoh-a sohchangsa kahi;
Pakai lunghanna kitopi ngamlou,
Chonset kisoptheng ding ahi buhbang bangin.

Verse 3
Sohchan naa kona ong kahitai,
Amitchosa tun avah kamu tai;
Athisa Pathen’a hingkit kahi,
Kipana thu hi gamtin’a seichoi lenge.

songs.title: 234. KHATCHENGIN LUIGALIKAIYUN. S.S. 1031.
235. HE AROSE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Melmaten Pakai dei chu,
Thingpel’a khai sangun;
Pakai chun Van’a eipuitou ding.
Athou tai ….. Athou tai !
Lhan’a kon Athou tai;
Pakai chun van’a eipuitou ding.

Verse 2
Joseph in along domlhan,
Song lhan’a lup sah-un;
Pakai chun van’a eipuitou ding.

Verse 3
Lhai jel’in sopi Mary,
Pakai long hol dingin;
Pakai chun van’a eipuitou ding.

Verse 4
Van Lhatheng khat hung kumlhan,
Lhan sin song tangdoh-in;
Pakai chun van’a eipuitou ding.

songs.title: 235. KIDANG TAH-IN KAHIN KHANKHO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Kidang tah-in kahin khankho akikhel tai,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat !
Hitih chana kahol Lhagao vah ka neitai,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat.

Chorus
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat ;
Jona twilenin alonge kalung sunga,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat.

Verse 2
Thi le vaveina lama che hi ka bang tai,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat ;
Ka chonset jouse jong sop thengin aumtai,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat.

Verse 3
Nopna chang dinga eikihol’a ka hitai,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat ;
Meipi jing um talou ding kahin lai lampi,
Kalunga Jesu chenna pat.

Verse 4
Kei dingin vah aum thina phaichama chun,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat ;
Chua konin kamui Salem kulpi em chu,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat.

Verse 5
Kache ding ken kahei Salem kulpi jon’a,
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat ;
Iti kipa umtam ken kajon pantai tun ;
Ka lunga Jesu chenna pat.

songs.title: 236. LIFT UP YOUR HEADS O YE GATES.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Psalms 24:7-10)

Verse 1
Kotpi nangho kihong lenun,
Tonsot kotpi nang ho ;
Kihong lenun loupina Leng,
Chu alut theina din.
(Koi ham loupina Lengpa chu ?)
Pakai hat chu ahi.
(Koi ham chuche Leng loupi chu ?)
Thahat chungnung le gal’a hat Pakai chungnung ahi (2)
Halleluijah ! Halleluijah (2) Halleluijah,
Amen, Amen, Amen.

Verse 2
Kotpi ho kihong len’uvin,
Tonsot kotpi nangho ;
Kihong lenun loupina Leng,
Chu a lut theina din.
(Koi ham loupina Lengpa chu ?)
Pakai hat chu ahi,
(Koi ham chuche Leng loupi chu)
Chuche Leng loupi chu koi ham ?
Loupina Leng dang aumpoi Ama jeng bou ahi, (2)
Halleluiyah, Halleluiyah (2) Halleluiyah.
Amen, Amen, Amen.

songs.title: 236. NALUNGSET KUL SUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
O mihang alem gam tai,
Vannoi lungkhamna gam’a konin;
Canan gamnom jonin, lungdonna twipi chung,
Athasan hat jal’in mu bangin aleng tai.

Verse 2
O mihang akim tapoi,
Chonset gal khom banga dou dingin;
Lhagao hung leng kitnin lungkhamna gam’a hin,
Chonsetna gal alen genthei chate dingin.

Verse 3
O gal vai hung homkit’in,
Zion kulsunga nahom bangin;
Galvai hunghom kit’in thimgal ahung len’e,
Jona Lhagao theng chu kachunguva leng hen.

Verse 4
O hung kit’in o Pakai,
Nalungset kul sunga gal alen;
Na gam’a chan sung Zion hinna kulpi neite,
Jona chemjam choiyin twi bangin hung lenin.

songs.title: 237. MIHEM CHONSETNA KON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. (Matt. 420)

Verse 1
Mihem chonsetna kon huhdoh dingin,
Jesu hunga ahi leiya ;
Aman ling lukhuh chu akikhuh-in,
Calvary lhanga kei chunan athi.

Chorus
Ahingin van’a akal tai,
Aman ka chonset angaidam soh tai ;
Ahingin vana akal tai,
Hung kit tei ding nikhat leh.

Verse 2
Jesu van’a chea gacheng kit dingin,
Buikhuh a kon athou kittai ;
Leiya ama ahung kum kit nileh,
Aloite van gama apui tou ding.

Verse 3
Na chonset nau Jesu henga phongun,
Man beiyin lhat nauvin nate ;
Jesu henga hungun vang thum dingin,
Ama kom’a thilpha akim soh-e.

songs.title: 237. VAHLE SOT TAPONG’E
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tahsanin gah veng’e alang’e van loupi,
Ka gentheina leiset gamthip’a konin;
Hinna twi lonna gam o lungsetna gam chu,
I-tih le kalhung dem galvon ka koina ding.

Verse 2
Leiset gimnaa hin vahle sot tapong’e,
Khovah ding ahitai ka kicholdo nading;
Chu ni loupi ni le van mithengte ho to,
Kelngoinou thasa chu la’n vahchoi tauvinge.

Verse 3
Tuhin kap jeng jong leng vagal gamnom’a chun,
Kipah-in mu tange loupisa gol ngaite;
Lhandampu ang sunga chun lengkhom tauving’e,
Kikhen kit pou vinge kapkit tapou vinge.

Verse 4
Kalung gentheina hi kipa hina ding chu,
I-tih le hiding ham ka Pakai hung loiyin;
Leiya lhenchomte le van mitheng jouse jong,
Mukal ka ngahlel’e peogal gamnom’a chun.

Verse 5
Chu gam nom’a chun ka ngai kimsoh tauvinte,
Leiset hi dalhang ting kicholdo tang kate;
Ni akem’in phat anai tai kipana ni,
Vahle sot taponge kap sot tapong kate.

songs.title: 238. KIPANA GAMNOM
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka ngaiye Pakai Jesu nagam sem,
Jordan gal’a gamnom tah chu;
Nei puilut’in Salem gam’a.
O kipana gamnom lenna gam’a,
Kilungsetna Pakai khopi;
Pahcha hoitah pahna gam’a.

Verse 2
Meivom kal’a kipana gam nom’a,
Nei puilut in chu gam nom’a;
Khojin louna gam nom’a chun.

Verse 3
Mang jeng tahen leiset lunghel mun hi,
Neipui lut’in o ka Pakai;
Lunghel louna gamnom’a chun.

Verse 4
Chu gam khopi nom chu kalhun tengle,
Leiset gimna hi gel louvin;
Hallelujah Pakai ang’a.

Verse 5
O Pakai nagam sem sana khopi,
Ngaiyin kalha alengvaiye;
O Pakai neihung puidoh-in.

Verse 6
O Pakai Lhatheng bang lengthei hileng,
Hung leng tange Salem nom’a;
Lily pah hoi pahna gam’a.

songs.title: 238. PAKAIYIN NANGAIDAM THU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat sl
(Psalms 6:16)

Verse 1
Pakaiyin na ngaidam thu naphon nah em ?
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in ;
Pakai thina Cross chu iti najot em ?
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in ;
Nang nache nah em Ama vah a chu ?
Ngaidam nachan tam na mona kon ;
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in.
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite thu,
Seikit’in seikit temin ;
Thusim ngei chu seikit temin,
Na dinga loupina hi ding,
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in.

Verse 2
Na galsat najona thusim ngeitah chu,
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in ;
Galsat kipan ho dingin phachom inte,
Chonset gal len sat ihiuve tu hin,
Christa toh gam kilo loita ding ;
Christa dinga lhagao huhhingna thu chu,
Seikit’in ngaiyu hite avel vel’in.

songs.title: 239. JERUSALEM MY HAPPY HOME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. sl
(Rev. 22:12)

Verse 1
Jerusalem keima in nom,
Lungin kagel tan moi ;
I-tih tah le gim ka dalhan,
A nom chu kamu dem ! (2 vei)

Verse 2
Akul nisa sanga vahjo,
Nom chungnung hoi chungnung ;
A kot jouse chutia chu em,
A lamlen sana em. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Ahon sung vah nom chungnung deh,
Hinthing in hoisah soh ;
Chuto bang khopi hoi nom chu,
Mihem mit’in mulou (2 vei)
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

Verse 4
Mithengte kikhen kitta lou,
Ol jong tan nei talou ;
Neipui lut’in chu gama chun,
Nei kaiyin na khut’in (2 vei)

Verse 5
Pakai chenna gam noma chun,
Olle kei jong chenge ;
Ama kamu teng tonsot’in,
Avahchoi la sange (2 vei)

songs.title: 239. LHANDAMPUN KEI DIN ATHOH-E.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngai tem’un hinna mun kasem joutai ati,
Leiset’a chon le gol nopna ho hin;
Ka lenna gam loupi hi asumil tai.
O vantil ho chun Laltouna adipsoh tai,
Vahchoina tintang ngei atum’un;
Aloupi nan achol douvin,
Lal nunnem’in Calvary’a Athoh in kap.

Verse 2
O Pathen cha Lhandampu chu gel’uvin,
Calvary le sapsetna thing chunga;
Ka chonset jal’in athoh-in ajou tai.

Verse 3
Van khonom holte ho chun hinveu le vang,
Lhandampu dangchah athohna chu;
Calvary hung naiyin kalung sunga hin.

Verse 4
O nei puiyin Lhagao Calvary lhanga,
Pakai kho gamnom hoitah a chun;
Chen lang keima hi nei vahchoiyin ati.

Verse 5
Pakai nagam sem’a chun neipui teiyin,
Gentheiya kalenna gam ka ngei poi;
Nagam munna gam nom’a chun leng tange.

songs.title: 240. KIKHEN TASACHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat s. (Psalms 45:17)

Verse 1
Kikhen tasa chu Pakai Jesu jal’in,
Tun damsel’in ikimu kit tauve ;
Lungkhat le tha khat ‘in kikhom uhite,
Lung nguisa hal’in kipah uhite.

Chorus
Jesun eina hoidam cheh jeh-vin,
Ama min vahchoiya kikhom hiu hite ;
Mihem mai chun kipana akim jou poi,
Lhagao Thengin eilhamon jingu hen.

Verse 2
Vana Pakai koma kikhom ding ging chen,
Tonsot goulu chu muding tup cheh-in ;
Pa le mihemte mitmun ngah uhite,
Pakaiyin cha dia eidei jal’uvin.

Verse 3
Hi leiset’a hin chomkhat pah jongleu hen,
Vanna aga imu ding gel’uvin ;
Anung juite chu hi-a genthei jong le,
Ama hungteng kipana hita ding.

songs.title: 240. THE PERCIOUS BLOOD.
241. NANGMA KAHI O EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (I Thess. 10:22)

Verse 1
Nangma kahi O Eilhandampu,
Nalungset O nem kajai ;
Kalung sunga hin tahsanna khang hen,
Nang kahin nai theina din.

Chorus
Neipui naiyin Pakai neipuiyin,
Nathina Cross phunga chun ;
Neipui naiyin naiyin, Pakai neipuiyin,
Na thisan lonna a chun.

Verse 2
Na natong dingin Pakai nei thenson,
Na lungset thahatna chu ;
Ka lhagao mang ding Nangah kingai hen,
Nangma a kalung mong hen.

Verse 3
Nangma ang sungah taovin ka kum’e,
Laltouna angin kabol ;
Ka Pathen Na anga ka dilsuh hi
Gol banga Nang bel kahi.

Verse 4
Thina twikhanglen gal’a lungsetna,
Aume kamu phah lou ;
Kipana chungnung aume chua,
Ka lhun teng keima san ding.

songs.title: 241. PATHEN THILSEM HON THU ASEIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin Pathen thilsem hon thu aseiye,
Asempau hung ding ngah-un kap’in apeng’ui;
Lei kisemthah ding ngahlel’a kap’a peng ahi,
Athahsem sohkei ding ahi.

Chorus
Vo mihem chate,
Thim lah-a a kon hung thoudoh loiyuvin;
Vo thim’a umte, vah-a hungun,
Ven thilsem hon thu aseiye.

Verse 2
Veuvin Pathen thilsem hon thu aseiye,
Pathen chate hung kilah ding agaldot’ui;
Pathenin hi leiset athahsem niteng chule,
Sopi mun nanei ding hinam ?

Verse 3
Veuvin thilbul chengse kilong sohhel ding,
Van jong lekhajol banga leng mang sohhel ding;
Pathenin hi leiset athahsem niteng chule,
Na dinmun akicheh nadem?

songs.title: 242. ALL THE DAY LONG. Ch. Song 833.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhandampu nung chu juiyin,
Hi la hi kasan Amin loupi pen jing hen;
Lungset vangin eilhat,
Athisanin eilhat tai; Amin loupi pen jing hen.
Hallelujah tonsot Pakai,
Loupi jing hen tichu ka tonsot la chu ahi;
Eihuhhingpa, eilhandampu,
Chonset lhatnan loupipen jing hen;
Ahinna kadin aphal Eilhatdamnan athi,
Amin loupi pen jing hen.

Verse 2
Thim lah-a eihuhdoh in,
Eichingtup jinge Amin loupi pen jing hen;
Lungdonna le kichatna,
Aman eilhamon hen; Amin loupi pen jing hen.

Verse 3
Ka koma hungin eiching,
Ngin, eilhamonin; Amin loupi pen jing hen,
Jordan lui eipui galkaiyin,
Vangam eilhut’in; Amin loupi pen jing hen.

songs.title: 242. GAMLA TAH-ALHAGAO MANGDING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. m. (Matt. 28:18-20)

Verse 1
Gamla tah-a lhagao mang ding atame,
Asang aja thim noiya atouvui ;
Sochatna thu gamtinna hil ding koi ham ?
Jesu lam vea man gellouva che ding.

Chorus
Thu neina se eikipe tai,
Thu neina se eikipe tai,
Cheuvin gamtina hillhang leuvin,
“Veuvin Keiman ka umpi jing nai” ati.

Verse 2
Ven leiset hi kot jouse akihong tai,
Christa sepai thouvun lung khat hiuvin ;
Christian thouvun manouvin Pakai dingin,
Setbul sutlhan Gospel thu hilleuvin.

Verse 3
Jaidam tah-in Pathenin eiho eikou,
Eiho dingin Christa athi leiya ;
Sochatna thu chitin namtin gahil’un,
Lhagao tamtah honga gapui lut’in.

Verse 4
O chung Pathen chitin namtin lah-a hin,
Hinphong loiyin Thupha agam tina ;
Noi leiset hin Hossana tin sam’u hen,
Pakai ahi Leng chungnung chu heu hen.

songs.title: 243. HOME SWEET HOME.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leng le lal mun loupia vahle jongleu hen,
I-in neocha sanga nomjo mundang umlou;
Chunga valpa ahsiten eigaldot jing,
Lei chunga hin lung ngahna ding mundang umlou.
In nom, ka In nom,
Ka in neocha sanga nomjo;
Mun dang umlou.

Verse 2
Kipa thanop loupina amol loiyin,
O ka bi-in neocha chu mukit ka nom’e;
Chung leng vacha ten nom’in jai la’n oiyun,
O nei mu sah kit’in silung monna din.

Verse 3
In dalha phatsotpi ache mang nungin,
Kalungin gah ngaitong ka in neocha chu;
Thil hoi le loupi dang ijat tamnan jong,
Kalungin ahin nungsun’in ahin seiye.

songs.title: 243. NILHUM NUNG’A CHU GAMNOM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Dan. 12:3)
1 Nilhum nunga chu gamnom lhun ding kagelle,
Kalung sung kipana adime ;
Lungset jal’a Lhandampu kom kalhun tengle,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantem ?
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantem, chong nantem ?
Nilhangkai nilhum jou teng chule ;
Kicholdo na inpi nom chu kalhun tengle,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong nantem ?

Verse 2
Pakai thahat panin tao toh thon tonging ting,
Lhagao mangsa holdohna dingin ;
Chu niloupi nile ahsi keima san ding,
Vahchoi o twilen kinong bang ding.

Verse 3
Pakai mel kamu teng iti kipa tang ngem !
Nop le kipana kemtalou ding ;
Chung sana khopia chen ding chun kei eineme,
Ka lallukhuh ahsi chong tei ding.

songs.title: 244. CHU JINGLE IN NOM’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat ml
(John 14:2)

Verse 1
Chu jingle in nom’a kimu nautem ?
Twikhanglen pang emnom tah a chun ;
Che masa ngai cheng eingah jing hotoh,
Kimu to iti anop tadem !

Chorus
Kikhop ding, kikhop ding,
Twikhanglen pang emnom tah-a chun ;
Kikhop ding, kikhop ding,,
I ngai chengtoh kimu to cheh ding.

Verse 2
Chu nile in nom’a kimu nautem ?
Hiche leiset gentheina dalhan ;
Lhatsate la sah ijomna diuvem,
Kimu to iti anop tadem !

Verse 3
Chu jingle in nom’a kimu nautem ?
Eilhandampu nunnom mel mu din ;
Ngai cheng toh ikihe cheh nadiuvem,
Kimu to iti anop tadem!

songs.title: 244. MIHEM HINKHO CHOMCHA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mihemte ho hinkho phat chomcha hi,
Genthei lungdon lengvai na dim jingin;
Damna leh lungmonna kibol jongleh,
Kimu deh ponte leiset dam sungin.

Chorus
Ka ngalel’u khopi hoi le nom chu,
Na mithengte ho napuilut nading;
Sotna laiyintem o Pakai aphat?
Namel munom’in ka galdot jingui.

Verse 2
Leiset tahsa hatlou kaphe hou hi,
Lhanmol leh vuikhuh mun jon bou ahi;
Pakai nangma hungkah kadam sungun,
Na natong dingin nei mang teiyuvin.

Verse 3
Pakai na mithengte kahi vangun,
Nalung lhaina banga kimang theilou;
Mitamtah ka umjing nalaiyuve,
Nei ngaidam’un tin kahung taove.

Verse 4
Pakai nathilsem ho jouse jong chu,
Nachate nom’a alenna diu chu;
Naoso nat thohgim’a peng peng bangin,
Pakai hung tale chun phajo lou ham?

songs.title: 245. KEI LENG CHA KAHI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (James 2:5)

Verse 1
Kei Lengcha kahi ka-Pa ahaove,
Leiset gou Ama khut’a um ahi ;
Ahao songmantam, sana le dangka,
Asum insung dim anei simjou lou.

Chorus
Kei Lengcha chu kahi,
Lengcha chu kahi ;
Eihuhhing Christa toh ;
Kei Lengcha chu kahi.

Verse 2
Pathen cha deitah vannoi Huhhingpa,
Ahung peng genthei tah-in leisetna ;
Tua vang chung gama tonsot Leng changta,
Van chunga keima in nom eipeh ding

Verse 3
Leiset chunga hi vahmanga kahi,
Nu sunga kon chonsea pen kanahi ;
Tua huhhing changa kamin kisunta,
Inpi nom loa lallukhuh kasan ding.

Verse 4
I-lou leiset in kalhah lel ding ham ?
Kei ding chunga Leng in gotsa aum ;
In nusea vahmang hijongleng sange,
Pathen loupi hen kei Lengcha kahi.

songs.title: 245. KHODAH-UVIN NA TONGUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chang atna ding phat anai tai,
Kiging jingun nidan tinin;
Thina lhanmol nalep kah-in,
Pakaiya dingin na tongun.

Chorus
Khodah uvin loujao ho khu veuvin,
Chang amin’in akoi gam tai;
Natong ding ahinsol na din,
Louneipu heng’a tao jingun.

Verse 2
Chang at phat ahung lhun tengle,
Pakaiyin chang a atkhom ding;
Aw sopi lungmong ta-hih-in,
Lhagao mang hon nakou jinge.

Verse 3
Loujao ho khu vetem’uvin,
Anatong ding mi aum poi;
Tuhin chen lang Pakai dingin,
Kipah tah-in natong pan tan.

songs.title: 246. AT THE BATTLE FRONT. (M.H. 158)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai sepaiya pang din kahinkho kape tai,
Gal kisat sot hen lang iti hahsat jeng jongle;
Pathen galvon le Lhagao Theng chemjam pan’ing ting,
Gal kisatna mun laitah a neimu ding.
Ngaiyun tram, tram sepaite kijot khu,
Joy asam’uvin galte ajam tai;
Ngaiyun tram, tram sepaite kijot khu,
Hat dingin akon’uve;
Keima jong kahi sepai loupi pen,
Ka Pathenin gal munna eipanpi ding;
Keima jong kahi sepai loupi pen,
Gal kisatna mun laitah a neimu diu.

Verse 2
Ngailutna ponlap thengtah chu dom sanguvin lang,
Sochatna thu seileuvin michonsete henga;
Ka galteu tam hen lang ei um kimvel jeng jongle,
Gal kisatna mun laitah a neimu diu.

Verse 3
Vo sopi nangman jong namin nakoiyem chua,
Nadin nah em Lhandampu henga tahsan neiya;
Tun hungin lhon hite Pakai Christa nungjui din,
Gal kisatna mun laitah a nei mu diu.

songs.title: 246. VO PATHEN NANG
247. MITHENGTE CHENA LAMLUI IJOTNUI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Mithengte chenna lamlui ijot’ui,
I lengpauvin lam akaiye ;
Van gam in nom jon’a che ihiuve,
Sun ahsin eisalvah jingui.

Chorus
Van in jon’a che ihiuve,
Kipana Lallukhuh chang dingin ;
Lem louvin chu gam ilhun tengle,
Iti kipa tautem !

Verse 2
Mitheng sangja achei Zion jonin,
Akitol’ui lhatsa janel ;
Eiho jong in jon Leng thupeh a che,
I thaomei devah jingute.

Verse 3
Kinem tah le kilungsetto cheh-in,
Tahsanin lamlui hou hite ;
I lengpau imua ikihpoulim teng,
Iti kipa aum tadem.

songs.title: 247. PATHEN THANGVAHNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I-gam lhang dung hi ivetle gam jong jol nam,
Christiante chamdel’a laitol ilennau;
Khong le dah thouvin kipah in lan, Jai oiyun,
Pathenin phungvuh hen Kuki hi ama Nam din.
Nanom peh-a Kukite thinglhang,
Theng a laitol ilennau;
Lhangtin le thingtin pahhoi le khohui ajamnoiya,
U le nao cham del’in lungkhat in lem’ute,
Aw kipah tah in lem’ute I-gamsungu khopi.

Verse 2
Sam’un choileu hite khong le dah tho pum’in,
I-gam’u le Khangthahte kipana din;
O kihil toute kol kimvel nam dang ho jong,
Kikhom’ute i-gam le Khangthahte vahchoinan.

Verse 3
I-gam nom chungnung hi Pathenin phungvuh hen,
Amin theng hi loupi jing hen vahchoina;
Hinlai damsungin lem’ute Leng Christa chu,
Khangthahten lem’ute tonsot a chultalou ding.

songs.title: 248. KILHAHNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Sopi gol ho toh ilenkhom iti nop tam,
Kikhenna ding lung kigel lou o-ohe.
Lungsung a lungkhamna jouse,
Gol ho kikhen jeng jongleu hen;
Phat khat leng Christa ang sung o-ohe.

Verse 2
Sopi gol ho nom’uvin thanopna ahin,
Ikikhen ding’u ahitai o-ohe.

Verse 3
Insung mite sang’a kalungset kagol ho,
Golte ho lungset kem theilou o-ohe.

Verse 4
Nom’uvin nom’uvin khojah na dim’in,
Ikikhen dingu ahitai o-ohe.

Verse 5
Che ding kahitai ka sopi gol ngaite ho,
Hung’un kisalam tou hite lungset’in.

songs.title: 248. NGAIYIN THUGIL LOUPI KIDANG HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Ngaiyin thugil loupi kidang hi,
Kei jong amangsa kahi ;
Avan loupina ahin dalhan,
Manlu tah-in eilhat tai.

Chorus
Kon eilhat doh em thina kon,
(Pathen Chapa Cross a thi chu)
(I abol em ? Tahsan jingun)
Tun van chunga acheng tai.

Verse 2
Chung vantil’in eison theilou diu,
Ama chungnung pen ahi ;
Thing Cross chunga long tohpa bou chu,
Van’a Pathen Cha ahi.

Verse 3
Nang jong lut’in Huhhingpa ang’a,
Ama bou chibai boh-in ;
Ama lungsetna nang jong chang ding,
Aman nang jong huhhing ding.

songs.title: 249. ALMOST BERSUADED. (R.S. 251)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lunghei ding koncha, tahsan dinga,
Lunghei ding koncha, sang dia;
Khat touvin seiyinte Lhagao kiche mangtan,
Nikho phajo dang teng hinkou nange.

Verse 2
Lunghei ding koncha, tun hung teiyin,
Lunghei ding koncha, nungchon hih-in;
Jesu kouna aw nem vantil hon na naiyui,
Eina taopeh nau, lamvai hungin.

Verse 3
Lunghei ding koncha, chang amin tai,
Lunghei ding koncha, manna hung ding;
“Themcha” lolhing ngailou, themcha hi thonna bou,
Ohe ka-leh gel, “Themcha” manna.

songs.title: 249. VEUVIN LUNGSET KEMLOU HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.b. (I John 3:1)

Verse 1
Veuvin lungsetna kemlou hi,
Pan eipeh-u ahi ;
Setna lamvai mangsa eiho,
Pathen cha kivo ding.
Veuvin lungsetna kemlou,
Lungsetna kemlou Pan “Cha” tia
Eikounau ‘ o nem chu ;
Van vouva eikikhel teng,
Pathen cha eikikou ding.

Verse 2
Thisan jal’a ngaidam chang ten,
Lungsetna heu hite ;
Alungsetna O ja jing ding,
Pathen naiyu hite.

Verse 3
Loupina ichan diu ni chu,
Tun hung lhung loi tante ;
I-Pakai imu tengu leh,
Ama mel iput diu.

Verse 4
Phatthei ichanna dinguvin,
Tahsan theng hiu hite ;
Thoukit Pakai anga din teng,
Amai lhai imu diu.

songs.title: 250. CHUNGNUNG PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.d. (Psalms 34:3)

Verse 1
Chungnung Pakai namtin chunga vaihom,
Vahchoiyute, vahchoiyute ;
Chibai boh-un A-anga kun cheh-un,
I-lengpau chu vahchoiyun.
Lhatdam changsa nanghon,
Vahchoiyun Amin theng ;
Lem’un Kelngoinou, lemun hat chungnung,
Phongin thanom tah-in, samlen aloupina ;
I-lengpau chu vahchoiyun.

Verse 2
Chungnung Pakai leng jouse Leng chungnung,
Vahchoiyute, vahchoiyute ;
Athahat in gam jousea vai apoi,
I-lengpau chu vahchoiyun.

Verse 3
Chungnung Pakai mintheng chungnung ahi,
Vahchoiyute, vahchoiyute ;
Avahchoiyui Vantil le mihem ten,
I-lengpau chu vahchoiyun.

songs.title: 250. I KNOW WHOM I HAVE BELIEVED (R.S. 617)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka hepoi Pa lungset kidang,
I-ding eina hetsah;
Chutia lungset dia kilom lou,
Ama din eilhat tai.

Chorus
Hinla ka henai ka tahsan Pa,
Le eijollhapa chu thanei ahi;
Ahenga ka pehdoh chengse,
Chu nikho dia hong bit thei.

Verse 2
Ka hepoi hinna dia tahsan,
Hi iti eina peh;
Athu tahsanna jal’a la,
Lung sung chamnan alo.

Verse 3
Ka hepoi Lhatheng natoh hi,
Michonse alahlut;
Thun ahung kiphong Jesu chu,
Aman eitahsan sah.

songs.title: 251. JESUS IS THE WORLD TO ME. (R.S. 686)
251. NASETPOHGIH AKON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl (I John 1:7)

Verse 1
Naset pohgih a kon theng nan natem ?
Thisan bou ahi, na thenna ding ;
Setna jouse nangman jou nan natem,
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

Chorus
Thisan bou chun na kidang atong,
Kelngoinou thisanin ;
Thisan bou chun na kidang atong,
Kelngoinou thisan lutah chun.

Verse 2
Buhbang sangin nang bangjou nan natem ?
Thisan bou ahi, na banna ding ;
Setnan mihem hinkho alen mangpi,
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

Verse 3
Na Lengpa Jesu natong nan natem ?
Thisan bou ahi, na tohna ding ;
Nitin Ama navahchoi ding hinam ?
Thisan thahat bou chu ahi.

songs.title: 252. I KNOW WHOM I HAVE BELIEVED (R.S. 617)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hallelujah (3) Vannoi huhhing ding apenge,
Hallelujah (3) Khosam’un leng Christa pen thu.
Hallelujah Christa min chu,
Hallelujah atonsot in;

Chorus
Loupi hen (3)
Vannoi gamtin’a loupi hen.
2 Hallelujah (3) Chitin namtin kipah-un,
Hallelujah (3) Tonsot in Jesu loupi hen.

Verse 3
Hallelujah (3) Pakai Christa hungkit inte,
Hallelujah (3) Van gam mihemte ding hi hen.

Verse 4
Hallelujah (3) Chamna Pakai Jesu min’in,
Hallelujah (3) Chamna le lungmon um jing hen.

songs.title: 252. KALAM MUTHIM JING’A KON HIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat d. (Psalms 34:6)

Verse 1
Ka lam muthim jinga kon hin,
Ka hunge Nang hengah ;
Nangma vahchoi din kahunge,
Navah emsel jonin.

Chorus
Vo Jesu, Pathen Kelngoinou,
Ka chunga naphatna ;
Nangma milungsetna jal’in,
Ka kinem e keima.

Verse 2
Lung lengvaiyin kahin bel’e,
Na lungset thu gingchan ;
Nei lungsetna o nem kajai,
Na thisan lon kamui.

Verse 3
Chonse kalung thim sunga hin,
Lhagaovin na tong hen ;
Na thu kavon le ka thaomei,
Ka hinna hijing hen.

Verse 4
Pakai neihil’in na o ngei,
Chonset thim noiya hin ;
Ka kinepna le kahinna,
Ka tonsot la hihen.

songs.title: 253. LHATDAM KAHI O KALHAGAO
songs.lyrics:
S.S. 864.
Doh is B. Flat (Isaiah 43:1)

Verse 1
Lhatdam kahi O ka lhagao,
Vahchoiyin na-Pakai ;
Eihuhhingpa ka dinga thi,
Akom’a cholnga ding.

Chorus
Lhatdam kahi (2 vei)
Avahchoi la sange ;
I-Paklai chu vahchoi jinge,
Aman eihuhhing tai.

Verse 2
Calvary thing Cross chu kaven,
Hinna twi alonge ;
Kalung thenglou asoptheng tai,
Sange avahchoi la.

Verse 3
Kabat jouse eisah peh tai,
Pakai thahatna chun ;
Ka chonset sop thenga twi chu,
Pakai thisan ahi.

songs.title: 253. WE ARE BUT LITTLE CHILDREN (S.S. 1139)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chapang neocha cha kahiuve
Mun loupia peng ka um pouve;
Hinla Jesu Lhandampu hin,
Anatong din eipan piuve.

Verse 2
Christian chapangten nitin’a,
Dougal tamtah isat ding’u;
Setna jouse nemse dingin,
Vo Jesu keiho nei panpin.

Verse 3
Christian chapang’in Cross pu-a,
Hesoh le kichat ito diu;
Jesu juiyun Anatong’un,
Akom’a ilhun theina din.

songs.title: 254. KHATBOU AHI EILHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flatsl
(Matt. 23:8).

Verse 1
Khat bou ahi Eilhandampu nunnem chu,
Ama lungsetna kikan ihiuve ;
Alungsetna chun eisuhal kit’u hen,
Meiyin kong hen mit kit louhel dingin.

Chorus
Jesu minin sopite hunguvin,
Kun’u hite I-lamkaipau anga ;
Kun’u hite A-ang sunga nemheuvin,
Aloupina ichoi-at kahseuvin.

Verse 2
Khat bou ahi Pakai ijen dingu chu,
Asei thu mangun juiyun nitinin ;
Jabol’ute aponlap che nung juiyin,
Amintheng nunnom hen atonsot’in.

Verse 3
Khat bou ahi chungnungpen le loupipen,
Ama milungset chungnung neunnem pen ;
Ja-tah in anung juiyin ponlap leh-un,
Tonsot in Amintheng nunnom hen.

songs.title: 254. THE SEED OF LIFE
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
I-lungsung set thim jing noiya,
Hinna muchi ki-tu chu;
Pah ding le ga ngei dinga,
Vetup dingin thupeh ahin;
Hinna Lallukhuh lo dingin.
Pakai Jesu Lhagao hinsol’in,
Nangma dinga pah namtui hunghi ngei theiya;
Na Lallukhuh jemhoi dingin,
Ka hinnau sutheng sel’in.

Verse 2
Nagam genthei le nam lengvai,
Hinna Gospel thutheng pha;
Pah ding le ga ngei dinga,
Vetup dingin thupeh ihiu;
Chonphatna Lallukhuh lo din.

Verse 3
Pakai Lhagaova konlou chu,
Chihna le themna lalna;
Dan pha le chonphatna dan,
Lunggil’a hung pah ding ngei chu
Setna gallen ahung soh tai.

Verse 4
Ngailutnan kot lentah ahong,
Van leng kin bolna dingin;
Twi vat khat le thing hal khat,
Mukham hilou tincheng ho hi;
Van gam gouva sodoh theina.

songs.title: 255. ITHAO TWIYU ADIM NADEM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. (Matt. 25:6)

Verse 1
Ithao twiyu adim nadem Pakai hung tengle,
Ithaomei vah-u chim nantem Pakai hung tengle ;
Chu che jan loupi tah-a,
Ithaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.
O kiging un (3 vei)
Pakai hungna ding.

Verse 2
Kitamto O kija nantem Pakai hung tengle,
Kipa nopna ogin thong ding Pakai hung tengle ;
Chuche jan loupi tah-a,
Ithaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung tengle.

Verse 3
Geisang louvin kiging phaute Pakai hung tengle,
Kise khenna phat hunglhung ding Pakai hung tengle ;
Chuche jan loupi tah-a,
Ithaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung teng leh.

Verse 4
Kipana nikho hi nantem Pakai hung tengle,
Halleluijah kipana hiding Pakai hung teng ;
Chu jan chu kipana jan,
Ithaomei vah chim nantem Pakai hung teng leh.

songs.title: 255. KEI CHONSET JAL’IN.
256. PAUL KHOLJIN LA.
256. THE HANDWRITING ON THE WALL.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Dan. 5.5)

Verse 1
Belshazar le asemang pachong akivah laiyun,
Houin theng sana khon ho chu amangun ju adon’ui ;
Ajan chun leng insunga mu kidangtah amuvin,
Inpi tijat in alotai, hichu Pathen khut ahi.

Chorus
Bang sun chu Pathen khut ahi, (2 vei)
Akisun chu koiman helou ;
Mijouse lungdong jouta,
Bang hinsun chu Pathen khut ahi.

Verse 2
Sohchang Daniel mihang chu leng anga agadingin,
Lengpa khansetna lentah chu asosal’in aphoh tai ;
Akisun chu asimin leng le mipi ngui jouta,
“Tua pat in lenggam abeitai; tin Daniel in ale tai”

Verse 3
Pathen thaneina le hanna chu Daniel apei,
Tichun lung olmo louhel’in achenna Juda gam le ;
Asohchanna gama jong milen le mineo anga,
A-Pathen khutsut asim thei banga, kisun chu ahi.

Verse 4
Hiche khut chun asun cheh eiho chonna jouse jong,
Milen le mineo mochanna phat hunglhung tei ding ahi ;
Hijeh chun nang michonse lungheiyin Jesu anga,
Themmo nachan louna dingin pellin banga kisun chu.

songs.title: 257. KANGAINOM’E CHRISTA THUSIM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat (Hos. 3:6)

Verse 1
Kangai nome Christa thusim,
Mihem alungsetna thusim ;
A mihuhhing thusim kidang,
Lungset jal’in keidin athi.
Christa thusim kidang (2 vei)
A mihuhhing thusim kidang,
Lungset jal’in kei din athi.

Verse 2
Kangai nome Christa thusim,
Athen le aloupina chu ;
Pathen Lhagaovin eihil hen,
Kalung sunga hin cheng jing hen.

Verse 3
Kangai nome Christa thusim,
Pakai toh kilhon khom kahi ;
Amun tina a o kajai,
Tahsan det dingin eideiye.

Verse 4
Kangai nome Christa thusim,
Ahaona le aloupina ;
Alenggam loupi khangtou ding,
Chamna Lengpa chu hung kit ding.

songs.title: 257. KIPANA CHRISTMAS LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungset them chungnung Pathen loupi hen,
Kum lhunga einahoi dam jal’un;
Tun Christa Leng loupi pen imu tauve,
Asempa pen nia kipah lou ding koi ham?

Chorus
Kipah-in lem’ute,
Chungnung pen Chapa Christa chu;
Aniseh in lem jingu hite,
Tonsot in loupi jing hen.

Verse 2
Tunin chitin namtin kipah inte,
Alungset na jal’in;
Kum sunga ahinkho lhing chu avangpha,
Tua damsel’a umsen Pa vahchoiyute.

Verse 3
Kum sunga itohnau ga kimuta,
Hichu Pathen lungset jal ahi;
Hijeh chun nanei jousen lem’un Christa,
Nalung, nanei, na aw thon hung lem’uvin.

Verse 4
Vo chungnung pen milungset them Pathen,
Houbung tin phatthei nan malsom’in;
Tua kipana jinga pahbang molkit thei,
Van gam’a kipanan kemtih nei talou.

songs.title: 258. HIN NIKHO LHIN KA NGA JING CHU
258. KUM ASOT UM NGAILOU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chung van gam’a ka in gotsa um,
Ana ngaito din Pakai cheta;
Lhatdamna gam nom’a chun,
Lhatdam sa lungset te toh;
Loikhom’a vahchoi la sa jing dingin.
Kum asot um ngailou,
Kipana gam’a chun;
Gim genthei um talou,
Chu mun’a chu khatvei ichen ding.

Verse 2
Kei dingin Lhandampu hung thita,
Ka lhagao huhdohna ding jeh-in;
Set dimna leisetna hin,
Keiya kon’a peldoh ding;
Van gam nom hoitah a cheng jing dingin.

Verse 3
Phat tampi che jing ding o Pakai,
Keima nei vop jinge ti kahei;
Mang louhel’in Pakaiyin,
Ichenkhom nadiu lim’a;
Vetnom, vetda umlou chamna lengta.

Verse 4
Chung gam nom sana khopia chun,
Lhilon hesoh genthei um talou;
Kipana la sa jing ding,
Chol le nan beisoh ta ding,
Nunnom jing ding chu gam in nom’a chun.

songs.title: 259. PHAT AKEM’E LEISETNA HIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat akem’e leisetna hin,
Kipah in lem’ute kipa ni akem’e;
Phat kiheiyin nang ngah lou ding,
Hinlai dam sungin Pakai vahchoiyin;
Leiset golnop hi ima hilou,
Lem’u hite Leng Christa,
Hinlai dam sungin.

Verse 2
Leiset molsang ngui chunga hin,
Genthei nan eibom’e, goldei kikhenna mun;
Nikhat kipan nomlen jong leng,
Ken jom joulou O ka chenna mun;
Ka pallai ni kem theilou hile,
Golto lengkhom’a Pakai,
Ken vahchoi jing ding.

Verse 3
Kipah-ute phat kem sungin,
Lei kipa thanopna pah bangin amolji;
I-kikhen teng lunghel umjin,
Kou kit theilou hinkho chomcha hi;
Kagal dot-e van khonom tolsung,
Kikhen lunghel um talou ding,
Mithengte laiya.

songs.title: 259. VEN LHANDAMPU CALVARY CROSS
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat m. (Isaiah 45:22)

Verse 1
Ven Lhandampu Calvary Cross chunga,
Nang le kei din genthei athoh tai ;
Lungset tah-in nang nakou ngaiyin,
Tahsanin sangin.
Tahsan in sangin, (2 vei)
Cross chunga hinna twi alonge,
Tahsanin sangin.

Verse 2
I chonsetnau jouse asoptheng tai,
Lhatdam ichan theina dinguvin ;
Jesun hinna kot chu ahong tai,
Tahsanin sangin.

Verse 3
Ven Lhandampu lhan’a kon athoutai,
Aheng jonin mun a on-lai hin ;
Mai lhaisel’a nang na lhamon ding,
Tahsanin sangin.

Verse 4
Tun chung van nom’a Jesu acheng tai,
Gentheite hesohna ve jingin ;
Nang jong chu gama napui tou ding,
Tahsanin sangin.

songs.title: 260. JESUS BLESSED JESUS
260. KEIMA CROSS SEPAI CHU KAHI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl

Verse 1
Keima Cross sepai chu kahi,
Pakai seijui kahi ;
Akin’a pang ding kicha lou,
Amin seichoi lenge.

Chorus
Det tah-in dingun,
Kipa man sanna dingin ;
Det tah-in dingun,
Lallukhuh hoi isan diu.

Verse 2
Vanna kipaman sanna din,
Midang kitet lai hin ;
Keima ka kicholdo ding ham,
Hiche leiset chunga

Verse 3
Kadin leiya dou ding atam,
Thisan lui noh kahi ;
Keiman leiya gol kanei poi,
Pakai bou eihu ding.

Verse 4
Keiman manong ting dou vinge,
Pakaiyin tha nei pen ;
Genthei hesoh ding kaging poi,
Nei panpin Pakaiyin.

songs.title: 261. GOSPEL KHOLJIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo Gospel kholjin hoilam’a che ding nahim?
Nangma ngaiya dangchah sang tamtah aum tai;
Mu jinga mulou le ja jinga jalou hon,
Nathil bol thei lhatdamna ngah jingui.

Chorus
Mol le lhang sang jongle che ding kahi,
Pakai thupeh juilou thei kahipoi;
Angailutnan eisol kacham louvin,
Pakai natoh kakin ahi.

Verse 2
Setna soh-in mi sangja thimnoiya aum,
Calvary sochatna niso lam helouvin;
Gotmunna che din lhem lungmongin Satan in,
Ache jingui aw Gospel kou loiyin.

Verse 3
Gospel kouna sang nomlou jousete ho chu,
Ka le hagelna thoh unte tonsot geiyin;
Chu-a kisih jongleu ngaidam chang talou ding,
Achung uva tonsot themmo chuta.

Verse 4
Aw sopite Gospel kouna sang loiyute,
Gospel lahtou ni ding Rapture ni anai tai;
Tahsan chate jouse chu-gam’a lengunte,
Choldouvinte Hallelujah tiuvin.

songs.title: 261. VANGSETNAN EIPHAHEN LANG.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Vangsetnan eipha hen lang,
Twilen kinong bang jongle ;
Kei lungmongin um nange,
Khopi hui hung nung jongle ;
Kong kaina phatah kanei,
Tonsot’a seithei lou ding.
Ka kong ngahmun adet nai,
Khopihui hung nung jongle ;
Ka ngahmun neo jeng jongle,
Ken lhahchomna neilou ding,
Adet nai ka kong kaina mun chu.

Verse 2
Kavel’a twipi kinong,
Vangsetna tamtah soh thei ;
Ichung meijin le thim soh,
Twipi kiting hung sang cheh ;
Hiche mun’a um kahi,
Ka kong kaina adet nai.

Verse 3
Gentheina tah mun’a hin,
Hesoh nan eichup jongle ;
Hui mut’in thi thei jong leng,
Ken kaki topi ngam nai ;
Niseh-in thim jeng jongle,
Kong kaina phatah kanei.

songs.title: 262. GAM LA-CHOINA. (R.S. 311)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka lenna gam leiset hi,
Tolthing na noulai bangin;
Nou jing hen bolna tolsung,
Lenna gam tolthing sahei.

Chorus
Ka lenna gam leiset hi,
Chung Pathen vangpeh chang hen;
K.C.C. khangthahte din,
Pa vahchoina hijing hen.

Verse 2
Ka penna lhanghoi gam hi,
Nunnom’in kithang jing hen;
Tolthing ngui Saron pah-in,
Chullouvin chansoh jing hen.

Verse 3
Gol to ka lenna gam hi,
K.C.C. lenkhong ginna;
Hi jing hen atonsot in,
Christa vahchoina hi hen.

Verse 4
Mol lah-a mol hoi chungnung,
Lhang lah-a lhang hoi chungnung;
Pakai vahchoina aw gin,
Thong jing hen nagam sunga.

songs.title: 262. JESU THISAN’IN KATHENG TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s
(Rev. 21:4)

Verse 1
Jesu thisanin katheng tai,
I kimu to diu luigalla ;
Kipah tah-a ikikhop diu,
Kikhen kitna umta louding, luipi kinong gal’a.
Luipi kinong gal’a (3 vei)
I-kimu to cheh diu ; (4 vei)
Kikhen kitta lou ding.

Verse 2
Kavan innom kalung mit’in,
Kamui iham ken kagin ding ;
“Nalhi thehhul ding Pathenin”
Tin vantilte sei o kajai, luipi kinong gal’a.

Verse 3
Chua ngai chengto kimu ding,
Iti thanop aum tadem ;
Kotpi hoi le tolpi nom chu,
Anop ahoi chul talou ding, luipi kinong gal’a.

Verse 4
Ka ngai Lhandampun eipui le,
Keijong chu gamnom kalhun ding ;
Bang louvin ken vahchoi tange,
Genthei lengvai umtalou ding, luipi kinong gal’a.

songs.title: 263. JERUSALEM THAH A CHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungjinna ni lhomcha nung teng,
Thohna chom chakhat jou tengle;
Loupi in in jon tau hite,
Jerusalem thah a chun.

Chorus
Ngailut ngailutna lungsetna (3)
Jerusalem thah a chun;
O Jordan kaina lampi (3)
Jerusalem thah a chun.

Verse 2
Kipa man chang ding che ho toh,
Aleng gam chang ding miho hi;
Nopna le gol khenlou na mun,
Jerusalem thah a chun.

Verse 3
La ka sah le ka lha among,
Pakaiyin eilhat chu monpin;
Kalung thim lhan aleng galkai,
Jerusalem thah a chun.

Verse 4
Mitheng ho chu ponbang sil’in,
Leng ang’a selangdah tum toh;
O chu gam’a len ka nom’e,
Jerusalem thah a chun.

songs.title: 263. VO PATHEN KHANGLUI KI-NGAINA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Psalms. 90 : 1)

Verse 1
Vo Pathen khanglui ki-ngaina,
Tua khangthah kinepna ;
Khopi huiya Nang ka hinnau,
Ka tonsot inpiu Nang.

Verse 2
Na laltouna limdam noiya,
Na mithengte acheng ;
Na ban khat jeng jonga lhing thei,
Ka kulpi dinguvin.

Verse 3
Mol le lhang kikhen masanga,
Leigum um masanga ;
Tonna pat Nang Pathen hing jing,
Kikhel lou tonsot’a.

Verse 4
Nangma mit mum kum sang jong hi,
Jing khat jong lhing joulou ;
Kei hon “Tu masang, tu nung” ting,
Nangin “Tun” nati jing ;

Verse 5
Phat hin luipi long jing bangin,
Mihem len mangpi jing ;
Jan mang jinga aman bangin,
Mihem mel mang jita.

Verse 6
Vo Pathen khanglui kingaina,
Tua khangthah kinepna ;
Eichingpau le tonsot inpi,
Hi jingin tonsot, in.

songs.title: 264. KHANGUN THOUVUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Christa dinga hing kahitai kadam sungin,
Van leng Pakai palai kahi moh um ponge;
Thu kidang tah chamna thupha hom ding kahi,
Hesoh ingting genthei jongleng cholnga ponge.

Chorus
Ka hechen tai ka mopohna ka hechen tai,
Pakaiyin einganse na thil ho jouse chu;
Het them lou ho eingaidam in aw ka Pakai,
Tongjing tange Pakai hatna songin.

Verse 2
Aw ka Pakai thimnoiya tou misang tampi,
Nang lha ngaiya natwi don nom lhagao dangchah;
Hinpui doh-in na natong ding mi alhom’e,
Huhhing in lang ngaidam in aw Calvarya.

Verse 3
Aw Lhandampu natoh bangkhai nadalhah ho,
Tongjom peh dia neisol ahi neipanpin lang;
Natohna le genthei naho kageldoh le,
Nathingpel pun sei choilenge vannoiya hin.

Verse 4
Kadam laini twimei banga phat chomcha hi,
Boina twipi kinong banga lhepna lah-a;
Dou jou dingin thahat neipen Lhagao theng chun,
Neikai hoiyin hatlou kahi o Lhandampu.

songs.title: 264. LUIGAL LAM’A GAMNOM EMHOI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat sl
(Song of Solomon 5:16)

Verse 1
Luigal lam’a gamnom emhoiya chun,
Loupi tah-in mi sangja kikhom ;
Ahivangin vanna loupi pen pa chu,
Koitoh kiten tem Lhandampu chu !

Chorus
Ama asang aja lah-a lamkai,
Samun avahchoina o sangin ;
Ama chu Pakai deipen ahijeh-in,
Atonsot’in Ama vahchoiyun.

Verse 2
Pakai dei chungnung pen ngai chungnung pen,
Aman nakouve o nem heochan ;
Vo kalha ngaiyin na sochatna Thupha,
Manbeiyin kisanin sochatna.

Verse 3
Pakai dei chungnung pen ngai chungnung pen,
Ngaiyin o nem heochan nakouve ;
Jesun “Hungin pohgih genthei kahenga,
Seplhan kicholdon” tin eikouve.

songs.title: 265. ENTHRONE IS JESUS NOW. S.S. 136.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Rev. 7 : 2)

Verse 1
Jesun lengvai apoi,
Van Laltouna chunga ;
Alua lallukhuh akhuh-in,
Ama amithengte.

Chorus
Loupia lhatdamsate,
Avel’a akikhom ;
I-lungna chimsoh ding ; ol olle,
Ol olle (2 vei) ilungna chimsoh ding ol olle.

Verse 2
Mipi simsen lou chu,
Ading vah emsel’in ;
Lal tenggol kiphu cheh-uvin,
Vahchoi la asauve.

Verse 3
Kelngoinou lem la san,
Adiuva thipa chu ;
Athisan lutah a konin,
Lallukhuh akhuh-ui.

Verse 4
Lungsetna Lhagao Theng,
Na phattheina hin lhan ;
Chuche van gammom tah-a chu ,
Ka lhah theina diuvin.

songs.title: 265. GOL LHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Christa min’a kangai chullou,
Lungset um ngei napal lai hi;
Pakai Christa gon bangin,
Ache tai tunin nakhang hoi.
Lampi thudih le hinna,
Jot in Pakai lungsetna noiya;
Damsel chan che tan o goldei.

Verse 2
Khangkhat pallai ache vangin,
Pakai gonpeh khang kit tenga;
Vangphatna tin na chunga,
Umjing hen o Christa min’in.

Verse 3
Ngailut thilpeh kanei joupoi,
Ngaidam aw nem ka thum’uve;
Nagun le Christa jal’in,
Sumil lou jen’in nagolte.

songs.title: 266. SOCHATNA KIPANA THUPHA HI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. s. (Eph. 1 : 7)

Verse 1
Sohchatna kipana Thupha hi,
Nang le kei dinga hinna thu ;
Pakai chu eiho chonset jal’in.
Thingpel chunga ahung thi tai.

Chorus
O michonse nangin tahsanin,
Sangin hiche hinna Thupha ;
Lhandampu Cross chunga thipa chun.
Nang jong napei sochatna thu.

Verse 2
Thina konin eihuhhing tauve,
Pathen chaten eisemtauve ;
Chonse dingin hinna lui along,
Kisop thengin thisan long chun.

Verse 3
Chonset’in vai neisot talou ding,
Chomkhat thu dinga bou ahi ;
Pakaiyin Ama thahatna chun,
Chonsetna jouse sumang ding.

Verse 4
Pathenin lungset tah-in nakou,
Tun Jesu heng lam jonin chen ;
Koi hijong le aheng jon chan chu,
Pakaiyin nol anei ngai poi.

songs.title: 266. WELCOME LA. (III Alex 105)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathen vangbohna jal’in tuni hin,
Lamto dingin ka hunguve;
Chol le nanga hung kalsong u le nao,
Banjet in ka sanguve.
Ka sanguve, ka lemuve,
Christa min’a hunga sopite nabon chauvin.

Verse 2
Mol le lhangin eikhan jeng jongu le,
Pa malsomnan eikan khom’ui;
I kimuto kit tauve tuni hin,
Nalung kipa sah cheh-un.

Verse 3
Mantih ni neilou hihen Welcome hi,
Akipatna joh bou hi hen;
Sim le mal’a Christa Houbung mite,
Pathenin ei umpiu hen.

Verse 4
Christa min’a hung kalsong sopite,
Kinem’in ka ngah jinguve;
I-toh khomnau jouse aboncha hin,
Christa min’in hijing hen.

songs.title: 267. JESUKALUNGIN KADEI PEN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Jesu kalungin kadei pen,
Vang neipeh chu muchen thei leng ;
O nadei bang tah-in neipen,
Nangma bou chu lungset theina.

Chorus
Lungthim giltah nei hin peuvin,
Na khopi hoi chu muna din ;
Ka lungthim hi hinvah sah-in,
Kei dinga um van’a Pathen,

Verse 2
Pathen Nangin kei neilungset,
Chonse ho jong nanga ahi ;
Kipah tah-in Nang ka sange,
Mu kanome nei lungsetna.

Verse 3
Kholmun olna gam nom’a chun,
Pahcha hoitah gamu jong leng ;
Lhagao hatmo hatsahna ding,
Na lungsetna kalhah umlou.

Verse 4
Lungset tah-in halna neipen,
Na gam loupi neimu sah-in ;
Na lhenchomte kipana ding,
Neihol nau chu neimu sah-in.

songs.title: 267. NAGAM NOM KA NGAIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hileiset gentheina gam’a hin,
Nopna gam le ngaite lenna;
Ka ngai ngeiye o ka Pakai,
Nopna umlou leiya.

Chorus
Na gam nom ka ngaiye,
Na lungset kinem’in;
Set le gimna gam;a,
Ka mong jou poi Pakai.

Verse 2
Hinna Lal thengpen Pakai Christa,
Nei lhamon’in nathisan chun;
Na thutep lhin ding ka ngah-e,
Sochatna hin kemlou.

Verse 3
Thina gal’a gamnom ka ngai chu,
Pakai sem gamnom chu ahi;
Hinna thingphung lim noiya chu,
Nisa vah jong ngailou.

Verse 4
Chitin namtin Pakai leng ho Leng,
Chamna le lung olna gam’a;
Nei lhut-in Salem thah nom’a,
Mithengte lenna a.

songs.title: 268. AW KA VAHCHOIYE PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lhang kumkho akihei tai,
Phai tidam hung lengin, gol hin puiyin.
Aw ka vahchoiye Pakai,
Aw na lemnan la kasai;
Lungset in tha nei peuvin,
Gen thei cha kahi.

Verse 2
Thing le louna apul tai,
Lungset’in tha neipen sollang nei khun.

Verse 3
Thi le lungdon beina gam,
Thisan a lhatsa te nei holnau gam.

Verse 4
Chu thisan jal chun Pakai,
Nei puilut in chung van mun lalna gam.

songs.title: 268. NITIN JESU KALUNGIN ANAIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat.

Verse 1
Nitin Jesu kalungin anaiye ti ken kahei,
Sana la jing ninou soh emsel sangin ahoijoi ;
Katah-in kamangin Ama chu ken kangai pen’e,
Nitin Ama ka ngailutna akhang tul tul jinge.

Chorus
Sana ….. lui pang emnoma,
Sana ….. luipeo ema ;
Chua Pakai cheng jing,
A hoina chullou tonsot’a.

Verse 2
La tah-a konin kamui Aloupi nan eisal’e,
Jing valpa le molhoi pah em sangin jong a emjoi ;
Hichun kalung ngai jouse alhingtai tin ken kahei,
Nitin Ama ka ngailutna akhang tultul jinge.

Verse 3
Kalung hesoh kom le Aman kei eilhamon jinge.
Aphei chunga eipomin Akhut’in eilhem biji ;
Ka setna ngaidam Christa chu iti kangai hitam,
Nitin Ama ka ngailutna akhang tul tul jinge.

songs.title: 269. HEROD LENGPA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Herod lengpa chule,
Amite jouse Jerusalem khopia;
Lungdonna meipin abom Leng apen chun,
Christa hoiya peng ham?

Verse 2
Juda gam Bethlehem,
I-sahlou hel’un aneopen jong hilou,
Ka mite ching ding khat peng ding ahi,
Tin themgaovin asei.

songs.title: 269. PAKAI CHRISTA LENG CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Rev. 19 : 16)

Verse 1
Pakai Christa Leng chu vahchoiyun,
Atonsot’in vahchoiyin um hen ;
Loupi jana ama a ahi,
Tun jong atonsot’in.

Chorus
Vahchoiyute, vahchoiyute,
Gam loupia Leng vahchoiyu hite ;
Vahchoi cheh-u hite ;
A lemnan o ging hen.

Verse 2
Chunga vantil sangjan alemui,
Laltouna kimin la asauve ;
Namtinin jomun kipana la,
Vahchoiyun Leng chungnung.

Verse 3
Chonset galjou Ama bou ahi,
Ichunguva Aman vaihom hen ;
Amin’a eiman jong ijo ding,
Tonsot’in Vahchoiyun,

songs.title: 270. MITLHI LONGA KIKHENNA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Mitlhi longa kikhenna umlou ding ol olle,
Chung Pathen gamnom ilhun tengule ol olle;
Vangil chung lam peh-a khun,
Haltah-in leng tau hite;
Chung Pathen vangkhoa chu Jesu to ol olle.

Verse 2
Kelngoinou thengtah chu ga kimunte ol olle,
Goldei kikhenpi sate ho kom’a ol olle;
Ama kivahchoi tante chu-a mitlhi hultante,
Lungdon lungjin mel kimu talou ding olle.

Verse 3
Goldei kikhen kitna um talou ding ol olle,
Leiya lungdonna bang hi umlou ding ol olle;
Molhoi pah pahna munna tonsotna ilen tengle,
Mitlhi lonna genthei umlou ding chutengle.

Verse 4
Mitlhi longa kikhenpisa goldeite chuto,
Thina mun gal’a gam hoi tah le nomtah a chu;
Kumsot’a kikhen kit louna a chengkhom tau hite,
Van gam nom’a chun kitha-ol taute tonsot’in.

Verse 5
Hiche leiset hi lungdonna le kana ahi,
Lenkhom’a mitlhi lonna le lelna mun ahi;
Lhagao khopi sunga chun nop le kipan lengtaute,
Van gam nom’a chun kitha-ol taute tonsot in.

Verse 6
O kalungdei kagolte, molpang lep tauvinte,
Ve jing ing ting kagolte mol alepkah seuvin;
Christan eiching jingu hen, ikimu kitkah seuvin,
Damsel’in aw chung Pathen malsom’in chetauvin.

songs.title: 270. MOLLE LHANG AMUNTIN’AMIN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. d. (I.Tim. 6 : 12)

Verse 1
Molle lhanga mun tina min,
Ngaiyun Gospel sumkon gin !
Lhagao tilkhouna thu ngaiyun,
Eikounau thupeh ahi.
Kigoltoh-un, galsat dingin, (2 vei)
Ngaiyun sumkonin nakou, ngaiyun, ngaiyun ;
Ngaiyun Christian sepai ten.

Verse 2
Kivon’uvin pakai galvon,
Ponlap loupi dom sangun ;
Thudih a galsat ihiu leh,
Vantilten eihu’vinte.

Verse 3
Mut gingun sumkon ging tah-in,
Samun galsat jona joy ;
“Jesu Christa din” tin samun,
Jona chu eiho chan ding.

songs.title: 271. ALUNGDONNA MUN HOL’UTE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Alungdonna mun hol’ute,
Pakai athohna chu;
Gethsemani hon sunga chun,
A-ul thisan along.

Chorus
Simon lungtohna chemjam chu,
Nadou jou lou ding ham?
Eilhandampu chu akaiyun,
Thempu Lal in sunga.

Verse 2
Linglukhuh le ponsan apei,
Tengin chibai boh-in;
Koi ham navo hinsei doh-in,
Tin ana donguve.

Verse 3
Eilhandampu ana lheh-e,
Kei dia nathoh na chu;
Michonse ten akhuh ngai poi,
Alallukhuh bang chu.

Verse 4
Chua mipi akikhom’e,
Pakai taitomte ho;
Lungdon lengvai naten abom,
Thingpel’a dom sangun.

songs.title: 271. THINALUIGAL’AKHOPI HOITAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.b. (Rev. 21 : 18)

Verse 1
Thina luigal a khopi hoitah aum’e,
Aloupije koiman seijou lou ;
Chua ni lhum ngailou thingna jong pul ngailou,
Chung sana khopi nomtah a chun.
Chua ni lhum ngailou thingna jong pul ngailou,
Chu gama chu Lhandampu le mithengte cheng ;
Chung sana khopi nomtah a chun.

Verse 2
Chung gama Leng chu Eihuhhingpa le Pakai,
Genthei molso chengtoh achengui ;
Chua chun ahsi bangin a emsel jingui,
Chung sana khopi nomtah a chun.

Verse 3
Lhagao mangsa Cross phunga lhutsoh uhite,
Kelngoi hon lah a lhalut ute ;
Hichu idinguva van Lallukhuh hi ding,
Chung sana khopi nomtah chun.

songs.title: 272. HALNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungdon olmo bol hih-uvin,
Keiman ka lhenchomte;
Kaina kong chu ahung lenge,
Mihem jouse um ding.

Verse 2
Van’a chenna in nom ahi,
Chua um ding ngaiton;
Valpa banga emjing dingin,
Nalungin gel jingun.

Verse 3
Lungthim thempa chondan hepa,
Chua um ding ahi;
Van gam loupi hin musah-in,
A ol molso dingin.

Verse 4
Veuvin ka lhanchomte veuvin,
Van lallukhuh hoi chu;
Koi san ding jong aum chom poi,
Nangho san ding ahi.

Verse 5
Keima mun theng hea tahsan,
Loute ka van gam’a;
Gam loupi chu hin heuvin tin,
Alunga cheng det ding.

Verse 6
Van gam loupi chenna ding chu,
Gotsa le lhensa um;
Jordan pang chu hin jot’un tin,
Jerusalem inna.

Verse 7
Jerusalem innom’a chun,
Pansa tauvin nate;
Van kulpi chu vel’un natin,
Sumkon mut un nate.

Verse 8
Lungdon hesoh nalunguva,
Chensah hih-un nanghon;
Hat le lungthim chu ngaitouvin,
Nitinin gel jingun.

Verse 9
Imajouse Lhandampu chun,
Ajou soh tai tun vang;
Bol’un bol’un aloupi chu,
Mun nomtah hisah-un.

songs.title: 272. JAN MUTHIM NOIYA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. s1
(Rev. 21:25)

Verse 1
Jan muthim noiya kilengsot talou ding,
Kotpi hoi akikhon tengle ;
Chung kho nom Christa vah-a ilen le ding,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle.
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle, (2 vei)
Pakai mu ding iti kipa um tantem ;
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle.

Verse 2
I-ngaiten kongkai muna ei-ngah jingui,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle ;
Setna kona che kei eina lamto ding,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle.

Verse 3
Nat hesoh genthei lungdon umtalou ding,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle ;
Goldei chengtoh kipah a kileng khom ding,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle.

Verse 4
Hinlai khankhon eisu lunggim talou ding,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle ;
I-chenkhom diu Christa toh chunggam noma,
Kotpi hoi akihon tengle.

songs.title: 273. JOSEPH LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka-pa toh kimu to hileng,
Ka lengvaina seisoh dinga;
Tunla kimu kitta pong ting,
Hoilam’a umkhen na hitam.
Lungset neilou tobanga ka-pan,
Ibol’a neisol hitam?

Verse 2
Ka-ute le ka-naote ho,
Ibol’a nei eng bol’u ham?
Kokhuh-a nei lelut phat un,
Athisa to kabang jeng tai.

Verse 3
Ishmael ho henga nei joh-un,
Mi soh-a che ding ka hitai;
Potiphar soh ka hijeh-in,
Tukal’in kimu tapoute.

Verse 4
Potiphar jinu phalou chun,
Numei jon lung aput jeh-in;
Jonpi dingin eina kaiyin,
Ka Pakaiyin eihuhdoh-in.

Verse 5
Pharaoh lengpa a ihmut nin,
Kidang tah-in mang aneiyin;
Ahungkhah phat in amang chu,
Abonchan ahaimil soh tai.

Verse 6
Songkul’a kon eikou doh-un,
Amang kidang le-peh ding chun;
Ka Pakaiyin eikithopin,
Amang chu ka-ledoh peh tai.

songs.title: 273. PATHEN’AKON KAGAMLA TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Matt. 11:21)

Verse 1
Pathen’a kon ka gamla tai,
Tun kahung kit tai ;
Chonset lama kache sot tai,
Pakai kahunge.

Chorus
Kahunge, kahunge,
Potdoh kit lou din ;
Lungset’in nanga hinge,
Pakai kahunge.

Verse 2
Kum lutah ka sumang sohtai,
Tun kahung kit tai ;
Lung kisih-in, ka hung kit tai,
Pakai kahunge.

Verse 3
Chonset vah len ka genthei tai,
Tun ka hung kit tai ;
Na lungset thu tahsan tange,
Pakai kahunge.

Verse 4
Kalha le kalung ana tai,
Tun kahung kit tai ;
Kipa le tha neipe kit’in,
Pakai kahunge.

songs.title: 274. KALUNG DEIPEN KA KIPANA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kalung deipen ka kipana,
Ahung peng hoisel’in;
Deichom tah-a kavet chimlou,
Kap in kikhen kitta.

Verse 2
Mihem semthu hilou beh-in,
Ahung peng hoisel’in;
Hileiset pap lah-a um din,
Jesun aphal tapoi.

Verse 3
Ipi dinga ilungset dem,
Apa kom lhung ding chu;
Van chung gam nom’a leng dingin,
Ipun apui tou tai.

Verse 4
Tuhin kap in kikhen jongle,
Kipa kamu kit ding;
Van chung gamnom gim le genthei,
Lungdon beina gam’a.

songs.title: 274. NASET THISAN BANG JONGLE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat.
(Isaiah. 1:8)

Verse 1
Naset thisan bang jongle,
Buhbang sanga bangjo ding ;
Thisan sangin san jongle.
Kelngoi mul bang ding ;
Naset thisan bang jongle, (2)
Buhbang sang bangjo ding, (2)

Verse 2
O’n nakouve ngai phauvin,
Hung kilen Pathen hengah ;
Lungset khoto them ahi,
Lungset len ahi ;
O’n na kouve ngai phauvin, (2)
Hung kilen Pathen hengah, (2)

Verse 3
Na chonset angaidam tai,
Lungin jong gelkit hih-in ;
“Keima heng lam hin veuvin,
Pakaiyin ati ;
“Na chonset angaidam tai,” (2)
Lungin jong gelkit hih-in. (2)

songs.title: 275. GANTHEIYA VAHCHOLTE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. d. (Psalms. 30:5)

Verse 1
Gentheiya vahchoite kipah-uvin,
Kipa jing anai tai !
Pathen Ama tah-in eiseipeh-ui,
Kipa jing anai tai !

Chorus
Kipana jing anai tai !
Kipana jing anai tai !
Kana jan khat kal hilou ding,
Kipa jing ninou hungsoh ding.

Verse 2
Mitheng ten tijat lungdon pailhauvin,
Kipa jing anai tai !
Genthei lengvaiyin nalhi theh ngimin ;
Kipa jing anai tai !

Verse 3
Lungdonna jankho hungvah loi tading,
Kipa jing anai tai !
Kidang tah a jing ninou hungsoh ding
Kipa jing anai tai !

Verse 4
Kipah tah-in jingthou cheh-u hitem,
Kipa jing anai tai !
Pathenin ilhiu jouse thehhul ding,
Kipa jing niso teng.

songs.title: 275. PAKAI JESU PEN LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nilhah khat Bethlehem’a,
Kelngoi ching gam geh hon;
Ihmu louva touva ahoulim petuvin.

Verse 2
Khangkim in van’a konin,
Vantil khat ahung kumlhan;
Nisah vah sanga vahjon akimvel salvah-in.

Verse 3
Kicha hih-un kelngoi ching ho,
Na kelngoiyu dalhauvin;
Cheleu chun bong an konga gamuvin nate.

Verse 4
Kicha hih-un kelngoi ching ho,
Keiman mijouse din;
Hinna thupha sei dinga hung kahi ati.

Verse 5
Chujouvin Vantil chu,
Vantil dang sang japi chuto;
Pathen vahchoi la asan van’a akal tauve.

Verse 6
Jesu vannoi leisetna,
Naosen’a ahung pen thu;
Matthew le Luke lekha simleu chun hennate.

Verse 7
Jesu setna nei louvin,
Mihem’a apen jeh-in;
Michonse kei jal’in genthei thoh-in athi.

Verse 8
Ollha ni somni le ngam nin,
Jingkah in ka thouvin;
IMMANUEL la kasauve.

Verse 9
Chule chapang jouse tunia,
Pakai golnop ni hin;
Hitin Jesu alunguva lut din ataovui.

songs.title: 276. ILENNAU HILEISET HI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ilennau hileiset hi,
Lungjinna le kana bou;
Pah bang pah-in amolji,
O Salem thah hung naiyin.

Chorus
Lungjin lungdonna gal’a,
Kipana gam nom’a chun;
O i-tih le ilhung dem,
Lhandampu mun semna chu.

Verse 2
Chonsetna lhepna meipi,
Ajing jinge o Pakai;
Nalungset loupi tah chun,
Nei lhamon mihem lah-a.

Verse 3
Ka ngaiye Pakai nagam,
Lei lungdon gam munna hin;
Olna umlou leisetna,
Nagam ngaiyin kakap jing.

Verse 4
Lei pah hoina pul loiyin,
I-hin nikhou akem jing;
Ajoule chugam lhun teng,
Kipan pah chul lou ding.

songs.title: 276. KA NGAI NOM’E JESU THUSIM NGEI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Flat. (Psalms. 89 : 1)

Verse 1
Kangai nome Jesu thusim ngei,
Huhhingpa kidang tah ahi ;
Chonse lhatna thi geiya thoh pa,
Ken seilenge avel vel’in.
O thusim ngei, thusim ngei kidang,
Chullouva kisei thusim ngei ;
Loupin seithang jing tange,
Thusim ngei kidang hi ;
Amel hoi kamu na a chun.

Verse 2
Van mun loupia konin hung kum lhan,
Athisanin eilhat tauve ;
Tonsot hinna eichoh peh tauve,
Huhhing thahat chungnung ahi.

Verse 3
Ami hepina luiyin along,
Ami ngailutje tena bei ;
Alungset tonsot geiya lhingset,
Hichun keijong eihuhhing tai.

songs.title: 277. KILHAHNA LA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat hi akem jing leisetna hin,
Kipani akem mangloiyin;
Goldei cheng kikhenna ni alhungjin,
Lunglen puldou anai leisetna.

Chorus
Damsel cheh-un u-le naote,
Banjal jetnin kalhauve golte;
O Pakai Jesun eiching jingu hen,
Goldei ikimu kit kahseuvin.

Verse 2
Ikikhenna din kolni asoh,
Kap in lonlhi sosah jongleu hen;
Kikhen lou thei chu ihipouve gol,
Ilennau mun hi adanjeh in.

Verse 3
Lhandampun eiching jing jengu hen,
I-lennau mol le lhang dang jongle;
Alungsetnan eikankhom jingu hen,
Khat cheng chengin eiching jingu hen.

Verse 4
I-hinlai nikho hi akem jing,
Goldei ikikhenpi ho jong chu;
Ahinkho alhingin mol lep jita,
I-kimu kit teng golcheng kimlou.

Verse 5
Hileiset hi kikhenna bou hin,
Salem gamnom ilhun tengu le;
Lunghel’a kikhenna umtalou ding,
Chu-a kimu gingchan ka lhauve.

songs.title: 277. PATHEN MILUNGSET VAHHOI CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. s1
(Matt. 5 : 14)

Verse 1
Pathen mi lungset vah hoi chu,
Ahung kikho emsel’in ;
Avah chun eisalvah jingui,
I sochatna dinguvin.

Chorus
Na thomei devah jinguvin,
Vahsah-in twipi gal jong ;
Chonsetna thi ding atam’e,
Nang chen ga huhhing loiyin.

Verse 2
Leiya chonset thimpi ajing,
Twikhanglen kinong bangin ;
Panpi ngai sangja aume,
Vah kengin gahuh doh-in.

Verse 3
Na thaomei devah-in lang chen,
Lhagao mangthai ding atam ;
Sochatna Thupha hom jalin,
Muthima mangthah theiho.

songs.title: 278. BIBLE THUDIH AHI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Bible thudih ahi, (2)
*Lungsetna kot kihon sung hin;
Hung lut in gam thenga. (3) D.C.

Verse 2
Dan sese mi sugampa thu kipe ahi,
*Ahung lhung tai lhenchomte lah;
Genthei lhiso ka-na. (3) D.C.

Verse 3
Phat nitin’in akem,
Hinkho jong nitin kem;
*Christa to nom’a lenna din,
Ka hinkho lhing loi hen. (3) D.C.

songs.title: 278. CHOIYUN PAKAI KIPAH-IN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. d. (Psalms. 150:2)

Verse 1
Choiyun Pakai kipah-in Hosana tin,
Vahchoiyun kipah tah-in ;
Dom sangun lang nalungu kipah tah-in,
Phongjal’uvin Amintheng chu;
Kijot’uvin aponlap lim noiya,
Ama ging chauvin nache pumun.
Alungsetna vah-in eisalvah jing ding,
Akhut’a eikaile jing ding tu le tonsot’na.
Long louvin kijot’un,
Ponlap leh-un ichungu vah ;
Long louvin kijot’un,
Sau hite kipana la chu ;
Long louvin kijot’un,
Meibang lompi imauva achei ;
Gam loupile chung khopi,
I phah mauvin.

Verse 2
Vahchoiyute Ama tonsot Leng ahi,
Loupi hen chunga Pathen ;
Lemmun Pakai alungsetna seiphongun,
Jom’uvin chunga lathah chu ;
Kijot’uvin vahchoiyun kijot’un,
Cheu hite Jesu toh kiloi din ;
Lhatdamte kikhopna in nomtah a chun,
Lhandampu chu kivahchoi ding tonsot tonsot’a.

songs.title: 279. GAM NGAI UM LE KHOTHENG NOM.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam ngai um le khotheng nomtah chu,
Aw lhagao lungdong chu gam hol’in;
Chu mun’a chun hinna thing le Pakai,
Van mithengte chun nalem’un.

Chorus
Aw chugam em nom’a ilen diu,
Lhandampu le van mithengte lenna gam’a;
Hinna lungmonna twi don’u hite,
Gam ngai um chu ilhun diu.

Verse 2
Khopi hoi le Lhandampu mel chu,
Vahchoina selangdah gin ngei tum’un;
Akipanau pah namtuiyin pah-in,
Lei lungdonna gam ngai louvin.

Verse 3
Lhandampu le mithengte lenna,
Gam ngai um le goldeite kimna gam;
Selung lengin kagaldot nitin’in,
Aw ka ngai gol laiya len ding.

songs.title: 279. KAPAPATHEN KALAMVAI TENG.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. s1
(Matt. 6:10)

Verse 1
Kapa Pathen kalamvai teng.
Kalung sunga lam neihil’in ;
Nangma thu bou ken ngah inge,
“Nang lung hinge,

Chorus
”
“Nang lung hinge”, (2 vei)
Kalungin sei hen neihil’in ;
“Nalung hinge.”

Verse 2
Gentheiya kachang lhat tengle,
Goldei jouse umji talou ;
Nang bou ka kingaina nahi,
“Nang lung hinge.”

Verse 3
Ka ngaiye kalung hesoh teng,
Lhagao Theng eilhamon dingin ;
Vo ka-Pathen Nang ka ngansei,
“Nang lung hinge.”

Verse 4
Thinan kamit asin tengle,
Ka vangam ken hinjon tange ;
Luigal gam nom hungkai tange,
“Nang lung hinge.”

songs.title: 280. THOUVUN THOUVUN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Ps. 97 : 1)

Verse 1
Thouvun thouvun, kipana thu lan hungsan,
Thouvun thouvun, alemna la hi hung jomun ;
Thouvun, thouvun leichung kipa adim tai,
Chung lam vah-in lei hi asalsoh tai ;
Amol, alhang, dam phai kipah in agingsoh tai,
Thilsem jousen asempau alemui.
Chonset ajousoh-in Jehovah alal tai,
Nomun, nomun kipah-uvin Jehovah Leng ;
Agam thahat phongun leiset chunga,
Aloupina ponlap dom sanguvin ;
Aleng chang tai nomun, nomun,
Nomun, Jehovah Leng.

Verse 2
Tumun, bengun kipa nopdah khongpi,
Avel vel’in seiyun sauvin kipa nahi ;
Leiyin ajom soh kahsen seiyun sauvin,
Vantil ho toh kitoh-in jom cheh-un ;
Chonset thina konin ahuhhing tai leiset hi,
Tonsot hinna kipa lan hung lemun.

songs.title: 280. VEUVIN LHANDAMPU PAKAI CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin Lhandampu Pakai chu,
Gimna thing chung chu angah-e;
Kei jong Lhandampu neipuiyin,
Ka lenna gam genthei umna.

Chorus
Lhepna gam tin’a umte chun,
Aw Pakai ka vahchoi joupoi;
Vantil thengte tahsan bangtah,
Ka gel ni hin hung lhung tahen.

Verse 2
Ve tem’un hinna ding lam chu,
Jot ahahsat sahlou koi ham?
Pakai van Lhagao puilou chun,
Koiyin ajot lhung thei ding ham?

Verse 3
Itih tah le kamu tadem?
Ka ngahlel lei gentheina kon;
Nom’a kalen ding kinem’in,
Aw eilungsetnau gamtep chu.

songs.title: 281. AW NOPPI NI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoiya hatna kapu Jesu Christa,
Van’a Lalmun hin dalhan gim le da thoh din;
Gim ding ahet jeng vangin,
Hilam chu gel louvin kapa Jesu Christan.
Aw noppi nin (3)
Ka-Pu ahunge.

Verse 2
Vaicha nungah laigil’a pengin Jesu,
Mihem bangin naosen voudam ahinloi;
Bethlehem kholai sunga,
Hi-a chun ka-Pu soh in mihem lim aloi.

Verse 3
Pathenin Acha ahinsol ave jinge,
Chonchan lhitnan pap miho sochatna din;
Lhagao Theng manna lungthim.
Leiya chengin bol’in eivetsah leuve.

Verse 4
Kum thum porsal bol’in eijahsah leuve,
Chu-in thingpel’a thin mitlhi soh-in Lhanpu;
Buikhuh a nithum lum’in,
Alaltouna toukit din Van gam ajon tai.

songs.title: 281. CHU LUIGAL’ACHUN EIKOUVUI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.s. (Heb. 12:1)

Verse 1
Chu luigal’a chun eikouvui,
Ka ngai chimlou goldei ten ;
Amaho ken muloi tading,
Kikhen kit um talou ding.

Chorus
Chu luigal gam nom hoi Eden,
In loupi em hoiya chun ;
Vantil ten kei eipuitou ding,
Jesun eina lamto ding.

Verse 2
Chu luigal’a chun eikouvui,
Eikounau O nem kajai ;
Jing niso huilhi nem nung jing,
Kalung sunga aginge.

Verse 3
Chu luigal’a chun eikouvui,
Lungdon le jan um talou ;
Jesu toh aleng khom’uve,
Avon’u pon bang vamleh.

Verse 4
