Chu luigal’a Chun eikouvui,
Mitlha louvin eidot’ui ;
“Chu luigal jon’in kahung tai”
Tin kalungin adonbut.

songs.title: 282. KIPANAPAH CHULTHEI PULDING.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.m. (Heb. 4 : 9)

Verse 1
Kipana pah chulthei pul ding,
Kem thei louva pah kit ding,
Chunga meivom kaikhomna le,
Thimjin kit um talou ding,
Jing ninou soh emsel’a chun,
Kipan tantih nei talou ;
Chung gamtheng emnom tah a chun,
Mi thengten la asauve.
Ikimu to kit cheh diu,
Chung gam mitheng ho laiya ;
Chu luigal gam nom tah a,
Che masa i-ngai cheng toh ;
Ikimu to kit cheh diu,
Chunggam mitheng ho laiya.

Verse 2
Leiset’a kilungsetna gui,
Thina in sutan jita ;
Iki ngainau jong lhou theilou,
Mihem ikikim thei poi :
Chung gam ilhun teng vangule,
Kilungset gui tanlou ding ;
I ngai jouseu kimsoh tading,
Kikhen kit umtalou ding.

Verse 3
I hinkhou hi alhin teng leh,
Eijong chua ichen ding ;
Chonset thina le gentheina,
Mangin jong mat kit lou ding ;
Chan anu kimu kitta ding,
Nun acha kimu kit ding ;
Gamtin’a lum i-ngai hou chu,
Chu gama imu cheh diu.

songs.title: 282. ZION LHANG HOI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ngaiyuvin van sumkon gin khu,
Kiginguvin ati,
Zion lhang hoi (le em chunga) – (3)
Lamkaite khu veuvin,

Chorus
Avon emhoitah chu veuvin;
Athalpiu to dingun,
Pakai din sepai akhom’ui,
Canan gam jon dingin.

Verse 2
Keijong kalung eisuhal’in,
Sepaiyin pang tange;
Tua pat galvon (kivon tange) – (3)
Pakai ding galsat din;
Aloi din midoi adeilou,
Adoinau lang ding bep;
Mihang tahbehte bou adei,
Thi gin ngailoute chu.

Verse 3
Sepai lamtol’a dingte chun,
Gal hat mel apu’ve;
Abon’un von (kim’in neiyun) – (3)
Galsat hat mel pu’vin;
Athemgao hatpau nungjuiyun,
Kelngoinou loupi chu;
Ama thisanin kivon’un,
Amin Jesu ahi.

Verse 4
Sumkon in sepai akhom’ui,
Damun sepai jong um;
Pakai galvon (akidange) – (3)
Immanuel loupi chu;
Michonseten Jesu ajui,
Tonsot Pathen Chapa;
Hichun Canan gam ka lhungun,
Twipi nong gal geiyin.

songs.title: 283. PAKAI CROSS KA NGAISANG PEN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai cross chu ka ngai sangpen,
Leiset sem hi ka ngai nem’e;
Hichun o chitin jouse chu,
Chua kipana kim tante.

Chorus
O ka ngaiye vahchoi jing ing’e,
Ka Pakai Cross chu ka hinna pen;
Gentheite chu nangma jeh-in,
Van khopi nom chu lhung thei tante.

Verse 2
Leiset hoina le loupina,
Ka van lhepna in einaiye;
Tonsotna ka lhagao din,
Kipana ka mujou tapoi.

Verse 3
Gitlou hui le van kah-a hin,
Kagal ma a kadin kom le;
Ka kulpi le eilhandampu,
Nei puilutnin Salem nom’a.

Verse 4
Twiso get le leisetna hin,
Van Kelngoinou loupina chu;
Vahchoiyin tonsot in Ama,
Hallelujah tin pahchaute.

songs.title: 283. PATHEN HOUTE KIPAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. b.

Verse 1
Pathen houte kipah lung le alhagaovun,
Ngaiyun ka thuseiyu hi Thu Thah ;
Tunin Jesu apeng tai,
Sel le loiyin jong alem ;
Gan kong sunga ajal lai chun,
Christa peng tunin. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Pathen houte kipah lungle alhagaovun,
Ngaiyun tonsot hinna thu joy joy,
Tunin Jesu apeng tai,
Ahong tai van kotpi chu ;
Mihemte vangphatna ahi.
Christa peng tunin. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Pathen houte kipah lungle alhagaovun,
Nang ho dia thi gin umlou chamna ;
Jesu peng huhhing dingin,
Aman nabon’un nakou ;
Avan gam noma lhung dingin ;
Nalhat diu apeng, apeng nalhat diu.

songs.title: 284. KELNGOI CHING HON AGAMGE NAUVA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.m.

Verse 1
Kelngoi chingho agam genauva,
Jankhang laiyin Vantil sangja hung kilah in ;
Chunga la ngeitah asauve,
Hichu Pakai golnop kipat.
Nop ni ….Nop ni … Nop ni … Nop ni,
Apeng tai vannoi Leng chungnung.

Verse 2
Valpa hungsoh solam a konin,
Jing ninou bangin ahung vah kidang tah in ;
Hichun vannoi hinsal soh in.
Hichu sun le janin vah jing.

Verse 3
Hiche solam Valpa vahkai chun,
La tah a kon solam miching thum ahungun ;
“Israel Leng hoiya penga ham ?”
Tin hin hollun Valpa kaiyin.

Verse 4
Miching ho chu Naosen umna in,
Sunga alut’un hapan akipah-uvin,
Kipa man sana bego myrth,
Lultah in peuvin alem’ui.

songs.title: 284. VAHCHOIYUTE PAKAI LALMANG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vahchoiyute Pakai Lalmang leng chungnung,
Alungsetnan eihin hoiyun;
Thi-na le natna konin eihuhhing’ui,
Damsel’in ikimu to kit cheh tauve.

Chorus
O vahchoiyute eihuhhingpau chu,
Sim le mal sah le lhang’a chehchau sa;
Lem louvin ikimu kit-un Pakai min’in,
Alemnan aw ging hen Hallelujah.

Verse 2
Chamna Lengpa Pakai golnop len beita,
Kipa nopna jouse beita;
Tichun eiho jong gamtin’a chehchauvin,
Mol le lhangdam phaiyin eina khang’uve.

Verse 3
Kahung lamtouve hiche Welcome phunga,
Ka banjet in ka sanguve;
Christa chamna le lung olna chang cheh-un,
Nopni loupi ni hihen Christa min’in.

Verse 4
Kipa nopna halna thah-in leng kit-in,
Lung le lhagao nguisa jong hi;
I-chennau thinglhang le i-pheu gongsa jong,
Leng Christa lem dingin noukit hen tunin.

songs.title: 285. KIPANADAH GINGHEN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. m.

Verse 1
Kipana dah ging hen nalunggil sunga,
Chamna le lungmon nan nang nuselou ding ;
Lamjang khul chu jot’in lang.
Nitin Pakai din hingin ;
Pakai nalung sunga, nopdah aging ding.
Nop dah ging hen nalunga, (2 vei)
Nachena chan’a Pakai.
Amin chu lum’in songin ;
Pakai nalung sunga nopdah a ging ding.

Verse 2
Hia kon chun nangman Pakai lungsetna,
Navel’a muthim mite hetsah dingin ;
Lungsetna thupha seiyin,
Lungset neiyin na tongin :
Pakai nalung sunga nopdah a ging ding.

Verse 3
Inpi najot laiyin bolset nato ding,
Mihem mit’a mutheilou lungset jona ;
Pen nate Jesun nitin,
Navel’a ding jinginte ;
Pakai nalung sunga, nopdah a ging ding.

Verse 4
Na hinlai dam sungin Pakai na tongin,
Nang kipen lang natoh theina lama chun ;
Nalung thengsel’in mangin,
Lungsetna nangin molson ;
Pakai nalung sunga nopdah a ging ding.

songs.title: 285. PAKAI HUNG DING
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ahung tai Leng loupi chungnung,
Ama bang umlou leisetna;
Chamna le Leng loupi chungnung,
Lem’un (2) Hosana Leng chungnung.

Chorus
Lem’un Leng loupi chungnung,
Lem’un Hallelujah;
Chamna le Leng loupi chungnung,
Lem’un (2) Hossana Leng chungnung.

Verse 2
Lei le van min Hossana tin,
Sam’un ni loupi nia din;
Niloupi ni hin vahsah-in,
Lem’un (2) Hossana Leng chungnung.

Verse 3
Ahung tai Leng loupi chungnung,
Ama pakai ho Pakai chu;
Lei mihemte lhatdohna din,
Lem’un (2) Hossana Leng chungnung.

songs.title: 286. HIN TOHDOH-UN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chungnung’a Pathen aloupi,
Kum lhung keiyin eina chingun;
Ama mi lungsetna jal’in,
I-tohgau cheh imu tauve.
Hin tohdoh-un, (2)
Nanei jouseu hin tohdoh-un;
Pakai Jesu vahchoi khomna din Amen.

Verse 2
Christa Leng penni loupi ni,
Kipapin chapangte kei hon;
Tunin nakotpi phung’a hin,
Ka hunguve nanei ngeh-in.

Verse 3
Pakai min’a nahin to-doh,
Paini jengcha hijeng jongle;
Chapangte lung lhaina jal’in,
Van’a nasan ding um’inte.

songs.title: 286. VANGPHATNA THISANLUINAH CHUN.
287. HUNGUN PAKAI VAHCHOIYUTE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kumlui mangta ni le lha kum kiheita,
Tujing kumthah ni emsel sohta;
Jalna konin hung thoudoh-un lhaisel’in,
Kipa-in lem’ute ninou emsel to.

Chorus
Hungun hungun Pakai vahchoiyute,
Alungsetna sumil ding koi ham?
Kum lhunga damsel’a eichingpau ahi,
Tonsot tonsot in Amin loupi jing hen.

Verse 2
Hinkho lhing’a che masa i-ngaiteu chu,
Tuhin van gam nom’a alengui;
I-ding chu ho pul idou diu ham leiya,
Kum lhunga eichingpau Pathen vahchoiyun.

Verse 3
Kipana thu le tohga keng’in hungun,
Tuhin Pa ahunge vanghom din;
Lhandampun nachonna thuphon angainom,
Kum lhunga mona phongin lang set bang tan.

Verse 4
Ningkum lhaute tukum lemnan la saute,
Nabon’un na inkon hung lhauvin;
Nung le Pa vangpeh cha’n jouse kisih ding,
Lhaisel’in lem’ute Pa le Lhandampu.

songs.title: 287. OH FOR AFAITH.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. s1
(Luke. 17:5)

Verse 1
Taona lolhinsah pen Pathen,
Lhamonna ka thum’e ;
Lung dongin hesoh jeng jong leng, Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 2
Nangma banga um ka nom’e,
Nang bou eingailu pen ;
Thengsel chan umthei hih jong leng.Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 3
Na nopna chang hoi kahi poi,
Chonse kahi jeh in ;
Nang koma hung dinga lom lou, Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 4
U le nao ka inkoten jong,
Ei deimon eitheu hen ;
Gol chengin eidalha jong leu, Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 5
Hi leiset’a nahung kumlhan,
Thingpel’a nahung thia ;
Van’a neitao peh jing jeh un, Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 6
Houbung lah a um thei dingin,
Thina ging talouvin ;
Van’a kitup tah a umdin, Pakai neithe hih-in.

Verse 7
Mihem thi le hing thutan’a,
Loupi le ja uma ;
Meilom’a nahung kum phat teng., Pakai neithe hih-in.

songs.title: 288. NANGMA TOH THEI CHAN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Matt. 5 : 16)

Verse 1
Nangma toh theichan midang toh dingin ngah hih-in.
Salvah in mi dang ngahlou jen’in ;
Pakaiyin nangma panpi ding natohna chan’a,
Salvah in na umna mun chu.
Salvah-inna umna mun chu ; (2 vei)
Christa a gamla umten navah amuna din,
Salvah-in na umna mun chu.

Verse 2
Muthim noiya lam jotte nangman salvah peh-in,
Thangset’in navah chu le hih-in ;
Lungdongte kipa sah-in nahalna la ngei chun,
Salvah-in na umna mun chu.

Verse 3
Pathen thu simin Aman nang nakithopi ding,
Guhthim setnan natoh sel hih-in ;
Musah in na meivah chu miten Pakai heu hen,
Salvah-in na umna mun chu.

songs.title: 288. VAN CHUNG SANG KON PAKAI JESU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vanchung sang kon Pakai Jesu,
Lungdong gentheite kipana;
Leiset lung genthei chai soh-in,
Kei din Christa Nahung vah tai.

Chorus
Akidange ! ….. Akidange!
Na ngailutna akidange;
Kei dia nathohna Calvary,
Ka seithei poi Pakai Jesu.

Verse 2
Nang kasei chim thei poi Pakai,
Nang ka ngaichim theipoi Pakai;
Kalung muthim hin vahsah-in,
Ngailut vadung nei musah-in.

Verse 3
Hesoh genthei twipi nong lai,
Kapal ngampoi O Lhandampu;
Hinla ngailut na lim hoi chu,
Kei din Christa Nahungvah tai.

Verse 4
Elbai hon lam ajot tauve,
Phah ho suhthengin aum’in;
Pengsol hon penthahna neiyun,
Athi kaithouvin aum tai.
Na ngailutna pah kalem ding,
Kalha hatmo hatsah dingin;
Leiset boina kinong sung hin,
Lhagaovin neipui le jingin.

songs.title: 289. KA TAONA NGAIYIN LANG.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka chenna gam gamthip ahi Pakai,
Lhepna meipi le lungdonnan;
Alejin Lhandampu mel dei um,
Pakai Nakom’a umjing kanom.

Chorus
Ka taona ngaiyin lang,
Ka thum phatthei boh-in;
Na awnem ngaiyin ka um jing,
Nalhamonna nalhamonna aw chu.

Verse 2
Kama a Gethsamani’a lung dongin,
Napanpi ding koima umlou;
Keiman jong nakhonung hinjui ding,
Pakai Nakom’a umjing kanom.

Verse 3
Boina meipi lah-a ni emhoiyin,
Kalung sung thimjing ahinsal;
Calvary ngailutna hung long chu,
Phong dingin nei kithopin Pakai.

Verse 4
Hahsa jong leng Nanga kahi Pakai,
Nanga dingin nei thah sah-in;
Kaphat cheng Nang dinga man kanom,
Nang dingin nei thensah-in Pakai.

songs.title: 289. TWIKHANGLEN KINONG LAILUNG’A.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. m. (Ps. 107 : 30)

Verse 1
Twikhanglen kinong lailunga,
Tonsot gam jon, kitol nahi ;
Na kong lamkai len thupeh chun,
“Tol’in, tol’in tol’in”

Chorus
Tol’in, tol’in khohui thiploi tante,
Tonsot’in muthim jing ponte,
Tol’in, tol’in,
Hing jing Pathen thupeh ahi tol’in.

Verse 2
Na chung thimpi ajing jinge,
Twipam naiya chol jongle chun,
Ngaiyin chunga o’n natil’e,
“Tol’in, tol’in, tol’in”

Verse 3
Malam no dingin naloite,
Tijat in dau hen kong tol ding ;
Gel ding dang nang din aumpoi,
Tol’in, tol’in, tol’in.

Verse 4
Twinongin nakong nuhhen lang,
Thachol’in lhasam jongle chun !
Pathen thupeh chu thon ponte,
Tol’in tol’in tol’in.

songs.title: 290. O KA NGAI PAH BANGA PAHNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai nagam kalhun masangsen,
Kei ka gentheiye jaleng laiya;
Lungdon meipi ahung jingjin,
Nagam lhun masangsen.

Chorus
O ka-ngai pah banga pahna,
Hinthing limdam noiya;
Goldeite alennau,
Agal’a gamnom in kalung alange.

Verse 2
Nagam ngai ho chun ngailutna a,
Toi theilou pah ahoi atiuve;
Mihem kingailutna vang hi,
Dougal asohji tai.

Verse 3
O hung loiyin lang eilhandampu,
Kimu ni le hiche leiset hi;
Lungdon meipi ahung jingjin,
Nagam ka-ngai ngeiye.

songs.title: 290. PATHEN LUNGSETJAL’IN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Eph. 2 : 8)

Verse 1
Pathen lungset jal’in,
Lhatdam chamkim asem ;
Aloupina lungset jal’in,
Engse lhatdam changta.
Tahsanin lhatdam namui, tahsan … tahsan,
Tahsan lungset vanga namu;
Toh phat vanga namu hilou,
Toh hilou, ….. toh hilou toh phat vanga;
Hoitho ding hilou, Pathen thilpeh ahi,
Pathen thilpeh ahi, (2 vei) Thilpeh ahi.

Verse 2
Pa lungset alange,
Acha Christa chunga ;
Cross jachat uma atoh chun,
Pa lungset aphonge.

Verse 3
Atahsan chan henga,
Christa Pa aphonge ;
Lungsetna lhatdam chamkim changta,
Pathen cha ahiuve.

songs.title: 291. KUMTHAH VANGBOH IN PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. D. (Psalm. 31:3)

Verse 1
Kumthah vang boh-in Pakai.
Akikhom mi jouse jong ;
Na thu thenga kivon’a,
Nalung lhainan nei sem’un.

Verse 2
Kum lhunga nei hoidam’u,
Kipa thulhut le thil to ;
Phatthei neiboh-un Pakai,
Hiche kumthah lhungin jong.

Verse 3
Kap le maova lung lengvai,
Lhem lungmongin navan thun ;
Thim le kichat no mangin,
Tha le hinkho athah pen.

Verse 4
Ateh akhang mi jousen,
Lei jousen vahchoi cheh-in ;
Mipi ten phongjal leu hen,
Na thahat lungset kidang.

songs.title: 291. O KA NGAI PAH BANGA PAHNA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
O Pakai na misemte hin,
Namin loupi ahepouve;
Hin geldoh sah-in. (2)
Ka min loupi ahet pouleu,
Nangho dingin hin peng kate;
Nei het jing nadiu. (2)

Verse 2
Mark get khatna asei bangin,
Mihem sangli navah va bang;
Hin lolhin sah-in. (2)

Verse 3
Pakai ijakaiya nahi,
Penticost ni bang chun hungin;
Nei lolhin sah-un. (2)

songs.title: 292. CHRISTAHOUBUNGDIN DING’UN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. s. (Psalms. 41 : 4)

Verse 1
Christa Houbung din dingun, lungkhat le tha khat in,
Avahchoina seiyun genthei kithopiute ;
Mangsa hol’u hite. Christa Houbung din.
Christa Houbung din dingun,
Lungkhat le thakhat’in ;
Peu hite ithau tua pat’in,
Christa Houbung din.

Verse 2
Christa Houbung din taovun, tong’ute nitinin,
Lunglut le hakat in, toh-in kitet’ute ;
Kitep nit’u hite, Christa, Houbung din.

Verse 3
Christa Houbung din saute, Hosana tin saute.
Nomlen ihiuva pat, eitep peh-ui jona ;
Kitepna chu umjing, Christa Houbung din.

songs.title: 292. O LAZAR KALEIYA HIN. (Lk. 16:19-31)
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Keima leiya kalen lai hin,
Kalet kalal kathep dan chu seithei lou;
Sana dangka in hoi kidang,
Chutah chun ka lhagao huhhing jou nadem;
Ohe! keima kahing jouta poi.
Ahithei le O Lazar kaleiya hin,
Nakhut muh-a twi themkhat;
Hin vatlhah sah-in kaleiya hin,
Ohe! keiman kadou jou tapoi.

Verse 2
Lazar leiya alenlai hin,
Mihaopa dokhang noiya an mal jah ho;
Ki-lo dingin kotna achei,
Ama phah chu mihaopan mun kidahta,
Ahinla Pathenin panpi na.

Verse 3
Mihaopan leiset dalhah-a,
Van gam pel’a meidil’a ache phat’in;
Lazar Abraham ang sunga,
Atou chu mun Lengpa akisih lheh-e,
Ohe! keima kahing jou tapoi.

songs.title: 293. HUNG LEM CHEH-UN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Christa penna Bethlehem,
Leiset leng ho lenna munnom gam ahi;
Bethlehem chun huhhing chomlou ding,
Egypt gam’a jamlut pitan ati-e.
Hung lem cheh-uvin, (2)
Ha ha ha ha ha, ha ha ha ha, ha ha ha ha ha ha;
Hosana sam jingute van le leiya hin.

Verse 2
Anu le apa kom’a,
Ajanmang chun Lhagao Thengin lam hil’in;
Herod thang chun ohlih chomlou ding,
Hung kinungle kitdan Herod thi kahsen.

Verse 3
Athi nung chun akouve,
Hung kinungle kit tan Herod athi tai;
Hijongle nahuhhing Lalpa chun,
Angailutnan leiset mihem khomsoh ding.
Aw a-ngailutna aw a-ngailutna,
Ha ha ha ha ha, ha ha ha ha, ha ha ha ha ha ha;
Hosana sam jingute van le leiya hin.

Verse 4
Nahung peng’e leisetna,
Nangma leng channa din hi noi leisetna;
Atonsot in tonsot in Pakai,
Hijingin Pakai Halleluja Amen.

songs.title: 293. KANGAIYE PAKAI NANGMA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.d. (I. Pet. 1:8)

Verse 1
Ka ngaiye Pakai Nangma bou keima a,
Chonset nopna jouse ken kanuse tai ;
Eihuhhinga ka-ngai Nangma bou nahi,
Ka ngaiye Pakai Nangma ken ka ngaiye.

Verse 2
Ka ngaiye Lhandampu neilungset teiyin,
Nangman neilhatdoh tai thing Cross chunga chun ;
Ka-ngaiye linglukhuh keidin nakhuh tai,
Ka ngaiye Pakai Nangma ken ka ngaiye.

Verse 3
Thi jong leng hing jong leng ken Nang ka ngailui,
Kahin laisen Nangma ken vahchoi jing ding ;
Thina in eikhen masangsea ken lhai ding.
Ka ngaiye Pakai Nangma ken ka ngaiye.

Verse 4
Na in loupi tah vah jinga kachen ding,
Ken tonsot’a chua Nangma kalem ding ;
Nang vahchoinan sange lallukhuh pumin,
Ka ngaiye Pakai Nangma ken ka ngaiye.

songs.title: 294. GAL AKISATGALSATNASUMKON.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.s. (1. Tim. 6 : 12)

Verse 1
Gal akisat galsatna sumkon aginge,
Galvon vonun tin akisam soh tai ;
Pakai sepai asang ajan akitol tai,
Christa galjo ding chu akilange.
Gal akisat’e, Christian sepai,
Kimaiton akisat’uve ;
Galvon gin umtah akivon nuvin,
Se le pha kisat ni ahi ;
Gal akisat’e lungkham hih-un,
Aloupina tuhdet jingin,
Pathen eilama panga ahile,
Akhon nia jo la isah diu.

Verse 2
Gal akisat, hungun sepai thudih panun,
Jehovah lamkaina kijou tei ding ;
Pathen galvon lunghem louvin kivon cheh-un,
Athahatna jo ding hetsa ahi.

Verse 3
I-gal lamkai Pakai ahi kijou tei ding,
Galjo ding chu kichenin akilang ;
Amin loupi agam tinin jabol cheh ding,
Kho hungvah a champi ni hung soh ding.

songs.title: 294. KAHUNG KUN’E NA ANG’A.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset loupina le hoina,
Pah banga kalem’in;
Ka lhandampu nei ngailutna,
Masangin ka hepoi.

Chorus
Kahung kun’e, O Na ang’a,
Chonset a vahmangsa;
Masanga konna amangsa hi,
Pakai nei ngaidam.

Verse 2
Na lungsetna kei din alhing,
Chonse hijeng jong leng;
Na ngaidamna mang theilou ding,
Lungsetna in adim.

Verse 3
Chonset jouse Nasop theng tai,
Na thisan lu long chun;
Chonse pen hi kahung naiye,
Pakai nei sop thengin.

Verse 4
Pakai Nangbou kalhen nahi,
Mangkit talouhel ding;
Nagam kahung lhun masangin,
O nei pui jing jengin.

songs.title: 295. ASEI BANGIN ATHOUDOH TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Veuvin Easter kinong ahi,
Easter kipa toh thon;
Veuvin song akitang doh tai,
Lhan gohkeu vetsahnan.

Chorus
Asei bangin athoudoh tai,
Loupi tah-in vanna konin;
Easter ni hin kipa la sauvin,
Huhhingsa Jesu athoudoh tai.

Verse 2
Veuvin Easter kinong ahi,
Easter kipa toh thon;
Veuvin lhankhuh thim gohkeuvin,
Jesu aum tapoi.

Verse 3
Veuvin Easter kinong ahi,
Choi at in aum poi;
Amaiso loupi khu veuvin,
Chung gam ahinsal khu.

Verse 4
Veuvin Easter kinong ahi,
Easter thu le la thah;
Easter thil thah khu hung veuvin,
Pakai galjo ahi.

songs.title: 295. I-PAKAI VAH ACHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.d. (Prov. 16 : 20)

Verse 1
I Pakai vah chu Amu jui ihiuve,
Loupina ichan diu aume ;
Alunga ichon leh, Aman eiumpi diu,
Huhhingpa ahi tahsan jingin.
Tahsan jingin Pakai tahsan jingin,
Nopna ding lamdang umlou,
Pakai tahsan tailou.

Verse 2
Chung meithim kalou ding, gim hesoh beita ding,
Pakai chenna chunggam noma chun ;
Thi le nat um talou, lhi lonna beita ding ;
Phattheina ahi tahsan jingin.

Verse 3
Ami lungsetna chu, mihemten sim joulou,
Alatouna ilhun tengule ;
Thisana alhatsa,Ami lungsette chu ;
Kipa na chang ding tahsan jingin.

Verse 4
Pakai khopi muh a, nom tah-a kitou ding,
Ama toh laitol ilenkhom diu ;
Chung mithengte jousen, Amasei ngai cheh ding ;
Lung olmo louvin tahsan jingin.

songs.title: 296. GAMLA TAH IN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. B. Flat. d. (Isaiah 62:4)

Verse 1
Gamla tah-in kajai leiset mite ka le mao O,
Leiset mite chonset lungjinin alosoh tai ;
Lei lungdon le gimna jouse ka nusesa noiya,
Ken ngai kit talou ding chung khopia.
Cheng kahi chung khonom’a,
Chung meivom kailouna a;
Tonsot’a kanglou twikhuh,
Don ding ken kaneiye ;
Kemlou chung Mana kivah kahi,
Kel le chah umlou na a,
Keima kacheng-e chung khopia.

Verse 2
La tah a leiset’a khun tijat lungjin adim’e,
Niseh-in mihemte thisan luiyin alonge,
Kei vang kahoiye Pathen inpi sunga nomtah-in,
Iman eiphalou ding chung khopia.

Verse 3
Leiset’a ka le mao o huipi bangin nung jongle,
Kahoiye Pakai jal’in hiche khopi sunga ;
Hiche chunggam’a hin iman eisuse phalou ding ;
Tonsot’a hoi kahi chung khopia.

Verse 4
Tuvangin ken kahethei tai Pathen thugil tah chu,
A o kajah-in Kahei thugil kidang tah chu ;
Kamit’in kamui lhagao huhhingna thu chentah-in
Nom tah-in cheng tange chung khopia.

songs.title: 296. WHERE YOU THERE?
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Na um em Pakai Cross a kikhaiya, (2)
Hichun phat khat, phat khat,
Eiki thinsah thinsah, thinsah,
Na um em Pakai Cross a kikhaiya.

Verse 2
Na um em Thinga akhet beh-uva? (2)

Verse 3
Na um em Anah teng asut-uva? (2)

Verse 4
Na um em Nisan sal ding ada-a?

Verse 5
Na um em Lhan’a alup sah-uva?

songs.title: 297. EVERY BODY OUGHT TO KNOW.
songs.lyrics:
Mitin het ding dol ahi, (2)
Mitin het ding dol ahi, Jesu koi ham.

Verse 1
Ama phaicham lili ahi,
Ama vah jing jeng Valpa;
Sangsom lah-a hoipen Ama,
Mitin het ding dol ahi.

Verse 2
Cross a chonsete din athi,
Athisan’in buhbang so;
Lungset hingjing hung ding Pakai,
Nahet ding Ama ahi.

songs.title: 297. PAKAI TAONA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Duet A & T (Mt. 6:9-3)

Verse 1
Van’a um ka-pau Pathen,
Na min kija hen nagam ;
Hung lhung hen vana nalung,
Chan akim bangin leiya.

Chorus
Jong nalung chan kimhen tu,
Nin kaneh khop dingu an ;
Nei peuvin kaleiba teu,
Ka-ngaidam bangun keiho.

Verse 2
Bat jong ngaidamin chule,
Lhepnaa neipui hih-un ;
Agilouva konin nei,
Huhdoh jouvin gam thahat.

Verse 3
Naloupina tonsot’in,
Nanga ahi van’a um ;
Ka-Pau Pathen namin ki,
Jahen O Pakai Pathen.
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

songs.title: 298. PAKAI KEI HOI LANGA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai kei hoi langa che tangem,
O kei nei hil’in;
Na thutah nei hetdoh sah kit’in,
O kei neihil’in nalamdih.

Chorus
O Pakai Lhagaovin,
Kalunga thu sei kit’in;
Pakai Nalhagaovin,
Kalung sunga hin hung chengin.

Verse 2
Na thudih a kon ka gamla tai,
O neipui naiyin;
Lunga gel’in kei hung thei ponge,
Naban thahat chun nei kaiyin.

Verse 3
Nangma jen kana kiphal’in,
Hatmo Na ang’e;
Tun nadin sonlel mel kapu tai,
Naban thahat chun nei kaiyin.

Verse 4
Thutah a chonphat le chonnem’in,
O kei nei von’in;
Lei lung ngai ho dalha soh ing ting,
Kumkhon Nangma jen jing tange.

songs.title: 298. THOUDOH UN LHATDAM CHATE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. B. Flat. d. (11 Tim. 2:3)

Verse 1
Thou doh-un lhatdam chate se,
Pakai Christa kai jouse ;
Thoudoh-un namtin chitinte,
Kikhom’uvin Zion’a.

Chorus
Sau hite galjo la saute,
Twikhanglen van gin bangin ;
Lhandampu Christa thisanin,
I dougal ijo tei diu.(3)

Verse 2
Mitheng mihang chemasa ho,
Dettah-in leiya pangun ;
Tun van chunga ponlap leh un,
Kipah-in aleng tauve.

Verse 3
Thi gin tijatna umlou ding,
Van Pakai chenna gam’a ;
Pakai ahung kum kit nile,
Leiset kipan losoh ding.

Verse 4
Eiho jong Pakai ang sunga,
Kipah a kiding loi ding ;
Mi tinin kipaman sang ding ;
Ama jeng kivahchoi ding.

songs.title: 299. ITI NGEI TAM LUNGSET KIDANG.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Iti ngeitam lungset kidang,
Chonse kei eilhat tai ;
Kei amangsa eiholdoh tai,
Mitchon tun kamu tai.

Verse 2
Hichun kiginje eihil’e,
Tun kei eilhamon tai ;
Hi lungset chu eimusah tai,
Ka tahsan phat phat chun.

Verse 3
Gim hesohna a kon keima,
Tun sohcha kahi tai ;
Hiti chun eihin puihoi lei,
Tun jong in eilhut ding.

Verse 4
Hia chun kum sangsom sangja,
Ni banga em jing ding ;
Tonsot’a kipa la sading,
Vahchoiyin Lhandampu.

songs.title: 299. KIPANA KIM TANTE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leisetna kipana kahol lai hin,
Eihuhhingpun eikou ngailutna in;
Lei kipana dalhan ka tahsan tai,
Van kipana keiya anahi tai.

Chorus
Pakai Jesu eihuhhingpu,
Nangbou ka kipana nahi;
Ka hinna nangin neiyin lang,
Kipana kim tante.

Verse 2
Cholngahna le monna kana hol’in,
Monna dang aumpoi, Christa lou chu;
Ama-a ka pohgih ka ngah phat’in,
Lungkhamna ding dang umkit talou ding.

Verse 3
Ka tahsa le hinna kahin petai,
Nangin lan lang Pakai neihin mangin;
Sang tamtah thim noiya tou nalai ho,
Navah loupi sunga alen theinan.

songs.title: 300. KEI TAILOU NANGHON PATHEN.
300. VO, ADAM! ADAM!
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Eden theiga naneh ni ni nathi tei ding,
Tin Pathenin thutep ana koi pehsa;
Satan in nen thipon nate ati,
Koijoh dih nasah-em? ven, Adam athi tai.

Chorus
Vo, Adam! Adam! hoiya na-um ham?
Ibol’a nang kisel manga nahim?
Adam! Adam! hoiya na-um ham?
Bol hih-in kati chu nabol hitam.

Verse 2
Adam lhanthim thina lim’a tou nalai ho,
Pa Pathenin Adam bangin nakouve;
Hung thouvin lang thina gam hin dalhan,
Hung kipan tan nangma Eden thah-a leng din.

Verse 3
Phat alhunge tuhi ahi mithi hon jong,
Pathen Chapa o ajah diu nikho chu;
Aja ho se thoudoh tei diu ahi,
Atahsan lou vang chu themmo changsa ahi.

Verse 4
Pakai Jesun ka masanga hungho chengse,
Gucha le michom ahibouvui ati;
Keima vangin hinna aneiyuva,
Aneibe cheh nadiuva hung kahi ati.

songs.title: 301. CHRISTA TUNIN JONG AHINGE.
songs.lyrics:
(CHRIST JESUS LIVES TODAY)

Verse 1
Thoukit Christa ken kanei tunjong ahing jinge,
Tuni geiyin jong leiset chunga aleng jinge;
Angailutna chul ngailou eilungsetna kahei,
Ama ka ngaichat teng ka koma umjing.

Chorus
Christa ….. Christa tunin jong ahinge,
Niseh in keima eipuilei, A aw kaja jinge;
Christa ….. Christa tunin jong ahinge,
Tonsot hin kemlou eipetai, ka sunga ahunge.

Verse 2
Ka chena channa Aman keima eilhonpi jing,
Kalung hesohna a jong Aman olna eipei;
Tijat lungdonna channa Aman eipui galkai,
Ahung kit ni le kei kipah thanom ding.

Verse 3
Kipah thanom in Christian! Avahchoinan la san,
Leng Christa Hallelujah! tin vahchoinan sam’un;
Atahsan’a sang tapou Aman pampai ngailou,
Angailutna thu kidang seichoi leuvin.

songs.title: 301. SENLAI CHENNA KHOLUI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Senlai chenna kholui le golle paite,
Kagel kom le kalung helji ;
Senlai khankho le chun ngai kagel teng
Senlai ka houin lunga alange.
O van in nom hoi tah,
Chung gam nom ngaite chenna ;
Mitheng ten eina lamto ding ;
Chuteng leiset gimna ken mil ding,
Che masa ngaicheng kamu soh ding.

Verse 2
Hiche leiset khankho hi ken kagel teng,
Chung gam nomin kalung alai ;
Ngai cheng chung gam nom’a lengui,
Itih le keijong kalhung theita dem !

Verse 3
Leiset loupina le ahoina jouse,
Hung mang ding nikhat leivuiya ;
Kei vang Pakai laltouna angah,
Tua kangai cheng toh lengkhom tading.

songs.title: 302. KA PAKAI JESUN KASETNA JOUSE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka Pakai Jesun kasetna jouse,
Apomang tai thingpel chunga chun;
Keima vannoiya khetbeh,
Vannoi kei dinga khetbeh ahi.

Chorus
Keiman jong ka thingpel chu kiput ing ting,
Ka Pakai kom kalhun tengle keiman;
Jona Lallukhuh to kalhet ding,
Chuteng ka gentheina sumil tange.

Verse 2
Keiman vang seiset jum le ja pum’in,
Hiche Cross hi song ing ting chenge;
Ka ngai sang pen chu Thingpel,
Hijing jeng hen tonsot tonsot in.

Verse 3
Vannoi hi kadalha soh tai tunin,
Achung hokit taponge keiman;
Cross chun vannoi to eina,
Chomkhen soh tai, Hallelujah Amen.

Verse 4
Nang dingin Pakai in le lou dalhan,
Genthei lhilon kathohna jouse;
Jo-na ni loupi ni le,
Sumil tange Pakai na ang’a.

songs.title: 302. KAHINKHO HI TWILEN KINONG.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. G. s. (Isaiah 49:2)

Verse 1
Ka hinkho hi twilen kinong,
Bangin huipin alet’e ;
Kiselna ding mun kahol’e,
Pathen khut lim kahol’e.

Chorus
Kei eisel ding, kei eisel ding,
Twi le huipi phahlou na a ;
Kei eisel ding, kei eisel ding,
Pathen khut’in eisel ding.

Verse 2
Gim le hesoh toh jeng jong leng,
Ka dinga inlam ngaina ;
Ken engbolna sang chomlou ding,
Lungset kouna bou sang ding.

Verse 3
Ka melma ten eidou jongle.
Satan’in thaje jongle ;
Pathenin eiching jing nante,
Satanin eijou lou ding.

Verse 4
Chomkhat leiya Cross pu jong leng,
Setna huipi toh jong leng ;
Ka lhagao Pakai khut’a um,
Pan acha eilha lou ding.

songs.title: 303. JESU AHI, VANNOI VAH CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Adam vangin gaosapna changta jongleu hen,
Atahsante dia hinna Christa jal’in;
Thina muthim lah-a natou keiho chunga,
Jalenna kolninou emsel bangin, ahung soh tai.
Jesun aseiye, “Keima vannoi vah kahi,
Kanung eijuiya chu muthim’a chu vahle louva,
Hinna vah chu amu ding ahi” ati.

Verse 2
Egypt gama kon’in nathutep thonlou chun,
Na napuidoh-e nami Israelte;
Tunjong nei puidoh-ui Nathupha seiphong a,
Navahchoi sang dingin, tonsot thina muthim’a kon.

Verse 3
Kidangtah nami ngailutna le hepina,
Ka melmateu jengin jong jumna atoh;
Ima gin nei louvin nathupha seiphongin,
O thong jejun jailan, gingthei tin thon nagam sunga.

Verse 4
Nanung kahin juiyui nakoulhen namiten,
Leisetna kahin jin kalamjot pum’un;
Akhonni geiyin jong nei puiyun navah chun,
Leiset muthim lah-a Jesu ahi, vannoi Vah chu.

songs.title: 303. JESUN EICHOHINGDING.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B.

Verse 1
Jesun eicho hing ding,
Mi chonsete pui ding, Pathen in a,
Chonse kipah-un lang ;
Na lengpau tahsanun,
Leiset tahsan louvin,
Ama songun.

Verse 2
La sajingu hitin,
Van Pakai vahchoiyin, Lhagao lim’un,
Solchah ho jousen jong ;
Leiset chung gamtin a,
Ama avahchoiyui,
Pakai Jesu.

songs.title: 304. THUSIM NGEI KASEI NOMTA!
304. VAKHU BANGIN LENG THEI LENG.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vakhu bangin leng thei leng,
Galeng tange chung gam’a;
Leiya gol ngaite ho to,
Chu mun’a chun lengkhom tang kate.

Chorus
Leisetna kikhen pisa,
Ingailut gol ngaite ho chun;
Eijap jingui luigal’a,
Gamnom hoitah a lengkhom dingin.

Verse 2
Leiset hi keima dingin,
Kicholdo na in hilou;
Chom kah-a dalha tading,
Ngaiten eijap jingui luigal’a.

Verse 3
Nei hung puiyin o Pakai,
Lei gimna kadou jou poi;
Lungdeite to leng dingin,
Ngaiten eijap jingui lui gal’a.

songs.title: 305. CHRISTIANTE CHING THEIYUN.
songs.lyrics:
Key. G. (Eph.4:1)

Verse 1
Christiante ching theiyun nachena a,
Nalampi a kichatna atame ;
Het louva nalhem dingin najuiye,
Kumkhoa setna a koi din najuiye.
Christiante ching theiyun ; (3 vei)
Gin atam-e.

Verse 2
Christiante ching theiyun set ahunge,
Vanpi nim hen thimpin tom jongle chun ;
Huipi nungle mei kihoh loi tante,
Chuteng tonsot’a kicholdo tading.

Verse 3
Christiante ching theiyun lhuh louna din,
Sumil hih in Pakai chu kou jingin ;
Setto chanin pangin ding detjingin,
Taona galvon le lumin kivonin,

Verse 4
Christiante ching theiyun kinem tah-in,
Chu gam lhun teng Lhandampu dei tah chun ;
“Hung lut’in na-Pakai kipana a,”
Tia nakou teng nalung kipa dim ding.

songs.title: 305. GAM MINTHANG KISEI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gam minthang kisei chul ngailou,
Pakaiyin asem gamnom chu;
Sun le jan um talou hel ding,
Zion khopi nom tah-a chun.

Chorus
Van Jerusalem khopi chu,
Gilkel dangchah kisei kitlou ding;
Ni le lha leh Ahsi vah ngailou,
Kelngoinou chu avah jing jenge.

Verse 2
Pakai nagmtheng noma chun,
Thina huipi nungta lou ding;
Mitlhi longa kikhen kit na,
Umtalou ding nagam’a chun.

Verse 3
Hiche vannoi genthei mun’a,
Thina gam kanojing lai hin;
Lungdong’a ka genthei komle,
Pakai nangin neilha mon’in.

songs.title: 306. HUHHINGPUN NAKOUVE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo michonse! Huhhingpun nang nakouve,
Avel’a nakou kit lou ding;
Van gam lhunna ding muthim’in tom le chun,
Dalhah-a na umlou ding ham?

Chorus
Lhandampun thohhat tah-a nakou petcha hin,
Vaokam malam chu jon’in;
Tujan’a nahinna chu thina lhanmol’a,
Atolmang jeng thei ahi.

Verse 2
Vo michonse! Pakaiyin nang nakouve,
Sottah manbeiyin nakouve;
Huhhingpu kouna chu na nungsun hitam!
Nungsun le chun i-nati dem?

Verse 3
Michonse Pakaiyin ngah jing ponna te,
Nalhagao chu adalhah ding;
Van gam lhunna ding lungset khang cheta le,
Tonsotna naka lou ding ham?

songs.title: 306. JESU BOU KADEI PEN’E KAGOL DIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. E.

Verse 1
Jesu bou kadei pen’e kagol din,
Amabou lungdonna eimonsah ding ;
Kipah tah-in Ama bou lem inge,
Ka chonset pohgih jongle Jesu bou ka ngaiye.

Chorus
Jesu bou kadei chungnung pen,
Itih chan hijeng jongle ;
Niso hoilai hijong leh. Meibol kailai hijongle,
Niseh a ka lhonpi ding ; Jesu bou kadei.

Verse 2
Jesu bou kadei pen’e kagol din,
Hinna lampi thim jongle eihil ding ;
Galten kalha lhem lengvai jeng jongle,
Ka changa kadin joulou ding ken ka ki het’e.

Verse 3
Jesu bou kadei pen’e ka gol din,
Ama michonse te dia jol ahi ;
Jesu bou kadei chungnung pen ahi,
Ama banga gol lungnem le thahat dang umlou.

songs.title: 307. HUNGUN GOLVAH GOTSA
songs.lyrics:
Key.B.Flat.m (Luke. 14 : 17)

Verse 1
Hungun golvah gotsa, kouna ngaiyun,
Hung nen hinna changlhah, mijouse ding ;
Avomgui hin jonun A-oma kingaiyun,
Anei jouse nanga chonse hungun.

Verse 2
Twinah phunga hungun, Hinna luipi,
Na gimna subei ding, lungjin khoisat ;
Mi janel dia kiphal koimacha da jilou,
Thisan phung hin bel’un, chonse hungun.

Verse 3
Hangtah-in nailut’un Alaltouna,
Lhaitet golseh jouchan, hia um ding ;
Na lhahsam nau iham lungsette nahiuve,
Jesu bou nalamkai, chonse hungun.

Verse 4
Gamnom lama hungun, jin le kinon,
Vannoi hi michom gam, gamthip ahi ;
Sana tumging ngeile, kipana seijoulou,
Teh le khang lallukhuh, chonse hungun.

Verse 5
Ka hunguve Jesu, nei sanguvin,
Kalhau nomlen sah-in, nei silthengun ;
Nagam vah nom sunga, pon banga kijem din,
Choldo ding tonsot’a chonse hungun.

songs.title: 307. NEI PANPIN PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Twikhanglen kinong lailunga,
Agal langkhat kajot lai hin;
Huipi le twipi akinong,
Nei panpin Pakai.

Chorus
O ka-Pakai lungset thempa,
Chamna lengpa monna Pakai;
Hileiset thim jing noiya hin,
Nei panpin Pakai.

Verse 2
Genthei thoh-a kakou lai hin,
Nei lungset in nei umpiuvin;
Lung hesoh le genthei na a,
Nei panpin Pakai.

Verse 3
Ka gentheina eihuhdoh din,
Nahung penge hi leisetna;
Nahung chenna keiho umna,
Nei panpin Pakai.

songs.title: 308. ALHALIM NOIYA UM
songs.lyrics:
Key. D.Flat.m. (Psalms. 17:8)

Verse 1
Alhalim noiya um kahin kahoiye,
Jan muthim hen khopihui nung jongle ;
Ka tahsane, Aman kei eilha lou ding,
Eihuhhingin kei Ama cha kahi.

Chorus
Alha lim noi, (2 vei)
Lungset jal’a kahoina ;
Alhalim noiya kalha cheng ding,
Atonsot’a cheng jing ding.

Verse 2
Alhalim noi mongtah a ka kiselna,
Kalung leh katha akicholdo tai ;
Noi leiset’a kei din monna aumpoi,
Alhalim noiya bou monna kanei.

Verse 3
Alhalim noi, iti noptam kipana,
Kei kisel ding lunggim kichai kahsea ;
Tijat lunggimin kei eipha talou ding,
Pakaiya kumkhon kicholdo tange.

songs.title: 308. THINA GAL’A GAMNOM CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thina gal’a gamnom chu,
Kalung mit’in kagah mui;
Leiset gimna dalha ho chu,
Pakai to alengui.
Eijong chu gam ilhun tengle,
Avahchoi la ngei isah diu;
Pakai ang sunga chun.

Verse 2
I-hinkho hi pahcha bang,
Jinga mang thei twimei bang;
Lungjin lungdon hesohna jeng,
I-tih ka dalha dem!

Verse 3
Ka ngai ngeiye chu gam chu,
Ka Pakai dei lenna a;
O i-tih le kalhung tadem?
Lung ngai jouse kimna.

Verse 4
Tuhin leiya lengvaiyin,
Ka hinna hi mang jong leng;
Olle kho ahung vah tengle,
Ka gimna mil tange.

songs.title: 309. CHRISTABOU CHU AHI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (Peter. 2:7.)

Verse 1
Khatvei genthei lengvai meithai,
Tehse chatmo ho lung ol’a ;
Kipah a um kamui,
Ken kadonge alungmon nau ;

Chorus
Akinepnau ipiham tin,
“Christa ahi,”ati.
Christa bou chu ahi,
Heng Christa bou ahi.

Verse 2
Thikon jalkhun koma ka ding,
Thi dinga lum chapangsen chu,
Jesun akou ngah-in,
Nui heovin alhagao alhan ;
Ahin same O nem heochan,
Christa bou chu ahi.

Verse 3
Thupha jal’a thi khat kamui,
Gentheiya thina muna chun ;
Alung olmo lou chu,
Ken kadonge atha hatna ;
Van lam aven ahin seiye,
“Christa ahi” ati.

Verse 4
Thupha seile pa chu kamui,
Nel phai le buhbang gam jot’in ;
Chonse ho huhdoh din,
Hinkho le in angailu poi ;
Thina le genthei gingta lou,
“Christa jalin” ati.

Verse 5
Thina gam chu ache mangtai,
Twi le leiya thi ho thouvun ;
Leiset kavam sohta,
Huhhingsate chu ken kamui ;
Alhatdamnau la ngei sauvin,
Christa bou chu ahi.

Verse 6
Christa henga hungun tunin,
Apa Acha Lhagao thengin ;
Moulangin nakouvui.
Na chonsetna nadamsah ding ;
Alungsetnan na damsah ding,
Christa thahat jal’in.

songs.title: 309. M OS C OW LE TE H ER A K A H- A L E NN A
songs.lyrics:
C HU N GA KI B OL .

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu huhhingna Thupha,
Lei chunga hin athangsoh tai;
Chitin namtin kol kimvel’a miten,
Ao-vun Hosanna Pakai Jesu.
Chungnung penna Pathen loupi hen,
Lei chunga cham le lungmon leng hen!

Verse 2
Vannoi kolkim’a vabang lengin,
Pakai loupina ka mube jing;
Thilsem kidang le ju le van jong,
Avahchoiyui chungnung pen Pathen.

Verse 3
Pakai malsom’a vabang leng thei,
Vanlai jol’a leng van huikong;
Mukal ka ngahlel neilhut loiyin,
Bolna tonsunga goldeite kom.

Verse 4
O! toljingin naban thahat chun,
Pakai neipui jing jenguvin;
O neilhut’un u-le nao lenna gam,
Seichoi lenge na hinna Thupha.

songs.title: 310. LHANDAMPU NUNG CHU JUIYIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Lhandampu nung chu juiyin,
Hi la hi kasan Amin loupipen jing hen ;
Lungset vangin eilhat,
Athisanin eilhat tai,
Amin loupipen jing hen.
Halleluijah tonsot Pakai,
Loupi jing hen tichu ka tonsot la chu ahi ;
Eihuhhingpa, Eilhatdampu,
Chonset lhatna loupipen jing hen ;
Ahinna kadin aphal,
Lhatdam nan athi, Amin loupipen jing hen,

Verse 2
Thim lah a eihuhdoh-in,
Eichingtup jinge Amin loupipen jing hen ;
Lungdonna le kichatna,
Aman eilhamon hen ;
Amin loupipen jing hen,

Verse 3
Kakoma hungin eiching,
Ngin eilhamonin Amin loupi pen jing hen ;
Jordan lui eipuigal kaiyin,
Vangam eilhut’in ;
Amin loupi pen jing hen.

songs.title: 310. NAKHANGDONG HOILAIYIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vo! khangdong ho nakhang hoilai,
Pakaiya din peuvin;
Nakhang hoilai Pakaiyin amangcha nom’e,
Nahuhhingpa na chu tongin,
Sana khang hoilaiyin.
Na ….. khangdong hoilaiyin,
Nasempa Pathen geldoh-in;
Nakhang hoilai Pakai dingin,
Tongin thanom tah-in.

Verse 2
Phat le nikho akem jinge,
Hinkho jong akem jing;
Phat tampi chejouta nile lha kiheita,
Vo! khangdong ho napah hoilai,
In Pakai na tongin.

Verse 3
Pakaiyin ati nakhangdong,
Hoilaiyin na tongin;
Ajoule nakhang hoilai molpang lep inte,
Tu hinkho hoilaiyin tongin,
Tongin toh phat ahi.

Verse 4
Nangho cheuvin namtin henga,
Kipana Thu hil’un;
Koi hile atahsan jousen hinna mu ding,
Nakhang hoilai kilet kah-in,
Pakai na chu tongin.

songs.title: 311. ITI NOP TAM JESU TAHSAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Prov. 16 : 20)

Verse 1
Iti nop tam Jesu tahsan,
Eithupeh dungjuiya chon ;
Athutep dung juiya ol ding,
Ama he jinga um ding.

Chorus
Jesu, Jesu katahsane
Ka hechen’e dihtah-in ;
Jesu, Jesu loupi Jesu,
Alungset tahsan ninge.

Verse 2
Iti noptam Jesu tahsan,
Eisil thenge thisanin ;
Lungset o nemin eikouve,
Damna thisan luiya din.

Verse 3
Heng anome Jesu tahsan,
Set’a kona eilhat ding ;
Olna kanei teng nang gama,
Nop le ol chamna kei ding.

Verse 4
Ka kipah-e Nathu kihil,
Lhandampu Jesu Christa ;
Keiya Nang naum ken kahei,
Akhonni geiya dingin.

songs.title: 311. PATHEN MINGAILUTNA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pathenin eingailutnau eimu sah-ui,
Eiho chonsetna ium laitah-uvin;
Christa eiho chonset suhbei na dingin,
Calvary Cross chunga ahung thi tai.

Chorus
Pathenin hibang hin vannoi angailun,
Ama tahsan chan chu mangthah louhel’a;
Tonsot hinkemlou anei theina dingun,
Achapa changkhat chu ahin petai.

Verse 2
Kalchuh kut masangin Jesun vannoiya,
Kon’a a-Pa henga ache ding ahen;
Vannoiya Ama-a ho chu angailun,
Akhon ni geiyin angailu lheh-e.

Verse 3
Athu hettoh sah ginchat umtah Jesu,
Christaa kon lungset lungmon umpiuvin;
Eiho eingailu’a athisanna ichon-,
Set chengseuva kona eisutlham’u.

Verse 4
Pakai keima henga ahung kilah-e,
Nangma gui tanlouva kalungset nahi;
Hiche jeh-a chu nangma koma kaki-,
Tahna kaban jom jing jeng ahiye.

songs.title: 312. LANGEITAH KHATKASANOME
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
La ngeitah khat kasa nome,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat ;
Lhandampu vahchoi la sange,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat.

Chorus
Lhatdam kachan’a pat (2 vei)
Amin vahchoi jing tange ;
Lhatdam kachan’a pat,
Amin loupi vahchoi jing tange.

Verse 2
In nom hoitah khat kaneiye,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat ;
Tonsot’in cheng jing inge kei,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat.

Verse 3
Lhandampu vahchoi la sange
Lhandam kachan’a pat ;
Tonsot in sa jing inge ken,
Lhatdam kachanna pat.

songs.title: 312. LEISET LOUPINA KAHOL LAIYIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset loupina kahol laiyin,
Kalung sunga kon thu hinsei chu;
Lamvai nang hung kile tan eiti.
Ka Pakai tailou ken monpi neilou,
Kalamvaina a kon eihun tem!
Pakai Nang tailou monna umlou.

Verse 2
Gentheiyin lamvai jeng tajong leng,
Nang ngailutna kon ol ka hitai;
Leiset lung ngaina ken mil tange.

Verse 3
O! Lhandampu tun kahin kouve,
Ka hinna abonchan Nang kapei;
Nei mangchan Pakai nakin na din.

Verse 4
Tun vang leiset thil nuse tang ting,
Ka Pakai nahinna thu jeng bou;
Jailan sachoi le tange kumkhon.

songs.title: 313. CHRISTMAS LA
songs.lyrics:
Acheuve ahsi nung nuiyun,
Athum’un lungkhat tah-in,
Kinung heilou malam jonin,
Ahsi chun alamkaiyun.

Verse 1
Ven i-Pathen Chapa changkhat khu ven (2)
Phattheina gohong pe din ahunge; (2)
Khodah-uvin genthei chate,
Ahung tai Jesu ahung tai;
Muthim gam jouse salvah din,
Ahung tai nang le kei din.

Verse 2
Mihem lim’in ahung van Leng Chapa, (2)
Ngailutna le Kipana pe dingin, (2)
Kineo sah tah-in ahungin,
Milen milalten vetomlou;
Mijouse sopi mit in mun,
Pathen lunglam eihil’ui.

songs.title: 313. NALUNGGEL ATHON TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Na lunggel athon teng nalung gentheiyem ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin ;
Toh le tham chunga na thachol ngui nguiyem ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin.
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin, (2 vei)
Akhon ni geiya nagol deipen ahi,
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin.

Verse 2
Na changa muthim lah a nava le jim ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin ;
Christan lhembin nate Ama tahsanin,
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin.

Verse 3
Thoudoh kit Pakai thua nachon ding hinam ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin ;
Athupha theng vah a nache ding hinam ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin.

Verse 4
Chonset pohgih poh a nalha lengvai jem ?
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin ;
Na lungkot honglenin Lhandampu lut hen,
Pakai thingkil ma gel’uvin.

songs.title: 314. HALLELUJAH, HALLELUJAH.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Leng Christa chu ahung peng tai;
Vantilten Ama ahinlhai,
Bethlehem daiya chun,
Leng Christa chu ahung peng tai,
Loupi hen atiuve.
Oh! ….. Bethlehem jon’ute,
Vanlal cha penna chu;
Samang jalna gankong sunga;
Lhandampu ka mu ding.

Verse 2
Avahchoi vantil lasa hon,
Lungsung ihmu akaithouve;
Valpa ahsi lamkai vah chun,
Miching ho apuiyin;
Oh! keima jong neipuiyin lang,
Bethlehem daiya chun.

Verse 3
Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Ka Lhandampu penna mun chu;
Tahsa mit’in kagaldot le,
Oh mu kanom ngeiye,
Hung vah kit’in Valpa Ahsi,
Keima jong neipuiyin.

songs.title: 314. HUNG DINGA NANOP EM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Hung dinga nanop’em ? Lung lengvai lhachompa ;
Chonset bulpu nangma,Pakai le Lhandampu,
Khopi muh a kunin, Pen nate lo Jesun.
O olna nom, dei olna nom,
Jesun pen nate ol ;
Tahsan’a hibang tah a nom loulai nahim ?
Pen nate ol Jesun.

Verse 2
Hung dinga nanop’em ? Na dinga lungset um ;
Nang dia olna damna, Hung teiyin tahsanin lang ;
Ama min ngei hi, Pen nate ol Jesun.

Verse 3
Hung dinga nanop em ? Seiding i-na neiyem ?
Jesu nalungset pa, Na tahsana dinga,
Cross chunga thi hita, Pen nate ol Jesun.

Verse 4
Hung dinga nanop’em ?Nakouve Aman tun ;
Koiyin lungset om’a ; Na chonse thesoh sim ;
Theilouhita jongle, Pen nate ol Jesun.

songs.title: 315. KA KHOLJINNA SAPSETNA MUN
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Ka kholjinna sapsetna mun,
Lungdon twisanglen kinong;
Panpi kangai ka Lhandampu,
Nei hin huh-in.

Chorus
Jesu nagam nalhun tengle nei hejingin,
Leiset chonset asang taloi;
Kadou joupoi Pakai nunnem,
Jesu nagam nalhun tengle nei hejingin.

Verse 2
Kadam sung ni chomcha ahi,
Helou kahim? jan mol lep;
Setna meipi jing noiya hin,
Nei huhhing-in.

Verse 3
Kadam sung nikho man ding dan,
Neihil jingin Lhandampu;
Ka phat hoi hi Nangma dingin,
Mang tang kate.

Verse 4
Leiset loupina ho sangin,
Nahoiye kalung sunga;
Sapsetna linglukhuh jong chu,
Khuh jongle chun.

songs.title: 315. KAHIL THEI POI HOIYAHUNGKON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. sl

Verse 1
Ka hil theipoi hoiya hungkon,
Ka lunga chamna hi ;
Chamnan alo bou hi kahei,
Damheova ahin lo,
Ka lunga chamna luipi along (2 vei)
Ka vel’a setna twi nong jongle ;
Christan eiumpi nai.

Verse 2
Toh gim noiya um hijong leng,
Luipi kisel long jing ;
Ka lha lengvai dangnou jing ding,
Changa lunghel lou ding.

Verse 3
Ka seithipoi a-ngailutna,
Chungnung eipeh-u hi ;
Kalung sung thimjing semhohta,
Tahsan jal bou ahi.

Verse 4
Kahil theipoi ipia eilhen,
Gim thoh le thi dinga ;
Hinla athoh khompi hileng,
Ama toh leng chang ding.

songs.title: 316. LUNGSET THEM PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lungset them Pakai neihung vil’in,
Lhamonna o kanei jou tapoi;
Nanglou lungmonna ken neijou lou,
Nei hung vil’in o ka Pakai deitah.
Ka van in nom’a, (2)
Nei hung puiyin eilhandampu;
Ka van in nom’a.

Verse 2
Genthei lengvai ka ka-na o-hi,
Na ngailutna thun nei hung lhem’in;
Kapet kahaiya Nang kamu teng,
Hinna thinglim noiya kichol donge.

Verse 3
Chemasa ngaite to kimu ding,
Einem jinge kalung sunga hin;
Gol ngaite kim del’in lengunte,
Neilhut loiyin o ka Pakai deitah.

songs.title: 316. PATHENIN EILUNGSETJAL’UN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. m.

Verse 1
Pathenin eilungset jal’un,
Phat chomkhat din ileng khomun ;
Tun kikhenna ni ahung tai,
Ka lhauve damsel cheh-uvin.

Chorus
Phat chomkhat kikhen jong leu hen,
Khatvei ikimu to kit diu ;
Pathenin eiching jingu hen,
Ikimu to kit kah seuvin.

Verse 2
Sopi ngaite kikhen nungteng,
Molle lhangin eikhen jongle ;
Iki lungsetnau milpoute,
Lungset jing Valpan vah jing hen.

Verse 3
O sopi deite kilhahnan,
Banjal’in chibai kabol’ui ;
I monau ki-ngaidam’u te
Pathen vangpeh ichanna din.

Verse 4
Sopite kikhen jongleu hen,
Ngailutnan eikan khom jing hen ;
Leiya kimu hih jongleu hen,
Vangam’a din kinemute.

songs.title: 317. NEI NGAIDAM’IN PAKAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Nei ngaidam’in O Pakai nei ngaidam’in,
Katoh ding helouvin sottah kana um’e;
Kei changseh dingin bou kana gel’e,
Nei ngaidam’o Pakai nei ngaidam’in.

Chorus
Keima jeh in lhagao simsenlou,
Amangthah tai tonsot thim noiya hin;
Na anga ipi kasei ding ham?
Nei ngaidam’o Pakai nei ngaidam’in.

Verse 2
Na huhhingna thu manbeiyin kamu tai,
Ka hinkho simsen louvin nei vangboh-e;
Hinla kachangin bou kana mang chai,
Nei ngaidam’o Pakai nei ngaidam’in.

Verse 3
Ka kipana pen lhagao tamtah huhhing,
Katoh ding khohpen Hinna Thupha seiphong;
Hinla lhagao khatbeh kahin lhut poi,
Nei ngaidam’o Pakai nei ngaidam’in.

Verse 4
Nakouna hi haimil thei ding kahipoi,
Na thupeh lenpen Kipana Thupha hil;
Na Lhagao Thengin neipui jingin lang,
Nangma a din ka kiphal tai Pakai.

songs.title: 317. PAKAIYIN ALOITE TOH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Math. 26:26,27)

Verse 1
Pakaiyin aloite toh,
Jerusalem indan chungnunga chun ;
Lungdongle mitlhi pumin,
Kilhahnan ankong aum khommui.

Chorus
Hiche kasa ahi, Hiche ka thi ahi,
Neuvin lang lungmong tah in doncheh un ;
Kapa gam hunglhun kahsea ;
Kadon kit louhel ding ahitai.

Verse 2
Kelngoi chingpa alhutai,
Kelngoite vahcheh gam ding ahitai ;
Ohe anungjuite chu,
Lungdong le lunghemin ngui jouta.

Verse 3
A ankong umpi ho jong,
Dougal’in soh jouta Pakai chunga ;
O i-pakai chunga hin,
Thudih a danin vaihom talou.

songs.title: 318. THILSEM KIDANG HO HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B.

Verse 1
Thilsem kidang hohi kageldoh komle,
Pathen loupina chu akilange ;
Vana Ahsi le Van gin kithong jonghi,
Aboncha Ama thahatna ahi.

Chorus
Chuteng kalhan vahchoi ding Huhhingpa,
Aloupi ngei, aloupi ngei ;
Chuteng kalhan vahchoi ding Huhhingpa,
Aloupi ngei, aloupi ngei.

Verse 2
Gammang thimjing laiya keima kalenge,
Hamngei kidang vahchoi O chu kajai ;
Molsang chungvum a konin ka galdot le,
Nemheo huilhi le gin ngei chu kajai.

Verse 3
Pathen milungset kidang chu kahe tai,
Chapa changkhat leiset’a hin sollhan ;
Olmo louvin Calvary Cross chunga chun,
Ka chonset jouse apomang sohtai.

Verse 4
Loupi tah a Pakai chu ahung tengle ,
A inpia eipui tou niteng chule ;
Kalung le ka lha kipana dimset ding.
“Aloupi ngei” ting ting vahchoi tange.

songs.title: 318. VANNOI CHONSET THIMNOIYA HIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi chonset thimnoiya hin lhagao tamtah,
Mangthah ding aum’e huhhing ngai ahiuve;
Amaho gapuidoh ding,
Koi um’am Pakaiyin aseiye.
Aw sochatna ngaiya peng’a ahiuve,
Lhatsa nangman nahuhdoh joulou ding ham?
Huhhingna ngaiya mao ho chu ga huhhingin.

Verse 2
Aw sopi kinon lang phat hi akem jinge,
I-hinlai nikhou hi hung mang loi ding ahi;
Lungset le ngailut thon,
Amaho gapuidoh din kipan tan.

Verse 3
Pakai ngailut lhagao tamtah setna lhata,
Nitin aphat’u ka-nan amangjou tauve;
Lhagao ngaiya dangchah ho,
Hinna twi choiyin lang ga petan.

Verse 4
Pakai na natong dia lhatsa kahilou ham?
Katoh ding helouvin kana um nalaiye;
Pakai nei ngaidam’in,
Na thupeh ho kana sumil jou tai.

Verse 5
Pakai tun ka kipan tai Naleng gam’a din,
Nacha kahi Pakai nei sumillou jen’in;
Katahsa ka hatna,
Apumpin Nanga din kaphal theng tai.

songs.title: 319. KISEKHENNA LA
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jesun namtin akhop ding ahi phat khatle,
Mise le mipha khen nia akhen ding ahi;
Loi khat chu Jesun nang naphai ati phatle,
Nang na um nadem hiche miho lah-a chun.

Chorus
Mthengten kipa la asah teng,
Mitlhi long’a akap tam dingu;
Huhhingsa miten hinna twi adon phatle,
Twi dua dangchah a thum tamtah um ding ahi.

Verse 2
Kaphat alhin teng keijong kache ding van’a,
Leichung damsung tohman kasan tei ding ahi;
Loikhat in chonphatna Lallukhuh akhuh teng,
Na naum nadem hiche miho lah-a chun.

Verse 3
Hung lhung ding ahi Pakai nikho phat khatle,
Hiche thutep chu koiman apel theilou ding;
Loikhat in thina meikong ajot tengule,
Nang na um khadem hiche miho lah-a chun.

Verse 4
Mo neilou Pathen Chapa athi laitah-in,
Chonse kei khel’a Pathen vaihom toh ahi;
Huhhing hisa mithengte akhop tengule,
Kei um ding kahi O chu miho lah-a chun.

songs.title: 319. TUNIAPAKAI NIKHO HUNGLHUNG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Tunia Pakai nikho hung lhung,
Avahchoi din ikikhomui ;
Jingpia thouvin Ama houdin,
I kipa nau thu lhut ute.

Verse 2
Chonset pum’a thupha choiyin.
Eihon thuse ijop jingun ;
Alungset kidang igel le.
Eihinghoi datmo aume.

Verse 3
Ni gup sungin na itongun,
Pakai nikho nit ding ahi ;
Ama thu jeng bou gelna din,
Pakai nikho asem ahi.

Verse 4
Kalung gel’in thu manlou ho,
Van gam thu tailou gelda hen ;
Pathen loupile Athenje,
Ngaito jo hen adol ahi.

Verse 5
Jesu banga thilpha bol’in,
Ama banga thusei theinan ;
Pakai lhatheng bou ka ngaiye,
Van choldo naa eipui din.

songs.title: 320. PAKAI NAMIN KIJAJINGHEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. d. (John. 14 : 5)

Verse 1
Pakai namin kija jing hen,
Na lenggam chal jing hen,
Mitin Na anga thipchet ding,
Na gam hung lhun ni le.

Chorus
Pakai thenson…. hiche in hi,
Hin bunglhan Lhagao Theng ;
Cheng hen namite lunggil’a,
Phatthei chamkim hin pen.

Verse 2
Nangma Hou-in ka molsouve,
Na hoidamna jal’in ;
Na intheng lomtah hi dingin,
Lomin sem chamkimin.

Verse 3
Maicham thilto taona muntheng,
Chonse lungheina mun ;
Na gam chal le naloupina,
Kin loupi, neina ding.

Verse 4
Kivop jingin na-Hou-in hi,
Thunoh lungjin dal’in ;
Na O jaidamin hil jingin,
Nagam hunglhun kahsen.

songs.title: 320. TOHKHOMPI LHAHNA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai kiti chu amin ahi,
Eipui le-a eidamsah Pa;
Kol le vaiya eichingpa Pakai ahi.
Jingkol kikeuva jingkhang kathon,
Samang kavaimoi laijon o goldam dei.

Verse 2
Samang navaimo jeng tajong leng,
Tongkai kidon’in nei gel jing’o;
Chung Pathen anga kimutona dingin.

Verse 3
Tongkai kisanpi gol le pai cheng,
I-Pakai na tong cheh-ute;
Aleng gam’a chan inei theina diuvin.

songs.title: 321. LENGVAI GENTHEI KOMLE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lengvai genthei komle kei mong theilou,
Chung toni jong nilhum joulou Pakai;
Einem ding dang umlou Pakai tailou,
Pahbang mol hen leiset ka hinkho hi.

Chorus
Lungdon kana gim gentheina mun hi,
Pel tange tun Pakai navan in’a;
Chuteng genthei gimna ken mil tange,
Leiset pel’a lhunkal ngahlel kahi.

Verse 2
Leiset chung hi gol ngai kikhenna mun,
Insung mi jong kikhenna mun ahi;
Chung leng va bang gamtin’a kaleng len,
Monna umlou Pakai nangma tailou.

Verse 3
Van khopi tol laiya lengte ho chun,
Lungdon kana asei ngaita pouve;
Ponbang sil’in van khotol’a lengun,
I-tih tah le kei jong kalhung tadem.

Verse 4
Lengthei hileng keiman dalha tading,
Kavan tonsot pahbang pahna mun’a;
Ken mil tange genthei puldou kana,
Chemasa ngai chengtoh tolleng tange.

songs.title: 321. PATHEN THU GOUBOM HONG’UTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (John 12:47)

Verse 1
Pathen thu goubom hong’ute,
Gou lutah kim’a kikhol ;
Tahsa gou toh tethei hilou,
Vangam gou tonsot hinna.

Chorus
Hol’ute …. lung thengin,
Lhagaova gunchu tah-in ;
Sau hite ….. Kipa la’n,
Athu hing thahat pen chu.

Verse 2
Hiche Sunday Sekul’a hin.
Pathen le mihem dei kim ;
Lhagao hinna tahsa monna,
Pathen thuguh kiphonna.

Verse 3
Athu ngailu sun le jan’a,
Gunchu le thanom hiute ;
Luipanga thingphung hinpha bang,
Pakai dia hinpha hiute.

Verse 4
Nahsahmo lou jenin sopi,
Nangma kisong lou jenin ;
Pakai bel’a Athu nun bou,
Van gou lo ding akhon nia.

songs.title: 322. KUM LHOMCHABOU UMTA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Psalm. 90:9)

Verse 1
Kum lhomcha bou umta.
Phat chomcha hung bei ding ;
Ngai chengto ibol khomna diu,
Lhan’a mollem ho toh.

Chorus
O Pakai neisem phan,
Na niloupi nia din ;
Na thisan lun neisop thengin,
Ka setna sil thengin.

Verse 2
Ni Ihomcha bou umta,
Hiche gam thim’a hin ;
Nisa ngailouna ichendiu,
I monnau chung chon ding.

Verse 3
Chomkhat meipi ajing,
Hiche songthop gama ;
Huipi nun louna ichen diu,
Luipi nong umlou ding.

Verse 4
Gentheina chomkhat bou,
Kikhenna chomcha bou ;
Tohgim kana chomkhat joule,
Kana umtalou ding,

Verse 5
Hicheng hi chomkhat bou,
Ama hungkit loiding ;
I hinna diuva thoukit pa,
Ama toh leng chang ding.

songs.title: 322. LUNGSETNA KHANG ALEM JINGE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Idamlai ni phat chomcha hi,
Bei vah ding ahitai;
Sopi kingaiton phat aum tapoi,
Nalung heiyin vangam ahung nai tai.

Chorus
Phat aboi tai, phat abei tai,
Lungsetna khang alem jinge;
I-Pakai chu hung loiyinte,
Nalung heiyin van gam ahung nai tai.

Verse 2
Aw hinna thu mulou ho khu,
Vetem’un sopite;
Tonsot thini na mun lam chu jonin,
Akitol’ui mitlhi long pum pum’in.

Verse 3
Phat kipa um chomcha sung hin,
Pakai na tongute;
Ageisang tai aw phat aum tapoi,
Kipan’ute Pakai natong dingin.

songs.title: 323. KUMLUI MANGTA
songs.lyrics:
Key.F. s.

Verse 1
Kumlui mangta ni le lha kum kihei ta,
Tujing kumthah ni emsel soh ta ;
Jalna konin hung thoudoh-un lhaisel’in,
Kipah’in lem’ute ninou emsel toh.

Chorus
Hungun, hungun Pakai vahchoiyute,
Alungsetna sumil ding koiham ?
Kum lhunga damsel’a Eichingpau ahi,
Tonsot, tonsot’in Amin loupi jing hen.

Verse 2
Hinkho lhinga chemasa ingaiteu chu,
Tuhin vangam noma alengui ;
Iding chu ho pul idou diu ham leiya,
Kum lhunga Eichingpau Pathen vahchoiyun.

Verse 3
Kipana thu le tohga kengin hungun.
Tunin Pa ahunge vang hom din ;
Lhandampun nachonna thuphon angai nom,
Kum lhunga mona phongin lang set bang tan.

Verse 4
Ningkum lhaute tukum lemnan la saute,
Na bonun na inkon hung lhauvin ;
Nung le Pa vangpeh changlouse kisih ding,
Lhaisel’in lemute Pa le Lhandampu.

songs.title: 323. VANGIL CHUNGLAM’A KHUN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vangil chunglam’a khun vantilten la asai,
Alengpau vahchoina la ngei chu;
Laltouna kimvel’in longdol’in asauve,
Achoinau la ngei van kipana.

Chorus
Avahchoiyui chunga van mithengte hon jong,
Kelngoinou lemnan la asauve;
Chu ngei a-itih a chultih neilou,
Kelngounou chu avah jing jenge.

Verse 2
Pathen le Chapa chenna chu avah jinge,
Muthim thahatna aum tapoi;
Chu khopi kot jouse chu sana kijem,
Kelngoinou chu avah jing jenge.

Verse 3
Tonsot kipana gam ilhun phat tengule,
Kana lhisona beisoh tading;
Kel le dangchah natna jong kihe talou ding,
Kelngoinou kivahchoi jing tading.

songs.title: 324. LEI NOPNA HI MANG JONGLE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Lei nopna hi mang jongle,
Ka monna nang nahi o Pakai;
Ka kiselna jong nang nahi,
Na lhagaovin nei umpi jing jengin.

Chorus
Aw nei changlha lou jenin,
Ka monna nahi;
Vo ka Pakai hi leisetna hin,
Nanglou monna dang ken neilou.

Verse 2
Chul ding ka leiset hinkho,
Hung mangloi ding pahbang ka hinkho hi;
Mol’a lep in tin mol tante,
Koukit thei hilou twi bangin along.

Verse 3
Ka hinkho twi banga long,
Nei changlha lou jenin o-Pakai;
Gentheiya lengvai ka nahi,
Nei panpin Pakai lam neihil jingin.

songs.title: 324. PAKAI PATHEN LE JEHOVAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Pakai Pathen le Jehovah,
Kahung taovui Na anga ;
Hiche chapang hung kipui hi,
Lungset’in vang jouse pen.

Chorus
Hiche chapang, hiche naosen,
Kahin puiyui Na anga ;
Lungset themin kichin jingin.
Ahinkho bulhin kahsen.

Verse 2
Pentil’a pat Nangma semin,
Ahung penge pi le pu ;
Akhang khangin nahin chingin,
Na lungset hoithem jal’in.

Verse 3
Hibang chun tun hiche naocha,
Nahin pensah-e leiya ;
Lungset themin phattheina pen,
Tun jong khonung teng jongle.

Verse 4
Pentil neilou hingjing Pathen,
Seijui dihtah hisah-in ;
Leiset set thim jing lah a hin,
Pa Pathenin ching jingin.

songs.title: 325. BEI HEN KA TAHSAN MO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Prov.3:26)

Verse 1
Bei hen ka tahsan mo, ka koma Jesu,
Hoi nante Pathenin Ama chate chu ;
Kei ahenga tao leng thonmon ngai nante,
Ka koma naum le ka olmona bei.

Verse 2
Kalam mu athim vang, Aman eipui nai,
Ken athu ka-ngai ding Aman eipui chu ;
Kong keh hen mijouse lhamang jeng jongle,
Ama thusei vang chu, khangtou jing tei ding.

Verse 3
Ama milungset ken, tuman kamu tai,
Kei athita dingsa, eina chohing tai ;
Aman a-o ngei chun, eina lhem damin.
Aman lung lhaisel’in, eina huhhing tai.

Verse 4
Nat le genthei lengvai lungdon olmona,
Keima lung pha mongem Aman seisoh ta ;
Sochatna ding chu kahei Ama seina,
Iti nama jongle jui jinge Pakai.

Verse 5
Koimacha ngamlou ding ama thoh bang chu,
Athoh tai michonse sochat theina din ;
Lamse joa ache tai kei lampi sanga ;
Pakai che naa chu kei che dang katem ;

songs.title: 325. KUKI CHRISTIAN CHURCH.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi leiset chunga hin chitin namtin,
Simsenlou ichengun, chondan neicheh ihiuve;
Namhat ho gamgi neiyin acheng,
Kuki chate jong Pakaiyin vannoiya;
Alhendaoh nam khat chu ihiuve.
Sim le mal’a chehchaosa ho,
Hung’uvin ka nam mite;
Lungkhat in Pakai vahchoiyute,
Pakai lenggam din tongute;
Vannoi hi Pakai gam ahung hi kahsen.

Verse 2
Malai ipu le ipate hou nam chem khat in,
Ana lam’un, Lojang ana thanguve;
Hibang chun eiho jong lung khat in,
Hunguvin lhagao khat in lam’u hite,
Muthim’a umte salvah dingin.

Verse 3
Pakaiya nam kipum khatten Pakai lenggam,
Akehlet be ding, Idia igeisang diu ham?
Loujao ho amin’in akoi tai,
Pakai lenggam a namdang vaikonte,
Muphah lou gamla tah agei tauve.

songs.title: 326. KOI HUNGKUMLHAM VAN’AKON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.

Verse 1
Koi hung kumlham van”a koiham ?
Eihuhhingpau Jesu;
Naosen’a hung peng koi ham?
Jesu eihuhhingpau.

Chorus
Lim tah-in vahchoi cheh-un,
Sochatna ahin polhai;
Ama sang’a pha umlou,
Jesu eihuhhing pau.

Verse 2
Thingpel’a kithat koi ham?
Jesu eihuhhing pau;
Nang le kei ding’a hinna,
Jesu eihuhhingpau.

Verse 3
“Ngaidam nang’e” tia koi ham?
Jesu eihuhhingpau;
“Tahsanun hing’un” ati,
Jesu eihuhhingpau.

Verse 4
Tua chunga leng chang koi ham?
Jesu eihuhhingpau;
Athu ingai diu koi ham?
Jesu eihuhhingpau.

Verse 5
Koi ham van chunga konna,
Leiya hung kum kit ding?
Agou loupi hung khom ding,
Leng jouse leng Jesun.

songs.title: 326. MALAI PI LE PU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Malai pi le pu chonset thina gui chu,
Tanlouvin mitin chunga alhungsoh tai;
Hiche thina chun vannoi alodim tai,
Vo sopi chonset thina chu nungsun’in.

Chorus
Chonsetna mangsa vannoi mite lhatdoh dingin,
Pakai Cross a kouna O aging tai;
Kouna O ngaiya alunghei jouse chu,
Tonsotna mang talouhel ding.

Verse 2
Sopite tuni tah-in nalung heiyin,
Chonset thina nungsun’in Pakai beljon;
Kisih-a taona o Aman angah jing,
Nang jong nakouve ngailutna o nem’in.

Verse 3
Nalhagao le na hinna apumpi chu,
Pedoh jengin na Pakai ang sunga chun;
Chutengle nalung sung kipana dim ding,
Vahchoina ogin vannoiya thongsoh ding.

Verse 4
Sopite phat hom’in nalung heiloiyin,
Phat hi ache jinge nang na ngalou ding;
Phat hoi pet’in nahuhhingpu chu bel’in,
Phat in nadalhah teng kisih khannate.

songs.title: 327. HUNGUN PATHEN CHATE HUNGUN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Hungun Pathen chate hungun,
Na sempau Pathen henga ;
Athupha hinna le damna,
Hung ngaiyun kahinpoi ken.

Chorus
Hibou hinna le damna thu,
Sochatna nopna lungmonna ;
Achapa Jesu Christa chun,
Hung kumlhan eihung peuve.

Verse 2
Indoi, seldoi, uitheng kithoi,
Pailha soh-un abonchan ;
Apanna, aphatna umlou,
Jou kibol thu aboncha.

Verse 3
Thu kitan ni sochat theina,
Jesu thisan jengcha bou ;
Chuti lou chun adang umlou,
Jesu bou chu sochatna.

Verse 4
Phat anai tai ni alhing tai,
Man gangun tahsan loiyun ;
Achuti loule homlou ding ,
Pathen thupi tanni ding,

Verse 5
Hung kumlhan tin Christa mong chu,
Avantil theng sangja toh ;
Vannoi mihem khom soh-in tin,
Thu atan ding aboncha.

Verse 6
Chuni athu tan nia ding din,
Hung kigon phasa demin ;
“Naphai” tia na lah theina din,
Kunin taovin A-anga.

songs.title: 327. TONGUTE CHRISTA DINGIN.
328. HI LEISET GENTHEINA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Hi leiset gentheina gam’a hin o Pakai,
Selung hel’in ka um;
Lhepna meipi ajinge nitin ka dingin,
Semhoh-in Pakai meipi jing hi.

Chorus
Itih le leiya hin nopna aum dem?
Leiset hi nopna gam ahipoi;
Pakai ang sung bou monna ahi,
Chu gam chu kalhun tei ding ahi.

Verse 2
Aw Pakai niloupi hung lhun ding ka ngahlel,
I-tih le alhung dem?
Nagam sem ngaiyin nitin in ka galdot-e,
Nei hung puiyin Pakai lengvai kei.

Verse 3
Leiset pahhoina hi hungmol ding hijongle,
Nathu mang lou ding;
Ka leiset hinkho hi hungmol ding hijongle,
Chu gam’a din nangin nei puiyin.

Verse 4
Ka leiset hinkho hi hungmol ding hijongle,
Nangma bou einem ding;
Nitin selung hel’in chu gam chu ka galdot,
Einem ding dang umlou leisetna.

songs.title: 328. LHANDAMPU EIPUINA CHAN’
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.sl (Psalm.129:24)

Verse 1
Lhandampu eipuina chan’a,
Ka ngaichat jouse eipe jing ;
Alungset ban chun eihoi jing,
Lam tina ken kajui ding.

Chorus
Eipuina chan’a kajui ding,
Eipuina chan’a kajui ding ;
Eipuina chan’a kajui ding,
Lam tina ken kajui ding.

Verse 2
Ka lampi thim hen jing jongle,
Ka thachol hen genthei jong leng ;
Alungset nan eikipa sah,
Lam tina ken kajui ding.

Verse 3
Lei genthei nan eibom jongle,
Set twipi kinong jeng jongle ;
Alungset banin eihoi jing,
Lam tina ken kajui ding.

Verse 4
Leiset genthei nan eihen teng,
A in noma din eikouve ;
Kilungsetna twipi gal’a,
Lam tina ken kajui ding.

songs.title: 329. KIPAH-UN! PAKAI VAHCHOINAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Rom 8:31)

Verse 1
Kipah-un ! Pakai vahchoinan la sauvin,
Tumging toh thon vahchoi jingun ;
Eilhatdoh tauve ilou ikichat diu,
Jesu ilamkai aum nai.
Pan eipanpiu hen, (3 vei)
Koiman eijou lou diu ; Koi haimo ?
Koimachan jong eidou jou lou diu.

Verse 2
Pakaiya hat’un kipah thanom jingun,
Nitin hat’un chondih jingun,
Thudih a dingun satanin nanai teng,
Aman thahat eipe jing diu.

Verse 3
Athudih a dingun athutep thonlou,
Christaa thakhat ihiuve ;
Lei hi mang jongle Ama hing jingjeng ding,
Ti in Bible in aseiye.

Verse 4
Pakaiya um jingun athun chon jingun,
Ama tonsot hinna ahi ;
Lhagao nat damna Pakai Jesu ahi,
Ama tailou lam dang umlou.

songs.title: 329. PAKAI CHU HUNG DING HITA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai chu hung ding hita,
Avantil asang aja toh;
Vannoi pumpia mitheng ahin lonkhom diu.
Kiging jingun kigo jingun,
Pakai chu hungvah ding ahitai;
Kigo sadam’un um taute,
Vanlai jol’a kilamto din.

Verse 2
Leiset nopsahna leng ho,
Junom sanom ne-a hinkho mang;
Pakai hung niteng dalhah-a umdiu ahi.

Verse 3
Sum le pai ngailu val ho,
Neipap le kisose ho jong;
Pakai hung niteng dalhah-a um diu ahi.

songs.title: 330. KIGINGUN PHAT ANAI TAI.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Kiging’un phat anai tai,
Tin eikihil hil jing’ui;
Vanoi vouso akikhel soh tai.
I-dia lungmong’a nahim sopite.

Chorus
Phat anai (2) O sopite,
Vannoi umchan dalha jengtan;
Kiging jingun (2) Phat umtalou,
Kiging jingun, Kigingun taovun.

Verse 2
Vannoi leiset athil ngaichat,
Mangthah ding kon ahitai;
Keima hungvah jet ding ka hitai,
Kiging jinga um chu anunnom’e.

Verse 3
Vanna avantilte hon jong,
Asumkon cheh mut dingin;
Akiging jingui tuphat tah hin,
Pathen thupeh ngah-in aum jingui.

Verse 4
Pathenin kelngoi le keltah,
Akhen ding kon ahitai;
Kelngoi chengsen vanmun alo diu,
Keltah chengse meidil chang diu ahi.

songs.title: 330. VANTHAH LE LEITHAH KAMU-E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.s. (Rev. 21:1)

Verse 1
Vanthah le leithah kamu-e,
Van masa le leilui mang ding ;
Twikhanglen jong umtalou ding,
Khotheng hoile Jerusalem.

Chorus
Gamthah a Mou neipu aum,
Pathen’a kon mikhat kamui ;
Laltouna kon ahinsei chu,
Pathen mihem lah a alhai.

Verse 2
Pathen mi ahi amaho,
A-pa Pathen mi ahijeh ;
Amitlhiu athehhul peh in,
Thina umkit talou hel ding.

Verse 3
Lunghel ka le nat abeitai,
Thil masa jong mang ding ahi ;
Chule laltouna kona chun,
“Ven thil kasem thah-e” ati.

Verse 4
“Hi thu hi kisut’in” ati.
“Thil hung lhung ding ahi,” ati,
“Kei Alpha le Omega hing,
Hinna twi manbeiyin penge.”

songs.title: 331. JESU NUNGJUI DIN KEI KAKIPAN TAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. d. (Rev. 21:1)

Verse 1
Jesu nungjui din kei ka kipan tai, (3)
Kih kit lou ding. (2)

Verse 2
Ka-ma lma’a cross kanung lam leiset (3)
Kih kit lou ding. (2)

Verse 3
Ken kajui jing ding lhonpi bei jongle, (3)
Kih kit lou ding. (2)

Verse 4
Jesu nungjui dia na kipat tah em ? (3)
Kih kit lou ding. (2)

songs.title: 331. SETNA THIMPI LAH-A.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Setna thimpi lah-a leng lengthei kei,
Kap le maovin hinkho ka mang;
Pakai phat loupi kangah lel’e,
O hung lhung jeng tahen.

Chorus
Pa kasetna nei ngaidam’in lang,
Ka khelna gel louvin;
Nagam thenga dingin neigon lang,
Kisih-in kahung tai.

Verse 2
Hileiset setna thim jing lah-a hin,
Pakai nahung ding ngah lel’in;
Nasemsate kap-in apengui,
O hung lhung jeng tahen.

Verse 3
Leiset loupi le anopna lah-a,
Lungmon le kipana umlou;
Achul’in mol aleploi jitai,
O nagam sem ka ngai.

songs.title: 332. LATAH KHATGAM’AKONIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat. m. (Luke 15:6)

Verse 1
Latah khat gama konin,
Amangsa ahol jinge ;
Ngaiyun kelngoi Chingphan nitin’in eikou,
Mol le lhang le phaichama,
Nisa vah le go noiya,
Aman eihol jingui avah mangsa te.
Gamla kon, gamla kon,
Aman eihol jingui avah mangsate ;
Molle lhang le phaicham a,
Nisa vah le go noiya,
Ngaiyun kelngoi Chingphan nitin’in eikou.

Verse 2
Ven akeng thisan sohta !
Bolsetna ling dimset ta !
Ama phaichama daiya alen laiyin,
Kol lah le song thop lah a,
Hakat tah in eihil’ui ;
Aman eihol’ui amite huhhing din.

Verse 3
O ! kichaita chujan chu,
Amangsa kihol kimta ;
Mol le lhang thim lah a kona hung nauvam ?
Hungun kelngoi chingpu nung ;
Juiyute thanom tah in ;
Pakaiyin nemheocha eipui lai sungin.

songs.title: 332. PHAT KANEI JOUSEA HIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat kanei jousea hin Pakai vahchoi jing ding,
Ka kamsung jong hi Pakai vahchoina hihen;
Pakai vahchoi tailou keiman kipana dang neilou,
O ngei tah-in vahchoi jing’e.

Chorus
Pakai kahol’in Aman eihou tai,
Kagin jouse a kon eihuh tai;
Lengvai genthei kei eihuhhingpa Pakai Jesu,
Kahin kumkhon vahchoi tange.

Verse 2
Ka Pakai nangma ginglou mi hijeng jong leng,
Nei changlha lou jenin hinlai dam sunga hin;
Nagam hunglhun kahsen nangin neipom jingin Pakai,
Vahchoi jing ding hinlai khankhon.

Verse 3
Tanglouva phatna le hepinan ka hinkho,
Lhumkeiya eijui ding hinlai damsunga hin;
Keijong tonsotna dia Pakai angsunga kachen ding,
Chuteng kipana kim tante.

songs.title: 333. LHASAM JENG JONGLEU HEN
songs.lyrics:
Key E. Flat s. (Judges 8:4)

Verse 1
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lhapoute,
Kipana imu theina dingun ;
Jesu Christa nung chu juiyute,
Del jingu hite iphah mauvin.

Chorus
Aniseh-in del jingu hite,
Ka lhasame tia hailou dingin ;
Jesu Christan eipente thahat,
Del jingu hite iphah mauvin.

Verse 2
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lhapoute,
Genthei thoh hi umjengta jongle ;
Jesu Christa chu ahi eiding,
Ijona diu tha dang aum poi.

Verse 3
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lhapoute,
Pu hite lal Christa thingpel chu ;
Eihon iheuve genthei thoh ding,
Su mangu hite aboncha chun.

Verse 4
Lhasam jeng jong leuhen lhapoute,
Adihtah imu theina diuvin ;
Gamtina khovah ahung naiye,
Abanchan ahungchal khovah chu.

songs.title: 333. PHALBI DAP JANKHOSOT SAMANG JALMON.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phalbi dap jankhosot samang jalmon,
Jankhon lung lengin lung gel’in;
Kolmong kikeo kho hung vah-in,
Ka Pakai pen Thupha hin pon.
Jon jing ing’e ka lhandampu,
Penna mun Bethlehem.

Verse 2
Aw galdot’un Bethlehem lhanghoi chu,
Eiho dingin Leng thah hung peng;
Silung lengvaiya gentheiten,
Eilhandampu chu hin veuvin.

Verse 3
Ganhing ju le va te samang thouvun,
Leng ho leng pakai ho Pakai;
Bong in lham gan ankong sungah,
Nang le kei din ahung peng tai.

Verse 4
Leng Herod in suhmang vai anahom,
Tonsot chamna leng chapa chu;
Asuhmang ding chu phal hilou,
Paka vantil’in anahoi.

Verse 5
Vannoi chitin le namtin lah-a hin,
Eilhandampu Christa pen thu;
Gim namtwi bangin kithong hen,
Amin loupin vannoi lo hen.

songs.title: 334. GOSPEL DAH GIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Gospel Dah thip ding kigota vannoiya hin,
Phat hoilai ho la chemang jouta;
Vannoiya haona le nopsahna nitin apung jing,
Noah nikho alhung kit tai.
Muthim natoh pailhau hite,
Khovah von’in kivon’u hite;
Chunglam veuvin phat anai tai.

Verse 2
Aw gel tem’uvin khamna thei gutui ho hin,
Mihem hinkho apuimang joutai;
Khamna theiya lop chu mingol ahi tin,
Michingpan asei, Agiloupa ankong ahi.

Verse 3
Tahsa damloute dia damna lou le ai ho,
Thina gutwiyin asohjou tai;
Tena val’a neh le donin mihem hinkho asumange,
Muthim lengpa deilam ahi.

Verse 4
Huhhingsa ho dia hinna gimnamtwi Pakai,
Athi ho dia thina gim namtwi;
Huhhingna kot a lut loiyun tin Pakai eikou jingui,
Nalung heiyun phat abei tai.

songs.title: 334. KA LHA LE KA THISAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.s. (Eph. 2 : 1)

Verse 1
“Ka lha le ka thisan,
Ken nang din kape tai ;
Na sochat theina din,
Genthei tah in Ka thi,
Kapei, kapei ken ka thisan,
Nangman ineipeh em ?

Verse 2
Ka pa in nom tah le !
Ka latlouna loupi ;
Ka dalhai nang chunan,
Gim le da ka thoh-in ;
I na hin dalhah em nangman,
Keima nei chuna a.
3 Vana nop ka dalhan,
Genthei tin ka thoh-in ;
Damun meikonga kon,
Na sochat theina din ;
Nangman chuta i-na thoh em ?
Keima nei chuna a.

Verse 4
Van kona hinna,
Nopna, damna, olna ;
Ngaidam kahin polhan.
Manbeiyin nang kapei ;
I-na hinpoh em kei dinga ?
Keima i-neipeh em ?

songs.title: 335. LEISETNA HIN MONNA UMLOU.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leisetna hin monna umlou,
Gentheina le kana jeng bou;
Christa bou chu eihuhhing ding.
Ken peltange ka kana gam lei gentheina,
Ngaikit lou ding Christa kom’a;
Lei gentheina um talou ding.

Verse 2
Eihuhhingpu van kelngoinou,
Na thisanin nei huhhing tai;
Kei dinga nathisan long chu.

Verse 3
Leiset thimpi jing lah-a hin,
Kap le maovin hinkho aleng;
Ka Pa gamsem kalhun tengle.

Verse 4
Leiset twipi kinong laiya,
Agal lang khat kajot lai hin;
Setna huipi nung jeng jongle.

songs.title: 335. LOOK AND LIVE.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. sl (Isaiah. 45:22)

Verse 1
Pakai thupeh kahinpoi Halleluijah !
Hichu nangho dinga hinna ;
Hi Ama thupeh ahi Halleluijah !
Veuvin na hinna diu chu ahi.

Chorus
Ven lang hingun sopite,
Na hinnau Jesu veuvin ;
Hi Ama thupeh ahi Halleluijah,
Veuvin na hinna diu chu ahi.

Verse 2
Lungset a thah kahin poi Halleluijah,
Nangho ding ahi goldei ho ;
Chung gama hungkon ahi Halleluijah !
Pakai Jesun eihilchen tauve.

Verse 3
Hinna nahinpe tauve Halleluijah !
Na lhagao tonsot’a hing ding ;
Pakai jeng bou veleu chun Halleluijah !
Ama tahsan bou chu sochatna.

songs.title: 336 PAKAI JESUN ASEIYE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai Jesun aseiye kiging’un anai tai,
Van le leiset pumpi hung mang ding;
Keima thu vang jemhalcha jong manglou ding ahi.
Aw Pakai nagam hunglhun ding chu,
Tahsan chaten agaldot jingui;
Mitheng ho napui khom ni tengle,
Michonse din mun aum dem.

Verse 2
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu Pathen ama tailou,
Chapa le Vantilten jong helou;
Mihem chapa hung ding chu Thang banga kipel ding.

Verse 3
Pathen Chapa hung ding chu kiging’un anai tai,
Noah nikho lai mite bang’a;
Kimangcha ho jouse chu mangthai ding ahiuve.

Verse 4
Pakai chu ahung tengle se le pha akhen ding,
Khat kila khat chu kidalha ding;
Michonse tahsan bei chu leisetna mangthai ding.

songs.title: 336. TUN ATHANGDINGLE AGALJOU DIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B.Flat d. (Rev. 6:2)

Verse 1
Tun athang dingle agaljou dingin,
Lalmang Pakai ading tai ;
Asepai hat sangja chu aloiyin,
Gal kisatna munna chun,
Malam jonin aloite chun,
Semtoh dingin angaiton ;
Alamkai pau vahchoi dingin,
A aovui kipah tah-in.
Gal gin um chu koiham ajou ding,
Koimacha umlou ahat ;
Mithengte le ginchat te din,
Jona thutepsa ahi.

Verse 2
Tun athang dingle agaljou din,
Koi ham leng kidang tah chu ?
Asepai anung juite jouse chun,
Itih a vahchoi chimlou ;
Ka Pakai le Lhandampu chu,
Lhandampu lalpen ahi,
Agam thenga chun van ahsi,
Bangin a em’ui kum khon.

Verse 3
Tun athang dingle agaljou din,
Nang leng chungnung mang chungnung ;
Lei laltouna le aloupina chu,
Sepai sangja kumkhoa din ;
Ginchatna ding thumte chu,
Adougal ajo tengle ;
Pakai laltouna muna chun,
Olna loupi changta ding.

songs.title: 337 KEIMA CHUNAN VANLAL LENG.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Keima chunan O Vanlal lengpa chu,
Cross chunga chun along ahung toh-e;
Ahung thoh-e michonse kei dingin,
Thisanin eilhat tai.
Agimnei ngeiye Pakai nathisan lu,
Michonse kei dinga nathoh;
Ohe ana ngeiye.

Verse 2
I-Pakai Jesu athi ding kon chun,
Nidan gup apat nidan ko geiyin;
Gam jouse chu thimpi ahung jingin,
Vannoi angui jou tai.

Verse 3
Pakaiyn alhagao alha kon chun,
Gam le go anguiyin lunghem tah-in;
Pakai lhagao nakhut a kapei tin,
Chujou chun atan tai.

Verse 4
Galilee a kon ahin kilhonpi,
Numei ho jong chu I-Pakai Jesu;
Nailut ngam louvin gal kanga konin,
Veuvin mitlhi pum’in.

songs.title: 337. MARTYRDOM.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Vo Pathen Nang Leng chungnungpen,
Kalung thim’u na ven ;
Ijakai ka got’u Nangin,
Namun nahe jingnai.

Verse 2
Nangma na-ihmu milji poi,
Keiho neiching jiuvin ;
Lungthim phatah nei sempeh-un,
Pakai Jesu vang chun.

Verse 3
Na thu thua umding ka nom’ui,
Na thu hinna ahi ;
Hijeh chun neihe jingun lang,
Na mite ka hiuve.

songs.title: 338 PAKAI PATHEN THUHENG
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Pakai Pathenin athutheng bua einahil’ui,
Ninunung lam teng thil kidang hungsoh ding;
Vatnom datmo le hetlou kidang ho,
Nidan tin’a hungsoh jing ding.
Kiging’un kigouvin,
Pakai hungna ding nikho anai;
Kiging jingun aphat ding kihelou,
Khodah-un vejingun, Ahung nading lam chu;
Galdot jingun hung tei ding.

Verse 2
Keima gamnai teng neipap kiloset hung pung ding.
Kilung tona le dei le ngai hung chom ding;
Vai khat le vaikhat hung kidou to ding,
Thunoh lungjin nan lei lo ding.

Verse 3
Keima gam naiteng kami Israel kahin khop ding,
Gamtin’a soh bul’a atham nauva kon;
Gam lungset um chu hung kile kit ding,
Vannoiya hung thangsoh loi ding.

Verse 4
Pakai Pathenin athutheng bua eihil bang chun,
Vannoiya cham le lungmonna um talou;
Nitin thilsoh le thuthang ho jousen,
Agam nai dan eihil jing’ui.

songs.title: 338. THROUGH THE VALLEY OF THE SHADOW.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F (Psalm 23:4)

Verse 1
Phaicham lima chu keima kache tei ding,
Hin Lhandampu lungset noiya kache ding ;
Aman itih hijongle eilhalou ding,
Aman chua nopna eipe ding.

Chorus
Phaicham lima, (2 vei)
Phaicham lima chu keima kache tei ding ;
Hin Jordan twi nongin eisuse lou ding,
Chua chamna aum ken kahei.

Verse 2
Phaicham lima chu keima kache tei ding,
Lung gentheina jouse jong beisoh tading ;
Jesun aban thahat’a eituh jing ding,
Keima lung genthei kit talou ding.

Verse 3
Phaicham lima chun kei vahle jeng jong leng,
Jing khovah loupitah chu ken kamu ding ;
Jordan gal’a Pa vahchoina kei lha ding,
Chu muna lungsetnan eingah jing.

Verse 4
Phaicham lim lama chu keima kache ding,
Ka Pakai chena chana ken kajui ding ;
Phaicham lima Aman kei eipui jing ding,
Keiman choldona kamu kahsen.

songs.title: 339 PHAT HI AKEM HINKHO JONG.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Phat hi akem hinkho jong hi akem,
Puldou na le vangsetnan eichup tai;
Mangthah tei ding ka hitai o-Pakai,
Nei lhamon’in thahat neipen.

Chorus
Aw ka damna Pakai,
Tha neipen nei hatsah jingin;
Nangbou ka hansanna,
Gin ding dang ken nei talou ding.

Verse 2
Ka damlai khankho ding gelna in,
Beitih neilou chimtih nei theilouvin;
Hinla nanglou olna ding dang neilou,
Pakai na ang kahin bel tai.

Verse 3
Nangma sonna nohpan tange Pakai,
Neivop pou le idang kagin ding ham;
Hahsa hen lang nom ding hijeng jongle,
Nanung kajui jing ding Pakai.

Verse 4
Tahsan chate kiging jingun taovun,
Leiset phat hi hung mangloi jeng tale;
Geisang le chun phat homlel khannate,
Chimmon tongin phat hoilai hin.

songs.title: 339. NAKOT’A DING JIN LE CHU
340 MICHONSE HO KITHANA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Michonse teho kithana Calvary Cross,
Chu-a chun ka Pakai akhaiyun;
Melma simjou loute chun themmo achan’un,
Chonse kei dinga hinna ahi.

Chorus
Van lal leng Pakai ahi,
Leiya genthei tintang thohpa chu;
Melmate chun thinga khaisang jongleu,
Michonse keima eilhatna ahi.

Verse 2
Angailut numeite chun ama ajuiyun,
Aloiten vang adalha tauve;
Jerusalem chanute nangho din kap-un,
Namtin din kahinna kape tai.

Verse 3
Aw ka Pakai thinin van lung angui jeng tai,
Nisan jong avah songam louvin;
Thimpi ahung jingin lingpi akihot’e,
Chonse kei dia Pakai thi ni hin.

Verse 4
Ana ngeiye Pakai kei dia nathohna chu,
Chonse kei din nahinna napei;
Nei lungsetna sajoulou ka hinlai khankhon,
Ka hinna nang din kapei Pakai.

songs.title: 340. KHATVEI PATHEN CHAKHAT
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.Flat. s. (Luke 16:22)

Verse 1
Khatvei Pathen cha khat thi dingin aum,
Mihaopa kot benga atouve ;
Apanna umlou mi haopa sum le sel,
Lebu din vannah a-ngah jinge.

Chorus
Vantilten apuitai olna gam lama,
Chung lama la ngei gin akithong ;
Lhandampun alamtoi van golvahna din,
Lungdei gol kholna mun van gamnom.

Verse 2
I chunguva kidohna aum jinge,
I hinkho bu-lhinna iti ding ;
I lamjot pum’a pohgih ipoh laiyun,
Lung donga i-mitlhiu lon laihin.

Verse 3
Pakai seijui nanghon nakhol khom jongle,
Vana gou manlun na ngah jinge ;
Genthei kipan gel’in umsot talou ding,
Kikhelna ding nitin anaiye.

Verse 4
Manon Pakai lam chu manon chunga din,
Na phat le nana toh Pakai din ;
Na toh lhom jongle nasan ding atame,
Tua gentheina kipa Lallukhuh.

songs.title: 341 JORDAN LUIKAM GAL LAM’A.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Jordan luikam gallam’a chun,
Canan gam nom kagal dot le;
Tona kalung dei khensate,
Vanmi laiya lengin kamui.

Chorus
Lhandampu ngailutna loupi,
Vahchoiyun thisanna lhatten;
Kipa chullou pahna gam’a,
Van mite laiya kalen ding.

Verse 2
Aw vetan phat akidang tai,
Chu gam loupi a lhungte chun;
Alungdon kipana changta,
Tonsot hinna nopna a chun.

Verse 3
Lei hesohna jouvin lengun,
Lungdon puldou kana beita;
Mitlhi longa khenpisa te,
Kipah a ikimu kit diu.

Verse 4
Damlai hesoh genthei thoh-a,
Lhandampu jal’a gentheiten;
Lhagao olna nom a changta,
Kumkhoa nopna kem talou ding.

songs.title: 341. PATHEN’AIKIPAJING’U
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat.sl (Psalm.29:11, Sol.1:8)

Verse 1
Pathenna ikipa jingu,
Halna simthei louvin ;
Agou kholna vangam nom chu,
Chonnem na din heute
.
Chukom chu hinna ahi,
Mun emtah vangam nom ahi ;
Christa puma eiya ahi,
Kipah tah-in avahchoi la saute.

Verse 2
Manbeiyin chonsetna jouse,
Moh-in ngaidam ahi ;
Ngaidamna chu Pakai Jesu,
Thisan chu ahitai.

Verse 3
Chonset thahat jona pen chu,
Ama ahung kipei ;
Chonna athen theina ding chun,
Atheng chu ijatai.

Verse 4
Pathen na halna aume,
Halna chu ajal’e ;
Pathenin Christa eipeuve,
I lungu atheng tai.

songs.title: 342 THEMGAO HO SEI BANGIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Themgao ho sei bangin leng Christa chu,
Apeng Bethlehem’a;
Kipah-ute leiya namtin jousen,
Leng Immanuel’a chu.

Chorus
Van mipiten Bethlehem lhang chunga,
A-oi van leng cha chu;
Chungnung penna loupi pen hen,
Leiya cham leng hen ati.

Verse 2
Kelngoiching hon akelngoi nga pet’un,
Vantil loupi tah chun;
Bethlehem’a huhhingpu apeng tai,
Alem din cheuvin ati.

Verse 3
Van’a ahsi vah em loupi tah chun,
Solam michingte chu;
Apui jinge Bethlehem lhang geiyin,
Gou thil lu chu apeuve.

songs.title: 342. JING NINOU SANGIN NAHOIJOI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is. A.Flat.m. (S. Solomon 5:16)

Verse 1
Jing ninou sangin nahoijoi,
Lhandampu le ka Lengpa ;
Nahoi le navah emsel chu,
Ka lungin jaichim theilou.

Chorus
Jing ninou sangin nahoi joi,
Sunlai ni sangin jong navah joi ;
Loupi chungnung nang umna a,
Mei le thim aki hoh-e.

Verse 2
Ponbang vamleh a kijem Nang,
Na Lallukhuh emsel toh ;
Na vaihomna Leng gama chun,
Tonsot Pakai Nang nahi.

Verse 3
O na milungset loupi chu,
Na mikhoto chu haona ;
Na lenggam kilungsetna chun,
Kei din jong mun aseme.

Verse 4
Hinlai sana gui atan teng,
Leiset hinkho hung mang ding ;
Tang louvin chu gam hoiya chun,
Na vahchoi la ken sange.

songs.title: 343 THINA JORDAN KAM’A.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Thina Jordan kam’a lungdongin lha ajah,
Boina mei ajing kho athim’e Pakai;
