Kama a hung vah kit in lang,
O lhagao kaki pana pen.

Chorus
Nanglou chun toni kalhum joupoi Pakai,
Eden lui tol’a lengte hin;
Kakou Leng nunnem eipuipa,
Nalim noiya len kanom ta ngeiye.

Verse 2
Nopna kolvah ding chu kap’in kagaldot’e,
Mu ni um’intem ngai naiye Pakai;
Kadin kho hung vahkit hen lang,
O kalai ka bang tange.

Verse 3
Ka chenna ding gamnom ka ngai leisetna hin,
Chuteng Lalnunnem vahchoiyin la asa;
Bang louvin Sharon pah choiyin,
Ka galdot lungjin noiya hin.

songs.title: 343. VO JESU KEI EICHING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat.sl (Isaiah 12:2)

Verse 1
Vo Jesu kei eiching le Eihuhhing,
Ka gingchai Nang ; (2 vei)
Loupina chu ka tepkha masa tai,
Nangma ka tahsan lai hin.

Chorus
Ka tahsane,
Jesu Eihuhhingpa Nang ;
Loupina chu ka tepkha masa tai,
Nangma ka tahsan lai hin.

Verse 2
Ka kimvel twipi kinong jeng jongle,
Ka gingchai Nang ; (2 vei)
Songpi chunga kalha kaphut dettai,
Pakai Nang ka tahsane.

Verse 3
Muthimin eium kimvel jeng jongle,
Ka gingchai Nang ; (2 vei)
Nangma thahat chu nitinin kamui,
Nangma ka tahsan lai hin.

Verse 4
Vo Jesu Eihuhhing, Eiching kagol,
Ka gingchai Nang ; (2 vei)
Nangman neihoiyin neihuhhing jingin,
Nangma ka tahsan lai hin.

songs.title: 344. PATHEN MIKHOTONAKEMLOU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B.Flat.sl (I John 4:8)

Verse 1
Pathen mi khotona kemlou,
I lamvai nau lam jousea ;
Lengvai gentheite salvah jing,
Pathen chu vah le lungset.
Pathen chu vah le lungset,
Pathen chu vah le lungset.

Verse 2
Phat kikhel jing nitin kikhel,
Mite kem khang kikhel jing ;
Pa lungset vang kemtih umlou,
Pathen chu vah le lungset.

Verse 3
Nidan khat jeng jong kikhel lou,
Pathen phatna kilang jing ;
Mite Pathen vah le lungset,
Pathen chu vah le lungset.

songs.title: 344. TUA BOINA LHANGVUM’A DINGIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tua boina lhangvum a dingin,
Ngahlel’in van kho ka galdot;
Kumkho a kamil lou lungdeite,
Pon bang sil’a alennau.

Chorus
Eilungset in ka ngah jinge,
Ka kana gam jaojeng jongle;
Lhat teho bang louva ka lennau,
Mun gal mong chu nei lhut’in.

Verse 2
O ka din leiset hi boi jongle,
Tonsot kho ahung vah tengle;
Boina ho jouse hi bei tante,
Ka ngah-e niloupi chu.

Verse 3
Asot ngeiye kei ding boina,
Chul jeng jongle lei pahcha hi;
Mu kanom’e lhatte tol lenna,
Lungdei jouse kimta ding.

Verse 4
Damlai gamthip hi kapel tengle,
Van mite kipah-a lenna;
O khen louvin hinna thinglim’a,
Vahchoina bang talou ding.

songs.title: 345 ZION CHATE.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Leiset pon in kiphelha jongle,
Khopi hoitah chu keiman kanei nai;
Pakaiyin asem Zion chate lenna,
Hichu ka tonsot in.

Chorus
Zion chate jalenna ding ni chu anai tai,
Najao nadem o sopi?
Geisang le chun tonsot kot kihon homlou ding,
Hinkho damlai Pakaiya din peuvin.

Verse 2
Lei lung ngainan puimang khan nate,
Damlai nikho ngaichat thil atam’e;
Pah bang ihinkho mollep ding koncha hin,
Pakai na tong’ute.

Verse 3
Pakai Christa lalna gam’a chun,
Leng le lal chaga genthei um talou;
Lhunkal ka ngahlel Zion chate lenna,
Hichu ka tonsot in.

Verse 4
Nilhum kon vai chephat ahitai,
Vantilte le mitheng chemasa hon;
Khongpi le Baja thon eina-ngah jingui,
Vanna kilamto din.

songs.title: 345. DETNA NEILOU KEI TOBANG DIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. d. (Jn. 1:29)

Verse 1
Detna neilou kei tobang din,
Na thisan kei din alonge ;
Nahenga hung din nei kouve,
O ka-Pakai kei ka hunge !

Verse 2
Vaicha genthei mitcho kei din,
Lungsung natna sudam nahi ;
Heng ka ngaichan Nanga mudin,
O ka-Pakai kei ka hunge !

Verse 3
Sangin nate kei tobang hi,
Ngaidam, suhtheng, eilha ong din ;
Na thutep ka tansan jal’in,
O ka Pakai kei ka hunge !

Verse 4
Na lungset hetheilou keima,
Na thupeh chan sukeh jong leng;
Tun nangma a bou hi dingin,
O ka Pakai kei ka hunge !

songs.title: 346 NEISOL’IN NAVAH HOM DIN.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi muthim gam sung hi,
Nathun hin salvah soh-in;
Nathu ngaicha lhagao sang tamtah aum,
Tahsa dangchahna hilou;
Lhagao dangchah ahiuve,
Koi ham Pakai na natong ding chu.
Nei sol’in Navah hom din,
Cheng kate muntin le gamtin’a;
Hillhang lenge kipana thupha hi,
Chitin namtin kolkim vel’a.

Verse 2
Pakai na toh ding atam,
Natong ding mi alhom’e;
Koi ham Pakai chang at khom’a che ding chu,
Chang khoptup phat alhing tai;
Changvui akoi soh gam tai,
Koi ham Pakai natonga che ding.

Verse 3
Ka hinkho phat chomcha hi,
Nang vahchoinan mang tange;
Joshua banga hangtah a pang jing jeng din,
Kahung kipei Nang’a din;
Ka hinkho hoilai sung hi,
Nei mangchan Pakai na natong din.

songs.title: 346. KOUNA O NGAIYUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.d. (Joshua 5:15)

Verse 1
Kouna O ngaiyuvin,
Tua che ding koiham ?
Koiham kasei ngailou,
Ken kasei lou ham ?
Koiham eipanpi ding,
Galsatna mun’a ?
Dihtah le dettah a,
Pathena ding ding ?
Jesun aloi ponlap noiya achinge ;
Eihon ibon’un, leiset jouvu hite.

Verse 2
Pathenin “Choldo’uvin,
Phat alhin kah sen ;
Satan galsat dingin,
Kiging jinguvin !
Thoh hatna ilhagao,
I huhhing dingu ;
Pathen galsatna lung,
Le tha pannu te !

Verse 3
Sumkon gin chu ngaiyun,
Sauvin kijot’un ;
I lamkai len pau le,
I leng loupiu chu !
Lungkhat le thakhat in,
Gamla le naiya,
Kijot’un galsatna,
Kouna mun’a chun.

songs.title: 347. KAMIT’IN GAMNOM AMU TAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. sl (Heb.11:16)

Verse 1
Ka mit’in gamnom amutai,
Lunga jong gelphah louna chu ;
Aloupina chu emjing ding,
A vah chun asal emsel’e.

Chorus
Gam lungset em le kipana,
Naloupina chu vah jing jeng ;
Na gam em chu keiho chan ding,
Hiche leiset aman tengle.

Verse 2
Chua gamnom em sunga chun,
Thina le cholna um talou ;
Ikikhenpi gol ngaite toh,
Kimua kikhen kit talou ding,

Verse 3
Mel kikhel kit louna gama,
Genthei lengvai aum tapoi ;
Nisa vah jong angai tapoi,
Atonsot tonsot’a em jing.

Verse 4
Chua ka le lhiso beita,
Gentheina idalhah tengle ;
Gentheite chun in nom muta,
Pathen chenna gamnoma chu.

songs.title: 347. PAKAI KHOPI THENG SUNGA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Tonsot Zion kho ahung vah teng,
Pakai Lhandampu mel kamu ding;
Chuteng kakipana chamkim tading,
Pakai khopi theng sunga.
Pakai khopi theng nop le hoidan seijoulou,
Akot jouse songmantam jeng;
Alamlen jong sana a kijem,
Chu-a ni le lha vah ngailou;
Pakai khopi theng sunga.

Verse 2
Mi kiletsah ho le hoitho ho,
Pakai lungdei louva chon jouse;
Lut louhel diu van Canan gam thah nom,
Pakai khopi theng sunga.

Verse 3
Lungthenga tahsanna dettah-a,
Pakai ging jinga umte jouse;
Lut tei diu thon louhel’a gamtheng pen,
Pakai khopi theng sunga.

Verse 4
Ka le lhiso genthei lengvaina,
Um talou ding Pakai khopia;
Kel le chah chol le nan jong beita ding,
Pakai khopi theng sunga.

songs.title: 348. CHAMNA LENGPA APENG BETHLEHEM’A.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Chamna lengpa apeng Bethlehem’a,
Hichu gam lailung pen Canan gam nom;
Namtin dinga kenga lhun theina ahi,
Chu-a hinna le dam twitheng along’e.

Chorus
Aw lunglhaisel’in naosen leng pen ni hin,
Kipah-in saute cham le lung olna;
Chitin namtin dingin sochatna ahi,
Nom’un lem’un Halleluiyah tiuvin.

Verse 2
Phalbi dapjan khosot phoinel chunga,
Kelngoi ching hon akelngoi nga pet’un;
Jankhang laiyin Gabriel in ahung vil’un,
Hinna damna thupha kahin poi ati.

Verse 3
Chuin vantil sangjan vanlaijol’a,
Hung kilah-in chung la ngei asauve;
Chungnung pen’a Pathen loupina hi hen,
Lei chunga kipa le chamna leng ta hen.

Verse 4
Kelngoi ching hon chu khopi sung jon’un,
Solam michingten jong chu kho jon’un;
Chibai boh-in vaichaten anei sun’un,
Leng le Lalten jong agoubom’u hong’un.

songs.title: 348. PAKAI TO KILOI ITI NOPHITAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. m. (Deut.33:27)

Verse 1
Pakai to kiloi iti nop hitam ?
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai ;
Hibang phattheina, hibang nom lenna,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai.

Chorus
Kingai, kingai,
Iti jeng jongle ka hoina ;
Kingai, kingai,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai.

Verse 2
Leiset hinlai khojin le ka hoina,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai ;
Nitin chamna lampi avah jinge,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai.

Verse 3
Gin ding ken neilou lungdon umtalou,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai ;
Lung ol, jalenna, chamna ken neita,
Tonsot longlou banjal’a kingai.

songs.title: 349. HINKHO THAH MEL AKIDANGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.Flat.sl (I Peter. 1:8)

Verse 1
Hinkho thah mel akidange,
Lhandampu kamu nin ;
Ka lungset Lhandampu dei um,
Ken kamui Cross phunga chun.

Chorus
Lungdon tijat beisohta,
Jesun muthim salvahta ;
Van chung gam nom la talou,
Lhandampu kamu nin.

Verse 2
Ei lungsetna O nem kajai,
Lhandampu kamu nin ;
A lhatdamna thu hinpo lhan,
Tun keima eilhatdoh tai.

Verse 3
Lhandampun eikou ken kajai,
Min loupi ka chang tai ;
Nasa tah-in kei eihoiye,
Huhhingna chu kachang tai.

Verse 4
Akhut’in keima eikai lei,
Lhandampu kamu nin ;
Alaltouna limdam noiya,
Eihuhhingpa kamu ding.

songs.title: 349. HUHHING LENGPA.
songs.lyrics:
Verse 1
Vannoi mi huhhing ding leng chu,
Ahung peng tai Bethlehem’a;
Alemnan van mitheng jousen,
Aw ngeitah in avahchoiyui.
Vahchoiyute Huhhing Lengpa,
Vahchoiyute lhatdamsaten;
Seiphong leute muntin le gam tin’a,
Thina lim’a tou nalai hon;
Hinna vah amu nadiuvin,
Seiphong leute hinoi leisetna hin.

Verse 2
Solam michingte jousen jong,
Huhhing Leng pen kipapinan;
Manlu Sana, Bego, Mor’in,
Agalem’ui Bethlehem’a.

Verse 3
Chung le noi thilsem jousen jong,
Avahchoiyui chamna Lengpa;
Leiya lhenchomte jousen jong,
Aw ngeitah-in vahchoiyute.

Verse 4
Chungnung’a Pathen loupi hen,
Leiya cham le lungmon leng hen;
Alung lhaina mite chung’a,
Tu le Tonsot’in umjing hen.

songs.title: 350. LENGSEPAIYAPANGDIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Leng sepaiya pang din mijouse akouvui,
Kiphal thenga Pakai galsat hu dingin ;
Nangle kei jong eikou nakigot hinam ?
Lut’uvin Pakai sepaiya pang dingin.

Chorus
Jesu sepai pha pang ding thudih keng nga,
Namin nakhum tah em, galsat dia ;
Jesu chu gal lamkai, kichatna umlou,
Lut’uvin Pakai sepaiya pang dingin.

Verse 2
Thanei tah sepai galsat din Jesun nakou,
Nitina na tonga ajen lea pang din ;
Aman nang lha lou ding na umpi jing ding,
Lut’uvin Pakai sepaiya pang dingin.

Verse 3
Aman lungset le khoto tah in nakouve,
Alungset khon neilou kouna O ngaiyin ;
Tunin nang nakouve jaidam O nemin,
Lut’uvin Pakai sepaiya pang dingin.

Verse 4
Gal kisat kichaiya galjo la kisah teng,
Thudih a gal joute hinkou khomin tin ;
Loupina lallukhuh asan diu ahi,
Lut’uvin Pakai sepaiya pang dingin.

songs.title: 351. JUDA MAICHAM CHUNG’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Heb. 10:1)

Verse 1
Juda maicham chunga,
Gan thisan longlha chun ;
Lunggel anemjou talouva,
Chonset sutheng thei lou.

Verse 2
Van Kelngoi nou tah chun,
Ka chonset eipoh peh ;
Kithoina Christa thisan chun,
Chonset pon mansah thei.

Verse 3
Na anga kisih a,
Ka tahsanna ban jah hi ;
Na sipjang lutah a ngama,
Kahung lut thol ahi.

Verse 4
Tahsanin Cross lam ven,
Amui napohgih chu ;
Poh a chu ka chonset nakop,
O eilhat ngai um pen.

Verse 5
Hijeh chun ka Pakai,
Vahchoina jouse hi ;
Nangma a hihen tonsot’in,
Nanga bou kahi tai.

songs.title: 352. NILOUPI KHAT IMU TAUVE
353. CALLING THE PRODIGAL.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. s. (Luke 15:11-19)

Verse 1
Chapa jammang hung loiyin Pathenin nakouve,
Ngaiyin Aman nakouve nakou jinge ;
Ana vahmang jeng jong le chun hungtan tuni hin,
Lungset O’n nakou nakouve.

Chorus
Nangma nakouve,
Lung genthei nangma hungin ;
Nangma nakouve,
Lung genthei nangma hungin.

Verse 2
Thoh hat le lungset tongnem Pan nangma nakouve,
Ngaiyin Aman nakouve nakou jinge ;
Hung kinungle kittan Lhathengin nakou pet hin,
Lungset O’n nakou nakouve.

Verse 3
Hungtan Napa innah nang chan ding anneh aum,
Ngaiyin Aman nakouve nakou jinge ;
Van golvah ankong nangma ngah-in aum jinge,
Ngaiyin lungset O’n na-kouve.

songs.title: 354. OH WONDEROUS NAME.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.s. (Isaiah 9:6)

Verse 1
Ama min ngei kithang tah chu,
Themgao hon aheuve;
Ahung ding ahe masauve,
Vannoi chamna Pakai.

Chorus
Kidang tah a thusei thempa !
Hatchungnung pen Pakai !
Tonsot hinna Pakai Ama !
Pathen Chapa ahi !

Verse 2
Ama mintheng avahchoiyun,
Vana um lhatheng ten;
Loupi chungnung pen Ama min,
Eiho kingaina ding.

Verse 3
Choiyun Ama mintheng tah chu,
Hatchungnung pen Ama;
Ama vanga thahat kimu,
Vangam lhun theina ding.

songs.title: 355. CHUNG GAM INJON IKHOLJIN PET’U HIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. sl

Verse 1
Chung gam injon ikholjin pet’u hin seiyu hite,
Lhatdamna loupi tah thupha chu ;
Sau hite kipah le la ngeiyin lungsetna O chu,
Lhatdamna loupi tah thupha chu.

Chorus
Sei leuvin, sei leuvin,
Sei phongun phungtin namtina ;
Sei leuvin, Sei leuvin,
Lhatdamna loupi tah thupha chu.

Verse 2
Athu theng phongdoh dingte thisanin asop thenge,
Lhatdamna loupitah thupha chu ;
Alungsetna kemlou vah chun muthim asalvah-e,
Lhatdamna loupitah thupha chu.

Verse 3
Galsat muna la isah diu hichu galjona la,
Lhatdamna loupi tah thupha chu ;
Kivet chilna gam idalhah kahseuva isah diu,
Lhatdamna loupitah thupha chu.

Verse 4
Lhathengten tumging jouse toh thon sahjou tih neilou,
Lhatdamna loupitah thupha chu ;
Lhatdamna vou hoitah a chu Jesu avahchoi diu,
Lhatdamna loupi tah thupha chu.

songs.title: 356. VANAKON HUNGKUMLHAKOI HAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.

Verse 1
Vana kon hung kumlha koiham ?
Tonsot’a kem theilou Pathen ;
Ijeh a chung hin dalha ham ?
Michonse hin ding khotona.

Chorus
Jesu tobang koima umlou,
Mihemte phatna dinga thi ;
Achonset suhmangsoh peh-in,
Pathen Lal chungnungpen nom hen.

Verse 2
Along atom Pathen cha chun ?
Henge gimle genthei thoh in ;
Ijeh a gim genthei thoh ham ?
Mihemte chonset thenna ding.

Verse 3
Athi jouva chu iti tam ?
Athi jouvin athou kittai ;
Atho jouva iti kit tam ?
Jousoh-in van’a akaltai.

Verse 4
Tu jonga hia chu umam ?
Henge a-Pa alhai jinge ;
Iti tao lhaiyem koi dinga ?
Iphatna dingu angaitoi.

Verse 5
Ichelou diu ham ahenga ?
Kachei ami hepia lut din ;
Hungun hibang mi hepi henga.
Michonse ngaidama Pathen.

songs.title: 357. PAKAI NATONGAMITE CHU AVANGPHA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A flat sl

Verse 1
Pakai natonga mite chu avangpha,
Songmantam banga manlu pen na lhagao ;
Lhagao tamtah chunga puidohna dingin,
Ajouho lhagao vangpha.

Chorus
Ajouho lhagao vangpha,
Chung gam inpi nom laiya ;
Aman simjoulou lallukhuh isan diu,
Ajouho lhagao vangpha.

Verse 2
In noma chun lungset maiso jeng vah ding,
Nitin Jesu banga hing jing jengta ding ;
Mangthah ding lhagao van lama ipui diu,
Ajou ho lhagao vangpha.

Verse 3
Taona to thon eiho chejing jengute,
Mun tinna mangsa lhagao holdoh-in lang ;
Kelngoi ching Pakai koma ium jing diu,
Ajouho lhagao vangpha.

Verse 4
Gospel thu chu gamtina galhang samin,
Lungsetna thu nalung sunga ching jingin ;
Chonsen Pakaiya lung aheina dingin,
Ajouho lhagao vangpha.

songs.title: 358. KAPHALTHENG TAI PAKAI DINGIN
songs.lyrics:
. Doh is D. Duet S. & T. (Mark.10:28)

Verse 1
Ka phaltheng tai Pakai dingin,
Manbeiyin kaphal theng tai ;
Ken ngai jingle tahsan jing ding,
Nitin Aman eiching ding.

Chorus
Ka phaltheng soh tai,
Ka phaltheng soh tai ;
Eihuhhingpa Nanga dingin,
Ka phaltheng soh tai.

Verse 2
Ka phal thengtai, Pakai dingin,
Nemin A anga ka kun ;
Leiset nopna kanuse tai,
Tun Pakaiyin neiching tan.

Verse 3
Ka phaltheng tai, Pakai dingin,
Huhhingpan nei suthengin ;
O Lhagao theng hihen ahe,
Kei Nanga, Nang keima a.

Verse 4
Ka phaltheng tai, Pakai dingin,
Nang dingin ka kiphal tai ;
Lungsetna le thahat neipen,
Ka chunga phatthei um hen.

Verse 5
Ka phaltheng tai, Pakai dingin,
Kalung lhagaovin lohen ;
Sochatna Thupha kidang hi,
Tonsot tonsot’in thang hen.

songs.title: 359. PAKAIYIN EIKOUNAU OGIN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Isaiah 1:2)

Verse 1
Pakaiyin eikounau ogin kajai,
Tunvang kamu soh tai;
Tunvang ka din thil abukim soh tai,
Na o jeng sang tang’e.

Chorus
Ka tahsan’e eipanpi jing jengin Pakai
Nang’a hing’e;
Ka dingin na thisan lu alonglhai,
Nang’a hi jing tang’e.

Verse 2
Pakaiya kon lungsetna kamu tai,
Kalung ahal jing tai;
Na vang’in lhatdamna chu kachang tai,
Nang jeng tahsan tang’e.

Verse 3
Setna kanei Pakai neihet jeh in,
Idang ka gin ding ham;
Tun vang Pakai kei kahingdoh kit tai,
Hinna nei peh jeh in.

Verse 4
Pakai thil jouse neipe bukim tai,
Nalungsetna len chu;
Kipah tah-in keiman seiphong leng’e,
Na hinna thupha chu.

songs.title: 360. KALUNG KOT THIM’A KONIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d.

Verse 1
Kalung kot thim’a konin O kajai,
Chonsetna konin kahung khangin ;
Kalung kot kiuva chu Jesu ahi,
Vo Pakai tun hungin vang neipen.

Chorus
Na lung kot hongin,
Pakai Jesu lutna ding ;
Pakai Jesu nalunga alut tengle,
Na lungsung salvah ta ding.

Verse 2
Chuin Ami ngailut le lungset chun,
Ka lungsung thim asalvah soh tai ;
Van mithengte laiya kalen ding chu,
Ka kinemin ka kipah jinge.

Verse 3
Satan galte lah a um jeng jong leng,
Ama kalum le kapho ahi ;
Ka lhagao avah-in thahat apei,
Ka taona jouse angai jinge.

Verse 4
Eivah jinginte Avan gam geiyin,
Lungsetna manbeiya eipeh ding ;
Gamnom gotsa um chu kalhun tengle,
Leisetna tohphat man kasan ding.

songs.title: 361. LOUPI CHUNGNUNG IMMANUEL.
songs.lyrics:
Key. B. Flat. sl (Rev. 5:12)

Verse 1
Loupi chungnung Immanuel,
Namtin in avahchoiyui ;
Mitin in Pakai jacheh hen,
O tinin avahchoiyui ;
Chungnung Pakai Leng vahchoinan,
Kelngoinou pachat achang tai ;
Tin lei le vanin jong sam hen,
Lemun, lemun ; (2 vei) Immanuel.
Aw Immanuel, Immanuel, (2vei)
Loupi, jana, thudih le chamna ;
Chihna le thahat Ama changta,
Tun jong nung jongle ;
Aw Immanuel, Immanuel, (2 vei)
Leng jouse Leng le Pakai,
Lemun Immanuel.

Verse 2
Loupi chungnung Immanuel,
Lhatdamten avahchoiyui ;
Agamin kemtih nei ngailou,
Ama tonsot Leng ahi ;
Mitheng sangja lhatdamte chun,
Laltouna loupi kimvel’a ;
Tonsot chullou la asauve,
Lemun, lemun ! (2 vei) Immanuel.

Verse 3
Loupi chungnung Immanuel,
Lhan’a kon thou Leng chungnung ;
Amelmate kijou sohta,
Tonsot’in Amin loupi ;
Chonset, thina, damun beina,
Setnan vaihom kitta lou ding !
Tonsot’in Amin loupi hen,
Lemun, lemun ! (2 vei) Immanuel.

songs.title: 362. KITHANG’IN JESU CHRISTA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat. sl (Rev. 5:12)

Verse 1
Ki-thangin Jesu Christa lungset thu ngei,
Iti kidan ngaidam O ging sang ho chu ;
Keima huhhingnan Lhandampu anathin,
Koi hijeng jongle vang pehsa ahitai.

Chorus
Atahsan din ngaidam pehsa ahitai,
Sanginte Jesun atahsante jouse ;
Eiho huhnan athi lungset Lhandampu,
Halleluiyah eikisimtha jaljeh hin.

Verse 2
Pakai thu eihil chu ka dingin hinna,
Koi hijongle hichu kalum le ka thal ;
Tahsan jal’a nangin hinna namu ding,
Hinna Thupha hi gamtina seiphonglen.

Verse 3
Koi hijongle lhagao thudih a hung chu,
Setna tintang ngaidaminte Pakaiyin ;
Hichu Pathen Cha lungset kidang ahi,
Koi hijongle Lhandampu tahsan jouse.

Verse 4
Ama thu tailou adang tahsan hih-un,
Kana le lhisonan huhhing joulou ding ;
“Lhandampun abei tai” ti in asam’e,
Ama tahsante se bou chu sohcha ding.

songs.title: 363. WHERE THE SHADOWS FLEE AWAY.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. ml (Songs 2:17)

Verse 1
Cheu hite khopi nom lam’a,
Zion khopi gam noma ;
Anomin a emsel jinge,
Atekahpi ding umlou ;

Chorus
Galmi huhhingsa te ho toh,
Khovah em’a kimunte !
Jing khovah a ikikhop teng,
I hinkho bulhin tengle.

Verse 2
Solchahte martyar chang ho le,
Malaiya mitheng hon jong ;
Pakai mi huhhingna thu chu,
Aseiyui kumkhon kemmon ;
Asauve amaho chutoh,
Tonsot kem theilou gama ;
Jing khovah a ikikhop teng,
I hinkho bulhin teng le.

Verse 3
Chua la ngeitah asauve,
I golngai cheng jong aum ;
Ama ho chutoh kikhom ding,
Lal loupi Pakai anga ;
Lhandampu hung ding kipah-un,
I gentheinau beita ding,
Jing khovah a ikikhop teng,
I hinkho bulhin tengle.

songs.title: 364. CHUA TONSOT KHOPI HOI LE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. m. (Rev. 21:25)

Verse 1
Chua tonsot khopi hoile in vah jing jeng.
Chua kipana jeng jan muthim umtalou ;
Laltouna kimvel’a chun van miten la asauve,
O inhoi loupi tah a chu namel hoi kamu ding.
Innom loupitah vah jing aum,
Pakai sem khopi le inhoi nomtah chu.

Verse 2
Pahcha hoi chul ngailou chuche khopi hoiya,
Jesu vahchoinan mithengten la asauve ;
O iti ngeitam kipana Laltouna kimvel’a,
O inhoi loupi tah a chu namel hoi kamu ding.

Verse 3
Kei jong lhungloi tading chunggam khopi nom chu,
Pakaiyin kei eilhatta ken thi ging talou ;
Kamit’in muloi tading Laltouna muna atou.
O chuteng keiman inhoi loupi chungnung kamu ding.

songs.title: 365. JESUN LUNGSETCHAPANGHO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.s. (Luke.18:16)

Verse 1
Jesun lungset chapang ho, A anga din akou ;
Aman hinkho thah apei, Vangam kot ahon peh.
Jesun chapang ho,
Lungset tah-in akou ;
Hinkho thah chu ape jinge,
Chapang golpha Ama.

Verse 2
Jesun lungset chapang ho, Alungset seijou lou ;
Alung gimnau ahenai, Khat chengin apanpi.

Verse 3
Jesun lungset chapang ho, Phattheina vang pejing,
Alungset nan ngah jing, Iman suse lou ding,

Verse 4
Jesun lungset chapang ho, Apanpi niseh-in ;
Kipah thanom tah-in, Na kouna ngai jin.

Verse 5
Jesun lungset chapang ho, Adeiye agol din ;
Aman iti jeng jongle, Tonsot’a um pi jing.

songs.title: 366. THEIGA TIN KIMNA GAM LOUPI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. d. (Heb. 6:19)

Verse 1
Theiga tin kimna gam loupi,
Alhang emsel chul ngailou ;
Chua hinna twi theng along,
Vana nopna akim’e.

Chorus
Khopi hui…ging talou ding,
Tonsot luigal lam’a chun ;
Thihhat seplhan kong tol’an,
Kahoiye luipang noma.

Verse 2
Malam jon’a kongtol kahi,
Lhatdam ten eijap jingui ;
Pa lungset kouna thong kajai,
Mitheng ho lah-a kon chun.

Verse 3
Chua chun kong acholdo tai,
Sana luipang em nom’a ;
Twipi kinong kitol mangta,
Nisavah emsel soh ta.

Verse 4
Chua lhepna kon ihoi diu,
Hinlai huipi abei teng ;
Eihuhhing pau lungsetna thu,
Vahchoina tang talou ding.

songs.title: 367. GAM LOUPIA KON VANTILHO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat (Matt. 2:2)

Verse 1
Gam loupia kon Vantil ho,
Leiset’a hung leng lhauvin ;
Hung sauvin thilsem thusim hi,
Messiah pen phong jal’ un.
Hungun houvun (2 vei)
Leng pengthah Christa houvun.

Verse 2
Kelngoi chinghon jan khanglaiyin,
Akelngoi anga pet’un ;
Pathen leh mihem kicham na,
Naosen chu apeng tai tun.

Verse 3
Thempu hon jong gelda tauvin,
Vah loupi chu avah tai ;
Namtin in Ama ngailut chu ;
Jing valpa in aphongtai.

Verse 4
Mithengten maicham angsunga,
Kinem a anga jingu ;
Pakai tun ahung kumlha tai,
Ahou in sunga hungun.

songs.title: 368. LHATDAM CHANGDIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. Flat.d.

Verse 1
Lhatdam chang din Pathen thu tahsanpa bou,
Hichu loupi chamkimna ;
Van noma leng le jing ding lungset jal’a,
Hichu loupi chamkimna.
Loupi, loupi ! hichu loupi chamkimna,
Loupi, loupi ! hichu loupi chamkimna.

Verse 2
Koiman eichingpoi ka Pakai hang tah-in,
Hichu loupi chamkimna ;
Ama a kon gamla jong leng eive jing,
Hichu loupi chamkimna.

Verse 3
Leiset’a Amintheng jal’a athoh gim,
Hichu loupi chamkimna,
A lungsetna homjal’in Cross kiput’in,
Hichu loupi chamkimna.

songs.title: 369. LANGEITAH KHATKEIMAN KAJAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D flat d. (Rev.15:3)

Verse 1
La ngei tah khat keiman kajai,
Sahkit dingin katha anom ;
A-O ginin dih tah-in sei,
Ken lan sange Pa lungsetna.

Chorus
Ken lan sange la ngeitah chu,
Kicholdona Pakai O gin ;
Ken lan sange la ngeitah chu,
Kicholdona Pakai khopi.

Verse 2
Ka Pakaiya ka kingai ding,
Ka dinga ka lam abin teng ;
Lei mang jongle van in jon ding,
Van gam nom kahung lhun tei ding.

Verse 3
Hung geiyin hungvah jongle chun,
Kihong jing akot niseh a ;
Phat khat leh ijot cheh tei diu,
Kicholdona Pakai khopi.

Verse 4
Chena ding anikho lhin teng,
Lamdih chu koiman helou ding ;
Aman eipui lamdih lama,
Aban thahat’a eikai jing.

songs.title: 370. LUNG GENTHEI HO JESU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E flat. d.

Verse 1
Lung genthei ho Jesu nalunga lutsah-un,
Chu teng ilungdon nau jouse beisoh tante ;
Jesu to ikivop teng Athupeh chan mangleu hen,
Kipah thanom tah in lengkhom tauhite.

Chorus
Jesu ilunga alut teng,
Itihchan hijongle athu mangkit talou ding ;
Jesu ilunga alut teng,
Chamna le lungmonna mijousen heta ding.

Verse 2
Lung genthei ho Jesu nalunga lutsah-un,
Chutengle ilung sungu salvah sohta ding ;
Jesu lamkaina a chun eihon anungjui leu hen,
Lungnem tah-in Amato lengkhom taute.

Verse 3
Lung genthei ho Jesu nalunga lutsah-un,
Chuteng le Amatoh chengkhom jing tau hite ;
Hi leiset idalhah a van gam’a ichen tengle,
Ikipanau tonsot’a kemta lou ding.

songs.title: 371. PATHEN LHAGAO THENGPEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Pathen lhagao theng pen,
Navah theng sosah-in ;
Lunggel muthim salvah soh-in,
Ka mit’u vah sah-in.

Verse 2
Ka lhaset nau lhembin,
Van lhamon sah nei pen ;
Eilhatpau tahsan jing thei din,
Eihuhhing Leng chungnung.

Verse 3
Ka monau ngaidamin,
Nahenga nei puiyun ;
Pathen lungsetna chungnung chu,
Kidang tah sauvinge.

Verse 4
Ka tahsan phutdet’in,
Ka ginmo na beihen ;
Lungsetna thi theilou hel chu,
Mei bangin kou jing hen.

Verse 5
Mihem kho to thempa,
Tonsot chan a Pakai ;
Mihem vaipo Leng chungnung pen,
Ama hetsah-in lang.

Verse 6
Lungthim sutheng theiya,
Lhagao penthah sah thei ;
Hinna thah neipe cheh-un lang,
Lungthim sempha soh-in.

songs.title: 372. PAKAI JESU TOBANGDIN
373. LUNGIN HEJINGIN EDEN’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat.

Verse 1
Lungin hejingin Eden’a,
Ka-Pathen lim lo abeitai ;
Leng lukhuh kachang tai,
Calvary thingpel thahat chun,
Eilamdoh peh, khuh kit thei dia,
Ka thangvah-e chu bou.

Verse 2
Calvarya chuche nikho chun,
Kabul lenpen a kon eilhat ;
Ahinna eitopeh,
Ka chonset man eisahlhah peh ;
Van lekhabua athai mangin,
Eiphul talou hel ding.

Verse 3
Tahsannan ven amun le thing,
Kichen tah a thi Jesu chun,
Kumkhon ajem hoiye,
Satanin eijouve mihem ;
Pathen mihem’a hungsoh chun,
Eijopeh ka thangvah.

songs.title: 374. LUNGDONNASETKINGAIDAMTA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A flat. m. (Prov. 4:23)

Verse 1
Lungdonna set kingaidam ta,
Lungdong kit da tan ;
Imutna kon hung thoudoh-in,
Na lungkot hongin.

Chorus
Hinna thaomei avah lai hin,
Pathen lung alhaipet cha hin ;
Kiheiyin Alungsetna a,
Ki-nemin umin.

Verse 2
Lhandampun nakaihoi jing nai,
Lungdong kit datan ;
Tun lungset’in nangma nakou,
Nalung kot hongin.

Verse 3
Gospel’in nangma nakou jing,
Lungdong kit datan ;
Lhatdamna chamkim mu dingin,
Nalung kot hongin.

Verse 4
Kipanan tantih nei talou.
Lungdong kit datan ;
Cham lenna a din nakou jing,
Nalung kot hongin.

songs.title: 375. SUN OF MY SOUL.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.d. (Luke 24 : 29)

Verse 1
Pakai Nang ka lhagao ninou ,
Nei nai komle jan umji lou ;
Leiya beihen meipi jing hi,
Nang le ding namite a kon.

Verse 2
Ihmut nom jankho daitwi kai,
Ka mit choltah kangcha khanga ;
Ka lunggel khonna pen hihen,
Pakai oma kicholdo jing.

Verse 3
Nei umpin jinga pat jan gei,
Nang louva hing thei kahipoi ;
Nei umpin jankho anai teng,
Nang louvin ka ihmu ngampoi.

Verse 4
Tunin nacha vahvei khattou,
Na thupeh geldan um jongle ;
Achunga lungset na tongin.
Setna imhu din phal hih-in.

Verse 5
Ka jingtho tengu nei naiyun.
Nei umpin phatthei nei boh-un ;
Na lungsetna twikhanglen chun,
Na van gama neipui lhungun.

songs.title: 376. LHAGAO THENGNUNNEM HINSOL’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Lhagao Theng nunnem hinsol’in,
Pakai Jesu minin ;
Ka lunggil’uva cheng jing ding,
Mei bangin kong jing hen.

Verse 2
Pentecost nia ahung lhunin,
Sopite apanpin ;
Amo nau hemsut banga hen,
Mipin lung aheiyui.

Verse 3
Chutobangin na kinbol nan,
Lhagao Theng kathum’ui ;
Eipui eihil eilhamon din,
Van lhun masangse chun.

Verse 4
Thil dangse kipsoh jong leu vang,
Hi jeng bou ngaichat pen ;
Chonset tijat um hilchen din,
Lhagao jeng bou phachom.

songs.title: 377. CROSS KIDANG TAH CHU.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat . (Gal. 6:14)

Verse 1
Cross kidang tah chu kavet leh,
Loupi Leng Chapa thi kamun ;
Ka gou khol jong phatchomna bei,
Hoitho le hamdoh kangai dong.

Verse 2
Pathen Christa thina tailou,
Thil dang imacha song ponge ;
Ngaichat um thil kadei jouse,
A kin bol nan pesoh ing’e.

Verse 3
Akhut, akeng, alu veuvin,
Lungdon le ngailut long gomta ;
Chutobang gomsoh a lingphan,
Leng lukhuh akikhuh umkham.

Verse 4
Thilsem jouse keiya hile,
Pathen peh dia homtho um jing ;
Chutobang ngailutna nasa,
Ka hin kanei pehsoh angai.

songs.title: 378. KACHONSETPOHGIH TAH LE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Rev. 22:17)

Verse 1
Ka chonset pohgih tah le lei gim um,
Van kavet le chu a lut ka nom’e ;
Chu muna chun chonse din mun umlou,
Ahin ‘hungin’ tia eikou O kajai.

Verse 2
Chonse kahi kadin ngam ding hinam ?
Chuche gamtheng loupi thutep gam’a ;
Laltouna bang le loupi anga chu,
Hinla hungin tin khut’in eijap’ui.

Verse 3
Van jotna lampi kajui laitah hin,
Nitinin chonset nan eijui jinge ;
Hijongle lungset O thupha kajai,
“Na lungheiyin nasochat ding” eiti.

Verse 4
Ka jah hi Pakai Jesu O ahi,
Eipom dinga khut jah a chu ahi ;
Ngaidamna chu Ama thisan ahi,
Laltouna anga them eichansah tai.

Verse 5
Chonphatna Pakai ka taona sangin,
Phatna Nanga bou, kipa man keiya ;
Ling lukhuh nakhuh, keidia lallukhuh,
Na thi chu ka dinga hinna ahi.

Verse 6
Lungset Pakai ken imacha neilou,
Ka lung apumpin nanga kape tai ;
Phot chenna hihen nitin ka chonna,
Ngaidam kahi iti kakipa tam.

songs.title: 379. PAKAI NANGKEIMALENGNAHI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat (Rev. 22:17)

Verse 1
Pakai nang keima leng nahi,
Namin loupi jing hen ;
Ling lukhuh kahai louna din,
Calvary’a neipuiyin.

Chorus
Gethsemani hailou nadin,
Na thoh gim ka hailou nadin ;
Nei lungset ka hailouna din,
Calvary’a neipuiyin.

Verse 2
Na lhankhuh chu nei musah-in,
Kap’a na-opnau mun ;
Na lup pet’a vantil thengten,
Na na nga nau mun chu.

Verse 3
Mary bangin lunggim pumin,
Na henga kahunge ;
Lhan gohkeo chu neimu sah-in,
Calvary’a neipuyin.

Verse 4
Pakai nang dinga niseh-a,
Cross put kanom nadem ?
Ka dinga nathoh gimna khon,
Don ding kanom nadem ?

songs.title: 380. PAKAI SUM KANGAI DONGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Pakai sum ka ngai donge,
Sana le dangka toh ;
Van gam thupha ka gel leh,
Asunga lut theinan ;
Vangam hinna bua chu,
Kamona ngaidam a ;
Eihuhhingpun neihil’in,
Ka min kikhum taime ?
Ka min kikhum taime ?
Huhhinga um dinga ;
Van gam hinna lekhabua,
Ka min kikhum taime ?

Verse 2
Pakai kamona tamtah,
Luipeo songnel jat pha ;
Huhhingpu na thisanin,
Bou asoplheng soh thei,
Na thutep chu sut’a um ;
Lekhabu theng sunga,
“Na chonset boh lheh jongle,
Soptheng nange” ati.

Verse 3
O chu khopi nom hoiya,
A in ni sanga vah :
Huhhingsa cheng lhagao chun,
Ponbang lul asil’ui ;
Chonset le boh beisohta,
Vantil nga khopia chun ;
Chu mun nom lo dinga chu,
Kamin kikhum taime ?

songs.title: 381. PATHENIN EINGAILUTNAU ALOUPI TA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Pathenin eingailut nau aloupi ta,
Mi genthei hing hoilou vang eiboh jingui ;
Chonset ngaidam le lungmonna eipeuve,
Chonset jouse nangjou din eipanpi thei.

Verse 2
Twi jousen ka chonset lhau lhengjou theilou,
Gan tamtah thisanin eilhat thei dehlou ;
O thisan, thisan Jesu thisan theng bou,
Chonset jouse phong louva damlheng theina.

Verse 3
Vannoi lhatpa hengah kumkhoa loupina,
Lei le van mijousen jong pecheh-ute ;
Aman eidamsah jeh-in ka kipah-e,
Kumsot’in mijousen vahchoi jingute.

Verse 4
Tua kon kipana Thupha hung lhungta,
Vannoi salvah hunga Ama kimu ta ;
Gamtin’a kon namtin hung kikhom unte,
Van Pakai vahchoinan la hinsau vinte.

songs.title: 382. CHRISTACHONDAN PHA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Matt.13:45, 46)

Verse 1
Christa chondan pha kamu hi,
Kipana la sang ting ;
Ama keiya ahijeh-in,
Kipa la kasah ding.

Chorus
Christa chondan pha kamu hi,
Kipah-in la sang ting ;
Ama keiya ahijeh a,
Kipa la kasah ding.

Verse 3
Pathen jouse Pathen ahi,
Leng jouse leng chungnung ;
Kei din nisa vah bang ahi,
Hinna le damtheina.

Verse 4
Christa kei din hinna ahi,
Kei dia thia thoukit chu ;
Athisan lu eitopeh tai,
Ka deilhen pen ahi.

Verse 5
Christa ka ijakai ahi,
Ka lhamonna pen jong ;
Ama kahinna bulpi pen,
Ka kipana lukhuh.

songs.title: 383. PAKAI JESU KAPUM’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu kapum’a thensoh kagoi,
Kalunga cheng dingin nang bou kalha ngai ;
Milim jouse le gal jouse son mangin,
Nangin nei sil le buh sangin bang jonge

Chorus
.
Buh sangin jong bangjo tei nange,
Nei sille buh sangin bang jonge ;
Nangin neisil le buh sangin bang jonge.

Verse 2
Pakai Jesu ima boh ding phal louvin,
Na thisanin nenbeh jouse sil thengin ;
Sil thengna chu isanga jong ka ngailut,
Nangin nei sil le buh sangin bang jonge.

Verse 3
Pakai Jesu laltouna kon neihin ven,
Tunung le kei kinot thap din neipanpin ;
Nang tailou kei ka kikhoh sah joh louna din,
Nangin nei sille buh sangin bang jonge.

Verse 4
Pakai titahbeh a hiche nang kathum,
Na thohna Cross phunga tun ka ngah-e ;
Na thisana kapum’a neisil theng din,
Nangin neisil le buh sangin bang jonge.

Verse 5
Pakai Jesu sottah Nang kanga nahi,
Ka sunga umin lungthah neisem peh-in ;
Naheng hinjon chan koima nathet umlou,
Nangin neisil le buh sangin bang jonge.

songs.title: 384. KAPAKAI MUTHEI HIH JONGLENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.Flat (John. 10:4)

Verse 1
Ka Pakai mu thei hih jong leng,
Nidan tinin thu eihil nai ;
Adeilam thil kabol pet’in,
Pakai lhaiyin A-O ka hei
.
A-O kahei huhhingpu O,
Ka lunga kipana eipei ;
Itih chan’a thu eihil jing,
Pakai lhaiyin A-O kahei.

Verse 2
A ngailut nahsahmo jong leng,
Imacha ale thei umlou ;
Vannoi chonset apomang tai,
Tahsan le chun na sochat ding.

Verse 3
Dih le kichen tah a hil thei,
Imauva olna gamnom chu ;
Ngailut le lungmon thu eihil,
Chunga innom vahhoi eihil.

songs.title: 385. VO PAKAI HIN SUTHENGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Vo Pakai hin suthengin lang,
Kalung guh a umse hi ;(2 vei)
Ngaichatna le talent jouse,
Nang vahchoina dia nasem ; (2 vei)
Lam ngim laiya, (2 vei)
Manglouvin neipui jingin. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Nangin bou nei kaihoi theiye,
Lamjang laiya mang louvin ; (2 vei)
Jet le veiya thil um danin,
Lunggel apuikon theiye ; (2 vei)
O loupi pen, (2 vei)
Eihuhhingin neipuiyin. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Na umdan’a thil bol jouse,
Nang hin jemhoi pena chu ; (2 vei)
Kalung sunga jong hin tun lang,
Hichun hin ga hoiyinte ; (2)
Pah hoi bangin, (2)
Ka nunchan a kilang hen. (2)

songs.title: 386. PAKAI HINJUH SAH-IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B.

Verse 1
Pakai hin juhsah-in,
Vana kon kangah lel ;
Na vangboh go,
Muchi kim kilha hi ;
Jinga le chonunga,
Mitdoh-in pungun te,
Gam goa kon.

Verse 2
Na lungsetna chungnung,
Kavel’u gim namtui ;
Ahung let hin,
Mel helou gamla mi,
Hung lhung ding ahiuve,
Nalungset gimnamtui ;
Hung panginte.

Verse 3
Nangma melhoi tah chun,
Lei chunga thil jouse ;
Ajo jeng hi,
Namel’a thil dei um ;
Ngaichat tin akime,
Na thohna maha ho,
Ahoi pen’e.

songs.title: 387. IPI JEH AMIPI HO CHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Mark. 10:47)

Verse 1
Ipi jeh a mipi ho chu,
Molmo tah a kikhom hiuvam ?
Ningtin muntin nah kikhomun,
Ipi ngaito ahi diuvem ?
Adonbut’ui kino tah-in !
“Nazareth Jesu chea ahi.”

Verse 2
Hiche Jesu chu koi hiya,
Khopi chu aloling jeng ham ?
Kholjin vahlen tha neiyin tem ?
Mipi tamtah thunun jouna,
Mipi ho chun asam kit’ui,
“ Nazareth Jesu chea ahi”

Verse 3
Hiche Jesu hi anahi,
Leiset chunga anavah len ;
Pohgih tah pon anavah len,
Damlou na-ngong, kengbai damsah ;
Mitchon jong ana kipapi,
“Nazareth Jesu chea ahi”.

Verse 4
Gamtina anavah le len,
Ama khonung chu juiyute;
Na kotphunga ading jinge,
Nangma toh umkhom ding anom,
Kipah a isap lou diu ham ?
“Nazareth Jesu chea ahi.”

Verse 5
Pohgih po jouse hunguvin,
Ngaidam lungmon choldona um;
Pa anga kon vahmangsa ho,
Hung kiheiyin Ama sangin;
Huhhingpa anaipet cha hin,
“Nazareth Jesu chea ahi.”

Verse 6
A kouna na ngaisah lou le,
Alungsetna na-ngaida le !
Aman na dalha loita ding,
Chuteng na taona sang lou ding;
“Agei tai”, tia kho kisam ding,
Nazareth Jesu ache mang ta.

songs.title: 388. PAKAI JESU PHATDAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu phat dan kisei lhing them le,
Ngai nomin Ama bou kipa pin nate ;
Ama gelpet kipah-in alange,
Seijou theilou naho chun einakhang jitai.

Chorus
Kisei them le, kisei them le,
I-tobanga Ama golpha kanei ham ?
Kasei ding chu, kasei ding chu,
Ama na ngailut tei ding tuni geiya.

Verse 2
Ama themdan kisei lhing them bepta le,
Theng tah a chaloh jing kinom teita ding ;
Chuteng Pathen hatna kilang intin,
Paolou hel’in jong chonset phon aum theinai.

Verse 3
Ama ngailut dan kisei lhing themta le,
Ngailut aphat, aloupi, kilangdoh ding ;
Ngailut nung gel’in ilung nem tante,
Mitmo jumpin ban ding kinom cheh inte ong.

Verse 4
Vo Jesu thusim ken seijou theilou ding,
Nangma phatdan, thendan ngailut danho chu ;
Vo Pakai keijah Nang ngei hung kilah-in,
Pao louvin jong toh-in hettohsah ing kate.

songs.title: 389. GAMLA TAH MOLCHUNGA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat

Verse 1
Gamla tah molchunga Cross luikhat adinge,
Hichu gim le jumna melchihna ;
Ken Cross lui chu thildang sangin kadei pen’e,
Chonset kilhadohna chu ahi.

Chorus
Ken kangai nai hiche Cross lui chu,
Ka leiset hinkho kalha kahsen ;
Ken hiche Cross lui chu tuhjing ding,
Nikhat lallukhuh toh kalhet ding.

Verse 2
Hiche leiset miten akidah Cross lui chu,
Kei dingin lungsetna aume ;
Pathen kelngoinou chun Aloupina dalhan,
Calvary a thina athoh-e.

Verse 3
Chuche Cross lui chunga, thisan theng alonglhai,
Ahoi kidang tah chu ken kamui ;
Christa chun Cross chunga athoh gimin athin,
Kei eingaidamin eisop theng tai.

Verse 4
Chuche Cross chu keiman dihtah a jui jing ding,
Gim le jum tona neideh lou ding ;
Nikhat ka inpia Aman eihin kou ding,
Aloupina chang jing jengta ding.

songs.title: 390. NIKHATLAMPI KHATKANAJOTPETIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. Flat. Duet.

Verse 1
Nikhat lampi khat kana jot pet’in,
Michom khat’in jong ahinjot ;
Pohgih tah ahinpoh chu kavet leh,
Kana hetsa Cross chu ahi.

Chorus
‘Na Cross kiput’in neijuiyin,’
Tia Pakaiyin asei kajai ;
Kipeh doh lelna-kanei ding ham ?
Jesun bol peh sohta !

Verse 2
‘Pakai Jesu’ tin amin ka nasam,
Athingkil maha chu kamun ;
Kei dinga athohna jum le jana,
Thehngim din kei ka kipane.

Verse 3
‘Pakai na Cross chu ken put hung kate,’
Tia kasei le Cross khat eipei ;
Hichu kana paimangsa khat a hi,
Kana kichat Cross chu ahi.

Verse 4
Ka Cross ken kiput jing tange tuvang,
Ka lam jot jong chailoi tading ;
Chuteng kamitlhi eitheh ngim peh ding,
Gol le pai kileng khom tading.

songs.title: 391. CALVARY ANGAILUTKILANGCHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Calvary’a ngailut kilang chu,
Khangthah tinin asei diu ;
Tonsot’in jong toh jou lou ding,
Vahchoina lhing bep ding chun.

Verse 2
Van lapi lah a hiche hi,
Loupi pen hilou theilou ;
Selangdah kin lenpen jong chu,
Ngailut vahchoi bou hijing.

Verse 3
Kelngoi nou thisan thahat dan,
Lhagao lhatdoh anatje ;
Serap O nem jo val’in jong,
Achungnung jo jin ahi.

Verse 4
Khangthah neljat man nung jong le,
Vahchoi la kipan bang bou ;
Vetnom kidang thisan lua kon,
Kilang jing ding agildan.

Verse 5
Kelngoi nou kipehna lutje,
Sei jou hilou tonsot’a ;
Gel phahlou phat kichai nunga,
Athah hijing khon nei lou.

Verse 6
O ngei simjou lou nei jong leng,
Vahchoi lhing din kagel poi ;
Ka O neisun hi ngei lhum le,
Kati cheh-e vahchoi nan.

songs.title: 392. JESU JESU NANGMA BOUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Lah is G.

Verse 1
Jesu Jesu nangma bouvin,
Mi chonse nadamsah thei ;
Nangin nei lungset jeh-uva,
Na thisana nei lhat’u.
Nei he jingun, (2 vei)
Vo Jesu, Eihuhhingpau.

Verse 2
Mihem chonset simjou thei lou,
Luipeo nel sanga tamjo ;
Eilainat pen’u Nangin bou,
Ka hesoh thoh diu nathoh.

Verse 3
Vo Jesu Nathu jom dingin,
Lungset’in nei kithopin ;
Keiho ka hatlou jeh-uvin,
Nangman neikaihoi jingun.

songs.title: 393. VO PAKAI NEI LEM’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. Lah is E.

Verse 1
Vo Pakai nei lem’in,
Neihin salvah-in lang ;
Ka chonsetna nei ngaidamin,
Ka manthai kah sungin ; (2 vei)
Thina gomthim kicha ponge,
Thina hung nai jongle ;
Gomtong thim jing nei galkaipin,
Lungdon tijat umna pen jong,
Nangman najou soh tai.

Verse 2
Thina a kon kahung,
Na lungset kul sungah ;
Nangjui jeh a eidou jouse,
Thipsoh ding ahitai ; (2 vei)
Na haona thil ho jouse chu,
Tu hin katep pan tai,
Phat le nikho hung lhung loi ding,
Ka lhagao thangvan sanga chun,
Tonsot’a choldo ding.

Verse 3
Leiset hesoh ahin,
Lungdonna le lungjin ;
Thina le lha lengvai naa,
Genthei thoh jeng jong leng ; (2 vei)
Na lungset goubom hon phat le,
Kei dia loupina chu,
Tonsot’a akhan ding jeh chun ;
Ka ima aloupoiyje tun,
Loupi nan eisal nai.

songs.title: 394. CHRISTA THISAN LUTAH LONGCHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. (I Peter 1:19)

Verse 1
Christa thisan lutah long chu,
Kei dinga lu ahi ;
Kichat le tahsan lel’a kon,
Ka lhagao choldo ta.

Chorus
O thisan lui kidang tah long,
Lhandampu a kon chun ;
Van lhun geiya kala ding chu,
“O thisan, thisan lu.”

Verse 2
Keiman geldoh kitta ponge,
Tin Pathenin ati ;
Ka chapa thisan sop thengte,
Chonset le them mona.

Verse 3
Ka chonset ka milmo ho chun,
Eilung kham sah ponte ;
Thisan long chu mijouse ding.
Ka chonset sop thengta.

Verse 4
Ka tahsa phe hatlou tah hin,
Natna toh jeng jong le ;
Thisan lua chun kei kingai leng,
Monga ka choldo ding.
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

songs.title: 395. MOLLE LHANGHOITAH KHEL’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Song 2:17)

Verse 1
Molle lhang hoitah khel’a, meibol ahung kihodoh-a,
Twilong ho le vacha ho nisan ahin kho teng chule ;
Vana lhagui hungsoh chun, Pa thutepna asu langji,
Meibol chu akiho teng eiho kihechen to tading.
Eiho kihechen tading, tua ikihetto banga,
Chuche kipana jing nikho vahhoi chu aso tengle ;
Meibol chu akiho teng, eiho kihechen to tading.

Verse 2
Lunggim le lungkhamin ihinkho lampiu jot jeng jongle,
I loumau gamla henlang muthima na tong jongleu hen ;
Lhandampun mi nunnomte hungun tia eikou-tengu le,
Chuche jingkah meibol kiho teng, eiho kikhom tading.

Verse 3
Laltouna kimvel’a eiho kipah a kikhom tei ding,
I ngai chengto kimuto a eiho kihechen tading ;
Tantih neilouva eihon lhatdamna la isah diu,
Meibol chu akiho-a muthim chu akitol mang teng.

songs.title: 396. HUNGUN JESU VAHCHOIYUTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Hungun Jesu vahchoiyute,
Eihuhhingpau Leng chungnung pen chu ;
Eingailut nau chul lou tonsot’a,
Tang louvin vahchoi jingute.

Chorus
Minlu pen, Huhhingpu,
Aloupina vahchoijute ;
Minlu pen, Huhhingpu, Huhhingpu,
Pakai chu vahchoi cheh-ute.

Verse 2
Angailutna natsat jeh chun,
Ingaichat kim Aman eipente ;
Lungdonna le lha lengvai na a,
Huhhingpu chun eiumpi ding.

Verse 3
Lhagaova eihalsah dingin,
Pathenin phatthei eiboh inte,
Koi hi le Amintheng pan’a chu,
Huhhingpu chun eihuh nante.

Verse 4
Hungun minlu vahchoiyute,
Eihuhhingpau Leng chungnung pen chu,
Aloupina le athenje chu,
Ichonset lunguva cheng hen.

songs.title: 397. TWI NAH KHAT UM.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Twi nah khat um thisan along,
Calvary’a kon doh chu ;
Thisan luipi chonse penin,
Thenna anei na chu.
O Calvary lui hoitah, (3 vei)
Kei dinga nahung lon.

Verse 2
Chonse khetbeh thi ding kon chun,
Thenna lui chu amun ;
Ama bangin chonse jong leng,
Buhbang eisosah thei.

Verse 3
Pakai ngaitah nathisan lu,
Tamtah-in hepha lou ;
Huhhing ho chun hi chu amun,
Pohgih a kon ong ta.

Verse 4
Tahsanna in lui chu kamui,
Ka gam geiya hung long ;
Ka thupi pen eingailutna,
Ka thi ni geiya ding.

songs.title: 398. LAN KA HINKHO HI PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Lan ka hinkho hi Pakai,
Nangma din kape theng tai ;
Na lungset guiya konin,
Ka khut lan lang chasah in.

Verse 2
Lan lang chasah in ka keng,
Nang dia hoi le jangkhai din ;
Lan ka-o hi la sange,
Ka lengpa Nang ding jeng in.

Verse 3
Lan ka kamsung dimsah in,
Na thu seiphongle na din ;
Lan Ka sana dangka ho,
It ponge themcha jeng jong.

Verse 4
Lan ka ngailutna Pakai,
Ka sunglhaina kengbul’a ;
Lan ka phaltheng tai Pakai,
Nangma a hijing tange.

songs.title: 399. LUIPI PALGALKAI DAN NEI HIL’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Luipi pal galkai dan neihil’in,
Twilen’in eichup lou nan;
Twi soh-in eilhoh manglou nan,
Lhepnan eihin phah tengle;

Chorus
Luigal lhang sang hoi nomtah mai,
Kichoi sang chu nei vetpin;
Twi palpet eilamkai Jesu,
Koldet din nei kithopin.

Verse 2
Gamnoi ling le khao nang bingtah,
Twisoh thuh le hattah ho;
Itih chan eilung gim sah dia,
Phat chu teppeh nahiu ham?
Thim kihoh hen lungdonna jong,
Chonset jouse thipsoh ding;
I-lo diu gamnom sun ahi,
Pathen gam ahibouve.

songs.title: 400. TWIKHANGLEN PANGAKONIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat

Verse 1
Twikhanglen panga konin nang nakitol gamla tai,
Nang nakitol, nakitol, nakitol in ;
Twikhanglen le twipi kinongin natol gamla tai,
Ol ol’in nakitol, nakitol mange.
Nakitol, nakitol mange. Nang nakitol, tol’in
Nakitol, tol’in nakitol mange ;
Twikhanglen muthim lama,
Pa lungsetna a konin,
Manthah na mun lam jonin.

Verse 2
Huhhinga thaomei avah-e nangdin avel vellin,
Nang nakitol, nakitol, nakitol’in,
Kong kaimun khelpeh a nakong kitol mangloi tading,
Ol ol’in nakitol, nakitol mange.

Verse 3
In lam jon dia nakikouna O najapha tapoi,
Nang nakitol, nakitol, nakitol’in ;
Vo sopi, kouna O hi phat aumpet hin ngaiphan,
Tonsot’a dia nakitol mangpai kah-in.

songs.title: 401. HESOHNA LE LUNGGIMNA KHEL
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Hesohna le lunggimna khel,
Vo ka lhagao ve jingin ;
Pathen thutep chu guilhung ding,
Lungsetna niloupi chu,
Van Jubilee, (2 vei)
Ni loupi asoh pantai.

Verse 2
India mi le Negro mite,
Chitin namtin pao tinin ;
Calvary ngailutna chungnung,
Tunin chang theita veleu ;
Gospel hatna, (2 vei)
Sah le lhang kolmong thong hen.

Verse 3
Lengin, lengin O Nang Gospel,
Tang louvin jou peh-in lang ;
Sah le lhang sim le mal geiyin,
Na vaihomna chesoh hen,
Vannoi leiset, (2 vei)
Pakai gam ahi kahsen.

Verse 4
Mihing jouse ganhing jousen,
Pathen thilsem jouse hon ;
Pa, Chapa, Lhagao Theng pumkhat,
Ngailut Pathen thangvah hen ;
Leiset chungah, (2 vei)
Chamna le lungmon leng hen.

songs.title: 402. GOSPEL MALAM’A KITHONG JING
403. JUI JING’U HITE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Jui jingu hite Pakaiyin eipui nai,
Meipi le twipin jong eikhang joulou ding ;
Vaihompan laltouna atoupi jing,
Loupina le Leng lukhuh isan dingu.
Igalteu chu douvute, (3 vei)
Thon moa eiho jo ding.

Verse 2
Cross kiput’in lunggim thoh-in icheuvin,
Hicheng chu Jesun eithoh joupeh tauve ;
Ngailut le khotonaa athoh ahi,
Ihesoh nau atepsa ahi.

Verse 3
Ikimvel’u lungjin nan eidou jongleu,
Kicha louvin dettah-in dingu hite ;
Ilungu itobangin jong bol gim hen,
Pakaiyin hicheng chu eijopeh soh tai.

Verse 4
Tun vang Cross jangtah-in kiput’u hite,
Hesoh abeitai tanglouvin la sauvin ;
I-lha mong lheh-un, Inun’u anome,
Jesu Calvary lhang geiyin juiyute.

songs.title: 404. KALHAGAOVIN CHRISTAJENG’A
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Rom. 5:11)

Verse 1
Ka lhagaovin Christa jenga,
Lhamonna ahol chu ;
Vangbohna tamtah simjou lou,
Tun vang akimu tai.

Chorus
Christa tailou chu koima dang,
Ei kipasah um lou ;
Ngailutna le kipa jingna,
Ama jenga ka mu.

Verse 2
Ahenga olna hol louva,
Leiset gouhom keova ;
Ka hol pet’in Eihuhhingpan,
Ngailut’in eisang tai.

Verse 3
Vo Pakai leiset’a twikhuh,
Thal ding tin ka del’in ;
Hinla atwi kadon thei lou,
Thina gutwi ahi.

Verse 4
Ka nopna mangsa lhangaiyin,
Nangla kaholji pon ;
Na ngailutna thu thengtah chu,
Nei hetsah masang sen.

songs.title: 405. KAMU TAI GOLPHAJESU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Song of Solomon 2:1)

Verse 1
Ka mutai golpha Jesu, ei-hepi bukim ding,
A sangjan ka lhagao din ahoi pene ;
Phaichama Lily pah hoi, Ama bou chu ahi,
Ken kabel teng, Aman eisem bukim ding ;

Chorus
Lungdon lungjin kato teng, kingaina ka monna,
Aman eihil jinge kachon chan ding ;
Ama Phaicham Lily pah le Jing Valpa ahiye,
A sangjan ka lhagao din ahoi pene.

Verse 2
Aman lunggimna jouse apomang sohkei tai,
Lhep lungdon kato teng Aman tha eipei ;
Ka nusen kapeldoh tai nunlui setna jouse,
Vannoi leiset boina le lhepna gal hat jongle,
Keiman Jesu min’a kajo tei ding ;
Ama phaicham Lily pahle Jing Valpa ahiye,
A sangjan ka lhagao din ahoi pene.

Verse 3
Aman itih hijongle eidalha talou ding,
Ken Ama tahsana athupeh jui ding ;
Meikul lim sunga uma olmo talou dingin,
Manna hinna an na gilkel va tading ;
Chu hinna twi dung long jing jeng tading ;
Ama Phaicham Lily pahle le Jing Valpa ahiye,
A sangjan ka lhagao din ahoi pene.

songs.title: 406. KAPAKAI OIMON ASEM’UN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Ka Pakai oimon asem’un,
Ka chonset khel’in athi tai ;
A ban bolding agotpeh-un,
A Cross kiput’in ache tai.
Tu hin Jesun eithum jingui,
“Ka dang achah-e” ati’in. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Ling lukhuh le sangkhol san pen,
Agalten alomdoh tauve ;
Amin Golgotha muna chun,
Chonset angauve achungah.

Verse 3
Calvarya chun hesoh apon,
Apanpi ding koima umlou ;
“Hepa idia nei dalhah ham ?”
Tin asam’e Cross chunga chun.

Verse 4
Samari min twi ape poi,
Ama twinah sem’a ahin ;
Thingpel’a aumpet’in jong,
Ape-nom poi van nimin jong.

songs.title: 407. JESU MIN HILLANG’UTE.
408. JESU THAHATNAA KINGAIYIN III Alex. 19.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Jesu thahatnaa kingaiyin,
Kithopin nate khoto tah-in ;
A ngailut thonlou nakinep le,
Phatthei boh-in nate.

Chorus
Athahat angailut kinemin,
Athahat angailutna kilang ;
Athahat le van in khu ven lang,
Pakai chu tahsan jingin.

Verse 2
Jesu thahatnaa kingaiyin,
Nalam muthim jing salvah-inte ;
Napuina chan a kipah-in chen,
Asei chan jui jingin.

Verse 3
Jesu thahatnaa kingaiyin,
Nalung khamna se Ama not in ;
Na chonset poh chu gih lheh jongle,
Ahenga tao jingin.

Verse 4
Jesu thahatnaa kingaiyin,
Na ima jouse chu Ama pen ;
Ngailut le khoto naa dim chun,
Phatthei boh nan nate.

songs.title: 409. HUHHINGPA THISAN ALONGLHAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat.

Verse 1
Huhhingpu thisan along lhai,
Kabat sahlhahna din ;
Tonsot hinkemlou kanei nan,
Cross chunga atantai.

Chorus
Kelngoinou nunnem penin,
Athoh-in Calvarya ;
Kelngoinou thasa thoudoh kitna chu,
Eihuhhingpu ahi.

Verse 2
Chonset gitlou kabol jeh-in,
Cross chunga apengin ;
Hepi na le ngailutna in,
Eipei tonsot hinna.

Verse 3
Nisan jong amai sel mangin,
Avah songam louvin ;
Huhhingpun kamona se pon,
Cross chunga athoh chun.

Verse 4
Kei jong kun ing ting lhai jinge,
Pakai Cross bul a chun ;
Athoh nasatje gel’ing ting,
Amel kamu phat teng.

Verse 5
Ka lungdon mitlhi long jongle,
Keidin athoh najoi ;
Kapumin kat’in lut ninge,
Hichu kathem khon pen.

songs.title: 410. PATHEN KELNGOINOU THENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat. (John 1:29)

Verse 1
Pathen kelngoinou theng,
Nang panhu din ka-ngeh ;
Na thisan lu theng chun,
Keima eisop theng ding ;

Chorus
Ka pohgih nei poh hun,
Ka chonset sop thengin ;
Nei hil’in nachon phat,
Keima neisop thengin.

Verse 2
Kaki nepna dang bei,
Thildang ima ngeh lou ;
Kei dinga na-thi le,
Kei dia napen na bou :
Na ngaidam O kajai,
Nanga kahi kahei ;
Kichat ding nei talou,
Christa keiya hita.

Verse 3
Na koma umjing ding,
Ka lhagao anom’e ;
Ka lam neihil jingin,
Ka hinkho lhung keiyin ;
Ngaichat dang ka neipoi,
Min dang ka ngeh chompoi ;
Chonset ngaidam Nangma,
Nangma bou ka ngeh-e.

songs.title: 411. EVERYDAY AND EVERYHOURS.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A flat. (slowly) (Psalms 17:1, 39:24)

Verse 1
Huhhingpu tonsot hinna,
Na koma um jing bou ka nome ;
Na thisanin neisop’in,
Kumsot’in nei umpi jingin lang.

Chorus
Niseh in ……Niseh in,
Na thahat nan neihun lang,
Na mikhoto themna in,
Vo Pakai neihin umpi jingin.

Verse 2
Hi leiset lhachom tah a,
Ka len laisen nei puihoi jingin ;
Nang songin mangthah ponge,
Ka lampi jong mansah thei ponge.

Verse 3
Nang lhangai din neijol’in,
Ka hinkho jinga mang theiya hi ;
Ka lei hinkho mang jongle,
Van khopi vah nom’a ka umding.

songs.title: 412. CROSS THISAN’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Cross thisanin mihatlou jong,
Mihangpen asosah thei ;
Cross thisanin mihangtah jong,
Tamtah a lungdoi sah thei,
Calvary lhang ;(3 vei)
Thusim nei hettoh sah-in, (2 vei)

Verse 2
Na thahatna ka tahsane,
Na thilbol akidange ;
Na keng khophang noiya satan,
Thina lhankhuh nakoi tai,
Calvary lhang ;(3 vei)
Lungin sumil loujenin. (2 vei)

songs.title: 413. HUHHINGPU NGAILUTNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (John. 3:16)

Verse 1
Huhhingpu ngailutna ka hen,
Ngailutna kidang tah chu ahi ;
Van a konin ahung kumlhan,
Ei ngailut le eikhoto hintem. (2 vei)
Henge, heng, keidin keidin,
Henge, heng, keidin ;
Pakai ahung kumlhan,
Ngailut khenlouvin ;
Cross chunga athi,
Ei huhhing nan.

Verse 2
Athohna le athi soje,
Alem le thinga athi ka hen ;
Hijong le ningkom khat beh a,
Eithoh peh le alel kasei nam ? (2 vei)

Verse 3
Van chondan thusim kahe tai,
Jesu miten amudiu ahi ;
Hijong le van a mun kei dia,
Sem le phasa dem’a got hinam ! (2 vei)

Verse 4
Pakai kadoh nei donbut’in,
Naheng louva koikom jon tangem ?
Lhagao Thengin nei seipeh-in,
Kei dia van le Huhhingpa um chu. (2 vei)

songs.title: 414. THISAN LU, THISAN LU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.

Verse 1
Thisan lu, thisan lu,
Thing Cross chunga long chun ;
Chonsetna kon eilhat,
Mi chonse eingaidam ;
Chonset nenpen athenna chu,
Calvary thisan lu ahi. (2 vei)

Verse 2
O thisan, thisan lu,
Van kot eihon peh e ;
Van gam ilhun tengle,
I-la’u chullou ding chu,
“Thisan, thisan lu, thisan lu”
Tia tang louva la isah diu. (2 vei)

Verse 3
O lhang hoi Calvary,
Miten musit jongleu ;
Lhang dang jouse sangin,
Ken kangailu pene ;
O nopna lhang,
Vo mun theng pen,
Pathen thisan alonna chu. (2 vei)

songs.title: 415. JESU NUNNEM HINSEI KIT’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat. L.H.B. 48

Verse 1
Jesu nun nem hin sei kit’in,
Nasei banga ngei umlou ;
Nathu lhamonnan adimin,
Hil’in, nei tilkhou theiyui ;

Chorus
Leiset O gin ngei jouse le,
Tahsa leiset ngaina jong,
Nakam dam ngai umtah jah-in,
Thip’in akiphong jou poi.

Verse 2
Jesu loupi tah in lengin,
Nalalje hung kiphong hen ;
Leiyin Nang dehjou lou ding,
Gehenin panpi jong le ;
Na min ngei ja um chungnung pen,
Gal jouse kigel mang soh ;
Tijatnan lei ahin lotai,
Nang nahung naitah jeh chun.

songs.title: 416. GREENLAND BUHBANGGAM’APAT
417. PAKAI AHUNG TENG LOUPIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (I Thes. 4:16.)

Verse 1
Pakai ahung teng loupia,
Chung lama vanlai jol’a ;
Vantil’in seijuiho henga aseisa,
Idia vanlam navet’u ham ;
Jesu mama hungkit ding,
Namu banguva hungkit ding ahi.
Jesu hungkit ding Halleluijah,
Ama hungkit tei ding ;
Meilom lah-a ikimuto kit cheh diu chuni le,
Aloupina imudiu kikhoppi ni phat tengle ;
Halleluijah Christa hungkit ding ahi.

Verse 2
Ahi Pakai chu loupia,
Sumkon gintoh hungkum ding ;
Christa a thiho thou diu kimuto diu,
Chuteng leiset chunga huhhing,
Chang ho jouse kaltou diu ;
Meilom’a kimuto khom cheh dingu.

Verse 3
Sopite ho hiche thupha,
Hin kinepna eipeu hen ;
Pakai din phat um jouse mangchau hitin,
Ahung geisang lheh-e tia ;
Lung lhahsamna neilouvin,
Kilhamon to cheh ute hiti hin.

songs.title: 418. VEN HINNA TWI THENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat (Zech. 13:1)

Verse 1
Ven hinna twi theng thisan lu,
Tun jong along jinge ;
Hichun thisan le twi-along,
Buh banga thenna chu. (2 vei)
Buh banga thennaa chun kisil’in,
Koi hile akisil nom chan ;
Chonset alhau lheng thei.

Verse 2
Heng-ibonun che cheh-ute,
Chu thisan luiya chun ;
Thisan theng bou tahsan’ute,
Buh banga thenna chu. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Pakai chu ahung phat tengle,
Amite chu pui ding ;
Thisan lui tahsan ho bou chu,
Van gam chu changunte. (2 vei).

songs.title: 419. MIJOUSE HUNG LOIYUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat.

Verse 1
Mi jouse hung loiyun,
A ngailutna honga ;
Tu hin hung cheh-un lang,
Chemang kit lou hel din ;
Ageisang tai kinouvin lang, (2 vei)
Lungsetna kot ahon pet’in.

Verse 2
Jesun nakou pet’un,
Kilepna hol hih-un ;
Mitcho, genthei, lengvai,
Mi jouse hunguvin ;
Tua ijakai phasadem cheh, (2 vei)
Mun phapen jong nachan thei diu.

Verse 3
Jesu Cross thisan lu,
Manbeiya long hilou ;
Athohna jouse chu,
Khatcha jong amang poi ;
Agam chalna thil loupi pen, (2 vei)
Ngailut nan ajou molso tai.

Verse 4
Mi jousen lhai cheh un,
Pathen kelngoi nou chu ;
Amin vahchoiyu hen,
Aloupi pen jeh chun ;
Lei le van mi thu khat kisan, (2 vei)
Tonsot’in thangvah jingute.

songs.title: 420. CLEVELAND.
421. LUNGDON HESOHNAKATO TENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Ezek.16:60)

Verse 1
Lungdon hesohna kato teng,
Gim umtah aumpet jong le ;
Ka gel le ka kipah jo ji,
Pakai neilung khoh ji.

Chorus
Nangin neilung khoh ji,
Nangin neilung khoh ji ;
Na koma iham kagin ding,
Nangin neilung khoh ji.

Verse 2
Hinlai khankho lung khamna in,
Ka lhagao puimang jeng jongle;
Lung donga ka umphat tengle,
Pakai neilung khoh ji.

Verse 3
Gim hesoh genthei umhen lang,
Lungdon lengvai um jeng jongle ;
Kipa jing ding hi thu hihen,
Pakai neilung khohji.

songs.title: 422. DARCAS. (PAKAI JAN ANJON LA.)
423. GOLPHAJESU LHACHAPANGDIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E.

Verse 1
Golpha Jesu lhacha pang ding,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
Christa thokit thu lhangsam ding,
Koi um nam ? (2 vei)

Chorus
Alungsetna phongjal le ding,
Olna mun nom Jesu ahi ;
Milen, mineo, namtin jousea,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)

Verse 2
Angailutna thu lhangsam ding,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
Michonse pen angaidam thei,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
Aja ngaina twikhanglen bang,
Mivom, mikang, mitin jah a,
Kolkim ve’la lhangsam le ding,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

Verse 3
Jesu deh dinga pasal hat,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
Agaldou bang dou hu dinga,
Koi um mam ?(2 vei)
Pathen deilam ahi poule,
Gamthim, gamgo, munthip ho a ;
Amin loupi phong le thei ding,
Kei ka um. (2 vei)

songs.title: 424. KALHAGAO NISA BANGIN AVAH
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A flat. (2 Sam. 23:4)

Verse 1
Ka lhagao nisa bangin a vah,
Vah dang sanga vahjon ;
Vanchung nisa sangin avah,
Ka vah Jesu ahi.

Chorus
Ken kamu tai vah nunnom chu,
Cham le kipana ahung lhungtai ;
Jesu mailhai chu kamu tai,
Ka lhagao vah achang tai.

Verse 2
Ka lhagaovin vahchoi la asai,
Keidia Pa vahchoi la ;
Jesun ka vahchoi la ajai,
Kamin sa-hih jong leng.

Verse 3
Ka lhagaovin kipana anei,
Pakaiyin einai teng ;
Chamna la kalungin asai,
Kalung, chamnan aloi.

Verse 4
Ka lhagao kipanan adim’e.
Kinep thangvah toh thon ;
Phattheina aman eipe-e,
Van kipa ka nei tai.

songs.title: 425. O MI SANG TAMTAH LASAH DING
songs.lyrics:
. Doh is G. (Ps. 9:10)

Verse 1
O mi sang tamtah la sah ding,
Huhhingpa thangvah a ; (2 vei)
Pathen loupi pen Eilhatpau,
Ngailutna thangvah din. (3 vei)

Verse 2
Vo Leng chungnung eipui hoipau,
Thahatna eipeuvin ; (2 vei)
Hiche leiset chung jousea hi,
Na thu pongjal dingin. (3 vei)

Verse 3
Jesu namin ngei theng tah hi,
Ka hinnau le nopna ; (2 vei)
Michonse hon jong ahetnan,
Eilha mon sah pen chu. (3 vei)

Verse 4
Chonset jouse jousohpa chun,
Sohchang ahuhdoh-in ; (2 vei)
A thisan lutah atoh-in,
Eiho eihuhhing nan. (3 vei)

songs.title: 426. PAKAI KEN HOILANGKAJOTDINGHAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Pakai ken hoilang kajot ding ham ?
Chihna eipe ding Nangma nahi ;
Na deilam chan Pakai neipuiyin,
Na thutep lungsetna kaging chai.

Chorus
I ting’em Pakai iti tang’em ?
Ken Nangma iti jen-ning’em ?
Nei hil’in kei Pakai nei hil’in,
Nei patep’in O Pakai.

Verse 2
Pakai ken ipi kasei ding ham ?
Nangma bou lam eihil thei nahi ;
Na thutheng bou kasei thei nadin,
Pakai Nangin neipanpi jingin.

Verse 3
Pakai ken ipi kasei ding ham ?
Na mi hoithemna bou kangai chai ;
Na lhagao theng panpi kangai chai,
Lhepna jong keiman pal lhajou ding.

Verse 4
Pakai kei nachohsa kahitai,
Lunggel thohhat keiya hitalou ;
Nangman nei lhatdohsa ka hitai,
Nang dingin vahjing inge Pakai.

songs.title: 427. EILHATPACHU HOIYA UM HAM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (2 sam. 18:33)

Verse 1
Eilhatpa chu hoiya um ham,
Ti in kahin hol peh-e ;
Kei ding thil loupi eigot peh tai,
Tonsot van kipana ding.

Chorus
O ka ngaiye Eilhatpa,
O ka ngai Eihuhhingpa ;
Kei din thingpel chunga nahung thitai,
Gonggoh le dangchah geovin.

Verse 2
O nalungset gil le jaoje,
Koiman mukhon theilou chu ;
Van mithengte ho jouse jong chun,
Agilje gelpha jou lou.

Verse 3
Leiya nalen lai mel bang chun,
Tunla kamu thei tapon ;
Hijongle ngailutna thuhil chu,
Kalung gil’a acham’e.

Verse 4
Vo ka lhagao che peh-in lang,
Na lhatpa heng lama chun ;
Akhut jet lam’a chun gatouvin,
Na tonsot kipana din.

songs.title: 428. TAHSANIN GAMNOM UM KAHEI.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat.

Verse 1
Tahsanin gam nom aum kahei,
Aloupije sei thei lou hel chu ;
Tonsot’a ni sanga vah a chun,
Jesu toh chua um ka nome.

Chorus
Chua um, Chua um,
Jesu toh chua um ka nome ;
Chua um, chua um,
Jesu toh chua um ka nome.

Verse 2
Pathen lekhabu kasim’a kon,
Vangboh pehna mua kakisan le ;
Gilkel dangchah hesoh beita ding,
Lhasamte chu gama choldo ding.

Verse 3
Koiham van gam nopje seithei ding,
Lungjin lungdon lengvai bei tante ;
Thi le puldou ka le natna jong,
Thi kitna jong um talou hel ding.

Verse 4
Chuche gam noma chu cheng dingin,
Pathenin michonsete akou ;
Koi hijeng jongle anom chan chu,
Chuche gam noma chun chengunte.

songs.title: 429. VADUNGCHIMTAH LONGJINGNA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat. (Matt. 8:19)

Verse 1
Vadung chimtah lon jingna phaichama chun,
Lhandampu Jesun eipui nai kei che ding ;
A ban jal’in twikhanglen a hijong le,
Chenge kipah-in amangsa holdoh din.

Chorus
Lhandampun eipui nai,
Jui jinge kipah-in ;
Mi lungset Pakai puinaa,
Kipah a jui ding.

Verse 2
Pohgih pum hihen genthei pet hijongle,
Kelngoi gam mangsa te ho chu holdoh din ;
Hesohna hihen kipana hijongle,
Pakai toh kilhon khom tange chung gama.

Verse 3
Lhandampun eipui hoichan gam hijongle,
Kipa leh gentheina a thoh hat jing ding ;
Aman lungmonna lam dih chu ahenai,
Nisa banga vah in nom hoitah gam chu.

songs.title: 430. LHANGTHIM VUM LAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Lhang thim vum lam ken kavet ding,
Olle kho hungvah lha ding ;
Muthim jouse sonmang soh a,
Ni hungsoh ding vah hoitah,
Jesu Christa vannoi salvah,
Lunggel muthim salvah ding ;
Hi leiset’a namtin jousen,
Hinna Thupha hetante.
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

Verse 2
Sim le mal sah le lhang gamtin,
Kho tin’a Na min kikou ;
Themgao lhem thempu le doithem,
Koiman lhangai talou ding ;
Jesu eidamsah pau nahi,
Vannoi chonset po manga,
Thingpel chunga nakhai sangun ;
Longa neilhat’u ahi.

Verse 3
Leng jouse chu Jesua bou,
Gam jouse jong Ama a ;
Namtinin Ama alhai jing,
Pathen gam machal jing ding ;
Nagam theng nom laiya leng din,
Chitin namtin paotin mi ;
Pa, Chapa, Lhagao Theng pumkhat,
Vahchoi din koukhom soh in.

Verse 4
Jesu, chonset gal jousoh-in,
Gam jouse losoh in lang ;
Hinna kipana Thupha hi,
Mi tin lunga ga hoi hen ;
Go ju le hui lhoh lom banga,
Nivah le dai chim bangin ;
Na lhagaovin nei von’un lang,
Kumsot’in nei ngah phauvin.

songs.title: 431. LUNGSETNA THON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B Flat. (Mark 16:15)

Verse 1
Lungsetna thon amangsa holdoh-in,
Gamla tah molchung lam agei tai ;
Pakaiyin eiho eikouvui tunin.
“Ka henga hungun” tin asam jing.

Chorus
Mol chung lam agei tai kou loiyun,
Hung kile kit’in tin kouvun man gangun ;
Lhandampu kulsunga lut loiyun,
Kelngoinou Jesu set jeh-in akithat tai.

Verse 2
Amangsa Jesu henga hinpuiyun,
Lhagaova genthei lung lengvaite ;
Sochatna lampia hin puilut’un,
Mangsate hinna lampi hil’un.

Verse 3
Lungsetna tang louvin seiphong leute,
Niseh-in Christa nungjui jute ;
Kipah thanomin Jesun eipui nai,
Hinna lampi Jesu thu hil’un.

songs.title: 432. LAM LHUNGKEIYIN PAKAIYIN EIPUIYE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. Flat (Psalms. 34:3)

Verse 1
Lam lhung keiyin Pakaiyin eipuije,
Amin vahchoiyun ;
Van Mana chun eivah-e,
Amin theng chu vahchoiyun
.
Halleluijah hiche ka la,
A-itih a Jesu Jesu ;
Sauvin avahchoina la chu,
Amin vahchoiyun.

Verse 2
Ka lhahsam teng Aman eipanpiji,
Amin vahchoiyun ;
Ka kichat teng eidal’e ;
Amin theng chu vahchoiyun.

Verse 3
Hinkho man themna eipen eipui jing,
Amin vahchoiyun ;
Aman kei eidalha poi,
Amin theng chu vahchoiyun.

songs.title: 433. VEN! MEI BANG TOH AHUNGKUMLHAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B Flat. (Rev. 1:7)

Verse 1
Ven ! mei bang toh ahung kumlhai,
Chonse lhatna athasau ;
Mitheng sang som sang jan ajui,
Loupi leh hu len tah-in.
Halleluijah, (3 vei)
Jesu hung ding vaihom a,

Verse 2
Veuvin mit jousen amu ding,
Loupi tah a akivon ;
Ama nahsah moa johdoh ho,
Anah sun’a khaisang ho.
Kap’a peng diu, (3 vei)
Messiah au tengu le.

Verse 3
Sumkon gin kichat amut teng,
Van leh lei jam mangta ding ;
Ama vetdase lung dong ding,
Kouna thupeh O ja ding.
Thupi tanna, (3 vei)
Muna chu diu tonsot’a.

Verse 4
Tonsot lhatdamna ngah jing ten,
Mudiu loupia hung kilah ;
Vannoi san lou Mithengte sen,
Van laiya Ama mu ding.
Halleluijah (3 vei)
Pathen hung kiah mu diu.

Verse 5
Amen, tin mi jousen lem hen,
Chungnung pen Laltouna a ;
Thahat, loupi Lhandampu ding.
Tonsot Lenggam Ama ding.
Oh, hungloiyin, (3 vei)
Halleluijah hung loiyin.

songs.title: 434. KEIMAN MALAM KANO JINGE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat. (Psalms. 13:3)

Verse 1
Keiman malam kano jinge,
Niseh-in ka machal jinge ;
Ka tao jinge machalna din,
Nei dinsah-in mun chungnunga.

Chorus
Nei phongin lang, nei din sah-in,
Tahsanin gam nom mung kate,
Lungset, kipa vah umna mun.
Nei din sah-in mun chungnunga.

Verse 2
Ka lungin lung olna neilou,
Lung genthei leh kichat mun’a ;
Ka chenna ding in nom tah chu,
Kalung tupna mun chungnunga.

Verse 3
Hesoh leh gentheina gal’a,
Van gamnom kicholdo na a ;
Lung ol leh chamna aume,
Mun nom chungnung Pakai koma.

Verse 4
Ka nga jing mun nom chungnung chu,
Thohgim leh hahsa toh jong leng ;
Vahchoina lan chung gam athong,
Mun noma Pakai nei puiyin.

songs.title: 435. NAHINNA DIN KEIMA NEIVEN!
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Isaiah 45:22)

Verse 1
Na hinna din Keima neiven !
Kouna thupeh ngaiyun !
Man beiya lhatdamna thu hi,
Gamtin’a seiphong len !

Chorus
Na hinna din Keima neiven,
Leiset chunga um ten !
Na Pathen’u kahijeh-in,
Na hinna din Keima neiven.

Verse 2
Cross chunga ka um nei veuvin,
Set pohna lengvaite ;
Naset jal’un genthei ka thoh,
Nei tahsan jinguvin.

Verse 3
Na Pakai thoudohpa neiven,
Lhepna muthim phat sung ;
Hepina man beiya pe ding,
Satan jong nehjou ding.

Verse 4
Na hinna din neive jingin,
Panpi dang nanei poi ;
Ngaidam chamna na-ngaichat teng,
Keima jeng bou neiven.

songs.title: 436. CHRISTAN ADEI MITHENGGALHAT
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat.

Verse 1
Christan adei mitheng gal hat leh midih,
Galsatna muna nang din mun aume ;
Setna vannoiya kijot’un malam non,
Kipa man van khopi em chu isan diu.
Malam nouvin Cross gal mi,
Lung dong louvin, tahsan jingun ;
Malam nouvin Cross gal mi,
Songun Pakai athu ngaiyun ;
Gal jona din nouvin.

Verse 2
Satan lhepnan nitinin eijui jinge,
Hijong le Pakaiya jona i-chang diu ;
Til’a gal hat masate leh hangtah ten,
Malam nouvin lunglhai sel’in in lhungta.

Verse 3
Malam no cheh-un hangtah-in lam jot’un,
Pakai Jesu ve jingun lang tao jingun ;
Amitin chitin Pakaiya hi cheh hen,
Hosana isap teng lei hi ijo diu.

songs.title: 437. CHAMNA LENGPA APENG BETHLEHEMA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Chamna Lenpa apeng Bethlehema,
Hichu gam lailungpen Canaan gam nom ;
Namtin dinga kenga lhun theina ahi,
Chu-a hin le dam twi theng alonge.

Chorus
Aw lunglhai sel’in Naosen Leng penni hin,
Kipah-in saute, cham le lung olna ;
Chitin namtin dingin sochatna ahi,
Nomun lemun Halleluijah tiuvin.

Verse 2
Phalbi dap jan khosot phoinel chunga,
Kelngoi ching hon akelngoi nga pet’un ;
Jankhang laiyin Gabriel’in ahung vil’un,
“Hinna damna Thupha kahinpoi” ati.

Verse 3
Chuin vantil sangjan vanlai jol a,
Hung kilah in chung la ngei asauve ;
Chungnung pen a Pathen loupi na hihen.
Lei chunga kipa leh chamna leng hen.

Verse 4
Kipah-ute chung le noi Leng pen nin,
Van khongpi leh lei khongpi gingto hen ;
Leng jouse Leng leh Pakai jouse Pakai,
Hinlai dam sungin lem’ute Leng Christa.

Verse 5
Kelngoiching hon chu khopi sung jonun,
Solam michingten jong chu kho jonun ;
Chibai boh-in vaichaten anei sunun,
Lengle lalten jong agoubom ahongun.

songs.title: 438. JANTHIP JAN, JAN THENGJAN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Luke 2 : 9)

Verse 1
Janthip jan, Jan theng jan,
Thipchet’in, Vahseh-in ;
Nu-ngah thengsel mi nu toh,
Naosen pengthah thengsel to,
Nomin alum e. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Janthip jan, Jan theng jan,
Kelngoi ching ho tijan ;
Vana loupina hung lang,
Van min sam’un, Halleluiyah,
Lhandampu apeng. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Jan thip jan, Jan theng jan,
Chapa lungsetna vah ;
Na mithenga kon kilang,
Lhatdohna ngailut toh ;
Pakai Christa peng.

songs.title: 439. KAHEI, KALHANDAMPU AHING’E
songs.lyrics:
Key. D. Flat. s.

Verse 1
Kahei, ka Lhandampu ahing’e,
Leiset chunga hung kit tei ding ;
Kahei, tonsot hin kemlou eipei.
Loupi thahat chungnung anei.

Chorus
Kahei kahei, Jesu chu ahing,
Leiset chunga hung ding kit tei ding ;
Kahei kahei, hinna chu eipei,
Loupi chungnung thahat anei.

Verse 2
Kahei, athu tepsa chu thonlou,
Asei thucheng mangthah ngailou ;
Chonset po kaphe hi mang jongle,
Kamu tei ding Ama olle.

Verse 3
Kahei, kachenna ding eigon peh,
Ama umna keijong cheng ding ;
Kalung kinepna chu ahinpoi,
Akhon nile kei dia hung ding.

songs.title: 440. MAN GANG’UN KHOVAH CHATE HO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Ps. 96:7)

Verse 1
Man gangun khovah chate ho,
Pakai thupehsa ahi ;
Jesu thupha kidang tah hi ;
Hangtah-in lhangsam leuvin.

Chorus
Kon’uvin Christian sepaite,
Manouvin nungchon louvin ;
Christa din pang det cheh-uvin,
Jo na ni ahung naitai.

Verse 2
Kigouvin hinna thu hom din,
Kouna O chu ngai phauvin ;
Pakai thahat chu panun lang,
Amangsa huhdoh loiyun.

Verse 3
Cheuvin gentheite kou khomun,
Lhatdoh dinga thutepsa ;
Geisang louvin koukhom loiyun,
Golvahna ankong um din.

Verse 4
Cheuvin namtin mi jouse chu,
Hil loiyun sochatna thu ;
‘Phat anai’ tin hil loi loiyun,
Kouvun hung lut loiyu hen.

songs.title: 441. VO LUNGSET MUCHI JALSAH-A
songs.lyrics:
Key. Doh is A. Flat.

Verse 1
Vo, lungset muchi jalsah-a,
Lou len bol’a nang ho ;
Muchi chu hung khangtouvin tin,
Aga pha na-at ding.

Chorus
Jing le thai le …. nalam lhah a,
Thutep muchi …. lhah chu ;
Aga min ho …. molle phaiya,
Achaina kigom ding.

Verse 2
Mitlhi pum hijongle tu’vin,
Muchi chu hing tei ding ;
Atoh hah jongle mang ponte,
Pa gasah ding jal’in.

Verse 3
Pathen chang at gopkhom soh ding,
Tong le gim ho jo teng ;
Pao lou kipan sana at nun,
Khomkim tauvin nate.

songs.title: 442. VO KHANGTHAH NUNGAH GOLLHANG HO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Isaiah. 40)

Verse 1
Vo Khangthah nu-ngah golhang ho,
Chapangte huhdoh-uvin ;
Hin puiyin Lhandampu henga,
Alampi hil loiyuvin.

Chorus
Machonun vo nu-ngah golhang,
Thudih lama machonun ;
Puidoh-un muthima umte,
Jing khovah hoi em noma.

Verse 2
Vo Khangthah nu-ngah golhang ho,
Idia igeisang diu ham ?
Mi tamtah Pathen helouva,
Mangthah gam diu ahitai.

Verse 3
Vo Khangthah nu-ngah golhangho,
Mailhai sel’in tongute ;
Hoichana che jeng jongleu hen,
Kipana la sa jingun.

songs.title: 443. VAN GAM CHIHNA THUPHACHUN
songs.lyrics:
Key Doh is A. Flat. (I John, 4:16)

Verse 1
Van gam chihna thupha chun,
Leiset alo soh tai ;
Pathen Chapa Christa kon,
Lungsetna bulhing set.

Chorus
Heuvin kipah tah-in sangun,
Lungset thu kidang tah chu ;
Pathen lungset noiya umin,
Thisanin eisop thengtai.

Verse 2
Pathen kamsung thu a kon,
Chihna kimu ahi ;
Bible a kisun thu chu,
Pathen kamsung ahi.

Verse 3
Pathen lungsetna kimu,
Tahsan vanga ahi ;
Calvary lhanga athin,
Chonset angaidam tai.

Verse 4
Lhagao Thengin eiseipeh.
Chung gam Thupha thu chu ;
Pathen lungsetna thu chu,
Christa thu loupi pen.

songs.title: 444. VAN GAM LHUNG DIA NAKIGOT EM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (John. 12:47)

Verse 1
Van gam lhung dia nakigot em ?
Tahsanun kiging phauvin ;
Koi hile ka thu tahsana,
Van gamnom chu chang inte.

Chorus
Van gam nom … seithei lou,
Lhenchomte dia kisem chu ;
Jon’uvin gamtheng chu,
Jubilee hungkai cheh-un.

Verse 2
Bible Thengin asei thu hi,
Pathenin mihem thu ding ;
Lhagao hinna thuchan asei,
Tahsan un chonset pailhan.

Verse 3
Christaa hin nom jouse chu,
Lhatdamna lam hinhol’in ;
Hinlai chonset pailhahna din,
Lhagao hinna eipeuve.

songs.title: 445. PHAT TININ KEI NEI KITHOPIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D Flat.

Verse 1
Phat tinin kei nei kithopin,
Leiset nisa em lai hin ;
Nei puiyin nei hil’in Pakai hinna lam,
Ei lungsetnau kidangtah chu ;
Lamdih penin hil’uvin,
Kipa na chu eiho a hitalou ham ?
O Pakai lensah-in,
Kipana hinkho damsung noplai hin ;
Lungjin jousen eivop teng,
Pakaiyin eipui len,
Leiset gimna abonchan eipailhah peh.

Verse 2
Hiche leiset thim jing noiya,
Lung mongmon vah le jong leng ;
Ka olmona ding aumpoi O Pakai,
Nangma vahchun eisal emin ;
Chonset jousen eivop teng,
Khovah chate eisosah-in O Pakai.

Verse 3
Jing niso teng nei hin veuvin,
Lungjin jousen eivop teng ;
Pakai tailou adang umlou eihuh ding,
Itih tah le ka dalha dem !
Thimpi jingin eivop hi,
Jing niso teng Huhhingpan eihoidam ding.

songs.title: 446. PAKAI JESU SEPAI DINGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (I Tim. 6:22).

Verse 1
Pakai Jesu sepai dingin,
Nitin anung juiyin ;
Amin theng chungnunna muna,
Lo einei sah diuvem ?

Chorus
Amin theng chungnung min theng,
Ka setna asop lhai !
Mu dia lungtup Lallukhuh chu,
A Cross dop jinga kon.

Verse 2
Thisan twipi galkaina ding,
Cholngahna aum poi ;
Mi thengten eithum peh nau chu,
Pathenin ei panpi.

Verse 3
Hinna pahcha pahna gama,
Kei eipuina ding ngem ;
Kalung tuppen Lallukhuh chu,
Thisan lutah tobang.

Verse 4
Gal dou ding iti tam jong le,
Hatna eipei Jesun ;
Cross dopna kigim jeng jongle,
Pakaiyin eipanpi.

songs.title: 447. AN OPEN BIBLE FOR THE WORLD.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat. (Psalms 119:105)

Verse 1
Bible-in vannoi losoh ding,
Hichu eiho loupina ding ;
Namtin in aloupina chu,
Phattheina haona anei ding.

Chorus
Pathen lungset vahhoi loupi,
Twikhanglen le leiset chunga ;
Kithang jingin sun le janin,
Pathenin eihil tonsot’in.

Verse 2
Sana khopi em sunga chun,
Sun le jana nisa vah jing ;
Mei thim jong kihohdoh soh ding ;
Chonset natoh jong kichai ding.

Verse 3
Eihon Pathen mai imu diu,
Alungset nan sal em jing ding ;
Hiche loupi kamu teng le,
Kei iti ka kipah ta dem !

Verse 4
Choldo na apei lunggimte,
Mit lhi longte jong kihoh soh ;
Thahat apei cholte dingin,
Kumkho a kinepna pe jing.

songs.title: 448. KHANGDONGGALMI GALHATHON
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat.

Verse 1
Khangdong galmi galhat hon kipana la domsangun,
Lamtona thu seiphongun Jesu hing ;
Khatvei nang le kei dia thi isetnau thing chunga pon.
Tun eiho onsah dingin Jesu hing.

Chorus
Setna hunglhung dingle nakhang cheding ngah hih-in,
Na chena jousea kipah tah-in Jesu din san ;
Kipana lan domsangun lei le van’a seiphongun,
Phattheina kipana thu Jesu hing.

Verse 2
Chapangte anom len lai khangdongte dia kipana,
Lei le twilen chunga san Jesu hing ;
Nang le mijouse dia vah chonsete dia mu theina,
Jesua hinna mu dingin Jesu hing.

Verse 3
Jesu hin phattheina thu Leng le Pakai ho Pakai,
Thahat’in Cross domsangin Jesu hing ;
Iki hennau susen eidaltan ho sumang in,
Eiho din thina jouvin Jesu hing.
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

songs.title: 449. JESU LUNGSET KIDANG CHU
450. WHO ARE THESE ?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. (Rev. 7:13)

Verse 1
Meivom kaina chungpeh a khun,
La hung kisa koi sah ham ?
Ami ngailutna le thahat,
Na la ngeitah-in sauvin.
Kelngoi nou thisan thenga,
Avon sopthenga mithengte ahi.

Verse 2
Kelngoi nou chu alamkaiyin,
Ama avahchoi jingui ;
Hinna an’in avah jingui,
Thisan’a lhatdoh sate.

Verse 3
Laltouna kimvel’a touva,
La ngei sa jinga koi ham ?
Leiset gentheina mun dalha,
Vana kicholdo ahi.

Verse 4
Pathen Kelngoi nou lamkaiyin,
Sun le janin atongun ;
Aman van an chun avah-in,
Alhiu atheh hul peh-in.

Verse 5
Amin ngeitah lhatdamna chun,
Theng chungnung Christa anga ;
Amit mu’vin akikhel’un,
Laltouna kimvela chun.

songs.title: 451. PAKAI NANG KANGAILU PEN’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (1 Kings 10:7)

Verse 1
Pakai nang ka ngailu pen’e,
Leiset nopna sangin ;
Ajeh chu Nangman lung neipen,
Hichu ngailutna lung.

Chorus
Mi asang aja ngailutna,
Hillou lai aume ;
Ei suthenga thisan lu chu,
Mi tamtah hillou lai.

Verse 2
Pakai Nangman nei nga jingle.
Keima kicha lou ding ;
Na min ngei ken ka vahchoi ding,
Leiset nopna sangin.

Verse 3
O ka Pakai ka Lhandampu,
Kalung sunga chengin ;
Chuteng kalung kipah jing ding,
Leiset nopna sangin.

Verse 4
O Lhandampu Lhatdam kidang,
Nei thilpeh i-hin tem;
Hitobang kipana hinkho,
Leiya nei ching jingin.

songs.title: 452. KEIMAN LHANDAMPU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Psalms 4:17)

Verse 1
Keiman Lhandampu loupi tah ka neiye,
Lei golngai lhom jongle Lhandampu kanei ;
Aman tun eingah jinge lungset le hepin,
Ka Lhandampu nang Lhandampu jong hinam ?
Nang dingin ka taove ; (3 vei)
Ka taove nang din.

Verse 2
Keiman Pa khat kanei tonsot kinepna,
Thahat le lung ol eipeh kavahchoiye ;
Eihin kouloi tading vana kimu to din,
Nang jong kei toh kilhonin puinan natem !

Verse 3
Von bang leh le loupi tah san ding kanei,
Loupitah a kamu ding ka ngah jinge ;
Vah tah le valtah kasan ni teng chule,
Vo gol nangman jong khat nasan munang katem ?

Verse 4
Chamna kanei luidung bangin aneme,
Leiset golten chuche chamna hekhalou ;
Eihandampu bou apu le eipe ahi.
O nang nakipeh jong hin hetpeh nang ngem !

Verse 5
Jesu na nei teng hil’in athu midang,
Ka Lhandampu nang Lhandampu jong ahi ;
Jauvin Lhandampun loupia a hin puikhom ding,
Na taona Pathenin sanpeh tei nante.

songs.title: 453. THILPHA IMU BANG HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. (Eph. 13:9)

Verse 1
Thilpha imu bang hi,
Koiman amu thei poi ;
Ipau gamthil ahi,
Leiset min mu theilou :
Eikhen ponte ima chan jong,
Pathen ngailut na a konin.

Verse 2
Asanje simthei lou,
A thuhje seithei lou ;
Ngailut chungnung ichan,
Aman simthei lou chu ;
Nangho van a mithengte ho,
Aloupije neihil theiyum.

Verse 3
Leiset amang pantai,
Aphatna jouse toh ;
A thil bol theina le,
Aloupina se jong ;
Lei pahcha hi achul jitai,
Ka-Pakai bou aphai kati.

Verse 4
Leiset gouthil pha le,
Aloupina jouse ;
Ahoina jouse le,
Muthei jouse sangin ;
Ka-Pakai bou alul pene.
Ling lukhuh chu khuh peh jongleu.

songs.title: 454. MALAM JON CHEH-UVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Malam jon cheh-uvin Anungjui jingun,
Eiching paovin eipui le na chan uva ;
Jesu Christa ban thahat tah chu veuvin,
Hatmo te dinjona dingin kithopin.

Chorus
Malam jon cheh-uvin,
Kitoh-in malam jon’un Jesun eipui nai ;
Malam jon cheh … uvin,
Akhon nia loupina ichanna dingun.

Verse 2
Malam jon jinguvin hamhing pha mun lam,
Twi nemheuva alonna le gamthip mun ;
Songthop gama che ding phat lhun teng jongle,
Tahsanun huhhing theina thahat anei.

Verse 3
Vah hoitah mun lam chu jon jinguvin,
Gamla tah mei kaina phaicham chunga chun ;
Sauvin kipana la ilhun kahseuvin,
Sangsom sangjan Halleluijah ati na.

songs.title: 455. HEBREW GAL HINGPA ADILSUHNA MUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E. (Dan. 6:10.)

Verse 1
Hebrew gal hingpa adilsuhna mun,
Jingkah sun nilhah a tao pet ;
Aman indan sunga agel Zion,
I chennau gamla jongle.

Chorus
Na hon nah em kot Jerusalem lam’a,
Hi-a chomkhat galhing tobang jongleu hen ;
Haosapu lentah ahung kitna ding chu
Najah nah em a ni tin’a.

Verse 2
Kicha hih in meilhumpi sung chot ding,
Da hih in lho honga ding jong ;
Huhdoh nan nate Daniel Pathenin,
A vantil hinsol lhante.

Verse 3
Hing jing Pathen chate olmo hih un,
Na sochatna la sauvin lang ;
Na mai ngat’in Zion mol lang veuvin,
Ngah jingun haosa hung ding.

songs.title: 456. KIPANAKEMLOU EIHO DIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Kipana kemlou eiho dia,
Jesu Christa vang ahi ;
Pathen cha tia kivona,
Min jong eipeuve eiho din.
Pathen cha tia kikou gol eiho cheng,
Tua ipi soh ding ham ti hetloulai ;
Pakai imuteng le ihet diu, Pakai imuteng ihet diu,
Pakai mel banga eiho ium diu ;
Aloupina eihoa hiding.

Verse 2
Pakai alungsung vahsel ding,
Limgehcha Pathen mu ding ;
Thengsel’a ahung vah teng,
Eihuhhingpau imu cheh diu.

Verse 3
Lungsetna avou kikhel ding,
Pakai mel iput dingu ;
Christan eiteppeh tauve,
Pakaiya chan eiho ding chu.

songs.title: 457. HINNA CHANGLHAH HOM’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B Flat.

Verse 1
Hinna changlhah hom’in Pakai kei din,
Dil len panga changlhah nahom bang chun ;
Na hinna lekhabua Nang kaholle,
Ka lungin ngaijin Nahinna Thupha.

Verse 2
Na thu phatthei boh in Pakai keidin,
Galileea changlhah phatthei naboh bang ;
Soh channa kihenna bul kilhapna,
Chuteng nanga chamna ken muta ding.

Verse 3
Lhagao theng hin sol’in tun ka chunga,
Aman kamit tham hen eimu sah hen ;
Nangma thutah keima nei hil jingin,
Na Thupha bua kon ken Nang mu tange.

Verse 4
Hinna changlhah nahi Pakai kei din,
Nangma thutah chun kei eihuhhing tai ;
Neh a hintheina din keima neipen,
Ngailutna hinna thu chu neihil’in.

songs.title: 458. KEI PAKAI HINKHOA LEN KANOM’E
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Kei Pakai hinkhoa len kanome,
Jesu umchan bangin ka umnome ;
Lung ngamtah-in Ama lhachan pang inge ;
Ken tongpan inge Jesun asei bangin.

Chorus
Pakai Jesu kalung sung thensah-in,
Nangma lhachan neipan sah-in Pakai ;
Lungset tah-in keima nei huhhingin,
Nangma hinkhoa len ding ka nom ngeiye.

Verse 2
Jesu hinkho keima dinga ahi ;
Toh theina thahat keima jong neipen ;
Keiman hinna Thupha seiphong leng kate,
Lhagao Thengin keima nei lahlut sah-in.

Verse 3
Jesu hinkhoa kei len kanom ngei,
Lungset O nemin kalung sung sun hen ;
O nei lamkaiyin hoithonaa konin,
Pakai dingin manchah pha nei hisah-in.

songs.title: 459. TWIKHANGLEN SUNGA LHAGAO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat. (I Tim. 1:15)

Verse 1
Twikhanglen sunga lhagao jouse dingin.
Lutsah-in Hinna vah ;
Mitheng dia kouna O nem gin ngei thong chu,
Tang louvin kithang jing hen.

Chorus
Chan soh-in hinna Thupha vah chun,
Salvah-in … muthim gam jouse ;
Ngah jingin alungsetna thu gingchan,
Thang jing hen … twipi gal jong.

Verse 2
Mitheng sangsom sangja van lasah ngei,
Chul louvin long jing hen ;
Phat hi huipi nung banga long jing ahi,
