Chul louvin kithang jing hen.

Verse 3
Gospel a kouna Onem gin ngei thong chu,
Tang louvin ging jing hen ;
Pathen thusom ching dinga eikou nauva,
Lutsah-in Kpana la.

songs.title: 460. MUTHIM LE CHONSETNA LAMPIA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B Flat. (Rev. 21:16-24)

Verse 1
Muthim le chonsetna lampia che ta ponge,
Leiset gimnan eikipa sah lou ;
Van in nom jon’a che te ho nungjui chu kahi,
Ka lampi chun loupina eilhut ding.
Keima lampi ah, (2 vei)
Kei mun loupi jotna lampi aum ;
Songmantam kotpi mun chu,
Lhandampun eingana mun ;
Mun loupi jotna geina lai kahi.

Verse 2
Hinna lampi chu kichi henlang hah jeng jongle,
Ama vah chun eipui le jing nai ;
Keiman Jesu lha lou ding itihchan hi jongle,
Ka jotna mun loupi lhun theina ding.

Verse 3
Lui gal’a khun khopi ningli hoi nomtah aum,
Hiche in chu keima ding ahi ;
Ka kholjin kachai teng keiman Ama kamu ding,
Kei mun loupi jon ka hinalaiye.

songs.title: 461. APHAT DUNGJUIYIN ACHALJING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Aphat dungjuiyin achal jing,
A niseh-in achal jing ;
Leiset chung natoh dalha a,
In lam jonin che tange.
Aphat dung, phat dung juiyin che tange, (2 vei)
Che tange che tange, In lam jonin ;
Aphat dung, phat dung juiyin che tange.

Verse 2
Kum ho dungjuiyin che tange,
Chung le noi thilsem jouse ;
Lung sunga kipana dim jing,
Lengvai genthei adim’e.

Verse 3
Leiset chung mile sangson sangja,
Keiman kajot laise hin ;
Ka che velkol jou phat tengle,
In lam jon a kache ding.

Verse 4
Niseh-in Pakaiya taovun,
Lamdih tah a eipui diu ;
Chu tailou lamdih dang umlou,
Chu bou chu Lamdih ahi.

songs.title: 462. KA UMNA MUNTHENGA UM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. Flat

Verse 1
Ka umna mun thenga um nunnom Huhhing lhatheng
Nei lan lang nei semin Nangma min ;
Hileiyin Nangma bou gel’in tun kei kipah ing,
Hungin kalung natou nan semin.

Chorus
Ka umna munthenga um nunnom Huhhing lhatheng,
Hungin na laltounaa toudin ;
Nei mangin natong din nangma mi kahi jeh-in,
Chu teng neipuiyin van ka in na.

Verse 2
Na ang sunga katao pet hi nunnom Huhhingpu,
Hungin kalung lungset dim sah-in ;
Ka chonset le lungdonna jouse jong sel mangin,
Van chung gam’a din nei hin sem’in.

Verse 3
O Pakai nahou in mithengin nei hin semin,
Nom’a nabusah louna mun chu ;
O athah-in neihin semin lang Huhhing Pakai,
Ka lha le ka pumpi Nang kapei.

songs.title: 463. LEISET MIHEM JOUSEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Leiset mihem jousen Jesu loupina phongun,
Pakai Christa dingin natha neisun phaldoh-in ;
Mi jousen Jesu chibai aboh cheh ding ahi,
Mol le lhang dam phaicham Christa Amaa ahi.

Chorus
Vannoiya hin, vannoiya hin,
Seiphongun Kipana Thupha chu gamtina ;
Christa galjona Cross ponlap chu domsanguvin.
Van mitheng jousen Pakai vahchoi la sau hen.

Verse 2
Vannoi mihemte Jesun athisanin achoi,
Eiho lungsung khangtou ding kipanan chansoh ding,
Lhasam lou ding eiho Pakaiya ihijeh-un,
Cross galjo na chu eiho loupina vah emsel.

Verse 3
Leiset mihemte din thilpha kidang aume,
Umna mun aume van a I-pau in noma ;
Amun tin gamtin a Jesu dingin ding det’un,
Christa lama pang hon galjo na chu alah diu.

songs.title: 464. NALUNGDEIYIN NEI HEIYIN PAKAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is E Flat.

Verse 1
Nalung deiyin nei heiyin Pakai,
Eisempa Nangma nacha keima ;
Nadeilam bang tah in ne i heiyin,
Lung mong le kinem in ka ngah-e.

Verse 2
Nalung deiyin nei heiyin Pakai,
Thachol le lunglha kaum pet hin ;
Thahatna jouse Nanga ahi,
Nei tham’in thahat neipe kit’in.

Verse 3
Nalung deiyin nei heiyin Pakai,
Neikhol chil’in nei patep in tun ;
Buhbang sanga bangjon nei semmin,
Kun’in na anga kahung taove.

Verse 4
Nalung deiyin nei heiyin Pakai,
Naban thahat nin neituh jingin ;
Lhagao Theng kalung sung dimsah in,
Na min kumkhon sei choile tange.

songs.title: 465. CHRISTALE HOUBUNGDIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Christa le Houbung din i-O ging hen,
Eihon ja cheh-ute nunnom Leng chugnung chu ;
Dingu hite lunglhai sel’in gollhang than,
Dettah in dingu te Christa lenggam din.

Chorus
Christa eilhatdoh pau din,
Christa Lhandampu din ;
Houbung din thisanin achoi,
Pakai neithen sah in.

Verse 2
Christa le Houbung din taovu hite,
Juiyu hite niseh in Cross kiput’u tin ;
Lhagao Theng thahat nan kipum peh ute,
Kipah tah in juiyute ijo chan’un.

Verse 3
Christa le Houbung dingin peu hite,
Phat le inei sunnun peu hite Pakai din ;
Peu hite Pakai dingin ijo chan’un,
I nei lungsetna itih a chullou ding.

Verse 4
Christa le Houbung din paiju hite,
Kitomo kichat chule kiletsah jouse ;
I hinkhou kinepna loupin dimta hen,
A jet lam’a dia eikou niteng chule.

songs.title: 466. HOUBUNGKINGAPNAKHATBOU
467. LUNGSET THENG, LUNGSETCHUNGNUNGPEN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B Flat. (1 Jn 4:8)

Verse 1
Lungset theng, lungset chungnung pen,
Leiya van kipa hung kum ;
Ka lah uva hung cheng denin,
Hepina lallukhuh to ;

Chorus
Ngailut jouse kimna nahi,
Lungset, Atheng nang nahi ;
Na sochatna hinpo lhan lang,
Hung lut’in lungsung jousea.

Verse 2
Na ngailut lhagao hai khumin,
Lungthim genthei ho jousea ;
Nangma a hisohna dingin,
Choldona musoh nadin ;
Chonset lunggel tolmang soh in,
Alpha le Omega hin ;
Tahsanna in nei phutdet’un,
Chamlhat sah in kalungu.

Verse 3
Nei hung lhadoh un Hat chungnung,
Na lungsetna nei peuvin ;
Hung loiyin dalha kitlou din,
Keiho phatthei neiboh jingun,
Jen jing dingin nangma bou ;
Tao le vahchoina tang louvin,
Lungsetna a loupi din.

Verse 4
Tun vang chaitan nathil semthah,
Boh beh lou le theng tah in ;
Sochatna chu mutau vinge,
Nanga hi chamkim tah in ;
Loupina a kon loupi cheh,
Van’a mun kalo na diu ;
Lallukhuh ka kisan uva,
Nangbou ka vahchoi jing diu.

songs.title: 468. KUM PHALAI CHENG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Kum phalai cheng ka sumang joutai,
Pakai Cross a athi gel louvin ;
Keima jal’a Calvarya athi helouvin.
Lungset chungnung manbeiya kimu,
Sim theilouvin ngaidam ka chang tai ;
Ka lhagao pohgih pon chamna nei Calvarya.

Verse 2
Pathen thu a kon ka chonsetna,
Ka simdoh in ka kithing thingin ;
Ka lhagaovin Calvary lam agaldot geiyin.

Verse 3
Tun ijakai Jesu kape tai,
Kipah in ka lengpan kanei tai ;
Tun ka lhagaovin Calvary la bou sa tante.

Verse 4
Ngailutnan sochatna ahin pei,
Manbeiyin mihemten amutai ;
Calvaryn Pathen le mihem akankhom kit tai.

songs.title: 469. O HOIYAUM TAUVEM CHANG ATHO
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. Moderato.

Verse 1
O hoiya um tauvem chang at ho chu,
Chonset buleiya changphal khom ho chu ;
Thutah koite kenga chang atjou ding,
Atjou masang sea cholnga lou ding chu.

Chorus
Hoi ham chang at ho ? Koi pen hung ding ?
Changkhop khomjou chang ai loupina lha ding ;
O koi ham eikithopi diuvah,
Chonset buleiya changphal khomtup ding.

Verse 2
Lamdih jot’in amangsa holdoh in,
Ham sang jongle buleiya chang um thei ;
Chule lamlen ho jong galong soh in,
Van sal inna din hin khomtup soh in.

Verse 3
Chang ho gam tin’a a min pan tauve,
Vannoiyin chang atphat a ngah lel-le ;
Natong alhomin, chang at ding atam,
Natoh loi louleh tamtah mangthah ding.

Verse 4
Koite kengin hungdoh un mihemte,
Atkhom soh un sana changvui ho chu ;
Tong jingun louneipa hung masang sen,
Chang ai golnop kipana a lha ding.

songs.title: 470. HI LEISETNAKAKHOLJIN LAI SUNGHIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Hi leisetna ka kholjin lai sung hin,
Molsang vumma le phaicham a jong ;
Jesun nungsun pong nge ei ti jeh in,
Ama thutep chu thon ngailou ding.

Chorus
Van gam vah a chun, van gam vah a chun,
Ka lhagao galjouva leng tading ;
Halleluijah tin Pakai lemin,
Vahchoi tange tonsot tonsot’in.

Verse 2
Kavel’a thimpin eibom jeng jongle,
Ka Pakai chu selmang dehlou ding ;
Ama chu thimpin hin nai theilou ding,
Keiman Ama jui jing jeng tange.

Verse 3
Nisun vah a chun kipah in cheng ting,
Chunga ka innom jon jing ing ting ;
Ama vahchoi pumin che jing tange,
Lungsetna nisa vah noiya hin.

songs.title: 471. KEN NALAM TONG’E JINGKAH LE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat
. 1. Ken nalam tonge jingkah le,
Solam kotpi hoi phunga ;
Tahsan dettah in kholjin’in,
Phat homlel get’in nate.
Ken lamtonge, Ken lam tonge,
Chung gama solam kotpi hoi phunga ;
Ken lam tonge, Ken lam tonge ;
Ken lam tonge jing khovah teng chung gama.

Verse 2
Man gangun gam loupi jon din,
Kotpi phunga nei ngah’un ;
Jing khovah teng kei hunging ting,
Nei ngah sot pouvin nate.

Verse 3
Na meivah-u devah jingun,
Mou neipu hung ngah jingun ;
Hiche khopi hoi sunga chun,
Ama toh ilen khom diu.

Verse 4
Iti noptan tem chung khopi,
Mitheng hon einga jing nau ;
Kilamto loupi ni hinte,
Solam kotpi hoi phunga.

songs.title: 472. PATHENIN MIHEMTE SOCHAT THEINADINGIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A Flat. (John 3:16.)

Verse 1
Pathenin mihemte sochat theina dingin,
Achapa chang khatseh chu ahinpe tai ;
Koi hijongle atahsan chan mangthah louva,
Tonsot hinkemlou manbeiya amu ding.

Chorus
Mihemte din sochatna ahin polhai,
Calvarya Christa thisan lonjal ahi ;
Sangin na hinna din Calvarya thipa,
Chuteng nachonset pohgih beisoh tading.

Verse 2
Vannoi themmo chansah ding hilou Chapa chu,
Atahsan chanin tonsot hinna nei ding ;
Atahsan lou chu tonsotna themmo chang ding,
Ahinkho nang le kei dingin ape tai.

Verse 3
Tunin nangma jong huhhing dingin nakouve,
Pathen lungsetna manbeiya kimu chun ;
Koi hijongle hung hen manbeiyin kilah hen,
Tonsot hinkemlou Pathenin apeh hi.

Verse 4
Chonset ngaidamna hi Christa thisan ahi,
Ka lhagao din tonsot olna apetai ;
Hijeh chun kahinkho Amadin petange,
Ka Pakai nadei bang tah in nei mang tan.

songs.title: 473. JESU DIAMUN ONGNANEI NAM?
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat. (S & A) (Rev. 3:20)

Verse 1
Jesu dia mun ong nanei nam ?
Na chonset pohgih apoi ;
Na kot akiuve lut ding tin,
Chonsen nalutsah ding ham ?

Chorus
Mun ong loupi Leng Jesu din,
Kinon tun athu ngaiyin ;
Na lungsung kot chu hong lennin ;
Lutsah in aphatcha hin.

Verse 2
Mun ong nople kiveina dia,
Hin, a kithat Christa din ;
Mun ong umnam alutna ding,
Athilona lung sunga.

Verse 3
Jesu dia phat ong nanei nam ?
Lungset’in nakou kitne ;
O tuni ahi lah phat cha,
Jing teng phat kile maithei.

Verse 4
Mun le phat ongpen Jesu din,
Lungset nikho aman teng ;
Nalung daiya dalha tei ding,
Tang ding huhhingpan nakou.

songs.title: 474. MICHONSE TEHO KITHANA.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C. (Luke 23:44)

Verse 1
Michonsete ho kithana Calvary Cross,
Chua chun ka Pakai akhaiyun ;
Melma simjou loute chun themmo achan’un,
Chonse kei ding’a hinna ahi.

Chorus
Vanlal leng Pakai ahi,
Leiya genthei tintang thohpa chu ;
Melmate chun thinga khaisang jong leu,
Michonse keima eilhatna ahi.

Verse 2
Angailut numeite chun Ama ajuiyun,
Aloiten vang adalha taove ;
Jerusalem chanute nangho din kap’un,
Namtin din kahinna ka petai.
HOUBUNG LA HOUBUNG LA

Verse 3
O ka Pakai thinin van lung angui jeng tai,
Nisan jong avah pe ngam louvin ;
Thimpi ahung jingin lingpi akihot’e,
Chonse kei dinga Pakai thinin.

Verse 4
Ana ngeiye Pakai keidia na thohna chu,
Chonse keidin nahinna napei ;
Nei lungsetna sajoulou kahinlai khankhon,
Ka hinna nangdin kapei Pakai.

songs.title: 475. LHANDAMPU CHU AKAIYUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.(Beat ni a lhe ding ) (John 19:18)

Verse 1
Lhandampu chu a kaiyun a melmate chun,
Calvary lhanga ;
Alua linglukhuh pum’in Cross kiput sah un,
Cross chunga chun akhenbeh ui.
Ana ngeiye, O i Pakai thohna chu,
Aathisan long chun ;
Chonse keima eilhatdoh tai.

Verse 2
Nisa jong vahngam louvin amai asellin,
Thimpi a jinge ;
Leiset’in thohjou louvin lingpi kihot’in,
Laiya songpi a keh gamtai.

Verse 3
Iti kidan’a hitam ka Pakai thi ni,
O van lengpa chu ;
Asemsa van le lei jong a kithing soh in,
O vankho jong a ngui jeng tai.

Verse 4
Lungin jong kamil thei poi ka Pakai thina,
Calvary lhang hoi ;
Mitin’in na lhatdamna a mutheina din,
Na tonsot kho hungvah loi hen.

songs.title: 476. HUNGIN LENGHATCHUNGNUNG
songs.lyrics:
Doh is C.

Verse 1
Hungin Leng hat chungnung,
Namin lansau vingnge, Thangvah unge;
Ka Pau loupi chungnung, Ima jousea galjou,
Kei dingin Leng hung hin, Tonsot Pathen.

Verse 2
Hungin Thu muthei soh,
Na chemjam kengin lang, Ka tao nauva;
Hung lhan phatthei boh in, Pachanna thu hungpen,
Ka chunguva thenna, Lhagao hungin.

Verse 3
Hungin Lhamonna theng,
Ka pangui Nang dingin, Tu pet hin jong;
Hat chungnung Nang nahin, Lungsunga hung busan,
Potdoh louhel dingin, Hatna Lhagao.

Verse 4
Thum’a kilang Nangbou,
Tonsot thangvah na hin, Tukal’in jong;
Nalet nalalna chu, Loupin mujing unge,
Tonsot tonsot geiyin, Lungset Pakai.

songs.title: 477. MALAIYA PATHENIN ANASEISA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Malachi3:8)

Verse 1
Malaiya Pathennin ana seisa,
Kagam ga chu neihin peuvin ati ;
Tin hopsam’a khat chu angeh jing ahi,
Hongphal tah in nei peuvin ati.

Chorus
Vo lhatdamsa te ho kitah uvin,
Lepthol umlou hel’a te ho chunga ;
Van kotkhah hin honging ting ajat simsen lou,
Ka hin buhlhah peh ding ahi ati.

Verse 2
Na lousoh ho jong na ki im jingin,
Akum seh in neichom jing jeng tauvin ;
Kalung han na chunguva hung lhung ding kon,
Ahitai tin Pathenin asei.

Verse 3
Christa lenggam’a dia kitoh khom ho,
Pathen nei ho sum le chang jouse chu ;
Sumthoi changthoi dingin nahom jou tauve,
Them ikichannui ibol jouseu.

Verse 4
Dihna neilou Houbung asoh gam tai,
Noah nikho lai ahung lhung kittai,
Pakai thupeh ho donlouvin aum tai,
Tutah in nalung khel’in sopi.

Verse 5
Pakaiyin a lei manna hin ben teng,
Iti na donbut ta ding’em sopi ;
Kihong phajou nange tia nakigel’em,
Ka le hagelna mun nachan ding.

songs.title: 478. MALAIYIN PATHENIN ABRAHAM CHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B flat (Heb. 11:17)

Verse 1
Malaiyin Pathenin Abraham chu,
Ana patep in atahsanna;
Achapa neiseun Isaac athum peh-e,
Abraham din phatthei channa ahitai.
Na tahsan chu natoh-in mi vetsah in,
Pakai kipah inte;
Nang le kei jeh in min Pakai amu thei poi,
Nachonna in phonglen lang;
Natoh-in vetsah le chun,
Nathusei miten hethei tante.

Verse 2
Vo sopi Pakai natahsan nah em?
Nahuhhing nakihet chet hinam?
Nitin adei lam bol’a napan hinam?
Phochenin lang gangtah in ngaito loiyin.

Verse 3
Nei le gou Pakai dia naphal hinam?
Sum le pai idia na it ji ham?
Abraham gel’in pedoh jengin sopi,
Nang jong phattheina seijoulou nachan ding.

Verse 4
Vo sopi nikho le phat ong jouse,
Nangma din nitin nahomtho jing;
Nahuhhing Pakai din phat nanei jipoi,
Natahsan le hangtah in kiphal jengin.

songs.title: 479. PAKAIYIN KATHIL KANEI JOUSE CHU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Malachi3:8-10)

Verse 1
Pakaiyin kathil le kanei jouse chu,
Nanghon nasel’uvin nagu’ve ati;
Nathil nei jouse lah a som’a khat chu,
Neipeh le nei theina vang chu kapeh ding.
Na nei jouse chu it louhel’in,
Hopsom’a hopkhat chu nei hinpe jing jengun;
Phattheina tanglouva ka peh ding,
Vangam kot ka hon ding phattheina
Nachunga hung lhung ding ahi;
Anneh lhingsel’a kapeh ding nahi,
Pakaiyin chunga leng ju le va jong kaneh sah lou ding,
Pakaiyin ati, Neipeh ding ham neipeh lou ding ham,
Ti in Pakaiyin ati.

Verse 2
Pakaiyin kathil chu gu hih-un ati,
Pakaiyin kathil ati jouse vang chu;
Na tohga sunga konna som’a khat chu,
Pakaiyin keima thil jeng ahi ati.

Verse 3
Nalousoh sunga konin som’a khat chu,
Selmang louhel’in somma khat chu koiyun;
Hiche banga napeh le phattheina chu,
Tantih neilouva namu jing ding ahi.

Verse 4
Pathen thil asel le agu jouse chu,
Nikhat kah le jankhat kah-a mangthah ding;
Pathen thil som’a khat chu napeh vangle,
Haotheina damtheina jouse ka peh ding.

songs.title: 480. SALEM PHAICHAM’A LA KISA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F.

Verse 1
Salem phaicham’a la kisa,
Ogin lhagao ho khu koi hiuvem ;
Zion lhanga kho kisam O,
Kipana thu theng chu ahi.
Pakai min’na hunga,
Leng chungnung chu loupi hen ;
Pakai min’a hungpa chu tonsot’in nunnom jing hen,
Pakai min’a hungpa chu tonsot’in nunnom hen ;
S.P. – Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana,
Hosana, Hosana.
A.T.B.- Vahchoiyu te Hosana, Hosana, David leng Pakai
min’in, Hosana Hosana.
Tanglou hel’in ; Tanglou hel’in,
Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana.

Verse 2
Veuvin iti kipa umtam,
Leng chungnung chu leng chungnung min’in ;
Hosana tin Hosana tin,
Eiho jousen vahchoiyu te.

Verse 3
Hosana tin Hosana tin,
David chapa Leng chungnung min’in ;
Vanle vannoi leiset jong hi,
Ama min’a jousoh hel ding.

songs.title: 481. PAKAI KELNGOI CHIN’A EICHING
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A flat (Malachi3:8-10)

Verse 1
Pakai kelngoi chin’a eiching,
Keima lhasam pong’e;
Hamhing lah-a eikolsah ji,
Kiling lou twi pang’a.

Verse 2
Pakaiyin katha dosah-in,
Akitepsa bangin;
Lamdih jeng’a eipui le ji,
Amin khohsah jal’in.

Verse 3
Thina phaicham lim jot jong leng,
Ima ka ging tapoi;
Na tenggol’in eihong jing’e,
Nei lhonpi jing jeh-in.

Verse 4
Ka melmate masang’a jong,
Neh ding nei luipeh-e;
Ka lu-a thao nei nupeh-in,
Ka don ding khon letlhan.

Verse 5
Hinkhon phatna le hepinan,
Eijui jing jeng’in tin;
Ka hin kumkhoa Pakai Inna,
Kachen den ding ahi.

songs.title: 482. CHONSETNAN EINACHUPTAN
483. EILHANDAMPUN ANASEIYE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. Flat.

Verse 1
Eilhandampun anaseiye,
Hiche lai nikho chun ;
Tunin jong asei nalaiye,
A O gin ngei kahei.
Nangho cheuvin, Cheuvin tin asei jinge ;
Nangho cheuvin, Thupha mijouse peuvin.

Verse 2
Lhandampun thupeh ananei,
Eiho hamphat na din ;
Athu ngai jouse kipana,
Ahi ding anahei.

Verse 3
Lhandampun manlu thupeh khat,
Hichu vannoi dinga ;
Ei ngailut nau athuhje,
Eihetsah nom’u ahi.

songs.title: 484. CHUNG VANTILTE LASAUVIN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Chung vantilte la sauvin, Noi leiset hoiling sohta;
Mol le lhang phaicham jousea, Kipana la thong sohta.
Lou…..pipen, Achungnungpen Pathen,
Lou…..pipen, Achungnungpen Pathen

Verse 2
Kelngoi chingho Jubilee, Kipanana la tang talou,
Kipana thu ihintem? Vanna la ngei kisa khu !

Verse 3
Bethlehem’a hung veuvin, Vantilten alem naosen,
Pakai Christa leng pengthah, Dilsun chibai boh-ute.

Verse 4
Chung vantilten avahchoi, Gan ankong sung’a naosen,
Ngailut lunggui jan’utin, Mary Joseph sang’ute.

songs.title: 485. O BETHLEHEM LHANGHOI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G. (Micah 5:2)

Verse 1
O Bethlehem lhanghoi ka Lhandampu penna,
Juda khopi lah a aneopen nahi poi ;
Ka mite ching ding chu hung pengdoh ding ahi,
Themgao thusei bangin tunin aguilhung tai.

Chorus
O hunglem cheh un Lhandampu Pakai,
Van mithengten jong kipa la asauve ;
Van le lei agomsoh tai Lhandampu Pakai chun,
Ama vahchoina la kisa chim talou ding.

Verse 2
Vo jinlhun in hompa idia lungmol nahim,
Leng ho leng lhunna ding mun hoilai ba hitam ?
Genthei le hesoh in Pakai le ka Leng chu,
Bong in lham noiya chun O ahung lhung jeng tai.

Verse 3
O akidang ngeiye Lhandampu pen ni hin,
Kelngoi chingho henga kipana alhung tai ;
A-kelngoiyu dalhan chibai aga boh-ui,
Keiman jong cheng kate naosen leng lem ding chun.

Verse 4
Na lhunna ding umlou hinoi leisetna hin,
Kalung sung bong in hi hin semthah kit’in lang ;
Kalung laigil’a hin hung chengin ka Pakai,
Tonsot’in Nangma toh chengkhom jing jeng tange.

songs.title: 486. HUNG’UN GALEM’UTE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D. Psalm 19

Verse 1
Naosen pengthah kidang tah chu,
Achunnu Maryn apom;
Vantil hon la ngeiyin lem’un,
Kelngoi ching hon jong alem.

Chorus
Hung’un galem’ute,
Mihem chapa apeng tai;
Vantil ho la sah chun;
Kelngoi ching hon jong alem’uve.

Verse 2
Gan ankong’a lum Lhandampu,
Thuguh chu aphongdoh tai;
Chonset a kon sochatna chu,
Kineo sahna thu ahi.

Verse 3
Hijeh chun mijouse hung’un,
Huhhing a leng apeng tai;
Kipa thilpeh le ngailut thon,
Sang cheh-ute ilengpau.

songs.title: 487. GAM JOUSEAPHONGUN PAKAI THU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D Flat. (1 Tim. 1:15)

Verse 1
Gam jousea phongun Pakai thu,
Po leuvin twipi gal’a ;
Seipeh-un chonsete henga,
Muthim gam vahsoh kahsen.

Chorus
Gam jousea seiphong leuvin,
Po leuvin twilen gal a ;
Pakai thu phongun gamtin a,
Vahchoiyun Amin kumkhon.

Verse 2
Kipana thu hi seileuvin,
Khovah pha amu theinan,
Muthim umna gam jouse chu,
Vahsah un jan muthim gam.

Verse 3
Kipana thu seichoi lenge,
Mol le lhangdam phaicham a ;
Jesu thu mun jousea sei ding,
Ahuhhingna thahat chu.

Verse 4
Namdang dinga katao pet’un,
Thanom tah-in kithopin ;
In le louva sumil louvin,
Jesu igam diu hihen.

songs.title: 488. SILOM TWIKUL MOLLIM NOIYA
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. Flat. (Eccles. 12:1)

Verse 1
Silom twikul mol lim noiya,
Pahcha namtui keh chu ;
Iti namtui tam mol noiya,
Saron pah mum hoi chu. (2 vei)

Verse 2
Hibang chun tulai khang chapang,
Hoi keichan apenge ;
Alungu thengsel nemheu chan,
Pathen lam asangui. (2 vei)

Verse 3
Silom tuikul mol lim noiya,
Pahcha chu pul teiyin ;
Mol noiya pahcha namtui chu,
Thonmoa mol loi jita. (2 vei)

Verse 4
Mihemte jong chutobang ding,
A hinkho alhin teng ;
Athi ding lung leng olmo ding,
Thon moa la thi tei ding. (2 vei).

songs.title: 489. TWIKHANGLEN BANG LUNGSETNA HI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Twi khanglen bang lungsetna hi,
Twilet banga khoto na ;
Hinna Pakai theng thina chu,
Eilhatdohna thi ahi ;

Chorus
Koi ham Angailut nahsah moa,
Vahchoi louva um thei ding ?
Tang louhel’in van um laisen,
Koiman miljou thei ponte.

Verse 2
Ven Calvary lhang chunga chun,
Thupi giltah kehjah ta :
Pathen ngailut nan atin val,
Atumkeh iti phat tam !
Pathen ngailut le hepina,
Mihem lama along kop ;
Phatna le ngailut kitoh-in,
Leiset mopoh anouvui.

songs.title: 490. LOUJAO HO VEN CHANG AMINTAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Loujao ho ven chang amintai,
Mijouse natong dinga;
Pakai kouna o khu ngaiyun,
Chang at dia kouna ahi.

Chorus
Lhomcha tampi sosah thei Pathen,
Loupina dia tong hilou;
Jesu minna vaikon jouse,
Lallukhuh sang ding ahi.

Verse 2
Toh ding’a na nakipe chu,
Mite musit pen hikham?
Pathenin nakithopi ding,
Aman nang panpin nate.

Verse 3
Lei hinkho akichai tengle,
Lei natoh kichai tading;
Pakai dia tongpha nahile,
“Kacha nabol phai” tinte.

songs.title: 491. LOUPI PEN ALOUPI VAHCHOIYUN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. flat

Verse 1
Loupipen aloupi vahchoiyun,
Thahat loupi chungnung Jesu bou ahi;
Loupipen Lenggam le thuneina,
Alaltouna mun’a kona kipan ahi;

Chorus
Seiphong’un domsang leuvin Pakai Jesu min,
Vahchoiyun, seiphong leuvin Christa Jesu leng;
Loupipen aloupi vahchoiyun,
Kithat Jesu vahchoi cheh-un leng jouse Leng

songs.title: 492. PATHEN THU HI ITI NGEITAM
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. flat

Verse 1
Pathen thu hi iti ngeitam chonse lunghei sah thei,
Pathen thu hi dihtah ahi, lunglhom achihsah thei.
O na danthupeh hi o iti dei umtam!
Hichu nilhum keiyin kagel jing’e;

Verse 2
Pathen thupeh dihtah ahi, lungsung’a kipana,
Pathen thupeh thengtah akon, mitchon kho amu tai.

Verse 3
Pathen gin chu chihna ahi tonsot thohhat jingna,
Pathen thutan dihtah ahi Achon phatna jong theng.

Verse 4
Pakaiyin nang nahil jinge, Ahinkho umchan thu,
Ajou chan’in asan thei tohman koisan aum.

songs.title: 493. IJON’UI CANAAN PONLAP
songs.lyrics:
Doh is F. (Exo. 32:26)

Verse 1
I jonnui Canaan ponlap le zaila thon,
Set galdou dia kipedoh sepai ihiu ;
Gal chun ithahatnau athejal thei ding,
Pakai lama pang ding koipen ihiuvem ?

Chorus
O koiham thudih a Pakai lama pang ding ?
Ama panhua alama pang ding koi ham ?
O koi ham thudih a Pakai lama pang ding,
Ama panhua alama pang ding koi ham ?

Verse 2
Chemjam le gal manchah duljeju kengin,
Satan mai vantil bangin vah jeng henlang ;
Thim thuneina gil hen tijat um jongle,
Pakai hatna jal’a jona ichan diu.

Verse 3
Pathen mihepi ngaidam heloulaiya,
Set vaihomna noiya um nalaija koi ham ?
Na kiletsahna kingai tom’in hungin,
Kinon nanga pet hin Pakai kom bel’in.

Verse 4
Hesoh natna le chon dihlouna geldan,
Khoisat le jaila sah kikhel loi tading ;
Kitepma kaihoipa thingpel chu pua,
Jona isap diu Pakai lama keima.

songs.title: 494. O NGAILUTNA KHONTIH NEILOU
songs.lyrics:
Doh is B. flat

Verse 1
O ngailutna khontih neilou, Pakai Jesu ngailutna
Twipi kinong sangtah bangin kapumpin eichup soh tai;
Kachung, kanoi, kakimvel’a, aholnan ahinna pen,
Ama ho din atao jinge, Aman kei eidom sang tai.

Verse 2
O ngailutna khontih nei, Twi gal tinna poleuvin,
Amilungset khontih neilou, kikhel lou atonsotna;
Alungsette avejing’in, aholnan ahinna pen,
Ama ho din atao jing’e, vanna kon avejing’e.

Verse 3
O ngailutna khontih neilou, Ngailut chungnungpen ahi,
O ngailutna twikhanglen bang, Kacholdona gam ahi;
Pakai ngailutna asang’e, Kadin van lenggam ahi,
Loupi tah-in eikhang sang’e, Aman kei eidom sang tai.

songs.title: 495. PATHEN LEKHABU BIBLE
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Pathen lekhabu Bible, Jesu thutah ahil’e,
Van In jotna lampi ahi, Vanna ikaltou diu.
O Bible O Bible, ka ngai ka lhalel ngeiye.
O Bible O Bible, Pathen lekhabu hi.

Verse 2
Pathen lunggel agilje, Lei mite setna jouse,
Damna ding thu ahilchen’e, Thu lu tah ahiye.

Verse 3
Jesu Bible apha-e, Pathen thilpeh ahiye,
Thina thokitna ahil’e, Hinna thu ahiye.

Verse 4
Janna thaomei vah bang’in, Athun lungsung asalvah,
Gou lutah sangin alujoi, Lunggil’a kachin ding.

songs.title: 496. THIPCHET-UVIN PATHEN KAHI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Thipchet-uvin Pathen kahi, (3)

Verse 2
Nathahatsah Pakai kahi, (3)

Verse 3
Nei umpiuvin Pakai Pathen (3)

songs.title: 497. NEI KHOLCHIL’IN
songs.lyrics:
Doh is D.

Verse 1
Nei khol chil’in o ka Pakai tunin,
Ka bol ka toh jouse nahesoh nai;
Chondih louna lampia lamvai kahi,
Ka chonset siltheng’in nei thensah-in.

Verse 2
Vo ka Pakai nei siltheng kanom’e,
Na thupha chun kalung gel sutheng’in,
Ka chonsetna lhagao meiyin hal’in,
Na min loupi vahchoi din nei sem’in.

Verse 3
Vo ka Pakai kapumpi kilah-in,
Kalung sunga na ngailut dimsah-in;
Ka lhinlel le ka hatmo nahe nai,
Pakai keiman nang ka pedoh soh tai.

Verse 4
O lhagao theng ka hatna nang nahi,
Kalung sunga nang natong’a nahi;
Ka ngaichat jouse neipe bukim’in,
Tonsot a nang ka vahchoi theina din.

songs.title: 498. NAZERETH JESU KAMUNIN.
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A.flat.

Verse 1
Nazareth Jesu kamunin,
Lungdong datmon ka ding’e;
Chonse, themo, miboh keima,
Iti eingailut hitam !

Chorus
Akidang’in amah ngeiye!
Tonsotna ka la ngeipen,
Akidang’in amah ngeiye!
Eilhatpa’n eingailutna.

Verse 2
Hon sung’a kei jeh-in taovin,
“Hepa nalungdei hi hen;
Athoh gim mitlhi soh louvin,
Kei din ul thisan in long.

Verse 3
Vanna kona vah hung’a chu,
Vantilten dip dam’in ven;
Athoh genthei hu ding umlou,
Ka chonset aman apoi.

Verse 4
Ka chonset pohgih le thepmo,
Achung’a akisim tai;
Ka chonset jeh-in Calvarya,
Athoh in ama athi.

Verse 5
Eingailua kei eichodohpa,
Amai kamu ding ahi;
Ka hinkhoa ka kipana pen,
Angailut vahchoi ahi.

songs.title: 499. GOLPHAKIDANGTAH KAMUTAI
songs.lyrics:
Doh is A. (Prov. 18:24)

Verse 1
Golpha kidangtah kamu tai,
Eina lungset kahet man ;
Ngailut khaogui jin eikai len,
Ama chunga eihen tai,

Chorus
Kalung pumpi sunga avel,
Vel’in aveidet chet nin ;
Kei amaa Ama keija,
Ama tonsot atonsot na.

Verse 2
Golpha kidang tah kamu tai,
Hepina adimset’in ;
Lamkai chingtah le thumop them,
Mihang thanei chungnung pen;
Hibang tah a eilungset them,
Hinna thina leiset le ;
Damun in eikhen theilou ding,
Tonsot’a kei Ama ding.

Verse 3
Golpha kidang tah kamu tai,
Eihuhhing din anathi ;
Thisan le Ahinna jeng jong,
Tun keima keija hilou ;
Tun keima keija hitalou,
Akipe doh pa a joh ;
Lungthim thahat hinna kanei,
Tonsot’a ama a ding.

songs.title: 500. HUNG’O, HUNG’O, IMMANUEL
songs.lyrics:
Doh is G.

Verse 1
Hungo, hungo, Immanuel,
Soh a kon lha ong Israel ;
Lungdongin amao mi gam’a,
Pathen chapa hung masangsen.
Kipah uvin,
Immanuel, na umpi ding vo Israel.

Verse 2
Hungo, hungo, Pakai chungnung,
Malai Sinai mol meilah a ;
Amite koma loupi le,
Hulen tah a thusom peta.

Verse 3
O hungo, David phungpi bul,
Thim thuneina kon potdoh in ;
Damun palta na mite chun,
Lhankhuh chunga galjou molso.

Verse 4
Hungo, chamkang ninou bang chan,
Hin suhal’in kalhao nguisa ;
Muthim meipi jing semhoh in,
Thina lim thimpi del mangin.

Verse 5
O hungo Nang David kot-heh,
Kavan in kotpiu hong lenin ;
Hesohna lampi khah tannin,
Bitkeichan neilhut’un chuggam.
